kept together with POKéMON andcarried about.\cYou are a TRAINER, yes?
And your POKéMON radiate vitality.\cSo, what say you?
Will you take this EGG to hatch?

sourceRecords.japanese: タマゴと　いっしょに\nたーっぷり　あるいて　おくれ！
sourceRecords.english: Good! I hope you'll walk plenty with\nthis here EGG!

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nタマゴを　もらった！
あれ？　ポケモン　いっぱいで\nタマゴを　つれて　あるけないよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Oh? You've too many POKéMON.\nThere's no room for this EGG...

sourceRecords.japanese: そうかね‥‥\cまあ　タマゴを　かえしたく　なったら\nまた　はなしかけて　おくれよ
sourceRecords.english: As you wish, then...\cIf you have a change of heart about\nhatching this EGG, I will be here.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンの　タマゴは\nときどき　そだてやさんで　みつかる‥‥\cそんな　うわさを　きいたよ
sourceRecords.english: Every so often, an EGG will be found at\nthe POKéMON DAY CARE.\cOr at least that's how the rumor goes.

sourceRecords.japanese: くめども　くめども　おゆが　でる\nポットでも　ないのに　おゆが　でる\c‥‥ふしぎ　じゃろ？\cかざんが　ちかくに　あるところ　では\nちかすいが　ようがんの　ねつで\rあたためられて　いるのじゃよ！
sourceRecords.english: We draw as much hot water as we need,\nand yet the hot springs never run dry.\cIsn't it magical?\cThese hot springs appear near active\nvolcanoes. Veins of water under the\rground are heated by magma to well up\ras hot springs.

sourceRecords.japanese: こうして　すなに　うまっていると\nはあぁ‥‥\cあたたかくって　イイキモチ‥‥\c‥‥ん？　イテテッ！\cしりを　ポケモンに　かまれた！
sourceRecords.english: Being buried in this hot sand is...\nSigh...\cSo warm and heavenly...\cEh? Gyaah! Ouch!\cA POKéMON nipped my backside!

sourceRecords.japanese: おや　あんた\nおんせんが　すき　なのかい？\cまだ　わかいのに　めずらしいねえ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Oh, you like hot springs, do you?\cThat's surprising for one as young\nas you.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたし　アスナさん　みたいに\nすてきで　つよい　ジムリーダーに　なるため\rまいにち　おんせんに　はいってるの！
sourceRecords.english: I bathe in the hot springs every day.\cI want to become a beautiful and strong\nGYM LEADER like FLANNERY.

sourceRecords.japanese: おんせんに　ポケモン　いれると\nでんきぶろや　あわぶろ　はたまた\rようがんぶろに　なって　すごそうだわ
sourceRecords.english: If people put POKéMON in hot springs,\nit might be seriously strange.\cWhy, it might be an electric bath, or\na bubble bath, or even a lava bath...

sourceRecords.japanese: この　おんせんは‥‥\cしんけいつう　きんにくつう　それから\nれんあいのなやみ　おかねもうけ　などに\rこうかてき　なんだとさ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: They're claiming that these hot springs\nare good for calming nervous tension,\rrelieving aching muscles, solving\rromantic problems, and attracting\rmoney...

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　フエン　タウン\nポケセン　おんせん　よいところ
sourceRecords.english: LAVARIDGE TOWN\c“POKéMON CENTER HOT SPRINGS\nAn excellent place for relaxing!”

sourceRecords.japanese: フエン　タウン　ポケモンジム\nリーダー　アスナ\rやけど　しそうな　じょうねつの　ひと
sourceRecords.english: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: FLANNERY\r“One with a fiery passion that burns!”

sourceRecords.japanese: 「ポケモン　かんぽうやく」\nりょうやく　くちに　にがし！
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON HERB SHOP\n“Bitter taste - better cure!”

sourceRecords.japanese: なんだ　なんだ！？\cソライシはかせの　けんきゅうじょに\nあやしい　おとこが　ではいり　しておったぞ！
sourceRecords.english: What's up, what's up?\cI saw a shady fellow scuttling in and\nout of PROF. COZMO's LAB.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここいら　いったいは\nむかしから　いんせきが　おおくてな\cりゅうせいのたきも　いんせきが　おちて\nできたとか　そう　いわれておる
sourceRecords.english: This region's been known for meteors\nsince the olden days.\cThey say METEOR FALLS was gouged out\nby a falling meteorite long ago.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほら！　みてちょうだい！\nわたしの　たいせつな　ルリリ！\cツヤツヤの　ナデナデの　フカフカよ！
sourceRecords.english: See! Take a look!\nThis is my precious AZURILL!\cIt's slick and smooth and plushy, too!

sourceRecords.japanese: ルリリ『るーりーるー

フエンタウンの　ジムリーダー
アスナとは　たたかったかね？\cあのこの　おじいさんは　すごかったよ
なんでも　ポケモンリーグのしてんのう　だった　らしいからね\cきっと　アスナも　これから
すばらしい　トレーナーに　なるだろうね
sourceRecords.english:
Have you already challenged FLANNERY,
the LEADER of LAVARIDGE GYM?\cThe girl's grandfather was famous.
He was one of the ELITE FOUR in thePOKéMON LEAGUE at one point.\cIt wouldn't surprise me to see FLANNERY
become a great TRAINER in her ownright.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンコンテスト　スーパーランク　うけつけ\nはじけろ！　ポケモン　トレーナー！
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON CONTESTS\nSUPER RANK REGISTRATION\c“Burst on to the POKéMON scene!”

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　ハジツゲ　タウン\nちいさな　はたけが　ある　のうそん
sourceRecords.english: FALLARBOR TOWN\n“A farm community with small gardens.”

sourceRecords.japanese: 「わざおしえマニアの　いえ」\nポケモンの　わざ　おしえます！
sourceRecords.english: MOVE TUTOR'S HOUSE\n“New moves taught to POKéMON.”

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしの　パパが　いってたの\cこの　トンネルって　おーきな　おとに\nはんのうして　さわぎだす　おくびょうな\rポケモンが　いっぱい　なんだって！\cだから　かいはつ　こうじ　やめたんだけど\nおとこの　ひとが　ひとりで\rトンネルを　ほろうと　してるんだって！
sourceRecords.english:
My papa told me.\cHe says this tunnel is full of
timid POKéMON.\cThey get all scared of loud noise and
make a big uproar.\cSo they had to stop the big tunnel
project.\cBut there's one man.
He's trying to dig the tunnel by himself!

sourceRecords.japanese: あいする　ひとの　ために\nどうくつを　ほっていた　ひとが　いるの！\cなんだか　すごーい！
sourceRecords.english: There was a man who dug a tunnel for\na lady he loved.\cI don't really get it, but hey!

sourceRecords.japanese: かざむきの　かんけいで　このまち　には\nかざんばいが　とんでくることは　ない！\cくうきの　おいしい　このまちで　くらせば\nからだが　じょうぶでない　ひとでも\rきっと　げんきに　なれる　はずさ！
sourceRecords.english: The way the winds blow, volcanic ash\nis never blown in this direction.\cThe air is clean and delicious here.\nLiving here should do wonders for even\rfrail and sickly people.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくの　ポケモン　かわいさに\nすこし　じしん　でてきたからね\cコンテスト　デビュー　させたくて\nこの　まちに　きたんだ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm feeling a little confident about the\ncuteness of my POKéMON.\cI wanted to make its CONTEST debut,\nso that's why I'm here.

sourceRecords.japanese:
フレンドリィ　ショップの　となりに
どうくつが　あるだろ？\cなかを　ふさいでいる　いわを　こわし
とおれるように　しようと　がんばっているやつが　いるらしいんだ！\cとおれるように　なると　いいのに‥‥
カナズミにも　いきやすく　なるから！
sourceRecords.english:
Did you see the cave next to the
POKéMON MART?\cThere's a guy in there who's trying to
bust up boulders so he can bust outthrough to the other side.\cIt'd be great if we could go through...
It'll make it easy to visit RUSTBORO.

sourceRecords.japanese: フレンドリィ　ショップの　となりの\nどうくつが　とおれるように　なっただろ！\cカナズミまで　デボンの　しんせいひんを\nかいに　いきやすくなって　うれしいよ！
sourceRecords.english: That cave next to the POKéMON MART\nis now a tunnel to the other side.\cIt's great - it's easy to go shop for new\nDEVON products in RUSTBORO now.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　シダケ　タウン\nくさの　においの　かぜふく　こうげん
sourceRecords.english: VERDANTURF TOWN\c“The windswept highlands with the\nsweet fragrance of grass.”

sourceRecords.japanese: 「ミチルの　いえ」
ポケモンコンテスト　ノーマルランク　うけつけ\nあつまれ！　ポケモン　トレーナー！
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON CONTESTS\nNORMAL RANK REGISTRATION\c“Gather here, all ye POKéMON TRAINERS!”

sourceRecords.japanese: カナズミと　シダケを　むすぶ\n「カナシダ　トンネル」\cかいつう　こうじは　ちゅうしに　なりました
sourceRecords.english: RUSTURF TUNNEL\n“Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF\c“The tunnel project has been\ncanceled.”

sourceRecords.japanese: キナギから　カイナへは\nしおの　ながれが　とても　はげしいの\cうかつに　なみのり　すると\nおもわぬ　ほうこうに　ながされちゃう
sourceRecords.english: The sea between PACIFIDLOG and\nSLATEPORT has a fast-running tide.\cIf you decide to SURF, you could end\nup swept away somewhere else.

sourceRecords.japanese: ね！　ね！　すごいでしょ！\nみずの　うえに　おうちが　たってるの！\cぼく　ここで　うまれたんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: See, isn't it neat?\nThese houses are on water!\cI was born here!

sourceRecords.japanese: キナギの　にんげんは\nみんな　つりをしたり　もぐったりして\rせいかつ　してるんだな
sourceRecords.english: The folks of PACIFIDLOG all fish and\ndive as part of the lifestyle.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　キナギ　タウン\nあさひが　みずべを　てらす　まち
sourceRecords.english: PACIFIDLOG TOWN\c“Where the morning sun smiles upon\nthe waters.”

sourceRecords.japanese: たっ　たすけて　くれーっ！！
おーい！　そこの　きみ！\nたすけて　おくれーっ！！\cそこに　ある　カバンに\nモンスターボールが　はいってる！
sourceRecords.english: Hello! You over there!\nPlease! Help!\cIn my BAG!\nThere's a POKé BALL!

sourceRecords.japanese: どっ　どこへ　いくんだ！？\nわたしを　みすてないで　おくれーっ！
sourceRecords.english: Wh-Where are you going?!\nDon't leave me like this!

sourceRecords.japanese: オダマキ『はあ　はあ‥‥\cやせいの　ポケモンを　ちょうさ　しようと\nくさむらに　はいったら\rとつぜん　ポケモンに　おそわれて‥‥\cとにかく　たすかったよ　ありがとう！\c‥‥おや？\cきみは　[PLAYER][KUN]　じゃないか！\cこんな　ところでは　なんだから\nちょっと　けんきゅうじょ　まで　きておくれ
sourceRecords.english:
PROF. BIRCH: Whew...\cI was in the tall grass studying wild
POKéMON when I was jumped.\cYou saved me.
Thanks a lot!\cOh?\cHi, you're [PLAYER][KUN]!\cThis is not the place to chat, so come
by my POKéMON LAB later, okay?

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンが　よわってきたら\nポケモンセンターに　いくと　いいよ！\cポケモンセンターなら　すぐ　ちかく\nコトキタウンに　あるからね
sourceRecords.english: If POKéMON get tired, take them to\na POKéMON CENTER.\cThere's a POKéMON CENTER in OLDALE\nTOWN right close by.

sourceRecords.japanese: やせいの　ポケモンは\nくさむらから　とびだしてくる　からな！\cこうして　くさむらの　なかに　はいって\nつかまえたい　ポケモンを　さがすんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: Wild POKéMON will jump out at you in\ntall grass.\cIf you want to catch POKéMON, you have\nto go into the tall grass and search.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　１０１ばん　どうろ\n[UP_ARROW]　コトキタウン
ミツル『[PLAYER]さん‥‥\nポケモンって　こういう　くさむらに\rいたり　するんでしょ‥‥？\cぼくが　じょうずに　つかまえられるか\nそこで　みてて　くださいね‥‥\c‥‥うわっ！！
sourceRecords.english: WALLY: [PLAYER]...\nPOKéMON hide in tall grass like this,\rdon't they?\cPlease watch me and see if I can\ncatch one properly.\c...Whoa!

sourceRecords.japanese: ミツル『やった‥‥　ぼくの‥‥\nぼくの　ポケモンだ‥‥！！
sourceRecords.english: WALLY: I did it... It's my...\nMy POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]さん　ありがとう！\nジムに　もどろうよ！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER], thank you!\nLet's go back to the GYM!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼく‥‥　せが　ひくいから\nくさむらを　あるくと　もぐっちゃうんだ\cハッパが　はなの　あなに　はいって\nふぁ　ふぁ　ふぁ　ふぁ‥‥\cぶわっくしょーん！
sourceRecords.english: I'm...not very tall, so I sink right\ninto tall grass.\cThe grass goes up my nose and...\nFwafwafwafwafwa...\cFwatchoo!

sourceRecords.japanese: ふふふ　みてて　ごらん！
どうだ？　すごいだろ！\cあがれない　だんさも　うえから　ならば\nとびおりる　ことが　できるのだ！
sourceRecords.english: Ta-daaaah! Awesome, huh?\cThere are some ledges that you can't\nclimb up, but you can jump down.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモン　たくさん　つかまえよーっと！
sourceRecords.english: I'm going to catch a whole bunch of\nPOKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　１０２ばん　どうろ\n[RIGHT_ARROW]　コトキタウン
ここは　１０２ばん　どうろ\n[LEFT_ARROW]　トウカシティ
ハルカ『えーと　１０３ばん　どうろに　いる\nポケモンは　あれと　あれね‥‥
sourceRecords.english: MAY: Let's see... The POKéMON found\non ROUTE 103 include...

sourceRecords.japanese:
あら　[PLAYER][KUN]！\c‥‥そうか！　おとうさん　から
ポケモンを　プレゼントして　もらったのね！\cせっかくだから　ちょっと
ポケモンしょうぶ　しようよ！\cトレーナーって　どんな　ものか
あたしが　おしえて　あげるから！
sourceRecords.english:
Oh, hi, [PLAYER][KUN]!\c...Oh, I see, my dad gave you a
POKéMON as a gift.\cSince we're here, let's have a quick
battle!\cI'll give you a taste of what being a
TRAINER is like.

sourceRecords.japanese: うわっ！　すごい　すごい！\n[PLAYER][KUN]　つよい　じゃない！
sourceRecords.english: Wow! That's great!\n[PLAYER][KUN], you're pretty good!

sourceRecords.japanese:
ハルカ『あたし　おとうさんが
あなたの　ことを　ちゅうもく　するのもわかるような　きが　する！\cだって　もらって　すぐの　ポケモンが
もう　あなたに　なついているもの！\cあなたなら　どんな　ポケモンとでも
なかよく　なれるかも！\cじゃあ
けんきゅうじょに　かえろっか！
sourceRecords.english:
MAY: I think I know why my dad has an
eye out for you now.\cI mean, you just got that POKéMON but
it already likes you.\cYou might be able to befriend any
kind of POKéMON easily.\cWell, it's time to head back to the
LAB.

sourceRecords.japanese: ユウキ『そうか　あいつと　あいつが\n１０３ばん　どうろに　いる　ポケモンか‥‥
sourceRecords.english: BRENDAN: Okay, so it's this one and\nthat one that live on ROUTE 103...

sourceRecords.japanese:
おや？　[PLAYER]！\c‥‥そうか　とうさん　から
ポケモンを　もらったのか\cじゃあ　ついでだ
ポケモンしょうぶ　してやろうか？\cトレーナーって　どんな　ものか
オレが　おしえてやるよ！
sourceRecords.english: Hey, it's [PLAYER]!\c...Oh, yeah, Dad gave you a POKéMON.\cSince we're here, how about a little\nbattle?\cI'll teach you what being a TRAINER's\nabout!

sourceRecords.japanese: ふうん\n[PLAYER]って　つよいんだね

ユウキ『とうさんが
[PLAYER]の　ことを　ちゅうもく　するのもわかったような　きが　する‥‥\cもらって　すぐの　ポケモンが
もう　なついているよ\c[PLAYER]なら　どんな　ポケモンとでも
なかよく　なれるかも　しれないな\cじゃ
けんきゅうじょに　もどろうか
sourceRecords.english:
BRENDAN: I think I get it.
I think I know why my dad has his eyeout for you now.\cLook, your POKéMON already likes you,
even though you just got it.\c[PLAYER], I get the feeling that you
could befriend any POKéMON with ease.\cWe should head back to the LAB.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくの　ポケモン　もう　へろへろ‥‥\nキズぐすり　もってくれば　よかった‥‥
sourceRecords.english: My POKéMON is staggeringly tired...\nI should have brought a POTION...

sourceRecords.japanese: ここから　うみを　わたっていけば\nコトキタウンまで　ちかみちが　できるぞ！\cふふふ　おとくな　じょうほう　だろ？
sourceRecords.english: If you cross the sea from here,\nit'll be a shortcut to OLDALE TOWN.\cFufufu, that's useful, isn't it?

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　１０３ばん　どうろ\n[DOWN_ARROW]　コトキタウン
その　はまべの　こやには\nハギろうじん　という　ひとが　すんでるの！\cむかしは　どんな　あらなみも　おそれない\nすごうでの　ふなのり　だった　らしいわ！
sourceRecords.english: That seaside cottage is where\nMR. BRINEY lives.\cHe was once a mighty sailor who never\nfeared the sea, however stormy.

sourceRecords.japanese: うみ　かぁ‥‥\cうみのそこ　って　いったい\nどんな　ふうに　なってるのかな？
sourceRecords.english: The sea, huh?\cI wonder what it's like at the bottom\nof the sea?

sourceRecords.japanese: モンスターボールを　なげるときは\nポケモンの　わざで\rどくや　やけどに　したり\rねむらせると　つかまえ　やすいよ！
sourceRecords.english: If you're going to throw a POKé BALL,\nweaken the wild POKéMON first.\cIt will be easier to catch if it's been\npoisoned, burned, or lulled to sleep.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひとの　ポケモンを　とったら　どろぼうよ\cモンスターボールは\nやせいの　ポケモンにだけ　なげましょうね！
sourceRecords.english: You're a thief if you try to steal\nsomeone else's POKéMON.\cYou should throw POKé BALLS only at\nwild POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたし　トレーナーじゃ　ないわよ\cでも　トレーナーどうし　しせんが　あうのは\nしょうぶしようって　サイン　なのよね！\cもし　たたかいたく　なかったら\nしせんを　あわさなければ　いいのよね！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER.\cBut that's right, if TRAINERS lock eyes,\nit's a challenge to battle.\cIf you don't want to battle, stay out\nof their sight.

sourceRecords.japanese: くちのなかに　タネを　いっぱい　いれて\nそれを　プププッ！　とふきだすのが　すき！\cおまえも　これを　やるから　つかえよ！\cポケモンに　つかうとさ\nタネを　とばす　わざを　おぼえるから！
sourceRecords.english: I like filling my mouth with seeds,\nthen spitting them out fast!\cYou can have this, so you try it out!\cUse it on a POKéMON, and it will learn\na move for firing seeds rapidly.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひとこと　アドバイスな！\cわざマシンは　つかいすて！\nつかうと　なくなるから\rよく　かんがえてから　つかえよな！
sourceRecords.english: A word of advice!\cA TM, TECHNICAL MACHINE, is good only\nfor one-time use.\cOnce you use it, it's gone.\nThink twice before using it!

sourceRecords.japanese: この　フラワーショップ　ちかごろ\nうえきも　うって　くれるのよ！\cうれしくて　たくさん　かっちゃったから\nあたしの　しろいハーブは　もう　いらないわ\rあなた　もらってよ！
sourceRecords.english: This FLOWER SHOP started selling\nsaplings recently.\cIt made me so happy, I went overboard\nshopping. I don't need this WHITE HERB\ranymore. Would you take it, please?

sourceRecords.japanese: この　フラワーショップ　ちかごろ\nうえきも　うって　くれるのよ！\cうれしくて　たくさん　かっちゃった！\nどこに　かざろうかしら？
sourceRecords.english: This FLOWER SHOP started selling\nsaplings recently.\cIt made me so happy, I went overboard\nshopping. Where should I put them?

sourceRecords.japanese: 「ハギろうじんの　こや」
ここは　１０４ばん　どうろ\n[RIGHT_ARROW]　トウカシティ
ここは　１０４ばん　どうろ\n[UP_ARROW]　カナズミシティ
「フラワーショップ　サン・トウカ」
おとくな　けいじばん！！\cホウエンちほう　には\nダブルバトルと　いって　２たい２の\rポケモンしょうぶを　いどんでくる\rトレーナーが　います！\cダブルバトルでは　ポケモンの　リストの\nひだりと　いちばん　うえにいる\rポケモンが　とびだして　たたかうので\rリストの　ならびには　ようちゅうい！
sourceRecords.english: TRAINER TIPS\cIn the HOENN region there are pairs\nof TRAINERS who challenge others\rfor 2-on-2 POKéMON battles called\rDOUBLE BATTLES.\cIn a DOUBLE BATTLE, the TRAINER must\nsend out two POKéMON, the one at the\rleft of the list and the top one.\rWatch how POKéMON are lined up.

sourceRecords.japanese: おとくな　けいじばん！！\cポケモンを　うまく　つりあげる　コツは\nビックリ　したら　エーボタン！
sourceRecords.english: TRAINER TIPS\cAdvice on catching POKéMON with a ROD:\nPress the A Button if you get a bite.

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『ほい！　カイナに　とうちゃく！\cたしか　クスノキさんに\nデボンのにもつを　とどけるんだったな！
sourceRecords.english: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've made land in SLATEPORT!\cI suppose you're going to visit CAPT.\nSTERN and deliver the DEVON GOODS?

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『にもつを　とどけないのかい？\cそれとも　ムロに　もどるのかね？
sourceRecords.english: MR. BRINEY: Aren't you delivering the\nDEVON GOODS?\cOr were you meaning to sail back to\nDEWFORD?

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『ムロタウン　か\cよっしゃ！　いくぞ　ピーコちゃん！
sourceRecords.english: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!\cAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『では　にもつを　とどけておいで\nわしは　ここに　いるから
sourceRecords.english: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver\nthe DEVON GOODS. I'll be waiting.

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『ほい！　カイナに　とうちゃく！\cふねに　のりたくなったら\nまた　わしに　こえを　かけておくれ！
sourceRecords.english: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've made land in\nSLATEPORT!\cYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail again!

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『やあ！　きみのため　なら\nいつでも　ふねを　だそう！\cきみが　いきたいのは　どこ　かな？
sourceRecords.english: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\cNow, my friend, where are we bound?

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『ふねに　のる　ひつようが　あるときは\nいつでも　こえを　かけておくれ
sourceRecords.english: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever\nyou need to set sail again!

sourceRecords.japanese: あつい　トレーナーさんも\nあつくない　トレーナーさんも\rおとうさんの　おみせに　よってってー！
sourceRecords.english: Yo, TRAINERS!\nWhether you're hot to trot,\ror cool cat not,\rchill at my papa's spot!

sourceRecords.japanese: こどもって　あちこち　うごきまわるから\nめを　はなせなくて　たいへん！\cポケモンが　いっしょ　だから\nだいじょうぶ　だと　おもってるけど‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Little kids can dart around so quickly...\cYou don't dare take your eyes off them\nfor an instant. It's very taxing.\cMine's with my POKéMON, so they should\nbe okay, but...

sourceRecords.japanese: なかなか　すなの　おしろ　できないね
sourceRecords.english: Our sand castle's taking a long time\nto make.

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]　これ　あげる！

すなはまの　すなを　ぜーんぶ　あつめて
おっきな　おしろを　つくるの\cそれで　あたしたち
おうさまと　おうじょさまに　なるの\c[STR_VAR_1]は
けらいに　してあげるね
sourceRecords.english: We're going to get all the sand from\nthe beach and make a big castle!\cAnd then we're going to be a king and\nqueen.\cWe'll let you be a servant.

sourceRecords.japanese:
この　あたりの　うみは　きれいだがな\cそれでも　たまに　こうして　すてられた
ゴミを　ジグザグマに　あつめてもらうよ\cよごれた　みずは　あめと　なって
かわに　ながれこみ　のみみずと　なる‥‥\cうみを　よごすと
けっきょく　じぶんらが　こまるからの
sourceRecords.english:
The water around these parts is clean.\cBut, I get my ZIGZAGOON to pick up
litter from the shoreline at times.\cDirty water becomes rain and joins our
rivers, which we drink from...\cIf we pollute the sea, it all comes
back to haunt us eventually.

sourceRecords.japanese: ジグザグマ『ぐぐ？
「うみの　いえ」\cすなはま　といえば　ポケモンしょうぶ！\nあつい　トレーナー　ここに　つどえ！
sourceRecords.english: SEASHORE HOUSE\c“May hot battles rage on hot sands!\nThe place for hot TRAINERS!”

sourceRecords.japanese: おとくな　けいじばん！！\cポケモンの　レベルが　おなじ　でも\nつよさまで　おなじとは　かぎりません！\cそれに　トレーナーが　そだてた\nポケモンの　ほうが　つよくなると\rいわれて　います！
sourceRecords.english: TRAINER TIPS\cPOKéMON at the same level may not\nalways have identical stats.\cPOKéMON raised by TRAINERS are said\nto grow stronger than wild POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: [EVIL_TEAM]だんの　かつどうは\nいまは　まだ　だれにも　いえないのだ
sourceRecords.english: TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]'s activities must be kept\nsecret for now.

sourceRecords.japanese: はやく　カイナに　いって\nひとあばれ　したいんだよな
sourceRecords.english: I want to get going to SLATEPORT and\nkick up a ruckus!

sourceRecords.japanese: [EVIL_TEAM]だんに　はいって\nはじめての　しごと　だぜ‥‥　どきどき
sourceRecords.english: This is my first job after joining\nTEAM [EVIL_TEAM]. I've got the shakes!

sourceRecords.japanese: [EVIL_TEAM]だんの　かつどうは\nきっと　みんなを　えがおに　するだろう
sourceRecords.english: TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]'s actions will put a smile\non everyone's face!

sourceRecords.japanese: ハルカ『[PLAYER][KUN]　ひさしぶり！\cいろいろ　ポケモン　さがしてる　あいだに\nあたしの　ポケモンも　つよくなったんだ！\cだから‥‥\nちょっと　しょうぶ　しようよ！
sourceRecords.english: MAY: Hi, [PLAYER][KUN], long time no see!\cWhile I was searching for other\nPOKéMON, my POKéMON grew stronger.\cSo...\nHow about a little battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: あっちゃー！\nおもってたより　つよいよ！
ハルカ『[PLAYER][KUN]も\nポケモン　そだててるんだね！\cうん　じゃあ　これは\nあたしからの　プレゼントよ！
sourceRecords.english: MAY: [PLAYER][KUN], you've been busy\ntraining, too, haven't you?\cI think you deserve a reward!\nThis is from me!

sourceRecords.japanese:
ハルカ『それは　ダウジングマシン！\cダウジングマシンを　つかうと
めには　みえなくても　おちているどうぐが　あると　はんのう　しておとで　おしえて　くれるのよ！\cじゃあ　[PLAYER][KUN]
また　どこかで　あおうね！\cまけた　あたしが　いうのも　なんだけど
そのときまでに　もっと　ポケモンそだてて　おいた　ほうが　いいかもよ！
sourceRecords.english: MAY: That's an ITEMFINDER.\cTry it out. If there is an item that's\nnot visible, it emits a sound.\cOkay, [PLAYER][KUN], let's meet again!\cI know it's a little silly coming from\nme, but I think you should train a lot\rharder for the next time.

sourceRecords.japanese: ユウキ『[PLAYER]か\nこんなところに　いたんだ\rちょうしは　どう？\cポケモン　そだててるか　どうか\nオレが　たしかめて　やるよ
sourceRecords.english: BRENDAN: Hey, [PLAYER].\nSo this is where you were.\rHow's it going?\cHave you been raising your POKéMON?\nI'll check for you.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふうん‥‥\nなかなか　やるね
ユウキ『[PLAYER]も　いつのまにか\nポケモン　そだててたのか‥‥\cよし！\nこれを　やるよ
sourceRecords.english: BRENDAN: [PLAYER], you've trained\nwithout me noticing...\cGood enough!\nHere, take this.

sourceRecords.japanese: ユウキ『そいつは　ダウジングマシン\cつかうと　めには　みえなくても\nおちている　どうぐが　あると\rはんのう　して　おとで　おしえてくれる\cじゃ　オレ　あたらしい\nポケモンを　さがしに　いくから
sourceRecords.english:
BRENDAN: That's an ITEMFINDER.\cUse it to root around for items that
aren't visible.\cIf it senses something, it emits a
sound.\cAnyway, I'm off to look for new
POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: この　サイクリング　ロードを\nじてんしゃで　はしりぬけたら\rだんぜん　きもち　よさそうだね！
sourceRecords.english: Wouldn't it be great to ride a BIKE\nat full speed on CYCLING ROAD?

sourceRecords.japanese: どう？　かぜになびく　わたしの　くろかみ！\cこのため　だけに　かみを　のばしたの！
sourceRecords.english: How do you like the way my raven-\ncolored hair streams behind me?\cI grew my hair out just for that.

sourceRecords.japanese:
おっ！　その　じてんしゃ
ミスターカゼノに　もらったんだね！\cみれば　わかるよ
だって　きみの　じてんしゃに‥‥\cカゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ
カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ\cカゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ
カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ\cカゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ
カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ\cカゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ
カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ\cカゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ
‥‥って　かいて　あるんだもん！\cあっちこっち　のりまわして
せんでん　してあげると　いいね！
sourceRecords.english:
Oh, hey, you got that BIKE from RYDEL!\cOh, it's glaringly obvious.
It says right on your bike...\cRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\cRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\cRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\cRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\cRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL...
That name's everywhere.\cYou should ride it around all over
the place - it's good advertising!

sourceRecords.japanese: うえと　した　２つの　どうろ‥‥\cにんげんと　ポケモン\nそれぞれの　どうろ　だと　おもえば\rこれもあり　なのかも　しれんのう
sourceRecords.english: The two roads, one above, one below...\cA road each for people and POKéMON.\nPerhaps that is right and fair.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたしは　じてんしゃ　もってない　からねえ\nしたの　みちを　のんびり　あるいて　いくよ
sourceRecords.english: I don't have a BIKE, so I'll take a\nleisurely walk on the low road.

sourceRecords.japanese: いろんな　テクニックを　おぼえると\nますます　じてんしゃが　たのしくなる！\cテクニックを　つかわないと\nすすめない　ばしょも　あるしね！
sourceRecords.english: Learning techniques will make BIKE\nriding even more fun.\cThere are some places that you can\nreach only by using a BIKE technique.

sourceRecords.japanese: サイクリングロードで　キンセツを　めざすか\nしたの　みちで　ポケモンを　さがすか\rどっちに　しようかな？
sourceRecords.english: Which should I choose?\cMake a beeline for MAUVILLE on\nCYCLING ROAD, or take the low road\rand look for POKéMON?

sourceRecords.japanese: ぶつかった　かいすう\n　‥‥　[STR_VAR_1]！\cかかった　タイム\n　‥‥　[STR_VAR_2]！
ブラボー！！　すばらしい！！\cきみは　じてんしゃを　こころから\nあいしている！　たましいを　ゆさぶられたよ！
sourceRecords.english: Bravo! Splendid showing!\cYour love of cycling comes from deep\nwithin your heart.\rYou've shaken me to my very soul!

sourceRecords.japanese: なかなかの　テクニックを　もってるな！\cまあ　スピードを　だしすぎて\nアクシデントを　おこさないように　しなよ！
sourceRecords.english: Your technique is remarkable.\cI suggest you slow down just enough\nto avoid collisions.

sourceRecords.japanese: まだ　みじゅくな　ぶぶんも　あるようだが\nせっかくの　じてんしゃを\rたのしむ　きもちを　わすれないで　くれよ
sourceRecords.english: I would consider you a work in\nprogress.\cStill, I hope you don't forget the\nsheer pleasure of cycling.

sourceRecords.japanese: おいおい　なんだか\nあぶなっかしい　うんてん　してるなあ\rもっと　れんしゅう　しろよな
sourceRecords.english: My word... Your cycling skills border\non terrifying.\cMost certainly, you need much more\npractice riding.

sourceRecords.japanese: うむむ‥‥　うむむむ‥‥\cきみには　じてんしゃは　むいていない　かもな\nミスターカゼノに　かえしたら　どうだね？
sourceRecords.english: ...I am aghast...\cYou're perhaps not cut out for this\nunfortunate cycling business.\cYou ought to give serious thought to\nreturning that BIKE to RYDEL.

sourceRecords.japanese: この　サイクリングロード！\cキンセツから　カイナに　むかって\nマッハじてんしゃで　はしりぬける\rレーサーの　ぶつかった　かいすうと\rかかった　タイムを　はかって　いるんだ！
sourceRecords.english: This is CYCLING ROAD.\cIf you were to ride from MAUVILLE to\nSLATEPORT on a MACH BIKE, you would\rbe rated for the number of collisions\rand your total time.

sourceRecords.japanese: どんな　けっか　だろうが　さらに\nうえを　めざしての　チャレンジ　まってるよ！
sourceRecords.english: Regardless of the results, I count on\nseeing more challenges from you.\rAlways aim higher!

sourceRecords.japanese: この　サイクリング　ロードでは\nマッハじてんしゃ　で　はしりぬけた\rレーサーの　ぶつかった　かいすうと\rかかった　タイムを　はかって　いるんだ！\cダートじてんしゃ　だと　まがりやすいから\nきろくは　はかって　あげないよ！
sourceRecords.english: On this CYCLING ROAD, those riding\nMACH BIKES are rated for their number\rof collisions and their total times.\cACRO BIKES do not qualify for rating.\nThey are easy to turn, so it's not fair.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　１１０ばん　どうろ\n[DOWN_ARROW]　カイナシティ
「シーサイド　サイクリング　ロード」
「[EVIL_TEAM]だん　さんじょう！」\c‥‥かんばんに　らくがきが　してある
sourceRecords.english: “TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] RULEZ!”\cSomebody scribbled that on the sign...

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　１１０ばん　どうろ\n[LEFT_ARROW]　１０３ばん　どうろ
「シーサイド　パーキング」
ここは　１１０ばん　どうろ\n[UP_ARROW]　キンセツシティ
おとくな　けいじばん！！\cポケモンを　ねむらせたり　まひさせると\nあいての　じゆうを　うばえます！\cこれは　ポケモンしょうぶの\nじゅうような　テクニック　です！
sourceRecords.english: TRAINER TIPS\cThe foe can be made helpless by\nparalyzing it or causing it to sleep.\cIt is an important technique for\nPOKéMON battles.

sourceRecords.japanese: おとくな　けいじばん！！\cバッグに　いれた　どうぐは\nセレクトボタンを　おすと　じゅんばんを\rいれかえる　ことが　できます！
sourceRecords.english: TRAINER TIPS\cThe items in the BAG can be reorganized\nby pressing SELECT.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここより　[RIGHT_ARROW]へ３ぽ　[UP_ARROW]へ２ほ　ゆけば\nそこは　すてきな　「カラクリやしき」！
sourceRecords.english: “Three steps [RIGHT_ARROW] and two steps [UP_ARROW]\nto reach the wondrous TRICK HOUSE.”

sourceRecords.japanese: いままでの　さいこう　きろく‥‥\cぶつかった　かいすう\n　‥‥　[STR_VAR_1]！\cかかった　タイム\n　‥‥　[STR_VAR_2]！
sourceRecords.english: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE...\cNo. of collisions: [STR_VAR_1]\cElapsed time: [STR_VAR_2]

sourceRecords.japanese: いままでの　さいこう　きろく‥‥\c‥‥　だれも　ちょうせん　していないのか\nなにも　きろく　されていない！
sourceRecords.english: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE...\cNo one seems to have taken the\nchallenge. There is no record...

sourceRecords.japanese: いつも　みずを　あげてたら\nたくさん　はなが　さいたんだ\cそしたら　きのみも　たくさん　できた！\cはい！\nこれ　あげる
sourceRecords.english: I watered the plants every day.\nThey grew lots of flowers.\cAnd they gave me lots of BERRIES, too.\cHere you go!\nYou can have it!

sourceRecords.japanese: がんばって　あかいポロック　つくるんだ！\n[STR_VAR_1]も　がんばってね！
sourceRecords.english: I'm trying to make RED [POKEBLOCK]S!\nI hope you do, too!

sourceRecords.japanese: あれ？　バッグの　きのみポケットが\nいっぱいだよ！\cまた　こんどね
sourceRecords.english: Your BAG's BERRIES POCKET is full.\cI'll give it to you another time.

sourceRecords.japanese: きょうは　あかいポロックのために\nあかい　きのみを　さがそっと
sourceRecords.english: I'm going to look for red BERRIES to\nmake RED [POKEBLOCK]S.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみ！　たびの　とちゅう　だろうけれど\cどうだ？　ここは　ひとつ\nわたしたち　かぞく　４にんと\rポケモン　しょうぶを　してみないか？
sourceRecords.english: Hello! I take it you're a traveler.\cHow's this? What do you say to taking\non our family of four in a series of\rPOKéMON battles?

sourceRecords.japanese: あっそ！\nきが　むいたら　また　おいで！
sourceRecords.english: Is that so?\nDrop in, if you change your mind!

sourceRecords.japanese: いい　どきょうだ！　きにいったぞ！
sourceRecords.english: That's the spirit! I like you!

sourceRecords.japanese: たはーっ！\nおもっていたより　つよいんだね　きみは！
sourceRecords.english: Aiyah!\nYou're a lot tougher than I expected!

sourceRecords.japanese: おーい！\nなかなか　つよい　トレーナーが　いたぞー！
sourceRecords.english: Hey, all!\nI've found a pretty strong TRAINER!

sourceRecords.japanese: あれま！　いがいに　わかいのね！\cうちの　しゅじんに　かってしまう　とは\nなんと　すごうでの　トレーナー　なの！\cじゃあ　こんどは　わたしと　しょうぶよ！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, my goodness! Aren't you young?\cYou must be quite the TRAINER to beat\nmy husband, though.\cIt's my turn to battle now!

sourceRecords.japanese: んまーっ！\nあなたって　なんて　つよいのかしら！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, gosh!\nI can't get over how strong you are!

sourceRecords.japanese: つよいわよー！\nこのひと　すっごく　つよいわよー！
sourceRecords.english: There's a strong TRAINER here!\nThis one's really strong!

sourceRecords.japanese: ママより　つよいなんて　すごーい！\cでも　あたし　だって　つよいんだから！\nほんと　なんだってば！
sourceRecords.english: You're stronger than Mommy? Wow!\cBut I'm strong, too!\nReally! Honestly!

sourceRecords.japanese: えっ　もしかして　まけちゃった‥‥
くやしい‥‥\c‥‥　ぐっすん！　おばあちゃーん！！
こらーっ！\nわしの　かわいい　まごに　なにすんじゃ！\cこうなったら　わしが　おまえさんを\nメタメタに　してやるから　かくごせぇ！
sourceRecords.english: How dare you make my granddaughter\ncry!\cFor that, I'm going to smack you!\nPrepare to lose!

sourceRecords.japanese: フガッ！　つよいのう‥‥\nまごの　いうことは　ほんとう　じゃった
sourceRecords.english: Kwah! You are strong...\nMy granddaughter was right...

sourceRecords.japanese: あんた‥‥　いそぎのたびで　ないのなら\nうちに　よっていって　おくれ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: If you're not in any hurry, visit with\nus awhile.

sourceRecords.japanese: ねっこのカセキを　みつけた！\cこっちの　カセキを　とると\nもう　ひとつの　カセキは　しずみそうだ‥‥\cねっこのカセキを　とりますか？
sourceRecords.english: You found the ROOT FOSSIL.\cIf this FOSSIL is taken, the other\none will sink into the sand...\cTake the ROOT FOSSIL anyway?

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　ねっこのカセキを\nそのままに　しておいた
ツメのカセキを　みつけた！\cこっちの　カセキを　とると\nもう　ひとつの　カセキは　しずみそうだ‥‥\cツメのカセキを　とりますか？
sourceRecords.english: You found the CLAW FOSSIL.\cIf this FOSSIL is taken, the other\none will sink into the sand...\cTake the CLAW FOSSIL anyway?

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　ツメのカセキを\nそのままに　しておいた
もっと　ポケモン　きたえないと\nかちぬくのは　きびしそうだ\cいままでの　ジムリーダーより\nはるかに　つよいと　きくからな\rポケモンリーグにいる　してんのうは！
sourceRecords.english: If you don't raise your POKéMON some\nmore, it could be tough to keep winning\rup through the ranks.\cI've heard the POKéMON LEAGUE's\nELITE FOUR are far stronger than\rany GYM LEADER.

sourceRecords.japanese: カチヌキいっかに　いどんだけれど\n４にん　つづけての　ポケモンしょうぶは\rきびしいよな‥‥　ボロまけ　したよ
sourceRecords.english: I challenged the WINSTRATE family,\nbut four matches in a row is tough\rgoing... They destroyed me.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　１１１ばん　どうろ\n[DOWN_ARROW]　キンセツシティ
われら　かぞくの　こころは　ひとつ\n「カチヌキ　ファミリーの　いえ」
sourceRecords.english: “Our family's hearts beat as one!”\nTHE WINSTRATE'S HOUSE

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　１１１ばん　どうろ\n[LEFT_ARROW]　１１２ばん　どうろ
ここは　１１１ばん　どうろ\n[LEFT_ARROW]　１１３ばん　どうろ
「ケンコーばあさんの　いえ」\nつかれたと　おもうなら　よってらっしゃい！
sourceRecords.english: OLD LADY'S REST STOP\n“Come in and rest your tired bones.”

sourceRecords.japanese: おとくな　けいじばん！！\cポケモンの　つよさを　あらわす　ことばで\nとくこう　とは\rとくしゅ　こうげきりょく　のこと！\cとくぼう　とは\nとくしゅ　ぼうぎょりょく　のこと　です！

sourceRecords.japanese: ブツブツ‥‥\cハジツゲに　むかった　なかまは\nなにを　やってるんだ？　おそいなあ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Grumble...\cWhat happened to the others who went\nto FALLARBOR? They're late...

sourceRecords.japanese: ブツブツ‥‥\cおれも　ロープウェイに　のって\nちょうじょうに　いきたいぜ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Grumble...\cI'd like to ride the CABLE CAR to the\ntop, too..

sourceRecords.japanese: うーむ‥‥　キンセツに　いきたいのだが‥‥\nこの　だんさを　おりてしまうと\rフエンに　もどるのは　たいへん　だよな‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Eh, I'd like to get to MAUVILLE, but if\nI went down these ledges, it'd be no\reasy matter to get back to LAVARIDGE.

sourceRecords.japanese: 「えんとつやま　ロープウェイ　のりば」\n[UP_ARROW]　このさき　すぐ！
sourceRecords.english: MT. CHIMNEY CABLE CAR\n“A short walk [UP_ARROW] way!”

sourceRecords.japanese: 「えんとつやま」\cフエンタウンや　ちょうじょう　へは\nロープウェイを　ごりよう　ください
sourceRecords.english: MT. CHIMNEY\c“For LAVARIDGE TOWN or the summit,\nplease take the CABLE CAR.”

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　１１２ばん　どうろ\n[LEFT_ARROW]　フエンタウン
ワハハ！！\nいまの　かがくりょくは　すごいですぞ！\cなんと　この　かざんばいを\nガラスに　かえることが　できるのです！
sourceRecords.english: Wahahaha! Today's technology is a\nwondrous thing!\cTake this volcanic ash here.\nIt can be fashioned into glass.

sourceRecords.japanese: かざんばい　つもった　くさむらの　うえ\nあるくと　どこを　とおったか　わかるから\rたのしく　なっちゃう！
sourceRecords.english: It's fun walking through the volcano's\nashes on the ground and grass.\cYou can see where you walked - it's\nreally neat!

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　１１３ばん　どうろ\n[RIGHT_ARROW]　１１１ばん　どうろ

sourceRecords.english: TRAINER TIPS\cYou may register one of the KEY ITEMS\nin your BAG as SELECT.\cSimply press SELECT to use the\nregistered item conveniently.

sourceRecords.japanese: 「ガラスざいくの　おみせ」\nかざんばい　から　ガラスの　どうぐ

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしの　ポケモン　ほえてばかりで\nみんなが　にげてしまって‥‥\cあなた　よかったら\nこの　わざマシン　もらってください

sourceRecords.japanese: わざマシン０５の　なかみは　ほえる　です\nほえると　ポケモンも　にげだすのです

ここは　りゅうせいのたき\nとおりぬけると　カナズミシティ

どうくつの　なかって\nくさむらの　ある　どうろと　ちがって\rいつ　ポケモンが　とびだして　くるのか\rわからないから　ドキドキ　しちゃうわ

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　１１５ばん　どうろ\n[DOWN_ARROW]　カナズミシティ

sourceRecords.english: Ohhh, what am I to do?\cWe were on our walk, PEEKO and I, when\nwe were jumped by an odd thug...\cThe scoundrel made off with my\ndarling PEEKO!\cWrrrooooooaaaar! PEEKO!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぬぉー！！\cトンネル　ほりてー！！

ぬぉー！！
なんて　ことだ！？\cどうぐも　なにも　つかわずに

おおきな　ものおとに　はんのう　してさわぎだす　ポケモンが　いる\cだから　きかいを　つかっての

sourceRecords.english:
Nnn... Roar!
What's going on?\cI was digging the tunnel without any
tools when some goon ordered me out!\cThat tunnel's filled with POKéMON
that react badly to loud noises.They could cause an uproar.\cThat's why we stopped using heavy
equipment for tunneling...\cI'm worried that the goon will do
something stupid and startle thePOKéMON into an uproar.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぬぉー！！\cへんな　おとこが　とびだしていった！\nこれで　トンネルを　ほれるよ！
sourceRecords.english: Nnn... Roar!\cThat goofy goon hightailed it out of\nthe tunnel! I can go back to digging!

sourceRecords.english:
Oh! It's you!\cYou're that person who not only helped
me in PETALBURG WOODS, but also gotback my stolen package and then evengraciously delivered it to SLATEPORT!\cCAPT. STERN informed us that the
package arrived, too!\cI thank you very, very much!\cWhy, if I were a rain cloud, I would
shower you with gratitude and hailyou as a hero!\cFor you, the most wonderful TRAINER,
I bear good news!\cRecently, our company developed a new
kind of POKé BALL.\cAs a token of our appreciation, this
is our gift to our wonderful TRAINER!

sourceRecords.japanese: あたらしい　モンスターボールは\nカナズミの　フレンドリィ　ショップで\rうってますからね！\cぜひ　つかって　みてください！\nではでは‥‥

sourceRecords.japanese: どうぐ　いっぱいで\nリピートボール　あげられないね

sourceRecords.japanese: にもつを　とどけてくれた　ことへの\nかんしゃの　きもちとして\rトレーナーさん　にも　あたらしい\rモンスターボールを　プレゼント　なのよね！
sourceRecords.english: As a token of our appreciation for\nyour delivering our package, I have a\rgift of a new kind of POKé BALL for our\rmost wonderful TRAINER!

sourceRecords.japanese: メガネを　おとしたんだ‥‥\nきみも　さがすの　てつだってよ

sourceRecords.english: RUSTURF TUNNEL\n“Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF\c“The tunnel project has been\ncanceled.”

MAY: [PLAYER][KUN]!

Of course you are! Go!

MAY: Use FLY, and your POKéMON will

GYM BADGE from FORTREE CITY.That's important, so don't forget.\cYou should FLY home and visit
LITTLEROOT for a change.\cI bet your mom's worried about you,
[PLAYER][KUN].\cWell, let's meet again somewhere!

ユウキ『[PLAYER]！

しょうぶ　しょうぶ　だぜ！

BRENDAN: [PLAYER]! So this is where

I'll test you!\cNow!
It's a battle, so battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: ふうん‥‥\nけっこう　つよく　なってるんだな

I thought you FLY by catching a whole
flock of BIRD POKéMON, and thenhanging on to them somehow.\cBut it turns out there's an HM move

time ago...

ポケモン　つかまえに　いこうかな？
sourceRecords.english:
MAY: [PLAYER][KUN]!\cI was just checking my POKéDEX.\cThere's still a lot of POKéMON that
I've seen but haven't caught.\cAnd there are many others that
I think will evolve.\cI wonder where I should go catch
some POKéMON next?

sourceRecords.japanese: ハルカ『こんどは　どこに\nポケモン　つかまえに　いこうかな？\cいった　さきで　また\n[PLAYER][KUN]と　であったりして！？
sourceRecords.english: MAY: I wonder where I should go catch\nsome POKéMON next?\cWouldn't it be funny if we ran into each\nother, [PLAYER][KUN]?

sourceRecords.japanese:
ユウキ『[PLAYER]か\cいま　ポケモンずかんを
チェック　してたんだ\cまだまだ　つかまえていない
ポケモンも　いるけどかなり　いい　かんじだろ？\cこうして　ずかんを　みていると
また　ぼうけんに　いきたくなるな
sourceRecords.english: BRENDAN: Hey, it's [PLAYER].\cI was just checking out my POKéDEX.\cThere are still many POKéMON that\nI need to catch, I know, but this\ris looking pretty good.\cChecking this POKéDEX out gives me\nthe urge to hit the road again.

sourceRecords.japanese: ユウキ『こんどは　どこで\nポケモン　つかまえるか　なやむな‥‥\cもし　ポケモン　つかまえているとき\n[PLAYER]と　であったら\rしょうぶ　してやろうか？
sourceRecords.english: BRENDAN: I'm having a hard time deciding\nwhere I should catch POKéMON next.\cHey, [PLAYER], if I see you while I'm out\ncatching POKéMON, I can pitch you a\rbattle if you'd like.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンの　えほんが\nたくさん　そろっている！
sourceRecords.english: It's lined with POKéMON picture books.

sourceRecords.japanese: 『ポケモンの　しゅるいと　ぶんぷ』\n『ヒトと　ポケモンの　きょうぞん』\r『はじめて　まなぶ　ポケモンがく』\cオダマキはかせが　かいた　ほんが\nたくさん　ならんでいる！
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON SPECIES & HABITATS...\nHUMAN & POKéMON COEXISTENCE...\rPOKéMONOLOGY FOR BEGINNERS...\cIt's brimming with books written by\nPROF. BIRCH.

sourceRecords.japanese: はかせは　つくえのうえで　けんきゅうを\nするよりも　じっさいに　そとへ　とびだして\rたいけんする　タイプのひと　なんです！
sourceRecords.english:
Hunh? PROF. BIRCH?\cThe PROF's away on fieldwork.
Ergo, he isn't here.\cOh, let me explain what fieldwork is.\cIt is to study things in the natural
environment, like fields and mountains,instead of a laboratory.\cThe PROF isn't one for doing desk work.
He's the type of person who wouldrather go outside and experiencethings than read about them here.

sourceRecords.japanese: はかせは　つくえのうえで　けんきゅうを\nするよりも　じっさいに　そとへ　とびだして\rたいけんする　タイプのひと　なんです！
sourceRecords.english: The PROF isn't one for doing desk work.\nHe's the type of person who would\rrather go outside and experience\rthings than read about them here.

sourceRecords.japanese: オダマキはかせは\nポケモンが　どこに　すんでいるのか\rぶんぷの　ちょうさを　なさっています\c[RIVAL]さんは　すきな　おとうさんの\nおてつだいを　なさって　いるのですよ
sourceRecords.english: PROF. BIRCH is studying the habitats\nand distribution of POKéMON.\cThe PROF enjoys [RIVAL]'s help, too.\nThere's a lot of love there.

sourceRecords.japanese:
オダマキ『‥‥さて　[PLAYER][KUN]！\cきみのことは　おとうさん　から
いつも　きかされていたよ！\cきみは　まだ　じぶんの　ポケモンを
もったことが　ないんだって？\cそれにしては　さっきの　たたかいぶり
なかなか　みごと　だったよ！\cやっぱり　きみには　おとうさんの
ちが　ながれて　いるんだな！\cそうそう！　たすけてくれた　おれいに
さっきの　ポケモンは　わたしからきみへの　プレゼントに　しよう！\c[PLAYER]は
[STR_VAR_1]を　もらった！
sourceRecords.english:
PROF. BIRCH: So, [PLAYER][KUN].\cI've heard so much about you from
your father.\cI've heard that you don't have your
own POKéMON yet.\cBut the way you battled earlier,
you pulled it off with aplomb!\cI guess you have your father's blood
in your veins after all!\cOh, yes. As thanks for rescuing me,
I'd like you to have the POKéMON youused earlier.\c[PLAYER] received the [STR_VAR_1]!

sourceRecords.japanese: オダマキ『せっかく　だから　[STR_VAR_1]に\nニックネームを　つけてみては　どうだい？
sourceRecords.english: PROF. BIRCH: While you're at it, why not\ngive a nickname to that [STR_VAR_1]?

sourceRecords.japanese: オダマキ『これから　さらに\nけいけんを　つんで　いけば\rいい　トレーナーに　なれそうだ！\cちょうど　うちの　[RIVAL]が\n１０３ばん　どうろで\rポケモンの　ちょうさを　しているから\rあいに　いったら　どうだろう？
sourceRecords.english:
PROF. BIRCH: If you work at POKéMON
and gain experience, I think you'll makea darn good TRAINER.\cMy kid, [RIVAL], is out on ROUTE 103
studying POKéMON.\cIt might not be a bad idea for you to
go see [RIVAL]. What do you think?

sourceRecords.japanese: オダマキ『そうか！\nそれは　[RIVAL]も　よろこぶぞ！\cトレーナーが　どんな　ものか\nおしえてもらうと　いいぞ！
sourceRecords.english: PROF. BIRCH: Great!\n[RIVAL] should be happy, too.\cGet [RIVAL] to teach you what it\nmeans to be a TRAINER.

sourceRecords.japanese: オダマキ『そんなこと　いわずに\nあいに　いったら　どうだろう？
sourceRecords.english: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, don't be that way.\nYou should go meet my kid.

sourceRecords.japanese: オダマキ『[RIVAL]　だったら\n１０３ばん　どうろに　いる　はずだ！\cもしも　きみの　ポケモンが　キズついたら\nじぶんの　いえで　やすむと　いいぞ！
sourceRecords.english: PROF. BIRCH: [RIVAL] should be on\nROUTE 103 somewhere.\cIf you or your POKéMON get tired,\nget some rest at home.

sourceRecords.japanese:
オダマキ『おっ　[PLAYER][KUN]！\cはじめてで　[RIVAL]に
かつ　だなんて　すごいじゃないか！\c[RIVAL]は　かなり　まえから
わたしの　けんきゅうを　てつだっていてトレーナーれきは　けっこう　ながいんだよ！\cうむ！　[PLAYER][KUN]　にも
けんきゅうの　ために　とりよせたこの　ポケモンずかんを　あげよう！
sourceRecords.english:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, hi, [PLAYER][KUN]!\cI heard you beat [RIVAL] on
your first try. That's excellent!\c[RIVAL]'s been helping with my research
for a long time.\c[RIVAL] has an extensive history as
a TRAINER already.\cHere, [PLAYER][KUN], I ordered this for my
research, but I think you should havethis POKéDEX.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nポケモンずかんを　もらった！

オダマキ『その　ポケモンずかんは
きみが　であった　ポケモンを\cじどうてきに　きろく　していってくれる
ハイテクな　どうぐ　なんだ！\c[RIVAL]も　その　ずかんを　もっていて
あちこちに　あそびに　いくんだな\cで　めずらしい　ポケモンを　つかまえて
ずかんに　きろく　できるとだね\cフィールドワークを　している　わたしを
さがしだしては　みせて　くれるんだよ！
sourceRecords.english:
PROF. BIRCH: The POKéDEX is a high-tech
tool that automatically makes a recordof any POKéMON you meet or catch.\cMy kid, [RIVAL], goes everywhere
with it.\cWhenever my kid catches a rare POKéMON
and records its data in the POKéDEX,why, [RIVAL] looks for me while I'm outdoing fieldwork, and shows me.

sourceRecords.japanese: オダマキ『きみの　ゆくてには\nたくさんの　ポケモンが　まっているよ！\cあー　はやく　フィールドワークに\nいきたく　なってきたぞ！
sourceRecords.english: PROF. BIRCH: Countless POKéMON await\nyou!\cArgh, I'm getting the itch to get out\nand do fieldwork again!

sourceRecords.japanese: ハルカ『[PLAYER][KUN]も\nポケモンずかん　もらったんだね！\cよかったね！　あたしと　いっしょだよ！\nじゃあ　あたしは　これを　あげる！
sourceRecords.english: MAY: Oh, wow, [PLAYER][KUN]!\nYou got a POKéDEX, too!\cThat's great! Just like me!\nI've got something for you, too!

sourceRecords.japanese:
ハルカ『ポケモンが
たくさん　いると　たのしいよ！\cあたし　いろんな　ポケモン　さがしたいから
いろんな　ところを　さがすわ！\cそして　かわいい　ポケモンが　いたら
モンスターボールで　つかまえちゃう！
sourceRecords.english:
MAY: It's fun if you can get a lot of
POKéMON!\cI'm going to look all over the place
because I want different POKéMON.\cIf I find any cute POKéMON, I'll catch
them with POKé BALLS!

sourceRecords.japanese: あら？　バッグ　いっぱいだよ
ハルカ『こんどは　どこまで\nポケモンを　さがしに　いこうかな？
sourceRecords.english: MAY: I wonder where I should go look\nfor POKéMON next?

sourceRecords.japanese: ユウキ『ふうん　[PLAYER]も\nポケモンずかん　もらったのか\cじゃあ　オレは　これ　やるよ
sourceRecords.english: BRENDAN: Huh...\nSo you got a POKéDEX, too.\cWell then, here.\nI'll give you this.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ユウキ『ポケモンが
たくさん　いると　たのしいからな\cオレ　いろんな　ポケモン　さがすため
いろんな　ところに　いくんだ\cそして　かっこいい　ポケモンが　いたら
モンスターボールで　つかまえるんだ
sourceRecords.english:
BRENDAN: You know it's more fun to
have a whole bunch of POKéMON.\cI'm going to explore all over the place
to find different POKéMON.\cIf I find any cool POKéMON, you bet
I'll try to get them with POKé BALLS.

sourceRecords.japanese: おや？　バッグ　いっぱいだよ
ユウキ『こんどは　どこに\nポケモン　さがしに　いこうかな‥‥
sourceRecords.english: BRENDAN: Where should I look for\nPOKéMON next...

sourceRecords.japanese: なんか　すごそうな　マシンだ！\nはかせが　けんきゅうに　つかうのかな？
sourceRecords.english: It's a serious-looking machine.\nThe PROF must use this for research.

sourceRecords.japanese: けんきゅうに　つかわれている　パソコンだ！\n‥‥　さわるのは　やめておこう
sourceRecords.english: It's a PC used for research.\nBetter not mess around with it.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンに　ついて　かかれた\nほんが　いっぱい　ある！
sourceRecords.english: It's crammed with books on POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: むずかしそうな　ほんが　おいてある！
sourceRecords.english: It's a book that's too hard to read.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶの　とき\nポケモンの　リストの　ひだりに　いる\rポケモンが　とびだして　たたかうの\cだから　つれあるく　ポケモンが　ふえてきたら\nポケモンの　じゅんばんを　かえると\rしょうぶが　ゆうりに　なるかも！
sourceRecords.english: When a POKéMON battle starts, the one\nat the left of the list goes out first.\cSo, when you get more POKéMON in your\nparty, try switching around the order\rof your POKéMON.\cIt could give you an advantage.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンって　たたかうと\nレベルアップして　つよくなるのよ！
sourceRecords.english: When POKéMON battle, they eventually\nlevel up and become stronger.

sourceRecords.japanese: つれて　あるく　ポケモンが　つよかったら\nとおくまで　いけるように　なるね！
sourceRecords.english: If the POKéMON with you become\nstronger, you'll be able to go farther\raway from here.

sourceRecords.japanese: すみっこに　おいてある　パソコンは\nポケモントレーナーの　ための　ものなんだ\cきみも　じゆうに　つかって　いいんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: That PC in the corner there is\nfor any POKéMON TRAINER to use.\cNaturally, that means you're welcome\nto use it, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンセンターって　すごいよな！\cポケモン　なんびき　あずけても\nおかねが　かからないから\rどんな　ときでも　あんしん　だよね！
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON CENTERS are great!\cYou can use their services as much\nas you like, and it's all for free.\rYou never have to worry!

sourceRecords.japanese: ２かいの　ポケモン　つうしん　クラブは\nつい　さいきん　できたの\cでも　まだ\nちょうせいちゅう　ですって
sourceRecords.english: The POKéMON CABLE CLUB on the second\nfloor was built recently.\cBut they say they're still making\nadjustments.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２かいの　ポケモン　つうしん　クラブは\nつい　さいきん　できたの\cあたし　さっそく\nポケモンこうかん　しちゃった！
sourceRecords.english: The POKéMON CABLE CLUB on the second\nfloor was built recently.\cI traded POKéMON right away.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんでも　うりきれ　らしくて\nモンスターボール　かえないの‥‥
sourceRecords.english: The clerk says they're all sold out.\nI can't buy any POKé BALLS.

sourceRecords.japanese: どんどん　モンスターボール　かって\nどんどん　ポケモン　つかまえちゃうわよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm going to buy a bunch of POKé BALLS\nand catch a bunch of POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンは　たいりょくが　なくなると\nたたかう　げんきも　なくなる\cそんな　ときは　キズぐすりを　つかって\nたいりょくを　かいふく　してあげるんだ！
sourceRecords.english: If a POKéMON gets hurt and loses its HP\nand faints, it won't be able to battle.\cTo prevent your POKéMON from fainting,\nrestore its HP with a POTION.

sourceRecords.japanese: こういう　ちいさな　しまで\nポケモンと　かぞく　なかよく　くらすのも\rなかなか　いい　もんですよ
sourceRecords.english: There's a lot to be said for living on\na small island like this in harmony with\rPOKéMON and the family.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしは　カイナシティ　という\nおおきな　みなとまち　から\rおよめさんに　きたのよ\cのんびりとした　しま　だけれど\nきれいな　うみに　かこまれて　いれば\rそれだけで　しあわせ　なんだね
sourceRecords.english: I came from the large port of SLATEPORT\nCITY when I married my husband here.\cLife goes by slowly on this little\nisland. But being surrounded by the\rbeautiful sea - that's happiness, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: ジグザグマ『ぐぐう！
まちの　はずれの　いしのどうくつ　には\nめずらしい　いしが　あるって　きいたわ
sourceRecords.english: There's a stone cavern at the edge\nof town.\cI've heard you can find rare stones\nthere.

sourceRecords.japanese: つかれて　たたかうことの　できない\nポケモンだって　ひでんと　いわれる\rわざは　つかうことが　できるよ！
sourceRecords.english: Even if a POKéMON faints and can't\nbattle, it can still use a move learned\rfrom a Hidden Machine, HM.

sourceRecords.japanese:
げんき　しとぉや！！
チャンピオンを　めざす　[PLAYER]！！\cムロタウン　ジムの　リーダー　トウキは
かくとうタイプ　ポケモンの　つかいてだ！\cノーマルタイプで　むかうと
きびしぃー　いちげきを　くらうからきを　つけたほうが　いいぞ！\cしかも！　この　ジムの　なかは
うみのそこ　みたいに　くらいんだ！\cでも！　トレーナーを　ひとり　たおすごとに
だんだん　あかるく　なって　いくぞ！\cじゃ　きばってこォー！！
sourceRecords.english:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound [PLAYER]?\cDEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY commands
FIGHTING-type POKéMON.\cGoing against him with NORMAL-type
POKéMON is asking for trouble.\cFIGHTING POKéMON will lay a serious
smack down on NORMAL POKéMON,so be careful!\cWhat's worse, the GYM is as dark as
the ocean floor.\cBut it will get brighter after defeating
the TRAINERS in your way.\cHey, okay, go for it!

sourceRecords.japanese: うおォ！　ずいぶん　あかるく　なったな！\cきみの　みらいも　あかるいぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Whoah! It's turned too bright in here!\cYour future is bright, too!

sourceRecords.japanese: ちから　こそ　せいぎっ！\nドリャーッ！！
ちからぶそく　だった‥‥！
じゅう　よく　ごうを　せいす！\nみごとな　たたかいぶり　だった！
sourceRecords.english: Your skill overcame my strength!\nYour technique is commendable!

sourceRecords.japanese: トウキさまと　たたかうまでも　ないわ！\nわたしが　たおして　あげる！
sourceRecords.english: There's no need for BRAWLY to be\ninvolved!\cI'll crush you!

sourceRecords.japanese: まさか‥‥\nこんなに　かんたんに　やられるなんて
sourceRecords.english: But... How?\nHow could I lose so easily?

sourceRecords.japanese: この　まけを　むだに　しないため\nもっと　とっくん　する！\cそして　いつかは　ジムリーダーに‥‥\cいえ　ポケモンリーグの\nチャンピオンに　なるわよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm not going to waste this loss.\nI'll use it to motivate me to train!\cOne day I'll become a GYM LEADER...\cNo, I'll become the POKéMON LEAGUE\nCHAMPION!

sourceRecords.japanese: あたしを　あまく　みない　ことね！\nないても　しらないわよ！
sourceRecords.english: Don't you dare brush me off!\nIt's not my fault if you cry!

sourceRecords.japanese: わぁーーーん！\nまけたーーーっ！
くらやみの　なかで　たたかうことで\nこころを　きたえるの\cでも　まっくら　だから\nトウキさまの　おかおを　みられない‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I battle in the dark to make my heart\nstronger.\cBut because it's so dark, I can never\nsee BRAWLY's face...

sourceRecords.japanese:
ボクは　ムロ　ポケモンジム
リーダーの　トウキ！\cこの　あたりの
はげしい　なみに　もまれ‥‥\cくらい　どうくつで
しゅぎょう　して　いるのさ！\cボクに　ちょうせん　しよう　という
キミの　じつりょく‥‥どれほどの　ものか　みさせてもらうよ！
sourceRecords.english:
I'm BRAWLY!
DEWFORD's GYM LEADER!\cI've been churned in the rough waves
of these parts, and I've grown toughin the pitch-black cave!\cSo you wanted to challenge me?
Let me see what you're made of!

sourceRecords.japanese: ううーん　よそう　していたより\nキミは　ビッグウェーブ！\cわかった！\nこの　バッジを　もっていきな！
sourceRecords.english: Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger\nsplash than I expected!\cYou swamped me!\cOkay, you've got me.\nTake this GYM BADGE!

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　トウキから\nナックルバッジを　もらった！

ナックルバッジには
レベル３０までの　ポケモンならひとから　もらった　ポケモンでもすなおに　する　こうかが　ある！\cそれに　たたかって　いなくても
ひでんわざの　フラッシュを　つかえる！\cこの　わざマシン
よかったら　つかいな！
sourceRecords.english:
The KNUCKLE BADGE makes all POKéMON
up to Level 30, even those you get intrades, obey without question.\cAnd, you'll be able to use the HM move
FLASH outside of battle.\cIf you'd like, use this TECHNICAL
MACHINE, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: その　わざマシン０８　には\nビルドアップが　はいっている！\cこうげきりょくと　ぼうぎょりょくを\nあげる　わざ　なのさ！
sourceRecords.english: That TM08 contains BULK UP.\cIt's a move that raises both ATTACK\nand DEFENSE stats.

sourceRecords.japanese: キミの　さいのうは\nいつのひか　おおきな　なみと　なって\cポケモン　トレーナーたちの　あいだに\nおどろきの　あらしを　まきおこすだろう！
sourceRecords.english: I can see your talent becoming a giant\nwave to cause a storm of astonishment\ramong TRAINERS one day!

sourceRecords.japanese: ムロタウン　ポケモンジム
ムロタウン　ポケモンジム\cトウキ　にんてい　トレーナー！\n[PLAYER]
sourceRecords.english: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM\cBRAWLY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n[PLAYER]

sourceRecords.japanese: いまの　はやりって　いったら　やっぱり\n「[STR_VAR_1]」よね！\c「[STR_VAR_1]」の　ない\nせいかつ　なんか　かんがえられない！
sourceRecords.english: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be\n“[STR_VAR_1]”!\cI can't imagine what life would be like\nwithout “[STR_VAR_1]”!

sourceRecords.japanese: いまの　はやりって　いったら　やっぱり\n「[STR_VAR_1]」よね！\cでも　もう　そろそろ\nあきてきたなー\cあたらしい　はやりでも　さがそっかなー
sourceRecords.english: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be\n“[STR_VAR_1]”!\cBut I'm getting kind of bored with it.\cI should look for the next big thing.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしは　ポケモンにも\n「[STR_VAR_1]」を\rおしえてるんだけど\cこれが　なかなか\nたいへん　なのよねー
sourceRecords.english: I'm teaching my POKéMON about\n“[STR_VAR_1],”\rbut it's not going well.\cIt's a bit too much, I think.

sourceRecords.japanese:
いま　はやりの
「[STR_VAR_1]」のことをしらべてるんだけど\c「[STR_VAR_1]」と
「[STR_VAR_2]」ってのは\cふかい　かんけいが　あるって　いうのは
ほんとうの　ことなのかい？
sourceRecords.english: I'm studying up on the hip and trendy\n“[STR_VAR_1]” now.\cIs it true that there's a deep link\nbetween “[STR_VAR_1]”\rand “[STR_VAR_2]”?

sourceRecords.japanese: お！\nやっぱり　そうなのか\cこれで　おじさんも　またいっぽ\nりゅうこうに　ちかづいたぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Oh!\nSo, my hunch was right!\cI'm one step closer to being hip and\nhappening, yowza!

sourceRecords.japanese: なに！？\nそうなのか！？\cいやー　おじさんが　りゅうこうに\nついて　いくのは　たいへんだ！

is really popular right now.\cOkay, listen!

[STR_VAR_1]!\cWonderful
[STR_VAR_1]!

sourceRecords.japanese: さっきの　はなし\nなんだけどさ\cこんど　この　しまで\n「[STR_VAR_1]」\rパーティーを　ひらこうぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Anyway, as I was saying earlier, we\nshould get together and organize a\r“[STR_VAR_1]” party\ron the island.

sourceRecords.japanese: お　いいね！！\cだれが　いちばん\n「[STR_VAR_1]」が\rうまいかを　きめるんだね！\cじゃあ　きょうから\c「[STR_VAR_1]」\nざんまいだ！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, a smashing good idea!\cIt will settle once and for all\nwho is the best at\r“[STR_VAR_1].”\rBrilliant, indeed!\cStarting today, our lives will revolve\naround “[STR_VAR_1]”!

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥そうだなぁ\c「[STR_VAR_1]」は　もう\nりゅうこう　じゃなくて\cせいかつの　いちぶ\nという　かんじかなぁ？

そんなに！？\cきみは　ねても　さめても
