sourceRecords.english:
Beg pardon?
That much, what?\cHowever, it's true that
“[STR_VAR_1]”weighs heavily on your mind, whetheryou're awake or asleep.\cAbsolutely, you're the
“[STR_VAR_1]”PROFESSOR, old sport!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくと　きみが\nコンビを　くめば\c『[STR_VAR_1]』では\nもう　むてきって　ことだな！
sourceRecords.english: If you and me team up as a combo,\nwe'll be invincible when it comes to all\rthings “[STR_VAR_1]”!

sourceRecords.japanese: そのとおり！\c「[STR_VAR_1]　コンビ」\nっていう　かんじだね！\cハハハ！！
sourceRecords.english: Spot on, my friend!\cWe shall be the\n“[STR_VAR_1]” DUO!\cIsn't that a ripe image?\nHahahah!

sourceRecords.japanese:
さいきん　ぼくの　なかでは
「ヘドロばくだん」が　だいブーム　なのさ！\cえー　きみ
「ヘドロばくだん」　しらないの？\cそれは　かわいそうだな
よし！　ぼくが　あげるよ！
sourceRecords.english:
For me, SLUDGE BOMB is at the peak
of popularity. It's the one.\cHunh? You're telling me that you don't
know about SLUDGE BOMB?\cThat's outright pitiful.
I'll give you one.

sourceRecords.japanese: 「ヘドロばくだん」も　いいけど\n「[STR_VAR_1]」って\rわざを　つかえる\rポケモンも　いいよね！
sourceRecords.english: I love SLUDGE BOMB.\cBut POKéMON with the\n“[STR_VAR_1]”\rmove are in, too.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ほら！　りゅうこう　さいせんたんの
この　シルクのスカーフ　ステキだろ！\cおっ　めが　かがやいてるね！
オレの　センスが　わかるんだな　きみは！\cうれしいね！
これは　プレゼント　するよ！
sourceRecords.english:
Gorge your eyes on this!\cIt's a SILK SCARF. It's right at the
cutting edge of fashion, yeah!\cOh, I can see your eyes twinkling!
You appreciate my dazzling style!\cOh, you're a delight!
Here you go. I want you to have it!

sourceRecords.japanese: え　もてないの？\nきみの　にもつを　ぜんぶ　うってでも\rもつべき　スカーフだぜ　これは！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, you don't have room?\cNow, listen tight, this SCARF is a must-\nhave! Why, I would sell all my items\rin order to get it!

sourceRecords.japanese: シルクのスカーフは　ノーマルタイプの\nわざの　いりょくを　あげてくれる！\cほとんどの　ポケモンに　にあう\nすてきな　スカーフ　ってことだぜ！
sourceRecords.english: The SILK SCARF raises the power of\nNORMAL-type moves.\cIt's a marvelous SCARF that will go\nwith almost all POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese:
へえ！　きみ　うみを　こえて
わざわざ　ムロまで　きたの！\cもしかして　トウキさんの　うわさを　きいて
あいに　きたんじゃない？\cトウキさん　かっこよくて
みんなが　あこがれるもんな！
sourceRecords.english:
Wow, you bothered to cross the sea
to visit DEWFORD?\cDid you maybe come here because you
heard about BRAWLY?\cHe's so cool...
Everyone idolizes him.

sourceRecords.japanese: どうも！\nやすくて　よく　きく　かんぽうや　です
sourceRecords.english: Welcome to the HERB SHOP, home of\neffective and inexpensive medicine!

sourceRecords.japanese: フエンの　かんぽうやくを\nみにくるとは　なかなか　しぶいのう\cきにいった！　これを　もってけ！
sourceRecords.english: You've come to look at herbal medicine\nin LAVARIDGE?\cThat's rather commendable.\cI like you! Take this!

sourceRecords.japanese: おまえさんに　あげた　もくたんは\nかんぽうやくを　つくるのに　つかうが\rポケモンに　もたせても　すごいぞ！\cほのおタイプの　わざの　いりょくを\nたかめて　くれるのじゃよ！
sourceRecords.english:
That CHARCOAL I gave you, it's used
for making herbal medicine.\cIt also does wonders when held by
a POKéMON.\cIt intensifies the power of FIRE-type
moves.

sourceRecords.japanese: かんぽうやくの　ききめは　すごいが\nポケモンに　のませると　きらわれるぞよ\rきっと　すっごく　にがいんじゃろうな！
sourceRecords.english: Herbal medicine works impressively well.\nBut your POKéMON will dislike you for it.\rIt must be horribly bitter!

sourceRecords.japanese:
げんき　しとぉや！！
チャンピオンを　めざす　[PLAYER]！！\cフエンタウン　ジムの　リーダー　アスナは
ほのおタイプ　ポケモンの　つかいてだ！\cポケモンに　たいする　じょうねつは
かざん　よりも　はげしく　あちィ！\cうっかり　ちかづくと　やけど　するから
みずで　ひやしながらきばってこー　な！！
sourceRecords.english:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound [PLAYER]?\cLAVARIDGE's GYM LEADER FLANNERY
uses FIRE-type POKéMON.\cHer passion for POKéMON burns stronger
and hotter than a volcano.\cDon't get too close to her - you'll burn!
Hose her down with water and thengo for it!

sourceRecords.japanese: いやあー　あちィ　たたかい　だった！
sourceRecords.english: Yow! That was a scorching hot battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: あちちちちちっ！\nぷはーっ！　あつかったーっ！
あせが　めに　しみるぜ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I'm blinded by sweat in my eyes...

sourceRecords.japanese: すなブロは　けっこうが　よくなって\nかんせつの　いたみに　こうかてき　だぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Being buried in hot sand promotes\ncirculation.\cIt's effective for healing pain in\nyour joints.

sourceRecords.japanese: ストレスを　かいしょう　する\nおれの　ひとときを　ジャマ　するなーっ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm trying to relieve my stress.\nDon't come along and stress me out!

sourceRecords.japanese: アスナさんに　まけてしまえーっ！
sourceRecords.english: I hope FLANNERY flames you good!

sourceRecords.japanese: はあ　ふう‥‥\cすなブロに　ながく　はいっていると\nけっこう　つかれちゃう　もんだよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Haaah... Whew...\cIf you spend too much time buried in\nhot sand, it tuckers you out...

sourceRecords.japanese: さすがに　つかれてきた　ようだね\nすなブロで　ひとやすみ　したいだろう？\cだが　きりょくを　たもつ　ことも\nトレーナーに　ひつような　さいのう　だよ
sourceRecords.english: You must be getting tired by now.\nYou'd like to rest in the hot sand,\rwouldn't you?\cBut you should know that maintaining\nyour willpower is an important ability\rfor all TRAINERS.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひあそびは　けがのもと　だったか‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Play with fire, and be burned...

sourceRecords.japanese: きみの　ちからは　ほんものだ‥‥\nでも　リーダー　アスナさんは　つよいよ！\cあまく　みていると　おおやけど　するぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Your skill is real...\nBut our LEADER FLANNERY is strong.\cIf you don't watch yourself, you'll be\nburned seriously.

sourceRecords.japanese: おまえの　ポケモン\n２００どの　あつさに　たえられるかよ！？
もえかたが　たりなかったか‥‥
２００どの　あつさ　ってのは\nようがんの　おんど！\cおまえの　ポケモン　おれに　かてたんだから\nようがんの　なかでも　へいき　だろうな！
sourceRecords.english: The temperature of magma is\n392 degrees.\cYour POKéMON beat me, so they should\neasily survive in magma.

sourceRecords.japanese: えーっと！\nじゃあ　しょうぶの　あいて　しますね！
なんて　つよいの！？
あたしも　アスナさんと　いっしょに\nきれいで　つよい　トレーナーに　なるんだ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm going to be a pretty and strong\nTRAINER just like FLANNERY.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ようこそ　‥‥じゃなくて\cよくぞ　ここまで　きた　ものだな！\cわたしは　ここの　ジムリーダーを
つとめさせて　いただく　‥‥じゃなくて\cジムリーダーを　まかされた　アスナだ！\cくう‥‥
ジムリーダーに　なりたて　だからってゆだん　など　しないことだ！\cおじいちゃん　ゆずりの　さいのうと
このとちで　みがきあげた　ホットな　わざあなたに　みせてやる！
sourceRecords.english:
Welcome... No, wait.\cPuny TRAINER, how good to see you've
made it here!\cI have been entrusted with the...
No, wait.\cI am FLANNERY, and I'm the GYM
LEADER here!\cUh...
Dare not underestimate me, thoughI have been LEADER only a short time!\cWith skills inherited from my grand-
father, I shall, uh...demonstrate thehot moves we have honed on this land!

sourceRecords.japanese:
くう‥‥
かたに　ちから　はいっちゃって‥‥\cあたし‥‥
ジムリーダーに　なりたて　だからってちょっと　むり　していたのかな‥‥\cやっぱ　じぶんらしく　でないと
いっしょに　たたかってくれるポケモンも　こまっちゃうよね！\cそれを　おしえてくれた
あなたに　これ　あげる！
sourceRecords.english:
Oh...
I guess I was trying too hard...\cI... I've only recently become a GYM
LEADER.\cI tried too hard to be someone I'm not.\cI have to do things my natural way.
If I don't, my POKéMON will be confused.\cThanks for teaching me that.
For that, you deserve this.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　アスナから\nヒートバッジを　もらった！

ヒートバッジが　あれば
レベル５０　までならひとから　もらった　ポケモンでもいうことを　きいて　くれるんだ！\cそれに　ひでんわざの　かいりき　が
つかえるようにも　なるよ！\cこれは　かんしゃの　きもち
えんりょ　せずに　もらって！
sourceRecords.english:
If you have a HEAT BADGE, all POKéMON
up to Level 50, even those you get intrades from other people, will obeyyou completely.\cAnd, it lets POKéMON use the HM move
STRENGTH outside of battle.\cThis is a token of my appreciation.
Don't be shy about taking it!

sourceRecords.japanese:
わざマシン５０　には
オーバーヒートが　はいってるよ！\cその　わざは　あいてに
おおきな　ダメージを　あたえるんだ！\cだけど　とくこうが
がくっと　さがっちゃう　からながい　しょうぶには　むかないかも‥‥
sourceRecords.english: That TM50 contains OVERHEAT.\cThat move inflicts serious damage on\nthe opponent.\cBut it also sharply cuts the SP. ATK\nof the POKéMON using it. It might not\rbe suitable for longer battles.

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたの　つよさ\nだれかを　おもいださせるの　よね‥‥\cそうだ！　トウカシティの　ジムリーダー\nセンリさんに　にているんだ！
sourceRecords.english: Your power reminds me of someone...\cOh! I know! You battle like NORMAN,\nthe GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.

sourceRecords.japanese: フエンタウン　ポケモンジム
フエンタウン　ポケモンジム\cアスナ　にんてい　トレーナー！\n[PLAYER]
sourceRecords.english: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM\cFLANNERY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n[PLAYER]

sourceRecords.japanese: おんせんで　タマゴを　あたためている\nばあさんから　きいたんじゃが‥‥\cそだてやに　ポケモンを\n２ひき　いっしょに　あずけたらの\rなんと　タマゴが　みつかったそうじゃ！！
sourceRecords.english: My wife's warming an EGG in the hot\nsprings. This is what she told me.\cShe left two POKéMON with the DAY CARE.\nAnd they discovered that EGG!

sourceRecords.japanese: ジグザグマ『ぷしゅー！
スピーダー　つかって\nポケモンの　すばやさ　あげるんじゃ！\cそうすりゃ　せんせいこうげき　できて\nたたかいが　ゆうりに　なるからのう！
sourceRecords.english: Use X SPEED to add to a POKéMON's\nSPEED in battle.\cThat will help it get in the first\nstrike - a decided advantage!

sourceRecords.japanese: えんとつやまの　ちょうじょう　だけで\nかうことが　できる　おみやげは\rポケモンに　あげると　よろこぶよ！
sourceRecords.english: On MT. CHIMNEY's peak, there's a local\nspecialty that you can buy only there.\cGive it to a POKéMON - it will be elated.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンと　いっしょに　あるいていると\nなんだか　ポケモンが　なついてくれるような\rそんな　きが　するのよね
sourceRecords.english: I think POKéMON get closer to their\nTRAINERS if they spend time together.\cThe longer the better.\nThat's what I think.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンに　あかいポロックを　あげると\nなんだか　かっこよくなった！\cボクも　あかいポロック　たべようかな？
sourceRecords.english: I gave a RED [POKEBLOCK] to my POKéMON.\nIt looks a lot cooler all of a sudden.\cHmm...\nMaybe I ought to eat a RED [POKEBLOCK].

sourceRecords.japanese: ほっほっほ！　おわかいの\nここから　おんせんに　いけますぞ！\cポケモンが　ここで　やすむのなら\nひとも　おんせんで　ゆっくり　しませんと！
sourceRecords.english: Hohoho! Hey, kid, you can reach\nthe hot springs from here.\cIf POKéMON are getting rest, so too\nshould their TRAINERS.

sourceRecords.japanese:
あたしの　エネコにね
つきのいしを　つかってね‥‥\cしんか　させるか　どうか
すっごい　まよってるのよぉ\cしんか　させると　つよくなるけど
すがたかたち　かわっちゃうし‥‥
sourceRecords.english:
I'm having a hard time deciding if I
should make my SKITTY evolve or not.\cI only have to use this MOON STONE,
but it's so hard to decide...\cIf I make it evolve, it will become
much stronger.\cBut it will look so different, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: エネコ『みゃおう？
ひろった　きんのたま‥‥\nやっぱり　うるしか　ないのかなあ？\rほかに　つかいみちも　ないからなあ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: This NUGGET I found here...\nI suppose I'll have to sell it, seeing\ras how it has no other use.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ぼくの　ポケモン　あそこの　かべに
にがおえが　はって　あったんだ　けど\cもう　ちがう　ポケモンの　やつに
かわっちゃった‥‥\cまた　がんばって　ぼくの　ハナちゃんを
はって　もらうぞう！
sourceRecords.english: They had a sketch of my POKéMON up\non the wall over there, but they\rchanged it with a new one already.\cI'm going to enter my HANA in CONTESTS\nso we can get her sketch up again!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポロックは　つくってる？\cこんど　いっぱい　きのみを\nもっておいでよ！
sourceRecords.english: Hi, are you making any [POKEBLOCK]S?\cYou should come by with a bunch of\nBERRIES sometime.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここに　ゆうしょう　した　ポケモンの\nえが　かざって　あるだろ？\cこれ　ぼくが　かいてるんだ！\cきみの　ポケモンが　ゆうしょう　したら\nはりきって　かかせて　もらうよ！
sourceRecords.english: You see how they display a sketch of\na CONTEST winner here?\cI sketch them!\cIf any of your POKéMON wins a CONTEST,\nI'd gladly make a sketch of it!

sourceRecords.japanese: やあ　ゆうしょう　おめでとう！\cきみの　ポケモンの　にがおえは\nここに　バッチリ　かざって　おいたからね！
sourceRecords.english: Hello! Congratulations!\cI've put up a sketch of your POKéMON\nright here for everyone to see!

sourceRecords.japanese: １じ　しんさでは　いいセン　いくけど\nなぜか　アピールで　かてないんだ‥‥\cじぶんの　ポケモンばっかり　みてると\nかてないって　ことかなあ
sourceRecords.english: We do all right in the preliminary round,\nbut we can never win the appeals...\cMaybe it means I have to watch what\nother contestants are doing...

sourceRecords.japanese: みて！　わたしの　ポケモン\nこんなに　リボンが　いっぱい！\cあなたの　ポケモンは　リボン　もらった？\nもらって　いれば　ポケナビで　みられるわよ！
sourceRecords.english: See!\nMy POKéMON won all these RIBBONS!\cHave your POKéMON earned any RIBBONS?\nYou can check them on your POKéNAV.

sourceRecords.japanese: ジムリーダーにも　かてない‥‥\cコンテストでも　かてない‥‥\cあっちのまち　こっちのまちを\nいったり　きたり　だよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I can't beat GYM LEADERS...\cI can't win any CONTESTS...\cI've been here, there, and everywhere,\nand it's all for naught...

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモン　コンテスト\nスーパーランク　ステージ！

あなたは‥‥？\c[PLAYER][KUN]　というのですか
あなた　トレーナー　なんですね\cということは　あたしの　つくった
あずかりシステム　つかってますね？\cだって　つかいたいから
パソコンの　まえに　いる　あたしにはなしかけてきた　という　わけですよねかんたんな　すいり　です\cあっ　あたし　マユミ　といいます\cあずかりシステムを　つかっている
トレーナーに　あえて　すごく　うれしいです\cよかったら　あたしの　いえにも
あそびに　きてください１１４ばんどうろに　ありますから
sourceRecords.english:
Oh, hello.
You are?\cOkay, your name's [PLAYER][KUN].
I can see that you're a TRAINER.\cSo that means you use the POKéMON
Storage System I developed.\cHow I arrived at that conclusion is
a simple deductive process.\cYou spoke to me because you wanted
to access something on this PC.\cOh, I'm sorry. I'm LANETTE.\cHonestly, I'm glad to meet you - it's
great you're using the Storage System.\cIf you could, please visit me at home.
My house is on ROUTE 114.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおむかしの　ポケモンって\nどんな　すがた　だったのかしら？\cこの　まちの　はずれにいる\nかせきマニアなら　おしえてくれるかも
sourceRecords.english: I wonder what POKéMON looked like\nlong, long ago?\cMaybe the FOSSIL MANIAC at the edge\nof town will know.

sourceRecords.japanese: この　ハジツゲの　はたけ　ではな\nかざんばいの　なかでも　そだつような\rじょうぶな　きの　なえを　うえてるんじゃ
sourceRecords.english: In the fields of FALLARBOR, we plant\nseedlings of hardy trees that thrive\reven in volcanic ash.

sourceRecords.japanese: ソライシ『ああ‥‥\n[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　だまされたからと　いって\rいんせきが　てに　はいる　ばしょを\rおしえてしまったら　だめ　だなあ‥‥\cりゅうせいのたき　の　いんせき\nもう　ぼくの　モノには　ならないよな‥‥
sourceRecords.english: PROF. COZMO: Oh...\nI never should have let myself be\rconned into telling TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] where\ryou can find METEORITES...\cThat METEORITE from METEOR FALLS...\nIt's never going to be mine now...

sourceRecords.japanese: おお！　ええ？\cそれは‥‥\cもしかして　もしかすると‥‥\c[EVIL_TEAM]だんが　りゅうせいのたき　から\nもっていった　いんせき　ですか‥‥！？\cよかったら　ぼくに　ください！\cただで　とは　いいません\nかわりに　この　わざマシンを\rあげますから‥‥
sourceRecords.english:
Oh!
Hah?\cThat item...\cCould it be?\cIs it the METEORITE that TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]
took from METEOR FALLS?\cPlease, may I have it?\cI'm not asking for it for free.
How about in exchange for this TM?

sourceRecords.japanese: ソライシ『この　わざマシンは\nぼくの　きもちです\rぜひ　つかってください！
sourceRecords.english: PROF. COZMO: This TM, it represents\nmy feeling of gratitude.\rPlease use it!

sourceRecords.japanese: ソライシ『いやー　すごく　うれしいな\nこれで　ぼくの　けんきゅうも　はかどります！
sourceRecords.english: PROF. COZMO: Oh, I can't believe it.\nThis is really, really great!\cThis is really going to help my research!

sourceRecords.japanese: ソライシ『そんな‥‥\nものすごく　がっかりだよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: PROF. COZMO: Oh, but...\nI'm crushed with disappointment...

sourceRecords.japanese: ソライシ『その　いんせき‥‥\nよかったら　ぼくに　ください！\cただで　とは　いいません\nかわりに　この　わざマシンを\rあげますから‥‥
sourceRecords.english: PROF. COZMO: Please, may I have that\nMETEORITE?\cI'm not asking for it for free.\nHow about in exchange for this TM?

sourceRecords.japanese: ソライシはかせは\n[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　ひとと　いっしょに\r１１４ばん　どうろに　ある\rりゅうせいのたきに　いきましたよ
sourceRecords.english: PROF. COZMO went off to METEOR FALLS\non ROUTE 114 with some people from\rTEAM [EVIL_TEAM].

sourceRecords.japanese: ソライシはかせ‥‥\nあんなに　おちこんで　かわいそう！
sourceRecords.english: Poor PROF. COZMO...\nHe's so depressed... I feel sorry for him.

sourceRecords.japanese: ソライシはかせ　ったら\nあんなに　よろこんで　かわいい！
sourceRecords.english: Look at PROF. COZMO...\nHe's so happy! I think it's cute.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼく　ポケモン　わざマニア\cポケモンが　せいちょうして　おぼえていく\nわざを　すべて　しっていて\rポケモンに　おしえることが　できるんだ！\cぼくが　いま　あつめている\nハートのウロコを　くれたら\rしってる　わざを　おしえてあげるよ！
sourceRecords.english:
I'm the MOVE TUTOR.\cI know all the moves that POKéMON
learn - every one of them - and I canteach POKéMON those moves.\cI can teach a move to a POKéMON
of yours if you'd like.\cI'll do it for a HEART SCALE.
I'm collecting those now.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおっ！\nそれは　まさしく　ハートのウロコ！\cわざを　おぼえさせたいんだね？
sourceRecords.english: Oh! That's it! That's an honest to\ngoodness HEART SCALE!\cLet me guess, you want me to teach\na move?

sourceRecords.japanese: どの　ポケモンに　するんだい？
どの　わざに　するんだい？
ごめんね‥‥\cぼくが　その　ポケモンに\nおしえられる　わざは　ないみたいだよ
sourceRecords.english: Sorry...\cIt doesn't appear as if I have any move\nI can teach that POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　おれいに\nハートのウロコを　１まい　あげた！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] handed over one HEART SCALE\nin exchange.

sourceRecords.japanese: おぼえさせたい　わざが　あったら\nハートのウロコを　もってきてね！
sourceRecords.english: If your POKéMON need to learn a move,\ncome back with a HEART SCALE.

sourceRecords.japanese: えっ？\nタマゴに　おしえられる　わざは　ないよ
sourceRecords.english: Hunh? There isn't a single move that\nI can teach an EGG.

sourceRecords.japanese: そこの　いりぐちから　はいって\nコンテストの　かいじょうを　みてきたんだ\rあんな　おおきい　ステージに\rのぼるなんて　きんちょう　するなあ！
sourceRecords.english: I went in through the entrance and\ntook a look around the CONTEST hall.\cGetting up on that big stage...\nIt's going to be tense!

sourceRecords.japanese: あたしの　ポケモンへの　きもち‥‥\nそれは　まさに　メロメロなのよ‥‥\cあら　へんなところ　みられちゃった\cまあ　いいわ\nあなた　コンテストに　でるのなら\rこの　わざマシンは　いかが？
sourceRecords.english:
Oh, my love for POKéMON...
The attraction they evoke in me...\cWhoops!
You weren't meant to see that!Well, anyway.\cIf you're entering a CONTEST, try this
move on for size.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンの　あたしへの　きもちも‥‥\nやっぱり　メロメロに　ちがいないわ！
sourceRecords.english: My feelings for POKéMON...\nOh, they attract me so...

sourceRecords.japanese: きみは　なにコンテストに　でるんだい？\cたとえば　かっこよさコンテストに　だすなら\nかっこいい　ポケモンで　きまりさ！\cコンテストに　ふさわしい　ポケモンに\nふさわしい　わざを　もたせて\rエントリー！　これ　じょうしきさ！
sourceRecords.english:
Which CONTEST are you planning on
entering?\cIf you're entering a COOL CONTEST,
a cool POKéMON has to be the one!\cPick a POKéMON worthy of the CONTEST
theme, and make sure it has theright set of moves to match.\cThat's fundamental!

sourceRecords.japanese: きみ　なにコンテストに　でるの？\nひとつ　アドバイス　してあげるよ！\cたとえば　かわいさコンテスト　でも\n１じしんさで　かわいさ　だけが\rみられてる　わけじゃ　ないみたいなんだ\cそだてかたを　くふう　したほうが　いいよ！
sourceRecords.english:
Which CONTEST are you entering?
Want a piece of advice?\cIn any CONTEST, for example, a CUTE
CONTEST, I don't think they judge youonly on cuteness in the first round.\cYou need to work out ways for raising
POKéMON better.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンが　かわいく　なるように\nそだてて　いたんだけど\cコンテストって　かわいらしさも\nきそう　ことが　できるのね！\cだいじに　そだてて　よかった‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I raised my POKéMON to be cute.\cI found out you can put POKéMON in\na CONTEST for cuteness!\cI'm so glad I raised my POKéMON with\nloving care...

sourceRecords.japanese: おれの　ポケモン‥‥\cそりゃあ　もう　かっこよくて\nたくましくて　うつくしくて\rかわいくて　かしこいんだけど　さ\cこうなったら　ぜんぶの　コンテストで\nかたっぱし　から　ゆうしょう　ねらうか！
sourceRecords.english: My POKéMON rules!\cIt's cool, tough yet beautiful, cute,\nand smart. It's complete!\cI may as well go for wins in every\nsingle CONTEST.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモン　コンテスト\nノーマルランク　ステージ！
ポケモン　しょうぶに\nスペシャルアップは　かかせない！\cたたかいの　ときだけ　とはいえ\nわざの　いりょくが　あがるんだからな！
sourceRecords.english: For any POKéMON match, X SPECIAL\nis crucial.\cIt jacks up the power of some moves\neven though it's only for one battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: コンテストに　かてるような\nどうぐは　うってない　ですねえ‥‥\cやはり　ふだんから\nだいじに　そだてないと　ダメなんですねえ
sourceRecords.english: They don't sell any items that will let\nyou win CONTESTS...\cIt means you have to raise POKéMON\ndiligently on an everyday basis.

sourceRecords.japanese: シダケでしか　かえない　ネストボール\nよわい　ポケモンほど　つかまえ　やすくなるの
sourceRecords.english: The NEST BALL works better on\nweakened POKéMON.\cVERDANTURF is the only place you can\nbuy it.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンに　なつかれて　いないようでは\nいちにんまえ　とは　いえないね\rポロックを　あげたりとか　しているのかい？
sourceRecords.english: I daresay a TRAINER isn't qualified if\nPOKéMON aren't settled and friendly.\rHave you given them any [POKEBLOCK]S?

sourceRecords.japanese: シダケにくる　りゆうと　いえば\nずばり　ポケモン　コンテストじゃろ？\cコンテストへの　ちょうせんは\nここから　はじまるからのう‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Let me hazard a guess why you're in\nVERDANTURF. The reason: CONTESTS.\cAll CONTEST challenges originate here.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ミツル『[PLAYER]さんに　まけたけど
もう　おちこんでないよ\cだって　ラルトスと　いっしょに
あちこちの　ジムで　うでだめし　してすごい　トレーナーに　なるってもくひょうが　できたから！\cいつか　[PLAYER]さん　よりも
つよくなって　もういちどポケモンしょうぶを　おねがい　するからね！
sourceRecords.english:
WALLY: I lost to you, [PLAYER], but I'm
not feeling down anymore.\cBecause I have a new purpose in life.
Together with my RALTS, I'm goingto challenge POKéMON GYMS and becomea great TRAINER.\cPlease watch me, [PLAYER].
I'm going to be stronger than you.\cWhen I do, I'm going to challenge you
to another battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミツル『いつか　[PLAYER]さん　よりも\nつよくなって　もういちど\rポケモンしょうぶを　おねがい　するからね！
sourceRecords.english: WALLY: Please watch me, [PLAYER].\nI'm going to get stronger than you.\cWhen I do, I'm going to challenge you\nto another battle.

sourceRecords.japanese:
おじさん『おお！　[PLAYER][KUN]
ミツルくんは　となりに　いるよ！\cしかし　たいした　もんだね！\cしぜんに　かこまれた　かんきょうが
ミツルくんを　げんきに　させている！\c‥‥いや　もしかすると
あのこに　きぼうを　あたえて　いるのは\cポケモンなのかも　しれないな‥‥
sourceRecords.english:
UNCLE: Oh! [PLAYER][KUN]!
WALLY's next door.\cBut, boy, there's something I have to
tell you.\cThis natural environment is doing
wonders for WALLY's health.\cMaybe it's not just the environment.
It could be POKéMON that are giving theboy hope.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミツルくん‥‥\nいつのまにか　いなくなっちゃった‥‥
sourceRecords.english: WALLY's gone away...\nHe slipped off on his own...

sourceRecords.japanese: おじさん『そうですか‥‥\nあの　ミツルくんが\rひとりで　そんな　とおくまで‥‥\cさすがは　わたしの　おとうとの　むすこだ！
sourceRecords.english: UNCLE: Is that right?\nWALLY's gone away that far all by\rhimself...\cWell, I have to give him credit - he is\nmy little brother's son.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ミチル『あなたは‥‥？
‥‥‥あ　そうか！\cミツルくんが　いってた
[PLAYER]さんって　あなたの　ことね！\cわたしは　ミツルくんの　いとこ　なの！\cどう？　あのこ　こっちに　きてから
ずいぶん　げんきに　なったでしょう？
sourceRecords.english:
WANDA: You are?
Oh, right, I get it!\cYou're the [PLAYER] who WALLY was
telling me about.\cI'm WALLY's cousin.
Glad to meet you!\cI think WALLY's become a lot more lively
and healthy since he came here.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミチル『ミツルくんの　ことなら\nだいじょうぶ！　しんぱい　ないわよ！\cだって　わたしの　いとこ　だし\nなにより　ポケモンが　いっしょ　ですもの！
sourceRecords.english: WANDA: Don't worry about WALLY.\nHe'll be just fine.\cI know my little cousin, and he has\nPOKéMON with him, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみの　おかげで\nまいにち　かのじょに　あえて\rおれは　ハッピーだよ！
sourceRecords.english: Thanks to you, I can see my girlfriend\nevery day.\rHappy? You bet I am!

sourceRecords.japanese:
うちの　むすめの　こいびとは
ずいぶん　じょうねつてきな　ひとでね\cむすめに　あうため　だけに
ひたすら　トンネルを　ほってるってよ！\cむすめも　しんぱい　なのか
いつも　トンネルに　あしを　はこんでるよ
sourceRecords.english:
My daughter's boyfriend is a very
driven and passionate sort of person.\cHe's been digging a tunnel nonstop
just so he can see my daughter.\cMy daughter's a little concerned,
so she goes out to the tunnel a lot.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんと！　むすめの　こいびと　ときたら\nすでで　トンネルを　ほっていたって！\cそりゃあ　たまげた　もんだ！
sourceRecords.english: It's amazing. My daughter's boyfriend\nwas digging the tunnel by hand!\cIt's so incredible!

sourceRecords.japanese: ミツルくんに　もしものことが　あったら\nあたしゃ　トウカにいる　ごりょうしんに\rあわせる　かおが　ないよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: If anything were to happen to WALLY,\nI would never be able to look his\rparents in PETALBURG in the eye...

sourceRecords.japanese: ミツルくんが　サイユウに　いたって！？\cそりゃ　トウカの　ごりょうしんも\nびっくり　するだろうねぇ
sourceRecords.english: WALLY was in EVER GRANDE?\cHis parents in PETALBURG would be\nastonished to hear that!

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたの　ポケモンが\nどれくらい　なついているか　みてあげる\cあら‥‥\nあなたの　ポケモン
sourceRecords.english: Let me see your POKéMON.\nI'll check to see how much it likes you.\cOh.\nYour POKéMON...

sourceRecords.japanese: これいじょうは　ない　ってぐらい\nあなたに　なついているわね\rみている　こっちも　しあわせに　なるわ！
sourceRecords.english: It adores you.\nIt can't possibly love you any more.\rI even feel happy seeing it.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんだか　しあわせそう\nすごく　あなたに　なついているわね
sourceRecords.english: It seems to be very happy.\nIt obviously likes you a whole lot.

sourceRecords.japanese: かなり　なついているわね\nあなたに　あまえたそうに　しているわよ
sourceRecords.english: It likes you quite a lot.\nIt seems to want to be babied a little.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちょっと　なついてきた　って　かんじ　かな\nあなたのこと　しんじている　みたい
sourceRecords.english: It's getting used to you.\nIt seems to believe in you.

sourceRecords.japanese: まだ　あなたに　なれていない　ようね\nふつうの　かんけい　って　かんじが　するわ
sourceRecords.english: It's not very used to you yet.\nIt neither loves nor hates you.

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥　なんだか　けいかい　しているみたい\nめつきも　ちょっと　こわいし\rぜんぜん　あなたに　なついていないわ
sourceRecords.english: It's very wary.\nIt has scary viciousness in its eyes.\rIt doesn't like you much at all.

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥　ちょっと　いいづらいんだけど\cあなた　じぶんの　ポケモンに\nそんなに　きらわれていて　だいじょうぶ？
sourceRecords.english: This is a little hard for me to say...\cYour POKéMON simply detests you.\nDoesn't that make you uncomfortable?

sourceRecords.japanese: ピカチュウ『ピカピカッ！
とおく　はなれた\nサイユウの　おくちに　ある　という\rポケモン　リーグ\cそこに　あつまるのは\nすごうでの　トレーナー　ばかり　ですって！
sourceRecords.english: Far away, deep in EVER GRANDE CITY,\nis the POKéMON LEAGUE.\cThe TRAINERS who gather there are\nall frighteningly well skilled.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモン　リーグは\nしてんのう　４にん　つづけて\rしょうぶする　という　ルールらしいの！\cとちゅうで　まけたら　ひとりめ　から\nやりなおし　だなんて　きびしいのね！
sourceRecords.english: In the POKéMON LEAGUE, I think the\nrules say that you have to battle the\rELITE FOUR all in a row.\cIf you lose to any of them, you have\nto begin your challenge again from the\rfirst one.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみの　トレーナーカードは　なにいろ？\nあたしのは　カッパー　なんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: What color is your TRAINER'S CARD?\nMine's copper!

sourceRecords.japanese: キナギタウンって　サニーゴたちの\nあつまりの　うえに　うかんでいるの\c‥‥なんて　いったら\nあなたは　しんじるかしら？
sourceRecords.english: PACIFIDLOG TOWN floats on top of\na colony of CORSOLA.\cIf I told you that, would you believe me?

sourceRecords.japanese: キナギで　くらす　ひとびとの　せんぞは\nふねの　うえで　うまれて\rそして　ふねの　うえで　しんだ　という\cなにかを　さがすために\nそんな　いきかたを　していたそうじゃ
sourceRecords.english: The ancestors of the people in\nPACIFIDLOG were said to have been\rborn on boats and then lived and died \raboard them.\cI understand that they lived that way\nbecause they were searching for\rsomething.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ホウエンちほう　には
いわ‥‥　こおり‥‥　はがね‥‥\cそれぞれの　ちからを　つかさどる
３びきの　ポケモンがそれぞれ　どこかの　どうくつに　いる‥‥\cおれ　ちいさな　ころに
そんな　はなしを　きいたことが　あるよ
sourceRecords.english:
In the HOENN region, there are three
POKéMON that represent the power ofrock, ice, and steel.\cEach of them is said to hide away deep
inside caves.\cThat's the story I heard when I was
just a little kid.

sourceRecords.japanese: 「むっつの　てんが\n　みっつの　とびらを　あける」\cおじいちゃんが　よく　いっていたけど\nいまだに　なんのことだか　わからないわ
sourceRecords.english: “Six dots open three doors.”\cGrandpa used to say that, but I don't\nknow what he meant.

sourceRecords.japanese: ウォッホン！！\cわしが　ポケモン　だいすきクラブで\nいちばーん　えらい　かいちょうの‥‥\cおとうと　ですぞ！\cまあ　ここで　ポケモンと　いっしょに\nバカンスを　たのしんで　おるのですな！
sourceRecords.english: Er-hem!\cI am the POKéMON FAN CLUB's most\nimportant person, the CHAIRMAN's\ryounger brother.\cI'm here enjoying my vacation with\nPOKéMON, yes, indeed.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほう！\nきみの　ポケモン‥‥
とっても　なついて　いますなあ\cそんな　かわいらしい　ポケモンには\nこの　わざマシン　どうですかな？
sourceRecords.english: It clearly likes you very much.\cA POKéMON that adoring and adorable\ndeserves a TM like this, no?

sourceRecords.japanese: ふむう‥‥\nわるくは　ないんだが　よくもない‥‥\cおやの　トレーナーである　きみの\nどりょくが　ひつよう　ですな！
sourceRecords.english: Hmm...\nIt's not bad, but it's also not good.\cYou, as the TRAINER, need to put in\nsome more effort.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんだか　めつきが　わるいですのう\cそんな　こわそうな　ポケモンには\nこの　わざマシン　どうですかな？
sourceRecords.english: It has a vicious look to it.\cA frightening POKéMON like that\ndeserves a TM like this.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンの　なつきどが　たかいと\nおんがえしの　いりょくも　たかくなる\cなつきどが　ひくいと\nやつあたりの　いりょくが　つよまるんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: If a POKéMON likes you a lot, RETURN's\npower is enhanced.\cIf it doesn't like you, FRUSTRATION's\npower goes up.

sourceRecords.japanese: そうそう　あと[STR_VAR_1]にち　たてば\nいい　わざマシンが　てに　はいるんだよ！\cそのとき　また　あそびに　きたまえ！\nきみの　ポケモンに　あった\rすてきな　わざマシンを　あげるから
sourceRecords.english: Oh, yes. In about [STR_VAR_1] or so days,\nI should be getting a good TM or two.\cYou should come see me then.\nI'll give you a TM that's suitable for\ryour POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: ルリリ『るりー
とっても　なついて　いるようだ
sourceRecords.english: It appears to be very friendly with the\nTRAINER.

sourceRecords.japanese: ルリリ『ルルリッ！！
あんまり　なついて　いないようだ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: It doesn't appear to like the TRAINER\nvery much.

sourceRecords.japanese:
トレーナーさん！　よかったら
ポケモンを　こうかん　して　くださいな\cキナギだけに　いると　つかまえられる
ポケモンが　かぎられるのよね！\cあなた　[STR_VAR_1]　もってない？
あたしは　[STR_VAR_2]を　あげるわ！
sourceRecords.english:
Hello, TRAINER. Would you do me a favor
and trade POKéMON with me?\cLiving in PACIFIDLOG, I can only catch
certain kinds of POKéMON.\c[STR_VAR_1]? Do you have one?
I'll trade you my [STR_VAR_2] for it.

sourceRecords.japanese: わあ！\n[STR_VAR_1]　って　ふわふわ　してるのね！
それ　[STR_VAR_1]　と　ちがうわよ
ちょっと　がっかり‥‥
こうやって　ポケモン　こうかん　したら\nあなたと　あたし　もう　ともだち　よね！
sourceRecords.english: Since we traded, you and me,\nwe're friends, aren't we?

sourceRecords.japanese: それって　ポケモンずかん？\cそれって　あなた　たくさんの\nポケモンと　であった　ってこと？\cそれって　すっごい　うらやましい！
sourceRecords.english: Is that a POKéDEX?\cDid you get to meet a lot of different\nPOKéMON?\cI wish I was like you.

sourceRecords.japanese: ホウエンの　そらたかくを　とんでいく\nポケモンを　みた！　って　ひとが　いるけど\cずっと　とびまわって　いるのかしら？\nどこかで　やすんだり　しそうだけど
sourceRecords.english: People were saying they saw a POKéMON\nFLYING high above HOENN.\cIs it FLYING around all the time?\nDoesn't it need to rest somewhere?

sourceRecords.japanese: おそらの　ポケモン！\nおそらの　ポケモン！
きみ　どこから　きたの？
はい‥‥？\nハイ‥　タウン‥‥？\cしらないなぁ　そんな　まち
sourceRecords.english: Yes?\nYES TOWN?\cI've never heard of a place like that.

sourceRecords.japanese: いいえ　って　そんな‥‥\nどこからも　きてない　はずが　ないでしょ\cま　まさか　きみ‥‥\nうみの　そこで　うまれた　とか‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: No? That doesn't make any sense.\nYou have to come from somewhere.\cOh! Wait! You're not going to say you\nwere born at the bottom of the sea?

sourceRecords.japanese: きょうは　マボロシじま　みえんのう‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I can't see MIRAGE ISLAND today...

sourceRecords.japanese: なっ　なんと！\nきょうは　マボロシじま　みえるのじゃ！
sourceRecords.english: Oh! Oh my!\nI can see MIRAGE ISLAND today!

sourceRecords.japanese: マボロシじま‥‥\nおそらく　しんきろうの　かんけいで\rみえたり　みえなかったり　するんだろう\cいや　ひょっとしたら　ほんとうに\nあらわれたり　きえたり　しているのか‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: MIRAGE ISLAND...\cIt must become visible and invisible\ndepending on the weather conditions\rthat make mirages appear.\cOr is it really appearing and\ndisappearing?

sourceRecords.japanese:
きみは‥‥
そうか　[PLAYER][KUN]　だね？\cさっきは　ミツルの　あいてを　してくれて
ありがとう‥‥\cあのこは　うまれた　ときから
からだが　じょうぶでは　なくてね\cそれで　すこしの　あいだ　シダケタウンの
わたしの　しんせきの　うちであずかってもらう　ことに　したんだよ\cあそこは　ここよりも　ずっと
くうきが　きれいな　ところ　だからね！\c‥‥で　ミツルかい？　ミツルなら
もう　しゅっぱつ　していったよ\cいまごろは　どの　あたりかなあ‥‥
sourceRecords.english:
You're...
Ah, you must be [PLAYER][KUN], right?\cThank you for playing with WALLY a
little while ago.\cHe's been frail and sickly ever
since he was a baby.\cWe've sent him to stay with my relatives
in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.\cThe air is a lot cleaner there
than it is here.\cWhat's that? Where's WALLY?
He's already left, our WALLY.\cI wonder where he could have
gotten by now?

sourceRecords.japanese: ミツルは　どうしてるかなあ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?

sourceRecords.japanese:
やあ　[PLAYER][KUN]！\cミツルは　シダケタウンに　いってから
すっかり　げんきを　とりもどしたよ！\cそれも　みんな　きみの　おかげさ！\cなにしろ　このまちを　でるときに
ミツルが　ポケモンを　つかまえるのをてつだって　くれただろう？\cあのときの　ことが　ミツルは　とっても
うれしかった　らしいんだ！\cいや　ミツル　だけじゃない
ちちおやの　わたしも　うれしいよ！\cあのこに　きみの　ような
やさしい　ともだちが　できたことが　ね！\cそのおれい　という　わけでは　ないけど
これを　うけとって　くれないか！
sourceRecords.english:
Hi there, [PLAYER][KUN]!\cOur WALLY's become very healthy
since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN.\cWe owe it all to you!\cWhen WALLY left town, you helped
him catch a POKéMON, right?\cI think that made WALLY really
happy.\cActually, not just WALLY.
It made me, his father, happy too.\cHappy that he's got such a great
friend as you.\cThis isn't a bribe or anything, but
I'd really like you to have this.

sourceRecords.japanese: なみのりを　つかえるように　なれば\nいろんな　ばしょに　いけるように　なるよ！
sourceRecords.english: If your POKéMON can SURF, you'll be\nable to go to all sorts of places.

sourceRecords.japanese: もうすぐ　ミツルが　かえってくるぞ！\nたのしみだなあ‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: WALLY's coming home soon.\nI'm looking forward to that.

sourceRecords.japanese: ええっ！？　サイユウシティで\nミツルと　であった　だって‥‥？\cんもう　[PLAYER][KUN]ってばー\cいくら　あのこが　げんきに　なったからって\nそんな　とおくの　まち　まで\rひとりで　いけるわけ　ないよねえ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Oh? You met WALLY in EVER GRANDE\nCITY?\cOh, [PLAYER][KUN], don't be silly.\cHe may have gotten healthy, but he\ncan't go somewhere far away like\rthat all by himself.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミツルが　ポケモンを　つかまえた　って\nすごく　うれしそうに　はなしていたの\cあのこの　あんな　えがお　ひさしぶり
sourceRecords.english: WALLY was really happy when he told\nus that he caught a POKéMON.\cIt's been ages since I've seen him\nsmile like that.

sourceRecords.japanese: あら　[PLAYER]さん！\nあなたに　わたしたい　ものが　あるの！\cうちの　しゅじんに　こえを　かけて\nぜひ　うけとって　くださいな！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, hello, [PLAYER]! We've got\nsomething we want you to have.\cMy husband has it, so please have a\nword with him, dear.

sourceRecords.japanese: うちの　しゅじんには　ないしょ　だけど\cじつは　ミツルったら　シダケタウンを\nかってに　でて　いっちゃった　らしいの‥‥\cあのこ　からだは　よわかったけど\nあんがい　しっかりした　せいかく　だから\rかならず　ぶじで　かえってくると\rわたしは　しんじてるわ！
sourceRecords.english:
I want you to keep this a secret
from my husband...\cBut our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN
without telling anyone.\cYou know, WALLY is frail, but
he's surprisingly strong-willed.\cI'm sure that he'll come back safe
and sound one day!

sourceRecords.japanese:
パパ『ん？\c[PLAYER]じゃ　ないか！
そうか　ひっこしが　おわったんだね\cそれにしても
よく　ここまで　ひとりで　これたな\cなるほど‥‥
ポケモンと　いっしょ　なのか\cふむ‥‥　じゃあ　[PLAYER]も
わたしの　ようにポケモントレーナーに　なるのか\cそれは　たのしみ　だな！
sourceRecords.english:
DAD: Hm?\cWell, if it isn't [PLAYER]!
So you're all finished moving in?\cI'm surprised that you managed to
get here by yourself.\cOh, I see.
You're with your POKéMON.\cHm... Then I guess you're going to
become a TRAINER like me, [PLAYER].\cThat's great news!
I'll be looking forward to it!

sourceRecords.japanese: あの‥‥　ぼく‥‥\nポケモンが　ほしいん　ですけど‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Um... I... I'd like to get a\nPOKéMON, please...

sourceRecords.japanese: パパ『ん？　きみは‥‥　たしか\nミツルくんと　いったよね
sourceRecords.english: DAD: Hm? You're... Uh... Oh, right.\nYou're WALLY, right?

sourceRecords.japanese:
ミツル『ぼく　きょうから　シダケタウンの
しんせきの　うちに　いくんですけど\cひとりじゃ　さみしいから　ポケモンを
つれて　いこうかと　おもって‥‥\cでも　いままで　じぶんで　ポケモンを
つかまえた　ことが　ないからどう　やったら　いいのか‥‥
sourceRecords.english:
WALLY: I'm going to go stay with my
relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN.\cI thought I would be lonely by myself,
so I wanted to take a POKéMON along.\cBut I've never caught a POKéMON before.
I don't know how...

sourceRecords.japanese: パパ『‥‥ふむ　なるほど
パパ『[PLAYER]！　はなしは　きいたね\cミツルくんが　ぶじに\nポケモンを　つかまえられるか\rみまもって　あげるんだ
sourceRecords.english: DAD: [PLAYER], you heard that,\nright?\cGo with WALLY and make sure that he\nsafely catches a POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミツルくん\nわたしの　ポケモンを　かして　あげよう！\cミツルは\nジグザグマを　あずかった！
sourceRecords.english: WALLY, here, I'll loan you my POKéMON.\cWALLY received a ZIGZAGOON!

sourceRecords.japanese:
ミツル『わあ‥‥
ポケモンだぁ‥‥！\cパパ『うむ‥‥
モンスターボールは　あげるからがんばって　みなさい！\cミツルは
モンスターボールを　もらった！
sourceRecords.english: WALLY: Oh, wow!\nA POKéMON!\cDAD: Hm. I'll give you a POKé BALL, too.\nGo for it!\cWALLY received a POKé BALL!

sourceRecords.japanese: ミツル『おじさん　ありがとう！
[PLAYER]さん‥‥\nぼくと　いっしょに　きてくれますよね
パパ『うまく　いったかい？
sourceRecords.english: DAD: So, did it work out?

sourceRecords.japanese:
ミツル『おじさん
おかりした　ポケモン　おかえし　します\c[PLAYER]さん　いっしょに　きてくれて
どうも　ありがとう‥‥\cポケモンを　つかまえることが　できたのは
ふたりの　おかげです！つかまえた　ポケモン　たいせつに　しますね\c‥‥あ！　おかあさんが　まってるから
ぼくは　もう　いかなきゃ！\cじゃあね　[PLAYER]さん！
sourceRecords.english:
WALLY: Thank you, yes, it did.
Here's your POKéMON back.\c[PLAYER], thank you for coming along
with me.\cYou two are why I was able to catch
my POKéMON.\cI promise I'll take really good
care of it.\cOh! My mom's waiting for me, so I
have to go!\cBye, [PLAYER]!

sourceRecords.japanese:
パパ『さて‥‥\c[PLAYER]！　ポケモントレーナー　として
つよく　なりたいのならわたしの　アドバイスを　ききなさい\cまずは　この　さきにある
カナズミシティに　いくんだ\cそこで　ツツジ　という　ジムリーダーと
たたかうと　いい！\cそうやって　かくちの　ポケモンジムで
ジムリーダーを　たおしてジムバッジを　あつめて　いくんだ\cもちろん　わたしも　ジムリーダーだ
いずれ　[PLAYER]と　しょうぶ　するだろう\cだが　それは　[PLAYER]が
つよくなってからの　はなし　だよ
sourceRecords.english:
DAD: Now...\c[PLAYER], if you want to become a
strong TRAINER, here's my advice.\cHead for RUSTBORO CITY beyond this
town.\cThere, you should challenge the GYM
LEADER, ROXANNE.\cAfter her, go on to other POKéMON
GYMS and defeat their LEADERS.\cCollect BADGES from them,
understood?\cOf course, I'm a GYM LEADER, too.
We'll battle one day, [PLAYER].\cBut that's only after you become
stronger, [PLAYER].

sourceRecords.japanese:
パパ『ん？　カナズミの
ポケモンジムには　いかないのか？\cまだまだ　かけだしの　トレーナーと
たたかっても　おもしろく　ないからな\c[PLAYER]には　もっと　つよくなって
わたしの　まえに　あらわれて　ほしいんだ\cそうだな　ジムバッジを
４つ　あつめられたら　そのときは[PLAYER]と　しょうぶ　しよう！
sourceRecords.english:
DAD: Hm? Aren't you going to the
POKéMON GYM in RUSTBORO CITY?\cThere's no challenge for me to
battle a greenhorn TRAINER.\c[PLAYER], I want you to challenge me
when you become a lot stronger.\cI'll battle you, [PLAYER], when you
can show me four GYM BADGES, okay?

sourceRecords.japanese:
パパ『なるほど‥‥
カナズミの　ジムリーダーに　かったのか\cだが　まだまだ　[PLAYER]より
つよい　トレーナーは　いっぱい　いる\cうみの　むこう　ムロタウンには
トウキ　という　ジムリーダーが　いるかれとも　しょうぶ　してみると　いい
sourceRecords.english:
DAD: I see... So, you've beaten the
GYM LEADER in RUSTBORO CITY.\cBut there are many more TRAINERS
who are stronger than you, [PLAYER].\cAcross the sea in DEWFORD TOWN is a
GYM LEADER named BRAWLY.\cYou should go challenge him.

sourceRecords.japanese: パパ『ふむ‥‥\n[PLAYER]は　つよくなって　いるな\cその　バッジの　かずを　みれば　わかるよ
sourceRecords.english: DAD: Hm... [PLAYER], you have gotten\nstronger.\cI can tell by the number of BADGES\nthat you've earned.

sourceRecords.japanese:
パパ『そうか‥‥
ジムバッジを　４つ　あつめたのか\cでは　やくそく　どおり
ポケモンしょうぶ　だな‥‥\c[PLAYER]‥‥\cわたしは　いま　こうして
じぶんの　こどもとしんけん　しょうぶ　できることがうれしくて　たまらない！\cだが　しょうぶは　しょうぶ！\cわたしは　ジムリーダーとして
ぜんりょくを　つくす！[PLAYER]も　ほんきで　かかってくるんだ！
sourceRecords.english:
DAD: Hm...
So, you did get four GYM BADGES.\cFine, as I promised, we will have a
POKéMON battle.\c[PLAYER]...\cI'm so happy that I can have a 
real battle with my own child.\cBut, a battle is a battle!\cI will do everything in my power as
a GYM LEADER to win.\c[PLAYER], you'd better give it your
best shot, too!

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥！\cまさか‥‥\cまさか　[PLAYER]に‥‥\c[PLAYER]に　まける　とは‥‥\c‥‥わかった！　きまりは　きまりだ！\nこれを　わたそう
sourceRecords.english: ...\cI... I can't...\cI can't believe it. [PLAYER]...\cI lost to [PLAYER]?\cBut, rules are rules!\nHere, take this.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　パパから\nバランスバッジを　もらった！

パパ『その　バランスバッジで
[PLAYER]の　ポケモンのぼうぎょりょくが　たかくなる\cひでんわざの　なみのり　を
おぼえた　ポケモンが　いるならみずのうえを　すすめるように　なる\cこれは　わたしからの　おくりもの
[PLAYER]なら　つかいこなせるだろう！
sourceRecords.english:
DAD: With that BADGE, the DEFENSE
of all your POKéMON will increase.\cPOKéMON that know the HM move SURF
will be able to travel over water.\cThis is my gift to you. [PLAYER], I'm
sure you can use it correctly.

sourceRecords.japanese: パパ『わざマシン４２は　からげんき\cどくや　まひ　やけどに　なると\nわざの　いりょくが　ばいに　なる！\cピンチを　チャンスに\nかえることが　できるかも　しれないな
sourceRecords.english: DAD: TM42 contains FACADE.\cIt doubles the power of moves if\nthe POKéMON is poisoned, paralyzed,\ror burned.\cIt might be able to turn a bad\nsituation into an advantage.

sourceRecords.japanese: パパ『ジムリーダーとして\nいいようが　ないくらい　くやしい‥‥\cだが　おや　としては\nうれしいような　さびしいような\rふしぎな　きもち　だ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: DAD: As the GYM LEADER, I can't\nexpress how upset I am...\cBut as a father, it makes me both\nhappy and a little sad. It's odd...

sourceRecords.japanese: パパ『そうだ‥‥\cさっき　ミツルくんの　ごりょうしんが\nいらして　[PLAYER]に\rわたしたい　ものが　あると　いってたぞ！
sourceRecords.english: DAD: Oh, yes...\cWALLY's parents came calling\nearlier.\cThey said that they had something\nthey wanted to give you, [PLAYER].

sourceRecords.japanese:
パパ『[PLAYER]！　たまには　ママにも
あいに　いって　あげるんだぞ！\cわたしは　ここで
じぶんを　きたえなおす！\c[PLAYER]に　まけた　ままでは
トレーナーとして　くやしすぎる　からな
sourceRecords.english:
DAD: [PLAYER], you should go visit
your mother every so often.\cI'm going to stay here and redouble
my training.\cIt would bother me as a TRAINER to
not avenge my loss to you, [PLAYER]!

sourceRecords.japanese: パパ『[PLAYER]！\nちょうしは　どうだ？\cポケモンは　おくが　ふかい！\nわたしは　いくら　しゅぎょう　しても\rたりなく　おもっている　ところだよ
sourceRecords.english: DAD: [PLAYER], how are things going?\cThe world of POKéMON is deep.\cI honestly think that no amount of\ntraining would ever be enough.

sourceRecords.japanese:
げんき　しとぉや！！
チャンピオンを　めざす　[PLAYER]！！\cこの　ジムは　へやにいる　トレーナーを
たおせば　おくの　とびらが　ひらくッ！\c‥‥おっと！　この　へやは　すでに
とびらが　ひらく　ように　なってるからぼくを　たおしたり　しないで　くれよ！\cこの　トウカジムの　トレーナーたちは
いろんな　どうぐを　つかってくるぞ！\cちなみに　ここから　いけるのは
ひだり‥‥　すばやさの　へやみぎ‥‥　めいちゅうの　へや　だ！\cとびらにも　かいてあるから　それを
よんでから　すすむんだ\cさあ！　すきな　ほうを　えらんだら
きばってこォー！！
sourceRecords.english:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound [PLAYER]?\cThe doors in this GYM open when you
beat the awaiting TRAINERS.\cWhoops! The doors in this room are
already open, so don't attack me!\cThe TRAINERS of PETALBURG GYM use
all kinds of items.\cThe door at the left leads to the
SPEED ROOM.\cThe door at the right leads to the
ACCURACY ROOM.\cThe room's name will be on the
door, so choose carefully.\cOnce you've chosen the door...
Well, hey, go for it!

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　じぶんの　パパさえも\nのりこえて　しまったのか！？\cこらァ　びっくり　たまげたッ！！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER]! Whoa! You've overcome even\nyour own father!\cLike, whoa!\nWhat a stunning turn of events!

sourceRecords.japanese: あいてよりも　さきに　こうげき　できる‥‥\cそれだけで　しょうぶは\nかなり　ゆうりに　なるだろう？
sourceRecords.english: The ability to attack before the\nopponent...\cJust that alone puts me at a great\nadvantage, don't you agree?

sourceRecords.japanese: すばらしい　しょうぶ　だった‥‥！
おくの　へやに　すすみたまえ！\nさらなる　しれんが　きみを　まっている\cひだりは　さがらずの　へや！\nみぎは　まもりの　へや　だ！
sourceRecords.english:
Go on to the next room where a new
challenge awaits you.\cAt the left is the ZERO REDUCTION
ROOM.\cThe right door leads to the DEFENSE
ROOM.

sourceRecords.japanese: だれに　かとうとも\nだれに　まけようとも\rおのれと　ポケモンを　きたえつづける‥‥\cそれが　ジムリーダー　なのさ
sourceRecords.english: Whomever you beat, and whomever you\nmay lose to, you never shirk from\rtraining yourself and your POKéMON.\cThat's what I think being a\nGYM LEADER is all about.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくの　ポケモンに　たいして\nのうりょくを　さげようとしても　ムダだね！
sourceRecords.english: Don't waste your time trying to\nlower my POKéMON's abilities!

sourceRecords.japanese: のうりょくは　さがらなかったけど\nそれでも　かてなかった‥‥
sourceRecords.english: My POKéMON's abilities weren't\nharmed, but I still lost...

sourceRecords.japanese: つぎは　ちからの　へや！\nその　こうげきりょくに　たえられるかい？
sourceRecords.english: The next room is the STRENGTH ROOM.\nCan you withstand brute force?

sourceRecords.japanese: ジムリーダーが　きみに　まけてから\nくんれんが　さらに　きびしく　なったよ！
sourceRecords.english: After you beat our LEADER, the\ntraining has become a lot tougher.

sourceRecords.japanese: あとすこしで　たおせると　おもったとき\nあいての　たいりょくが　かいふく　する\rそれが　どんなに　つらい　ことか‥‥\cその　つらさ　あじわってもらうよ！
sourceRecords.english:
Just when you think you're going to
win, your opponent restores HP...\cCan you just imagine how awful that
must feel?\cI'll show you exactly how awful it
feels!

sourceRecords.japanese: かいふく　しきれなかった‥‥\nすごい　こうげきりょく　だ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I couldn't restore HP enough...\nWhat ATTACK power...

sourceRecords.japanese: さすがは　ジムリーダーの　こども‥‥\cいや！　トレーナーの　さいのうは\nどりょくで　つちかわれる　もの‥‥\cきみに　まけたのは　ぼくの　どりょくが\nたりなかった　から　なんだ‥‥！\cさあ　つぎは　いちげきの　へや　だ！
sourceRecords.english:
I should have expected no less from
our LEADER's kid.\cNo, wait! A TRAINER's abilities are
earned only through effort.\cI lost because my own efforts
weren't enough.\cGo on! The ONE-HIT KO ROOM is next.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンジムで　しゅぎょうを　かさね\nいつかは　ジムリーダーに　なってみせるよ
sourceRecords.english: I'm going to keep training at GYMS.\nOne day, I'll become a LEADER.

sourceRecords.japanese: ジムリーダーの　こども　だからって\nてかげんは　しない！\cきゅうしょに　あたる　こわさ\nとくと　あじわって　もらうよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm not going to take it easy just\nbecause you're our LEADER's kid.\cI'll show you how horrid it is for\na POKéMON to take a critical hit!

sourceRecords.japanese: きみの　つよさは　ほんものだ‥‥！

きみの　パパは　ほんとうに　つよい
そんけいに　あたいする　トレーナーだ！\cそして　きみにも
きみの　パパと　おなじかがやきを　かんじる‥‥\cおやこ　ふたりが　のうりょくを　きそう
さいこうの　めいしょうぶを　みせてくれ！
sourceRecords.english:
Your father really is strong. He's
a TRAINER worth my respect.\cAnd, I sense the same glow coming
from you as your father.\cI hope that you'll stage a terrific
battle with your father!

sourceRecords.japanese: きみの　パパが　ジムリーダーに　なってから\nトウカの　トレーナーたちも　つよくなった
sourceRecords.english: Since your dad became the LEADER,\nthe TRAINERS of PETALBURG CITY have\rbecome a lot tougher.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふふふ‥‥\nここは　めいちゅうの　へや！\cすべての　こうげきが　あたるのって\nけっこう　いやな　ものよ
sourceRecords.english: Giggle...\nThis is the ACCURACY ROOM.\cIt's pretty nasty when every attack\nlands without fail.

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたの　ほうが　いちまい　うわてね‥‥
sourceRecords.english: You were a cut above me...

sourceRecords.japanese:
おくで　さらに　てごわい　トレーナーが
あなたを　まっている\cひだりは　まもりの　へや
みぎは　かいふくの　へや　よ\cあなたの　ポケモンの
こうげきりょくが　とわれるわ
sourceRecords.english:
There are some even stronger
TRAINERS waiting for you.\cThe left is the DEFENSE ROOM, and
the right is the RECOVERY ROOM.\cYour POKéMON's ATTACK power will be
on trial either way.

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたは　わたしたち　トレーナーが\nなにを　めざしているか　しってる？\c‥‥それはね　ポケモンと\nこころを　ひとつに　する　ことよ！
sourceRecords.english: Do you know what we're trying to\nachieve as TRAINERS?\cWe're striving to become soul mates\nwith our POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: まもりが　かたければ　かたいほど\nおもいきった　こうげきが　できるのよ
sourceRecords.english: The higher the DEFENSE, the more\nreckless I can be in attack.

sourceRecords.japanese: まもりきれなかった‥‥
あなたには　たいせつな　ことを\nおしえて　もらった　きが　するわ‥‥\cさあ　すすみなさい！\nひだりは　ちからの　へや\rみぎは　いちげきの　へや\cともに　こうげきを　とくいと　しているわ！
sourceRecords.english:
I think you've taught me a valuable
lesson here.\cNow, go on! The left door goes to
the STRENGTH ROOM.\cThe right door opens to the
ONE-HIT KO ROOM.\cBoth of them have TRAINERS who are
offensively skilled.

sourceRecords.japanese: どう？　なみのりは　つかってる？
sourceRecords.english: Hi! Have you tried using SURF?

sourceRecords.japanese: ぜんりょくで　あなたを　たおせと\nジムリーダーから　いわれている‥‥\cたとえ　その　あいてが\nリーダーの　こども　だとしても！
sourceRecords.english: Our GYM LEADER told us to go all out\nand beat you.\cEven if you happen to be the\nLEADER's kid!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぜんりょくを　だしたのに‥‥！
あなたの　ポケモンの　つかいかた‥‥\nどことなく　おとうさんに　にているわ\cさあ！　この　おくには　ジムリーダー\nあなたの　おとうさんが　まっているわ！
sourceRecords.english: The way you use your POKéMON...\nIt's like your father's style.\cGo on through! The GYM LEADER, your\nfather, is waiting!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンを　つよく　するのも　いいけど\cしょうぶの　ゆくえを　きめるのは\nそのひと　じしんの　ポケモンに　たいする\rきもち　なのよね‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: Sure, it's fine to make your POKéMON\nstronger.\cBut what decides the winner?\cWhy, it's the feelings TRAINERS have for\ntheir POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: いまは　まだ　この　とびらは\nとざされて　いる　ようだ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: This door appears to be locked\nright now...

sourceRecords.japanese: このさき　すばやさの　へや\c‥‥と　かいてある\nおくに　すすみますか？
sourceRecords.english: “SPEED ROOM,” the sign says.\cDo you want to go through?

sourceRecords.japanese: いまは　まだ　この　とびらは\nとざされて　いる　ようだ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: This door appears to be locked\nright now...

sourceRecords.japanese: このさき　めいちゅうの　へや\c‥‥と　かいてある\nおくに　すすみますか？
sourceRecords.english: “ACCURACY ROOM,” the sign says.\cDo you want to go through?

sourceRecords.japanese: このさき　さがらずの　へや\c‥‥と　かいてある\nおくに　すすみますか？
sourceRecords.english: “ZERO REDUCTION ROOM,” the sign\nsays.\cDo you want to go through?

sourceRecords.japanese: このさき　まもりの　へや\c‥‥と　かいてある\nおくに　すすみますか？
sourceRecords.english: “DEFENSE ROOM,” the sign says.\cDo you want to go through?

sourceRecords.japanese: このさき　かいふくの　へや\c‥‥と　かいてある\nおくに　すすみますか？
sourceRecords.english: “RECOVERY ROOM,” the sign says.\cDo you want to go through?

sourceRecords.japanese: このさき　ちからの　へや\c‥‥と　かいてある\nおくに　すすみますか？
sourceRecords.english: “STRENGTH ROOM,” the sign says.\cDo you want to go through?

sourceRecords.japanese: このさき　いちげきの　へや\c‥‥と　かいてある\nおくに　すすみますか？
sourceRecords.english: “ONE-HIT KO ROOM,” the sign says.\cDo you want to go through?

sourceRecords.japanese: このさき　ジムリーダー\cどんな　ポケモンが　まっているか　は\nじぶんの　めで　たしかめよ！\c‥‥と　かいてある\nおくに　すすみますか？
sourceRecords.english: “GYM LEADER'S ROOM\c“See for yourself what POKéMON await\nyou!” the sign says.\cDo you want to go through?

sourceRecords.japanese: トウカシティ　ポケモンジム
トウカシティ　ポケモンジム\cセンリ　にんてい　トレーナー！\n[PLAYER]
sourceRecords.english: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM\cNORMAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n[PLAYER]

sourceRecords.japanese: たびは　いいぞ！\cわしも　わかいときは　あちこちの\nうみや　やまを　わたりあるいた　ものだ！
sourceRecords.english: Traveling is wonderful!\cWhen I was young, I roamed the seas\nand the mountains!

sourceRecords.japanese:
あぁ‥‥\cわたしも　ポケモンと　いっしょに
ぼうけんの　たびに　でかけて　みたい‥‥\cしめった　くさむらに　もぐったり
ごつごつの　いわやまを　のぼったりうみの　あらなみを　わたったりまっくらな　どうくつを　さまよったり‥‥\cそれでいて　ときには　じぶんの　おうちが
こいしく　なったりして‥‥\cたびって　いいよね！
sourceRecords.english:
Sigh...\cI wish I could go on an adventure
with some POKéMON...\cCrawl through some damp grass...
Climb rocky, rugged mountains...\cCross the raging seas...
Wander about in dark caves...\cAnd, sometimes, even get a little
homesick...\cIt must be fabulous to travel!

sourceRecords.japanese: この　まちの　あたらしい\nジムリーダーに　なった　センリさん\cジョウトちほうの　ごかぞくを\nこっちに　よびよせた　らしいのよね
sourceRecords.english: NORMAN became our town's new GYM\nLEADER.\cI think he called his family over from\nthe JOHTO region.

sourceRecords.japanese: まえに　いちど　しょうぶ　してみたけど\nさすがに　センリさんは　つよいね！\cなんというか　こう‥‥\c「ポケモン　ひとすじに　いきる！」\nっていうのを　ヒシヒシと　かんじたよ！
sourceRecords.english: I battled NORMAN once, but, whew,\nhe was way too strong.\cHow would I put it?\cI just got the feeling that he\nlives for POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: パソコンで　つかえる\nポケモン　あずかり　システム‥‥\cつくった　やつは\nすげー　かがくに　くわしいんだろうな！
sourceRecords.english: That PC-based POKéMON storage\nsystem...\cWhoever made it must be some kind\nof a scientific wizard!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンに　オレンのみ　を　たべさせたら\nたいりょくが　かいふく　したんだぜ！
sourceRecords.english: When my POKéMON ate an\nORAN BERRY, it regained HP!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンには\nいろいろ　タイプが　あるの！\cで　タイプには　あいしょうが　あるから\nポケモンしょうぶの　とき\rゆうり　だったり　ふり　だったりするの
sourceRecords.english: There are many types of POKéMON.\cAll types have their strengths and\nweaknesses against other types.\cDepending on the types of POKéMON,\na battle could be easy or hard.

sourceRecords.japanese: たとえば　あなたの　キモリは\nくさタイプ　でしょ\cみずタイプや　じめんタイプに　つよくて\nほのおタイプが　にがて　なのよね！
sourceRecords.english:
For example, your TREECKO is a
GRASS type.\cIt's strong against the WATER and
GROUND types.\cBut, it's weak against FIRE-type
POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: たとえば　あなたの\nアチャモは　ほのおタイプ　でしょ\cくさタイプや　むしタイプに　つよくて\nみずタイプが　にがて　なんだ！
sourceRecords.english:
For example, your TORCHIC is a
FIRE type.\cIt's strong against the GRASS and
BUG types.\cBut, it's weak against WATER-type
POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: たとえば　あなたの\nミズゴロウは　みずタイプ　だよね\cほのおタイプに　つよくて\nくさタイプや　でんきタイプが　にがて　ね！
sourceRecords.english: For example, your MUDKIP is a\nWATER type.\cIt's strong against the FIRE type.\cBut, it's weak against GRASS-type\nand ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: いまは　よわい　ポケモンでも\nそだててあげれば　きっと　つよくなる！\cだいじ　なのは\nポケモンへの　あいじょうよ！
sourceRecords.english: Even if a POKéMON is weak now,\nit will grow stronger.\cThe most important thing is love!\nLove for your POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: むしよけスプレー　つかってる？\nつかうと　ポケモンが　よってこないから\rいそぐとき　べんり　なんだぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Do you use REPEL?\nIt keeps POKéMON away, so it's\ruseful when you're in a hurry.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみ　どくけし　もってるかい？\cポケモン　どくを　くらったまま\nあるいていると　たいりょく　なくなって\rたおれちゃうから　もっておくと　いいよ！
sourceRecords.english: Do you have any ANTIDOTES with\nyou?\cIf you walk around with a poisoned\nPOKéMON, it will lose HP until it faints.\rTake some ANTIDOTES with you.

sourceRecords.japanese: えーと‥‥　これが　こーなって\nそいでもって　あれが　あーなって\rと　いうことは　それと　これは　どれ？\cああ　もう　わけが　わからん！
sourceRecords.english:
Umm... If this goes here, and that
goes over there...\cThen where does this thing go?
And what about that doohickey?\cAaargh! I can't make heads or tails
of this!

sourceRecords.japanese:
‥‥ん？\cぼくは　クスノキかんちょう　から
れんらくせんの　せっけいを　まかされたツガという　ものだけど‥‥\cあっ！？
それは　デボンのにもつ！\cうーん‥‥
こまったな‥‥\cクスノキかんちょう
ほかにも　しごとが　あるからってどこかに　いっちゃったんだ\cわるいけど　きみ　クスノキかんちょう
さがして　にもつを　わたしてあげてよ！
sourceRecords.english:
Hm?
Hi, I'm DOCK.\cCAPT. STERN commissioned me to
design a ferry.\cOh! That there...
Are they DEVON GOODS?\cBut, hmm...
This won't do...\cCAPT. STERN went off somewhere.
He said he had some work to do.\cCould I get you to go find CAPT.
STERN and deliver that to him?

sourceRecords.japanese: ツガ『クスノキかんちょう\nどこに　いっちゃったのかな？\cわるいけど　きみ　クスノキかんちょう\nさがして　にもつを　わたしてあげてよ！
sourceRecords.english: DOCK: Where could CAPT. STERN have\ngone off to?\cCould you go find CAPT. STERN and\ndeliver that parcel to him?

sourceRecords.japanese: ツガ『ふねをつくる　っていうのは\nつくえの　うえでの　けいさん　だけでは\rわからないことも　おおくてね\cやっぱり　うみのことを　しりつくした\nベテランの　ちえが　ほしいところだよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: DOCK: Shipbuilding is an art.\cA lot of things can't be figured out\njust by calculating.\cI really could use advice from a veteran\nwho knows the seas...

sourceRecords.japanese: ツガ『やあ！　ハギろうじんが　ここで\nてつだって　くれるように　なったよ！\cでんせつの　ふなのりに　てつだってもらえて\nれんらくせんは　ちゃくちゃくと\rかんせいに　むかっているよ！
sourceRecords.english: DOCK: Hi! MR. BRINEY's joined us to\nlend us his help.\cThanks to the veteran sailor, the\nferry is steadily coming together.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ツガ『ついに　ふねは　かんせいしたよ！\cできた　れんらくせん　タイドリップごうは
まさに　さいこう　けっさく！\cだけど　もっと　いいものが　できそうな‥‥
そんな　きも　するんだよ\cそう‥‥
ものづくりに　おわりは　ないのさ！
sourceRecords.english:
DOCK: The ferry is finally ready!\cThe new S.S. TIDAL is truly a marvel
of technology!\cBut, I get the feeling that we can
make something even better.\cYou know, there's never an end to
technology's march.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ハギ『おお！　[PLAYER][KUN]！
ひさしぶり　じゃのう！\cいやあ　きみと　であってから
ふなのりの　ちが　さわいでな‥‥\cツガくんに　きょうりょく　して
れんらくせんを　つくりたく　なったんじゃ！\cれんらくせんが　できると　おおくの
ひとを　はこべるように　なるからのう\cしかし‥‥　ふむう‥‥
ツガくんは　すごいのう‥‥\cかれの　ぎじゅつと　わしの　けいけんを
がったい　させれば　かならずやすごい　ふねが　できるに　ちがいない！
sourceRecords.english:
MR. BRINEY: Ah, [PLAYER][KUN]!
It's been too long!\cAye, since I met you, this old seadog's
been feeling frisky!\cSo I've decided to help DOCK make a
ferry.\cAye, after all, a ferry would be able
to carry a lot of people.\cBut, you know, that DOCK is really
something special.\cWith his knack for technology and
my experience, I'm sure that we canbuild one great ship, aye!

sourceRecords.japanese: ピーコちゃん『ピー　ピひょろー！
きせつや　てんきや　つきのいち　など\nさまざまな　じょうけん　によって\rうみは　つねに　すがたを　かえていきます\cそう！　うみ　というのは\nいきもの　のような　もの　なんですよ！
sourceRecords.english:
The seasons, the weather, where the
moon sits in the sky...\cThese and other conditions make the
sea change its expression.\cThat's right!
The sea is like a living thing!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくは　すぐに　ふなよい　するのよね\nだから　ここで　おてつだい　してるのよね
sourceRecords.english: I get seasick real easily.\nSo I get to help out here instead.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおきな　ふねを　つくる　というのは\nのりものを　つくる　というよりも\rたてものを　つくるのに　にているんだよ
sourceRecords.english: Designing a large ship is more like\nmaking a big building than putting\rtogether a transportation vehicle.

sourceRecords.japanese: おもたい　てつで　できている　ふねが\nうみに　うくなんて　ふしぎ　だろう？\cあれは　「ふりょく」　という　げんりを\nおうよう　しているんだ
sourceRecords.english: Don't you think it's strange that a\nship made of heavy iron floats?\cIt floats because of a principle\ncalled buoyancy.

sourceRecords.japanese: カイナと　キナギの　あいだの　うみは\nしおの　ながれが　つよいから\rふつうの　ふねでは　ながされてしまう\cかなり　つよい　すいしんりょくが　なければ\nあの　うみを　すすんでいくのは\rむずかしい　だろうな‥‥
sourceRecords.english:
The sea between SLATEPORT and
PACIFIDLOG has a fast-running tide.\cOrdinary ships can't make headway
through there.\cYou'd need substantial propulsion
to plow through those waters...

sourceRecords.japanese: しょうぶでも　コンテストでも\nさいきょう　さいこうの　ポケモンを\rそだてたいなあ‥‥\rおぼえさせる　わざに　なやむね！
sourceRecords.english: I want to raise a POKéMON that's\nthe ultimate in “great” for both\rbattles and CONTESTS.\cIt's vexing, trying to figure out\nwhich moves I should make it learn.

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたの　おともだちは　きのみ　もってる？\cあそこに　ある　きのみブレンダーで\nおともだちと　いっしょに\rポロックを　つくれるの！　たのしいわよー！
sourceRecords.english: Do any of your friends have any\nBERRIES?\cYou can use that BERRY BLENDER and\nmake [POKEBLOCK]S with your friends!\cYou should try it - it's a lot of fun!

sourceRecords.japanese: ふたつ　あるから\nこれ　ひとつ　あげる！
sourceRecords.english: I have two, so you can have one!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポロック　つくって　いれて！\cでね　ポロック　つくる　ときは\nみんなが　ちがう　きのみで\rつくらないと　ダメ　なんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: Make [POKEBLOCK]S and put them in there.\cWhen you make a [POKEBLOCK], everyone\nhas to put in a different BERRY.

sourceRecords.japanese: コンテストで　ゆうしょう　すると\cかべに　ポケモンの　にがおえを\nなまえいりで　はって　もらえるのよ！
sourceRecords.english: If you win a CONTEST, they put up a\nposter of your POKéMON on the wall.\cIt will have a portrait of your\nPOKéMON and both your names.

sourceRecords.japanese:
コンテストの　ナイスな　じょうほう
おしえて　やるよ！\cある　わざの　つぎに
とくていの　わざで　アピールするとすごく　めだつ　ときが　あるんだ！\cうまくやれば　かなり
ゆうりな　アピールが　できるよ！\cただ　じゃまされちゃう　ときも　あるけどね
sourceRecords.english:
Want a tasty little bit of advice
for CONTESTS?\cUsing a certain move after another
certain kind of move sometimes getsyou extra attention.\cIf you know what you're doing, you
can score big in appeal.\cOf course, your opponents might try
disrupting your POKéMON's showing.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくの　おとうさん　コンテストの\nしんさいんを　やって　いるんだ！\cぼくは　おおきく　なったら\nコンテストの　しんさいん　と\rジムリーダーと　どっちに　なろうかな？
sourceRecords.english: My papa, he's a CONTEST JUDGE.\cI wonder what I should be when I\ngrow up, a JUDGE or a GYM LEADER?

sourceRecords.japanese:
どうして　おれの　ポケモンが
ゆうしょう　できなかったのかちぃっとも　わからねえ　からよぉしんさいんに　もんく　いったけどよぉ\cちぃっとも　あいて　してくれねぇのさ
くやしいったら　ありゃ　しねぇぜ！\cおい　おまえ！
だまって　これを　うけとれよぉ！
sourceRecords.english:
Hey, man, I'm like majorly cheesed,
you know. Like, you know, I justwanted to know why my POKéMONnever won, you know, like, hey?\cSo, like, I gave the JUDGE my two
cents, you know, they're free.\cAnd he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey!
So, like, total bummer, man!\cHey, like, you! Zip it, you know?
Just, you know, take this!

sourceRecords.japanese: わざマシン４１は　いちゃもん！\cあいてによぉ　おなじ　わざを　つづけて\nださせねえように　する　わざ　なんだよぉ！\cいっとくけどなぁ\nおれは　いちゃもん　つけてねぇぞ！
sourceRecords.english:
That's, like, TM41, you know?
Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?\cLike, it won't let the other guy
use the same move twice in a row, see?\cHey, now, you listen here, like,
I'm not laying a torment on you!

sourceRecords.japanese:
しかい『あら！　なかなか　すてきな
ポケモンを　つれて　いますね！\cぜひ！　コンテストに
でて　みて　くださーい！\cきっと　いいセン　いきますよ！
わたしの　みる　めは　たしかですよ！
sourceRecords.english:
MC: Oh, my, my!
Now isn't that a dandy of a POKéMON?\cPlease! Do step right up and take
part in our splendid CONTESTS!\cYou'll do well! I'm sure of it!
My eyes have never failed me!

sourceRecords.japanese:
しんさいん『やあ　こんにちは！
きみも　トレーナーの　ようだね！\cだったら　ポケモンコンテストに
でない　ては　ないよ！\cコンテストパスを　シダケタウンで　もらって
いますぐ　エントリーだ！
sourceRecords.english:
JUDGE: Well, hello there!
I see that you're a TRAINER!\cThen, it just wouldn't do for you
to miss a POKéMON CONTEST!\cGet a CONTEST PASS in VERDANTURF
CITY and enter anytime!

sourceRecords.japanese: これから　いよいよ　アピールタイム！\nどの　わざから　みせようかな？
sourceRecords.english: It's appeal time!\nWhat should I lead with?

sourceRecords.japanese: オレの　ポケモンの　アピール\nあんまり　みて　もらえなかった‥‥\cフッ‥‥　あの　しんさいん\nみる　めが　ないな！
sourceRecords.english: They didn't pay much attention to\nmy POKéMON's appeal...\cHumph, that JUDGE, he doesn't know\na good thing when he sees it.

sourceRecords.japanese:
おっ！　こんな　ところまで　あがってきて
キミ　けんきゅう　ねっしんだね！じゃあ　いいこと　おしえて　あげるよ\cだした　わざが　まわりに　うけると
かいじょうが　エキサイト　してくる！\cいちばん　エキサイト　したとき
アピールしてた　ポケモンには‥‥\cいいことが　あるかもな！
sourceRecords.english:
Oh, hi! You must be a serious fan to get
this close to the action.\cI'll reward your enthusiasm with this
sage advice.\cIf a move goes over really well,
the audience will get excited.\cThe POKéMON that makes its appeal
right when everyone's excited...\cWell, you'd think something good has
to happen!

sourceRecords.japanese: だ　だめだぁ！　ポケモンより\nじぶんの　ほうが　きんちょう　してる！\rブルブル‥‥　ドキドキ‥
sourceRecords.english: I can't do this! I'm more freaked out\nthan my POKéMON.\cI'm shivering and my heart is racing!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶも　コンテストも\nちがう　ようで　にて　いるよね！\cだいじに　そだてた　ポケモンを\nしんらいして　がんばる　ところがさ！
sourceRecords.english: A battle and a CONTEST aren't the\nsame, but they are alike, too.\cYou need to work hard and believe\nin the POKéMON you've raised.

sourceRecords.japanese: あの　ポケモン　ちょうし　よさそうだろ！\c２じしんさで　ちょうしが　よくなった\nポケモンは　あまり　きんちょうしないで\rアピール　できる　ように　なるみたいだな
sourceRecords.english: That POKéMON looks like it's on top\nof its game, huh?\cA POKéMON that does good in the\nsecondary judging seems to be more\rrelaxed when it's doing appeals.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんだあー　このぐらい　なら\nおれの　ポケモンの　ほうが\rだんぜん　うえ　だね！
sourceRecords.english: Will you look at that sorry sight?\cHeh, my POKéMON's absolutely better\nthan that lot!

sourceRecords.japanese: げんきな　アピールを　みていると\nいっしょに　からだを\rうごかしたく　なって　こないか？
sourceRecords.english: Don't you get the urge to move with\nPOKéMON if they're putting on an\renergetic appeal?

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモン　コンテスト\nハイパーランク　ステージ！
はい　はい！\nわたしは　せいめい　はんだんし\rいうなれば　なまえの　うらないです\cはい　あなたの　ポケモンの\nニックネームを　うらなって　あげるよ
sourceRecords.english: Hi, hi! I'm the NAME RATER!\nI'm the fortune-teller of names!\cI shall be pleased to rate your\nPOKéMON's nickname.

sourceRecords.japanese: どの　ポケモンの\nニックネームを　うらなうかね？
うーむ　[STR_VAR_1]か‥‥\nなかなか　いい　ニックネームを　つけたね\cでもねー\nもう　すこしだけ　いい　なまえを\rわたしが　つけて　あげようか？　どうかな？
sourceRecords.english: Hmmm... [STR_VAR_1], is it? That is\nquite a fine name you bestowed.\cBut! What say you, if I were to\nsuggest a slightly better name?

sourceRecords.japanese: そうか　では\nどんな　ニックネームに　しようかな
sourceRecords.english: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new\nnickname be?

sourceRecords.japanese: よし　これから\nこの　ポケモンは　[STR_VAR_1]だ！\cまえより　いい　なまえ　じゃないか\nよかったな！
sourceRecords.english: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as [STR_VAR_1]!\cIt is a better name than before!\nHow fortunate for you!

sourceRecords.japanese: そうか\nわかった　また　きなさいよ
よし　これから\nこの　ポケモンは　[STR_VAR_1]だ！\cまえと　おなじように　みえるが\nこっちの　ほうが　だんぜん　いいぞ！\rよかったな！
sourceRecords.english: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as [STR_VAR_1]!\cIt looks no different from before,\nand yet, this is vastly superior!\rHow fortunate for you!

sourceRecords.japanese: うーむ　[STR_VAR_1]か！\nこれは　すばらしい　ニックネームだ！\rけちの　つけようもない！\cこれからも　[STR_VAR_1]を\nかわいがって　あげなさいよ！
sourceRecords.english: Hmmm... [STR_VAR_1] it is!\cThis is a magnificent nickname!\nIt is impeccably beyond reproach!\cYou'll do well to cherish your\n[STR_VAR_1] now and beyond.

sourceRecords.japanese: おいおい‥‥\nそれは　タマゴ　じゃないか！
sourceRecords.english: Now, now.\nThat is merely an EGG!

sourceRecords.japanese:
ウォッホン！！\cわしが　ポケモン　だいすきクラブで
いちばーん　えらい　かいちょう　ですぞ！\cなんたって　かいちょう　ですからな
ポケモンを　そだてさせたらみぎに　でるもの　なし！\cどんな　コンテストでも
ゆうしょう　かくじつ　なのです！\cしかし　それでは　ほかの　みなさまの
たのしみを　うばって　しまいますからな\cいまは　ここで　みなさんの　ポケモンを
みさせて　いただくだけに　しておるのです\cいやー　ひとの　そだてた　ポケモンを
はいけん　するのは　たのしい　ですぞ！\cきちんと　そだてられた　ポケモンの
しあわせそうな　かお‥‥\cそれを　みつめる　トレーナーの
やさしげな　ひとみ‥‥\cいやー　しあわせで
むねが　いっぱいに　なりますな‥‥\cおっと　しつれい！　ついつい
はなしが　ながくなって　しまいましたな\cでは　さっそく　きみの　ポケモンが
どれほど　そだっているのかはいけん　させて　もらいますかな！
sourceRecords.english:
Er-hem! I am the CHAIRMAN of the
POKéMON FAN CLUB!\cBeing the CHAIRMAN, I am naturally
the most important!\cNo one could best me when it comes
to raising POKéMON. No one!\cIn any CONTEST, my victory is a
foregone conclusion!\cBut, that would deprive others of
their enjoyment.\cSo, I now while away my time
examining the POKéMON of others.\cIt is marvelous to witness how
others have raised POKéMON.\cThe contented faces of properly
raised POKéMON...\cThe kind and loving gazes of their
TRAINERS...\cMy heart is overwhelmed - there is
so much happiness.\cOh, my! Excuse me! I seem to have
nattered on far too long!\cPlease, do allow me to examine your
POKéMON and see how it's grown.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみの　ポケモン　そだって　ますかな？\nちょっと　はいけん　させて　もらいますぞ！
sourceRecords.english: How is your POKéMON growing?\nAllow me to examine it.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふむふむ‥‥\nなるほど‥‥

ふむう‥‥
わるくは　ないんだが　よくもない‥‥\cおやの　トレーナーである　きみの
どりょくが　ひつよう　ですな！\cたとえば　もっと　たくさん
ポロックを　あげるのは　どうですかな？
sourceRecords.english:
Hmmm... It's not bad, but it's not
good, either...\cYou, the TRAINER, must put more
effort into raising this POKéMON!\cFor instance, may I suggest that
you give it more [POKEBLOCK]S?

sourceRecords.japanese: あらら‥‥\cけっこう　ポケモンが　そだっているので\nいいものを　あげようと　おもったのですが\rもちものが　いっぱい　ですな
sourceRecords.english: Oh, my...\cYour POKéMON is growing quite well,\nso you deserve a reward.\cUnfortunately, you have no space for\nthis in your BAG.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみの　[STR_VAR_1]　ですが\nなかなか　みごとに　そだって　おりますな！\rいやー　たいした　ものです！\cだが　この　どうぐを　つかって　あげたなら\nもっと　そだつこと　まちがいなし！　ですぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Your [STR_VAR_1], it is growing in\na most impressive manner!\rIt is one fine specimen!\cBut! If you were to give it this,\nit would grow even better! Indeed!

sourceRecords.japanese: その　あかいバンダナを　もたせると\nポケモンの　かっこよさを\rみんなに　みとめさせることが　できますぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Let a POKéMON hold that RED SCARF.\cEveryone will recognize the coolness\nof that POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: その　あおいバンダナを　もたせると\nポケモンの　うつくしさを\rいまより　きわだたせることが　できますぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Let a POKéMON hold that BLUE SCARF.\cIts beauty will be accentuated much\nmore than now!

sourceRecords.japanese: その　ピンクのバンダナを　もたせると\nポケモンの　かわいさを\rもっと　ひきだすことが　できますぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Let a POKéMON hold that PINK SCARF.\cIt will draw out the cuteness of\nthe POKéMON some more!

sourceRecords.japanese: その　みどりのバンダナを　もたせると\nポケモンの　かしこさを\rさらに　みがくことが　できますぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Let a POKéMON hold that GREEN SCARF.\cThat will enhance the\nsmartness of POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: その　きいろのバンダナを　もたせると\nポケモンの　たくましさを\rいっそう　アピール　できますぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Let a POKéMON hold that YELLOW SCARF.\cIt will bolster your POKéMON's\ntoughness so much more!

sourceRecords.japanese: きみに　あげる　どうぐは\nもう　なにも　ないですぞ！\cなにしろ　どうぐに　たよらんでも\nきみの　ポケモンを　そだてる\rさいのうは　バツグン　ですからな！
sourceRecords.english: I'm sorry, but I've nothing else to\ngive you! None at all!\cAfter all, you're blessed with the gift\nof raising POKéMON without resorting\rto any items!

sourceRecords.japanese:
わたし　ポケモンが　なついている
すがたを　みるのが　すき\cポケモンって　いっしょに　いる
ひとの　きもちに　すごく　びんかん！\cあなたが　ポケモンを　だいじに　すれば
ポケモンも　あなたに　なついてくれるわ！\cあなたの　ポケモンが　あなたに　なついたら
わたしにも　みせてね
sourceRecords.english:
I love seeing POKéMON that love
their TRAINERS.\cPOKéMON are very sensitive to the
feelings of their TRAINERS.\cIf you treat your POKéMON with love
and care, they'll love you back.\cWhen your POKéMON grow to love you,
please come show me.

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたの　ポケモン\nあなたに　なついているのね\cポケモンに　やさしい　トレーナーさんに\nだいすきクラブからの　おくりもの　よ
sourceRecords.english: Your POKéMON really adores you.\cFor you, a most compassionate\nTRAINER, a gift from the FAN CLUB!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンって　いっしょに　いる\nひとの　きもちに　すごく　びんかん！\cあなたが　ポケモンを　だいじに　すれば\nポケモンも　あなたに　なついてくれるわ！
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON are very sensitive to the\nfeelings of their TRAINERS.\cIf you treat your POKéMON with love\nand care, they'll love you back.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶに　まけて\nひんしに　させて　ばかりだと\rポケモンが　どんどん　すさんで\rトレーナーのこと　うたがう　ようになる\cつまり　なついて　くれなくなるよ
sourceRecords.english:
If you keep letting a POKéMON faint
in battle, it'll come to resent it.\cSoon, it will become less trusting
of the TRAINER.\cIn other words, it certainly won't
like you very much.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンって　どうぐ\nつかってもらうのが　すきなのかな？\cだって　タウリンとか　あげると\nすごく　うれしそうに　するのよ！
sourceRecords.english: Do POKéMON enjoy having items used\non them?\cMine acted really happy when I gave\nit some PROTEIN.

sourceRecords.japanese: エネコ『ふにゃあーあ
ジグザグマ『キュウウ‥‥
マリルリ『マリ　マリ！？
うみの　かがく　はくぶつかんへ\nようこそ　いらっしゃいませ！\cにゅうじょうりょう　５０えんに　なります\nけんがく　して　いきますか？
sourceRecords.english: Welcome to the OCEANIC MUSEUM.\cThe entrance fee is $50.\nWould you like to enter?

sourceRecords.japanese: ごゆっくり　どうぞ！
‥‥あら　おかねが　たりませんわ
sourceRecords.english: Oh? I'm sorry, but you don't seem to\nhave enough money.

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥あら　さっきの　だんたいさん？\nあなただけ　おくれちゃって　しかたないわね\rはやく　とおっちゃって！
sourceRecords.english: Oh? You're with that group that\nwent in earlier?\cYou're the only one who's late.\nYou'd better go catch up to them!

sourceRecords.japanese: また　きてくださいね
みんなの　ために\nわれわれ　[EVIL_TEAM]だんは　いるのよ！
sourceRecords.english: We, TEAM [EVIL_TEAM], exist for the good\nof all!

sourceRecords.japanese: げんちしゅうごう　で\nここに　あつまったのは　いいけど‥‥\cかんじんの　リーダーが　まだ　こないんだ
sourceRecords.english: We were told to assemble here, so\nwe did, but...\cOur BOSS, the lynchpin, isn't here.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここに　おいてある　もの\nかっぱらうと　もうかるかな？
sourceRecords.english: If I ripped off the stuff here,\nwould it make me rich?

sourceRecords.japanese: この　ちしきを　いかして\nわるいこと　してやるか‥‥
sourceRecords.english: What I learn here, I can put to use on\nnefarious deeds...

sourceRecords.japanese: なかまが　カナズミで　ドジらなければ\nここに　こなくて　すんだのによ！
sourceRecords.english: If our goons didn't bungle things\nin RUSTBORO, we wouldn't be here!

sourceRecords.japanese: さっき　５０えんが　なくて\nうけつけで　すごい　じかん　かかったよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I didn't have $50, so it took a long\ntime getting by the receptionist.

sourceRecords.japanese: うみのこと　べんきょう　して\nポケモンしょうぶに　やくだてたいの
sourceRecords.english: I want to learn about the sea and\nuse that knowledge for battling.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたくしッ\nうみを　みると　こうふん　するのですッ！\cそんな　わたくしに　とって\nクスノキかんちょうは\rあこがれの　ひと　ナンバー１　なのですッ！
sourceRecords.english: I get all giddy and gooey when I\nsee the sea!\cFor me, CAPT. STERN is the number\none role model!

sourceRecords.japanese: うみは　はてしなく　ひろく\nどこまでも　ふかい‥‥\cきっと　われわれが　しらない　ポケモンも\nいっぱい　いるのだろうね
sourceRecords.english: The sea is vast without end, and\ninfinitely deep...\cThere must be many POKéMON that we\ndon't know about.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたし　うみの　ポケモンが　ほしいの\cだって　ひんやりと　してて\nだきしめたら　きもちよさそう　だもの
sourceRecords.english: I want a sea POKéMON.\cI think it would feel cool and nice\nto hug.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひえー！！\nなんで　おまえ　ここに　いるんだよ！？\cおれ？\nおれは　おまえに　コテンパンにされた\r[EVIL_TEAM]だん　だよ\cこれを　やるから　ゆるしてくれよ！
sourceRecords.english:
Aiyeeeh!
What are you doing here?\cMe? I'm the TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] member you
thumped before, remember?\cHere, take this!
You have to forgive me!

sourceRecords.japanese: くそー！　おまえの　せいで\nさくせん　しっぱい　したから　かわりに\rなにかを　ぬすもうと　してたのに‥‥\cくそー！　おぼえてろ！
sourceRecords.english:
Aww, darn it!
You so screwed up our plans!\cI was going to rip off something
to make up for it, but...\cJust you wait!
You'll get yours one day!

sourceRecords.japanese: たのむから\nなんとかして　うけとってくれよ！
sourceRecords.english: Awww, come on!\nYou have to take this and let me go!

sourceRecords.japanese: ガラスの　なかで　あおい　みずが\nくるくると　まわって　いる！\c「これは　かぜの　ちからで　じんこうてきに\n　うずしおを　おこす　じっけん　です」
sourceRecords.english: A blue fluid is spiraling inside a\nglass vessel.\c“This is an experiment to create a\nWHIRLPOOL artificially using wind.”

sourceRecords.japanese: ガラスの　なかで　あかい　ボールが\nうかんだり　しずんだり　している！\c「これは　ボールの　ふりょくを　りようした\n　たきのぼりの　げんりの　じっけん　です」
sourceRecords.english: A red ball is bobbing up and down\ninside a glass vessel.\c“This is an experiment simulating a\nWATERFALL using the ball's buoyancy.”

sourceRecords.japanese: うみの　そこの　つちの　みほんだ！\c「かいていには　ながい　ねんげつを　かけて\n　せいぶつの　しがいが　ふりつもり\r　ちそうが　かたち　づくられて　いきます」\c「これらを　ぶんせき　することで\n　とおい　むかしの　ことが　わかるのです」
sourceRecords.english:
It's a sample of soil from the ocean
floor.\c“Over many years, the remains of
life-forms settle at the bottom ofthe sea making sedimentary layers.\c“By analyzing these layers, the
ancient past is revealed.”

sourceRecords.japanese: うみべの　すなの　みほんだ！\c「やまから　かわを　つたって　きた　いしは\n　みずの　なかで　ころがる　うちに\r　くだかれたり　けずれたり　していきます」\c「それらが　ちいさな　つぶに　なって\n　うみべの　すなが　できて　いくのです」
sourceRecords.english: It's a sample of beach sand.\c“Stones from mountains are washed\ndown by rivers where they are\rchipped and ground down.\c“They are reduced to grains and end\nup as sand on beaches.”

sourceRecords.japanese:
「うみの　まめちしき　その１
　なぜ　うみの　みずは　あおいの？」\c「ひかりには　いくつもの　いろが　あって
　ほとんどの　ひかりは　みずに　はいると　その　いろが　なくなって　いきます」\c「けれど　あおい　ひかり　だけは
　そのままの　いろで　のこる　ため　うみは　あおく　みえるのです」
sourceRecords.english:
“OCEANIC MINI FACT 1
Why is seawater blue?\c“Light is composed of many colors.\c“When light passes through water,
most kinds of light lose color.\c“However, blue light retains its
color, making the sea appear blue.”

sourceRecords.japanese: 「うみの　まめちしき　その２\n　なぜ　うみの　みずは　しょっぱいの？」\c「かいすい　には　いわから　にじみでた\c　しおの　もとに　なる\n　ナトリウムイオン　と　えんそイオン\r　という　ぶっしつが　おおく　ふくまれ\r　だから　なめると　しょっぱいのです」
sourceRecords.english:
“OCEANIC MINI FACT 2
Why is the sea salty?\c“Seawater contains dissolved salt in
the form of sodium and chlorine ions.\c“These ions leach out of rocks and are
carried out to sea by rain.\c“The concentration of dissolved salt
makes the sea salty.”

sourceRecords.japanese: 「うみの　まめちしき　その３\n　うみと　りくは　どちらが　ひろいの？」\c「だいたい　うみが　７０パーセントで\n　りくが　３０パーセント　くらいです\c　りくちに　くらべて　うみは\r　その　２ばい　いじょうも　あるのです」
sourceRecords.english:
“OCEANIC MINI FACT 3
Which is bigger? The sea or land?\c“The sea covers about 70% of the
planet, and the rest is land.\c“The sea is therefore more than twice
the size of land.”

sourceRecords.japanese: デコボコに　なみうった　かせきが　ある！\c「うみの　そこに　たまった　つちには\n　かいすいが　ながれる　えいきょうで\r　なみの　ような　もようが　できます」\c「それが　そのまま　かせきに　なったものを\n　リップルマークと　よんでいます」
sourceRecords.english:
It's a fossil with wavy ridges on it.\c“Soil on the ocean floor gets scoured
by the tide.\c“The flowing seawater marks the soil
with small ridges and valleys.\c“If this soil becomes fossilized, it is
called a ripple mark.”

sourceRecords.japanese: まるい　ドームの　なかで　なんだか\nよく　わからない　きかいが　まわってる！\cなにかの　ふかさを　しらべるのかな？
sourceRecords.english: A strange machine is rotating under\na glass dome.\cMaybe it's for measuring the depth\nof something...

sourceRecords.japanese: はい？　クスノキは　わたし　だが‥‥？\cおお！　それは　デボンの　ツワブキさんに\nたのんで　おいた　パーツだね！\cいやー　どうも　ごくろうさま！\nおかげで　しゅっぱつ　できそうだ‥‥
sourceRecords.english:
Yes? If you're looking for STERN,
that would be me.\cAh! That must be the part I
ordered from MR. STONE of DEVON.\cThank you! That's great!
We can prepare for our expedition now.

sourceRecords.japanese: へへへ　その　パーツ\nおれたちが　いただくぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Hehehe, hold it!\nWe'll take those parts!

sourceRecords.japanese: クスノキ『だ　だれだ　きみたちは！
sourceRecords.english: CAPT. STERN: Wh-what?\nWho are you people?

sourceRecords.japanese: おれたち　[EVIL_TEAM]だん！\cリーダーが　そのパーツを　ほしがってるんだ！\nなにも　いわずに　よこせ！
sourceRecords.english: We're TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]!\cOur BOSS wants those parts!\nShut your yap and fork them over!

sourceRecords.japanese: うわー！\nこどもに　やられちまった！
やばい‥‥\nリーダーに　おこられちまうぞ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Oh, man, what a disaster...\nThe BOSS is going to be furious...

sourceRecords.japanese: ふん！　だらしない　やつめ！\nここは　おれに　まかせてもらうぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Humph, sniveling wimp!\nLet me take care of this!

sourceRecords.japanese: なんだと！\nおれも　まけてしまった！
ど　どうしよう‥‥\nパーツを　うばえないと　まずくないか？\cうむ‥‥\nまさか　こどもに　じゃま　されるなんて\rこれっぽっちも　おもってなかったぜ
sourceRecords.english: Now what? If we don't get the parts,\nwe're in for it!\cArrgh, I didn't count on being meddled\nwith by some meddling kid!

sourceRecords.japanese: パーツを　うばうのに\nいつまで　かかっているのかと　おもえば\rこんな　こどもに　じゃま　されていたのか？
sourceRecords.english: I came to see what was taking so\nlong to snatch some parts, and you\rsimps are held up by a mere child?

sourceRecords.japanese:
わたしは　アクアだんの　アオギリ\cきみは　なぜ　われわれ
アクアだんの　じゃまを　するのかね？\cポケモンも　ひとも　すべての　いのちは
うみから　うまれた‥‥\cだから　アクアだんは
うみを　ふやそうと　しているのだよ\cどうだい？

I am TEAM AQUA's ARCHIE.\cTell me, why do you meddle in the
noble affairs of TEAM AQUA?\cPOKéMON, people, all life depends on
the sea.\cSo, TEAM AQUA is dedicated to the
expansion of the sea.\cDon't you agree? What we are doing
is a magnificent undertaking.\cAh, fine...
You're still too young.\cIt can't be helped that you do not
understand our ideals.\cBut, if you ever oppose us again,
there will be consequences!\cHeed my warning!
Farewell!

sourceRecords.english:
I am TEAM MAGMA's MAXIE.\cWhy on earth do you feel compelled
to mess up TEAM MAGMA's plans?\cPOKéMON, people, all life exists on land...\cThat's why TEAM MAGMA is trying to
expand the world's landmass.\cDon't you agree? What we are doing
is a magnificent undertaking.\cWell, no matter...
You're young.\cYour inability to understand our
noble cause can't be helped...\cBut, if you were to impede us ever
again, you'll see no mercy from us!\cKeep that firmly in mind!
Farewell!

sourceRecords.japanese:
クスノキ『きみは‥‥
そうか　[PLAYER][KUN]　というのか‥‥\cいやあ　あぶない　ところ　だった！
たすけてくれて　ありがとうよ！\cおっと　そうだった！
デボンに　たのんでおいた　パーツをもってきて　くれたの　わすれていたよ！
sourceRecords.english:
CAPT. STERN: You're...
Ah, okay, you're [PLAYER][KUN]...\cAnyway, that was a tense situation!
Thank you for saving us!\cOh, yes, I almost forgot that you
even brought the parts from DEVON!

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　クスノキかんちょうに\nデボンのにもつを　わたした！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] handed over the DEVON GOODS\nto CAPT. STERN.

sourceRecords.japanese: クスノキ『おっと！\nこうしちゃ　いられない！\cそろそろ　かいてい　ちょうさに\nしゅっぱつ　する　じかんだ！\cじゃあ　これで　しつれい　するよ！
sourceRecords.english: CAPT. STERN: Whoops!\nThere's no time to lose!\cWe have to set out on our ocean floor\nexpedition really soon.\cThanks, and excuse me!

sourceRecords.japanese: ふねの　もけいを　みておると\nムロの　ちかくに　ある\rすてられぶねを　おもいだすのう‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I saw a model of a ship here.\cIt reminded me of the ABANDONED SHIP\nnear DEWFORD TOWN...

sourceRecords.japanese: はくぶつかんの　なかを\nはしり　まわるんじゃ　ありませんよッ！
sourceRecords.english: Don't you dare run around inside\nthe MUSEUM!

sourceRecords.japanese: せんすいてい　かっこいー！\nおれも　のりてーよ！
sourceRecords.english: Wow, the submarine's awesome!\nI want to go for a ride!

sourceRecords.japanese: 「カントーの　すいしつ　サンプル」\nと　かかれた　ラベルが　はってある！\cうみは　みんな　つながって　いるのに\nちいきに　よって　すこし　ちがうらしい
sourceRecords.english: “KANTO WATER QUALITY SAMPLE,” the\nlabel says.\cThe sea is all connected, but the\nwater seems to differ by region.

sourceRecords.japanese: 「ジョウトの　すいしつ　サンプル」\nと　かかれた　ラベルが　はってある！\cちいきが　ちがえば　うみの　みずの\nしょっぱさも　ちがったり　するのかな？
sourceRecords.english: “JOHTO WATER QUALITY SAMPLE,” the\nlabel says.\cMaybe the water's saltiness differs\nfrom one region to another...

sourceRecords.japanese:
ゴムで　できた　ボールが
ふくらんだり　しぼんだり　している！\c「うみの　そこには　すいあつ　といって
　みずじたいの　おもさが　かかります」\c　あさい　ところでは　すいあつも　かるく
　ふかい　ところでは　なんまんトン　もの　すいあつが　かかるのです」
sourceRecords.english:
A rubber ball is expanding and shrinking.\c“In the sea, the weight of water itself
exerts pressure.\c“In shallow water, the pressure is not
very heavy.\c“However, in extremely deep water,
the pressure can reach even tens ofthousands of tons on a small area.”

sourceRecords.japanese: 「ホウエン　ちほうの　もけい」\cホウエンちほう　ぜんたいの　ミニチュアだ！\nミシロタウンは　どのへん　だろう？
sourceRecords.english: “MODEL OF HOENN REGION”\cIt's a miniature diorama of the\nHOENN region.\cWhere is LITTLEROOT TOWN on this?

sourceRecords.japanese: かいすいの　ながれに　ついての　てんじだ！\c「うみの　そこに　ちかい　ところ　では\n　みずの　おんどや　えんぶんの　ちがいで\r　うみの　みずが　ながれて　いきます」
sourceRecords.english: It's a display on the flow of seawater.\c“Near the bottom of the sea, water\nflows due to differences in such\rfactors as temperature and salinity.”

sourceRecords.japanese: かいすいの　ながれに　ついての　てんじだ！\c「うみの　ひょうめん　あたり　では\n　かぜの　ちからに　よって\r　うみの　みずが　ながれて　いきます」
sourceRecords.english: It's a display on the flow of\nseawater.\c“Toward the surface, seawater flows\nas currents driven by the winds.”

sourceRecords.japanese: 「れんらくせん　タイドリップごう」\cこれは　げんざい　クスノキ　ぞうせんじょで\nつくられている　ふねの　もけい　です！
sourceRecords.english: “THE FERRY S.S. TIDAL\c“A scale replica of the ship under\nconstruction at STERN'S SHIPYARD.”

sourceRecords.japanese: 「せんすいてい　かいえん　１ごう」\cうみの　そこを　ちょうさ　するための\nこうせいのう　せんすいていの　もけい　です！
sourceRecords.english: “SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1\c“A replica of the high-performance\nocean floor exploration submarine.”

sourceRecords.japanese: 「せんすい　ポッド」\cかいていで　さぎょうを　するための\nむじん　こがたポッドの　もけい　です！
sourceRecords.english: “SUBMERSIBLE POD\c“A replica of a compact, unmanned\npod for seafloor exploration.”

sourceRecords.japanese: 「サント・アンヌ　ごう」\cせかいを　いっしゅう　している\nごうか　きゃくせんの　もけい　です！
sourceRecords.english: “S.S. ANNE\c“A replica of the luxury liner that\ncircles the globe.”

sourceRecords.japanese: えっ？　ふね　ですか？\cもうしわけ　ございません　げんざい\nれんらくせんは　ないんです‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I beg your pardon?\nYou're looking for a ship?\cI'm sorry, the ferry service isn't\navailable at present...

sourceRecords.japanese: れんらくせんを　ごりよう　ですね！\nチケットは　おもち　でしょうか？
sourceRecords.english: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nチケットを　もっていない！\c‥‥もうしわけ　ありません！\cふねに　のれるのは\nチケットの　ある　かた　だけです
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] doesn't have the TICKET...\cI'm terribly sorry.\cYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nふねのチケットを　みせた！\cはい！　けっこう　です！\cいきさきは　どちら　でしょう？
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] flashed the TICKET.\cPerfect! That's all you need!\cAnd where would you like to go?

sourceRecords.japanese: また　ごりよう　ください！
sourceRecords.english: Please sail with us another time!

sourceRecords.japanese: ミナモ　ですね！
バトルタワー　ですね！
れんらくせんに　のって　おまちください
sourceRecords.english: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.

sourceRecords.japanese: いきさきは　どちら　でしょう？
sourceRecords.english: Then, where would you like to go?

sourceRecords.japanese: うみの　そこ　かあ‥‥\nいったい　どんなふう　なのかな？\cおれも　いつか　もぐってみたいぜ！
sourceRecords.english: A journey to the bottom of the sea...\nI wonder what it'd be like?\cI'd love to go deep underwater like\nthat some day.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくも　クスノキ　かんちょうと　いっしょに\nかいてい　ちょうさに　いきたかった！\cでも　せんすいていの　なかは　せまいから\nぼくが　のったら　かんちょうが\rのれなく　なっちゃうんだよね‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I wanted to go with CAPT. STERN on\nthe ocean floor exploration.\cBut the sub's too small for me.\cIf I squeezed in, there wouldn't be\nany room for the CAPTAIN...

HIDEOUT in LILYCOVE CITY?\cFwahahahaha...

sourceRecords.english:
