sourceRecords.japanese: たくましさコンテスト　ステージ\nワイルドな　ポケモンに　ドキドキ！
sourceRecords.english: TOUGHNESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE THRILLED BY TOUGH POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: この　せかいには\nどれだけの　ポケモンが　いるのかな？\cいつのひか　うみを　こえて\nとおい　くにの　ひとと\rポケモン　こうかん　したいなあ！
sourceRecords.english: I wonder how many kinds of POKéMON\nthere are in the world?\cIt'd be great to cross seas and\ntrade POKéMON with people far away.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちかごろ　ひとの　ポケモンを　うばったり\nいんせきを　よこどり　したりする\rろくでもない　やつらが　いるらしいな！
sourceRecords.english: I've been hearing about some rotten\nscoundrels who steal POKéMON and rip\roff METEORITES.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひとの　ポケモンを　うばったり\nいんせきを　よこどり　していた\rろくでもない　やつら‥‥\cちかごろ　すがたを　みなくなったよ
sourceRecords.english: Those rotten scoundrels who steal\nPOKéMON and rip off METEORITES...\cI haven't seen them around recently.

sourceRecords.japanese: プラスパワーを　ポケモンに　つかって\nこうげきりょくを　たかめるんだ！\cこれで　しょうり　まちがいなし　さ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm going to get X ATTACK to raise\nATTACK during battle.\cThat way, I'll be guaranteed to win!

sourceRecords.japanese: ちょっと　たかいかも　しれないけど\nなんでもなおし　って　べんりよ\cポケモンの　どんな　いじょうも\nこれひとつで　なおせるんだもんね！
sourceRecords.english: FULL HEAL is a little expensive,\nbut it is convenient.\cJust one of these can cure any\nPOKéMON status problem.

sourceRecords.japanese: あ！\n[PLAYER]だ！！

きいたよ！
きみ　つよいんだってな\cここでは　みんな
だれが　いちばん　つよい　トレーナーかはなしを　してるんだけど\cおれ　きみの　うわさを　きいて
きみの　ファンに　なることに　したよ！\cこれからも　つよい　トレーナーと
バンバン　たたかって\cおれたちに　あつい
たたかいを　みせてくれよ！\cそうすれば　きっと　みんなも
きみの　ことを　みなおすと　おもうんだ\cじゃあ　きたい　してるよ！
[PLAYER]！！
sourceRecords.english:
I've heard the news!
You're really strong, aren't you?\cWe always argue about who is the
strongest of all TRAINERS here.\cSo when I heard about you, I decided
to be your fan!\cI hope you'll keep on battling other
tough TRAINERS.\cThat way, we'll be able to see more
of your hot, hot battles.\cThat will make the others here see
exactly how great you are.\cRemember, I'm cheering for you,
[PLAYER]!

sourceRecords.japanese: おう　[PLAYER]！！\nおうえん　してるぞ！！
sourceRecords.english: Yo, [PLAYER]!\nYou're the one we want to win!

sourceRecords.japanese: あいつらは　しらないんだ\nきみが　いちばん　すごいって　ことをさ！\cそうだろ　[PLAYER]！\nこんじょう　みせてくれ！
sourceRecords.english: The others, they don't know that\nyou're the best of the best!\cIsn't that right, [PLAYER]?\nShow them you've got guts!

sourceRecords.japanese: きみには　わるいけど　いま　いちばん\nちゅうもくの　トレーナーは\rまちがいなく　[STR_VAR_1]　だね！\cあの　つよさは\nだたものじゃ　ないよ
sourceRecords.english: I hate to say this, but the TRAINER\neverybody's talking about is\r[STR_VAR_1], no question about it!\cThat TRAINER's power...\nIt's out of the ordinary.

sourceRecords.japanese: くそー　いまは　[STR_VAR_1]が\nいちばん　つよいって　いってるのに\cだれも　きいて　くれない‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Darn it... I've been telling people\nthat [STR_VAR_1] is the best now...\cBut no one wants to listen...

sourceRecords.japanese: さいきん　つぎつぎと　ジムリーダーを\nたおしている　っていう\cつよい　トレーナーが\nあらわれた　らしいんだ\cきみ　しらないかい？
sourceRecords.english:
I've been hearing things about a
tough new TRAINER.\cThis TRAINER's supposed to be beating
GYM LEADERS, even.\cDo you know anything about this
new TRAINER?

sourceRecords.japanese: あ！\n[PLAYER]！！\cがんばってね\nおうえん　してるから！
sourceRecords.english: Oh!\n[PLAYER]!\cGo for it!\nI'm pulling for you!

sourceRecords.japanese:
トウキさま‥‥\cあ！
ちがう　ちがう！\cわたしは　あくまで　あなたの
ファン　なんだからね！\cだから　あたしの　ために
がんばってよ！
sourceRecords.english:
Sigh...
BRAWLY...\cOh, no! Wait!
That's not right! No, no, no!\cI'm your fan through and through!\cSo make me proud!
Go for it!

sourceRecords.japanese: やっぱり　わたしは　トウキさま　しか\nすきに　なれない　のよねー
sourceRecords.english: I can't help it, I can only get to\nlike BRAWLY...

sourceRecords.japanese: だれも　トウキさまの\nみりょくを　わかって　くれないの‥‥\cいいわ！\cわたし　ひとりでも　トウキさまの　ことを\nおうえん　しつづけるから！
sourceRecords.english: Nobody understands the charm of\nBRAWLY...\cI don't care!\cEven if I'm the only one, I'm going\nto keep cheering for BRAWLY!

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしの　いちばん　すきな\nトレーナーは　なんと　いっても\cムロの　ジムリーダー\nトウキさまよ！
sourceRecords.english: Whatever anyone says, my favorite\nTRAINER is DEWFORD's GYM LEADER\rBRAWLY!

sourceRecords.japanese: きみは　ついに　あらゆる　めんで\nきみの　おとうさんを　こえたな！\cこの　わしが　いって　いるんだから\nまちがいない！
sourceRecords.english: You've surpassed your own father in\nevery regard!\cI'm telling you, so there's no question\nabout it at all!

sourceRecords.japanese: きみの　おとうさんは　ピンチに　なっても\nあきらめずに　たたかって　いたよ‥‥\cわしは　しっているよ\cきみは　いくら　まけても　けっして\nあきらめない　という　ことを！\rだから　がんばってくれ！
sourceRecords.english: Even when things turned bleak, your\nfather never gave up.\cThis I know to be true.\cYou never give up even if you lose!\nSo keep on battling!

sourceRecords.japanese:
きみより　センリさんの　ほうが
もっと　つよくて　かっこよくみごたえの　ある　たたかいを　していたぞ！\cいくら　きみが　つよいと
いわれて　いても\cきみの　おとうさんに　くらべたら
まだまだ　だな
sourceRecords.english:
NORMAN battled with more power,
charisma, and showmanship than you.\cEven though people may say that
you're strong...\cYou've still got a long way to go
compared to your father.

sourceRecords.japanese:
きみも　センリさんと　おなじ　ふんいき
というか　はくりょくが　でてきたね\cしかし　センリさん　とは　けっていてきに
ちがう　ものが　ある！\c‥‥それは　わたしからは　いえない
じぶんで　さがして　みるんだな
sourceRecords.english:
You're beginning to get the same
air of awe NORMAN exudes.\cBut there's something conclusively
different between you and NORMAN.\cI can't tell you what that is.
You'll have to find it yourself.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ここにいる　みんなは
ポケモンしょうぶが　だいすきでね\cだれが　いちばん　つよい　トレーナーか
はなしを　して　いるんだ！\cきみも　ゆうめいに　なれば
みんな　ファンに　なるかもな！
sourceRecords.english:
Everyone here, we're all huge fans
of POKéMON battles.\cWe discuss who we consider to be
the strongest of all TRAINERS.\cIf you were to become famous, we
might even become your fans!

sourceRecords.japanese: うわー！　[PLAYER]だー\nほんもの　だー\cあくしゅ　してー\nあくしゅ！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, woweee! It's [PLAYER]!\nFor real, too!\cPlease, shake my hand, shake my hand!

sourceRecords.japanese:
‥‥わたし　いつまでも　[PLAYER]の　こと
おうえん　する　からね！\cわたし　もう　[PLAYER]の　まける
とこなんて　みたくないよ\c[PLAYER]　ほんとは
つよいんだ　もんね！
sourceRecords.english:
I'll always cheer for you, [PLAYER]!
Always, always!\cI don't want to see you lose ever,
[PLAYER].\cBecause I know you're really, really
strong, [PLAYER]!

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]さん　って　かっこいい‥‥\cねえ　みんなも\nそう　おもうでしょー？
sourceRecords.english: [STR_VAR_1] is really cool...\cEveryone thinks so, right, right?

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]さん　って　ほんとうに\nかっこいい　よねぇ‥‥\cわたし　ひとりに　なっても\nずうっと　おうえん　するんだー！
sourceRecords.english: [STR_VAR_1] really is cool, don't\nyou think so?\cEven if it's just me, I'm going to keep\ncheering my favorite TRAINER.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしのね\nすきな　トレーナーは\cかっこよくて\cつよくて\cそれでいて　やさしい\cそんな　トレーナーが　いいなぁ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: My favorite TRAINER is...\cCool...\cStrong...\cAnd really nice...\cI wish there was a TRAINER like that...

sourceRecords.japanese: あ！　[PLAYER]だー！\nすげー！\cぼくも　おおきく　なったら\n[PLAYER]　みたいに　つよく　なりたいよ！
sourceRecords.english: Whoa! It's [PLAYER]!\nWicked!\cWhen I grow up, I want to be strong\nlike you, [PLAYER]!

sourceRecords.japanese:
‥‥
ぼく　ひとりに　なったって\cずっと　[PLAYER]の　ことを
おうえん　するよ！\cだって　[PLAYER]の　こと
しんじてるもん！
sourceRecords.english: Even if I'm the only one...\cYou'll always be the only one I\ncheer for, [PLAYER]!\cBecause I believe in you, [PLAYER]!

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]って　かっこいいよねー\nぼく　あくしゅ　してほしいなー
sourceRecords.english: [STR_VAR_1] is so wickedly cool...\nI want to shake hands with my hero.

sourceRecords.japanese:
‥‥
ぼく　ひとりに　なったって\cぜったい　[STR_VAR_1]の　ファンを
やめない　からね！\cだって　ぼく　きいたんだもん
[STR_VAR_1]は　ぜったいに　まけないって
sourceRecords.english: Even if I'm the only one...\cI'm never going to stop being\n[STR_VAR_1]'s fan!\cBecause I've heard, [STR_VAR_1]\nnever loses!

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]！\nやっぱり　すごいよ　きみは！\cぼくは　きみを　はじめて　みたときから\nすごい　やつだって　おもってたよ！\rやはり　ぼくのめは　たしかな　ようだね！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER]!\nYou are amazing after all!\cEver since I set eyes on you, I knew\nthat you were great.\cIt looks like my eyes didn't deceive me.

sourceRecords.japanese: まあ　ほかの　やつの\nことなんて　きにするなよ\rぼくが　ついて　いるんだ！\cきみは　しんぱい　しないで　いつもどおり\nたたかって　いれば　いいんだよ
sourceRecords.english: Who cares about the others.\nI'm in your corner!\cYou don't need to worry. Just get\nout there and battle like always.

sourceRecords.japanese:
きみも　なかなか
いい　トレーナーだと　おもうけど\cいまは　やっぱり　[STR_VAR_1]が
いちばんだと　おもうんだ\cまあ　ぼくが　おもっている　だけだから
あまり　きにしなくて　いいよ
sourceRecords.english:
You're a pretty decent TRAINER,
I think.\cBut I also think that [STR_VAR_1]
is number one right now.\cThat's just my opinion.
Don't worry about it too much.

sourceRecords.japanese:
きみは　ほんとうに　つよいな‥‥
[STR_VAR_1]　より　つよいかも　しれない\cでも　[STR_VAR_1]　には
ぼくが　ひつよう　なんだ\cだって　ぼくが　[STR_VAR_1]を
おうえん　しなきゃだれが　おうえん　するんだ！
sourceRecords.english: Wow, you really are strong.\nMaybe even stronger than [STR_VAR_1].\cBut [STR_VAR_1] needs me.\cIf I don't cheer for [STR_VAR_1],\nwho will?

sourceRecords.japanese: みなおしたわ！\nあなたって　ほんとうに　つよいのね！\cどうしたら　そんなに　つよく　なれるのか\nおしえて　もらいたいわ
sourceRecords.english: You've changed my mind!\nYou are strong, aren't you?\cI'd like you to tell me how you managed\nto get so strong!

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたって　ピンチに　なれば　なるほど\nみりょくてきな　たたかいを　するのよね\rつぎの　たいせんが　たのしみだわ！
sourceRecords.english: The tougher the situation, the more\nattractively you battle.\cI can't wait for your next battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: さいきんの　トレーナーは\nやっぱり　[STR_VAR_1]よね！\rあの　つよさは　ただもの　じゃないわ\cあなたも　いいせん　いってるけど\n[STR_VAR_1]に　くらべたら　まだまだねー
sourceRecords.english: Among the recently hot TRAINERS,\n[STR_VAR_1] is the standout.\cThat toughness, it's simply not normal.\cYou're doing okay, but you're not in\nthe same class as [STR_VAR_1].

sourceRecords.japanese:
あなたって　ほんとうに
にんき　ものよね‥‥\cつよいし　ポケモンにも　やさしいし
いうこと　ないわ\cでもね！　わたしは
[STR_VAR_1]を　しんじているの！\c[STR_VAR_1]の　ほうが　ぜったいに
つよいに　きまってるん　だから！
sourceRecords.english: You are really popular...\cYou're strong, and you're caring to\nPOKéMON. No one can knock you.\cBut, you know, I believe in [STR_VAR_1].\c[STR_VAR_1] is definitely stronger!\nI'm positive!

sourceRecords.japanese: おぬし‥‥\cやるな！
おぬしの　しんの　ちからは\nこの　わしだけが　しっていれば　よいのじゃ\cみなには　その　ひめられた　ちから\nわかるまい‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Your true worth, it is fine if only\nI recognized it.\cThe others I doubt will understand\nthe hidden power that beats within.

sourceRecords.japanese: うむ　おぬし　なかなかの\nめを　しておるな\cじゃが！\c‥‥うーむ\nまだまだの　ようじゃな
sourceRecords.english: Yes, I see strength in your eyes.\cBut!\cYou still haven't realized your\npotential.

sourceRecords.japanese:
たしかに　おぬしは
とてつもなく　つよいかも　しれない\cじゃが！
わしには　わかる\cその　つよさは　まだ
しんの　つよさとは　いわないのじゃ！しんの　つよさとは！\c‥‥\cじつは　わしも
よく　わからんのじゃ
sourceRecords.english:
It is true that you are tremendously
powerful.\cBut!
I can tell...\cThat strength cannot be considered
true strength yet!\cTrue strength is...!
... ...\cActually, I have no idea, either.

sourceRecords.japanese: えっ？　ふね　ですか？\cもうしわけ　ございません　げんざい\nれんらくせんは　ないんです‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I beg your pardon?\nYou're looking for a ship?\cI'm sorry, the ferry service isn't\navailable at present...

sourceRecords.japanese: れんらくせんを　ごりよう　ですね！\nチケットは　おもち　でしょうか？
sourceRecords.english: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nチケットを　もっていない！\c‥‥もうしわけ　ありません！\cふねに　のれるのは\nチケットの　ある　かた　だけです
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] doesn't have the TICKET...\cI'm terribly sorry.\cYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nふねのチケットを　みせた！\cはい！　けっこう　です！\cいきさきは　どちら　でしょう？
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] flashed the TICKET.\cPerfect! That's all you need!\cAnd where would you like to go?

sourceRecords.japanese: また　ごりよう　ください！
sourceRecords.english: Please sail with us another time!

sourceRecords.japanese: カイナ　ですね！
バトルタワー　ですね！
れんらくせんに　のって　おまちください
sourceRecords.english: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.

sourceRecords.japanese: いきさきは　どちら　でしょう？
sourceRecords.english: Then, where would you like to go?

sourceRecords.japanese: れんらくせんが　かんせい　しないと\nふなのり　というものは　ヒマだぜ‥‥\cカイナの　ぞうせんじょの　れんちゅう\nしゃかりきに　がんばって　くれよな
sourceRecords.english: Until they finish making the ferry, we\nsailors have nothing to do...\cI wish they'd get a move on, the folks\nat the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT.

sourceRecords.japanese: やっと　れんらくせん　タイドリップごうが\nうんこう　するように　なったんだ！\cカイナの　ぞうせんじょの　みんな\nたいへん　だったろうな\rこれからは　おれが　いそがしくなるぞ！
sourceRecords.english: The ferry S.S. TIDAL is finally in\noperation.\cThe folks at the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT\nmust've worked extra hard.\cWell, it's my turn to get busy now!

sourceRecords.japanese: えーと‥‥\nそうじゃ　わし　わすれじいさん\cポケモンの　わざを\nわすれさせる　ことが　できるんじゃ！\cわざを　わすれ　させるかね？
sourceRecords.english: Uh...\nOh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.\cI can make POKéMON forget their moves.\cWould you like me to do that?

sourceRecords.japanese: どの　ポケモンに　するんじゃ？
sourceRecords.english: Which POKéMON should forget a move?

sourceRecords.japanese: どの　わざを\nわすれ　させるんじゃ？
[STR_VAR_1]は　わざを　１つしか\nもってない　ようじゃ‥‥
むむ！　\n[STR_VAR_1]の　[STR_VAR_2]じゃな？
だいせいこう　じゃ！\c[STR_VAR_1]は　[STR_VAR_2]を\nわすれた　ようじゃ！
sourceRecords.english: It worked to perfection!\c[STR_VAR_1] has forgotten\n[STR_VAR_2] completely.

sourceRecords.japanese: わすれさせたい　わざが　あったら\nまた　くるのじゃぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Come again if there are other moves\nto be forgotten.

sourceRecords.japanese: なぬ！？　タマゴは\nわざを　おぼえていない　ようじゃが‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: What?\nNo EGG should know any moves.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンは　にんげんの　パートナーであって\nけっして　にんげんの　どうぐ　じゃないよ\cそこを　かんちがい　しておる\nにんげんも　たまに　いるんだよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON are partners to people.\nThey aren't our tools.\cUnfortunately, there are some people\nwho fail to understand that...

sourceRecords.japanese: カクレオン『るろろ‥‥？
むにゃむにゃ‥‥\cぼく　ねぼけて　いるから\nこれを　あげる‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Huh? What? What's that?\cI'm not near awake yet...\nYou can have this...

sourceRecords.japanese: むにゃむにゃ‥‥\cねる　こは　そだつ‥‥\nねむって　たいりょく　かいふく‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Yawn...\cSleep is essential for good health...\nSleep and regain health...

sourceRecords.japanese:
あら　あら　あら！　あなた　わかいのに
ひとりたび？　えらいわねえー！うちのこ　たちにも　みならわせたいわあ\cおばさんは　ポロックめいじん！
ちょいと　ほんきを　だせばすごく　いい　ポロックを　つくれるのよー！\cポロックめいじんの　おばさんが
いろいろと　おしえてあげようか？
sourceRecords.english:
Oh, my, my! Are you traveling alone?
But you're so young! Good for you!\cI'm sure my kids could learn a thing
or two from you!\cMe? I'm a master of [POKEBLOCK]S.\cIf I get serious just a little, why, I
can concoct great [POKEBLOCK]S.\cWould you like to learn from me, a
master of [POKEBLOCK]S?

sourceRecords.japanese: あらあ　そう？\nなんでも　じぶん　ひとりだけで\rがんばろうと　しちゃ　ダメよー！
sourceRecords.english: Oh? Are you sure?\cYou shouldn't always try to do\neverything by yourself, dear!

sourceRecords.japanese:
あらあ　すなおな　いいコねえー！
じゃ　ちょっとながいけど　ききなさいよ\cいい？\cポロックには　なめらかさって　もんが　あるの
ポロックを　みれば　わかるでしょ？なめらかさは　かずが　すくないほど　いいの！ここ　まちがっちゃ　ダメよ！\cなめらかさの　すうじが　ひくくて
レベルが　たかいのが　いい　ポロック！いい　ポロックは　たくさんポケモンが　たべて　くれるんだから！\cそれと　いい？\cなめらかな　ポロックが　つくりたかったら
けちらないで　いろんな　しゅるいのきのみで　つくってみるのよ！まぜた　きのみによって　なめらかさがちがって　くるんだから！\cそれと　いい？\cなるべく　おおぜいで　つくったほうが
なめらかな　ポロックが　できるのよ！だれでも　いいから　おねがいしていっしょに　つくって　もらいなさいよ！\cさてと　このくらい　おぼえて　おけば
あなたも　いちにんまえに　なれるわよ！\cだいすきな　ポケモンと　なめらか　ポロック
そして　なかよし　かぞくが　いればこのよは　しあわせ！あなたも　がんばりなさいな！
sourceRecords.english:
Oh, good! You're a smart soul!
This is a bit long, so listen up!\cAre you ready?\cIf you look at [POKEBLOCK]S, you should see
that they are rated on how they feel.\cThe lower the feel rating,
the better it is. Don't forget this!\cA good [POKEBLOCK] has a low feel
rating and a high level.\cA POKéMON can eat more good
[POKEBLOCK]S than ordinary ones, too.\cAnd this is important.\cIf you want to make smooth [POKEBLOCK]S,
use different kinds of BERRIES.\cDon't be stingy - the kinds of BERRIES
affect the smoothness of [POKEBLOCK]S.\cAnd another thing.\cThe more people blending BERRIES, the
smoother the [POKEBLOCK]S.\cThat's why you should talk to other
people and make [POKEBLOCK]S together.\cThat's about all you need to know to
make good [POKEBLOCK]S.\cIf everyone had POKéMON they love,
smooth [POKEBLOCK]S, and a loving family,the world would be a happier place.\cDon't give up, dear!

sourceRecords.japanese: よつごが　うまれた　ときは\nすごく　ビックリ　したが\rみんなで　なかよく　あそんでいる　すがたを\rみていると　しあわせ　きぶんに　なるよ！
sourceRecords.english: When my wife gave birth to quadruplets,\nyou bet I was shocked.\cBut, now, seeing them play together,\nit makes me happy.

sourceRecords.japanese: マルチバトル　してるけど\nぼくが　かつに　きまってるぜ！
sourceRecords.english: We're having MULTI BATTLES, but I know\nI'm going to win.

sourceRecords.japanese: レコードコーナーで　まぜまくる！\nって　なにが　まざってるんだ？
sourceRecords.english: We like mixing stuff at the RECORD\nCORNER.\cBut what gets mixed up?

sourceRecords.japanese: きのみブレンダーで\nとびっきりの　ポロック　つくっちゃうぜ！
sourceRecords.english: We're going to make super [POKEBLOCK]S\nwith a BERRY BLENDER!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンの　たくましさ　じまん　したいから\nみんなで　コンテスト　してるんだ！
sourceRecords.english: I want to brag about how tough my\nPOKéMON is, so we're going to enter a\rCONTEST together.

sourceRecords.japanese: この　ほしの　さいだいの　なぞ\nそれは　かいていに　あると　おもうんだ！\c‥‥というのは\nだれかが　いってた　ことなんだけど
sourceRecords.english: This planet's biggest mysteries are\nat the bottom of the sea.\cSomebody said that, but I don't know...

sourceRecords.japanese: そういや　トクサネと　ルネの　あいだには\nふかい　ふかい　かいこうが　ある\c‥‥そんな　はなしも\nだれかが　いってた　ことなんだけど
sourceRecords.english: There's a deep underwater trench\nbetween MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.\cThat's what someone told me, anyway.

sourceRecords.japanese: いらっしゃいませ！\nミナモ　デパート　です
デパートに　くると　たのしくなって\nいろんな　ものを　かっちゃうのよ
sourceRecords.english: Whenever I come to the DEPARTMENT\nSTORE, I always end up buying all sorts\rof things because it's so fun.

sourceRecords.japanese: きょうは　すてきな　かぐを\nおかあさんに　かって　もらうの
sourceRecords.english: Today, my mom is going to buy me some\nnice furniture.

sourceRecords.japanese: コンテストで　ゆうしょうした　ごほうびに\nマリルリに　なにか　かって　あげるんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm buying something for my AZUMARILL\nas a reward for winning a CONTEST.

sourceRecords.japanese: マリルリ『まりりるぅー！
１かい　‥‥　サービス　カウンター\n　　　　　　　ちゅうせん　かいじょう\c２かい　‥‥　トレーナーズ　ゾーン\c３かい　‥‥　バトル　コレクション\c４かい　‥‥　わざマシン　コーナー\c５かい　‥‥　ぬいぐるみ　フロアー\cおくじょう　‥‥　いこいの　ひろば
sourceRecords.english: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER\n    LOTTERY CORNER\c2F: TRAINER'S ZONE\c3F: BATTLE COLLECTION\c4F: TM CORNER\c5F: POKé DOLL FLOOR\cROOFTOP: ROOFTOP PLAZA

sourceRecords.japanese: どうぐの　きほんは　うまく　つかいこなすこと\nこれ　いちばん　だいじ　なのヨ
sourceRecords.english: Learn to use items properly.\nThat's basic, really.

sourceRecords.japanese: いえで　まってる　ダンナの\nおみやげ　なんだけど　どれが　いいかしら？
sourceRecords.english: My husband is waiting at home.\nWhat would make a good gift for him?

sourceRecords.japanese: これから　とおい　ところへ\nたびに　いくからな\rここで　どっさり　どうぐを　かっておくのさ
sourceRecords.english: I'm leaving on a long journey soon.\nI need to stock up on items.

sourceRecords.japanese: たびの　おともに\n２かい　‥‥　トレーナーズ　ゾーン
sourceRecords.english: FOR YOUR TRAVELING COMPANIONS\n2F: TRAINER'S ZONE

sourceRecords.japanese: てっとりばやく　ポケモンを　つよくするなら\nどうぐを　あたえるのが　いちばん！\cタウリンなら　こうげきりょく　アップ！\nリゾチウムなら　とくこう　アップ　だぜ！
sourceRecords.english: For quickly toughening up POKéMON,\nitems are the best.\cPROTEIN boosts ATTACK, and CALCIUM\nraises SP. ATK.

sourceRecords.japanese: じょうぶな　ポケモンに\nなって　ほしいからね\cブロムヘキシンで　ぼうぎょりょくを　あげるか\nキトサンで　とくぼうを　あげるか\rいま　かんがえている　ところ　なんだ
sourceRecords.english: I want my POKéMON to have more\nendurance.\cI'm trying to decide whether to raise\nDEFENSE with IRON, or SP. DEF with ZINC.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンにね\nインドメタシンを　あげたら\rすばやさが　あがったの！
sourceRecords.english: I gave a CARBOS to my POKéMON and its\nSPEED went up.

sourceRecords.japanese: まけない　トレーナーの　ひつじゅひん\n３かい　‥‥　バトル　コレクション
sourceRecords.english: ESSENTIALS FOR UNBEATABLE TRAINERS\n3F: BATTLE COLLECTION

sourceRecords.japanese: うむむ‥‥\cこうげきの　わざ　か‥‥\nまもりの　わざ　か‥‥\cどの　わざマシンを\nポケモンに　おぼえさせるか　なやむ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Hmm...\cAn attacking move...\nOr a defensive move...\cIt's no easy matter to decide which TM\nmoves should be taught to POKéMON...

sourceRecords.japanese: わざマシンって　たくさん　あるのね！\cなにかの　カタログには\nぜんぶで　５０しゅるい　って\rかいて　あったわ
sourceRecords.english: There are so many different kinds of\nTM moves.\cA catalog I read said there are fifty\ndifferent kinds.

sourceRecords.japanese: わざマシン　ぜんぶ　ほしいけど\nポケモン　４つしか　わざ　おぼえないもんな
sourceRecords.english: I'd like to get all the different TMs,\nbut a POKéMON learns only four moves.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンリーグ　への　ちかみち\n４かい　‥‥　わざマシン　コーナー
sourceRecords.english: A SHORTCUT TO POKéMON LEAGUE\n4F: TM CORNER

sourceRecords.japanese: すてきな　ぬいぐるみが　いっぱい　なのねー\nこどものぶん　だけじゃ　なくて\rあたしのぶんも　かおうかしら　オホホホホ！
sourceRecords.english: This place is full of cute DOLLS.\cI should buy some for me, instead of\njust for my children.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたし　まだ　ポケモン　そだてられないから\nかわいい　ぬいぐるみ　かってもらうの
sourceRecords.english: I'm not big enough to raise POKéMON,\nso I'm getting a cute DOLL instead.

sourceRecords.japanese: かわいい　マットが　たくさん　うってるの！\nどれを　かおうかな‥‥\rぜーんぶ　かっちゃおうかな‥‥
sourceRecords.english: They sell many cute MATS here.\cI wonder which one I should get?\nMaybe I'll buy them all...

sourceRecords.japanese: かわいい　ともだち\n５かい　‥‥　ぬいぐるみ　フロアー
ほりだしものいち‥‥\nいつ　やるのか　きまって　ないのかな？\cテレビ　みてても\nぜんぜん　コマーシャル　ないんだよね
sourceRecords.english: Don't they have set dates for their\nclear-out sales?\cI watch TV, but they never show any\ncommercials.

sourceRecords.japanese: まちに　まった　ほりだしものいち！\nここでしか　かえないもの　ばかり！\rよーし　たくさん　かっちゃうぞお！
sourceRecords.english: Yes! I've been waiting a long time for\nthis clear-out sale.\cThey have items that you can only get\nhere. I'm going to load up, that I am!

sourceRecords.japanese: ああ　のどが　かわいたなあ
じどう　はんばいき　がある！\nほしい　のみもの　は‥‥
sourceRecords.english: It's a VENDING MACHINE.\nWhich drink would you like?

sourceRecords.japanese: ガゴン！\c[STR_VAR_1]が　でてきた！
ガゴン！\cあたりだ！　もういっぽん\n[STR_VAR_1]が　でてきた！
sourceRecords.english: Clang!\cScore! An extra can of [STR_VAR_1]\ndropped down!

sourceRecords.japanese: おかねが　たりない！
‥‥　‥‥　やっぱり　やめた！

げんき　しとぉや！！
チャンピオンを　めざす　[PLAYER]！！\cこのジムの　ジムリーダーは
エスパータイプの　ポケモンつかい！\cかくとうタイプや　どくタイプの
ポケモンで　いどむとものすごい　ダメージを　くらうぞ！\cしかも　ばつぐんの
コンビネーションで　せめてくる！\cだから　きみも　かつために　ポケモンとの
きずなを　きばって　みせて　やれ！
sourceRecords.english:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound
[PLAYER]?\cThe GYM LEADERS here use PSYCHIC-type
POKéMON.\cIf you go up against them with
FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON,they'll inflict horrible damage!\cPlus, they'll come at you with
outstanding combination attacks.\cIf you want to win, you'll need to show
them how tight you are with yourPOKéMON. Go for it!

sourceRecords.japanese: こりゃあ　たまげた！！\nきみは　すごか　トレーナーだ！
sourceRecords.english: Wow, you're astounding!\nYou're one great TRAINER!

sourceRecords.japanese: しょうぶは　こころの　つよさで　きまる\nこころ　よわき　ものは　かてない！
sourceRecords.english: Battles hinge on the strength of your\nspirit! The weak-spirited will never win!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけたか！\nオレも　きたえ　なおさねばっ！
sourceRecords.english: I lost! I must temper my spirit again!

sourceRecords.japanese: まよった　ほうが　まける\nオレからの　ちゅうこくだ！
sourceRecords.english: The indecisive lose.\nThat's my warning to you.

sourceRecords.japanese: キミの　さいのうを　みせて　もらおうか！
すばらしい　さいのうの　もちぬしだ！
よのなかに　てんさいが　いるならば\nここの　ジムリーダーが　そうだ‥‥\cだが　もしかすると　キミの　ほうが\nさいのうは　うえかも　しれない‥‥
sourceRecords.english: If there are prodigies in the world,\nthen our GYM LEADERS are them!\cHowever, you may be even more talented\nthan them...

sourceRecords.japanese: ふふふ‥‥\nねんりきで　モンスターボールを\rくうちゅうに　うかせて　みせよう‥‥\cうおおぉぉぉぉぉ‥‥！\n‥‥　‥‥\r‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\rちょうしの　わるい　ときも　ある‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Fufufufu... Watch me levitate a POKé\nBALL telekinetically!\cWrooooooooaaaar!\n... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cSometimes, I'm out of sync...

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモン　しょうぶも\nちょうし　わりーっ！
sourceRecords.english: My POKéMON battling skills are out\nof sync, too!

sourceRecords.japanese: モンスターボールは　おおきすぎた\nこの　わたぼこり　なら　ぜったいに‥‥\cふううううううっ‥‥！\n‥‥　‥‥\rちがうぞ！\rはないきで　とばして　なんか　いないぞ！
sourceRecords.english:
A POKé BALL was too heavy to lift
psychically. But this dust bunny...\cWhoooooooooooooooh!
... ... ... ... ... ...\cNo, I'm not cheating!
I didn't blow on it! Honestly!

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたが　アタシに　まけた　としても\nおちこまない　ことね！\cあなたが　よわい　わけじゃ　なくて\nアタシが　つよすぎる　からよ！
sourceRecords.english: When you lose to me, don't be too hard\non yourself.\cIt's not that you're weak - I'm just\ntoo strong!

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたは　さらに　つよすぎた！
まけたから　って　クヨクヨ　しないわ\nもっと　しゅぎょう　すれば　いいんだもの！\cまえむきな　ところが　アタシの　とりえ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm not going to get down on myself for\nlosing. I just need to train harder.\cPositive thinking - that's my strong\npoint!

sourceRecords.japanese: みえる‥‥\nあなたの　みらいが　みえる‥‥\cわたくしに　かてたら\nあなたの　みらいを　おしえて　あげる！
sourceRecords.english: I see it...\nI see your future...\cIf you can beat me, I will tell you\nyour future!

sourceRecords.japanese: まいりました‥‥！
あなたと　ジムリーダーさまの　しょうぶ‥‥\nものすごく　はげしい　てんかい‥‥\cけっかは‥‥\nわたくしの　くちからは　いえない‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: You will wage a terrifically intense\nbattle with our GYM LEADERS...\cThe result...\nYou won't hear it from me!

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたが　これまで　あゆんできた　みちのり\nあなたが　けいけん　してきた　ことがら\cすべてを　ぶつけて　きなさい！
sourceRecords.english: The roads you have traveled...\nWhat you have experienced...\cCome at me with everything you've\nlearned!

sourceRecords.japanese: すばらしい　みちのり　だわ‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: You've traveled a path of greatness!

sourceRecords.japanese: がんばった　ものには　あかるい　みらいが\nなまけた　ものには　ぜつぼうの　あしたが\cいんがおうほう‥‥\nすべては　じぶんに　はねかえる　ものよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: A bright future awaits those who have\nworked diligently.\cFor those who lazed idly, there is\nonly despair at the end.\cWhat goes around comes around...

sourceRecords.japanese:
フウ『へへへ‥‥　ジムリーダーが\cラン『ふふふ‥‥　ジムリーダーが\cフウ『ふたりも　いるんで　おどろいた？
ラン『ふたりも　いるんで　おどろいた？\cフウ『ぼくたち　ふたご！
ラン『あたしたち　ふたご！\cフウ『なにも　ことばに　しなくても
ラン『おたがいの　かんがえて　いることが\cフウ『あたまの　なかに　うかぶから
ラン『つうじあうことが　できるのヨ！\cフウ『そんな　ぼくたちの　コンビネーション
ラン『きみに　やぶることが　できる？
sourceRecords.english:
TATE: Hehehe... Were you surprised?\cLIZA: Fufufu... Were you surprised?\cTATE: That there are two GYM LEADERS?
LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?\cTATE: We're twins!
LIZA: We're twins!\cTATE: We don't need to talk because...
LIZA: We can each determine what...\cTATE: The other is thinking...
LIZA: All in our minds!\cTATE: This combination of ours...
LIZA: Can you beat it?

sourceRecords.japanese: フウ『ぼっ　ぼくたちの\nラン『コンビネーションが‥‥！\cフウ『やぶれた　からには　しかたない\nラン『まけを　みとめて　これを　あげるヨ！
sourceRecords.english: TATE: What?! Our combination...\nLIZA: Was shattered!\cTATE: It can't be helped. You've won...\nLIZA: So, in recognition, take this.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　フウと　ランから\nマインドバッジを　もらった！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] received the MIND BADGE\nfrom LIZA and TATE.

sourceRecords.japanese: フウ『マインドバッジには　ポケモンの\nとくこうと　とくぼうを　たかめる\rこうかが　ひめられている！\cラン『それから　ダイビング　という\nひでんわざも　つかえるように　なるヨ！\cフウ『あと　これも　もっていきなよ！
sourceRecords.english: TATE: The MIND BADGE enhances the\nSP. ATK and SP. DEF of POKéMON.\cLIZA: It also lets you use the HM move\nDIVE outside of battle.\cTATE: You should also take this, too.

sourceRecords.japanese:
フウ『その　わざマシン０４には
ラン『めいそうが　はいってるヨ！\cフウ『ポケモンの　とくこうと
ラン『ポケモンの　とくぼうを\cフウ『たかめてくれる　わざ　なんだ！
ラン『エスパーポケモンに　ぴったりだヨ！
sourceRecords.english:
TATE: That TM04 contains...
LIZA: CALM MIND!\cTATE: It raises SP. ATK and...
LIZA: It raises SP. DEF!\cTATE: It's a move that's perfect...
LIZA: For PSYCHIC POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: フウ『きょうだいの　きずな　より\nきみと　ポケモンとの　きずなの　ほうが\rはるかに　つよかった　みたいだね‥‥\cラン『あなたなら　もっと　つよくなれる！\nたたかった　あたしたちには　わかるわ！
sourceRecords.english: TATE: Looks like the bond between you\nand your POKéMON is far stronger than\rthe bond that we share as twins.\cLIZA: You will become even stronger!\nWe've battled you, so we know.

sourceRecords.japanese: フウ『へへへ‥‥　ジムリーダーが\cラン『ふたりも　いるんで　おどろいた？\cフウ『あら？　たたかえる　ポケモンが\nラン『いっぴき　しか　いないヨ！\cフウ『それでは　たたかえないね！\nラン『しょうぶを　たのしみたいから\rもっと　ポケモン　つれてきてヨ！
sourceRecords.english: TATE: Hehehe... Were you surprised?\cLIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?\cTATE: Oops, you have only one...\nLIZA: POKéMON that can battle.\cTATE: We can't battle that way!\cLIZA: If you want to challenge us,\nbring some more POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: トクサネシティ　ポケモンジム
トクサネシティ　ポケモンジム\cフウ　ラン　にんてい　トレーナー！\n[PLAYER]
sourceRecords.english: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM\cLIZA AND TATE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n[PLAYER]

sourceRecords.japanese: ムムムッ！\nきみの　[STR_VAR_1]‥‥
[STR_VAR_1]　が　すきだろう！\cいや　まちがいなく\n[STR_VAR_1]　が　すきだ！
sourceRecords.english: It likes [STR_VAR_1]S,\ndoesn't it?\cNo, I'm positive of it! It definitely\nlikes [STR_VAR_1]S!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポロックの　すききらいは　ないみたいだな
sourceRecords.english: It doesn't appear to like or dislike\nany [POKEBLOCK]S.

sourceRecords.japanese: だんなったら　みただけで\nポケモンが　すきな　ポロック　わかるのよ
sourceRecords.english: My husband can tell what kind of\n[POKEBLOCK]S a POKéMON likes at a glance.

sourceRecords.japanese: おれの　いもうとは　ヒワマキの\nボーイフレンドと　ぶんつう　してる\cちっとも　うらやましく　ないぞ！
sourceRecords.english: My little sister exchanges MAIL with\nher boyfriend in FORTREE.\cI don't envy her one bit at all.

sourceRecords.japanese: ヒワマキの　おともだちに　あえなくても\nポケモンが　おてがみを　はこんでくれるの\rはなれていても　さみしくないわ！
sourceRecords.english: Even though I can't see my friend in\nFORTREE, my POKéMON carries MAIL back\rand forth for us.\cI'm not lonesome, even though we're\napart.

sourceRecords.japanese: キャモメ『ぴひょー！
この　まちの　ジムリーダー\nなんといっても　あの　コンビネーションは\rさいこう！　さすが！　って　かんじよ
sourceRecords.english: The GYM LEADERS in this town are a\nformidable duo.\cTheir combination attacks are, like,\nexcellent and wow!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンの　とくせいに　よっては\nわざの　いりょくが　かわったり\rまったく　きかなかったり　するよ！
sourceRecords.english: Depending on the special abilities of\nPOKéMON, some moves might change\ror not work at all.

sourceRecords.japanese: つうしん　たいせんで　かちまくって\nみんなに　あたしの　みりょくを\rアピールしたら　ファンが　ふえちゃうかな！
sourceRecords.english: If I win a whole lot of link battles\nand show everyone how good I am,\rI might get a fan following!

sourceRecords.japanese: げんきのかけら　って　すごい！\cこれを　あたえると\nひんしの　ポケモンも　めざめるの！\cでも　パワーポイントは\nかいふく　しないから　きをつけて！
sourceRecords.english: REVIVE is fantastic!\cGive it to a fainted POKéMON, and the\nPOKéMON will arise.\cBut be careful, REVIVE doesn't restore\nthe used-up PP of moves.

sourceRecords.japanese: ゴールドスプレーは\nよわい　ポケモンを　よせつけない\cかずある　スプレーの　なかで\nいちばん　ながもち　するんだ！
sourceRecords.english: MAX REPEL keeps all weak POKéMON away.\cOut of all the REPEL sprays, it lasts\nthe longest.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ネットボールと　ダイブボールは
ここ　トクサネでしか　つくっていないめずらしい　モンスターボール！\cネットボールは　むしタイプや
みずタイプの　ポケモンに　こうかてき！\cダイブボールは　かいていに　いる
ポケモンを　つかまえ　やすいんだ！
sourceRecords.english:
The NET and DIVE BALLS are rare POKé
BALLS that are only made in MOSSDEEP.\cA NET BALL is effective against
BUG-type and WATER-type POKéMON.\cA DIVE BALL works best on POKéMON at
the bottom of the sea.

sourceRecords.japanese: おーい！　トレーナーよお！\nすごいつりざおは　ほんとうに　すごいぞお\cなんたって　かいていに　いる\nポケモンも　つりあげられる　からのお！\cどお？　ほしく　なった？
sourceRecords.english:
Hey there, TRAINER!
A SUPER ROD really is super!\cSay all you want, but this baby can
catch POKéMON off the seafloor!\cWhat do you think?
You want it, don't you?

sourceRecords.japanese: そうだろ　そうだろ！　すごいつりざおは\nほんとうに　すごい　からのお！
sourceRecords.english: You bet, you bet!\nAfter all, a SUPER ROD is really super!

sourceRecords.japanese: みずの　ある　ところなら\nどこでも　つりざお　つかうと　いいぞお！
sourceRecords.english: If there's any water, try dropping in\nyour ROD and see what bites!

sourceRecords.japanese: あら？\nつりは　きらい　なのかね？
すごいつりざおで\nかいていの　ポケモンも　つりあげろお！
sourceRecords.english: Go after the seafloor POKéMON with\nyour SUPER ROD.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ダイゴ『[PLAYER][KUN]‥‥？\cそう‥‥　ここは　ボクの　いえ
なにも　ないから　はずかしいね\cそうだ
この　ひでんマシン　もっていきなよ\cダイビングが　はいって　いるけど
ボクは　もう　ポケモンに　おしえたから
sourceRecords.english: STEVEN: [PLAYER][KUN]?\cYes, this is my place. It's a little\nembarrassing how empty it is here.\cOh, here, you should take this HM.\cIt contains DIVE.\nI've already taught my POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ダイゴ『なみのりを　していると
みずの　いろが　こい　ばしょが　ある\cそこで　ダイビングを　つかうと
うみの　そこに　もぐれるから\cうかびたい　ときは
もういちど　ダイビングを　つかうんだ\cばしょに　よっては
うかべない　ばあいも　あるけど
sourceRecords.english:
STEVEN: While you're using SURF, you
should notice dark patches of water.\cUse DIVE if you come to deep water
like it. You'll drop to the seafloor.\cWhen you want to come back up, use
DIVE again.\cIn some places, it won't be possible
for you to surface, though.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ダイゴ『この　トクサネと
ルネシティの　あいだ　にはかいていどうくつが　あるらしい\cクスノキかんちょうが　せんすいてい　で
はっけんした　という　アレだよ\cかいていどうくつ‥‥
めずらしい　いしが　みつかりそうだねちょっと　もぐって　こようかな
sourceRecords.english:
STEVEN: Apparently, there's an
underwater cavern betweenMOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.\cYou know, the one that CAPT. STERN
found in his submarine.\cAn underwater cavern...\cThere might be some rare stones down
there... I should go for a DIVE...

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nモンスターボールを　しらべた！\cなかには　ポケモンの\nダンバルが　はいっている！\cモンスターボールを　もって　いきますか？
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] checked the POKé BALL.\cIt contained the POKéMON\nBELDUM.\cTake the POKé BALL?

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nダンバルを　てにいれた！
これいじょう　ポケモンを　もてない！
sourceRecords.english: There is no space for another POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　モンスターボールを\nそのままに　しておいた
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] left the POKé BALL where\nit was.

sourceRecords.japanese:
てがみが　ある！\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\c[PLAYER][KUN]へ\cボクは　おもうことが　あって
しばらく　しゅぎょうを　つづけるとうぶん　いえに　かえらない\cそこで　おねがいだ\cつくえの　うえにある
モンスターボールを　うけとって　ほしい\cなかに　いるのは　ダンバルといって
ボクの　おきにいりの　ポケモンだから\cよろしく　たのむよ\cでは　また　いつか　あおう！
　　　　　　ツワブキ　ダイゴより
sourceRecords.english:
It's a letter.\c... ... ... ... ... ...\cTo [PLAYER][KUN]...\cI've decided to do a little soul-
searching and train on the road.\cI don't plan to return home for some
time.\cI have a favor to ask of you.\cI want you to take the POKé BALL on
the desk.\cInside it is a BELDUM, my favorite
POKéMON.\cI'm counting on you.\cMay our paths cross some day.\cSTEVEN STONE

sourceRecords.japanese:
てがみが　ある！\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\c[PLAYER][KUN]へ\cボクは　おもうことが　あって
しばらく　しゅぎょうを　つづけるとうぶん　いえに　かえらない\cそこで　おねがいだ\cつくえの　うえにある
モンスターボールを　うけとって　ほしい\cなかに　いるのは　ダンバルといって
ボクの　おきにいりの　ポケモンだから\cよろしく　たのむよ\cよかったら　ひでんマシン
ダイビングも　もっていくと　いい\cでは　また　いつか　あおう！
　　　　　　ツワブキ　ダイゴより
sourceRecords.english:
It's a letter.\c... ... ... ... ... ...\cTo [PLAYER][KUN]...\cI've decided to do a little soul-
searching and train on the road.\cI don't plan to return home for some
time.\cI have a favor to ask of you.\cI want you to take the POKé BALL on
the desk.\cInside it is a BELDUM, my favorite
POKéMON.\cI'm counting on you.\cIf you'd like, you should also take
the HM DIVE.\cMay our paths cross some day.\cSTEVEN STONE

sourceRecords.japanese: ダイゴの　あつめた\nめずらしい　いしが　かざってある！
sourceRecords.english: It's a collection of rare rocks and\nstones assembled by STEVEN.

sourceRecords.japanese: おとうと　ったら\nひとの　ひみつきちを　さがすのが\rたのしみ　なんだって！
sourceRecords.english: My little brother says he likes to go\nfind people's SECRET BASES.

sourceRecords.japanese: おとうと　ったら\nともだちの　ひみつきちに　いって\rポケモンしょうぶを　するのが\rたのしみ　なんだって！
sourceRecords.english: My little brother says he likes to\nvisit people's SECRET BASES and have\rPOKéMON battles.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひょっとして　[STR_VAR_1]　に\nひみつきち　つくったの　きみ？
sourceRecords.english: Was it you who made a SECRET BASE in\n[STR_VAR_1]?

sourceRecords.japanese: きみ　どこかに　ひみつきち　つくりなよ！\nぼくが　さがしだして　みせるからさ
sourceRecords.english: You should make a SECRET BASE\nsomewhere. I'll go find it!

sourceRecords.japanese: エネコロロ『みゃあん？
もうすぐ　ロケットが　はっしゃ　するぞ！
ロケットが　はっしゃ　したよ！\nこれで　[STR_VAR_1]かい　うちあげ　せいこうだ！
sourceRecords.english: The rocket launched safely!\nThat's successful launch no. [STR_VAR_1]!

sourceRecords.japanese:
ロケットを　はっしゃ　するには
１パーセントの　ミスも　ゆるされない\c９９パーセント　だいじょうぶ　でも
１パーセント　ダメならすべてが　ダメになる　きびしい　ものだ\cそれでも　やりとげようと　するのは
そこに　ロマンが　つまっている　からだな
sourceRecords.english:
A rocket launch demands perfection.
Not even a 1% margin of error is allowed.\cEven if it's 99% okay, the whole thing
is useless if 1% happens to be no good.\cDespite that, we never stop trying.
Why? It's a dream that never ends.

sourceRecords.japanese: かいがんを　さんぽ　していて\nこれを　みつけたんだけど\rぼくは　いらないから　きみに　あげる！
sourceRecords.english: I was taking a stroll down the beach\nwhen I found this.\cIt's not anything I need, so you can\nhave it.

sourceRecords.japanese: むかしから　ホウエンちほうは\nいんせきの　おおい　ばしょ　として\rゆうめい　なんだよね
sourceRecords.english: The HOENN region has been famous for \nits meteor showers for a long time.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひとに　よっては\nポケモンは　うちゅうから　やってきた！\rって　いうよね！　ほんとう　かなー？
sourceRecords.english: Some people claim that POKéMON came\nfrom space. Could it be true?

sourceRecords.japanese: でっかい　てつの　かたまりが\nおおぞらを　つきぬけ\rうちゅうまで　とんで　いく‥‥\cたまげた　もん　だわい
sourceRecords.english: A giant chunk of metal bursts through\nthe skies and flies into space...\cIt boggles my mind!

sourceRecords.japanese: トクサネは　てんきの　よい　ひが　おおい\nかぜの　むきも　あんてい　している\cロケットを　うちあげる　には\nもってこいの　ばしょ　なんですな
sourceRecords.english: MOSSDEEP has mainly sunny weather,\nand its winds are stable.\cIt's an ideal location for launching\nrockets.

sourceRecords.japanese: わしも　もうすこし　わかければ\nうちゅう　ひこうしに　なりたかった‥‥\cいや　いまからでも　おそくない！\nよーし　がんばるぞー！！
sourceRecords.english: If only I was a little younger, I would\nhave liked being an astronaut...\cNo... It's not too late!\nI can and will try!

sourceRecords.japanese: いつか　ふつーの　ひとも\nうちゅうに　いけると　いいのにな‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I wish ordinary people could go into\nspace one day...

sourceRecords.japanese: わしも　わかいころは　\nポケモン　トレーナーとして\rせかいじゅうを　たび　していたのじゃ\cジジイとなった　いまでは\nわかい　トレーナーの　しょうぶを　みるのが\rゆいいつの　たのしみ　じゃ
sourceRecords.english: When I was young, I traveled the world\nas a POKéMON TRAINER.\cNow that I've become an old buzzard,\nmy only amusement is watching young\rTRAINERS battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: とびらには　かぎが　かかって　いるようだ！
sourceRecords.english: The door appears to be locked.

sourceRecords.japanese: いまは　[STR_VAR_1]　という　トレーナーが\nわしの　いえに　きておる！\c[STR_VAR_1]と　しょうぶ　してみたいのじゃな？
sourceRecords.english: A TRAINER named [STR_VAR_1] is\nvisiting my home.\cWould you like to challenge\n[STR_VAR_1]?

sourceRecords.japanese: しょうぶ　せんのか‥‥\nしょうぶを　みられなくて　ガッカリ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: You won't battle? I'm disappointed\nthat I can't see you battle...

sourceRecords.japanese: おお　そうか　そうか！\cじゃが　この　いえは\nあんまり　がんじょう　じゃないから\cせめて　３たい３の\nしょうぶに　して　くれんかのう？
sourceRecords.english: Oh, good, good!\cBut my house isn't all that sturdy.\cCould I ask you to keep it down to\na 3-on-3 match?

sourceRecords.japanese: じゃあ　しょうぶの　まえに\nレポートを　かいて　おいたほうが　よいぞ
sourceRecords.english: Before you two battle, you should\nsave your progress.

sourceRecords.japanese: よい　しょうぶを　きたい　しておるぞ！
sourceRecords.english: I hope to see a good match!

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]
しょうぶは　ひきわけに　おわった！
sourceRecords.english: The match ended up a draw.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひきわけ　じゃったか！\cおたがい　いっぽも　ゆずらぬ\nすばらしい　しょうぶ　じゃったぞ！
sourceRecords.english: So, it became a standoff.\cIt was a brilliant match in which\nneither side conceded a step!

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]
みごと　じゃったぞ！\cまるで　わしの　わかい　ころを\nみている　ようじゃわい！
sourceRecords.english: That was superlative!\cWhy, it was like seeing myself in my\nyouth again!

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]
ざんねん　じゃったのう\nじゃが　よい　しょうぶ　じゃったぞ！\rつぎこそは　かてると　よいのう
sourceRecords.english: Ah, too bad for you!\cBut it was a good match.\nI hope you can win next time.

sourceRecords.japanese:
げんき　しとぉや！！
チャンピオンを　めざす　[PLAYER]！！\cルネシティの　ジムリーダー　ミクリは
みずタイプ　ポケモンを　つかいこなす！\cそして　ミクリが　いる　ばしょ　までは
こおりの　ゆかが　ゆくてを　さえぎる‥‥\cごめんな！　きみに　おしえて
あげられるのは　ここまで　なんだ‥‥！\cあとは　じぶんで　きばってくれッ！
sourceRecords.english:
Yo! How's it going, CHAMPION-
bound [PLAYER]?\cSOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER WALLACE is
a master of WATER-type POKéMON.\cAnd, to get to WALLACE, an icy floor
will hamper your progress...\cListen, I'm sorry, but that's all the
advice that I have for you.\cThe rest of the way, you have to
go for it yourself!

sourceRecords.japanese:
ホウエンで　いちばん　つよいと　いわれる
ミクリに　かったのかあ！！\cよし！　きみの
トレーナーカードを　みたまえ！\cすべての　バッジが　そろっているなら
いよいよ　ポケモンリーグ　ちょうせんだ！
sourceRecords.english: Yow! You've beaten even WALLACE, who\nwas supposedly the best in all HOENN!\cOkay! Check out your TRAINER's CARD.\cIf you've gotten all the BADGES, you're\nset for the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge!

sourceRecords.japanese: ジムリーダー　ミクリさまに　おしえてもらった\nかれいな　テクニックを　みせたげる！
sourceRecords.english: I'll show you the sublime techniques\nI learned from our LEADER WALLACE!

sourceRecords.japanese: ミクリさま　ごめんね‥‥
すべての　ゆかに　ヒビを　いれると\nなにかが　おこるわよ
sourceRecords.english: Watch what happens if you crack all\nthe floor tiles.

sourceRecords.japanese: せっかく　ここまで　これたのに\nあたしに　まけるから\rミクリさまに　あえないわね！
sourceRecords.english: You came all the way here, but you won't\nget to see WALLACE.\cNot if you lose to me, you won't!

sourceRecords.japanese: つよい　じゃない！！\nかわいい　みために　だまされたわ
sourceRecords.english: You're strong!\nI was fooled by your cute looks!

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたなら　ミクリさまと　たたかっても\nいちげきで　やられなくて　すむかもね
sourceRecords.english: You might be good enough to avoid\nbeing wiped out in one hit by WALLACE.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミクリさまの　たたかう　すがた‥‥\cその　うつくしさに　こころ　うばわれ\nわたくしも　ポケモンを　はじめましてよ
sourceRecords.english: The sight of WALLACE conducting a\nbattle...\cThe very beauty of it compelled me to\nbecome a TRAINER.

sourceRecords.japanese: たたかう　すがたの\nうつくしさで　まけましたわ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: You battled with more beauty than\nI could muster...

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたさまの　たたかう　すがたも\nすばらしくってよ\cああっ‥‥！\nポケモンに　であえて　よかったですわ
sourceRecords.english: The grace you bring to battle is\nfabulous.\cOh... I'm so fortunate to have found\nPOKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: おねえさんが　しょうぶの　きびしさ\nいろいろと　おしえて　あげちゃおっかな
sourceRecords.english: I should teach you how harsh battles\ncan be.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんだ\nつよいんだ
いいこと　おしえて　あげるね\cミクリさまに　あいたいのなら\nすべての　ゆかを　１かいずつ\rあるいて　いけば　いいの
sourceRecords.english: I'll tell you something good.\cIf you want to reach WALLACE, you\nneed to walk on each floor tile once.

sourceRecords.japanese: ホウエンちほうで　いちばん\nレベルの　たかい　ポケモンジム‥‥\cそれが　ここ　ルネジムよ！
sourceRecords.english: The POKéMON GYM of the highest level\nin the HOENN region...\cThat's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんて　レベルの　たかい‥‥
sourceRecords.english: What a high level you are!

sourceRecords.japanese: レベルの　たかい　ジムに　いることに\nまんぞく　しないで\rほかにも　しゅぎょうに　いくほうが\rつよくなれそうだし　なにより　たのしそうね
sourceRecords.english: Rather than being satisfied by being\nin a strong GYM, I imagine training in\rother places will make you stronger.\rBut above all, it looks more fun.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミクリさまと　いっしょに\nポケモンを　きたえて　いるの\cかんたんに　たおせると　おもわないでね
sourceRecords.english: I train my POKéMON together with\nWALLACE.\cDon't think I'm a pushover.

sourceRecords.japanese: たおされちゃった‥‥
あなた　みどころ　あると　おもうの\nいっしょに　ここで　ポケモン　きたえない？
sourceRecords.english: I think you have potential.\nWhy don't you stay and train with us?

sourceRecords.japanese: こおりの　うえでの　ひとふでがき\cそれが　できる　トレーナーは\nエレガントに　うつくしいのよ！
sourceRecords.english: A graceful glide across the ice while\ncrossing no lines...\cA TRAINER putting on that performance\nwould be elegantly beautiful!

sourceRecords.japanese: ちょっとー！？
あたりまえ　だけど\nポケモンの　つよさに\rおとなも　こどもも　かんけい　ないよ
sourceRecords.english: This is really obvious, but how strong\nyou are as a TRAINER has nothing to do\rwith how young or old you are.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンと　いっしょに　いると\nじかんが　あっ　というまに　すぎるのよ！
sourceRecords.english: When I'm with my POKéMON, the time\nflies by before you can say, “Oops!”

sourceRecords.japanese: あっ！
まけた　しょうぶも\nあっ　というまに　わすれたい‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I wish I can forget about lost causes\nbefore I can manage an “Oops!”

sourceRecords.japanese:
あらためて　なのろう\cわたしは　ミクリ
この　ルネの　ジムリーダー\cなんだろう
きみの　ふんいきが　すこし　かわった\cそんな　きが　する\cめざめのほこらで　なにが　あったか
きみが　なにを　してきたかこれからの　たたかいで　わかるだろう\cさあ　みせてもらおう
きみと　ポケモンの　ちからを\cそして　ぞんぶんに　おみせしよう
わたしと　ポケモンに　よるみずの　イリュージョンを！
sourceRecords.english:
Allow me to formally introduce
myself.\cI am WALLACE.
The GYM LEADER of SOOTOPOLIS.\cThere's something about you...
A difference in your demeanor.\cI think I sense that in you.\cWhat happened inside the CAVE OF
ORIGIN, and what you did, I will likelylearn through our upcoming battle.\cNow, show me. Show me the power you
wield with your POKéMON.\cAnd I, in turn, shall present you with
a performance of illusions in waterby me and my POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese:
すばらしい\cきみが　ほんとうに　すばらしい
ポケモン　トレーナーだと　わかった\cそんな　きみと　きみの　ポケモンに
であえたことを　よろこびたい\cこの　レインバッジは
そんな　きみに　ふさわしいさあ　うけとるが　いい
sourceRecords.english:
Bravo.\cI realize now your authenticity and
magnificence as a POKéMON TRAINER.\cI find much joy in having met you and
your POKéMON.\cYou have proven yourself worthy of
the RAIN BADGE. Accept it.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　ミクリから\nレインバッジを　もらった！

レインバッジを　もっていると
すべての　ポケモンがきみの　いうことを　すなおに　きいてくれる\cはげしく　ながれる　たきも
ひでんわざ　たきのぼりを　つかってのぼれる　ように　してくれる\cそれから　わたしとの　しょうぶを
わすれないように　これを‥‥
sourceRecords.english:
Having that BADGE assures you the
full obedience of all your POKéMON toevery command you make.\cThe BADGE also allows the use of the
HM move WATERFALL to scale wallsof cascading water.\cAnd, so that you never forget the
battle we shared, take this...

sourceRecords.japanese: きみに　わたした　その　わざマシン\nなかみは　みずのはどう\cつかうと　ときおり　ちょうおんぱで\nあいてを　こんらん　させる
sourceRecords.english: The TM I handed you contains\nWATER PULSE.\cIn use, it will occasionally confuse\nthe target with ultrasonic waves.

sourceRecords.japanese: ホウエンで　あつめられる\nすべての　ジムバッジを　てにいれた\rトレーナーが　いくべき　ばしょ\cそれが　ポケモンリーグ\cポケモンリーグに　いくならば\nホウエンちほうの　さいはて\rサイユウという　しまに　むかうと　いい
sourceRecords.english: TRAINERS who have gathered all the\nGYM BADGES of HOENN should make way\rfor the ultimate destination.\cThe POKéMON LEAGUE.\cTravel to the easternmost reaches\nof HOENN, to the island EVER GRANDE.\rThe POKéMON LEAGUE is there.

sourceRecords.japanese: ホウエンで　あつめられる\nジムバッジは　あと　ひとつ\cきみが　ポケモンリーグに　いどむ　つもりなら\nヒワマキの　ポケモンジムで\rのこりの　バッジを　てにいれると　いい
sourceRecords.english: There remains but one BADGE to\nobtain in HOENN.\cIf you wish to challenge the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must obtain the last\rBADGE from the GYM in FORTREE.

sourceRecords.japanese: ルネシティ　ポケモンジム
ルネシティ　ポケモンジム\cミクリ　にんてい　トレーナー！\n[PLAYER]
sourceRecords.english: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM\cWALLACE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n[PLAYER]

sourceRecords.japanese: この　まちの　ジムリーダー　ミクリは\nホウエンちほう　でも　いちばんと\rうわさ　される　じつりょくしゃ　だよ\cしかし　ミクリよりも　つよいと　いわれる\nしてんのうの　つよさ\rどれほどの　ものだろう？
sourceRecords.english:
WALLACE, this town's GYM LEADER, is a
powerful TRAINER.\cHe's rumored to be the best in the
whole HOENN region.\cBut the ELITE FOUR...\cThey're said to be even stronger than
WALLACE. How strong could they be?

sourceRecords.japanese: この　まちの　みんなが　みんな\nいえに　とじこもって　でてこないんです！\cこの　てんき‥‥\nなにかの　まえぶれ　なのでしょうか？
sourceRecords.english: Everyone in town has taken refuge\nand won't come out of their homes.\cThis weather..\nCould it be the prelude to something?

sourceRecords.japanese: どんな　ときでも\nどんな　ことが　あっても\rあたし　ポケモンと　ともだちで　いるわ\cだって　ポケモンと　いっしょだと\nすごく　たのしいもの！
sourceRecords.english: Whenever, wherever, and whatever\nhappens, I will always be friends with\rPOKéMON.\cBecause it's fun to be with POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: りゆうは　わからないけれど‥‥\nとっても‥‥　ふあん　なの‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I don't know why...\nBut... I'm really scared...

sourceRecords.japanese: ポイントアップは　すごいぞ！\cなんたって　ポケモンの\nパワーポイントを　ふやせるからな！
sourceRecords.english: PP UP is great!\cIt raises the POWER POINTS, the PP,\nof a POKéMON move.

sourceRecords.japanese: いったい　なにが　おこってるんだ！？
かいふくのくすり　ごぞんじ　ですか？\cポケモンの　たいりょく　ぜんかい！\nじょうたい　いじょうも　すべて　かいふく！\rまさに　ゆめのような　どうぐ　なのです
sourceRecords.english: Do you know FULL RESTORE?\cFull restoration of HP!\nEradication of all status problems!\cIt's truly an item of your dreams!

sourceRecords.japanese: この　てんき‥‥\nなにかが　めざめたのか‥‥？
うむう‥‥\nルネシティに　こもること　３０ねん‥‥\cわしが　あみだした　ひっさつの　わざマシン！\nおまえに　ゆずろう！
sourceRecords.english: For thirty years I've remained in\nSOOTOPOLIS honing my skills.\cI developed a shattering TM.\nI bequeath it to you!

sourceRecords.japanese: わざマシン３１は　かわらわり！\nせつめい　するのも　おそろしい　わざよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: TM31 contains BRICK BREAK! It's a move\nso horrible that I can't describe it.

sourceRecords.japanese: カクレオン『ぷー　ぷひゃあー
おくりびやま‥‥\cちょうじょうに　ふたつのたまが\nおかれて　いるのは　ごぞんじ　ですか‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: MT. PYRE...\cAt its peak are two orbs placed side\nby side. Did you know?

sourceRecords.japanese: そう‥‥　ふたつのたまが\nとなりあわせに　おかれている　ようすは\rなにか　こころが　やすらぎますよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Yes, two orbs side by side...\cThe sight of them together...\nIt is somehow soothing...

sourceRecords.japanese: そうですか‥‥\nいちど　いかれては　どうでしょう‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Is that so?\nPerhaps you ought to visit and see...

sourceRecords.japanese: あなた　ポケモン　トレーナーね？\cルネの　ジムリーダー\nミクリさまには　ファンが　いっぱいだけど\rあなたに　ファンは　いるのかしら？
sourceRecords.english: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?\cSOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER WALLACE has\nmany fans.\rDo you have any?

sourceRecords.japanese: へえー\nじゃあ　けっこう　つよいのね！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.

sourceRecords.japanese: あららん‥‥\nそれは　ちょっと　さみしいわね\cファンが　できるよう　がんばりなさいよ！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, dear...\nThat's a little lonesome.\cTry working a little harder to get a\nfan following.

sourceRecords.japanese: ねっしんな　ファンだと\nカントーや　ジョウトからも　やってくるの！\cあたしが　ミナモの\nトレーナー　ファンクラブに　いったときも\rとっても　すごかったもの！
sourceRecords.english: Dedicated fans come over from even\nKANTO and JOHTO.\cIt was really wild when I went to the\nTRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.

sourceRecords.japanese: いいことを　おしえてやろう\cこの　あたりの　うみの　そこには\nこだいの　いせきが　あるそうだ！\cひょっとしたら　むかしの　おたからが\nざくざく　みつかるかも　しれないぜ！
sourceRecords.english:
Listen up, and I'll tell you something
good.\cThere's supposed to be an ancient
ruin in the sea around here.\cThere could be treasures just waiting
to be discovered down there.

sourceRecords.japanese: たからもの　かぁ‥‥\cあると　いいけど\nそうでなくても　ポケモンと　いっしょに\rかいていを　おさんぽ　なんて　す・て・き！
sourceRecords.english: Ancient treasures...\cIt would be nice if they existed, but\neven if they didn't, it would be so\rbeautiful to take an underwater\rstroll with my POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: マリルリ『まるりー
この　ルネシティと　おくりびやまは\nなにかの　かんけいが　あるらしい‥‥\cむかし　いた　けんきゅうじょで\nそんなことを　ともだちと　しらべていたよ
sourceRecords.english: There appears to be some connection\nbetween SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE.\cMy friends and I did some research on\nit at the lab where I used to work.

sourceRecords.japanese: おにいちゃん\nむかし　うみの　けんきゅうを　してたんだ
sourceRecords.english: My big brother used to study the sea.

sourceRecords.japanese: わー　ひさしぶりの　おきゃくさん！\cなんだか　うれしいから\nホエルコの　おおきい　ぬいぐるみ　あげる！
sourceRecords.english: Hello! You're our first guest in a\ngood while.\cYou've brightened up my day, so I'll\ngive you a big WAILMER DOLL.

sourceRecords.japanese: だいじに　してね！
ほしいけど　いまは　ダメ？\nじゃあ　あずかっておいて　あげるね
sourceRecords.english: Oh, you want it, but not right now?\nOkay, then I'll hold it for you.

sourceRecords.japanese: そうなの？\nぬいぐるみ　ほしくないの？
sourceRecords.english: Are you sure?\nYou don't want this DOLL?

sourceRecords.japanese: あたし　ぬいぐるみ　だいすき！
かいていに　あった　かざんが　ふんかして\nうみの　うえまで　もりあがる\cそして　ふんかこうに　あめが　たまって\nできたのが　この　ルネシティ　なんだよ
sourceRecords.english:
An underwater volcano erupted and
forced itself up from the depths.\cIts crater emerged from the sea and
became filled with rainwater.\cThat's how SOOTOPOLIS CITY came into
being.

sourceRecords.japanese: ルネと　そとのせかいを　つなぐ　どうくつ\cまるで　なにかを　ここから　ださないように\nつくられた　みたい　だわ‥‥\c‥‥かんがえすぎ　かしら？
sourceRecords.english: The cave that links SOOTOPOLIS and\nthe outside world...\cIt seems as if the cave was made to\nkeep something from getting out.\cOr am I just imagining things?

sourceRecords.japanese:
きみ　キノココって　ポケモン　しってる？
ルネでは　めったに　みられないん　だけどね\cわし　おおきな　キノココが
めちゃめちゃ　だいすき　なのよ！\cおとうとは　ドジョッチの　ほうが
おおきいって　いうんだけど\cキノココの　ほうが
おおきいに　きまってる　よね！\cん？　きみ　キノココ　もってるの？
ちょ　ちょ　ちょっと‥‥おじさんに　みせて　おくれ！
sourceRecords.english:
Do you know the POKéMON SHROOMISH?
It's hardly ever seen in SOOTOPOLIS.\cAnyway, I love big SHROOMISH.
The bigger the better.\cBut my younger brother, he says that
BARBOACH is bigger.\cThat's silly. SHROOMISH has to be
bigger than that!\cHuh? Do you have a SHROOMISH with you?
P-p-please, show me!

sourceRecords.japanese:
[STR_VAR_2]ｃｍ！！

bigger.\cBut that's wrong! Everyone knows that

sourceRecords.japanese:
ようこそ　チャレンジャー！
おれは　してんのうの　カゲツ\cうーん　いい　かお　してるな

sourceRecords.english:
Welcome, challenger!
I'm SIDNEY of the ELITE FOUR.\cI like that look you're giving me.
I guess you'll give me a good match.That's good! Looking real good!\cAll right! You and me, let's enjoy a
battle that can only be staged herein the POKéMON LEAGUE!

sourceRecords.japanese: おやおや　まけちまったよ\nまっ　たのしんだから　いいんだけどよ
sourceRecords.english: Well, how do you like that? I lost!\nEh, it was fun, so it doesn't matter.

sourceRecords.japanese: まけた　おれから　ひとこと\cおまえなら　もっと　さきに　すすめるぜ\nさあ　つぎの　へやに　いって\rたたかいを　たのしんで　きなよ！
sourceRecords.english: Well, listen to what this loser has\nto say.\cYou've got what it takes to go far.\nNow, go on to the next room and enjoy\ryour next battle!

sourceRecords.japanese:
アハハ！\cアタシ　してんのうの　フヨウ\cおくりびやまで　しゅぎょう　するうちに
ゴーストタイプの　ポケモンと　きもちをかよわせる　ことが　できるように　なったの\cそう　アタシと　ポケモンの　きずな
とっても　つよいんだ！\cそんな　アタシの　ポケモンたちに
ダメージを　あたえる　ことが　できるかためして　ごらんよ！
sourceRecords.english:
Ahahaha!\cI'm PHOEBE of the ELITE FOUR.
I did my training on MT. PYRE.\cWhile I trained, I gained the ability
to commune with GHOST-type POKéMON.\cYes, the bond I developed with POKéMON
is extremely tight.\cSo, come on, just try and see if you can
even inflict damage on my POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: あーあ\nまけちゃった

あなたと　ポケモンとの　あいだにも
たしかな　きずなが　あったのね\cそれが　わからなかった
アタシが　まけたのは　とうぜん\cウン　あなたたちの　きずなが
どこまで　つうじるか　みてみたいなつぎの　へやに　すすみなよ
sourceRecords.english:
There's a definite bond between you
and your POKéMON, too.\cI didn't recognize it, so it's only
natural that I lost.\cYup, I'd like to see how far your bond
will carry you.\cGo ahead, move on to the next room.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ようこそ
してんのうの　プリムと　いいます\cこおりの　わざを　きわめたくて
はるか　ホウエンまで　やって　きました\cですが　ここに　ちょうせんに　くるのは
やわな　トレーナーと　ポケモンばかり‥‥\cあなたは　どう？\cほんきを　だしても　だいじょうぶ　だと
うれしいの　ですが‥‥！！
sourceRecords.english:
Welcome, my name is GLACIA of the
ELITE FOUR.\cI've traveled from afar to HOENN so
that I may hone my ice skills.\cBut all I have seen are challenges by
weak TRAINERS and their POKéMON.\cWhat about you?\cIt would please me to no end if I could
go all out against you!

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたと　ポケモンの\nたましいの　あつさ！\cそれは　なによりも　あつく\nわたくしの　こおりの　わざが\rつうじる　ものでは　なかったのですね
sourceRecords.english: You and your POKéMON...\nHow hot your spirits burn!\cThe all-consuming heat overwhelms.\cIt's no surprise that my icy skills\nfailed to harm you.

sourceRecords.japanese: つぎに　すすみなさい\cそこで　ポケモン　リーグの\nほんとうの　おそろしさ　たしかめなさい
sourceRecords.english: Advance to the next room.\cAnd there, confirm the truly fearsome\nside of the POKéMON LEAGUE.

sourceRecords.japanese:
わしが　ポケモン　リーグ
してんのう　さいごの　ひとりドラゴンつかいの　ゲンジ！\cポケモンは　もともと
じゆうきままな　やせいの　いきもの\cときとして　ひとを　こまらせ
ときとして　ひとを　たすける\cそんな　ポケモンと　いっしょに　たたかうのに
なにが　ひつようかおまえ　わかって　いるのか？\cわかっていなければ
この　わしに　かつことは　できるまい！
sourceRecords.english:
I am the last of the POKéMON LEAGUE
ELITE FOUR, DRAKE the DRAGON master!\cIn their natural state, POKéMON are
wild living things. They are free.\cAt times, they hinder us.
At times, they help us.\cFor us to battle with POKéMON as
partners, do you know what it takes?\cDo you know what is needed?\cIf you don't, then you will never
prevail over me!

sourceRecords.japanese: みごと！　というべきだな！

さすがは　ここまで
やってきた　ポケモン　トレーナーひつような　もの　わかっている　ようだな\cそう！　トレーナーに
ひつよう　なのは　ただしい　こころ！\cポケモンは　トレーナーの
ただしい　こころに　ふれてものごとの　ぜんあくを　はんだんしただしい　こころに　ふれて　つよくなる！\cさあ　つぎに　すすめ！
チャンピオンが　まって　おるぞ！！
sourceRecords.english:
You deserve every credit for coming
this far as a TRAINER of POKéMON.\cYou do seem to know what is needed.\cYes, what a TRAINER needs is a
virtuous heart.\cPOKéMON touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and learn good from wrong.\cThey touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and grow strong.\cGo! Go onwards!
The CHAMPION is waiting!

sourceRecords.japanese:
ダイゴ『ようこそ　[PLAYER][KUN]\cいつ　きみが　ここまで　くるのか

sourceRecords.english:
STEVEN: Welcome, [PLAYER][KUN].\cI was looking forward to seeing you
here one day.\cYou... What did you see on your
journey with POKéMON?\cWhat did you feel, meeting so many
other TRAINERS like you?\cWhat has awoken in you?
I want you to hit me with it all!\cNow, bring it!

sourceRecords.japanese: チャンピオンである\nボクが　まける　とはね‥‥\cさすがだ　[PLAYER][KUN]！\cきみは　ほんとうに　すばらしい\nポケモン　トレーナー　だよ！
sourceRecords.english: I, the CHAMPION, fall in defeat...\cKudos to you, [PLAYER][KUN]!\cYou are a truly noble POKéMON\nTRAINER!

ダイゴ『おめでとう！\cきみの　ポケモンを　おもう　きもち\cそして　その　きもちに　こたえるため

victory today!\cYou are rightfully the HOENN region's
new...

sourceRecords.english: BRENDAN: [PLAYER]...\cAre you trying to tell me...\nYou've beaten the CHAMPION?

オダマキ『ほれみろ　[RIVAL]！\c[PLAYER][KUN]なら　しんぱい　いらんと

sourceRecords.english:
PROF. BIRCH: See?

[PLAYER][KUN], you've finally done it.\cWhen I heard that you defeated your
own father at the PETALBURG GYM,I thought perhaps you had a chance...\cBut to think you've actually become
the CHAMPION!\cAh, yes!\cWhat became of your POKéDEX?
Here, let me see.

sourceRecords.japanese: オダマキ『とにかく　おめでとう！\cさあ　むねをはって　おくの　へやに\nいってくるが　いいよ！
sourceRecords.english: PROF. BIRCH: Anyways,\ncongratulations!\cNow, go proudly into the final room!

sourceRecords.japanese: ダイゴ『[PLAYER][KUN]\cいや　あたらしい　チャンピオン！\cボクに　ついてきなよ
sourceRecords.english: STEVEN: [PLAYER][KUN]...\cNo, the new CHAMPION!\cCome with me.

ハルカ『‥‥がーん！\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥

sourceRecords.english:
MAY: Groan...\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cI'm just joking! That's okay!

Honestly, congratulations!

sourceRecords.japanese:
ユウキ『‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cしかたないか
そういう　きまり　だもんな\c[PLAYER]！　よかったな
おめでとう！！
sourceRecords.english: BRENDAN: ... ... ... ... ... ...\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cIt can't be helped if that's the rule.\c[PLAYER], way to go!\nCongratulations!

sourceRecords.japanese: これより　さきは\nすべての　ジムバッジを　あつめた\rトレーナーだけが　すすめます！\cトレーナーよ！　きみの　ジムバッジ\nかくにん　させてください
sourceRecords.english: Beyond this point, only those TRAINERS\nwho have collected all the GYM BADGES\rare permitted to enter.\cTRAINER, let us confirm that you have\nall the GYM BADGES.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみは　まだ\nすべての　ジムバッジを　もっていない！\cポケモン　リーグを　めざすなら\nでなおして　きなさい
sourceRecords.english: You haven't obtained all the BADGES.\cIf you're bound for the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must return with them.

sourceRecords.japanese: トレーナーよ！　おのれと\nポケモンを　しんじて　すすみたまえ！
sourceRecords.english: TRAINER! Believe in yourself and your\nPOKéMON, and go forth!

sourceRecords.japanese: ダイゴ『ここは‥‥\cはげしい　たたかいを　かちぬいた\nポケモンを　きろくする　ばしょ\cリーグ　チャンピオンの\nえいこうを　たたえるための　へや！
sourceRecords.english: STEVEN: This room...\cThis is where we keep records of\nPOKéMON that prevailed through\rharsh battles.\cIt is here that the LEAGUE CHAMPIONS\nare honored.

sourceRecords.japanese: ダイゴ『さあ！　ポケモン　リーグを\nかちぬいた　きみの　なまえと\cともに　たたかった　きみの　パートナーを\nこの　マシンに　きろく　しよう！
sourceRecords.english: STEVEN: Come on, let's record your\nname as a TRAINER who triumphed over\rthe POKéMON LEAGUE, and the names of\rthe partners who battled with you.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンリーグは\nチャンピオンロードを　ぬけると　すぐ！\cここまで　きたら\nまえに　すすむしかないわ！
sourceRecords.english: The POKéMON LEAGUE is only a short\ndistance after the VICTORY ROAD.\cIf you've come this far, what choice\ndo you have but to keep going?

sourceRecords.japanese:
チャンピオンロードの
ながくて　けわしい　みちのり‥‥\cまるで　いままで　あるいてきた　みちを
おもいださせるかの　ようだな\cきみ　じぶんの　ポケモンを　
しんじて　がんばりたまえ！
sourceRecords.english: The long and harrowing VICTORY ROAD...\cIt's like reliving the path one has\ntraveled in life...\cBelieve in your POKéMON and give it\nyour very best!

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『こらこら！\nまて　まて　ピーコちゃん！
sourceRecords.english: MR. BRINEY: Hold on, lass!\nWait up, PEEKO!

sourceRecords.japanese:
おや？　きみは　たしか　ピーコちゃんを
たすけて　くれた　[PLAYER][KUN]！そのせつは　せわに　なったのう！\c‥‥なぬ？　ふねに　のりたい　とな？\cふむふむ？
ムロに　てがみを　とどけてカイナへ　にもつを　とどける‥‥なんだか　いそがしいのう　きみは\cじゃが　それくらい　おやすい　ごようだ！
わしに　まかせて　おきなさい！では　まず　ムロに　むかうとするか！
sourceRecords.english:
Hm? You're [PLAYER][KUN]!
You saved my darling PEEKO!We owe so much to you!\cWhat's that?
You want to sail with me?\cHmhm...\cYou have a LETTER bound for DEWFORD
and a package for SLATEPORT, then?\cQuite the busy life you must lead!\cBut, certainly, what you're asking is
no problem at all.\cYou've come to the right man!
We'll set sail for DEWFORD.

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『ムロタウン　か\cよっしゃ！　いくぞ　ピーコちゃん！
sourceRecords.english: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD, here we come!\cAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『そうかね\nたのまれごとは　いいのかね？\cまあ　ふねに　のる　ひつようが　あるときは\nいつでも　えんりょなく　いっておくれ！
sourceRecords.english: MR. BRINEY: Is that so?\nYour deliveries can wait?\cYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『きみの　いいたいことは　わかっとる！\cムロに　てがみを　とどけて\nカイナへ　にもつを　とどけるんだろう\cそれくらい　おやすい　ごようだ！\nわしに　まかせて　おきなさい！\rでは　まず　ムロに　むかうとするか！
sourceRecords.english:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!\cYou're to deliver a LETTER to DEWFORD
and a package to SLATEPORT.\cWhat you need me to do is no problem
at all - I'm the man for the job!\cFirst, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『きみの　いいたいことは　わかっとる！\cカイナの　クスノキさんに\nにもつを　とどけるんだろう\cそれくらい　おやすい　ごようだ！\nわしに　まかせて　おきなさい！\rでは　まず　ムロに　むかうとするか！
sourceRecords.english:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!\cYou're to deliver a package to
CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT.\cWhat you need me to do is no problem
at all - I'm the man for the job!\cFirst, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『やあ！　きみのため　なら\nいつでも　ふねを　だそう！\cきみが　いきたいのは　どこ　かな？
sourceRecords.english: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\cNow, my friend, where are we bound?

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『そうか‥‥　きみは\nピーコちゃんの　いのちの　おんじんだ\cふねに　のる　ひつようが　あるときは\nいつでも　えんりょなく　いっておくれ！
sourceRecords.english: MR. BRINEY: Is that so?\nWell, PEEKO owes her life to you.\cYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!

sourceRecords.japanese: ハギ『ほい！　トウカに　とうちゃく！\cふねに　のる　ひつようが　あるときは\nいつでも　えんりょなく　いっておくれ！
sourceRecords.english: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've made land in PETALBURG!\cYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!

sourceRecords.japanese: ピーコちゃん『ピー　ピひょろー！

きみほど　ポケモンを　じょうずに
つかいこなす　トレーナーは　はじめてだ！\cだが　きみよりも
わたしの　むすこの　ほうが　つよいぞ！\cなんたって　ポケモン　リーグへ
ちょうせんに　いった　ぐらい　だからな！
sourceRecords.english:
You're the first TRAINER I've seen who
deploys POKéMON so masterfully.\cBut, I should tell you - my son is
stronger than you.\cHe even took the POKéMON LEAGUE
challenge, I'll have you know.

sourceRecords.japanese: この　きょうせいギプスを　つかって\nわたしたち　かぞくは\rポケモンを　きたえて　います！\cわたしたち　かぞく　ぜんいんに　かった\nあなたには　ひつようない　かもしれませんが\rぜひ　うけとって　くださいな！
sourceRecords.english: We use this MACHO BRACE to more\neffectively strengthen our POKéMON\rin training.\cSince you've beaten our entire family,\nI don't know if you need it, but we\rwould like you to have our MACHO BRACE.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしたちは　ポケモンでの　しょうぶに\nじょうねつを　そそいで　います！
sourceRecords.english: When it comes to POKéMON battles,\nwe tend to be pretty passionate.

sourceRecords.japanese: パパより　ママが　つよくて\cママより　あたしが　つよくて\cあたしより　おばあちゃんが　つよくて\cでも　おばあちゃんより　つよかったのが\nあたしの　あにき　なの！
sourceRecords.english: Mommy is stronger than Daddy.\cI'm stronger than Mommy.\cAnd Grandma's stronger than me!\cBut my big brother is even stronger\nthan Grandma.

sourceRecords.japanese:
あんたが　いくら　つよくても
わしの　まごに　あったらかてなくて　なきだすこと　じゃろう‥‥\cわしら　かぞくが　しってる　トレーナーの
だれよりも　つよかった　からのう！\cまごの　やつも　いまごろは
ポケモンリーグの　チャンピオンにちょうせん　しているの　じゃろうか？\cそれとも　わしの　まご　じゃから
もう　チャンピオン　かもな‥‥　ウヒヒ！
sourceRecords.english:
There's no question that you're strong.\cBut if you were to battle my grandson,
you'd end up crying in frustration.\cHe's much stronger than any TRAINER
our family knows.\cHe must be challenging the POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.\cKnowing my grandson, he could be the
CHAMPION already!

sourceRecords.japanese: まごの　やつも　いまごろは\nポケモンリーグの　チャンピオンに\rちょうせん　しているの　じゃろうか？\cそれとも　わしの　まご　じゃから\nもう　チャンピオン　かもな‥‥　ウヒヒ！
sourceRecords.english: My grandson must be challenging the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.\cKnowing my grandson, he could be the\nCHAMPION already!

sourceRecords.japanese: あらあら　あなたの　ポケモン\nつかれてるんじゃ　ないかえ？\cよかったら　やすんで　おいき！\nそうだ　それがいい！　そうしなさい！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, dear, dear.\nAren't your POKéMON exhausted?\cIf you'd like, rest up here.\nThat's a fine idea! You should do that.

sourceRecords.japanese: そうそう\nここで　ゆっくり　して　おいき！
sourceRecords.english: That's right.\nTake your time and rest up!

sourceRecords.japanese: あらあら\nまだ　つかれてるんじゃ　ないかえ？\cもういちど　やすんで　おいき！\nそうだ　それがいい！　そうしなさい！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, dear, dear.\nAre your POKéMON still tired?\cYou should take another rest here.\nThat's a fine idea. You should do that.

sourceRecords.japanese: そうかね‥‥\nほんとうに　だいじょうぶ　かえ？\rえんりょ　しなくたって　いいんだよ
sourceRecords.english: Is that so?\nYou don't need to be shy about it.

sourceRecords.japanese: のぼり　ロープウェイ\nまもなく　しゅっぱつ　です\rごりように　なられますか？
sourceRecords.english: The CABLE CAR is ready to go up.\nWould you like to be on it?

sourceRecords.japanese: では　こちらに　どうぞ！
またの　ごりようを\nよろしく　おねがい　しまーす！
sourceRecords.english: Please ride with us another time.

sourceRecords.japanese: くだり　ロープウェイ\nまもなく　しゅっぱつ　です\rごりように　なられますか？
sourceRecords.english: The CABLE CAR is ready to go down.\nWould you like to be on it?

sourceRecords.japanese: では　こちらに　どうぞ！
またの　ごりようを\nよろしく　おねがい　しまーす！
sourceRecords.english: Please ride with us another time.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ぼくの　にいちゃん　かせきマニア‥‥
かせき　だいすき　ナイスガイ　さ‥‥\cちなみに　あなを　ほるのも　だいすきで‥‥
この　あなも　じぶんで　ほったんだ‥‥\cこれを　あげるから‥‥
きみも　にいちゃん　みたいにあなを　ほってみなよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english:
My big brother's the FOSSIL MANIAC...
He's a nice guy who loves fossils...\cHe loves digging holes, too...
He dug this hole by himself...\cYou can have this, so you can DIG
holes just like my big brother...

sourceRecords.japanese: ちなみに　ポケモンが　あなをほると\nどうくつの　いりぐち　まで\rいっしゅんで　もどれるんだ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: If you make a POKéMON DIG inside a\ncave, you're returned to the entrance...

sourceRecords.japanese: ケースのなかに　かわった　かたちの　いしが\nいくつも　かざってある‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Rocks in peculiar shapes fill the\ndisplay case

sourceRecords.japanese: 『ちそうが　できるまで』\n『あめ　ふって　じめん　かたまる』\r『いしと　つちと　がんせきと』\cたくさんの　ほんが　ならんでる！
sourceRecords.english: THE COMPOSITION OF STRATA...\nHOW RAIN SHAPES THE LAND...\rSTONES, SOIL, AND ROCK...\cIt's crammed with books.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ぼく　かせきマニア‥‥
かせき　だいすき　ナイスガイ　さ‥‥\cきみも　カセキが　ほしいの‥‥？\cここで　みつかる　カセキは
ぜんぶ　ぼくの　ものだから　あげないよ‥‥\cどうしても　ほしければ
１１１ばんどうろの　さばくに　いきなよ‥‥\cきいた　はなしでは　すなあらしで
すなの　なかに　ねむっていた　カセキがひょうめんに　うかぶことが　あるそうだよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english:
I'm the FOSSIL MANIAC...
I'm a nice guy who loves fossils...\cDo you want a fossil?\cBut the fossils around these parts all
belong to me... None for you...\cIf you can't go without a fossil, go to
the desert on ROUTE 111...\cFrom what I've heard, fossils that were
buried in the sand sometimes rise tothe surface from sandstorms...

sourceRecords.japanese:
きみも　カセキを　みつけたんだね‥‥
すてき‥‥　うっとり　しちゃうよ‥‥\cきみ　その　カセキ　どうするの‥‥？\cきいた　はなしでは　デボンでは
カセキを　ポケモンに　いきかえらせるけんきゅうを　している　そうだよ‥‥\cぼくは　カセキが　すきだから
そんなこと　しないけどね‥‥
sourceRecords.english:
You found a FOSSIL, didn't you?
That's so nice... It's so dreamy...\cWhat are you going to do with that
FOSSIL?\cFrom what I've heard, DEVON is doing
research on reviving POKéMON fromFOSSILS...\cI love my FOSSILS, so I would never
do anything like that...

sourceRecords.japanese: カセキって‥‥\nすてき‥‥　うっとり　しちゃうよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: FOSSILS are so... Wonderful...\nIt's so dreamy...

sourceRecords.japanese: マユミ『あっ！　[PLAYER][KUN]\cちらかっていて　ごめんなさい‥‥\nけんきゅうに　むちゅうに　なると\rつい　こう　なっちゃうんです‥‥\cはずかしいから　ヒミツに　してくださいね\nこれ　あげますから‥‥
sourceRecords.english: LANETTE: Oh! [PLAYER][KUN]!\cI'm sorry everything is so cluttered...\nWhen I get engrossed in research,\rthings end up this way...\cThis is embarrassing... Please keep\nthis a secret in exchange for this.

sourceRecords.japanese: あずかりシステムを　つくった\nあたしからの　アドバイス　です\cどの　ボックスに　どの　ポケモンを\nあずけたか　わかるように\rきちんと　せいり　したほうが　いいですよ！
sourceRecords.english: May I offer advice about my POKéMON\nStorage System?\cYou should organize your BOXES so you\ncan tell which POKéMON are in them.

sourceRecords.japanese:
けんきゅう　ようの　ノートだ
ボックスに　ついて　かかれている！\cボックス１つに　３０ぴきの
ポケモンを　あずけられる　ようにする\cパソコンには　ぜんぶで　４２０ひきの
ポケモンを　あずけられる　ようにする\cつづきを　よみますか？
sourceRecords.english: It's LANETTE's research notes.\nThere's information about BOXES.\cDesign BOXES to hold 30 POKéMON each.\cEach TRAINER should be able to store\n420 POKéMON on the PC system.\cKeep reading?

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンを　マーキングすると　ボックスが\nせいり　しやすくなる　ようにする\cボックスの　なまえ　かべがみを\nかえられる　ようにして　あずけられた\rポケモンが　よろこぶ　ようにする\cつづきを　よみますか？
sourceRecords.english: A marking system should be added to\nmake POKéMON easier to organize.\cThe name and wallpaper design of each\nBOX will be made changeable to please\rthe stored POKéMON.\cKeep reading?

sourceRecords.japanese:
ポケモンが　てんそう　される　ボックスは
さいごに　みた　ボックスにする\cその　ボックスが　いっぱいの　ときは
つぎの　ボックスに　てんそう　する\cつまり　ボックスを　みることで
ポケモンを　てんそう　したい　ボックスにきりかえられる　ようにする
sourceRecords.english:
When storing a POKéMON, it should be
sent to the BOX inspected last.\cIf that BOX is full, the received
POKéMON is stored in the next BOX.\cIn other words, when a BOX is examined,
it is automatically selected as the BOXto which POKéMON are sent.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　ノートを　とじた

パソコンを　みると
なんと　でんしメールが　きていた！\c「‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cきみの　あずかり　システム
なかなか　べんり　やな\cいろんな　ところに
じょせい　らしい　きくばりが　あってつかってて　たのしいし\cいっしょに　かいはつ　した
なかま　として　うれしいわ！\cほな　これからも　あずかりシステムの
けんきゅう　がんばってな\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥」
sourceRecords.english:
There's an e-mail from someone on
the PC.\c“... ... ... ... ... ... ...\c“Your Storage System offers more
convenience than mine.\c“It has a lot of user-friendly features
that make it fun and useful, too.\c“It makes me proud that I played
a part in its development.\c“Here's hoping that you'll continue
research in Storage Systems.\c“From BILL
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...”

sourceRecords.japanese:
あの　カナシダトンネル‥‥\cはじめは　たくさんの　にんげんと
さいしんの　キカイで　ほりすすんでいた\cだが　そのまま　ほりすすむと
あたりの　ポケモンにあくえいきょうを　あたえる　らしくてね\cで　おれら　どうしようもなく
ここで　ぼんやりと　しているわけさ
sourceRecords.english:
That RUSTURF TUNNEL there...\cAt first, we had a huge work crew boring
through rock with the latest machinery.But, we had to stop.\cIt turns out that we would have had
a negative effect on wild POKéMON inthe area.\cSo, we've got nothing to do but loll
around here doing nothing.

sourceRecords.japanese: どうしても　シダケに　いきたい\nやつが　じぶんの　ちから　だけで\rトンネルを　ほっているよ\cにんげんの　ちからで　すこしずつ　ほれば\nポケモンを　おどろかせなくて　すむし\rまわりの　しぜんにも　わるい　えいきょうを\rあたえないで　すむって　いってな
sourceRecords.english: There's a man digging his way to\nVERDANTURF all by his lonesome.\rHe's desperate to get through.\cHe says that if he digs little by little\nwithout using machines, he won't\rdisturb POKéMON, and he'll avoid harming\rthe natural environment.

sourceRecords.japanese: トンネルを　つかわずに　ここから\nシダケに　いくなら　うみを　わたり\rムロから　カイナ　そして\rキンセツを　とおって　いくしか　ないな！
sourceRecords.english: To get to VERDANTURF without using\nthis TUNNEL, you'd have to cross the\rsea to DEWFORD, sail on to SLATEPORT,\rthen travel through MAUVILLE.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんでも　シダケ　までの\nトンネルが　つうじた　らしいぞ！\cねがい　つづければ\nいつかは　かなう　って　ことなんだな！
sourceRecords.english: Did you hear? The TUNNEL to VERDANTURF\nhas gone through!\cSometimes, if you hope strongly enough,\ndreams do come true.

sourceRecords.japanese: ウヒョヒョ‥‥！\cこの　いんせきが　あれば\nえんとつやまが‥‥
ウヒョ？\cおまえが　だれだか　しらないが\nおれたち　[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　じゃまを　するなら\rようしゃは　しないぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Heh?\cI don't know who you are, but if you get\nin the way of TEAM [EVIL_TEAM], don't\rexpect any mercy!

sourceRecords.japanese: まてッ！\n[EVIL_TEAM]だん！\cおまえらの　あくじは\nわれわれ　[GOOD_TEAM]だんが　ゆるさん！
sourceRecords.english: Hold it right there, TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]!\cWe, TEAM [GOOD_TEAM], won't allow you to\nget away with your misdeeds!

sourceRecords.japanese:
ウヒョヒョ‥‥！
[GOOD_TEAM]だん　まで　やってきたのかよ！\cいちいち　あいてを　してやるのも
めんどうだな‥‥\cまあ　いいや！
いんせきは　てに　いれたしさっさと　えんとつやまに　いくか！\cウヒョヒョ！
あばよ！　まぬけな　[GOOD_TEAM]だん！
sourceRecords.english:
Hehehe!
Even TEAM [GOOD_TEAM] joins us!\cBut it's too much trouble to deal with
you all...\cHeh, it doesn't matter!\cWe've got the METEORITE, so off to
MT. CHIMNEY we go!\cHehehe! Be seeing you, you TEAM
[GOOD_TEAM] dingbats!

sourceRecords.japanese:
きみは‥‥？\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cそうか　[PLAYER][KUN]と　いうのか\cわたしは　マツブサ！
マグマだんを　ひきいて　アクアだんのやぼうを　そし　しているんだ！\cなぜなら　あいつら　アクアだんは
うみを　ふやす　といって\cはかいかつどうを　つづける
きけんな　しゅうだん　だからね‥‥\cだいちを　こよなく　あいする
われわれ　マグマだんの　てき　だよ！
sourceRecords.english:
And you are?\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cFine, so you are [PLAYER][KUN].\cI am MAXIE. As the head of TEAM MAGMA,
I have dedicated myself to thwartingthe dangerous plans of TEAM AQUA.\cWhy? Because TEAM AQUA is a grave
threat to us all.\cThey have committed many destructive
acts in their bid to enlarge the sea.\cWe, TEAM MAGMA, love dry land above
all! TEAM AQUA is our sworn enemy!

sourceRecords.japanese:
きみは‥‥？\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cそうか　[PLAYER][KUN]と　いうのか\cわたしは　アオギリ！
アクアだんを　ひきいて　マグマだんのやぼうを　そし　しているんだ！\cなぜなら　あいつら　マグマだんは
りくを　ふやす　といって\cはかいかつどうを　つづける
きけんな　しゅうだん　だからね‥‥\cうみを　こよなく　あいする
われわれ　アクアだんの　てき　だよ！
sourceRecords.english:
Who might you be?\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cAh, so you are [PLAYER][KUN].\cI am ARCHIE. As the head of TEAM AQUA,
I have dedicated myself to thwartingthe dangerous plans of TEAM MAGMA.\cWhy? Because TEAM MAGMA is a grave
threat to us all.\cThey have committed many destructive
acts in their bid to expand the land.\cWe, TEAM AQUA, love the sea above
all! TEAM MAGMA is our sworn enemy!

sourceRecords.japanese: [GOOD_LEADER]さま\nにげた　[EVIL_TEAM]だんを　おいかけないと‥‥
[GOOD_LEADER]『そうだな！\cいそがねば　[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　やつら\nえんとつやまで　なにを　するか　わからない！
sourceRecords.english: [GOOD_LEADER]: Yes, yes, we must!\nWe've got to hurry.\cThere's no telling what TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]\nwill do at MT. CHIMNEY!

sourceRecords.japanese: [GOOD_LEADER]『[PLAYER][KUN]　きみも\n[EVIL_TEAM]だんには　きを　つけたまえ！\cでは　さらばだ！
sourceRecords.english: [GOOD_LEADER]: [PLAYER][KUN], you should keep\nan eye out for TEAM [EVIL_TEAM], too.\cFarewell!

sourceRecords.japanese:
ぼく‥‥　ソライシ
いつもは　ハジツゲで　いんせきのけんきゅうを　している　はかせ　だけど‥‥\c[EVIL_TEAM]だん　という　れんちゅうが
「りゅうせいのたきに　あんない　しろ！」「いんせきを　とりだして　やるから」っていうから　ここに　つれてきたんだ‥‥\cだけど　ぼく‥‥
[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　だまされたよ‥‥\cああ‥‥　もう　あの　いんせき
ぼくの　モノには　ならないよな‥‥\cしかし　[EVIL_TEAM]だん‥‥
えんとつやまで　いんせきを　つかってなにを　するんだろう‥‥？
sourceRecords.english:
I... I'm COZMO...
I'm a PROFESSOR...\cI usually study METEORITES in
FALLARBOR TOWN...\cThen some people from TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]
made me guide them to METEOR FALLS...\cThey promised me that they would
excavate METEORITES for me...\cBut, I...
TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] tricked me...\cOh... That METEORITE...
It will never be mine now...\cBut that TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]...\cWhat are they going to do with that
METEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?

sourceRecords.japanese: ソライシ『[EVIL_TEAM]だん‥‥\nえんとつやまで　いんせきを　つかって\rなにを　するんだろう‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: PROF. COZMO: That TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]...\cWhat are they going to do with that\nMETEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　オレたち\nドラゴンつかいの　しゅぎょうの　ばしょ！\cチャンピオンも　くる　ばしょ　といったら\nその　すごさ　わかるだろうか！？
sourceRecords.english: This is where we DRAGON users do our\ntraining.\cThe CHAMPION even visits.\nNow do you see how special it is here?

sourceRecords.japanese: くっ！\nこれほど　つよいとは‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: Urgh!\nI didn't expect you to be so strong!

sourceRecords.japanese: まだまだ　みちは　ながく　けわしい\cオレと　オレの　ポケモンが\nいちばんに　なれるのは　いつだろう‥‥
sourceRecords.english: The road ahead remains long and harsh.\cWhen will my POKéMON and I become the\nbest?

sourceRecords.japanese: あれから　いちばん　めざして\nかなり　じぶんたちを　きたえた‥‥\cどれほど　つよくなったか\nきみで　たしかめさせて　もらおうッ！
sourceRecords.english: Since we met, we have trained hard\nwith our sights on number one.\cHelp us see how much stronger we've\nbecome!

sourceRecords.japanese: くっ！\nこれほど　つよいとは‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: Urgh!\nI didn't expect you to be so strong!

sourceRecords.japanese: あいかわらず　ポケモンを　きたえてるな\cきみが　その　つよさで　あるかぎり\nオレも　つよくなれるよ！
sourceRecords.english: You've obviously kept up your\nPOKéMON training.\cSo long as you remain strong, I, too,\ncan become stronger!

sourceRecords.japanese: ゲン『わしらは　いつも　ふうふで\nポケモンを　しておるからのう\rしょうぶにも　じしんが　あるんじゃよ
sourceRecords.english: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON\ntogether as a twosome.\rWe've confidence in ourselves.

sourceRecords.japanese: ゲン『おやおや\nまけたよ　ばあさん
sourceRecords.english: JOHN: Oh, my.\nWe've lost, dear wife.

sourceRecords.japanese: ゲン『けっこんして　５０ねん‥‥\nそういや　いちども　ばあさんに\rポケモンしょうぶで　かってないのう
sourceRecords.english: JOHN: We've been married for\nfifty years.\cCome to think of it, I've yet to beat\nmy dear wife in a battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: ゲン『おやおや\nわかい　トレーナー　じゃな！\cわしらと　しょうぶ　してくれるのなら\nポケモンを　もっと　つれてきなされ
sourceRecords.english: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!\cWill you battle with us? If so, you'll\nhave to return with more POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: ハツ『けっこんして　５０ねん‥‥\nわたしら　ふうふの　きずなは\rどんな　ものでも　きれませんよ
sourceRecords.english: JAY: We've been married for\nfifty years.\cThe bond we share as a couple could\nnever be broken.

sourceRecords.japanese: ハツ『おやおや\nまけましたよ　じいさん
sourceRecords.english: JAY: Oh, dear.\nWe've lost, my dear husband.

sourceRecords.japanese: ハツ『けっこんして　５０ねん‥‥\nふうふげんかに　なるたび\rポケモンしょうぶを　していましたねえ
sourceRecords.english: JAY: Fifty years of marriage...\cIf we ever argued, we always settled\nit with a POKéMON battle...

sourceRecords.japanese: ハツ『おやおや\nわかい　トレーナーさん　ですねえ\cわしらと　しょうぶ　してくれるのなら\nポケモンを　もっと　つれておいで
sourceRecords.english: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young\nTRAINER?\cIf you'd care to battle with us, you'll\nhave to come back with more POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: ゲン『わしらは　いつも　ふうふで\nポケモンを　たのしんでおる　からのう\rしょうぶにも　じしんが　あるんじゃよ
sourceRecords.english: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON\ntogether as a twosome.\rWe've confidence in ourselves.

sourceRecords.japanese: ゲン『おやおや\nまけたよ　ばあさん
sourceRecords.english: JOHN: Oh, my.\nWe've lost, dear wife.

sourceRecords.japanese: ゲン『けっこんして　５０ねん‥‥\nそういや　まいにち　まいにち\rばあさんと　しょうぶ　していたのう
sourceRecords.english: JOHN: Married for fifty years...\cOn reflection, the dear wife and I,\nwe battled day in and day out...

sourceRecords.japanese: ゲン『おやおや\nわかい　トレーナー　じゃな！\cわしらと　しょうぶ　してくれるのなら\nポケモンを　もっと　つれてきなされ
sourceRecords.english: JOHN: Well, well, what a young\nTRAINER!\cWill you battle with us? If so, you'll\nhave to return with more POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: ハツ『けっこんして　５０ねん‥‥\nおたがいを　ささえあってきた\rわたしら　ふうふは　つよいですよ
sourceRecords.english: JAY: We've been married for\nfifty years.\cWe've supported each other all that\ntime. We've made ourselves strong.

sourceRecords.japanese: ハツ『おやおや\nまけましたよ　じいさん
sourceRecords.english: JAY: Oh, dear.\nWe've lost, my dear husband.

sourceRecords.japanese: ハツ『けっこんして　５０ねん‥‥\nいろんなことが　ありましたねえ\cこれからも　じいさんと　いっしょに\nたのしいことが　つづくと　いいですわねえ
sourceRecords.english: JAY: Fifty years of marriage...\nMany things have happened.\cI hope that we will continue to make\nhappy memories together.

sourceRecords.japanese: ハツ『おやおや\nわかい　トレーナーさん　ですねえ\cわしらと　しょうぶ　してくれるのなら\nポケモンを　もっと　つれておいで
sourceRecords.english: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young\nTRAINER?\cIf you'd care to battle with us, you'll\nhave to come back with more POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: くるのか？\nくるなら　こいよ！
sourceRecords.english: What, are you coming?\nCome and get some, then!

sourceRecords.japanese: ピーコちゃん『ピ　ピひょー！

えーい　くっそー！\cうばった　ポケモンは
なんの　やくにも　たたないし\cいいところへ　にげこめたと　おもったのに
この　トンネル　いきどまり　じゃねーか！\cやい！　おまえ！
おれと　しょうぶ　するんだな！？
sourceRecords.english:
Grah, keelhaul it all!\cThat hostage POKéMON turned out to
be worthless!\cAnd to think I made a getaway...
In this tunnel to nowhere!\cHey! You!
So you want to battle me?

sourceRecords.japanese: む　むぐぐー！\nおれの　あくじも　いきどまりかっ！
sourceRecords.english: Urrrggh! My career in crime comes to\na dead end!

sourceRecords.japanese: おかしいなあ‥‥\cリーダーの　はなしでは　なにかの　にもつを\nデボンから　ぬすんでくる　っていう\rらくな　しごと　だった　はずなのに‥‥\cちぇっ！\nこんなもん　かえして　やらあ！
sourceRecords.english:
This is plain not right...\cThe BOSS told me this would be a
slick-and-easy job to pull.\cAll I had to do was steal some package
from DEVON.\cTch!
You want it back that badly, take it!

sourceRecords.japanese: ピーコちゃん！　ぶじで　よかった！
sourceRecords.english: PEEKO! Am I glad to see you're safe!

sourceRecords.japanese:
あんたは　ピーコちゃんの
いのちの　おんじん　じゃよ！\cわしは　ハギと　いうのじゃが
きみは‥‥？\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cそうか　[PLAYER][KUN]と　いうのか！
ほんとうに　ありがとうよ！\cこれからさき　こまった　ことが　あったら
えんりょなく　わしに　いっとくれ！\cいつもは　トウカのもりの　ちかくに　ある
はまべの　こやに　いるからの！\cさあ　ピーコちゃん
わしらの　おうちに　かえろうな！\cピーコちゃん『ピひょーっ！！
sourceRecords.english:
PEEKO owes her life to you!\cThey call me MR. BRINEY.
And, you are?\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cAh, so you are [PLAYER][KUN]!
I sincerely thank you!\cNow, if there's anything that troubles
you, don't hesitate to tell me!\cYou can usually find me in my cottage
by the sea near PETALBURG WOODS.\cCome, PEEKO, we should make our way
home.\cPEEKO: Pihyoh!

sourceRecords.japanese:
‥‥\cどうして　これいじょう　ほれない‥‥
この　いわが　かたすぎるのか？\cこのさきの　シダケタウンという　ところに
あいする　かのじょが　いるのに‥‥\cカナズミと　シダケを　トンネルで　むすべば
まいにち　かのじょに　あいに　いける\cそれなのに‥‥
おれは　どうすれば　いいんだ‥‥
sourceRecords.english:
... ...\cWhy can't they keep digging?
Is the bedrock too hard?\cMy beloved awaits me in VERDANTURF
TOWN just beyond here...\cIf RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF were
joined by this tunnel, I could visither every day...\cBut this...
What am I to do?

sourceRecords.japanese: カナズミから　シダケに　いこうと　すると\nムロから　カイナと　キンセツを　とおって\rいかなきゃ　ならないんだ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: To get from RUSTBORO to VERDANTURF,\nyou need to go to DEWFORD, then pass\rthrough SLATEPORT and MAUVILLE...

sourceRecords.japanese: なんと！　きみが　この　いわを\nくだいて　くれたんだね\cかんしゃの　しるし　として\nこの　ひでんマシンを　うけとってくれ
