sourceRecords.english: Wow! You shattered that boulder\nblocking the way.\cTo show you how much I appreciate it,\nI'd like you to have this HM.

sourceRecords.japanese: そいつには　かいりきが　はいっている\nちからもちの　ポケモンに　おぼえさせれば\rおおきな　いわを　うごかせるよ
sourceRecords.english: That HM contains STRENGTH.\cIf a muscular POKéMON were to learn\nthat, it would be able to move even\rlarge boulders.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミチルさん！\nこれから　いつでも　あえます！\cミチル『よかった‥‥　です\cさあ　わたしの　いえで\nゆっくり　やすんで　ください
sourceRecords.english: WANDA!\nNow I can see you anytime!\cWANDA: That's...wonderful.\cPlease, take some rest at my home.

sourceRecords.japanese:
この　いわの　むこうに‥‥
わたしの　かれが　いるの\cかれ‥‥　わたしに　あうため　だけに
トンネルを　ほってるわけ　じゃないわ\cみんなの　ために
てを　きずつけながらも　がんばってるの
sourceRecords.english:
On the other side of this rock...
My boyfriend is there.\cHe... He's not just digging the tunnel
to come see me.\cHe works his hands raw and rough
for the benefit of everyone.

sourceRecords.japanese: おとこが　やまに　いるから　やまおとこ！\cなのに　ポケモンが　やまに　いても\nやまポケモンと　いわないのは　なぜだ？
sourceRecords.english: What do you call a wild man up in the\nmountains? A mountain man, right?\cSo why don't they call a POKéMON in the\nmountains a mountain POKéMON?

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモン‥‥\nちから　つきた‥‥
ここって　ポケモンを　まもるため\nかいはつ　こうじを　やめたんだろ？\rそれって　いい　はなし　だよな
sourceRecords.english: They halted development here to\nprotect POKéMON, right?\rThere's a feel-good story!

sourceRecords.japanese:
おい　おまえ
このさきは　くらいからたんけん　するのも　たいへん　だぞ！\cさっきの　おとこ‥‥
ダイゴって　いったっけか？\cあいつは　フラッシュが　つかえたから
だいじょうぶ　だろうが‥‥\cうむ！　やまおとこは　であった
あいてに　やさしく　するのが　モットー！これを　ゆずってやると　するか！
sourceRecords.english:
Hey, you.
It gets awfully dark ahead.It'll be tough trying to explore.\cThat guy who came by earlier...
STEVEN, I think it was.\cHe knew how to use FLASH, so he ought
to be all right, but...\cWell, for us HIKERS, helping out those
that we meet is our motto.\cHere you go, I'll pass this on to you.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ひでん　フラッシュを
ポケモンに　おぼえさせて　つかうとだな\cまっくらな　どうくつも
あかるく　てらせるんだぞ！\cまあ　つかうには　ムロ　ポケモンジムの
ジムバッジが　ひつよう　だがな
sourceRecords.english:
Teach that hidden move FLASH to a
POKéMON and use it.\cIt lights up even the inky darkness
of caves.\cBut, to use it, you need the GYM BADGE
from DEWFORD's POKéMON GYM.

sourceRecords.japanese:
きみの　それ‥‥
ポケナビ　じゃないか\cたしか　ポケナビを　もっている
トレーナーどうしで　しょうぶを　するときろく　されて　いくんだよね\cしつれい
ボクの　なまえは　ダイゴ\cめずらしい　いしに　きょうみが　あって
あちこち　たび　してるんだよ\cえっ？
ボクに　てがみ‥‥？
sourceRecords.english:
That device you have there...
It's a POKéNAV.\cWhen TRAINERS that have POKéNAVS
battle, it keeps a record of howthings went, I think.\cOh, pardon me.
My name is STEVEN.\cI'm interested in rare stones, so
I travel here and there.\cOh?
A LETTER for me?

sourceRecords.japanese:
ダイゴ『うん　ありがとう\cわざわざ　とどけて　くれたんだ
なにか　おれいを　させてもらうよ\cそうだね
この　わざマシンを　あげよう\cはがねのつばさ　といって
ボクの　おきにいりの　わざ　だから
sourceRecords.english:
STEVEN: Okay, thank you.\cYou went through all this trouble to
deliver that. I need to thank you.\cLet me see...
I'll give you this TM.\cIt contains my favorite move,
STEEL WING.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ダイゴ『きみの　ポケモン
なかなか　いい　かんじ　だね\cしゅぎょうを　つづければ
いつかは　ポケモンリーグのチャンピオンに　だって　なれるボクは　そう　おもうな\c‥‥じゃあ
ボクは　さきを　いそぐから
sourceRecords.english: STEVEN: Your POKéMON appear quite\ncapable.\cIf you keep training, you could even\nbecome the CHAMPION of the POKéMON\rLEAGUE one day. That's what I think.\cNow, I've got to hurry along.

sourceRecords.japanese: バッグが　いっぱい　なのか‥‥\nじゃあ　しかたないね
sourceRecords.english: Oh, your BAG is full...\nThat's too bad, then.

sourceRecords.japanese: うーん\nいないなあ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Hmmm...\nNot a one to be found...

sourceRecords.japanese: ねえ　きみきみ　このあたりで\nキノココって　ポケモン　みなかった？\cおじさん　あの　ポケモン　すき　なのよね
sourceRecords.english: Hello, have you seen any POKéMON\ncalled SHROOMISH around here?\cI really love that POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: まちぶせ　していたのに\nいつまでも　トウカのもりで　うろうろと‥‥\cまちくたびれたから　きてやったぞ！
sourceRecords.english: I was going to ambush you, but you\nhad to dawdle in PETALBURG WOODS\rforever, didn't you?\cI got sick of waiting, so here I am!

sourceRecords.japanese: やい！　デボンの　けんきゅういん！\cその　しょるいを　こっちに　よこしやがれ！
sourceRecords.english: You! DEVON RESEARCHER!\cHand over those papers!

sourceRecords.japanese: ひやー！\cきみ　ポケモントレーナー　だよね\nおじさんを　たすけてよぉ
sourceRecords.english: Aiyeeeh!\cYou're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?\nYou've got to help me, please!

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥ん？　なんだ　おまえ？\nそいつを　かばおう　ってのか？\c[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　じゃまを　する　やつは\nこどもでも　ようしゃ　しねえ！\rしょうぶ　しやがれ！
sourceRecords.english: Hunh? What do you think you're doing?\nWhat, you're going to protect him?\cNo one who crosses TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]\ngets any mercy, not even a kid!\cCome on and battle me!

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥つ　つよい　じゃねーか！

むむむ‥‥　[EVIL_TEAM]だんの
じゃまを　するとは　なんて　やつ！もう　いっかい　しょうぶ　しろ！\c‥‥と　いいたい　ところ　だが
もう　てもちの　ポケモンは　いない\cそれに　カナズミ　シティにも　[EVIL_TEAM]だんが
ねらっている　ものが　あるからな！\cきょうは　これぐらいに　しといてやらぁ！
sourceRecords.english:
Grrr... You've got some nerve
meddling with TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]!Come on and battle me again!\cI wish I could say that, but I'm out of
POKéMON...\cAnd, hey, we of TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] are also
after something in RUSTBORO.\cI'll let you go today!

sourceRecords.japanese:
‥‥ふぅ
あぶない　ところ　だった！\cきみの　おかげで　だいじな　しょるいを
うばわれないで　すんだよ！\c‥‥そうだ！　おれいに
スーパーボールを　あげちゃおう！
sourceRecords.english:
Whew...
That was awfully close!\cThanks to you, he didn't rob me of
these important papers.\cI know, I'll give you a GREAT BALL as
my thanks!

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥そういえば　さっき　[EVIL_TEAM]だんは\n「カナズミにも　ねらっている　ものがある」\rとか　いってたよね‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: Didn't that TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] thug say\nthey were after something in\rRUSTBORO, too?

sourceRecords.japanese: たいへんだ！！\nこうしちゃ　いられない！
sourceRecords.english: Uh-oh! It's a crisis!\nI can't be wasting time!

sourceRecords.japanese: どうぐ　いっぱいで\nスーパーボール　あげられないね
sourceRecords.english: You're loaded with items.\nI can't give you this GREAT BALL.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモン　いっぱい　つかまえた！\cそら　いけ！\nぼくの　むしポケモン　チーム！
sourceRecords.english: I caught a whole bunch of POKéMON!\cGo, go, go!\nMy BUG POKéMON team!

sourceRecords.japanese: こんなに　ポケモン　いるのに\nかてなかったのか‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I have all these POKéMON, but I\ncouldn't win...

sourceRecords.japanese: たくさん　ポケモン　つかまえたら\nモンスターボール　なくなっちゃったよ
sourceRecords.english: I caught a bunch of POKéMON.\nNow I'm out of POKé BALLS.

sourceRecords.japanese: むしポケモンを　がっこうに　もっていくと\nそれだけで　にんきもの　だろ！？
sourceRecords.english: If you take BUG POKéMON to school,\nyou get to be instantly popular!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけると　にんきものに　なれないや
sourceRecords.english: I can't be popular if I lose.

sourceRecords.japanese: でかい　むしポケモン　もってると\nそれだけで　そんけー　されるだろ！？
sourceRecords.english: If you have a big BUG POKéMON, people\nrespect you for it.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくの　むしポケモン　そだったぞ！\nこれで　また　にんきもの　だぜ！
sourceRecords.english: My BUG POKéMON have grown.\nI'll be popular again.

sourceRecords.japanese: まけると　にんきものに　なれないや
sourceRecords.english: I can't be popular if I lose.

sourceRecords.japanese: つよい　ポケモン　もってると\nにんきものに　なれるだろ？\rだから　がんばって　そだててるのさ！
sourceRecords.english: You get to be popular if you have\nstrong POKéMON, right?\rSo, I've been training hard.

sourceRecords.japanese: よお！　おまえの　ポケモン　げんき？\cてもちの　ポケモンが　よわっていて\nたたかわせたく　ないときは　なるべく\rくさむらを　よけて　あるくと　いいよ！
sourceRecords.english: Yo, there!\nYour POKéMON doing okay?\cIf your POKéMON are weak and you want\nto avoid battles, you should stay out\rof tall grass.

sourceRecords.japanese: みえて　いなくても\nどうぐが　おちてることが　あるから\rあしもとを　しらべて　いるんだ！
sourceRecords.english: Sometimes, there are things on the\nground even if you can't see them.\cThat's why I always check where I'm\nwalking.

sourceRecords.japanese: それって　カナズミの　ジムバッジ！\cあなた　トレーナーなのね\nこの　どうぐ　つかってみたら　どうかしら？
sourceRecords.english: Oh, neat!\nThat's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!\cYou must be a TRAINER.\nYou should try using this item.

sourceRecords.japanese: きせきのタネを\nポケモンに　もたせてあげると　くさタイプの\rわざの　いりょくが　あがるのよ\cきせきのタネの　ほかにも\nポケモンに　もたせると　べんりな\rどうぐが　あるらしいわね
sourceRecords.english: It's a MIRACLE SEED.\nIf a POKéMON holds that item, its\rGRASS-type moves become stronger.\cBesides MIRACLE SEED, I think there are\nother convenient items for POKéMON\rto hold.

sourceRecords.japanese: おとくな　けいじばん！！\cしょうぶの　とき\nいちど　でも　かおをだした　ポケモンは\rけいけんちが　もらえます！\cよわい　ポケモンを　リストの　うえに　して\nしょうぶのとき　すぐに　こうたい！\rこれで　よわい　ポケモンも　そだちます！
sourceRecords.english:
TRAINER TIPS\cAny POKéMON that appears even once
in a battle is awarded EXP Points.\cTo raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the
top of the team list.\cAs soon as a battle starts, switch it
out. It will earn EXP Points withoutbeing exposed to any harm.

sourceRecords.japanese: おとくな　けいじばん！！\cポケモンには　ヒットポイントの　ほかに\nわざを　くりだす　ちからの　もと\rパワーポイント　というものが　あります\cわざの　パワーポイントが　なくなったときも\nポケモンセンターに　いきましょう！
sourceRecords.english: TRAINER TIPS\cIn addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON\nhave Power Points (PP) that are used to\rmake moves during battle.\cIf a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be\ntaken to a POKéMON CENTER.

sourceRecords.japanese: えんとつやま　めいぶつ\nフエンせんべい　ひとつ　２００えん！\rかって　おいきよ
sourceRecords.english: LAVA COOKIES are MT. CHIMNEY's local\nspecialty.\cTry one. It's just $200.

sourceRecords.japanese: どうも　ありがとね
おやまあ　おかねが　なくちゃ\nものは　かえないよ
sourceRecords.english: Oh, dear. You can't buy a thing if\nyou've not got the money.

sourceRecords.japanese: あら　そうかい
なぞの　そうちに\nいんせきが　はめられている‥‥\cなにかの　エネルギーを\nためている　さいちゅうの　ようだ
sourceRecords.english: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine...\cThe machine seems to be storing\nenergy in the METEORITE.

sourceRecords.japanese: なぞの　そうちに\nいんせきが　はめられている‥‥\cいんせきを　とりますか？
sourceRecords.english: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine...\cDo you want to remove the METEORITE?

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　いんせきを\nそうちから　とりはずした！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] removed the METEORITE from\nthe mysterious machine.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　いんせきを\nそのままに　しておいた
なぞの　そうち‥‥\nまったく　はんのう　しない‥‥
sourceRecords.english: This mysterious machine...\nIt makes no response whatsoever.

sourceRecords.japanese: [DOWN_ARROW]　デコボコさんどう\nとおりぬけると　フエンタウン
おんせんに　つかって\nリフレッシュ　してきたからねえ\rいまの　あたしゃあ　つよいよ！
sourceRecords.english: I've been to the hot springs and\nrefreshed my tired bones.\rRight now I'm feeling strong!

sourceRecords.japanese: おんや　まぁ\nたいした　もんだよ
sourceRecords.english: Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren't you something!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけて　しもうたか\nこれじゃあ　たつじん　とは　いえないねえ
sourceRecords.english: Well, well, I've lost. I can't call\nmyself an EXPERT now, can I?

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンと　こころを　ひとつに　できれば\nすばらしいことが　できそうじゃの
sourceRecords.english: If you can mesh your heart with those\nof your POKéMON, why, you should be\rable to achieve great things.

sourceRecords.japanese: おんや　まぁ\nたいした　もんだよ
sourceRecords.english: Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren't you something!

sourceRecords.japanese: おまえさんの　こころと\nポケモンの　こころは　ひとつ　なのかもな
sourceRecords.english: Perhaps your heart has become one\nwith the hearts of your POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんだか　もえあがってきて\nたたかいたくて　たまらないのっ！
sourceRecords.english: I've got the fire in me, baby.\nI can't stand it! I have to battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: あつい　たたかい　だったわ
sourceRecords.english: Ooh, that was a scorching-hot match!

sourceRecords.japanese: えんとつやまの　あつさが\nおんなを　もえあがらせるの
sourceRecords.english: The heat of MT. CHIMNEY lights my\nfire, baby!

sourceRecords.japanese: せっかく　えんとつやまに　きたんだから\nここでも　ポケモンを　たたかわせたいの！
sourceRecords.english: I've finally made it to MT. CHIMNEY.\nI want to make my POKéMON battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: その　たたかいかた\nまさに　えんとつやま　だいふんか！
sourceRecords.english: The way you battle...\nIt's like a MT. CHIMNEY eruption!

sourceRecords.japanese: せっかく　えんとつやまに　きたんだから\nかんこう　だけじゃ　もったいないわ\cしょうぶも　たのしみたいし\nおみやげに　せんべい　かわなきゃ！
sourceRecords.english: Like I said, I've finally made it to\nMT. CHIMNEY. It would be a shame if\rI only do a little sightseeing...\cI want to get in some battles and buy\nCOOKIES as souvenirs.

sourceRecords.japanese: おんせんに　はいったら\nちょうし　バッチリ　なのよね！\rぜったい　かてるわ！
sourceRecords.english: Since I bathed in the hot springs,\nI've been feeling great!\rI'm sure I'm going to win!

sourceRecords.japanese: うーん　ゆざめ　しちゃう
sourceRecords.english: Yowch!\nI'm getting a chill out of the water.

sourceRecords.japanese: もういちど　おんせんに　はいらなきゃ！\nあなたも　いっしょに　はいる？\cなんてねっ！
sourceRecords.english: I'll have to take another dip in the\nhot springs. Want to join me?\cJust joking!

sourceRecords.japanese: えんとつやまの　デコボコさんどう\nまさに　わたしが　もとめていた　やま！\rこの　デコボコした　ところが　たまらん！
sourceRecords.english: MT. CHIMNEY's JAGGED PASS...\cNow this is what I've always wanted\nin a mountain.\cThis jagged bumpiness...\nIt rocks my soul!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけて　くやしいぞ！
たしかに　ポケモンでは　まけた‥‥\cだが　やまを　あいする　きもちなら\nわたしの　ほうが　まさっているだろ！
sourceRecords.english: Yes, I did lose at POKéMON...\cBut, when it comes to the love of\nthe mountains, I have you beat!

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　きがるに　のぼって　いけないもの\nちょっと　ピクニックむき　じゃないわ
sourceRecords.english: This place isn't your casual hike.\nIt's not suited for a picnic.

sourceRecords.japanese: あーん　もう！\nしたが　デコボコだから‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Ohhh, no!\nThe ground is too bumpy...

sourceRecords.japanese: こんな　デコボコしたところ\nじてんしゃで　じょうずに　のぼっていく\rひとも　いるのよ！
sourceRecords.english: Did you know?\cSome people cleverly ride their\nbicycles up this horribly bumpy pass.

sourceRecords.japanese: どんな　みちも　ピクニックは　たのしい！\nポケモンも　いっしょ　だしね！
sourceRecords.english: Picnics are fun wherever you go.\nJust like POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけたのは\nしたが　デコボコだからよ！
sourceRecords.english: I only lost because the ground is\ntoo bumpy!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけたことは　さっさと　わすれて\nこの　デコボコみちを　たのしんじゃお！
sourceRecords.english: I'll forget about losing and just\nenjoy this bumpy hike.

sourceRecords.japanese: この　デコボコさんどうは　あるきにくい！\nポケモンを　きたえるのに　むいてるよ！
sourceRecords.english: JAGGED PASS is hard to walk on.\nIt's a good place for training.

sourceRecords.japanese: あしばを　きにしてる　うちに\nおわっちゃった　かんじだ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: It was all over while we were still\ntrying to find a good footing...

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくも　ダートじてんしゃ　もっていれば\nだんさを　とびこえて　いけるのにな
sourceRecords.english: If I had an ACRO BIKE, I'd be able to\njump ledges.

sourceRecords.japanese: デコボコに　なれちゃったから\nちかごろだと　うたいながら　のぼるのさ！
sourceRecords.english: I got used to this bumpiness.\nI sing while I climb now.

sourceRecords.japanese: やっぱり　デコボコだと\nたたかいにくいよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: It's still not easy to battle on this\nbumpy ground...

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくも　キンセツで　カゼノさんから\nダートじてんしゃ　もらおうかな
sourceRecords.english: I should get an ACRO BIKE from RYDEL\nin MAUVILLE CITY...

sourceRecords.japanese: この　おくりびやま　には\nいろんな　ものが　さまよっておる‥‥\cなにが　おきるか　わからん\nねんのため　これを　もっていきなされ
sourceRecords.english: All sorts of beings wander the slopes\nof MT. PYRE...\cThere is no telling what may happen.\nTake this. It's for your own good.

sourceRecords.japanese: きよめのおふだ　をな\nポケモンに　もたせて　おく\cすると　やせいの　ポケモンが\nあんまり　とびだして　こなくなるぞよ
sourceRecords.english: Have a POKéMON hold that\nCLEANSE TAG.\cIt will help ward off wild POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたも　おはか　まいりに　きたの？\nずいぶんと　ポケモン　おもい　なのね
sourceRecords.english: Did you come to pay your respect\nto the spirits of departed POKéMON?\cYou must care for your POKéMON a lot.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここには　ぼくが　たいせつに　していた\nジグザグマが　やすらかに　ねむってる‥‥
sourceRecords.english: This is the final resting place of my\nZIGZAGOON. I cherished it...

sourceRecords.japanese: テル『きもだめし　するんだ！\nぼくの　かっこいい　ところ　みれば\rかのじょ　もっと　ほれるからね！\cそうだ！　きみを　たおして\nかっこいい　ところ　みせちゃおう！
sourceRecords.english: LUKE: We're here on a dare.\cHeheh, if I show her how cool I am,\nshe'll fall for me. I know it!\cI know! I'll cream you and show her\nhow cool I am!

sourceRecords.japanese: テル『あっちゃー
テル『まけちゃったけど　だいじょうぶ！\nぼくが　いるからさ\rきもだめし　なんて　へっちゃら　だよ！
sourceRecords.english: LUKE: Well, we lost but that's okay!\nI'm right here by your side.\rWe'll make it through this dare!

sourceRecords.japanese: テル『ぼくと　しょうぶ　するなら\nもっと　ポケモン　つれてきなよ！\cそうでないと　ぼく　かのじょの　まえで\nかっこいい　ところ　みせちゃうからさ！
sourceRecords.english: LUKE: If you want to take me on, bring\nsome more POKéMON.\cIf you don't, I won't be able to show\noff how cool I am to my girl!

sourceRecords.japanese: マコ『かれしと　きもだめしに　きたの\nすっごく　こわいけど\rかれしが　いるから　だいじょうぶ！\cそうだ！　あなたを　たおす\nかれしの　かっこいい　ところ　みせちゃう！
sourceRecords.english:
DEZ: I came here on a dare with my
boyfriend.\cIt's really scary, but I'm with my
boyfriend. It's okay.\cI know! I'll get my boyfriend to look
cool by beating you!

sourceRecords.japanese: マコ『あーん　こわーい！
マコ『あたしたち　ラブラブだから\nまけても　へいき　なんだもん！
sourceRecords.english: DEZ: We're lovey-dovey, so we don't\ncare if we lose!

sourceRecords.japanese: マコ『あたしたちと　たたかいたいなら\nせめて　２ひきは　ポケモン　いないと\cあたしの　かれし　つよいんだから\nいっぴきじゃ　はなしに　ならないわ
sourceRecords.english: DEZ: If you want to challenge us, you\nshould bring at least two POKéMON.\cMy boyfriend's strong.\nJust one POKéMON won't do at all.

sourceRecords.japanese: かわいかった　エネコとの　おもいで‥‥\nおもいだすだけで　なみだが　あふれる‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Memories of my darling SKITTY...\nMy eyes overflow thinking about it.

sourceRecords.japanese: アイタタタ‥‥　ゆかの　そこかしこに\nあなが　あいているのに　きづかないで\rおじさん　うえから　おちてしまったよ
sourceRecords.english: Ooch, ouch... There are holes in the\nground here and there.\cI didn't notice and took a tumble from\nthe floor above.

sourceRecords.japanese: おまえも　ポケモン　さがしに　きたのか？\nあとから　きた　くせに　なまいきだ！
sourceRecords.english: Hey! Are you searching for POKéMON?\nYou came along after me! You're rude!

sourceRecords.japanese: ふええええええっ！\nゆるして　くださいーっ！
めったに　ひとが　はいらない　やま　だから\nめずらしい　ポケモンが　いると　おもってさ
sourceRecords.english: People don't come here often, so\nI thought there'd be rare POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: れいげん　あらたかな　やまの　ちからで\nサイコパワーの　アップした　わたしに\rこどもの　おまえが　かてるかな！？
sourceRecords.english: The rich atmosphere of the mountain\nhas elevated my psychic power!\cA mere child like you...\nYou dream of winning?

sourceRecords.japanese: アップ　アップ‥‥
わたしの　サイコパワーは　かくじつに\nつよく　なっている　はずなのに‥‥
sourceRecords.english: My psychic powers have surely\ngrown several times, but...

sourceRecords.japanese: おほほほほっ！\cここは　あなたの　ような　こどもが\nくる　ばしょ　では　ないのよっ！
sourceRecords.english: Ahahahaha!\cThis is no place for children, least\nof all you!

sourceRecords.japanese: あっさり　まけたわっ‥‥！
まだまだ　しゅぎょうが　たりないのね‥‥\nさんちょうを　めざすわよ‥‥！\cファイト！　わたし！
sourceRecords.english: This means my training is still not\nenough...\cI've got to keep working toward the\nsummit...\cGo, me!

sourceRecords.japanese: おししょうさま‥‥\nいまの　わたしの　じつりょく\rみていて　ください！
おししょうさま‥‥\nすんません‥‥
もっと　つよくならないと\nここに　ねむる　おししょうさまも\rあんしん　できないよな‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Until I improve, my teacher, who rests\nhere, will never find true peace...

sourceRecords.japanese: こわいものが　すきで‥‥\nすきで　すきで　たまらない‥‥\cあたし　ここに　いると\nこわくて　ふるえるの‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I love all things horrifying...\nIt's like a disease...\cWhen I'm here...\nI shiver with fear...

sourceRecords.japanese: まけるのは　きらい‥‥
こわいもの　みたさで\nここから　はなれられないの‥‥\cねえ‥‥\nあなたも　いっしょに　いない‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: I want to see dreadful things...\nI can't leave...\cStay...\nWon't you stay with me?

sourceRecords.japanese: ここに　いると‥‥\nなにかの　ちからが　はいってくるの‥‥
sourceRecords.english: When I'm here...\nA curious power flows into me...

sourceRecords.japanese: ちからが　ぬけていく‥‥
ここに　ねむっている　ポケモンたちの\nちからが　はいって　くるのかもよ‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: Perhaps the power is from the spirits\nof POKéMON in fitful sleep here...

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたの　うしろ‥‥\nなにが　いるの‥‥？
なにかが　きえたわ‥‥
ここに　ねむっている　ポケモンたち‥‥\nときどき　あそんでいる　みたいなの‥‥
sourceRecords.english: The POKéMON at rest here...\nSometimes, they play...

sourceRecords.japanese:
なんだ　なんだ！
おれたち　[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　なんの　ようだ！\cリーダーだったら　いま　だいじな　ものを
ぶんどりに　でかけていて　るすだぞ！\c‥‥どこに　いったのか　だって？\cわはははっ！　そんな　だいじな　ことを
おしえられる　わけ　ないだろうが！
sourceRecords.english:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]?\cOur BOSS isn't here! He's gone off to
snatch something important!\c... ...
Where did he go?\cWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?

sourceRecords.japanese:
なんだ　なんだ！
おれたち　[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　なんの　ようだ！\cリーダーだったら　いま　せんすいていを
ぶんどりに　でかけていて　るすだぞ！\c‥‥どこに　いったのか　だって？\cわはははっ！　そんな　だいじな　ことを
おしえられる　わけ　ないだろうが！
sourceRecords.english:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]?\cOur BOSS isn't here!
He's gone off to jack a submarine!\c... ...
Where did he go?\cWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?

sourceRecords.japanese:
なんだ　なんだ！
おれたち　[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　なんの　ようだ！\cリーダーは　いま　１２２ばん　すいどうの
おくりびやまに　むかっていて　るすだぞ！\c‥‥なにしに　いったのか　だって？\cわはははっ！　そんな　だいじな　ことを
おしえられる　わけ　ないだろうが！
sourceRecords.english:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]?\cOur BOSS isn't here! He's on his way to
MT. PYRE on ROUTE 122!\c... ...
Why did he go?\cWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?

sourceRecords.japanese:
なんだ　なんだ！
おれたち　[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　なんの　ようだ！\cリーダーは　いま　カイナシティに
むかっていて　るすだぞ！\c‥‥なにしに　いったのか　だって？\cわはははっ！　そんな　だいじな　ことを
おしえられる　わけ　ないだろうが！
sourceRecords.english:
What? What? What do you want with
TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]?\cOur BOSS isn't here!
He's on his way to SLATEPORT CITY!\c... ...
Why did he go?\cWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?

sourceRecords.japanese: ややや！\nあやしい　じんぶつを　はっけーん！
うーむ　まけちまったかー！
しょうぶには　まけたが\nおれは　やくめを　はたしたのだ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I took the loss for the TEAM, but\nI did my job...

sourceRecords.japanese: アジトの　ひみつを　しりたけりゃ\nおれを　たおす　ことだな！
sourceRecords.english: If you want to know the secret about\nour HIDEOUT, you have me to beat!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぜんぜん　かてません‥‥！
アジトの　ひみつ？\cそれはな‥‥　いちばん　おくに\nせんすいていが　あるって　ことよ！\cだが　いまごろは　いひひひ‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: Our HIDEOUT's secret?\cWell, let's just say...\nThere's a submarine at the far end!\cBut, by now...\nKekekeke...

sourceRecords.japanese: ねんりょうの　ほきゅう　オッケイ！\nおやつも　ほきゅう　オッケイ！\cあとは　ジャマものを　ぶっとばす　だけ！
sourceRecords.english: Fuel supply loaded A-OK!\nIn-cruise snacks loaded A-OK!\cNothing left to do but KO a pesky\nmeddler!

sourceRecords.japanese: こっぴどく　やられたーっ！
ふん！　これで　いいんだ\cおまえの　ジャマをする　というのが\nおれの　にんむ　だったのさ
sourceRecords.english: Humph!\nThis was supposed to happen!\cMy mission was to just hold you up!

sourceRecords.japanese: はーあ　アジトで　るすばんも\nたいくつ　だから　あいて　してあげるわー
sourceRecords.english: Yawn... Keeping watch over the\nHIDEOUT bores me. I'll take you on.

sourceRecords.japanese: はーあ　まけたわー
あんまり　うろちょろ　してると\nほかの　[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　やられるかもよー
sourceRecords.english: If you scurry too much, other TEAM\n[EVIL_TEAM] members might get you.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ウヒョヒョ‥‥\cもう　ここまで　きたのか！
おもって　いたより　やるな！\cだが　ここまでだ！
おれは　これまでの　したっぱども　とはひとあじ　ちがう！\cじかんかせぎ　なんか　しねえで
おまえを　コテンパンに　してやるぜ！
sourceRecords.english:
Hehehe...\cGot here already, did you?
We underestimated you!\cBut this is it!\cI'm a cut above the GRUNTS you've seen
so far.\cI'm not stalling for time. I'm going
to pulverize you!

sourceRecords.japanese: ウヒョヒョ‥‥\nまけちまったか‥‥
ウヒョヒョ‥‥！\cおれが　おまえと\nあそんで　やっている　あいだに\rリーダーの　じゅんびが　ととのったぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Hehehe!\cWhile I was toying with you, our BOSS\ngot through his preparations!

sourceRecords.japanese:
ウヒョヒョ‥‥！\cリーダーは　どこかの　かいていにある
どうくつへ　しゅっぱつ　したぜ！\cおいかける　つもりなら　ミナモの　さきに
ひろがる　でっかい　うみをさがしまわって　みるが　いいぜ！\cそれで　みつかれば　いいけどな‥‥
ウヒョヒョヒョ！
sourceRecords.english:
Hehehe!\cOur BOSS has already gone on his way to
some cave under the sea!\cIf you're going to give chase, you'd
better search the big, wide sea beyondLILYCOVE.\cBut will you find it then?
Hehehe!

sourceRecords.japanese: わっはっは　まちくたびれたぞ！\nおいらとも　しょうぶ　してもらおうか！
sourceRecords.english: Wahahah, I grew weary of waiting!\nYou owe me a battle, too!

sourceRecords.japanese: まちくたびれて\nまけて　やぶれて‥‥
リーダーぁ‥‥\nこんなもんで　どうでしょー！
アジト　じまんの　ワープパネル！\cいま　じぶんが　どこに　いるのか\nわかって　ないでしょ！\cそうやって　つかれはてた　あいてを\nたおすのが　さくせん　なのよ！
sourceRecords.english:
Warp panels, the HIDEOUT's pride
and joy!\cYou're clueless about where you are,
aren't you?\cFluster and tire out the enemy, then
lower the boom! That's our plan!

sourceRecords.japanese: なによっ！\nちっとも　つかれてない　じゃない！
sourceRecords.english: What's wrong with you?\nYou're not tired at all!

sourceRecords.japanese: そういえば‥‥　マスターボールを\nどこに　おいたのか　わすれちゃったわ\cあれを　まもっていないと\nリーダーに　おこられるのよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: That reminds me... I can't remember\nwhere I put the MASTER BALL.\cIf I fail to guard it, our BOSS will\nchew me out...

sourceRecords.japanese:
せんすいてい　には
「かいえん　１ごう」と　かかれている\c[EVIL_TEAM]だんが　カイナから
うばって　いった　せんすいてい　だ！\c[EVIL_TEAM]だんは
ここから　うえに　あがったみたいだ
sourceRecords.english:
“SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1” is painted
on the hull.\cThis is the submarine TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]
stole in SLATEPORT!\cTEAM [EVIL_TEAM] must have gone
ashore here.

sourceRecords.japanese: こどもに　ようは　ねーんだ\nほら　さっさと　かえれよ！
sourceRecords.english: We don't need a kid around!\nGo on home already!

sourceRecords.japanese: おれが　かえりたいよー！
はやく　かんぶに　なって\nしたっぱを　しごいて　やりたい‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I want to get a promotion so I can\nboss around the GRUNTS...

sourceRecords.japanese: せんすいてい　ちっちゃいからよー\nからだの　あちこちが　いたい　じゃねーか！
sourceRecords.english: That submarine... It's tiny inside.\nI'm sore all over!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけたら\nいたい　じゃねーか！
うばった　せんすいていの　のりごこち\nありゃ　さいあく　だな！\rとにかく　せますぎ　じゃねーか！
sourceRecords.english: That submarine we jacked, man, it's\nbrutal as a ride.\rIt's way too tight in there!

sourceRecords.japanese:
オーッホッホ！\cせんすいていも　ないのに
よく　ここまで　おいかけて　きたわね！たいした　おこさま　だわ！\cでもね‥‥
ジャマされると　めんどう　なのよね\cてんき　けんきゅうじょ　での
かりも　かえしたいし‥‥\cちょっと　いたい　おもい　させちゃうから
かくご　しなさーい！！
sourceRecords.english:
Ahahahaha!\cHow did you manage to get here without
a submarine?What an impressive child!\cBut... It won't do to have you
meddling about here.\cAnd, I do want payback for what
happened at the WEATHER INSTITUTE...\cI'm going to give you a little taste
of pain! Resign yourself to it!

sourceRecords.japanese: オーッホッホ！\cいったーい！
オーッホッホ！\cあなた　そんなに　つよいんだもの\n[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　なかま　じゃなくて\rとっても　ざんねんだわ\cリーダーが　じつげん　してくれる\nすばらしい　せかいを\rいっしょに　たのしむことが　できたのに
sourceRecords.english:
Ahahahaha!
You're so darn strong.\cIt's terribly disappointing that you're
not a TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] member.\cYou could have enjoyed the fabulous
world our BOSS has promised to oneof our own...

sourceRecords.japanese: だれだ　おまえ？\nどこから　はいってきた？
sourceRecords.english: Who are you?\nWhere did you come in from?

sourceRecords.japanese: まけた‥‥！
でぐちが　わかんねーんだよ\cこわがってる　わけじゃ　ねーぞ\nかんちがい　すんなよ！
sourceRecords.english: I can't find the way out!\cI'm not afraid. Don't get me wrong!

sourceRecords.japanese:
ミツル『あっ！　[PLAYER]さん！\cぼくが　こんな　ところに　いるなんて
おどろいた　でしょ！\cぼくが　ここまで　これたのは
[PLAYER]さんの　おかげだよ！\cあのとき　[PLAYER]さんに　まけたから
ぼくは　つよく　なれたんだ！\c‥‥だけど！
ぼくは　もう　まけない\cぼくに　ゆうきと　げんきを　くれた
ポケモンの　ためにも　かつんだ！\cそれでは‥‥　いきますよ！
sourceRecords.english:
WALLY: Hi! [PLAYER]!\cI bet you're surprised to see me here!\cI made it all the way here, and it's
all thanks to you!\c[PLAYER], losing to you that time
made me stronger!\cBut I'm not going to lose anymore!\cI'm going to win! For the POKéMON who
gave me courage and strength!\cOkay... Here I come!

sourceRecords.japanese: うわぁ！\nやっぱり　[PLAYER]さんは　つよいよ！
sourceRecords.english: Wow!\n[PLAYER], you are strong, after all!

sourceRecords.japanese: ミツル『‥‥　こんかいは\n[PLAYER]さんに　かてなかった　けど\rいつか　きっと　おいついて　みせるからね！
sourceRecords.english: WALLY: I couldn't beat you today,\n[PLAYER], but one of these days, I'll\rcatch up to you!

sourceRecords.japanese: ミツル『あっ！　[PLAYER]さん！\cぼく　あれから　つよくなった　はずだよ！\nそれを　[PLAYER]さんに\rみてもらいたいんだ！\cそれでは‥‥　いきますよ！
sourceRecords.english: WALLY: Hi! [PLAYER]!\cI've gotten stronger since that last\ntime! I wanted to show you, [PLAYER]!\cOkay... Here I come!

sourceRecords.japanese: うわぁ！\nやっぱり　[PLAYER]さんは　つよいよ！
sourceRecords.english: Wow!\n[PLAYER], you are strong, after all!

sourceRecords.japanese: ミツル『‥‥　こんかいも\n[PLAYER]さんに　かてなかった　けど\rいつか　きっと　おいついて‥‥\cポケモンリーグに　ちょうせん　するんだ！
sourceRecords.english: WALLY: I couldn't beat you this time,\ntoo... But one of these days, [PLAYER],\rI'm going to catch up to you...\cAnd challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE!

sourceRecords.japanese: ここまでは　なんとか　これたが\nあと　すこしが　とても　とおいよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I've made it this far a couple times,\nbut the last stretch is so long...

sourceRecords.japanese: ここで　おわったか‥‥
ここまで　きたなら\nいきおいで　チャンピオンに　なれよ！\rきみなら　できるさ！
sourceRecords.english: You've made it this far. Keep the\nmomentum going and become the\rCHAMPION! If anyone can, it's you!

sourceRecords.japanese: せっかく　ここまで　きたんだ\nいまさら　まけるなんて　ありえないよ！
sourceRecords.english: I didn't come all this way to lose now.\nThat possibility doesn't exist!

sourceRecords.japanese: まさか‥‥\nまけたのか‥‥？
ここで　まけた‥‥\cということは　まだ　チャンピオンに　なる\nしかくが　なかったと　いうことか‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I lost here...\cThat means I lack the qualifications\nto become the CHAMPION...

sourceRecords.japanese: この　はてしなく　けわしい　みち　こそ\nまさに　チャンピオンへの　みち　なのよ！
sourceRecords.english: This seemingly infinite and harsh road\nlives up to its name of VICTORY.

sourceRecords.japanese: すばらしい　たたかいかた　ね‥‥
あなたには　チャンピオンに　なれる\nかのうせいが　あるみたいね
sourceRecords.english: You seem to have the potential for\nbecoming the CHAMPION.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンリーグに　ちかづいていると　おもうと\nなんだか　ドキドキ　してきたよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: The thought that I'm getting closer to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE...\cI'm getting stage fright...

sourceRecords.japanese: なにも　できなかった‥‥
ポケモンリーグが　とおのいたよ‥‥\nなんだか　がっかり　するな‥‥
sourceRecords.english: The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant\nagain... What a letdown...

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンリーグで　かちぬくには\nポケモンへの　しんらいが　ひつよう　なの
sourceRecords.english: To win your way through the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you need the trust of your\rPOKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: しんらい　かんけい　バッチリね！
sourceRecords.english: Your relationship is based on\nsolid trust.

sourceRecords.japanese: いつも　いっしょに　いることで\nポケモンと　トレーナーとの　あいだに\rしんらい　かんけいが　できるの
sourceRecords.english: By being together all the time, trust\ngrows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　ゴール　じゃないの\nポケモンリーグへの　つうかてん　よ！
sourceRecords.english: This isn't the goal. It's only a place\non the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.

sourceRecords.japanese: その　ちょうし！
あなたなら　だいじょうぶよ　きっと！\nポケモンも　やるき　まんまん　だしね！
sourceRecords.english: You'll do fine, for sure!\nYour POKéMON are all eager to go!

sourceRecords.japanese: かぞく　ぜんいんで\nポケモンの　しゅぎょうを　してたんだ！\rだれにも　まけないぜ！
sourceRecords.english: I trained together with my whole family,\nevery one of us!\rI'm not losing to anyone!

sourceRecords.japanese: おれの　かぞく　より　つよい！？\nそんなことって　あるのか！？
sourceRecords.english: Better than my family?!\nIs that possible?!

sourceRecords.japanese: かぞくの　だれよりも　つよかった　おれ‥‥\nいままで　だれにも　まけなかった　おれ‥‥\cだけど　じしん　なくしちゃったよ\nいえに　かえろうかなあ
sourceRecords.english: I was better than everyone in my\nfamily. I've never lost before...\cI've lost my confidence...\nMaybe I'll go home...

sourceRecords.japanese: つよい　こどもが　いるって　ウワサだ！\nそれって　きみの　ことかい？
sourceRecords.english: I'd heard that there was a tough\nlittle kid around. Do they mean you?

sourceRecords.japanese: たしかに　つよい！
おれが　きいた　ウワサだと\nその　つよい　こども　ってのは\rトウカ　しゅっしん　らしいな！
sourceRecords.english: The rumors I heard, that tough little\nkid is from PETALBURG CITY.

sourceRecords.japanese: そろそろ　へばって　きたかな？
sourceRecords.english: You must be getting a little tired.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぜんぜん　へばってないわ！
sourceRecords.english: No signs of tiring at all!

sourceRecords.japanese: この　チャンピオンロードも\nポケモンリーグも　ながちょうば！\rたいりょくには　ちゅうい　してね！
sourceRecords.english: VICTORY ROAD and the POKéMON LEAGUE\nare long and grueling challenges.\rBeware of fatigue!

sourceRecords.japanese: ジムバッジを　たくさん　もってるからって\nゆだん　しないでよ\rうえには　うえが　いるんだから！
sourceRecords.english: You shouldn't get complacent just\nbecause you have a lot of GYM BADGES.\cThere's always going to be someone\nwho's better than you!

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたの　ほうが　うえね！
じぶんの　あつめた　ジムバッジを　みて\nいままでの　トレーナーを　おもいだすのよ
sourceRecords.english: Gaze on your collected BADGES and\nremember the TRAINERS you've faced.

sourceRecords.japanese: このあたりは　からだが　ひえきって\nしゅぎょう　するのも　ままならぬ‥‥\cだが　きあいが　あれば　だいじょうぶッ！\cおぬしも　この　きあいのハチマキで\nさむさに　たえてみせるのだッ！
sourceRecords.english: The penetrating cold around these\nparts is an impediment to training.\cBut with focus, one can overcome!\cWith this FOCUS BAND, buckle down and\nwithstand the cold!

sourceRecords.japanese: なにごとも　きあい　なのだーッ！！
とびらは　しまっている
ちかのカギを　つかいますか？
[PLAYER]は\nちかのカギを　つかった！\cとびらは　ひらいた！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] used the BASEMENT KEY.\cThe door opened!

sourceRecords.japanese: はつでんそうちに　ちかづいた　だけで\nねっきが　つたわってくる！\cはやく　とめたほうが　よさそうだ
sourceRecords.english: The generator is radiating heat that\ncan be felt even at a distance.\cIt looks like it should be turned off\nas soon as possible.

sourceRecords.japanese: はつでんそうちは　しずかに　なった

[PLAYER]は
スイッチを　ふんだ！\c‥‥ポチッとな！\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cはつでんそうち　は
とまった　ようだ
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] stepped on the switch.\cClick...\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe generator appears to have\nstopped...

sourceRecords.japanese: ふねの　なかでも\nうきわ　もっていたら　おかしい？
sourceRecords.english: What's so funny about having my inner\ntube aboard the ship?

sourceRecords.japanese: うわぁ　つよーい！
うきわを　もったままだと\nモンスターボール　なげにくいよ
sourceRecords.english: It's not easy throwing POKé BALLS\nwhile hanging on to an inner tube!

sourceRecords.japanese: ここって　おもしろいね！\nいるだけで　ワクワク　してくるよ！
sourceRecords.english: Isn't it fun here?\nI get excited just being here!

sourceRecords.japanese: こういった　ふねは　めずらしいので\nけんがく　しておるのですよ\cフムフム‥‥\nほかにも　へやが　ありそうですな
sourceRecords.english: Ships of this sort are rare, so I'm\ntaking a look around.\cHmhm...\nThere appear to be other cabins...

sourceRecords.japanese: ふなのりは　ふねに　のるとき\nかならず　ポケモンを　もっている！\rちょいと　しょうぶ　してくれ！
sourceRecords.english: When we go out to sea, we SAILORS\nalways bring our POKéMON.\rHow about a quick battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: こりゃ　まいった
ふなぞこが　みずの　なかに\nしずんで　いるんだよ\cポケモンが　みずに　もぐれる　わざを\nつかえたら　さきに　すすめるんだがな‥‥
sourceRecords.english: The ship's bottom has sunk into the\ndepths.\cIf a POKéMON knew how to go underwater,\nwe might make some progress...

sourceRecords.japanese: わーい！\nふね　だぞー！
カギが　かかっている\cとびらには　そうこ　と　かかれている
sourceRecords.english: The door is locked.\c“STORAGE” is painted on the door.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nそうこのカギを　つかった！\cさしこんだ　カギは　ぬけなくなったが\nとびらは　ひらいた！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] inserted and turned the\nSTORAGE KEY.\cThe inserted KEY stuck fast, but the\ndoor opened.

sourceRecords.japanese: とびらは　あいている！
うぅ‥‥\cなんだか　ふねの　なかに　いるだけで\nよってきちゃった‥‥\cふねは　ちっとも　うごいてないのに‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Urrrrppp...\cI'm getting queasy just being aboard\nthis ship...\cIt's not even moving, but...

sourceRecords.japanese: たんけんに　ぴったりの　ばしょだから\nなんだか　わくわく　してくるよ！\rきっと　すっごい　たからものが　あるぜ！
sourceRecords.english: This is a perfect place to go exploring!\nIt's exciting here!\cI bet there're amazing treasures on\nboard.

sourceRecords.japanese: フミ『おたから　さがしていたら\nトレーナー　はっけん！
sourceRecords.english: HAL: While searching for treasures,\nwe discovered a TRAINER!

sourceRecords.japanese: フミ『ぼくたち　ふたりの　ちからでも\nかてなかったのか‥‥
sourceRecords.english: HAL: We couldn't win even though\nwe worked together...

sourceRecords.japanese: フミ『おたから　みつからないんだよね‥‥\nもう　だれかが　もっていったのかな？
sourceRecords.english: HAL: We can't find any treasures...\nI wonder if someone got them already?

sourceRecords.japanese: フミ『ポケモン　２ひき　いないんだね\nそれだと　ぼくたちには　かてないよ！
sourceRecords.english: HAL: You don't even have two POKéMON.\nYou can't expect to beat us like that.

sourceRecords.japanese: アヤ『あら？　おたから　さがしていたのに\nトレーナー　はっけん　しちゃった！
sourceRecords.english: LOIS: Oh? We were looking for some\ntreasure, but we only found a TRAINER.

sourceRecords.japanese: アヤ『つよいんだ！
アヤ『おたから　どこかな？\nみつかったら　なに　かおうか　きめてるのよ！
sourceRecords.english: LOIS: I wonder where the treasures\nare hidden?\cI already know what I'm going to buy\nwhen I find them!

sourceRecords.japanese: アヤ『あら　ポケモン　２ひき　いないの？\nじゃあ　しょうぶは　おあずけね！
sourceRecords.english: LOIS: Don't you have two POKéMON?\nWe'll have to battle another time!

sourceRecords.japanese: フミ『ずっと　おたから　さがしていて\nポケモンも　つよく　なったんだよねー！\rちょっと　あいて　してみてよ
sourceRecords.english: HAL: We've been searching for\ntreasures all this time.\cOur POKéMON have grown stronger, too.\nLet us show you, okay?

sourceRecords.japanese: フミ『あいかわらず　つよいな！
フミ『おたからは　みつからないし\nポケモンは　まけるし　いえに　かえりたいよ\cでも　そんなこと　いうと\nかのじょ　おこりだすからな‥‥
sourceRecords.english: HAL: We can't find any treasures,\nwe lose at POKéMON...\cI want to go home... But if I say that,\nshe gets all angry with me...

sourceRecords.japanese: フミ『ポケモン　２ひき　いないんだね\nそれだと　ぼくたちには　かてないよ！
sourceRecords.english: HAL: You don't even have two POKéMON.\nYou can't expect to beat us like that.

sourceRecords.japanese: アヤ『あら？　また　であったわね！\nあたしたちと　いっしょで　あきらめずに\rおたから　さがしているのね！\cしょうぶして　まけた　ほうは\nあきらめることに　しない？
sourceRecords.english: LOIS: Oh, hi, we meet again!\cJust like us, you haven't given up\nsearching for treasures!\cHow about we battle, and the loser has\nto give up looking?

sourceRecords.japanese: アヤ『また　まけちゃった‥‥
アヤ『もっと　ポケモン　そだてて\nおたから　みつけるまで　かえらないわよ！
sourceRecords.english: LOIS: We'll raise our POKéMON more.\cWe're not going home until we find our\ntreasures!

sourceRecords.japanese: アヤ『あら　ポケモン　２ひき　いないの？\nじゃあ　しょうぶは　おあずけね！
sourceRecords.english: LOIS: Don't you have two POKéMON?\nWe'll have to battle another time!

sourceRecords.japanese: クスノキ　かんちょうに　たのまれてね\nこのふねの　ちょうさを　しているんだ\cついでに　たんちきを　さがしてきて　\nほしいって　いわれたんだけど\rみあたらないなあ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I'm investigating this ship on behalf\nof CAPT. STERN.\cHe also asked me to find a SCANNER,\nbut I haven't had any success...

sourceRecords.japanese: あ！　たんちき　じゃないか！\c‥‥よかったら　それ\nクスノキ　かんちょうに\rわたしてきて　くれないかなあ\cもうすこし　このふね　しらべたいんだ
sourceRecords.english: Oh! That's a SCANNER!\cListen, can I get you to deliver that\nto CAPT. STERN?\cI want to investigate this ship a\nlittle more.

sourceRecords.japanese: この　ふねは　カクタスごうと　いってね\nちょいと　むかしの　ふね　らしいんだ
sourceRecords.english: This ship is called S.S. CACTUS.\nIt seems to be from an earlier era.

sourceRecords.japanese: カギが　かかっている\cとびらには　１ごうしつと　かかれている
sourceRecords.english: The door is locked.\c“RM. 1” is painted on the door.

sourceRecords.japanese: カギが　かかっている\cとびらには　２ごうしつと　かかれている
sourceRecords.english: The door is locked.\c“RM. 2” is painted on the door.

sourceRecords.japanese: カギが　かかっている\cとびらには　４ごうしつと　かかれている
sourceRecords.english: The door is locked.\c“RM. 4” is painted on the door.

sourceRecords.japanese: カギが　かかっている\cとびらには　６ごうしつと　かかれている
sourceRecords.english: The door is locked.\c“RM. 6” is painted on the door.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nカギを　つかった！\cさしこんだ　カギは　ぬけなくなったが\nとびらは　ひらいた！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] inserted and turned the\nKEY.\cThe inserted KEY stuck fast, but the\ndoor opened.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひかっているだけの\nただの　ゴミ　だった‥‥
sourceRecords.english: It's bright and shiny!\nBut it's just trash...

sourceRecords.japanese: かべに　ちいさな　くぼみが　ある
sourceRecords.english: There's a small indent in the wall.

sourceRecords.japanese: かべに　ちいさな　くぼみが　ある\cひみつのちからを　つかいますか？
sourceRecords.english: There's a small indent in the wall.\cUse the SECRET POWER?

sourceRecords.japanese: ちいさな　どうくつを　はっけん！
ここに　ひみつきちを　つくりますか？
sourceRecords.english: Want to make your SECRET BASE here?

sourceRecords.japanese: はこには　ポケモンの　えが　かいてある\cポケモンマークの　ひっこしやさん　だ！
sourceRecords.english: The box is printed with a POKéMON logo.\cIt's a POKéMON brand moving and\ndelivery service.

sourceRecords.japanese: かいりゅうを　ものともせず　すすむ\nれんらくせんを　どうぞ　ごらんください
sourceRecords.english: This ferry is built to plow through\nfast-running currents.\cWe hope you enjoy your voyage with us.\nFeel free to explore the ship.

sourceRecords.japanese: それでは　れんらくせんに　よる\nふなたびを　おたのしみ　ください
sourceRecords.english: We hope you enjoy your voyage on\nour ferry.

sourceRecords.japanese: おつかれさまです　ただいま\nカイナシティに　とうちゃく　しました
sourceRecords.english: We have made land in SLATEPORT CITY.\nThank you for sailing with us.

sourceRecords.japanese: おつかれさまです　ただいま\nミナモシティに　とうちゃく　しました
sourceRecords.english: We have made land in LILYCOVE CITY.\nThank you for sailing with us.

sourceRecords.japanese: とうちゃくまで　まだまだ　だな\cじぶんの　へやに　もどって　やすんでいなよ\nたしか　きみの　へやは\r２ごうしつ　だったな\cあの　へやの　ベッドは\nふかふか　していて　きもちいいぞ！
sourceRecords.english:
It'll be some time before we make land,
I reckon.\cYou can rest up in your cabin if you'd
like. Your cabin's No. 2.\cThe bed in there is soft and plushy.
I can attest to how comfy it is!

sourceRecords.japanese: とうちゃく　したぞ！
ふなたびに　あきちゃって\nきゃくしつで　ポケモンで　しょうぶを\rしたがっている　トレーナーも　いるぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Go visit other cabins.\nTRAINERS bored of the boat trip will\rbe itching to battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: まっ　ふなたびを　たのしんでくれよ
まどの　むこうに\nすいへいせんが　ひろがっている！
ハギ『ようこそ！　[PLAYER][KUN]！\cわしが　この　タイドリップごうの\nめいよ　せんちょう　ハギ　じゃよ！\cいやぁ　いちどは　いんたい　したが\nこんな　すごい　ふねを　みてしまうと\rふなのりの　ちが　さわぐのう！！
sourceRecords.english:
MR. BRINEY: Welcome aboard, [PLAYER][KUN]!\cThey made me honorary captain of the
S.S. TIDAL!\cYou can call me CAPTAIN BRINEY now!\cYou know, I retired once before, but
when I saw this majestic ship...\cLet me just say, it stirred my sleeping
soul as a sailor!

sourceRecords.japanese: ピーコ『ピひょ　ピひょひょ‥‥！
１ごうしつ
２ごうしつ
３ごうしつ
４ごうしつ
こんなに　でっかい　ところ\nそうじ　してるのも　あきたぞ！\rちょいと　しょうぶ　しようや！
sourceRecords.english: Arrrgh! I'm fed up and dog-tired of\ncleaning this huge place!\cLet's have a quick battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: おとうと　まけちまったよ！
おれたち　おそうじ　ブラザーズ！\cあにきが　せんざい　ぶちまけてー\nおとうと　せっせと　みがくのさー
sourceRecords.english: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!\cThe old one dumps the detergent,\nand the young one does the scrubbing!

sourceRecords.japanese: こんなに　ひろいから\nふなぞこで　ポケモンしょうぶ　しても\rだいじょうぶ　だろ？
sourceRecords.english: This is the bottom of the ship's hull.\nThere's plenty of room.\rIt'll be alright for a POKéMON battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: あにき　まけちまったよ！
おれたち　おそうじ　ブラザーズ！\cあにきが　せんざい　ぶちまけてー\nおとうと　せっせと　みがくのさー
sourceRecords.english: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!\cThe old one dumps the detergent,\nand the young one does the scrubbing!

sourceRecords.japanese: ベッドが　ある‥‥\nやすんでいこう
sourceRecords.english: It's a bed.\nLet's take a rest.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミナモと　カイナを\nいったり　きたり‥‥\cコンテストの　けんがくが\nわたしの　たのしみ　なんだよ
sourceRecords.english: Go back and forth between LILYCOVE\nand SLATEPORT, that's what I do.\cIt's my hobby - going from port to port\nto take in POKéMON CONTESTS.

sourceRecords.japanese: たのしい　しょうぶ　だったよ
つぎの　コンテストには\nどんな　ポケモンが　でるのか\rたのしみで　たまらないよ
sourceRecords.english: I get so excited imagining what kinds\nof POKéMON I'll get to see in the next\rCONTEST. The anticipation of it thrills!

sourceRecords.japanese: きみの　ともだちは　つよいのかね？
つよい　ともだち　だね！
にんげん　だけが　ともだち　じゃない\nわたしに　とっては　ポケモンが\rたいせつな　ともだち　なんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: Friends need not be human.\nFor me, POKéMON are treasured friends!

sourceRecords.japanese: おきゃくさん\nノックは　したかね？
sourceRecords.english: Child...\nDid you knock on the door?

sourceRecords.japanese: まけても\nあわてず　さわがず
sourceRecords.english: A loss is to be accepted without haste\nor panic.

sourceRecords.japanese: どんな　ときでも　とりみださないのが\nしんしの　みだしなみ　だよ
sourceRecords.english: To be never ruffled in any situation is\nthe GENTLEMAN's code of conduct.

sourceRecords.japanese: ジン『ちょっと　はずかしいけど\nぼくたちの　ラブラブ　パワー　みせようかな
sourceRecords.english: JED: I feel a little shy about this, but...\nWe'll show you our lovey-dovey power!

sourceRecords.japanese: ジン『はぁ‥‥
ジン『ぼくたちの　ラブラブ　パワーでも\nかてないのは　はじめて　だよ！\rきみは　すごい　トレーナー　なんだね！
sourceRecords.english: JED: It's the first time that our lovey-\ndovey power couldn't prevail!\rYou must be an awesome TRAINER!

sourceRecords.japanese: ジン『ポケモン　いっぴき？\nそれだと　さみしくないか？
sourceRecords.english: JED: You only have one POKéMON?\nIsn't that just too lonesome?

sourceRecords.japanese: カホ『ちょっと　はずかしいけど\nふたりの　ラブラブ　パワー　みせてあげる！
sourceRecords.english: LEA: I feel a little silly, but...\nWe'll show you our lovey-dovey power!

sourceRecords.japanese: カホ『やん！
カホ『ふたりの　ラブラブ　パワーでも\nかてない　だなんて\rあなた　すごい　トレーナー　なのね！
sourceRecords.english: LEA: I can't believe it!\nOur lovey-dovey power failed...\rYou must be an awesome TRAINER!

sourceRecords.japanese: カホ『しょうぶ　したかったのに‥‥\nポケモン　２ひき　いないのね‥‥
sourceRecords.english: LEA: I wanted to battle...\nBut you don't even have two POKéMON...

sourceRecords.japanese: キミ　ちょうど　いいところに　きたね！\cボク　たいくつで　たまらないんだ\nちょっと　たのしませて　くれよ
sourceRecords.english: Ah, you've come just in time.\cI'm bored, you see.\nYou may entertain me.

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥もう　いいよ
パパに　たのんで　ボク　せんようの\nヨットを　かってもらおうかな？\rポケモンと　いっしょに　のれる　ヨット！
sourceRecords.english: Perhaps I shall get Father to acquire\na yacht for me.\rA yacht for me and POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: あら　かわいい　トレーナーさん\nおちゃに　なさる？\rそれとも　しょうぶ　かしら？
sourceRecords.english: Oh, you're such an adorable TRAINER.\nWould you like to have tea?\rOr would you rather battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: かっぱつで　いらっしゃるのね
ゆうがな　きゃくせんで\nせかい　いっしゅうも　よろしいけど‥‥\cれんらくせんで　のんびり\nホウエンを　みるのも　すてき　ですわ
sourceRecords.english: A world cruise on a luxury liner has its\ncharms, I must say...\cBut, I will admit there is an appealing\nside to touring HOENN by ferry.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたし　あやしく　ないです！\nだから　これを　あなたに　あげます！\cべつに　だれか　から\nよこどりした　モノじゃ　ないです！\rあんしん　して　つかって　ください！
sourceRecords.english: Uh... Hi! I... I'm not acting suspicious!\nUh... You can have this! For free!\cIt... Honestly, I didn't SNATCH it from\nsomeone! I'd never do such a thing!\rIt's clean! You can use it!

sourceRecords.japanese: よこどり　という　わざは\nあいてが　つかおうとする　わざを\rじぶんで　つかって　しまうのです！
sourceRecords.english: SNATCH steals the foe's move in\nadvance, and then uses the snatched\rmove on the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　バトルタワー！\nかちぬけ！　さいきょう　トレーナー
sourceRecords.english: BATTLE TOWER\n“Win it all and be the best, TRAINERS!”

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　バトルタワー　さ！\cトレーナーは　きたえあげた　ポケモンで\nひたすら　かちぬいて　いくのさ！
sourceRecords.english: This is the BATTLE TOWER.\cTRAINERS bring their best-raised\nPOKéMON for elimination-style matches.

sourceRecords.japanese: れんらくせんを　ごりよう　ですね！\nチケットは　おもち　でしょうか？
sourceRecords.english: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nチケットを　もっていない！\c‥‥もうしわけ　ありません！\cふねに　のれるのは\nチケットの　ある　かた　だけです
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] doesn't have the TICKET...\cI'm terribly sorry.\cYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nふねのチケットを　みせた！\cはい！　けっこう　です！\cいきさきは　どちら　でしょう？
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] flashed the TICKET.\cPerfect! That's all you need!\cAnd where would you like to go?

sourceRecords.japanese: カイナ　ですね！
ミナモ　ですね！
また　ごりよう　ください！
sourceRecords.english: Please sail with us another time!

sourceRecords.japanese: れんらくせんに　のって　おまちください
sourceRecords.english: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.

sourceRecords.japanese: いきさきは　どちら　でしょう？
sourceRecords.english: Then, where would you like to go?

sourceRecords.japanese: きょうは　３５にんぬき　できるまでは\nかえりませんわ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm not leaving until I've beaten 35\nTRAINERS in a row!

sourceRecords.japanese: すごく　つよそうな　トレーナーが\nいっぱい　だね！\rぼくは　まだ　でられそうに　ないや‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Gee, there're a lot of tough-looking\nTRAINERS here.\rI'm not good enough to enter yet...

sourceRecords.japanese: バトルタワーへ　ようこそ！\cこちらでは　バトルルームへの\nごあんないを　しております
sourceRecords.english: Welcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\cPlease register with me to enter\na BATTLE ROOM.

sourceRecords.japanese: バトルルームに　ちょうせん　しますか？
sourceRecords.english: Would you like to make a BATTLE ROOM\nchallenge?

sourceRecords.japanese: それでは　またの　ごりようを\nおまちして　おります
sourceRecords.english: We'll be looking forward to your\nnext challenge.

sourceRecords.japanese: バトルルームに　ごあんないする　まえに\nレポートを　かきますが　よろしいですか？
sourceRecords.english: Before entering a BATTLE ROOM, your\nprogress must be saved. Is that okay?

sourceRecords.japanese: レベル５０の　へやと　レベル１００の　へやが\nありますが　どちらに　ちょうせん　しますか？
sourceRecords.english: There are two BATTLE ROOMS,\nLevel 50 and Level 100.\rWhich would you like to challenge?

sourceRecords.japanese: それでは　さんかする　ポケモンを\nえらんで　ください
sourceRecords.english: Please select the POKéMON you wish\nto enter.

sourceRecords.japanese: それでは　バトルルームへ\nごあんない　します！
sourceRecords.english: I'll direct you to your BATTLE ROOM now.

sourceRecords.japanese:
バトルタワーは　ポケモンたいせんを
おこなうための　しせつです\cタワーないには　バトルルーム　という
たいせんの　ために　よういされた　へやがたくさん　ようい　されています\cそれぞれ　バトルルームには
７にんの　トレーナー　が　いてあなたの　チャレンジを　まっています\cみごと　その　７にんを　たおした　ときは
すてきな　しょうひんを　さしあげます！\cまた　とちゅうで　ちょうせんを
ちゅうだんしたい　ばあいはちゃんと　レポートを　かかないとつづけて　ちょうせんが　できないのできをつけて　くださいね
sourceRecords.english:
The BATTLE TOWER is a facility made
especially for POKéMON battles.\cWithin the TOWER are many BATTLE ROOMS.\cIn each BATTLE ROOM, seven TRAINERS
await your challenge.\cBeat all seven, and you will be rewarded
with a fabulous prize.\cYou may also take a break from your
challenge by saving your progress.\cMake sure you save properly or you
won't be able to resume your challenge.

sourceRecords.japanese:
おきゃくさま！\cさんかできる　ポケモンが　３ひき　いません！\cさんかする　ためには　レベルが　５０いかで
すべて　ちがうしゅるいの　ポケモンを３ひき　よういして　ください\cまた　もたせる　どうぐも
すべて　ちがう　どうぐに　してください！\cなお　タマゴ[STR_VAR_1]さんか　させることは　できません！\cじゅんびが　できましたら
また　おこし　ください
sourceRecords.english: Excuse me!\cYou don't have three eligible POKéMON.\cYou must have three different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\cThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\cEGGS[STR_VAR_1] ineligible.\cPlease come see me when you are ready.

sourceRecords.japanese:
おきゃくさま！\cさんかできる　ポケモンが　３ひき　いません！\cさんかする　ためには
すべて　ちがうしゅるいの　ポケモンを３ひき　よういして　ください\cまた　もたせる　どうぐも
すべて　ちがう　どうぐに　してください！\cなお　タマゴ[STR_VAR_1]さんか　させることは　できません！\cじゅんびが　できましたら
また　おこし　ください
sourceRecords.english: Excuse me!\cYou don't have three eligible POKéMON.\cYou must have three different POKéMON\nto enter.\cThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\cEGGS[STR_VAR_1] ineligible.\cPlease come see me when you are ready.

sourceRecords.japanese: おきゃくさま！\cぜんかい　ちゃんと　レポートを　かいて\nしゅうりょう　しませんでしたね？\cもうしわけ　ありませんが　そのばあい\nちょうせんは　むこうと　なります
sourceRecords.english: Excuse me!\cYou didn't save before you quit your\nchallenge last time.\cBecause of that, your challenge so far\nhas been disqualified. Sorry!

sourceRecords.japanese: おめでとう　ございます！\nみごと　７にんぬき　されましたね！\c
７にんぬきを　たっせい　されましたので\nこの　しょうひんを　さしあげます！\c
sourceRecords.english: For beating seven TRAINERS in a row,\nyou have earned this fabulous prize!\c

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は\n[STR_VAR_1]を　もらった！
‥あら　どうぐが　いっぱいですね\cどうぐを　せいりしてから\nまたおこしください
sourceRecords.english: Oh, your BAG appears to be full.\cPlease make room in your BAG, then come\nsee me.

sourceRecords.japanese: おつかれさまでした！\c
せいせきを　レポートに　かきますので\nおまちください
sourceRecords.english: Your record will be saved.\nPlease wait.

sourceRecords.japanese: おまちしておりました！\c
バトルルームに　ごあんないする　まえに\nレポートを　かきますので　おまちください
sourceRecords.english: Before entering a BATTLE ROOM, your\nprogress will be saved. Please wait.

sourceRecords.japanese: いよいよ　つぎは　５０にんめの\nトレーナー　ですね！\cこれからは　７にんを　かちぬく　たびに\nあなたの　ポケモンに　きねんリボンが\rおくられますので　がんばって　くださいね！
sourceRecords.english: You're finally about to face the\n50th TRAINER.\cFrom here on, every time you beat seven\nTRAINERS in a row, your POKéMON will\rreceive a commemorative RIBBON.\cGood luck!

sourceRecords.japanese: つよい　トレーナー　７にんを\nかちぬいた　きねんの　リボンを　どうぞ！\c[PLAYER]は　リボンを　もらった！
sourceRecords.english: Here are some RIBBONS for beating\nseven tough TRAINERS in a row.\c[PLAYER] received some RIBBONS!

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　ポケモンに\nリボンを　つけて　あげた！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] put the RIBBONS on the\nchallenger POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: ねえねえ！\cバトルタワーで　これから　しょうぶだ！\n‥‥て　いうときの\rきみの　きもちを　おしえてよ！
sourceRecords.english: Hello, hello!\nYou're going to battle here, right?\cCan you tell me what's going through\nyour mind as you prepare for battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: おっ　おしえて　くれるの！\nじゃあ　さっそく‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Oh, wow, you'll tell me?\nGreat! Then, what's your answer?

sourceRecords.japanese: とくに　なにも　おもわないって　こと？\nきみって　クールなんだね
sourceRecords.english: Oh, so you don't think much about it?\nYou're one cool customer.

sourceRecords.japanese: あれ？　やっぱり　やめたの？\nきみって　きまぐれ　なんだね
sourceRecords.english: Hunh? You changed your mind?\nI guess you're fickle.

sourceRecords.japanese: へえ　そんな　きぶんに　なるんだ！\nなかなか　こせいてき　だね‥‥\cどうも　ありがと！
sourceRecords.english: Okay, so that's how you feel?\nThat's quite original.\cThanks!

sourceRecords.japanese: かちぬいた　トレーナーの　にんずうは\nきろく　されて　いるのよ！\cきろくは　うけつけの　よこでも\nトレーナーカードの　うらでも　みられるわよ！
sourceRecords.english:
The number of matches you win in a row
is recorded.\cThe record is posted beside the
registration counter.\cIt's also on the back of your
TRAINER'S CARD.

sourceRecords.japanese: いちど　バトルタワーに　はいれば\nとちゅうで　まけちゃうか\r７にん　かちぬくまでは\rでられなく　なっちゃうんだ！\cかくごして　チャレンジ　しないとね！
sourceRecords.english: Once you've entered the BATTLE TOWER,\nyou can't leave until you either lose\ror you beat seven TRAINERS in a row.\cYou'd best be certain that you're up\nto the challenge.

sourceRecords.japanese:
はっはっはっ　いやあ　すばらしい
いやあ　すばらしい！\cあなた　わかってますか？
５０にんぬきを　しちゃったんですよ！\cじつに　すばらしい！\cバトルタワー　オーナーの　わたしから
ぜひ　きねんひんを　おくらせて　ください！
sourceRecords.english:
Hahahaha! Pure magnificence!
Pure magnificence indeed!\cDo you realize what you've achieved?
You've beaten 50 TRAINERS in a row!\cYes, purely magnificent!\cAs the OWNER of the BATTLE TOWER,
let me give you a memento!

sourceRecords.japanese:
うわっはっはっはっ　いやあ　すばらしい
いやあ　すばらしい！　じつに　すばらしい！\cあなた　わかってますか？
１００にんぬきを　しちゃったんですよ！ほんとうに　すばらしい！\cバトルタワー　オーナーの　わたしから
ぜひ　きねんひんを　おくらせて　ください！
sourceRecords.english:
Wahahaha! Pure magnificence!
Absolutely pure magnificence indeed!\cDo you realize what you've achieved?
You've beaten 100 TRAINERS in a row!\cYes, absolutely magnificent!\cAs the OWNER of the BATTLE TOWER,
let me give you a memento!

sourceRecords.japanese: これ　かざっておくと　めだちますよ！
sourceRecords.english: I suggest you keep it displayed.\nIt will surely attract attention.

sourceRecords.japanese: あっ　パソコンが　いっぱいですか‥‥\cしかし　せっかくですから！\nあとでも　よいので　とりに　きてください！
sourceRecords.english: Oh?\nYour PC has no room for this...\cBut it would be a shame to waste this...\nPlease come back for this!

sourceRecords.japanese: あんなに　すばらしい　たたかいを\nみせて　いただいて　まんぞくです！\rバトルタワーを　つくった　かいが　あった！
sourceRecords.english: I'm overwhelmed with satisfaction after\nseeing your magnificent performance.\cIt makes the building of the BATTLE\nTOWER all worthwhile!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンの　たいりょくを\nかいふくして　さしあげます
sourceRecords.english: We will restore your POKéMON to\nfull health.

sourceRecords.japanese: つぎは　[STR_VAR_1]にんめの　あいてです\nじゅんびは　いいですか？
sourceRecords.english: You will be facing opponent no. [STR_VAR_1].\nAre you ready?

sourceRecords.japanese: レポートを　かいて　しゅうりょう　しますか？
sourceRecords.english: Would you like to save and\nquit the game?

sourceRecords.japanese: バトルルームの　ちょうせんを\nちゅうし　しますか？
sourceRecords.english: Would you like to cancel your BATTLE\nROOM challenge?

sourceRecords.japanese: あらあら　つよそうな　トレーナーさんね\nわたくしの　ポケモンを　みてくださるかしら？
sourceRecords.english: Oh? You look like a good TRAINER.\nWill you look at my POKéMON?

sourceRecords.japanese: わたくしじゃ　かないませんわ
sourceRecords.english: I'm not good enough for you.

sourceRecords.japanese: とっても　たのしい　しょうぶ　でしたわ\nぜひ　また　たたかって　くださいね
sourceRecords.english: I enjoyed our battle very much.\nPlease battle with me some other time.

sourceRecords.japanese: えいっ！\nがんばれ！　あたしたちの　ポケモン！！
かてなかったあ‥‥
２ひきの　ポケモンが　いっしょに\nたたかうのって　びっくり　しなかった？
sourceRecords.english: Did it surprise you that two POKéMON\nbattled at the same time?

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンが　１ひき　だと\nあたしたちとは　たたかえないです\rだって　あたしたち　つよいもん！
sourceRecords.english: You can't battle with us if you have\nonly one POKéMON.\rWhy? Because we're strong!

sourceRecords.japanese: よしっ！　ひさしぶりの　しょうぶ！\nぜんりょくで　たたかうぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Hey, hey! This is my first battle in\na while. I'll give it my all!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぜんりょくで　たたかったのに‥‥
sourceRecords.english: But I gave it my all...

sourceRecords.japanese: おまえさん　つよすぎるぞ！\nさては　すごうでの　トレーナーだろう！？
sourceRecords.english: You're far too strong!\nYou must be a great TRAINER!

sourceRecords.japanese: わたくしの　ポケモン\nとても　かわいくて　とても　つよいの\rぜひ　おてあわせ　してくださいませ
sourceRecords.english: My POKéMON are extremely cute and\nextremely strong.\rPlease allow me to show you.

sourceRecords.japanese: まいりましたわ\nだって　あなた　つよいんですもの
sourceRecords.english: I must concede defeat.\nAfter all, you are strong.

sourceRecords.japanese: こんど　おてあわせ　するまでに\nもっと　ポケモンを　そだてて　おきますわ\cそのときは　てかげん　しなくってよ！
sourceRecords.english: The next time we meet, I will have raised\nmy POKéMON much more.\cDon't expect mercy then!

sourceRecords.japanese: やまおとこは　いつだって　げんき！\nわしの　ポケモンも　げんきで\rたたかいたくて　ウズウズしておるぞ！
sourceRecords.english: We HIKERS are always full of energy!\nMy POKéMON are also full of energy, too.\rWe're always itching for a battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: げんきが　なくなった‥‥
ワッハッハ！　たしかに　まけた！\nでも　たのしい　ポケモンしょうぶが\rできたから　だいまんぞく　だ！
sourceRecords.english: Wahahah! Sure, we lost!\nBut we had a great battle, didn't we?\rWe're satisfied with that!

sourceRecords.japanese: つよそうな　トレーナーですけど\nあたしたちに　かてますか？
sourceRecords.english: You look like a strong TRAINER,\nbut can you beat us?

sourceRecords.japanese: えーん\nまけちゃったよお！
ポケモンが　２ひき　どうじに　たたかえると\nいろいろ　できることが　ふえそうです
sourceRecords.english: If two POKéMON can battle at the same\ntime, all sorts of new things can happen.

sourceRecords.japanese: たたかえる　ポケモンさん\n１ひき　しか　いないですか？\cじゃあ　しょうぶは　おあずけ　ですね！
sourceRecords.english: Do you only have one POKéMON that can\nbattle?\cThen we can't battle with you yet.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶで\nぜんいんに　かてるかどうか　やってみた？
sourceRecords.english: Have you tried beating all the other\nTRAINERS in battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: きょうは　きてくれて\nほんとうに　ありがとう！\cはつばいを　たのしみに　まっていてね！
sourceRecords.english: Thanks for coming today!\cI hope you're looking forward to this\ngame's release!

sourceRecords.japanese: あれ？　もう　ぜんいんと\nポケモンしょうぶ　したの？
sourceRecords.english: Huh? Did you battle with all the\nTRAINERS already?

sourceRecords.japanese: きょうは　きてくれて\nほんとうに　ありがとう！\cはつばいを　たのしみに　まっていてね！
sourceRecords.english: Thank you for coming today!\cI hope you're looking forward to this\ngame's release!

sourceRecords.japanese: きみの　もってる　ポケモン\nおじさん　みたことが　ないよ！\rなんだか　うらやましいぞ
sourceRecords.english: I've never seen the POKéMON you have.\nIt makes me envious a little.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほら！　たくさんの　トレーナーと\nいろんな　ポケモンが　きみを　まってるよ！
sourceRecords.english: Look at all those TRAINERS!\nThey have different POKéMON, too.\rAnd they're all waiting for you!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンの　せかいへ　ようこそ！！
sourceRecords.english: Welcome to the World of POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶは\nあかるく　たのしく　はげしく！！
sourceRecords.english: May all POKéMON battles be bright,\nfun, and ferocious!

sourceRecords.japanese: あたし　きょうは　おるすばん\cおねーさんたちは　じゅんびが　あるって\nどこかに　いっちゃった！\cあきに　なったら\nおはなやさん　はじめるから　まっててね！
sourceRecords.english: I have to stay home today.\cMy big sisters had to go out.\nThey said it was for preparations.\cIn the autumn, we're going to start\na flower shop. Please wait for it!

sourceRecords.japanese:
わし　うみのいえ　の　オヤジ！
ひとよんで　うみサン！\cとにかく　あつい　ポケモンしょうぶを
みることが　だいすき　なんだよねー！\cキミもねー　あつーい　ハートで
ここに　いる　トレーナーぜんいんにかてたら　いいものを　あげるよー
sourceRecords.english:
I'm the owner of the SEASHORE HOUSE.
But you can call me MR. SEA!\cWhat I love above all is to see hot
POKéMON battles.\cLet me see that your heart burns hot!\cIf you can defeat all the TRAINERS
here, I'll reward your efforts.

sourceRecords.japanese: あつーい　しょうぶ　みせてくれー！\cそのためだけに　わし\nこの　うみのいえを　やってるんだねー！
sourceRecords.english: Show me some hot matches!\cI run this SEASHORE HOUSE just for\nthat reason alone!

sourceRecords.japanese: きみ　すごいねー！\nあつい　ポケモンしょうぶ　だったー\rわし　だいまんぞく　だよー！\cこれは　あつい　しょうぶを　みせてくれた\nきみへの　おれい　だよー\cサイコソーダ　はんダース　もっていきなよー
sourceRecords.english: You're scorching hot!\nThose battles blazed!\rI'm more than just satisfied!\cAs thanks for showing me your hot\nstreak, I want you to take these.\cIt's half a dozen bottles of SODA POP!

sourceRecords.japanese: と　おもったけど　バッグ　いっぱいかー\nじゃあ　あずかっておくよー
sourceRecords.english: Oh, but hey, your BAG's jammed full.\nI'll hang on to these for you.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンも　だいすき　サイコソーダ\nいっぽん　３００えん　だよー\rかって　いきなよー！
sourceRecords.english: Want to buy some SODA POP?\nPOKéMON love it!\cJust $300 a bottle!\nBuy some!

sourceRecords.japanese: はいよー
おかねが　ないよー
それは　ざんねん　だねー
ポケモンも　だいすき　サイコソーダ\nいっぽん　３００えんよ　いかが！？
sourceRecords.english: SODA POP! The POKéMON favorite!\nJust $300 a bottle! Want one?

sourceRecords.japanese: はい　どうぞ！
あらやだ！\nおかねが　たりないわよ
sourceRecords.english: Oh, dear!\nYou don't have enough money.

sourceRecords.japanese: それは　ざんねん！
この　うみのいえで　いちばん\nあつい　ポケモンしょうぶが　できるのは\rこの　オレさま　だぜ！！
sourceRecords.english: If you're looking for a battle on the\nhigh seas, you'll find no hotter \rTRAINER than me, matey!

sourceRecords.japanese: たしかに　あつい　しょうぶ　だった\nまけて　なっとく　って　かんじ　だぜ！
sourceRecords.english: That was a hot battle!\nI can accept that loss, matey!

sourceRecords.japanese: オレは　カイナに　くるたびに\nここで　あつい　しょうぶと\rつめたい　サイコソーダを　たのしむんだ！
sourceRecords.english: Whenever I'm in SLATEPORT, I enjoy\nhot battles and ice-cold SODA POP!

sourceRecords.japanese: たいくつな　しょうぶ　なんて　ムダ！\cもえあがるような　しょうぶ　こそ\nトレーナーと　ポケモンを　きたえるのよ！
sourceRecords.english: Boring battles aren't worth the effort.\cFiery hot battles are what toughen up\nTRAINERS and POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: あつい　じゃない！
あーあ　のどが　かわいちゃった\nサイコソーダ　のもうかな？
sourceRecords.english: Whew, I'm all thirsty.\nMaybe I'll have a SODA POP.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくの　ポケモンの　すごいところ\nみせちゃうけど　なかないでよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm going to show you how great my\nPOKéMON are, but don't cry!

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥　まけたけど　なかないぞ
ポケモンが　ぼくを　のせて\nみずの　うえを　すすむ　わざを　つかえたら\rうきわも　いらなくなるのに
sourceRecords.english: If one of my POKéMON knew the move\nfor carrying me across water on its\rback, I could get rid of this inner tube.

sourceRecords.japanese: だれかの　しせんを　かんじる‥
む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　つくえの　したに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
sourceRecords.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nbeneath this desk? You're sharp!

sourceRecords.japanese: む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　きの　うしろに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
sourceRecords.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nbehind this tree? You're sharp!

sourceRecords.japanese: む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　タンスの　なかに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
sourceRecords.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nin this dresser? You're sharp!

sourceRecords.japanese: む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　まどの　むこうに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
sourceRecords.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nbeyond this window? You're sharp!

sourceRecords.japanese: む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　うえきばちの　なかに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
sourceRecords.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nin this planter? You're sharp!

sourceRecords.japanese: む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　とだなの　なかに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
sourceRecords.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nin this cupboard? You're sharp!

sourceRecords.japanese: む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　まどの　うらに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
sourceRecords.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nbehind this window? You're sharp!

sourceRecords.japanese: む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　ざぶとんの　したに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
sourceRecords.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nbeneath this cushion? You're sharp!

sourceRecords.japanese: わがはい　こそ！\cホウエンちほう　さいだいの\nなぞの　じんぶつ\rひと　よんで‥‥\cカラクリだいおう！\nわははは！　はじめまして！
sourceRecords.english: Behold!\cFor I am the greatest living mystery\nof a man in all of HOENN!\rThey call me...\cThe TRICK MASTER!\nWahahaha! Glad to meet you!

sourceRecords.japanese: あんた　わがはいの　カラクリやしきに\nちょうせんしに　きたって\rわけだろう　そうだろう！\rよしっ　ちょうせんを　みとめよう！\cそこの　かけじくから　はいって\nちょうせん　するがいい！\rわがはいは　おくの　へやで　まってるぞ！
sourceRecords.english:
You, you've come to challenge my
TRICK HOUSE, haven't you?\cThat's why you're here, isn't it?
Yes, it is!\cConsider your challenge accepted!\cEnter through the scroll there,
and let your challenge commence!\cI shall be waiting in the back!

sourceRecords.japanese: かけじくだ！
かけじくの　うらを　のぞくと\nおおきい　あなが　あった！\cおくに　すすんで　みますか？
sourceRecords.english: There is a big hole behind the scroll!\cWant to go in?

sourceRecords.japanese: かけじくの　うえに　メモが　はってある\c「たびに　でます‥‥　さがさないでね\nカラクリだいおう」
sourceRecords.english: There is a note affixed to the scroll...\c“I am leaving on a journey.\nDon't look for me. TRICK MASTER”

sourceRecords.japanese: さて　こんどの　しかけは\nあんなことや　こんなことを‥‥\cうふふ　われながら\nむずかしいぞ‥　むふふ
sourceRecords.english: For the next time, I'll use this trick,\nand that scheme, and those ruses...\cMufufufu... If I may say so, it's\nbrilliantly difficult, even for me!

sourceRecords.japanese: わっ　なんだ！　あんたか！\cいま　まだ　つぎの　しかけを\nかんがえちゅう　なんだよ！\cもっと　わがはいに\nかんがえる　じかんを\rあたえて　くれたって　いいだろ！\rもうちょっと　したら　また　きてくれ！
sourceRecords.english:
Hah? What?!
Oh, it's you!\cI'm in the midst of devising new tricky
challenges!\cIt's not too much to ask for a bit more
time for me to think, is it now?You wouldn't begrudge me that?Come back in a little while!

sourceRecords.japanese: おお　あんた！　さては　このあいだの\nほうびを　とりに　きたんだろう　そうだろう！\rよしっ　いま　やろう！
sourceRecords.english: Ah, it's you! You're here to accept the\nreward from before, isn't that right?\rYes, right I am!\cHere!\nI'll give it to you now!

sourceRecords.japanese: あれ？　とりに　きたんじゃ　ないのか？
sourceRecords.english: Hah?\nDid you not come to claim your reward?

sourceRecords.japanese: ワガハイ　ハ　からくりニンギョウ　５ゴウ！\nぷれぜんとヲ　ウケトッテ　クレナイト\rダイオウノ　アトヲ　オッテ　イケナイヨ！
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 5 I AM!\nIF REWARD IS NOT TAKEN BY YOU,\rTHEN TRICK MASTER YOU CANNOT FOLLOW.

sourceRecords.japanese: ソレデハ　さらば！
エッ！　マタ　ぱそこんガ\nイッパイ　ダッテ‥‥？　アンマリダ！
sourceRecords.english: YOUR PC STATUS: FULL AGAIN.\nMEAN, YOU ARE.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　まきものを　みつけた！
[PLAYER]は　まきものに　かいてある\nあいことばを　おぼえた！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] memorized the secret code\nwritten on the scroll.

sourceRecords.japanese: あいことばが　かいてある
sourceRecords.english: A secret code is written on it.

sourceRecords.japanese: とびらには　カギが　かかっている！\c‥‥よくみると　とびらに　もじが　かいてある\n「ここに　あいことばを　かきつけよ」
sourceRecords.english: The door is locked.\c...On closer inspection, this is written\non it: “Write the secret code here.”

sourceRecords.japanese: あっ！\nあんた　ここまで　こられたのか！\rうーむ‥‥　できる！
sourceRecords.english: Aak!\nYou've made it to me?\rHmmm... You're sharp!

sourceRecords.japanese: てつやで　きを　うえたのに‥‥\cわがはいの　つぎの　つぎの　つぎの　つぎの\nつぎの　つぎ　くらいに　すごい！
sourceRecords.english: It took me all night to plant all those\ntrees...\cYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three, four, five, six places!

sourceRecords.japanese: てつやで　めいろを　つくったのに‥‥\cわがはいの　つぎの　つぎの　つぎの　つぎの\nつぎ　くらいに　すごい！
sourceRecords.english: It took me all night to make the maze...\cYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three, four, five places!

sourceRecords.japanese: てつやで　いわを　はこび　こんだのに‥\cわがはいの　つぎの　つぎの　つぎの　つぎ\nくらいに　すごい！
sourceRecords.english: It took me all night to bring in those\nboulders...\cYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three, four places!

sourceRecords.japanese: てつやで　いわを　おして　きたのに‥‥\cわがはいの　つぎの　つぎの　つぎ\nくらいに　すごい！
sourceRecords.english: It took me all night to shove in those\nboulders...\cYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three places!

sourceRecords.japanese: てつやで　にんぎょう　つくって\nてつやで　クイズも　かんがえたのに‥‥\cわがはいの　つぎの　つぎ\nくらいに　すごい！
sourceRecords.english: It took me all night to make MECHADOLLS\nand another to think up the quiz...\cYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two places!

sourceRecords.japanese: てつやで　とびらを　とりつけたのに‥‥\cわがはいの　つぎ\nくらいに　すごい！
sourceRecords.english: It took me all night to install\nthe doors...\cYou're almost my equal in greatness!

sourceRecords.japanese: てつやで　やじるしを　ならべたのに‥‥\cわがはいと　おなじ　くらい　すごい！
sourceRecords.english: It took me all night setting up arrows...\cYou're my equal in greatness!

sourceRecords.japanese: てつやで　ゆかを　みがいたのに‥‥\cわがはい　より　すごい！　のかも‥‥
sourceRecords.english: It took me all night polishing floors...\cYou're above me in greatness!\nPossibly...

sourceRecords.japanese: ど　どうしよう‥‥\nもう　カラクリの　ネタが\rつきて　しまった‥‥\rまた　ぜんこく　かくちを　まわって\rしかけを　いろいろ　かんがえて　くるか‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Wh-what should I do?\nMy fountain of ideas for tricks has\rrun dry...\cPerhaps it is time I toured the country\non a quest to devise new tricks...

sourceRecords.japanese: みとめたくは　ないんだが\nあんたには　まけた‥‥！\rまあ　なんども　きてくれた　あたり\rよっぽど　わがはいに\rみりょくを　かんじたの　だろうが\rそれと　わがはいの　まけは　かんけいなし！\cそうだ！\nがんばりやの　あんたと\rてんさいの　わがはいの\rゆうじょうを　きねんして‥\rこれを　うけとって　くれ！
sourceRecords.english:
I hate to admit defeat, but you have
bested me!\cStill, you must have been reeled in by
my charisma for you to visit me againand again. Yes, you must have!\cBut that has nothing to do with my
losing!\cIn recognition of the friendship
between you, the driven, and the geniusthat is myself, I demand that you takethis keepsake!

sourceRecords.japanese: なに　パソコンに　はいりきらない？\nそんなの　わがはいが　しるか！\c‥‥と　いいたい　ところだけど\nわがはいは　やさしいので　あとで　やろう！
sourceRecords.english: What? No room in your PC?\nWhat am I to make of that?\cI wish I could say that, but I am much\ntoo kind and caring, so come back later!

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cわがはいは　これから\nあらたな　しかけを　もとめて\rたびに　でる　ことに　する‥‥\rあんたも　いつか　ここにきて\rまた　あそんで　いってくれ！\cそれでは　さらば‥！
sourceRecords.english: ... ... ... ... ... ...\cI am leaving on a journey of discovery.\nA quest in search of new tricks.\cI wish that you will one day visit and\nentertain me again.\cAnd now, farewell!

sourceRecords.japanese: よしっ　あんたに\nほうびを　やろう！
なにっ　もちきれない？\nそんなに　なにを　もちあるいてるんだ？\rまあ　せっかく　ここまで　こられたんだし\rほうびは　あとで　やろう！
sourceRecords.english: What? Have you no room for this?\nWhat manner of items do you carry?\cBut fine, since you've reached me,\nyour reward will be with me till later.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんだ　とくいそうな　かお　してからに\nわがはいに　かった　きに　なるのは\rまだ　はやいわ！\rこのあとも　また　しかけを　つくるから\rそれが　おわってから　わがはいを　わらえ！\cそれでは　じかいを　おたのしみに！
sourceRecords.english:
Scrub that smug smirk from your face!
It's much too early to think you've won!\cI'll make new tricks to stump you, I will.
You may mock me only when you're done.\cCome back for the next exciting
installment!

sourceRecords.japanese: おいおい\nわがはいの　ことは　むし　か！\rずいぶん　さみしい　じゃないか
sourceRecords.english: Now, now! You're ignoring me now?\nNow that, I consider heartbreaking!

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　すてき」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER is fabulous.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

sourceRecords.japanese: おぼえさせた　ばかりの　いあいぎりで\nきって　きって　きりまくりよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'll hack and slash my way to victory\nwith the CUT we just learned!

sourceRecords.japanese: ほんき　ださないでよー！
きっても　きっても　あきないわ！
sourceRecords.english: I never get tired of hacking\nand slashing!

sourceRecords.japanese: へんな　やしきに\nまよいこんじゃった‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I wandered into this weird house\nby accident...

sourceRecords.japanese: おまけに　まけちゃった‥‥
さらに　まよっちゃった‥‥\nでられない‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I lost my way, I lost a battle, and I'm\neven more lost... I can't get out...

sourceRecords.japanese: カラクリだいおう　って\nなにもの　なのかしら？
sourceRecords.english: Just who is the TRICK MASTER?

sourceRecords.japanese: きを　とられていたら\nまけちゃったわ！
sourceRecords.english: I lost while I was lost in thought!

sourceRecords.japanese: つよいわ！\nあなたも　なにもの　なの？
[PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　かしこい」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER is smart.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

sourceRecords.japanese: どの　スイッチで\nどの　あなが　ふさがるんだ？
しょうぶ　してたら\nよけい　わかんなくなった！
sourceRecords.english: After that battle, I'm even more\nconfused!

sourceRecords.japanese: きみ　ぼくの　かわりに\nスイッチ　ぜんぶ　おしてきてよ！
sourceRecords.english: Can I get you to push all the buttons\nfor me?

sourceRecords.japanese: おっ！　カラクリやしき\n２どめの　チャレンジだね！
sourceRecords.english: Oh! You're on your second TRICK HOUSE\nchallenge!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶも\nそんなに　つよいの？
カラクリだいおうが　ひとりで\nこの　しかけを　つくってるんだって！
sourceRecords.english: The TRICK MASTER rigged all the tricks\nin this house all by himself.

sourceRecords.japanese: いつか　わたしの　ジムを　つくりたくて\nしかけを　けんきゅうしてるの！
sourceRecords.english: I want to make my own GYM one day.\nSo, I'm studying how to set traps.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶは\nけんきゅう　ぶそく　だったわーっ！
あなた　つよいのね‥\nジムリーダーに　なれるんじゃない？
sourceRecords.english: You're strong, aren't you?\nMaybe even enough to be a GYM LEADER!

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　あこがれ」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER is coveted.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

sourceRecords.japanese: なんども　おなじ　ところに\nもどって　きちゃうよー！
sourceRecords.english: I keep coming back to this same place!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくが　こまってるのに\nダメおしで　かつなんて　ひどいよー！
sourceRecords.english: I'm already having trouble, and then\nyou have to beat me? It's not fair!

sourceRecords.japanese: とびら　だらけで\nせまくて　こわいよー！
sourceRecords.english: It's full of doors here!\nIt's too small and dark in here! Help!

sourceRecords.japanese: なにが　なんだか　わからなくて\nかなしく　なってきたわ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I don't know what's going on here.\nI'm starting to feel sad...

sourceRecords.japanese: ひっ　ひどいわ‥‥
どうせ　あたしは　よわいし\nほうこうおんちよー！
sourceRecords.english: I know I'm weak!\nAnd, I have no sense of direction!

sourceRecords.japanese: いったい　なんの　ために\nこんな　やしきが　あるんだろう‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: I don't get it. What would anyone want\nwith a house this bizarre?

sourceRecords.japanese: いったい　なぜ\nわしは　まけて　しまったんだろう‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: I don't get it.\nHow did I lose?

sourceRecords.japanese: いったい　どれくらいの　しかけが\nこの　やしきに　あるんだろう‥？\cきみなら　わかるかもな
sourceRecords.english: I don't get it.\nHow many traps are in this house?\cYou may be the one to solve that.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　かっこいい」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER is cool.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

sourceRecords.japanese: こういうの　かんがえるのって　めんどう！\nわたしは　しょうぶだけ　したいのにー！
sourceRecords.english: It's too much bother to think this out.\nI only wanted to battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけちゃった　けど　やっぱり\nしょうぶが　いちばん　たのしい！
sourceRecords.english: Even though I lost, I still like battling\nthe best!

sourceRecords.japanese: トレーナーが　いそうな　ところは\nどこにでも　いきたく　なるわよね！
sourceRecords.english: Wouldn't you agree? You would go\nanywhere if TRAINERS were there.

sourceRecords.japanese: このくらいの　いわは\nゆび　いっぽんで　らくしょう　だぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Heh! Boulders like this, I can brush\naside with one finger!

sourceRecords.japanese: いわが　おせても\nパズルが　とけない‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I can push boulders, but I can't solve\nthe puzzle...

sourceRecords.japanese: ちからが　つよいだけじゃ　ダメだね‥‥\nアタマ　つかわないと
sourceRecords.english: It's not good enough to be brawny...\nYou have to use your head. Be brainy!

sourceRecords.japanese: カラクリやしきも　だんだん\nむずかしく　なってきたわね！
sourceRecords.english: The TRICK HOUSE is getting trickier,\nisn't it?

sourceRecords.japanese: ああっ！
さいごまで　いった\nひとって　いるのかしらね？
sourceRecords.english: Has anyone made it to the end?

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　てんさい」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER is a genius.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

sourceRecords.japanese: カタカタ‥\nワガハイ　ハ　からくりニンギョウ　１ゴウ！\cからくりニンギョウ　５ゴウノ　トコロマデ\nツヅケテ　くいずニ　セイカイ　スレバ\rあいことばニ　タドリツケルゾ！
sourceRecords.english: CLICKETY-CLACK...\nMECHADOLL 1 AM I!\cIF YOU ANSWER QUIZZES CORRECTLY,\nTHEN YOU WILL GO TO MECHADOLL 5.\rTHEN YOU CAN OBTAIN THE SECRET CODE.

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　１ゴウ　くいず！\cこのなかで　１０３ばんどうろに\nいない　ポケモンは　どれ？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.\cOne of these POKéMON is not found\non ROUTE 103. Which one is it?

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　１ゴウ　くいず！\cこのなかで　くさタイプが　はいっていない\nポケモンは　どれ？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.\cOne of these POKéMON is not of the\nGRASS type. Which one is it?

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　１ゴウ　くいず！\cこのなかで　ひっかくを\nつかう　ポケモンは　どれ？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.\cOne of these POKéMON uses SCRATCH.\nWhich one is it?

sourceRecords.japanese: オメデトウ　セイカイ　デース！\nオクヘ　ドウゾ！
sourceRecords.english: CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.\nGO THROUGH. PLEASE.

sourceRecords.japanese: ザンネン！\nマチガイ　デーーース！
ワハハハハ！　ワハハハハ！　カタカタ！
マタノ　ちゃれんじ　オマチシテマース！
sourceRecords.english: YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE WE WAIT FOR.

sourceRecords.japanese: カタカタ‥\nワガハイ　ハ　からくりニンギョウ　２ゴウ！\r１ゴウノ　くいずハ　ヤサシスギルヨ！
sourceRecords.english: CLICKETY-CLACK...\nMECHADOLL 2 AM I!\cMECHADOLL 1'S QUIZ DIFFICULTY LEVEL\nIS SET TOO LOW.

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　２ゴウ　くいず！\cオダマキはかせの　かばんの\nいちばん　みぎの　ポケモンは　なんだった？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.\cIn PROF. BIRCH's bag, there were three\nPOKéMON. Which one was at the right?

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　２ゴウ　くいず！\cポケモン　トレーナーズ　スクールで\nこうかん　していた　ポケモンは？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.\cWhich POKéMON was offered for a trade\nat the POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　２ゴウ　くいず！\cトウカのもりで　デボンの　しゃいんが\nさがしていた　ポケモンは　なんだった？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.\cThe DEVON RESEARCHER was looking for\nwhat POKéMON in PETALBURG WOODS?

sourceRecords.japanese: オメデトウ　セイカイ　デース！\nオクヘ　ドウゾ！
sourceRecords.english: CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.\nGO THROUGH. PLEASE.

sourceRecords.japanese: カタカタ‥\nワガハイ　ハ　からくりニンギョウ　３ゴウ！\rオカネニハ　ウルサイノダ！
sourceRecords.english: CLICKETY-CLACK...\nMECHADOLL 3 AM I!\cMATTERS OF MONEY ARE MY SOLE FOCUS.

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　３ゴウ　くいず！\cモンスターボール　３つ　かうのと\nいいキズぐすり　１つ　かうのと\rどっちが　たかい？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.\cWhich costs more?\nThree POKé BALLS or one SUPER POTION?

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　３ゴウ　くいず！\cあなぬけのヒモを　うって\nどくけしを　かうと　いくら　のこる？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.\cSell one ESCAPE ROPE and buy\none ANTIDOTE. How much money remains?

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　３ゴウ　くいず！\cなんでもなおし　と　スーパーボールを　かうと\nげんきのかけら　より　たかくなる？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.\cDo one FULL HEAL and GREAT BALL\ncost more than one REVIVE?

sourceRecords.japanese: オメデトウ　セイカイ　デース！\nオクヘ　ドウゾ！
sourceRecords.english: CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.\nGO THROUGH. PLEASE.

sourceRecords.japanese: カタカタ‥\nからくりニンギョウ　４ゴウ　ヨーン！\rウツクシイ　ワタシノ　くいず　イクワヨ！
sourceRecords.english: CLICKETY-CLACK...\nMECHADOLL 4 THAT IS ME!\cMY QUIZ IS AN OBJECT OF BEAUTY.

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　４ゴウ　くいずヨ！\cカナズミジムリーダー　ツツジの　ポケモン\nイシツブテは　オス　メス　どっち？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.\cRUSTBORO GYM LEADER ROXANNE used a\nGEODUDE. Was it male or female?

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　４ゴウ　くいずヨ！\cムロタウンの　しゅうかいじょでは\nだんせい　じょせい　どっちが　おおい？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.\cIn DEWFORD HALL, were there more men\nor women?

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　４ゴウ　くいずヨ！\cムロタウンの　ジムで　さいしょに　たたかう\nトレーナーは　だんせい？じょせい？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.\cThe first TRAINER in DEWFORD GYM was\nmale or female?

sourceRecords.japanese: オメデトウ　セイカイ　ヨー！\nウフッ　オクヘ　ドウゾ！
sourceRecords.english: CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.\nGO THROUGH. PLEASE.

sourceRecords.japanese: カタカタ‥\nワガハイ　ハ　からくりニンギョウ　５ゴウ！\rダイオウノ　サイコウ　ケッサク！
sourceRecords.english: CLICKETY-CLACK...\nMECHADOLL 5 AM I!\cTHE MASTER'S BEST AND PROUDEST\nACHIEVEMENT AM I.

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　５ゴウ　くいず！\cミスターカゼノが　おもてに\nかざっている　じてんしゃは　なんだい？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.\cHow many BIKES does RYDEL have on\ndisplay outside his cycle shop?

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　５ゴウ　くいず！\cフラワーショップ　サン・トウカで\nきのみを　くれるのは　なんにん？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.\cHow many people give you BERRIES at the\nPRETTY PETAL flower shop?

sourceRecords.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　５ゴウ　くいず！\cミナモシティに　かんばんは\nいくつ　ある？
sourceRecords.english: MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.\cHow many signs are there in\nLILYCOVE CITY?

sourceRecords.japanese: オメデトウ　セイカイ　デース！\nオクヘ　ドウゾ！
sourceRecords.english: CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.\nGO THROUGH. PLEASE.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　いのち」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER is my life.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

sourceRecords.japanese: さいきん　へんな　やしきが　あるって\nきいたから　しらべに　きたのよ！
sourceRecords.english: When I heard there was a strange\nhouse, I had to check it out.

sourceRecords.japanese: つよい　トレーナーを　はっけん！
やしきを　しらべてたら　おもしろくて\nなんかいも　チャレンジ　してるのよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm sure having a good time checking\nthis place out.\cIt's a challenge I've found worth\nrepeating!

sourceRecords.japanese: おいらの　とりポケモンで\nかべを　とびこえて　いっちゃうか‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: Maybe I could get my BIRD POKéMON\nto fly over the wall...

sourceRecords.japanese: わわっ　しまった！
てへへ‥　ズルしようと　したから\nまけちゃったの　かな‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Ehehehe... I guess I lost because I\nwas trying to cheat.

sourceRecords.japanese: かいてん　する　とびらで\nめが　まわってきた‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I'm getting dizzy from these rotating\ndoors...

sourceRecords.japanese: くーるくる　くーるくる\nおれは　もう　ダメだ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Everything's spinning around and\naround. I can't take this anymore...

sourceRecords.japanese: キミは　ぜんぜん　へいき　みたいだね\nそれとも　ポーカーフェイス　なの？
sourceRecords.english: You don't seem to be affected at all.\nOr do you have your poker face on?

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　だきしめたい」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER is huggable.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

sourceRecords.japanese: いつも　カラクリだいおうは　パッと\nきえちゃうけど　どう　やってるんだろ？
sourceRecords.english: The TRICK MASTER always vanishes\nlike smoke. How does he do it?
