sourceRecords.japanese: ひえー\nなんで　そんなに　つよいの？
sourceRecords.english: Aiyeeeh! You're much too strong!\nHow do you do it?

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくも　じゆう　じざいに\nきえたり　あらわれたり　してみたいな
sourceRecords.english: I wish I could appear and disappear as\nif I were smoke, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: おなじところを　つづけて\nなんども　まわると　ふきつなのよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Going around the same spot...\nIt begets ill fortune...

sourceRecords.japanese: まけた‥‥！\nえんぎが　わるいわ‥‥！
わたしは　もう　１０かい　いじょう\nまわってしまった‥‥　ふきつだわ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I've circled the same spot over ten\ntimes now... It's ill fortune...

sourceRecords.japanese: かった　ほうが　さきに　このしかけを\nぬけられる　よかんが　するわ！
sourceRecords.english: Whoever wins will get through here\nfirst. That's the feeling I get.

sourceRecords.japanese: あら！\nじゃあ　おさきに　どうぞ！
あなたは　カラクリやしきの　しかけを\nすべて　とく　って　よかんが　するわ！
sourceRecords.english: You're solving all the puzzles in the\nTRICK HOUSE. That's the feeling I get.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　あいしてる」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER I love.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

sourceRecords.japanese: ここまで　こられる　トレーナーは\nそうは　いないよな！
sourceRecords.english: Not many TRAINERS have made it\nthis far.

sourceRecords.japanese: つまり　キミも\nすごいって　ことだよな‥
sourceRecords.english: That must mean you're tough, too...

sourceRecords.japanese: えっ　ポケモンリーグの　チャンピオンに\nかったって？　す　すごい‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: You've beaten the POKéMON LEAGUE\nCHAMPION? That's too much!

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしと　しょうぶ　できるなんて\nあなた　しあわせよ！
sourceRecords.english: Consider yourself lucky to be\nbattling me!

sourceRecords.japanese: そんな　わたしが\nまけるなんて‥‥！
わたしに　かつなんて　きせきよ！\nじまん　できる　ことだわ！
sourceRecords.english: It's a miracle that you beat me.\nYou can brag about it.

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたも　カラクリやしきに\nちょうせん　しつづけて　いるんですね！
sourceRecords.english: You've been slugging through the TRICK\nHOUSE challenge, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: なるほど‥‥\nすばらしい　センスですね！
sourceRecords.english: I see...\nYou possess an extraordinary style.

sourceRecords.japanese: あなた　みたいな　ひとが　きてくれて\nカラクリだいおうも　まんぞく　でしょうね！
sourceRecords.english: Seeing someone like you should please\nthe TRICK MASTER.

sourceRecords.japanese: サイクリング　ロードでは\nおもいっきり　スピードを　だせるんだ！\cだれにも　ぶつからずに　かけぬけると\nすごく　きもち　いいよ！
sourceRecords.english: On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out\nand cycle as fast as you'd like.\cIt feels great to go that fast, but try\nnot to crash into anyone!

sourceRecords.japanese: サイクリング　ロードを\nあるいて　すすむのは　あぶない　です！\rじてんしゃに　のって　きてください
sourceRecords.english: Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING\nROAD. It's too dangerous.\cPlease come back with a BIKE.

sourceRecords.japanese: サイクリング　ロードでは\nおもいっきり　スピードを　だせるんだ！\cだれにも　ぶつからずに　かけぬけると\nすごく　きもち　いいよ！
sourceRecords.english: On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out\nand cycle as fast as you'd like.\cIt feels great to go that fast, but try\nnot to crash into anyone!

sourceRecords.japanese: サイクリング　ロードを\nあるいて　すすむのは　あぶない　です！\rじてんしゃに　のって　きてください
sourceRecords.english: Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING\nROAD. It's too dangerous.\cPlease come back with a BIKE.

sourceRecords.japanese:
この　あたりは
かざんばい　だらけ　ペコペコ！\cわたし　すごいよ　ペコペコ\cかざんばいを　ガラスに　してね
それで　どうぐ　つくるよ　ペコペコ！\cきみも　これで
かざんばいを　あつめなさい　ペコペコ！
sourceRecords.english: This area is covered in volcanic ash,\nhuff-puff!\cI'm specially gifted, huff-puff.\cI make glass out of volcanic ash\nand make items, huff-puff.\cGo collect ashes with this, huff-puff.

sourceRecords.japanese:
その　ふくろを　もって
はいの　つもった　ところを　あるくとあら　ふしぎ！\cふくろの　なかに　かざんばいが
どんどん　たまっていくよ　ペコペコ！\cかざんばいが　たまったと　おもったら
わたしの　ところに　きなさい　ペコペコ！
sourceRecords.english:
Just take that SOOT SACK and walk
through piles of ash, huff-puff.\cAnd it will fill up with the volcanic ash,
huff-puff.\cOnce you think you've collected a good
amount, come see me, huff-puff.

sourceRecords.japanese: かざんばい　あるのかね　ペコペコ！\nどれどれ　みせてごらん　ペコポコ！
sourceRecords.english: Have you collected ashes, huff-puff?\nLet me see, huff-puff.

sourceRecords.japanese: うーん‥‥\nかざんばいが　すくないよ　ペコペコ！\rガラスのどうぐ　できないよ　ペコペコ！\cあと　[STR_VAR_1]ほ　あるけば\nあおいビードロ　つくれるよ　ペコペコ！
sourceRecords.english: Hmmm...\nThere's not enough ash here, huff-puff.\rI can't make glass with this, huff-puff.\cLet's see... [STR_VAR_1] is the number of steps\nyou'll need to walk for me to make you\ra BLUE FLUTE, huff-puff.

sourceRecords.japanese: おほっ\nかざんばい　あつまってるよ　ペコペコ！\rガラスのどうぐ　つくるよ　ペコペコ！\cどれが　いいかね　ペコペコ
sourceRecords.english: Oh!\nYou've got a lot of ashes, huff-puff!\cI'll make you a glass item, huff-puff!\nWhich one would you like, huff-puff?

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]　だね　ペコペコ！\nほんとうに　それで　いいんだね？　ペコペコ
sourceRecords.english: A [STR_VAR_1], huff-puff?\nIs that the one for you, huff-puff?

sourceRecords.japanese: どれが　いいかね　ペコペコ
sourceRecords.english: Which one would you like, huff-puff?

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]　だね　ペコペコ！\cよしっ！　どうぐを　つくるよ　ペコペコ！\nちょっと　まってなさいよ　ペコペコ
sourceRecords.english: A [STR_VAR_1] it is, then, huff-puff!\cOkay! I'll make it for you, huff-puff.\nJust wait a little while, huff-puff.

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]　だね　ペコペコ！\cだけど　それを　つくるには\nかざんばいが　たりないよ　ペコペコ！\cかざんばいの　つもっている　ところを\nあと　[STR_VAR_2]ほ　あるかないと　ペコペコ！\cどれが　いいかね　ペコペコ
sourceRecords.english:
A [STR_VAR_1], huff-puff?\cThere's not enough ash here to make
that, though, huff-puff.\cLet's see... [STR_VAR_2] is the number of steps
you'll need to walk through volcanic ashfor me to make that item, huff-puff.\cWhich item would you rather have me
make instead, huff-puff?

sourceRecords.japanese: せっかく　かざんばいを　あつめたのに\nほしい　ものは　ないのかね　ペコペコ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: You've collected all that ash, but you\ndon't want anything, huff-puff?

sourceRecords.japanese: おお　[STR_VAR_1]　できたよ\nもって　いきなさいよ　ペコペコ
sourceRecords.english: Ah, I've finished your [STR_VAR_1].\nTake it, huff-puff.

sourceRecords.japanese: あら？\nそれいじょう　もてないよ　ペコペコ\cあずかって　おくから\nこんど　きなさい　ペコペコ
sourceRecords.english: Oh?\nYou've no room in your BAG, huff-puff.\cI'll hold on to it, so come back later,\nhuff-puff.

sourceRecords.japanese: あら？\nパソコン　いっぱい　なのか　ペコペコ\cあずかって　おくから\nこんど　きなさい　ペコペコ
sourceRecords.english: Oh?\nYou've no room in your PC, huff-puff?\cI'll hold on to it, so come back later,\nhuff-puff.

sourceRecords.japanese: あら？\nはいぶくろ　もっていないのか　ペコペコ\cもちあるかないと\nかざんばい　たまらないよ　ペコペコ
sourceRecords.english: Hah? You haven't got your SOOT SACK\nwith you, huff-puff.\cYou have to keep it with you to collect\nvolcanic ash, huff-puff.

sourceRecords.japanese: おやかたが　はなすのに　あわせて\nビードロ　ふくと　たのしか！\cペコペコ！　ペコポコ！
sourceRecords.english: It's fun to blow a glass flute while my\nboss is talking.\cHuff-huff! Puff-puff!

sourceRecords.japanese: リーダーが　ここでの　けんきゅうに\nきょうみを　もったらしくて\rおれらを　よこしたんだ！　ジャマするな！
sourceRecords.english: The BOSS got interested in the\nresearch they have going here, so he\rsent us out.\cYou quit meddling!

sourceRecords.japanese: くそー\nこどもに　まけた‥‥
リーダーは　なんでも　しっている‥‥\cしかし　なにを　かんがえて　いるのか\nしたっぱの　おれらには　さっぱりだ
sourceRecords.english: Our BOSS knows everything.\cBut I'm just a GRUNT. What would I know\nabout what he's thinking?

sourceRecords.japanese: あら？\nどうして　ここに　こどもが　いるのかしら？
あらー\nまけちゃったー！？
あらら‥‥\nこどもに　まけたら　おこられちゃう‥‥\cベッドで　ねてようかしら？
sourceRecords.english: Oh, no...\nI'll catch an earful for losing to a kid...\cI should just take a nap in the bed...

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくが　ベッドで　ねてる　あいだに\nみんな　２かいに　いっちゃったよ
sourceRecords.english: While I was sleeping, everyone went\nupstairs!

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]　つよいんだね！\cぼくも　[STR_VAR_1]　みたいな\nポケモントレーナーに　なりたいや！
sourceRecords.english: Wow, you're really strong!\cI wish I could be a POKéMON TRAINER\nlike you!

sourceRecords.japanese: はかせは　あめが　だいすき　なのです\cですが　あめが　ふりつづくと\nこまってしまう　ひとも　いるわけです\cそこで　はかせは\nこの　あめを　なにかに　つかえないか\rけんきゅう　なさっているのです
sourceRecords.english:
The PROFESSOR loves rain.
That's a fact.\cBut if it keeps raining, people will be in
trouble. That's another fact.\cAnd thus, the PROFESSOR is studying
if the rain can be put to good use.

sourceRecords.japanese: やあ！\nあなたの　おかげで　たすかりましたよ！\rそれにしても‥‥\c[EVIL_TEAM]の　れんちゅうは\nなにを　するつもり　だったのでしょう？
sourceRecords.english: Hello!\nWe've been saved by your actions!\cWhat I don't understand is what on\nearth the [EVIL_TEAM]S were up to.

sourceRecords.japanese: ベッドが　ある‥‥\nやすんでいこう
sourceRecords.english: There's a bed...\nLet's take a rest.

sourceRecords.japanese: この　けんきゅうじょで　うみだされた\nポケモンは　てんきと　かんけいある　って\rきいたから　いただきに　きたのさ！
sourceRecords.english: The INSTITUTE created a type of\nPOKéMON that has something to do with\rthe weather. We're here to take them!

sourceRecords.japanese: こんな　こどもに　じゃま　されるのか！？
sourceRecords.english: Our plan's being spoiled by a kid?

sourceRecords.japanese: ここで　うみだされた　ポケモンが\nもし　てんきを　じゆうに　あやつれるなら\rぜったい　[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　ひつよう　だぜ！
sourceRecords.english: If the POKéMON they made here can\ncontrol the weather freely, then we of\rTEAM [EVIL_TEAM] definitely need it!

sourceRecords.japanese: おれたち　[EVIL_TEAM]だん！\nめずらしい　ものが　ある　ところなら\rどこにでも　あらわれる！
sourceRecords.english: We're TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]!\nWe appear wherever anything rare is\rfound!

sourceRecords.japanese: こいつは　まいった！
[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　りそうを　しらないくせに\nじゃま　するんじゃ　ないよ！
sourceRecords.english: You don't have any idea what we of\nTEAM [EVIL_TEAM] are working towards!\rYou stay out of our way!

sourceRecords.japanese:
オーッホッホ！\cわれわれ　[EVIL_TEAM]だんの
じゃまを　しようと　いうの！？\cもう　こわいものしらず　といおうか
ただの　おろかものと　いおうか‥‥\cかわいすぎて　にくらしく　なっちゃう！
やっつけて　あげるわね！
sourceRecords.english:
Ahahahaha!\cYou're going to meddle in TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]'s
affairs?\cYou're either absolutely fearless,
simply ignorant, or both!\cYou're so cute, you're disgusting!
I'll put you down, kiddy!

sourceRecords.japanese: オーッホッホ！\nつよくて　にくらしく　なっちゃうわ！

オーッホッホ！
おもわぬ　じゃまが　はいっちゃったわ！\cしかたないわね！
ここは　いちど　ひきあげちゃう！\cでもね　[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　かつどうは
まだまだ　つづくんだからおぼえて　おきなさーい！
sourceRecords.english:
Ahahahaha!
We got meddled with unexpectedly!\cWe're out of options.
We'll have to pull out.\cBut this isn't the last you'll see of
TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]! We have other plans!Don't you forget it!

sourceRecords.japanese: ありがとうよ\nきみの　おかげで　たすかったよ\cおれいと　いっては　なんだが\nこの　ポケモンを　もらって　おくれ
sourceRecords.english: Thanks!\nThanks to you, we're safe!\cIt might be an odd way of thanking you,\nbut take this POKéMON.

sourceRecords.english: Aww! Done in!\nBut it's still fun to battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: さてと　グッズでも　かいに　いこうかな\cぼくの　ひみつきちを\nみんなに　たのしんで　ほしい　からね！
sourceRecords.english: Well, anyway, I should go buy some\ndecorations and furniture.\cI want my SECRET BASE to be a place\nother people can enjoy.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおきな　いえも　いいけど\nぼくは　こういう　ばしょが　すきなんだ\cだって　いろいろな　ひとが\nあそびに　きてくれる　からねー！
sourceRecords.english: A big mansion is nice, but I like this\nsort of place more.\cI like it because all kinds of people\ncome visit me.

sourceRecords.japanese:
わたし　グッズの　おかいものが
だいすき　です！\cそれと　おなじくらい　ポケモンを　そだてるの
だいすき　です！\cもし　よかったら　わたしの　ポケモンちゃんと
しょうぶして　くれますか？
sourceRecords.english:
I simply adore shopping for decorations
and furniture.\cI also love raising POKéMON just
as much.\cIf you would be so kind, will you battle
with my POKéMON?

sourceRecords.japanese: それでは　おねがいします
そう　それは　ざんねん　です‥
まいりました‥‥
ああ　たのしかった！\nつぎは　おかいものを　たのしもう　かしら
sourceRecords.english: That was all in good fun!\nI should go enjoy shopping now.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたし　グッズの　おかいものが\nだいすき　です\cそれと　おなじくらい　ポケモンを　そだてるの\nだいすき　です
sourceRecords.english: I simply adore shopping for decorations\nand furniture.\cI also love raising POKéMON just\nas much.

sourceRecords.japanese: みつかり　にくい　ばしょに\nひみつきちを　つくる　ひとが　いるけど\rこっそりと　かくれて　いたいのかなぁ‥‥\cうん　せっかく　みつけて　くれたんだから\nポケモン　しょうぶ　しようか？
sourceRecords.english: Some people make their SECRET BASES in\nhard-to-find places.\rDo they want to just lie low?\cBut since you found me, how about we\nhave a battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: かんたんには　おわらせ　ないよ！
もしかして　さがすのに　つかれちゃった？
sourceRecords.english: Oh... Are you maybe tired from searching\nfor this place?

sourceRecords.japanese: おわっちゃった‥‥
きみの　ひみつきちは　どこなんだい！\nこんど　あそびに　いこうかなー
sourceRecords.english: Where's your SECRET BASE?\nI should go visit you there.

sourceRecords.japanese: みつかり　にくい　ばしょに\nひみつきちを　つくる　ひとが　いるけど\rこっそりと　かくれて　いたいのかなぁ
sourceRecords.english: Some people make their SECRET BASES in\nhard-to-find places.\rDo they want to just lie low?

sourceRecords.japanese: グッズを　てにいれる　ほうほうは\nいろいろ　あるって　はなしよ\cどっちが　すてきな　グッズを\nてにいれるか　きょうそうね！\cついでに　ポケモン　しょうぶも　しない？
sourceRecords.english: People have told me that you can get\ndecorations in several ways.\cWe should have a race to see who can\nget nicer decorations and furniture!\cIn the meantime, want to battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: じぶんの　ひみつきちで　まけられないわ！
sourceRecords.english: This is my SECRET BASE.\nI can't lose!

sourceRecords.japanese: いつでも　しょうぶ　まってるわ！
えっ　もしかして　わたしの　まけ？
グッズあつめ　まけないわよ！\nまた　あそびに　きてね！
sourceRecords.english: I won't lose at collecting decorations.\nCome visit again!

sourceRecords.japanese: グッズを　てにいれる　ほうほうは\nいろいろ　あるって　はなしよ\cどっちが　すてきな　グッズを\nてにいれるか　きょうそうね！
sourceRecords.english: People have told me that you can get\ndecorations in several ways.\cWe should have a race to see who can\nget nicer decorations and furniture!

sourceRecords.japanese: すきな　ばしょを　さがして\nすきな　グッズを　おく！\cすきな　ポケモンを　そだてて\nぼくも　いっしょに　つよくなる\cそんな　ぼくと　しょうぶ　しよう！
sourceRecords.english:
I found a spot I liked, and I did it up
with my favorite decorations.\cI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow
stronger with it.\cThat's what I do.
Want to battle with me?

sourceRecords.japanese: きみの　じつりょくを　みせてくれ！
sourceRecords.english: Show me what you're made of!

sourceRecords.japanese: まぁ　そんな　ときも　あるよね！
sourceRecords.english: I guess there are times when you're not\ninto it.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみの　じつりょくは　じゅうぶん　わかった！
sourceRecords.english: I know exactly what you're made of now.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみも　ぼくも　もっと　つよく　なれる！\nおたがいに　がんばろうね！
sourceRecords.english: We can both become stronger.\nLet's keep at it!

sourceRecords.japanese: すきな　ばしょを　さがして\nすきな　ものを　おく！\cすきな　ポケモンを　そだてて\nぼくも　いっしょに　つよくなる\cまいにち　たのしいねー
sourceRecords.english: I found a spot I liked, and I did it up\nwith my favorite decorations.\cI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow\nstronger with it.\cEvery day is a great day.

sourceRecords.japanese: グッズの　しゅるいや　おきかたを　みれば\nそのひとが　どんな　センスの　もちぬしか\rよーく　わかるわね！\cわたしの　センスは　どうかしら？\nうふふっ　なにも　いえないって　かんじね！\cしょうぶの　センスも　ためして　みる？
sourceRecords.english: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\rdecorations they have, and how they\rdisplay them.\cWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?\cWant to see my taste in battling?

sourceRecords.japanese: おもいっきり　いくわよ！
いつでも　わたしの　センスを　みせるわよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'll be happy to demonstrate my style\nanytime.

sourceRecords.japanese: すごい　さいのうね！\nそこしれぬ　つよさを　かんじたわ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: You're supremely talented!\nYour power seems to be limitless...

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしの　センス　どうだった？\nもっと　センスを　みがくわよー
sourceRecords.english: What did you think of my style?\nI'll keep on polishing it!

sourceRecords.japanese: グッズの　しゅるいや　おきかたを　みれば\nそのひとが　どんな　センスの　もちぬしか\rよーく　わかるわね！\cわたしの　センスは　どうかしら？\nうふふっ　なにも　いえないって　かんじね！
sourceRecords.english: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\rdecorations they have, and how they\rdisplay them.\cWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?

sourceRecords.japanese: えっ　なにを　してるかって？\cポケモンの　わざを　つかって\nここに　ぼくだけの　へやを\rつくろうと　おもってね！\cそうだっ　この　わざマシンを　あげるから\nきみも　つくって　みるかい？
sourceRecords.english:
What's that?
What am I doing?\cI'm thinking about making my own room
here using a POKéMON move.\cI know! I'll give you this TM.
Will you use it to make your own room?

sourceRecords.japanese:
ツルが　おちそうな　きにむかって
ひみつのちからを　つかってごらん！ツルが　おちてきて　きのうえに　のぼれるよ！\cそれでね　うえには　ひろいへやが　あるから
ぼくは　そこに　すきなものを　おくんだ！じぶんだけの　ひみつのへや‥そう　ひみつきちさ！きみも　つくると　いいよー\cそうそう　ひみつきちを　つくれる　ばしょは
きのうえ　だけじゃ　ないよ！\cちいさな　くぼみがある　かべなんかにも
ひみつのちからを　つかって　みるといいよ！\cぼくも　ほかの　ばしょを　さがして　みるね
それじゃ！
sourceRecords.english:
Find a big tree that looks like it might
drop some vines.\cUse SECRET POWER in front of the tree.
Some vines should get free and dropdown, so you can climb the tree.\cYou'll find a lot of space for putting
your favorite things.\cIt'll be your own secret room...
A SECRET BASE!\cYou should make one, too.\cAnother thing, you don't always have
to make your SECRET BASE in a tree.\cTry using SECRET POWER on rock walls
that have small indents in them.\cI'm going to look for other places, too.
Okay, bye!

sourceRecords.japanese: そう　いらないんだ‥\nほしくなったら　また　こえかけてね！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, you don't want this?\nIf you change your mind, tell me, okay?

sourceRecords.japanese: あれ？\nそれいじょうは　もてない　みたいだよ\cまた　こんど　とりに　きてね！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, you don't have any room for this.\cI'll hold on to it, so come back for it\nanother time, okay?

sourceRecords.japanese: ひみつきちの　グッズは　すべて\nパソコンに　もどります\cそれでも　よろしいですか？
sourceRecords.english: All decorations and furniture in your\nSECRET BASE will be returned to your PC.\cIs that okay?

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]の　ひみつきちを\nとうろく　しますか？
sourceRecords.english: Do you want to register\n[STR_VAR_1]'s SECRET BASE?

sourceRecords.japanese: すでに　とうろくされています\nとうろくを　かいじょ　しますか？
sourceRecords.english: This data is already registered.\nWould you like to delete it?

sourceRecords.japanese: とうろく　できる　かずは\n１０かしょ　まで　です\cどれか　かいじょ　すれば\nとうろく　できます
sourceRecords.english: Up to 10 locations can be registered.\cDelete a location if you want to\nregister another location.

sourceRecords.japanese: とうろく　しました！
とうろくを　かいじょ　しました！
もようがえグッズが　ありません‥
[PLAYER]は\nパソコンの　スイッチを　いれた！
なにを　しますか？
sourceRecords.english: What would you like to do?

sourceRecords.japanese: とうろくした　ひみつきちは\nあいてが　ひっこしを　しないかぎり\rなくなる　ことは　ありません\cとうろく　リストから　さくじょすると\nほかの　ひみつきちに\rかわることが　あります\cとうろくは　１０かしょ　まで　できます[PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS]
sourceRecords.english: The registered SECRET BASE will remain\nunless the owner moves away.\cIf it is removed from the registry,\nanother SECRET BASE may take its place.\cUp to ten locations can be registered.[PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS]

sourceRecords.japanese: バトルタワーで　[STR_VAR_1]にん　かちぬいた\nきねんの　[STR_VAR_2]の　たて
sourceRecords.english: A shield of [STR_VAR_2] that marks winning\n[STR_VAR_1] times in a row at the BATTLE TOWER.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほんもの　そっくりの　オモチャのテレビ\nしらない　ひとが　みたら　まちがうかも！？
sourceRecords.english: A realistic toy TV. It could be easily\nmistaken for the real thing.

sourceRecords.japanese: タネボー　みたいな　オモチャのテレビ\nなんだか　ころがりだしそう！？
sourceRecords.english: A toy TV shaped like a SEEDOT.\nIt looks ready to roll away on its own...

sourceRecords.english: A toy TV shaped like a SKITTY.\nIt looks ready to stroll away...

sourceRecords.english: You may only make one SECRET BASE.\cWould you like to move from the SECRET\nBASE near [STR_VAR_1]?

sourceRecords.japanese: ひっこし　かんりょう！\cひみつのちからを　つかいますか？
sourceRecords.english: Moving completed.\cWould you like to use the SECRET POWER?

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモン　つうしん　クラブ\nコロシアム　に　ようこそ\cこちらでは　ともだちと\nポケモンの　たいせんが　たのしめます\cたいせんを　しますか？
sourceRecords.english: Welcome to the POKéMON CABLE CLUB\nCOLOSSEUM.\cYou may battle with your friends here.\cWould you like to battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモン　つうしん　クラブ\nトレードセンター　に　ようこそ\cこちらでは　ともだちと\nポケモンの　こうかんが　たのしめます\cこうかんを　しますか？
sourceRecords.english: Welcome to the POKéMON CABLE CLUB\nTRADE CENTER.\cYou may trade your POKéMON here\nwith a friend.\cWould you like to trade POKéMON?

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモン　つうしん　クラブ\nレコード　コーナー　へ　ようこそ\cこちらでは　トレーナーとしての　レコードを\nともだちと　まぜる　ことが　できます\cともだちと　レコードを　まぜますか？
sourceRecords.english: Welcome to the POKéMON CABLE CLUB\nRECORD CORNER.\cYou may mix your records as a TRAINER\nwith the records of your friends.\cWould you like to mix records?

sourceRecords.japanese:
つうしん　たいせんには　
たいせんの　モードが　３つあります\cシングルバトルは　せんとうに　ポケモンが
１ひきずつでて　ふたりで　たいせん\cダブルバトルは　せんとうに　ポケモンが

sourceRecords.english:
There are three link battle modes.\cSINGLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\cEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.\cDOUBLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with two or more POKéMON each.\cEach TRAINER will send out two
POKéMON in battle at a time.\cMULTI BATTLE is for four TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\cEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.

どちらの　たいせんをしますか？

sourceRecords.english: For a DOUBLE BATTLE, you must have\nat least two POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: こうかんでは　２ひき　いじょうの\nてもちが　ひつようです
sourceRecords.english: For trading, you must have at least\ntwo POKéMON with you.

sourceRecords.english: Hello, there!\cWe're accepting registrations for\n[STR_VAR_1] Rank POKéMON CONTESTS.

sourceRecords.english: Would you like to enter your POKéMON\nin our CONTESTS?

sourceRecords.japanese: どの　せつめいを　ききますか？

ポケモンコンテストは　４にんの　トレーナーが
１ぴきずつ　ポケモンを　もちよって４ひきで　おこなわれます！\cコンテスト　には　１じ　しんさと
２じ　しんさが　あります！\c１じ　しんさでは　かいじょうの
おきゃくさまが　きにいった　ポケモンをとうひょう　します！\c２じ　しんさでは　ポケモンが　じゅんばんに
とくいな　わざで　アピールを　します！しんさいんに　ちゅうもくされたりおきゃくさまに　わざを　きにいられたり‥‥とにかく　たくさん　めだって　ください！\c１じしんさと　２じしんさの　けっかから
そうごうポイントを　だしていちばん　たかかった　ポケモンがゆうしょう　できます！
sourceRecords.english:
A POKéMON CONTEST involves four
TRAINERS entering one POKéMON eachin competitive judging.\cA CONTEST has two stages of judging,
primary and secondary.\cPrimary judging is a popularity poll
involving the audience.\cSecondary judging features appeals
by the POKéMON using their moves.\cPlan appeals carefully to earn the
most attention of the JUDGE andexcite the audience.Do your best to stand out.\cThe primary and secondary scores are
added at the end.\cThe POKéMON garnering the highest
score is declared the winner.

sourceRecords.japanese: コンテストには　５しゅるい　あります！\cかっこよさ　うつくしさ　かわいさ\nかしこさ　そして　たくましさ\rいじょうの　５しゅるい　です！\cエントリー　する　ポケモンに\nピッタリの　コンテストを\rえらんで　あげて　くださいね！
sourceRecords.english: There are five kinds of CONTESTS.\cCOOL, BEAUTY, CUTE, SMART, and\nTOUGH are the five categories.\cChoose the CONTEST that is right for\nthe POKéMON you plan to enter.

sourceRecords.japanese:
ポケモンコンテスト　には
ノーマルランク　スーパーランクハイパーランク　そしてマスターランクという　４つの　ランクが　あります\cノーマルランク　には　すべての
ポケモンが　でることが　できます\cノーマルランクで　ゆうしょう　できた
ポケモンは　おなじ　しゅるいのスーパーランクの　コンテストに　でられます\cおなじように　スーパーで　ゆうしょう　すれば
ハイパーに　ハイパーで　ゆうしょう　すればマスターランクに　でられるのです\cマスターランクで　ゆうしょう　した
ポケモンは　なんどでも　マスターランクのコンテストに　でる　ことが　できます
sourceRecords.english:
There are four ranks of POKéMON
CONTESTS.\cNORMAL, SUPER, HYPER and MASTER
are the four ranks.\cIn the NORMAL Rank, any POKéMON may
enter.\cAny POKéMON that won a NORMAL Rank
CONTEST may move up the SUPER Rank inthe same category.\cIn the same way, a SUPER Rank winner
can move up to the HYPER Rank, and aHYPER Rank winner can advance to theMASTER Rank in the same category.\cA POKéMON that won in the MASTER Rank
may compete in the MASTER Rank asoften as its TRAINER wants.

waiting for!\cLILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE's clear-out
sale has finally arrived!\cAll the thingamajigs and doodads that
you've always dreamt about...\cYou may be in for fateful encounters
with them all!\cThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.

sourceRecords.japanese: この　ばんぐみは\nデボン　コーポレーションの　ていきょうで\rおおくり　いたしました‥‥
sourceRecords.english: This program has been brought to you\nby the DEVON CORPORATION.

sourceRecords.japanese: たいせつ　なのは　ポケモンへの　ラブ\cひつよう　なのは　ちょっとの　ゆうき\cだいじな　ポケモンの　はれぶたい\nポケモン　コンテストに　ようこそ！
sourceRecords.english: What's important is love for POKéMON.\cWhat you need is a little courage.\cLet your cherished POKéMON take\ncenter stage! POKéMON CONTESTS!

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたの　だいじな　ポケモン\nあいじょうを　こめて　そだてます！\cポケモンの　いくせい　なら\n１１７ばんどうろの　そだてや　まで　どうぞ
sourceRecords.english: We raise your beloved POKéMON with\nall of our love!\cFor all your POKéMON-training needs,\nvisit our DAY CARE on ROUTE 117.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふつふつと　わきあがる　えがおの　みなもと\n　　　　　　　　　　　フエン　おんせん
sourceRecords.english: The cauldron of good times and laughs!\nLAVARIDGE SPA.

sourceRecords.japanese: グッズ　いっぱい！　ドキドキ　いっぱい！\nなにかが　みつかる　すてきな　ところ\rおかいもの　なら　ミナモの　デパートで！
sourceRecords.english:
Overflowing with great merchandise
and excitement!\cA great place to find that something
you need!\cVisit LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE for
all your shopping needs!

sourceRecords.japanese: わし　グッズこうかんオヤジ\nわしと　グッズの　こうかん　する？
sourceRecords.english: Hi, I'm the TRADER.\nWant to trade decorations with me?

sourceRecords.japanese: そう‥‥\nわし　ざんねん‥‥
でも　きみとは　このまえ\nグッズの　こうかん　したよね
sourceRecords.english: But we've traded decorations already,\nyou and I.

sourceRecords.japanese: これ　わしが　もってる　グッズ\nなにか　ほしいの　あったら　いってね
sourceRecords.english: If you see any decorative item that\nyou want of mine, speak up.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほしい　グッズ　ないの？\nわし　ざんねん‥‥
sourceRecords.english: You don't want anything?\nI feel unwanted...

sourceRecords.japanese: それは　[STR_VAR_1]さんが\nつかってた　グッズ　だよ\cこれに　するかい？
sourceRecords.english: That decorative item once belonged\nto [STR_VAR_1].\cDo you want it?

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥って　きみ　グッズ\nひとつも　もってない　じゃん！
sourceRecords.english: Uh... Wait a second. You don't have a\nsingle piece of decoration!

sourceRecords.japanese: じゃあ　こうかんに　だしてくれる\nグッズを　えらんで！
sourceRecords.english: Okay, pick the decoration that you'll\ntrade to me.

sourceRecords.japanese: こうかん　して　くれないの？\nわし　ざんねん‥‥
sourceRecords.english: You won't trade with me?\nI feel unwanted...

sourceRecords.japanese: きみ　[STR_VAR_2]が　いっぱいで\nもう　もてないよ
sourceRecords.english: You've got all the [STR_VAR_2]S that can\nbe stored. You've no room for this.

sourceRecords.japanese: じゃあ　わしの　[STR_VAR_3]と\nきみの　[STR_VAR_2]を　こうかん　するよ？
sourceRecords.english: Okay, so we'll trade my [STR_VAR_3]\nfor your [STR_VAR_2]?

sourceRecords.japanese: きみ　いま　そのグッズ　かざってるね\nかざってる　グッズは　こうかん　できないよ
sourceRecords.english: That piece of decoration is in use.\nYou can't trade it.

sourceRecords.japanese: じゃあ　こうかん！\rきみの　パソコンに\nグッズを　おくっておくよ
sourceRecords.english: Then we'll trade!\nI'll send my decoration to your PC.

sourceRecords.japanese: ああ！　ごめん！\nそれ　とっても　レアな　グッズ　だから\rこうかん　できないんだ！\cほかに　ほしい　グッズ　ある？

sourceRecords.japanese: わし　でんせつおやじ\nでんせつの　トレーナーの　はなし　するよ\cわしの　ハナシ　ききたい？

sourceRecords.japanese: そう‥‥\nわし　ざんねん‥‥
わしが　しってる　でんせつは　これだけ\nどの　でんせつが　ききたい？

sourceRecords.japanese: でも　わし‥‥\nでんせつの　トレーナーの　はなし\rなにも　しらない\cどこかに　でんせつに　のこる\nトレーナーは　いないかなあ

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥え！！！\cきみ　[STR_VAR_1]かい　も\n[STR_VAR_2]　の！？\c‥‥ううむ　それは　すごい！\nあたらしい　でんせつの　はじまりだ！
sourceRecords.english:
What's that?!
You... You...\c[STR_VAR_2]
[STR_VAR_1] time(s)?!\cThat is indeed magnificent!
It's the birth of a new legend!

sourceRecords.japanese: これより　もっとすごい\nでんせつを　もってる　トレーナー\rどこかに　いない　かなあ‥

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥きみ　トレーナー？\cだったら　なにか　でんせつっぽい　はなし\nきかせてよ

sourceRecords.japanese: ところで‥\nまだ　でんせつ　ききたい？
sourceRecords.english: Incidentally... Would you care to hear\nanother legendary tale?

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥うーん　ものたりない　なあ\cもっと　すごい　はなしを\nきかせて　ほしいなあ

どんな　ポロックが　できるのかしら？\nドキドキ　しちゃう！
sourceRecords.english: I wonder what kind of [POKEBLOCK] I'll get?\nThis is so exciting!

sourceRecords.japanese: きのみブレンダーで　ともだちと　いっしょに\nきのみから　ポロックを　つくります\cつうしんに　はいる　まえに\nレポートを　かいても　よろしいですか？
sourceRecords.english: [POKEBLOCK]S will be made with your friends \nfrom BERRIES in the BERRY BLENDER.\cIs it okay to save the game before\nlinking with your friends?

sourceRecords.japanese: ともだちを　さがしています\n‥‥Ｂボタンで　キャンセル
sourceRecords.english: Searching for your friends...\n... ... B Button: Cancel

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]さんが　きました
[STR_VAR_1]さんと　[STR_VAR_2]さんが\nきました
[STR_VAR_1]さん　[STR_VAR_2]さん\n[STR_VAR_3]さんが　きました
だれも　きませんでした‥
きのみが　ないので\nきのみブレンダーは　つかえません
sourceRecords.english: You have no BERRIES.\nThe BERRY BLENDER can't be used.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポロックケースが　いっぱい　なので\nきのみブレンダーは　つかえません
sourceRecords.english: Your [POKEBLOCK] CASE is full.\nThe BERRY BLENDER can't be used.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポロックケースが　ないので\nきのみブレンダーは　つかえません
sourceRecords.english: You don't have a [POKEBLOCK] CASE.\nThe BERRY BLENDER can't be used.

sourceRecords.japanese: わしは　ポロックを\nつくるのが　だいすきで\cいつも　きのみを\nもって　きてるんだ
sourceRecords.english: I love making [POKEBLOCK]S.\cI always have some BERRIES with me.

sourceRecords.japanese: もし　よかったら\nいっしょに　きのみブレンダーで\rポロックを　つくろうや
sourceRecords.english: If you'd like, we could make some\n[POKEBLOCK]S together using the\rBERRY BLENDER.

sourceRecords.japanese: あれ？\nきのみを　もってないの？\cしかたないなぁ　もう\cおじさんの　あまった　きのみで\nよければ　あげるよ！
sourceRecords.english: Oh?\nYou don't have any BERRIES?\cWell, that won't do at all now, will it?\cIf you don't mind leftovers, you can\nhave one of my BERRIES.

sourceRecords.japanese: これで　いっしょに　きのみブレンダーで\nポロックを　つくろうや
sourceRecords.english: We'll use it to make [POKEBLOCK]S together\nusing the BERRY BLENDER.

sourceRecords.japanese:
あれ？
きのみを　もってないの？\cおじさんの　あまりが　あれば
あげるん　だけど‥\cきょうは　もう　あまって
ないんだ　すまんな
sourceRecords.english:
Oh?
You don't have any BERRIES?\cIf I had some left over, I'd gladly
give you one...\cBut, I don't have any to spare today.
Sorry about that.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモン　つれていれば\nキミも　りっぱな　ポケモントレーナー！\rボクの　ちょうせん　うけるよね！
sourceRecords.english: If you have POKéMON with you, then\nyou're an official POKéMON TRAINER!\rYou can't say no to my challenge!

sourceRecords.japanese: ああ　まけた‥‥\nもっと　そだてておけば　よかったよ
sourceRecords.english: Arrgh, I lost...\nI should have trained mine more...

sourceRecords.japanese: キミ　つよいなら　つよいって\nさいしょから　いって　くれよな！
sourceRecords.english: Listen, you. If you're strong, you\nshould have told me before!

sourceRecords.japanese: キミに　まけてから　ひっしに\nポケモン　そだてたんだ！　もちろん\rボクの　ちょうせん　うけるよね！
sourceRecords.english: Ever since I lost to you, I desperately\ntrained my POKéMON.\rYou can't say no to my challenge!

sourceRecords.japanese: ああ　まけた‥‥\nそだてかた　わるいのかな
sourceRecords.english: Arrgh, I lost...\nIs my training method not right?

sourceRecords.japanese: キミが　つよくなるなら\nボクも　もっと　つよくなって　みせるよ！
sourceRecords.english: If you're going to get stronger, I'll\nget stronger, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみ　トレーナーに　なったばかり？\nおたがい　しょしんしゃ　だね！
sourceRecords.english: Did you just become a TRAINER?\nWe're both beginners!

sourceRecords.japanese: かてると　おもったから\nこえを　かけたのに！
sourceRecords.english: I called you because I thought I\ncould beat you...

sourceRecords.japanese: まだ　１かいも　かってない‥‥\nはやく　かちたいなあ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I haven't won once yet...\nI wish I would win soon...

sourceRecords.japanese: おっと！　めが　あったな！\nむしポケモンで　あいてを　するぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Hahah! Our eyes met!\nI'll take you on with my BUG POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけてしまった！
めが　あった　トレーナーには\nしょうぶを　いどむのが　きまりさ！
sourceRecords.english: If you lock eyes with a TRAINER,\nyou have to challenge! It's a rule!

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしは　どんどん　かちぬいて\nさいきょうの　トレーナーを　めざすのよ！\cあなたも　きょうりょく　してね！
sourceRecords.english: I'm going to keep winning and aim\nto be the best TRAINER.\cHelp me further my career!

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしが　あなたに\nきょうりょく　しちゃった　みたいね‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I ended up furthering your career...

sourceRecords.japanese: どんどん　かちぬくには\nもっと　たくさん　ポケモンを\rつかまえないと　いけない　みたいね！
sourceRecords.english: To keep winning my way up, I see that\nI have to catch more POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: こころ　やすらぐ　かおりに\nあなたも　さそわれたのですね‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Did you feel the tug of our soul-\nsoothing fragrance?

sourceRecords.japanese: わたくしの　かおりに\nまどわされませんでしたね‥‥
sourceRecords.english: You weren't led astray by our aroma...

sourceRecords.japanese: アロマとは　かおりのこと‥‥\nかおりは　こころと　からだを　いやすのです
sourceRecords.english: Aromatherapy is a form of mental\nhealing that works with fragrances.

sourceRecords.japanese: クミ『あたしは　クミ！\nこっちは　いもうとの　ルミ！\rふたりで　いっしょに　たたかうのよ！
sourceRecords.english: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\rWe battle together!

sourceRecords.japanese: クミ『まけっちゃったよぉ‥‥
クミ『ふたりを　あいてに　するのって\nいろんな　ことを　かんがえるよね！
sourceRecords.english: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\ragainst two TRAINERS.

sourceRecords.japanese: クミ『あら？\nポケモン　１ひきしか　つれてないんだね！\rそれじゃあ　あたしたちと　たたかえないわ！
sourceRecords.english: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\rYou can't battle us like that.

sourceRecords.japanese: ルミ『あたしたちは　ふたりで　ひとり\nいっしょに　たたかうんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.

sourceRecords.japanese: ルミ『まけちゃったよぉ　おねえちゃぁん‥‥
sourceRecords.english: LIV: Oh, we lost, big sister...

sourceRecords.japanese: ルミ『おねえちゃんと　あたしは\nいきが　ぴったり　あってるのに‥‥\cまけちゃったよぉ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: LIV: We work perfectly together, me\nand my big sister...\cBut we still lost...

sourceRecords.japanese: ルミ『あたしたちと　たたかいたいなら\nポケモンを　２ひき　つれてないと　ダメよ！\rじゃないと　しょうぶに　ならないんだから！
sourceRecords.english: LIV: If you want to battle us, you\nhave to have two POKéMON!\rIt's not fair if you don't!

sourceRecords.japanese: クミ『あたしは　クミ！\nこっちは　いもうとの　ルミ！\rふたりで　いっしょに　たたかうのよ！
sourceRecords.english: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\rWe battle together!

sourceRecords.japanese: クミ『くやしい‥‥\nまた　かてなかったよぉ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: AMY: Aww, boo!\nWe couldn't win again...

sourceRecords.japanese: クミ『ふたりを　あいてに　するのって\nいろんな　ことを　かんがえるよね！
sourceRecords.english: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\ragainst two TRAINERS.

sourceRecords.japanese: クミ『あら？\nポケモン　１ひきしか　つれてないんだね！\rそれじゃあ　あたしたちと　たたかえないわ！
sourceRecords.english: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\rYou can't battle us like that.

sourceRecords.japanese: ルミ『あたしたちは　ふたりで　ひとり\nいつも　いっしょに　たたかうんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.

sourceRecords.japanese: ルミ『また　まけちゃったよぉ\nおねえちゃぁん‥‥
sourceRecords.english: LIV: Awww, we lost again...\nBig sister...

sourceRecords.japanese: ルミ『おねえちゃんと　あたしは\nいきが　ぴったり　あってるのに‥‥\cどうして　また　まけちゃったの？
sourceRecords.english: LIV: We work perfectly together, me\nand my big sister...\cBut why did we lose again?

sourceRecords.japanese: ルミ『あたしたちと　たたかいたいなら\nポケモンを　２ひき　つれてないと　ダメよ！\rじゃないと　しょうぶに　ならないんだから！
sourceRecords.english: LIV: If you want to battle us, you\nhave to have two POKéMON!\rIt's not fair if you don't!

sourceRecords.japanese: つりいとが　からまって　イライラするーっ！\nええいっ　しょうぶだっ！
sourceRecords.english: Gah! My fishing line's all snarled up!\nI'm getting frustrated and mean!\rThat's it! Battle me!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけたっ！\nよけいに　イライラするぞーっ！
sourceRecords.english: Gah! Lost it!\nI'm even more annoyed now!

sourceRecords.japanese: ええい　はらだたしい‥‥！\nイライライライラ‥‥
わたしの　ポケモンちゃん\nすごく　かわいいから　みていきたまえ！
sourceRecords.english: My POKéMON is delightfully adorable!\nDon't be shy - I'll show you!

sourceRecords.japanese: あわわ‥‥\nわたしの　ポケモンちゃん！
かわいい　ポケモンちゃんは\nやられた　すがたも　かわいいな‥‥
sourceRecords.english: My delightful POKéMON looks darling\neven when it's fainted!

sourceRecords.japanese: きみ！　わたしの　ポケモンちゃん\nさらに　かわいく　なったのだ！
sourceRecords.english: Hi, you! My delightfully adorable\nPOKéMON has become more darling!

sourceRecords.japanese: ああ！\nわたしの　ポケモンちゃん！
いっしょに　いれば　いるほど\nポケモンが　かわいくなって　たまらん！
sourceRecords.english: The more I spend time with it, the\nmore adorable my POKéMON becomes.

sourceRecords.japanese: ナオ『よーし！\nあたしたちの　ポケモンと　たたかうです！
sourceRecords.english: GINA: Okay, let's battle with our\nPOKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: ナオ『まけて　すごく　くやしいです
ナオ『うわー　[STR_VAR_1]　つよいです！\nあたしたち　もっと　しゅぎょう　するです
sourceRecords.english: GINA: [STR_VAR_1] is strong!\nWe have to train lots more!

sourceRecords.japanese: ナオ『あら？　ポケモン　１ひき　だけですか！\nじゃあ　あたしたち　たたかわない　です！\cだって　ポケモン　１ひき　だけだと\nポケモンが　さびしそうで　かわいそう　です！
sourceRecords.english: GINA: Oh? Only one POKéMON?\nThen, we don't battle with you.\cIf there's only one POKéMON, it will\nbe lonesome. That's not nice.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミオ『あたしたち　ふたご　だから\nポケモンしょうぶも　いっしょに　するです！
sourceRecords.english: MIA: We are twins, so we battle\nPOKéMON together.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミオ『ふたりで　しょうぶ　したのに\nまけちゃったです‥‥
sourceRecords.english: MIA: We battled together, but we\nboth lost...

sourceRecords.japanese: ミオ『もっと　ポケモン　そだてて\n[STR_VAR_1]　みたいに　つよく　なるです！
sourceRecords.english: MIA: We will train our POKéMON more\nand be strong like you.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミオ『あたしたちと　たたかうですか？\cじゃあ　ポケモンを\n２ひき　つれてないと　ダメですよ！\rだって　あたしたち　つよいもん！
sourceRecords.english: MIA: You want to battle with us?\cIt's a big no-no if you don't have two\nPOKéMON with you.\rWe're too strong for you!

sourceRecords.japanese: みずポケモンの　エキスパートとは\nなにを　かくそう　オレのこと！\c‥‥え？\nしらないの？
sourceRecords.english: Why keep it a secret?\nI'm the WATER POKéMON expert!\cHuh?\nYou don't know me?

sourceRecords.japanese: けっこう　つよいと　おもってたんだけどな\nじぶんのこと‥‥　がっかり‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I thought I wasn't too bad, if I may\nsay so, but I guess not... Bleah...

sourceRecords.japanese: つりに　むちゅうに　なってて\nポケモン　そだてるのを　わすれてたよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I got too into fishing.\nI forgot I had to raise my POKéMON...

sourceRecords.japanese: すなはまに　あしあと　つけるのって\nたのしーよねー！
sourceRecords.english: Leaving footprints in the sand is\nso fun!

sourceRecords.japanese: うへーっ！\nクツに　すなが　はいって　ジャリジャリする！
sourceRecords.english: Waah! I got sand in my runners!\nThey're all gritty!

sourceRecords.japanese: すなはまを　ボクの　あしあとで\nいっぱいに　したいんだけど\rすぐに　きえちゃうんだよなぁ
sourceRecords.english: I want to leave my footprints in the\nsand everywhere, but they disappear\rquickly...

sourceRecords.japanese: しょうぶ　しようかな‥‥\nやめとこうかな‥‥\cえーい！　たたかっちゃえ！
sourceRecords.english: Should I...\nOr shouldn't I?\cOkay, sure, I will battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: たたかわなければ　よかったかな‥‥
どっちに　しようか　まよってる　とき\nじぶんで　きめないで　たにんに　まかせると\rどっちに　なっても　こうかいするね‥‥
sourceRecords.english: If you're faced with a decision and\nyou let someone else choose for you,\ryou will regret it, however things\rturn out.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたしと　しょうぶ　してもらうわよ！
うーん‥‥\nかてると　おもったのにな
たたかうって　じぶんで　きめたから\nまけても　すっきり　してるわ！\c‥‥もちろん　まけて　くやしいけどね
sourceRecords.english: I made the decision to battle, so I\ncan accept this loss in grace.\cI am still upset about losing!

sourceRecords.japanese: ボクが　あいてして　あげるよ\nこの　おかねもちの　ボクがね
sourceRecords.english: Oh, sure, I'll accept your challenge.\nI have a lot of money.

sourceRecords.japanese: どうして　かてないんだ‥‥！？
おかねじゃ　かてない　ものが　ある‥‥\nそれが　ポケモンなんだね‥‥
sourceRecords.english: There are some things money can't buy.\nThat's POKéMON...

sourceRecords.japanese: きみに　まけてから　いろいろ\nポケモンのこと　べんきょう　したんだ！
sourceRecords.english: After I lost to you, I learned a bunch\nof things about POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: また　まけた‥‥\nどうして　かてないんだ‥‥！？
sourceRecords.english: I lost again?\nWhy couldn't I win?

sourceRecords.japanese: おかねもちの　ボク　なのに\nなかなか　ポケモンに　かてない‥‥\cなんて　おくが　ふかいんだろう\nポケモンって‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I'm fabulously wealthy, but I can't\nseem to win at POKéMON...\cIt's so deep, the world of POKéMON...

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたと　であったのも　なにかの　ごえん\nおてあわせを　おねがい　できるかしら
sourceRecords.english: We must have been fated to meet.\nMay I ask you for a battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: まあ！
であいは　わかれの　はじまり‥‥\nまた　どこかで　おあいしましょう
sourceRecords.english: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.

sourceRecords.japanese: また　おあい　しましたわね\nおてあわせ　おねがい　できるかしら
sourceRecords.english: Hello, we meet again.\nMay I ask you for a battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: あら‥‥\nわたくし　ベストを　つくしましたのに‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Oh, my...\nI did the best that I could...

sourceRecords.japanese: であいは　わかれの　はじまり‥‥\nまた　どこかで　おあいしましょう
sourceRecords.english: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.

sourceRecords.japanese: この　あたりに\nふしぎな　いわが　あるらしいが\rきみ　しらないかい？
sourceRecords.english: There's supposed to be a mystical\nrock around here.\rDo you know anything about it?

sourceRecords.japanese: いわのこと　ばかり　かんがえて\nポケモン　よわいまま　だったか‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I was thinking too much about that\nrock, while my POKéMON remained weak...

sourceRecords.japanese: すてきな　いわ　だったら\nなんじかん　みていても　あきないよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I can spend hours and hours staring\nat a nice rock without growing bored.

sourceRecords.japanese: よかった！　こどもが\nおぼれているのかと　しんぱい　したよ！\cだいじょうぶ　そうだから　しょうぶ　だな！
sourceRecords.english: Whew! I was worried that a kid was\ndrowning when I saw you.\cYou seem to be okay, so what do you\nsay to a battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: ゴボゴボ‥‥
すなはまに　むかって　かたてを　ふるのが\nおぼれたときの　サインだぜ！
sourceRecords.english: If you are drowning, the signal is to\nwave one arm toward the beach.

sourceRecords.japanese: あおい　うみで　およいでいると\nさいこうの　きぶん　だな！
sourceRecords.english: Swimming the deep blue sea...\nIt feels the greatest!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけた‥‥\nブルーな　きぶん‥‥
うみが　あおい　りゆう！？\cカイナの　はくぶつかんで　きいたけど\nそんなの　わすれちまったよ！
sourceRecords.english: Why is the sea blue?\cI learned about that at the MUSEUM in\nSLATEPORT, but I forgot.

sourceRecords.japanese: みずに　はいると　からだが　かるくなるわね\nなんだか　スリムに　なったみたい！
sourceRecords.english: My body feels lighter in the water.\nIt's as if I've gotten slimmer!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぷかぷか‥‥
みずの　なかでは　たいじゅうが\n１０ぶんの１　くらいに　なるのよ\cと　すると　いま　わたしは‥‥\nいけない！　たいじゅうが　バレちゃうわ！
sourceRecords.english: Your body weight is reduced to just\none tenth in the water.\cThat would make me...\nWhoops! I'm not telling you my weight!

sourceRecords.japanese: あおい　そら‥‥\nひろい　うみ‥‥\rのどか　よねー‥‥
sourceRecords.english: The blue, blue sky...\nThe vast sea...\rIt's so peaceful...

sourceRecords.japanese: なごんでいる　うちに\nまけちゃったわーっ！
sourceRecords.english: I lost while I was lounging!

sourceRecords.japanese: あたしと　いると　なごむって　いわれたいの\nうふふふふ！
sourceRecords.english: I want to be told I'm relaxing to be\nwith. Giggle.

sourceRecords.japanese: うみづりと　かわづり\nキミは　どっちが　すき？
sourceRecords.english: Which do you prefer, fishing in the\nsea or a stream?

sourceRecords.japanese: まるで　うみづりの　ように\nごうかいに　まけたぞーっ！
sourceRecords.english: Like in deep-sea fishing, I lost\nspectacularly!

sourceRecords.japanese: うみでも　かわでも　つりは　サイコーだ！\nキミも　そう　おもうだろ！？
sourceRecords.english: Fishing is the greatest whether it's\nin the sea or a stream.\rYou agree with me, right?

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモン　つりまくったからね\nすごい　しょうぶを　してみせるぞー！
sourceRecords.english: I caught a bunch of POKéMON fishing.\nI'll show you an impressive battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: また　ごうかいに　まけたぞーっ！
かっても　まけても　ポケモンは　サイコーだ！\nキミも　そう　おもうだろ！？
sourceRecords.english: Win or lose, POKéMON are the greatest!\nYou agree with me, right?

sourceRecords.japanese: トイレに　いきたくなったとき\nみんなは　どうしてるんだろう‥‥？\cトイレに　いっている　あいだに\nもし　おおものが　かかったらと　おもうと‥‥
sourceRecords.english: What do people do if they need to go\nto a washroom?\cWhat if my ROD hooks a big one while\nI'm in the washroom? I just can't go...

sourceRecords.japanese: トイレを　がまん　してたから\nまけたんだよ　きっと‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I lost because I'm trying to not go\nto the washroom...

sourceRecords.japanese: ああっ！\nおおものが　つれそうな　よかん‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, no! I've got this feeling I'll hook\na big one!

sourceRecords.japanese: はっはっはっ！\nりくでは　はやく　はしれないが\rみずの　なかなら　まけないぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Hahahah! I'm a lousy runner, but in\nthe water you can't catch me!

sourceRecords.japanese: まいりましたーっ！
すいえいの　きょうそうなら　まけないのに‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I wouldn't lose in a swim race...

sourceRecords.japanese: うみは　わたしの　にわ\nこども　だからって　てかげん　しないわよ！
sourceRecords.english: The sea is my backyard. I'm not going\nto take it easy because you're a kid!

sourceRecords.japanese: ひょっとして\nてかげん　してないよね？
sourceRecords.english: Did you take it easy on me by any\nchance?

sourceRecords.japanese: なみに　ゆられて　ただようのが　だいすき\nあなたも　やってみない？
sourceRecords.english: Drifting along with the waves...\nI love it! Why don't you give it a try?

sourceRecords.japanese: むにゃむにゃ‥‥\cなみに　ゆられてたら　きもちよくなって\nうっかり　ねてしまった！
sourceRecords.english: Yawn...\cI must have drifted off to sleep while\nI was drifting in the waves.

sourceRecords.japanese: あはは　まけた‥‥\nまた　ねますか‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Ahaha, I lost...\nI'll take a snooze, I think...

sourceRecords.japanese: うみに　うかんで　なみに　ゆられてると\nふかふかの　ベッドで　ねてる　みたいだよ！
sourceRecords.english: Floating and being rocked by the\nwaves - it's like sleeping in a plush,\rcomfy bed.

sourceRecords.japanese: うみは　オレの　にわ　みたいな　もの！\nしょうぶ　しようぜ！
sourceRecords.english: The sea is like my backyard.\nLet's battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: ホームグラウンドで　まけた‥‥\nショック！
sourceRecords.english: I lost on my home field...\nI'm in shock!

sourceRecords.japanese: おおきな　ユメを　いっぱい　つめてー\nでっかい　うみを　ひとおよぎー\cさぁて　まだまだ　およぐぞー！
sourceRecords.english: I swim the seas with a heart full of\ndreams...\cIt's a song!\nAnyways, I'm swimming some more.

sourceRecords.japanese: でっかい　うみを　およいでいたら\nポケモンが　すっごく　つよくなったぞー！
sourceRecords.english: Swimming in the big, wide sea, my\nPOKéMON has grown stronger!

sourceRecords.japanese: ショック！！\cポケモンは　つよくなったが\nトレーナーの　おれが　よわいまま！？
sourceRecords.english: What a shock!\cMy POKéMON has gotten stronger, but\nI stayed weak as a TRAINER!

sourceRecords.japanese: たたかいの　なかで　おぼえたことが\nトレーナーとしての　つよさに　つながる！\rでっかい　うみが　そう　いっていたぞー！
sourceRecords.english: What you learn in battle makes you a\nstronger TRAINER.\rThe waves taught me that.

sourceRecords.japanese: ムロタウン　っていう\nちいさな　まちを　しってる？
sourceRecords.english: Do you know a little town called\nDEWFORD?

sourceRecords.japanese: ヤダ　もーっ！
ムロタウンの　しゅうかいじょで\nふしぎな　ことばが　はやって　いるのよ！
sourceRecords.english: A weird saying is getting really\ntrendy at DEWFORD HALL.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしと　しょうぶが　したいの？\nいいわ！　あいてに　なって　あげる！
sourceRecords.english: Did you want to battle me?\nSure, I'll go with you!

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしじゃ　あいてに　ならなかったわ！
sourceRecords.english: I wasn't good enough for you.

sourceRecords.japanese: あなた　まだまだ　つよく　なりそうね\nわたしも　がんばろうっと！
sourceRecords.english: I think you're going to keep getting\nbetter. I'll go for it, too!

sourceRecords.japanese: ユミ『あたしたち　きょうだい　ふたりで\nしょうぶを　させてもらうわ！
sourceRecords.english: LISA: We challenge you as a sister\nand brother!

sourceRecords.japanese: ユミ『すごいわ\nつよさの　レベルが　ちがうのね
sourceRecords.english: LISA: Awesome.\nYou're in a different class of tough.

sourceRecords.japanese: ユミ『あなたは　いっしょに\nうみに　あそびに　いくような\rおともだち　いるのかしら？
sourceRecords.english: LISA: Do you have any friends who\nwould go to the beach with you?

sourceRecords.japanese: ユミ『アタシたちと　たたかうなら\nポケモン　もっと　つれてきなさいな
sourceRecords.english: LISA: If you want to battle with us,\nbring more POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: シン『いつも　きょうだいで\nポケモンしょうぶ　してるんだ！\c‥‥いっつも　おれが　まけるけど\n２たい２なら　きみに　かてるよ！
sourceRecords.english: RAY: We always battle POKéMON, me\nand my sister.\cI always lose, but we can beat you\n2-on-2!

sourceRecords.japanese: シン『ひゃー\nつよさの　レベルが　ちがいすぎるや
sourceRecords.english: RAY: Wowee, you're at a higher level\nthan us!

sourceRecords.japanese: シン『おれの　ポケモン\nねえちゃんから　もらって　そだてた\rだいじな　あいぼう　なんだぜ！
sourceRecords.english: RAY: My sister gave me my POKéMON.\nI raised it, and now it's my important\rpartner!

sourceRecords.japanese: シン『オレらと　たたかうなら\nもっと　ポケモン　つれてきてよ！
sourceRecords.english: RAY: If you want to battle us, go\nbring some more POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: オレの　ユメは　せかいに　ある\n７つのうみ　すべてで　およぐこと！
sourceRecords.english: My dream is to swim the world's seven\nseas!

sourceRecords.japanese: これじゃ\n７つのうみ　すべてで　およげない‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I won't be able to swim the seven seas\nlike this...

sourceRecords.japanese: うみの　ポケモンと　あそぶことも\nおよいでいる　ときの　たのしみだね！
sourceRecords.english: Playing with marine POKéMON is one of\nthe pleasures of swimming!

sourceRecords.japanese: なあ　キミ！\nキミも　すてられた　ふねに　いくのかい？
sourceRecords.english: Ahoy, there! Are you going out to the\nABANDONED SHIP, too?

sourceRecords.japanese: ああ　ぼくが　しずむ‥‥\nぶくぶく‥‥
すてられぶねの　なかに\nはいっていく　やつらが　いるんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: Some people even go inside that\nABANDONED SHIP.

sourceRecords.japanese: ウソつきな　カレに　いわれたのよ\nビキニが　にあってて　カワイイって‥‥
sourceRecords.english: My liar of a boyfriend told me that\nI look great in a bikini...

sourceRecords.japanese: いやん　まけたわーっ！
ウソでも　いいから　カワイイって　いわれたい\nふくざつな　おんなごころ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Even if it's a lie, I love being told\nI look great...\rWe girls are so complex...

sourceRecords.japanese: うみって　だいすき！\nおよいでいれば　イヤなことも　わすれるわ！
sourceRecords.english: I love the sea!\nI forget all my worries when I swim!

sourceRecords.japanese: しょうぶに　まけると\nストレスが　たまるーっ！
sourceRecords.english: When I lose a battle, I get all\nstressed out!

sourceRecords.japanese: ストレスは　およいで　はっさん！\nけんこうてき　よねー！
sourceRecords.english: Work off your stress by swimming!\nIt's so healthy!

sourceRecords.japanese: うりゃーっ！！\nみごとに　われた　ふっきんを　みろーっ！！
sourceRecords.english: Hiyah! Look at my chiseled abs!\nThis is what you call “cut”!

sourceRecords.japanese: うりゃーっ！！\nまけたーっ！！
うりゃーっ！！\cふっきんと　ポケモンの　しょうぶは\nかんけい　ないぞーっ！！
sourceRecords.english: Hiyah!\cMy sculpted abs have nothing to do\nwith POKéMON battles!

sourceRecords.japanese: ひやけ　たいさく\nあなたは　してる？
sourceRecords.english: Are you properly protected against\nthe sun?

sourceRecords.japanese: あちちちちっ！
ほっぺの　あたりが　いちばん\nひやけ　しやすい　ばしょ　なのよ！
sourceRecords.english: Cheeks are the most prone to burning!

sourceRecords.japanese: せかいじゅうの　みなとを　おとずれたが\nカイナは　さいこーの　みなとまち　だぜ！
sourceRecords.english: I've laid anchor in ports around the\nworld, but SLATEPORT's the best.

sourceRecords.japanese: あんた　さいこー　だぜ‥‥
さいこーの　みなとまちには\nさいこーの　トレーナーが　いたぜ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: In the best port was the best\nTRAINER...

sourceRecords.japanese: ううう‥‥\nしょうぶ　するの？　オレと？
げろげろ‥‥
いつもは　もっと　つよいんだぞ！\nふなよいで　ちょうしが　わるいだけだ！\cふなのり　だけど‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I'm usually stronger than this!\nI'm just seasick as a dog!\cI'm a SAILOR, but...

sourceRecords.japanese: のどが　かわいたよ‥‥\nうみのいえで　サイコソーダ　のみたいな‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I'm thirsty... I could go for a SODA POP\nat the SEASHORE HOUSE...

sourceRecords.japanese: うーん‥‥
おなかも　へってきた‥‥\nうきわが　おっきな　ドーナッツに　みえるよ
sourceRecords.english: I'm getting famished... My inner tube\nlooks like a giant doughnut...

sourceRecords.japanese: おなか　へってるけど\nしょうぶ　するなら　げんき　だよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm hungry, but I've got enough pep in\nme for a battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけた‥‥\nおなかが　へってるからだ
すなはまで　たべると\nなんでも　おいしく　おもえるよね
sourceRecords.english: When you eat on a beach, everything\nseems to taste a little better.

sourceRecords.japanese: ビーチパラソルって\nおおきな　おはな　みたいよねー！
sourceRecords.english: Doesn't a beach umbrella look like\na giant flower?

sourceRecords.japanese: ママーっ！
おそらの　うえから　すなはまを　みたら\nおはなばたけ　みたいに　みえるのよ！
sourceRecords.english: If you look at the beach from the sky,\nit looks like a big flower garden!

sourceRecords.japanese: もう　あなたには　まけません！\nそのために　うきわ　してるんだから！
sourceRecords.english: I'm not losing to you again!\nThat's why I have my inner tube!

sourceRecords.japanese: ママーっ！
うきわ　もってると　あたしと　ポケモンの\nかわいさが　ぐぐーんと　アップするの！
sourceRecords.english: If I have an inner tube, me and my\nPOKéMON's cuteness goes way up!

sourceRecords.japanese: うきわが　ないと　およげないけど\nポケモンなら　だれにも　まけないよ！
sourceRecords.english: I can't swim without my inner tube,\nbut I won't lose at POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: うきわが　あるから　まけちゃったのかな？
sourceRecords.english: Did I lose because I have an inner\ntube?

sourceRecords.japanese: あたしの　うきわ\nオシャレだから　てばなせないの
sourceRecords.english: My inner tube is a fashion item.\nI can't be seen without it.

sourceRecords.japanese: そこの　トレーナーさん\nあたしと　たたかう　でちゅ！
sourceRecords.english: Hi, big TRAINER.\nWill you battle with me?

sourceRecords.japanese: つよいでちゅね‥‥
どうしたら　そんなに\nつよくなれる　でちゅか‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: How did you get to be so strong?

sourceRecords.japanese: わはは！\nおじさん　おおもの　つっちゃうぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Wahahah! This dude's going to catch\nhimself a big one!

sourceRecords.japanese: おじさん　まけちゃったな‥‥
たしかに　きみは　おおもの　だな！\nいや　きっと　おおものに　なるぞ！
sourceRecords.english: This dude thinks you're a big one.\nNo, you're a big-one-to-be!

sourceRecords.japanese: リキ『やあ　こまったなあ\cふたりっきりの　じかん\nじゃま　して　ほしくないなあ
sourceRecords.english: PAUL: Well, this is a mood-breaker.\cI wish you wouldn't disturb our\nprecious time together.

sourceRecords.japanese: リキ『やあ　まいったな‥‥
リキ『やあ　ぼくたちが　ここに　いること\nだれにも　いわないで　くれよ！\rふたりっきりの　せかい　なんだからさ！
sourceRecords.english: PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that\nwe're here.\rThis is just our private world of two!

sourceRecords.japanese: リキ『ぼくたち　ラブラブ　だからね\nぼくたちの　ポケモンも\r２ひき　いっしょに　たたかわせるんだ！
sourceRecords.english: PAUL: We're totally, deeply in love.\nThat's why we make our POKéMON battle\rtogether.

sourceRecords.japanese: シキ『あたしたちが　ラブラブだから\nホウエンは　あっついのよお！
sourceRecords.english: MEL: We're, like, totally in love.\nOur romance is heating up all of HOENN!

sourceRecords.japanese: シキ『あたしの　せいで　まけたんだわ‥‥\nこんなんじゃ　リキに　きらわれちゃう！
sourceRecords.english: MEL: We lost, and it's my fault!\nPAUL will hate me!

sourceRecords.japanese: シキ『ねえ　リキ\nあたしのこと　おこってない？\rおこっちゃ　いやよ
sourceRecords.english: MEL: Um, PAUL, are you angry with me?\nPlease don't be angry.

sourceRecords.japanese: シキ『あたしたち　ラブラブ　だからね\nあたしたちの　ポケモンも\r２ひき　いっしょに　たたかわせるんだ！
sourceRecords.english: MEL: We're, like, deeply and truly in love.\nThat's why we make our POKéMON\rbattle together.

sourceRecords.japanese: おっと　あぶない！\nバイク　レースに　なれてない　ようだな！
sourceRecords.english: Whoa! Watch it!\nI guess you're not used to BIKE racing.

sourceRecords.japanese: キキーッ！\nブレーキが　こしょうした！
タイヤの　パンクや\nブレーキの　こしょうは　ケガのもと\rちゃんと　てんけん　しないとな
sourceRecords.english: Flat tires and brake problems can\ncause serious injury!\rInspect your BIKE for problems!

sourceRecords.japanese: ヘイ　ユー！\nワタシの　スピードに　ついてこれるかな！？
sourceRecords.english: Yo, you!\nCan you keep up with my speed?

sourceRecords.japanese: オー　マイ　ガッ！
スピードだけじゃ　ポケモンしょうぶ\nかてませーん！　ハンセイしまーす！
sourceRecords.english: Speed alone won't let me win at POKéMON.\nI need to reconsider this...

sourceRecords.japanese: じてんしゃの　スピード　でても\nあせっちゃ　いけないよ！
sourceRecords.english: Don't panic if your BIKE's going fast!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶも\nあせっちゃ　いけないな‥‥
あせらず　のんびり　いこうよ\nじかんは　たっぷり　あるからね！
sourceRecords.english: There's no need to panic or stress.\nTake it easy. There's plenty of time.

sourceRecords.japanese: おっ！　スピード　だしすぎ　じゃない？\nちょっと　のんびり　しょうぶ　しようよ！
sourceRecords.english: Aren't you going a little too fast?\nTake it easy and let's battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: べつに　あせってないけど\nなぜだか　まけて　しまうな‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I didn't panic, but I still lost...

sourceRecords.japanese: あせらず　のんびり　いこうよ\nじかんは　たっぷり　あるからね！
sourceRecords.english: There's no need to panic or stress.\nTake it easy. There's plenty of time.

sourceRecords.japanese: トライアスロンは　ハードな　スポーツ\nすいえい　じてんしゃ　マラソンの\r３しゅもくを　こなすのよ！
sourceRecords.english: The triathlon is hard in the extreme.\cYou have to complete the three events\nof swimming, cycling, and running.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモン　しょうぶも　ハードだわ！
つかれたから　ひとやすみ\nきゅうけいは　たいせつ　なのよ
sourceRecords.english: I'm exhausted, so I need a break.\nIt's important to get proper rest.

sourceRecords.japanese: じてんしゃに　のりながら\nポケモンしょうぶ　ってのも　いいものよね！
sourceRecords.english: Isn't it neat to hold a battle while\ncycling?

sourceRecords.japanese: うわー\nどうして　そんなに　つよいの？
sourceRecords.english: Wow...\nHow could you be so strong?

sourceRecords.japanese: ひょっとして　きろくに\nちょうせん　していたのかしら？\cだったら　ジャマして　ゴメンねー
sourceRecords.english: Were you going after a record?\cI'm sorry if I held you up!

sourceRecords.japanese: じてんしゃを　こぎつづけて\nふとももが　パンパンに　なっちゃった
sourceRecords.english: I've been riding without stopping.\nMy thighs are like rocks!

sourceRecords.japanese: きんにくつうが　しんぱいだわ‥‥
ジムの　バッチを　もってるの？\nどうりで　つよい　はずだわ！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, you have some GYM BADGES?\nNo wonder you're so strong!

sourceRecords.japanese: おまえの　さくせんは　すべて　みえた！\nわたしが　まけるはず　ない！
sourceRecords.english: I have foreseen your intentions!\nI cannot possibly lose!

sourceRecords.japanese: じぶんの　はいぼくは　みえなかった‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: I failed to prophesize my own demise!

sourceRecords.japanese: おまえの　みらいが　みえる‥‥\cふうむ‥‥\nあかるい　ひかりが　みえるぞ‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: I see your future...\cHmm...\nI see a shining light...

sourceRecords.japanese: おほほほほっ！\nわたくしの　ミラクルを　みせてあげるわ！
sourceRecords.english: Ahahahaha!\nI'll dazzle you with my wonders!

sourceRecords.japanese: ミラクルに　まけたーっ！
わたくしに　かったことが　ミラクル‥‥\nそう　きせき　なのよ！\rいつでも　かてるなんて　おもわないことね！
sourceRecords.english: You managed to win only because it was\na wonder! Yes, a wonder!\rDon't think you can win all the time!

sourceRecords.japanese: キミの　ポケモン　みせてくれない？\nひとめで　いいから　おねがい！
sourceRecords.english: Could I see your POKéMON?\nJust one look, please?

sourceRecords.japanese: コンプリート　したかった‥‥！
みたことのない　ポケモンに　であうと\nボクの　コレクターだましいが　もえるなぁ！
sourceRecords.english: When I see a POKéMON that I don't know,\nmy passion as a collector is ignited!

sourceRecords.japanese: ねえ　キミ\nあたらしい　ポケモン　つかまえた？\cよかったら　ポケモン　みせてくれない？\nひとめで　いいから　おねがい！
sourceRecords.english: Hi, have you caught any new POKéMON?\cCould I see your POKéMON?\nJust one look, please?

sourceRecords.japanese: キミの　ポケモン\nうらやましいな‥‥
ああ！　とにかく　めずらしい　ポケモン\nぜんぶ　ボクの　ものに　したいよー！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, I long to make all rare POKéMON\nmine!

sourceRecords.japanese: ええーい！\nうしろから　はなしかけるなー！
sourceRecords.english: Hey!\nDon't sneak up behind me like that!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけたっ！\nくやしいっ！！
すいめんに　うかぶ　うきを　じっと　みる‥‥\nしゅうちゅうりょくが　たいせつ　なんだ
sourceRecords.english: Fishing is all about concentration.\nYou have to focus on the floater.

sourceRecords.japanese: おほほ！　だいじな　ポケモンを\nじまん　するためなら　どこにでも　いきますわ
sourceRecords.english: Ahahaha! I would go anywhere to show\noff my delightful POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: あら　まあ　イヤですわ
しょうぶ　させるよりも\nコンテストで　がんばろう　かしら？
sourceRecords.english: Perhaps I should groom my POKéMON for\nCONTESTS rather than battles.

sourceRecords.japanese: おほほ！　だいじな　ポケモンなら\nなんどだって　じまん　しますわ！
sourceRecords.english: Ahahahaha! I would be happy to show\noff my POKéMON as often as you like!

sourceRecords.japanese: あら　まあ　イヤですわ
コンテストも　いいけど\nしょうぶ　するのも　すきなのよ！
sourceRecords.english: CONTESTS are delightful, but I like\nto battle, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: この　あたりの　くさむらで\nかっこいい　ポケモン　みつけたんだぜ！
sourceRecords.english: I found some cool POKéMON in the grass\naround here!

sourceRecords.japanese: かっこいい　だけじゃ　だめかぁ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Being cool isn't enough to win...

sourceRecords.japanese: つかまえた　ばかりの　ポケモンじゃ\nうまく　たたかえないや！
sourceRecords.english: It's hard to battle with POKéMON you\njust caught.

sourceRecords.japanese: おっ！　ゴーゴーゴーグル　にあってるね！\nでも　ぼくの　ほうが　にあってるだろ？\rどっちが　にあうか　しょうぶだよ！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, hey! Those GO-GOGGLES suit you.\nBut I think they look better on me.\cLet's decide who they look better on\nwith a battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: ゴーゴーゴーグルで　まわりが\nよく　わからなかったよ
sourceRecords.english: I couldn't see what was happening at my\nsides because of the GO-GOGGLES.

sourceRecords.japanese: ゴーゴーゴーグルが　あると\nさばくの　すなあらしも　へいき　だから\rそれだけで　うれしくなるよ！
sourceRecords.english: The GO-GOGGLES make it possible to\nget through sandstorms.\rThat makes me happy!

sourceRecords.japanese: さばくの　なかでも　ピクニック！\cどんな　ところでも　トレーナー　いるから\nしょうぶも　できるもんね！
sourceRecords.english: I'm having a picnic in the desert.\cYou can always find a TRAINER, so\nI can enjoy a battle here, too!

sourceRecords.japanese: いやーん　いじわるー！
すなあらしの　なかで　たたかうなら\nポケモンの　たいりょくに　きを　つけないと\rすぐに　きぜつ　しちゃうわよ！
sourceRecords.english: When you're battling in a sandstorm,\nwatch out for your POKéMON's HP.\cIt can faint if you don't keep an eye\non it!

sourceRecords.japanese: ゴーゴーゴーグルを　つけてると\nなんとなく　ヒーローきぶん！\rいまの　ぼくなら　だれにだって　かてるさ！
sourceRecords.english: Wearing these GO-GOGGLES makes me\nfeel like a superhero.\rRight now, nobody can beat me!

sourceRecords.japanese: きぶん　だけじゃ　かてないか‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I can't win on spirit alone...

sourceRecords.japanese: いつかは　ほんものの　ヒーローに　なる！\nそのために　もっと　がんばって\rポケモンと　じぶんを　きたえてみせるよ
sourceRecords.english: I'm going to be a real hero one day.\nI'm going to work harder to make me\rand my POKéMON stronger.

sourceRecords.japanese: さばくで　カセキが　みつかるって　きいたけど\nどこに　あるのかなあ？
sourceRecords.english: I heard there are fossils to be found\nin the desert. Where could they be?

sourceRecords.japanese: いまいち　だわ‥‥
さばくで　カセキが　みつかると　いうことは\nむかし　ここは　うみ　だったのね！
sourceRecords.english: If they can find fossils in the desert,\nit must have been a sea before.

sourceRecords.japanese: いせきを　さがして　３０ねん！\nそんな　わたしと　たたかうのかね？
sourceRecords.english: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\rI am to be challenged?

sourceRecords.japanese: いせきを　さがしてるけど\nつよい　ポケモンは　さがしてないんだ
sourceRecords.english: While I have searched for ruins, I've\nnot searched for strong POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: いせきを　さがして　３０ねん！\cいや　もう　４０ねん　さがしているか？\nあれ　どうだったかな？
sourceRecords.english: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\cNo, wait, was that forty years?\nWhich was it now?

sourceRecords.japanese: いせきを　さがして　３０ねん！\cいや　いせきを　さがして　４０ねん！\nそんな　わたしと　たたかうのかね？
sourceRecords.english: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\cNo, wait, was that forty years?\nAnyway, am I to be challenged?

sourceRecords.japanese: いせきは　みつからない\nつよい　ポケモンも　みつからない
sourceRecords.english: I've found no ruins, nor have I found\nany strong POKéMON...

sourceRecords.japanese: いせきを　さがして　３０ねん！\cいや　もう　４０ねん　さがしているか？\cうーん　５０ねん　だった　きもする‥‥\nあれ　どうだったかな？
sourceRecords.english:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!\cNo, wait, was that forty years I've
searched?\cHmm... It could even be fifty...
How long have I been at this?

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくも　げんき　いっぱい！\nポケモンも　げんき　いっぱい　だよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm full of pep!\nAnd my POKéMON is peppy, too!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンの　げんき　なくなったよ
げんき　いっぱいに　はしりまわる\nトレーナーが　いると\rつい　そっちを　みちゃうよね！
sourceRecords.english: When I see a TRAINER with a lot of pep,\nI can't help looking.

sourceRecords.japanese: どこに　いくのか　しらないけど\nちょっと　しょうぶ　してみない？
sourceRecords.english: I don't know where you're going, but\nwould you like to battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: にくらしいほど　つよいのね！
えんとつやまに　いこうかな？　って\nおもって　いるんだけど\rこのあたりの　けしきも　いいのよね！
sourceRecords.english: I'm thinking that I should go to\nMT. CHIMNEY, but the view around\rhere is very nice, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: おのれを　きたえるため\nであう　にんげん　すべてに\rしょうぶを　もうしこんでるッス！
sourceRecords.english: To train myself, I challenge all\nwhom I meet!

sourceRecords.japanese: まいったッス‥‥！
おぬしの　ように\nつよい　トレーナーに　かてるまで\rしゅぎょう　あるのみッス！
sourceRecords.english: All I can do is keep training until\nI can defeat strong TRAINERS such\ras yourself.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみが　ポケモンを　どこまで\nきたえているか　みせて　もらおう！
sourceRecords.english: Show me how much you've toughened\nyour POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: なるほど\nかなり　きたえてるね！
ポケモンも　トレーナーも\nたたかうことで　いろんなことを　まなぶ！\cだいじ　なのは\nまけても　あきらめないことさ！
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON and TRAINERS learn much\nthrough battling.\cWhat's important is to never give up\neven if you lose.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくたちは　さらなる　たかみを　めざして\nここで　ポケモンを　きたえている\rきみも　いっしょに　しゅぎょう　しよう！
sourceRecords.english: We're training here to elevate our\ngame to the next level.\rStay and train with us!

sourceRecords.japanese: なかなか　やるな！
そんなに　つよいなら\nポケモンリーグを　めざすと　いいよ！
sourceRecords.english: Since you're that strong, you should\naim for the POKéMON LEAGUE.

sourceRecords.japanese: あら　あなたの　ポケモン\nかなり　つよそうだわ！\rぜひ　おてあわせ　してくれない？
sourceRecords.english: Oh, your POKéMON look like serious\nactors.\rI have to ask you for an engagement.

sourceRecords.japanese: つよそう　じゃなくて\nつよいのね！
sourceRecords.english: They didn't just look strong, they\nare strong!

sourceRecords.japanese: あたしも　がんばって\nポケモン　そだてた　つもりだけど\rまだ　やること　いっぱい　あるわね！
sourceRecords.english: I thought I was raising my POKéMON\ndiligently, but, oh no, there is still\rmuch to be done.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンは　つかう　わざによって\nつよくなったり　よわくなったりも　するわ！\cあなたの　ポケモン\nどんな　わざを　おぼえているの？
sourceRecords.english: You can make POKéMON stronger or\nweaker depending on the moves you\rteach them.\cWhat kinds of moves do your POKéMON\nknow?

sourceRecords.japanese: いい　わざを　おぼえているのね！
あたしの　ポケモン　しんか　させずに\nさきに　わざを　おぼえさせてから\rそだてた　ほうが　よかったかな？
sourceRecords.english: Maybe I should have stopped my\nPOKéMON from evolving until they\rlearned better moves...

sourceRecords.japanese: わっはっはっ！\nどうだ？\rオレと　しょうぶ　しないか？\rわっはっはっ！
sourceRecords.english: Hahahaha!\nHow about we have a battle?\rYou and me!\rHahahaha!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけた‥‥\nわっはっはっ！
いろあざやかな　キノコを　たべたら‥‥\nわ　わらいが　とまらない！\rわっはっはっ！
sourceRecords.english: Hahahahaha! Something flew up my nose!\nHahahaha-hatchoo!

sourceRecords.japanese: やまのぼりで　きたえた　オレの　あしこし\nちょっとや　そっとじゃ　くじけないぜ！
sourceRecords.english: My legs are solid from pounding up\nand down the mountains.\cThey're not going to buckle easily,\nfriend!

sourceRecords.japanese: あ‥‥\nあしが　つった‥‥
なんじゅっキロも　ある　にもつを　せおって\nやまみちを　あるき　つづけるんだ\rからだが　じょうぶに　なるぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Try hiking, and I mean really\npounding, on these mountain trails\rwith a heavy pack weighing dozens of\rpounds.\cThat, my friend, will get your body\ninto serious shape.

sourceRecords.japanese: やまのぼりで　きたえてるからな\nかなり　パワフルだぞ！
sourceRecords.english: I've been keeping fit by hiking.\nPower, I have in spades!

sourceRecords.japanese: パワーで　まけたか？
えんとつやまの　うえには\nすごい　トレーナーが　いるらしいぞ！\rこんど　しょうぶに　いくつもりだ！
sourceRecords.english: I hear there are some seriously tough\nTRAINERS on top of MT. CHIMNEY.\cI intend to get up there and give them\na challenge!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくは　つよいんだ‥‥\nまけても　ないたり　しないぞ‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: I'm strong.\nI won't cry if I lose.

sourceRecords.japanese: うわーーーん！
おかあさんに　あえなくて\nさみしいから　ないてるんじゃ　ないよ！\rぐすん‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I'm not crying because I miss my mommy!\nSnivel...

sourceRecords.japanese: ピクニックと　いえば　うた！\nさあ　いっしょに　うたいましょ！
sourceRecords.english: When you're out on a picnic, why, you\nsimply have to sing!\rCome on, sing with me!

sourceRecords.japanese: こんなに　つよいなんて‥‥！
うたも　ポケモンしょうぶも\nうまい　へた　なんて　かんけい　ないよ！\rたのしんだ　ほうが　かち　なのよ！
sourceRecords.english: It doesn't matter if you're good or bad\nat singing or POKéMON.\cIf you have the most fun, you win!

sourceRecords.japanese: この　あたりが　わりと　すずしいの\nなんでか　しってるかい？
sourceRecords.english: Can you guess why it's so cool\naround here?

sourceRecords.japanese: ぴゅーっ！\nまけたーっ！
かざんばいが　たいようの　ひかりを\nさえぎってるから　ひえるんだね！\rあつがりの　オレには　たすかるよ！
sourceRecords.english: The volcanic ash blocks the sun, so it\ndoesn't get very warm.\cThat's good for me - I can't stand heat!

sourceRecords.japanese: やまの　ふんかは\nちきゅうが　いきている　しょうこ！
sourceRecords.english: The volcano's eruption is proof that\nthe earth is alive.

sourceRecords.japanese: つよいな　おまえーっ！
ごほ　がへっ！\nはいが　はいに　はいった‥‥\cうけなかった‥‥\nさむい‥‥　ブルブル‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Ouch! Owww! I can't see!\nI got ashes in my eyelashes!\cGet it? Ashes and eyelashes?\cOkay, that was bad, sorry...

sourceRecords.japanese: あたしの　ドンメルちゃんに\nかざんばいが　かからないように\rパラソルを　さしているの
sourceRecords.english: I use this parasol to ward off this\nfilthy, yucky volcanic ash from my\rdear NUMEL.

sourceRecords.japanese: はあ　はあ‥‥\nつかれましたわ‥‥
とても　おつよいのね\nおねえさん　かんしん　しちゃったわ
sourceRecords.english: You're very good at this.\nI must say I'm impressed!

sourceRecords.japanese: おひさしぶりね\nよろしかったら　しょうぶ　しません？
sourceRecords.english: Oh, hello, hasn't it been a while?\nMay I invite you to battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: おみごと　ですわ
あいかわらず　おつよいのね\nおねえさん　かんしん　しちゃったわ
sourceRecords.english: You've remained very good at this.\nI must say I'm impressed!

sourceRecords.japanese: はいの　なかから　ドロロンッ！！\nしょうぶで　ござる！
sourceRecords.english: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!\nI challenge thee!

sourceRecords.japanese: まいったで　ござる
もっと　かくれかたを　けんきゅう　しよう\nそれでは　しつれいするで　ござる
sourceRecords.english: I must refine the art of concealment.\nI bid thee farewell.

sourceRecords.japanese: はいの　なかから　ドロロロンッ！！\nしょうぶで　ござる！
sourceRecords.english: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!\nI challenge thee!

sourceRecords.japanese: まいったで　ござる
かくれかたは　よかったが\nしょうぶが　いまいち　だった‥‥\cそれでは　しつれいするで　ござる
sourceRecords.english: My flawless concealment was let down\nby my immature battle skills...\cI bid thee farewell.

sourceRecords.japanese: みつけてくれて　ありがとう！\nでも　しょうぶは　べつだよ！
sourceRecords.english: Thanks for finding me!\nBut we still have to battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: にんぽう　かざんばい　がくれ！\c‥‥　って　もう　おわり？
sourceRecords.english: I'll use my ninjutsu on you...\n“VOLCANIC ASH SWIRL CLOAK”!\c...What? It's already over?

sourceRecords.japanese: かくれていて　なにが　しんぱいって\nだれも　とおらないと　さびしいんだよね
sourceRecords.english: You know what's crummy about hiding?\nIt's lonely if no one comes along.

sourceRecords.japanese: ナナ『ふたりで　かざんばい　あつめてるよ\nでも　ポケモンしょうぶも　するんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: TORI: Both of us, we collect ashes.\nWe battle POKéMON, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: ナナ『まけちゃった\nつまんないから　かざんばい　あつめよ！
sourceRecords.english: TORI: We lost... It's boring, so I'm going\nto get some more ashes.

sourceRecords.japanese: ナナ『かざんばい　どれくらい　たまったかな？\nしろいビードロ　つくれると　いいのにね！
sourceRecords.english: TORI: How much ash do we have?\nEnough for a WHITE FLUTE, I hope.

sourceRecords.japanese: ナナ『あたしたち　２たい２で　たたかいたいの\nそうしないと　まけちゃうもん！
sourceRecords.english: TORI: We want to battle 2-on-2.\nIf we didn't, we would lose!

sourceRecords.japanese: ネネ『ふたりで　かざんばい　あつめてるよ\nでも　ポケモンしょうぶも　するんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: TIA: Both of us, we collect ashes.\nWe battle POKéMON, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: ネネ『かてなかった\nつまんないから　かざんばい　あつめよ！
sourceRecords.english: TIA: We couldn't win... It's boring,\nso I'm getting some more ashes.

sourceRecords.japanese: ネネ『かざんばい　けっこう　たまったよ！\nもう　しろいビードロ　つくれるよ　きっと！
sourceRecords.english: TIA: We have a lot of ashes!\nI think enough for a WHITE FLUTE!

sourceRecords.japanese: ネネ『あたしたち　２たい２で　たたかいたいの\nそうしないと　かてないもん！
sourceRecords.english: TIA: We want to battle 2-on-2.\nIf we don't, we won't win!

sourceRecords.japanese: やっほーっ！\c‥‥\cこだまの　かわりに\nやっほー！　って　いってくれよ！
sourceRecords.english: Yodelayhihoo!\c... ...\cYou're supposed to shout\n“yodelayhihoo” since it doesn't\recho here!

sourceRecords.japanese: やっほーっ！
こどものころ　こだま　って\nむこうの　やまにいる　モノマネさんが\rやっほー！　って　いってると　おもってた
sourceRecords.english: When I was a wee tyke, I believed there\nwas someone copying me and shouting\rback, “Yodelayhihoo.”

sourceRecords.japanese: じゅんびを　おこたる　もの\nやまに　のぼるべからず！
sourceRecords.english: If you're not prepared, you shouldn't\nbe up in the mountains!

sourceRecords.japanese: やまは　こわい　ところだ‥‥
ふゆの　やまは　なだれや　ふぶきで\nそうなんする　きけんが　おおいぞ！
sourceRecords.english: In the winter, mountains turn deadly\nwith blizzards and avalanches.

sourceRecords.japanese: キャンプの　たのしみと　いえば\nつりに　はなびに　きもだめし！\cだけど　いちばんは\nポケモンしょうぶ　だね！
sourceRecords.english: Camping's fun! You can fish, roast\nmarshmallows, and tell spooky stories!\cBut the best of all are the POKéMON\nbattles!

sourceRecords.japanese: つよすぎるーっ！
ぼくね　ポケモンと　いっしょに\nキャンプ　できるだけで　しあわせ　だよ
sourceRecords.english: I think it's great that I can go\ncamping with my POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: しょくごの　うんどう！\nわたしと　しょうぶ　しましょうよ！
sourceRecords.english: I need to exercise after a meal.\nLet's have a match!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけちゃったー！
おいしい　ごはんも　たべたし\nなんだか　ねむくなって　きたわ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I just had a tasty meal.\nI'm getting drowsy...

sourceRecords.japanese: うふふふふふ‥‥\nボクの　ポケモンと　しょうぶしない？
sourceRecords.english: Ufufufufufu...\nWant to battle against my POKéMON?

sourceRecords.japanese: ボ　ボクの　ポケモン‥‥
からだが　おおきくて　ゴツゴツ　かたくて\nおおきな　ツノと　するどい　キバ‥‥\rうふふふふ‥‥\rそんな　ポケモンが　ほしいなぁ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: A big body that's all lumpy and hard,\nenormous horns, and vicious fangs...\cUfufufufu...\nI wish I had a POKéMON like that...

sourceRecords.japanese: うふふふふふ‥‥\nボクの　ポケモンと　しょうぶ　しようよ
ああ　ポケモン　みることが　できて\nしあわせ　だ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I feel so lucky getting to see your\nPOKéMON...

sourceRecords.japanese: うふふふふふ‥‥\cポケモンの　たたかっている　すがたに\nぞくぞく　するんだ　ボク
sourceRecords.english: Ufufufufufu...\cWhen I see POKéMON battling, I get all\nshivery and shaky...

sourceRecords.japanese: キャンプファイヤー　するとき\nはなびを　するとき\rみずを　ようい　しておけよ！
sourceRecords.english: If you're lighting a campfire, make\nsure you have water handy.

sourceRecords.japanese: しょうか　かつどう\nありがとう！　ってか
ほんと　ひのようじん　だけは　おこたるな！\nひを　あまく　みるんじゃないぜ！
sourceRecords.english: You really do have to be careful with\nany sort of fire in a forest.\cDon't ever underestimate the power\nof fire.

sourceRecords.japanese: キャンプファイヤー　するとき\nはなびを　するとき\rみずを　ようい　するように　なったか！？
sourceRecords.english: Have you learned to keep water handy\nfor campfires?

sourceRecords.japanese: もえあがる　まえに\nけされた！　ってか
sourceRecords.english: I got hosed down before I could flare\nup, I guess.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほんと　ひのようじん　だけは　おこたるな！\nひを　あまく　みるんじゃないぜ！
sourceRecords.english: You really do have to be careful with\nany sort of fire in a forest.\cDon't ever underestimate the power\nof fire.

sourceRecords.japanese: つりで　しょうぶ　すると\nきみには　かちめが　ないだろう\rポケモンで　かかってきなさい！
sourceRecords.english: If we were fishing, you wouldn't stand\na chance against me.\rSo, bring on your POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: つりの　しょうぶなら　かってた‥‥
sourceRecords.english: If we were fishing, I would've won...

sourceRecords.japanese: りゅうせいのたきで\nおおものでも　つると　しようかな\rあそこの　たきには　なにか　いそうだからね
sourceRecords.english: I think I'll try my luck at landing\na big one at METEOR FALLS.\cThere has to be something in there.\nI just know it.

sourceRecords.japanese: つりも　すき　だが\nしょうぶも　すき！\cしょうぶを　いどまれたら\nつりの　さいちゅうでも　ことわらないよ！
sourceRecords.english: I like to fish. But I also like to\nbattle!\cIf anyone challenges me, I'm there,\neven if I'm fishing.

sourceRecords.japanese: しょうぶは　すき　だが\nつよい　わけじゃ　ないんだ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I like to battle, but that doesn't\nmean I'm good at it...

sourceRecords.japanese: こんどこそ！\cと　おもっちゃうから\nつりも　しょうぶも　やめられない
sourceRecords.english: This time I'll do it!\cI always think that, so I can't walk\naway from fishing or POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: カヨ『そうね\nなんとなく　そんな　きぶん　だから\rあなたにも　ポケモン　おしえたげよっか
sourceRecords.english: TYRA: Well, sure.\nI'm in the mood for it.\rI'll teach you a little about POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: カヨ『すごい　たたかいかた！
sourceRecords.english: TYRA: What an amazing battle style!

sourceRecords.japanese: カヨ『コウハイの　イヨに　あたしが\nポケモンを　おしえて　あげたの！
sourceRecords.english: TYRA: I was teaching my junior IVY\nabout POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: カヨ『うふふ！\nあたしたちと　しょうぶ　するなら\rポケモン　いっぴきじゃ　ダメなのよ！
sourceRecords.english: TYRA: Giggle...\nIf you want to battle with us, just one\rPOKéMON isn't enough!

sourceRecords.japanese: イヨ『あなた\nだれに　ポケモン　おそわったの？
sourceRecords.english: IVY: Who taught you about POKéMON?

sourceRecords.japanese: イヨ『すごい　たたかいかた！
sourceRecords.english: IVY: What an amazing battle style!

sourceRecords.japanese: イヨ『あたしが\nポケモン　はじめた　きっかけは\rセンパイが　おしえてくれた　からなの！
sourceRecords.english: IVY: I started training POKéMON\nbecause TYRA, my student mentor,\rtaught me!

sourceRecords.japanese: イヨ『ポケモン　いっぴき　だけなの？\nなんだか　さみしい　かんじ　しちゃうね
sourceRecords.english: IVY: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nI think it must feel lonesome.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふむ‥‥\nなかなか　できそうだな‥‥\rわたしが　あいてを　してあげよう！
sourceRecords.english: Hm...\nYou seem rather capable...\rLet me keep you company!

sourceRecords.japanese: そうぞう　いじょうの　つよさだ‥‥！
てんさい　など　いない\nすべては　どりょく！\rわたしは　そう　しんじている‥‥
sourceRecords.english: There is no such thing as a born genius.\nIt all depends on effort!\rThat is what I believe...

sourceRecords.japanese: ふむ‥‥\nあいかわらずの　みのこなし\rわたしの　あいてを　してもらおう！
sourceRecords.english: Hm... As always, your agility speaks\nfor itself.\rCome, keep me company!

sourceRecords.japanese: あいかわらずの　つよさだ‥‥！
どりょく　あるのみ！\cまけたのは　まだまだ\nどりょくが　たりないからだ！
sourceRecords.english: All it takes is effort!\cI lost because I haven't put in enough\neffort!

sourceRecords.japanese: おれのッ！\cワンリキーがッ！\cたたかいを　のぞんでいるッ！
いててててっ！
おれの　ワンリキー　たちがッ！\cつよさを　のぞむかぎり\cおれたちは　どこまでも　つよくなるぜッ！
sourceRecords.english: My MACHOP crew!\cSo long as they seek power, I will\ngrow strong with them!

sourceRecords.japanese: オレの　とくいわざは\nずつきで　レンガを　くだく　ことだ！
sourceRecords.english: My strongest skill is busting bricks\nwith my forehead!

sourceRecords.japanese: うがーっ！\nあたまが　くだけたーっ！
ポケモンに　カラテを　おしえてるんだが\nオレより　つよく　なりそうで\rちょっと　たのしみ　なんだ！
sourceRecords.english: I've been teaching my POKéMON karate.\cIt looks like they'll get a lot better\nthan me. I'm excited about that.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみに　まけてから　がんばって\nポケモンと　おのれを　きたえなおしたぞ！\rさあ　もういちど　しょうぶ！
sourceRecords.english: After you beat me, we trained hard to\nimprove our skills.\rCome on, give us a rematch!

sourceRecords.japanese: うがーっ！\nまた　まけたーっ！
おれの　ポケモンは　まだまだ　つよくなる！\nがんばって　きたえるぞ！
sourceRecords.english: My POKéMON will grow stronger!\nI'll redouble my training!

sourceRecords.japanese: この　すなはまは　わたしの\nヒミツの　しゅぎょう　ばしょ！\rかってに　はいって　こないでよ！
sourceRecords.english: This beach is my secret training spot!\nDon't come butting in!

sourceRecords.japanese: しゅぎょうが　たりないわ‥‥！
すなが　クッションに　なるから\nからだを　いためないの\rさいこうの　しゅぎょう　ばしょね！
sourceRecords.english: The sand acts as a cushion to reduce\nimpact and prevent injury.\rThis is the perfect place to train.

sourceRecords.japanese: さあ　ポケモンしょうぶ　いくわよ！
sourceRecords.english: Okay, let's get this battle on!

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしは　たたかえるけど\nポケモンが‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I can battle but my POKéMON...

sourceRecords.japanese: まけても　ちょっと　たのしいのは\nほんとうに　ポケモンが　すき　だからかな？
sourceRecords.english: Even when I lose, I still get some\nenjoyment out of it.\rIt must be that I love POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼく　めずらしい　ポケモン　もってるんだ！\nよかったら　みせて　あげようか
sourceRecords.english: I have a rare POKéMON!\nWould you like me to show you?

sourceRecords.japanese: きみ‥‥\nぼくの　ポケモン　ほしいでしょ？
sourceRecords.english: You...\nYou want my POKéMON, don't you?

sourceRecords.japanese: こんなに　めずらしい　ポケモン　もってるんだ\nそれだけで　ぼくは　まんぞく　なのさ！
sourceRecords.english: I have this rare POKéMON.\nIt's enough to keep me satisfied.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼく　めずらしい　ポケモン　もってるんだ！\nよかったら　みせて　あげようか
sourceRecords.english: I have a rare POKéMON!\nWould you like me to show you?

sourceRecords.japanese: きみ‥‥\nぼくの　ポケモン　ほしいでしょ？
sourceRecords.english: You...\nYou want my POKéMON, don't you?

sourceRecords.japanese: こんなに　めずらしい　ポケモン　もってるんだ\nそれだけで　ぼくは　まんぞく　なのさ！
sourceRecords.english: I have this rare POKéMON.\nIt's enough to keep me satisfied.

sourceRecords.japanese: トンネルが　つうじて　いないなら\nやまを　こえて　いけば　いいのだ！
sourceRecords.english: If the tunnel doesn't go through, then\nI'll just go over the top.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぜえ‥‥　ぜえ‥‥\nまけて　つかれて　しまった
トンネルなど　なくても　かまわん\nやまおとこは　やまが　みち　なのだ！
sourceRecords.english: It's no big deal if there's no tunnel.\nTo a HIKER, mountains are roads!

sourceRecords.japanese: おれの　ポケモン　つえーぞ！\nちょっと　みてみろよ！
あいたたたたっ！　キズが　できた！\nバンソーコー　はらなきゃ！
sourceRecords.english: Ouch! A scrape!\nI have to put on a bandage!

sourceRecords.japanese: バンソーコーは　おとこの　くんしょう！\nまた　ひとつ　ふえたぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Bandages are signs of toughness!\nI've got another one!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくの　むしポケモンは　つよいよ！\nしょうぶ　しようよ！
sourceRecords.english: My BUG POKéMON are tough!\nLet's battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけた‥‥！\nかてると　おもったのに‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: I lost!\nI thought I had you!

sourceRecords.japanese: むしポケモンは　しんかが　はやいから\nつよく　なるのも　はやい！
sourceRecords.english: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.\nSo they get strong quickly, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしの　かわいい　ポケモンの　つよさ\nじっくりと　おしえて　あげるわ！
sourceRecords.english: Let me teach you how strong my\nadorable POKéMON is!

sourceRecords.japanese: キミの　ほうが　いちまい　うわてね‥‥
かわいさと　つよさを　かねそなえた　ポケモン\nそれが　わたしの　りそうなの！
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON that possess cuteness and\npower, that's ideal, I think.

sourceRecords.japanese: トレーナーズ　スクールで\nいろいろ　べんきょう　したからね\rじっせんで　たしかめるよ！
sourceRecords.english: We learn all sorts of things at the\nTRAINER'S SCHOOL.\cI want to test things out for real!

sourceRecords.japanese: べんきょう　さぼってたから\nまけちゃったよ
sourceRecords.english: I slacked off in school...\nThat's why I lost.

sourceRecords.japanese: トレーナーズ　スクールで\nもういちど　べんきょう　しなおさなきゃ\rツツジさんに　おこられちゃうよ
sourceRecords.english: I'll have to redo some courses at the\nTRAINER'S SCHOOL.\rIf I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.

sourceRecords.japanese: あれから　トレーナーズ　スクールで\nまじめに　べんきょう　したからね\rこのまえ　みたいに　まけたりしないよ！
sourceRecords.english: I've been studying seriously at the\nTRAINER'S SCHOOL.\rI won't lose like I did last time.

sourceRecords.japanese: あれー？\nきちんと　べんきょう　したのに
トレーナーズ　スクールで\nもういちど　べんきょう　しなおさなきゃ\rツツジさんに　おこられちゃうよ
sourceRecords.english: I'll have to redo some courses at the\nTRAINER'S SCHOOL.\rIf I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.

sourceRecords.japanese: スクールでも　べんきょう\nかえりみち　でも　べんきょうよ！
sourceRecords.english: I study at school, and I study on the\nway home, too!

sourceRecords.japanese: ショック\nまけちゃったよ
ああん！　これじゃ　ツツジさまのように\nエレガントな　トレーナーに　なれないわ！
sourceRecords.english: Awww, I'll never become an elegant\nTRAINER like ROXANNE this way!

sourceRecords.japanese: あれから　ものすっごく　べんきょう　したの！\nその　せいか　みてもらうからね！
sourceRecords.english: I studied a whole lot since I saw you.\nYou must see my achievements!

sourceRecords.japanese: ショック\nまた　まけちゃったよ
sourceRecords.english: I'm in shock. I lost again?

sourceRecords.japanese: ツツジさまに　かったことが　あるの？\nそれじゃ　いまの　あたしには　かてないわ
sourceRecords.english: You've beaten ROXANNE?\nI can't beat you, then. Not yet.

sourceRecords.japanese: オレが　そだてている　ポケモンと\nしょうぶ　してくれないか？
sourceRecords.english: Listen, could I get you to battle the\nPOKéMON I'm raising?

sourceRecords.japanese: みごとに　そだててるね‥‥
つよさ　だけが　ポケモンじゃないよ！\nポケモンの　こせいを　みがきあげるのも\rたのしみかたの　ひとつ　だね！
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON isn't all about power.\cPolishing a unique aspect of one's\ncharacter is another way of enjoying\rPOKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: オレが　そだてている　ポケモン\nあいかわらず　いい　かんじ　だよ！
sourceRecords.english: The POKéMON I've been raising are\nlooking good, just like before.

sourceRecords.japanese: いい　そだてかた　してるね‥‥\nきみには　そだてやの　さいのう　あるかも
sourceRecords.english: You know how to raise them properly.\nYou might have DAY CARE skills...

sourceRecords.japanese: いい　ぐあいに　そだってるね！\nコンテストに　でることを　おすすめ　するよ！
sourceRecords.english: Your POKéMON are growing good!\nYou should enter them in CONTESTS.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンを　ちゃんと　そだててるか\nわたしが　たしかめて　あげますね
sourceRecords.english: Please, allow me to evaluate if you\nhave raised your POKéMON properly.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちゃんと　そだってますね
ポロックを　ポケモンに　たべさせれば\nポケモンの　こせいが　みがかれますよ
sourceRecords.english: If you feed [POKEBLOCK]S to POKéMON, the\nunique aspects of their character\rwill be enhanced.
