sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンを　ちゃんと　そだててるか\nまた　わたしが　たしかめて　あげますね
sourceRecords.english: Allow me to reevaluate if you have\nraised your POKéMON properly.

sourceRecords.japanese: みごとに　そだってますね
ポケモンの　せいかくに　よって\nすきな　ポロックが　あるみたいなの
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON seem to like different kinds\nof [POKEBLOCK]S, depending on their nature.

sourceRecords.japanese: トライアスロンの　まっさいちゅう　だけど\nさくっと　しょうぶ　しようじゃ　ないか！
sourceRecords.english: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but,\nwhatever, let's have a battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: たいりょく　なくなった！
まいったな‥‥\cいまの　しょうぶの　あいだに\nビリに　なっちゃったかも‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: I may have blown it...\cI might have dropped to last during\nthat battle...

sourceRecords.japanese: トライアスロンの　まっさいちゅう　だけど\nぼくには　よゆうが　あるからね\rさくっと　しょうぶ　しようじゃ　ないか！
sourceRecords.english: I'm smack in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut I'm comfortably ahead.\rLet's make this a quick battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: また　たいりょく　なくなった！
sourceRecords.english: I ran out of energy again!

sourceRecords.japanese: およぎと　じてんしゃでは　トップだったけど\nポケモンは　いまいち　じしんが　ないよ
sourceRecords.english: I was tops in swimming and cycling, but\nI'm not quite that confident with\rPOKéMON yet.

sourceRecords.japanese: トライアスロンの　れんしゅう\nポケモンと　いっしょに　してるからさ\rスピードに　じしん　あるよ！
sourceRecords.english: I do my triathlon training with POKéMON,\nso I'm pretty confident about my speed.

sourceRecords.japanese: れんしゅうが　たりなかったかな？
sourceRecords.english: I need to get more practices in,\nI guess.

sourceRecords.japanese: れんしゅうは　つづけてこそ\nいみが　あるのよね\cよーし！　また　れんしゅうよ\nあしたから！
sourceRecords.english: Training is meaningful only if you\nkeep it up regularly.\cOkay! I'll resume my training!\nTomorrow!

sourceRecords.japanese: どう　れんしゅう　つづけてる？\nあたしは　もちろん　つづけてるわ\rその　しょうこ　みせちゃうから！
sourceRecords.english: Are you keeping up with your training?\nI sure am!\rLet me show you the evidence!

sourceRecords.japanese: れんしゅうが　たりなかったかな？
sourceRecords.english: I need to get more practices in,\nI guess.

sourceRecords.japanese: あしたから　また　れんしゅう　するから\nよかったら　また　しょうぶ　してね！
sourceRecords.english: I'll resume training tomorrow.\nLet's battle again sometime!

sourceRecords.japanese: むかしは　むしとりしょうねん！\nいまは　こんちゅうマニア！\cでも　ポケモンを　あいする　きもちは\nずっと　かわらないぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Once a BUG CATCHER!\nAnd now a BUG MANIAC!\cBut my love for POKéMON remains\nunchanged!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンの　よわさも　かわらない‥‥
すきな　ことばかり　していたら\nいつのまにか　マニアって　よばれてるよ！\cまあ　むしポケモンに　くわしいからね\nマニアと　よばれて　とうぜん　なのさっ！
sourceRecords.english: All I did was follow my heart, and now\nthey call me a BUG MANIAC...\cStill, I am an expert on BUG POKéMON,\nso it's only natural that they call me\ra BUG MANIAC.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミホ『かわいい　コウハイの　まえ　だもん\nいいところ　みせちゃうんだから！
sourceRecords.english: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student\npartner. I have to do good!

sourceRecords.japanese: ミホ『もう！\nコウハイの　まえ　だから　かたせてよ！
sourceRecords.english: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student\npartner! Let me win!

sourceRecords.japanese: ミホ『あなたの　ポケモン\nなかなかの　コンビネーション　してる！\cそうね　あたしたちの\nつぎ　ぐらいに　すごいんじゃない？
sourceRecords.english: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good\ncombinations.\cI'd say you're second only to us!

sourceRecords.japanese: ミホ『あたしたちと　しょうぶ　したいなら\nポケモンを　２ひきは　もってきてね！
sourceRecords.english: ANNA: If you want to battle us, bring\ntwo POKéMON with you.

sourceRecords.japanese: リコ『すてきな　センパイとの　タッグで\nあなたを　まかしちゃうから！
sourceRecords.english: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my super\nsenior student partner and beat you!

sourceRecords.japanese: リコ『やーん\nセンパイ　ごめんなさい！
sourceRecords.english: MEG: Oh, no!\nI'm sorry, ANNA! I let you down...

sourceRecords.japanese: リコ『あたしが　センパイの\nあしを　ひっぱっちゃったの‥‥\cそうでなきゃ　あんた　かってないわよ！
sourceRecords.english: MEG: I dragged ANNA down...\nIf I didn't, she would have won!

sourceRecords.japanese: リコ『ポケモン　１ぴき　しか　いないの？\nじゃあ　しょうぶは　できないわね\cあたしたち　２たい２の\nしょうぶを　たのしみたいの！
sourceRecords.english: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nWe can't battle with you, then.\cWe want to have a 2-on-2 battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミホ『コウハイの　まえで\nなんども　まけてられないのよね
sourceRecords.english: ANNA: I can't keep losing in front of\nmy junior partner, right?

sourceRecords.japanese: ミホ『ちょうしが　でなかったのよ
sourceRecords.english: ANNA: I couldn't get into the groove.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミホ『あなたの　ポケモン\nなかなかの　コンビネーションしてる！\cそうね　あたしたちの\nつぎ　ぐらいに　すごいんじゃない？
sourceRecords.english: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good\ncombinations.\cI'd say you're second only to us!

sourceRecords.japanese: ミホ『あたしたちと　しょうぶ　したいなら\nポケモンを　２ひきは　もってきてね！
sourceRecords.english: ANNA: If you want to battle us, bring\ntwo POKéMON with you.

sourceRecords.japanese: リコ『センパイとの　タッグで\nこんどこそ　あなたを　まかしちゃうから！
sourceRecords.english: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my\nsenior partner and win this time!

sourceRecords.japanese: リコ『つよすぎるわ
リコ『センパイと　いっしょに　たたかったのに\nまけるだなんて‥‥　おちこんじゃう！
sourceRecords.english: MEG: I battled together with my\nsenior partner, but we lost...\cThat's so discouraging...

sourceRecords.japanese: リコ『ポケモン　１ぴき　しか　いないの？\nじゃあ　しょうぶは　できないわね\cあたしたち　２たい２の\nしょうぶを　たのしみたいの！
sourceRecords.english: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nWe can't battle with you, then.\cWe want to have a 2-on-2 battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: はなの　かおりは　ふしぎな　ちから\nからだも　こころも　きれいに　なるわ
sourceRecords.english: The aroma of flowers has a magical\npower. It cleanses us body and soul.

sourceRecords.japanese: あらら\nまけちゃったわね
sourceRecords.english: Oh, dear me.\nI seem to have lost.

sourceRecords.japanese: はなも　ポケモンも\nいい　かおりの　ものが　だいすき！\rクサイにおいは‥‥　かんべんね
sourceRecords.english: Flowers, POKéMON...\nI love whatever smells nice.\cStinky things...\nI'll pass.

sourceRecords.japanese: いい　かおりに　さそわれて\nいらしたのかしら？
sourceRecords.english: Were you drawn here by the sweet\naroma?

sourceRecords.japanese: においの　こうか‥‥\nあんまり　きかなかったわね
sourceRecords.english: The power of aroma...\nIt didn't seem to do much.

sourceRecords.japanese: あまいかおりを　うまく　つかうと\nポケモンが　さそわれて　やってくるわね
sourceRecords.english: If you use a sweet aroma properly,\nPOKéMON will be attracted by it.

sourceRecords.japanese: かれいに　おおぞらを　まう\nとりポケモンが　さいこう　だぜ！
sourceRecords.english: BIRD POKéMON that FLY elegantly in\nthe sky... They're the best!

sourceRecords.japanese: うう‥‥　まけた‥‥
きみも　いい　ポケモンを　もってるね！\nぼくも　まけずに　そだてよっと！
sourceRecords.english: You've got great POKéMON.\nI'll have to train mine better.

sourceRecords.japanese: はばたけ！\nおいらの　とりポケモン！
はばたいたけど‥‥
もっと　つよくなると\nじゆうに　とべるように　なるのにな！
sourceRecords.english: If they'd get stronger, they'd be able\nto fly more freely...

sourceRecords.japanese: あたしゃ　つりびとだが　トレーナーでもある\nつった　ポケモン　ちゃんと　そだててるよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm a FISHERMAN, but also a TRAINER.\nI'm raising the POKéMON I caught.

sourceRecords.japanese: そだてたはず　なんだが‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: I thought I was doing okay in my\ntraining...

sourceRecords.japanese: つりを　しながら\nポケモン　そだてても　かてなかった‥‥\rどっちも　はんぱ　だったのか！？
sourceRecords.english: I couldn't win by training POKéMON\nwhile I fished...\cWas I doing things in half measures?

sourceRecords.japanese: つりびとに　だいじ　なのは　どうぐ！\nトレーナーに　だいじ　なのは\rもちろん　ポケモンと　ハートだな！
sourceRecords.english: For FISHERMEN, equipment is the key.\cBut for TRAINERS, the key ingredients\nare POKéMON and heart, of course!

sourceRecords.japanese: ハートの　しょうぶで　まけたのか？
つり　というのも\nひとと　ポケモンとの\rしんけん　しょうぶ　だな！
sourceRecords.english: Come to think of it, fishing is a battle\nbetween a FISHERMAN and a POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくの　メロディ\nあなたの　こころに　とどけるよ
sourceRecords.english: Let my melody rock your soul!

sourceRecords.japanese: ルー　ルルルー
エレキギターって\nただ　うるさい　だけじゃ　ないんだ‥‥\cこうして　こころに　しみる\nメロディも　かなでられるのさ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: An electric guitar doesn't always\nhave to be noisy...\cIt can be strummed to squeeze out\nthis heart-stirring melody...

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくと　ポケモンの　メロディ\nあなたの　こころに　とどけるよ
sourceRecords.english: A melody from my POKéMON and me...\nLet us deliver it to your soul.

sourceRecords.japanese: ルー　ルルルー
ひいてるときの　ぼくの　きもちが\nエレキギターを　とおして\rあなたに　とどく　はずなのさ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: When I play, my emotions should reach\nyou through my electric guitar...

sourceRecords.japanese: ボクらは　モノマネサークル！\nキミの　うごきを　マネするよ！
sourceRecords.english: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!\nWe MIMIC what you do!

sourceRecords.japanese: うわあ　まけたーっ！
マネを　して　なにが　たのしいか‥‥\cふふふ‥‥\nキミには　わからない　だろうよ
sourceRecords.english: What's so good about mimicry?\cFufufu...\nYou'll never understand...

sourceRecords.japanese: ようやく　であえたね！\nぼくの　むしポケモンが　あいて　するよ！
sourceRecords.english: So, we finally meet!\nMy BUG POKéMON will keep you company!

sourceRecords.japanese: であわなければ　よかった‥‥
もっと　キミの　マネを　したい！\nほら　はやく　うごいてよ！
sourceRecords.english: I want to MIMIC you some more.\cCan you hurry up and move?

sourceRecords.japanese: きみが　まえに　すすんだら\nぼくらも　すすむ\cきみが　みぎへ　まがれば\nぼくらも　まがる‥‥
sourceRecords.english: If you step forward, we step forward.\cIf you turn right, we turn, too...

sourceRecords.japanese: キミが　かっても\nぼくは　まける‥‥
sourceRecords.english: But if you win, I lose...

sourceRecords.japanese: うーん　しょうぶの　しょうはい　だけは\nマネ　できないよなあ‥‥\rなんか　くやしい‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I can't MIMIC you winning the match.\nThat's just impossible...\rIt's burning me up...

sourceRecords.japanese: やっと　ボクを　つかまえられたね！\nそれとも　にげようと　していたのかな？
sourceRecords.english: Yep, you've finally caught me!\nOr were you trying to avoid me?

sourceRecords.japanese: すばらしい　たたかい　だったな！
sourceRecords.english: Whoop, that was a great match!

sourceRecords.japanese: ボクらは　モノマネサークル！\nたのしんで　もらえたかな？
sourceRecords.english: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!\nI hope you enjoyed our performance.

sourceRecords.japanese: ボクが　だれなのか　わからないだろう？\c‥‥まあ　ボクも　キミのこと　しらないから\nこうして　たたかうんだけどね！
sourceRecords.english: You don't know who I am, do you?\cBut, I also don't know you.\nSo, we'll battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: けっこう　つよい　じゃんか！
キミが　どこかに　いくまで\nボクらは　マネを　つづけるよ！
sourceRecords.english: Until you go away somewhere, we'll\nkeep on mimicking your every move.

sourceRecords.japanese: モノマネ　だいすきな　ひとが\nあつまって　つくった　モノマネサークル！\cであった　そのとき\nしょうぶが　はじまる！
sourceRecords.english: The MIMIC CIRCLE was formed by people\nwho like to MIMIC.\cA battle starts the instant we meet!

sourceRecords.japanese: まいりましたーっ！
キミも　モノマネサークルに　はいらない？
sourceRecords.english: Won't you join our MIMIC CIRCLE?

sourceRecords.japanese: サバイバルに　ひつような\nちしきと　ぎじゅつを　もつ　もの！\rそれが　ポケモンレンジャーさ！
sourceRecords.english: Who has the knowledge and the\ntechnique for survival?\cPOKéMON RANGERS, that's who!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンの　ちしきは　たらなかった‥‥
ぶんめい　から　はなれて\nにんげんの　やせいを　めざめさせる！\rそれが　オレたちの　テーマさ！
sourceRecords.english: To break away from civilization and\nawaken the wild spirit within!\cThat's our vision.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンと　いることで\nやせいを　とりもどすのさ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm going to regain my wild spirit by\nbeing together with POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: あいかわらず　つよいな！
とにかく　ポケモンを　しんじろ！\nじぶんを　しんじろ！\rそうすれば　みちは　ひらける！
sourceRecords.english: Believe in your POKéMON.\nBelieve in yourself.\cThe road will reveal itself to you.

sourceRecords.japanese: あら　あなた‥‥\nぼうけんを　している　わりには\rずいぶん　みがるな　かっこうね！
sourceRecords.english: Oh? Look at you.\cFor someone on an adventure, you're\ntraveling awfully light.

sourceRecords.japanese: じゅんび　ぶそくは　じこの　もと‥‥
ずいぶん　みがるな　かっこう　だけど\nひつような　どうぐは　もってるし\rきりょく　たいりょく　じゅうぶんね！
sourceRecords.english: You're traveling light but you have\neverything you need.\cYou're on top of things mentally and\nphysically, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンと　いっしょの　ぼうけんは\nうまく　いってるかしら？
まだ　なにかが\nたりなかったわね‥‥
トレーナーの　あなたが\nポケモンを　たよって　いるように\rポケモンも　あなたを　たよっているのよ！
sourceRecords.english: In the same way that you, as a TRAINER,\nrely on your POKéMON, your POKéMON\rrely on you.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおぞらは　おとこの　ロマン！\cじゆうに　そらを　とぶ　きもちよさは\nなにごとにも　かえがたい！
sourceRecords.english: The vast sky holds untold promise!\cNothing can compare to the sheer\nexhilaration of flight!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけたーっ！
そらを　とびまわる　ユメは\nとりポケモンの　おかげで　かなえられたよ！
sourceRecords.english: My BIRD POKéMON made my dreams of\nflying come true!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくの　とりポケモンの　じつりょくを\nみせて　あげるよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'll show you the true potential of me\nand my BIRD POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: じつりょく　ぶそく　だった‥‥
ぼくは　ちいさい　ころから\nとりポケモンに　あこがれて　いたんだ！
sourceRecords.english: Ever since I was a little kid, I always\nadmired BIRD POKéMON...

sourceRecords.japanese: かげに　ひそみ　やみに　いきる\nそれが　オレの　さだめ‥‥！\rいざ　ポケモンしょうぶ！
sourceRecords.english: To lurk in shadows, and live in\ndarkness... That is my destiny.\cI emerge to challenge you!

sourceRecords.japanese: まいった‥‥！
しょうぶに　やぶれた　ものは\nいさぎよく　かげに　もどる‥‥\rそれも　さだめ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Those defeated in battle withdraw\nquietly back into the shadows.\rThat, too, is destiny...

sourceRecords.japanese: ゆだん　してると\nいたい　めに　あうぜ！
sourceRecords.english: If you're not on your guard, you're in\nfor some pain!

sourceRecords.japanese: つよいな　きみーっ！
きしゅう　さくせんは　シッパイだった‥‥
きを　かくすなら　もりのなか！
sourceRecords.english: To hide a tree, use a forest!

sourceRecords.japanese: つわもので　ござるな
きを　かくすなら　もりのなか！\nポケモンを　かくすなら　ポケモンのなか！\cとくに　いみは　ないでござる
sourceRecords.english: To hide a tree, use a forest!\nTo hide a POKéMON, use a POKéMON!\cThere is no deep, hidden meaning\nto that.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしに　はなしかけた‥‥\nつまり　しょうぶを　いどむ　つもりだな！\cよーし！　なみのり　しながら\nつりあげた　ポケモンで　たたかうぞ！
sourceRecords.english: You spoke to me...\nSo you want to challenge me!\cSure! I'll try out the POKéMON I caught\nwhile SURFING!

sourceRecords.japanese: かつための　ポイントが\nちっとも　わからん！
sourceRecords.english: I don't have a clue about what it\ntakes to win.

sourceRecords.japanese: なみのりを　つかう！\cポケモンの　せなかに　のって\nつりを　たのしむ！\cなんて　ゆうがな　ひととき　だろう！
sourceRecords.english: Go for a SURF on my POKéMON...\cThen fish off its back...\cIt's an indescribably luxuriant moment!

sourceRecords.japanese: そらを　とんでいる　ポケモンに\nダメージを　あたえる　ワザを　もってる？
sourceRecords.english: Do you have any moves that can strike\na flying POKéMON?

sourceRecords.japanese: キミの　ほうが\nいちまい　うわて　だった！
そらをとぶ　って　ワザは　べんりだな！\cそらを　とんでいる　あいだは\nほとんどの　ワザが　あたらないだろ？
sourceRecords.english: The move FLY is convenient, don't\nyou think?\cWhile the POKéMON is flying, almost\nno moves can strike it.

sourceRecords.japanese: ボクの　ポケモンは　つよいぜ！\nキミの　ポケモンは　どうかな？
sourceRecords.english: My POKéMON is strong!\nHow about yours?

sourceRecords.japanese: キミの　ポケモンの　ほうが\nつよかった‥‥！
どんどん　つよくなる　ポケモンは\nほんと　たよりに　なるよなー！
sourceRecords.english: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one\nyou can count on.

sourceRecords.japanese: どんどん　つよくなる　ポケモンは\nほんと　たよりに　なるよなー！
sourceRecords.english: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one\nyou can count on.

sourceRecords.japanese: キミの　ポケモン\nほんとうに　つよいんだな‥‥
ポケモンが　つよくなるのと　いっしょに\nおれも　つよくならないとなー！
sourceRecords.english: My POKéMON are growing stronger.\nI have to grow stronger, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみの　ポケモン\nそうなん　しないか　みてあげよう！
sourceRecords.english: I'll check your POKéMON and see if\nthey're fit for the outdoors.

sourceRecords.japanese: そんなに　つよい　ポケモンと　いっしょなら\nそうなんの　おそれは　ないな！
sourceRecords.english: With POKéMON that strong, you're in\nno danger of needing rescue!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンと　いっしょに　どこまでもいく\nトレーナーの　よろこびと　いえるだろう！
sourceRecords.english: To travel wherever your heart desires\nwith POKéMON...\rThat's the joy of being a TRAINER.

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたの　たいりょく　どう？\nたいりょく　ぶそくだと\rいざと　いうとき　こまるわよ！
sourceRecords.english: How's your physical fitness?\nIf you're not fit, you could have a\rrough time in critical situations.

sourceRecords.japanese: たいりょく　だけは　あったのに‥‥
たいりょく　づくりが　わたしの　にっか\nまいにち　ポケモンと　ランニングよ！
sourceRecords.english: Fitness training is in my routine.\nI always run with my POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\nまた　まけた‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\n‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\rまた　がんばろう‥‥\rだいじな　むしポケモンの　ために‥‥
sourceRecords.english: ... ... ... ... ... ...\n... ... ... ... ... ...\rI'll try harder...\rFor my precious BUG POKéMON...

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンには　いろんな　とくせいが　ある\nそれを　かんがえてこそ\rいちりゅうの　トレーナーに　なれるのよ！
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON have many special abilities.\nIf you want to become a first-class\rTRAINER, learn about them.

sourceRecords.japanese: なかなか　かんがえてるのね
そう　ポケモンの　とくせいに　よって\nたたかいかたも　いろいろ　かわってくるわ！
sourceRecords.english: The special abilities of POKéMON\nwill make battle styles change.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんだね　きみは？\cもしかして　ひょっとすると\nあるかもしれない　といわれる\rこだいの　いせきを　さがしに　きたのかね！？
sourceRecords.english: Who might you be?\cAre you perhaps searching for ancient\nruins that are rumored to possibly\rexist according to legend?

sourceRecords.japanese: まいったね　こりゃ
あの　おおきな　いわ\nわたしは　いせき　だと　おもいたいが\rそれにしては　いりぐちが　ないね‥‥
sourceRecords.english: That giant rock... I would like to\nbelieve it may indeed contain ancient\rruins. But I see no entrance.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたしが　パラソルを　もってる　りゆう？\cうふふ　あたしに　かてたら\nおしえて　あげても　いいかな？
sourceRecords.english: Why am I carrying this parasol?\cI'll tell you if you can win against me.

sourceRecords.japanese: パラソルで　ポケモンの　こうげきは\nしのげないのね‥‥
sourceRecords.english: A parasol can't ward off POKéMON\nattacks...

sourceRecords.japanese: あたしの　ポケモンたちも\nあつい　ひざしは　にがてだと　おもうの\rだから　こうして　パラソルを　もってるのよ
sourceRecords.english: I don't think strong sunlight is good\nfor my POKéMON.\rSo I shield them with my parasol.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたしと　ポケモンと　パラソル\nどれか　ひとつ　かけていても\rうつくしさが　そこなわれるんだわ
sourceRecords.english: Me, POKéMON, and my parasol...\cIf any one of them is missing, the\npicture of beauty will be ruined.

sourceRecords.japanese: うつくしさが\nだいなしに　なっちゃったわ
あなたに　パラソルは　にあわないわ！\cだって　こんなの　もっていたら\nすっごく　ジャマに　なりそう　なんだもの
sourceRecords.english: A parasol wouldn't suit you at all.\cWhy, something like this would only\nget in your way.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンの　うごきを　とりいれて\nあたらしい　にんぽうを　あみだすんだ！
sourceRecords.english: I will adopt the movements of POKéMON\nand create new ninja techniques.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたらしい　にんぽう\nかんせいまで　まだまだ　かかりそうだ
sourceRecords.english: The creation of new ninja techniques\nis but a distant dream...

sourceRecords.japanese: ニンジャの　せんせいを　さがして\nでしいり　しようかな？
sourceRecords.english: Perhaps I ought to apprentice under\na ninja sensei.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくたち　ニンジャごっこの　かくれぬの！\nどこに　いるのか　わからなかっただろ！
sourceRecords.english: We ninja conceal ourselves under our\ncamouflage cloaks.\rI bet you didn't know where I was!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけた！\nかくれぬので　かくれるか？
sourceRecords.english: I lost!\nI should camouflage my shame!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくたち　ニンジャごっこの　かくれぬの！\nこれって　てづくり　なんだぜ！
あたしの　とっても　プリティな\nポケモンを　かわいがってよ！
sourceRecords.english: Will you play with my delightfully\npretty POKéMON?

sourceRecords.japanese: かわいがるの　いみが　ちがうわ！
ミナモの　コンテストに　いくのよ\nあたしの　ポケモンなら\rマスター　ランクでも　らくしょうよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm going to a CONTEST in LILYCOVE.\cMy POKéMON should have no problem\nsweeping the MASTER CLASS.

sourceRecords.japanese: せかい　かっこくを\nポケモンと　いっしょに　まわってきた\cすこしは　うでに　じしんが　ありますよ！
sourceRecords.english: With my POKéMON, I have traveled the\nworld's four corners.\cYou might say I have some confidence\nin my abilities.

sourceRecords.japanese: おみごと　ですな
また　ポケモンと　いっしょに\nせかいを　まわってみたい　ものです
sourceRecords.english: I would like to circle the globe once\nagain with my POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: せかい　かっこくを\nポケモンと　いっしょに　まわってきた\cすこしは　うでに　じしんが　ありますよ！
sourceRecords.english: With my POKéMON, I have traveled the\nworld's four corners.\cYou might say I have some confidence\nin my abilities.

sourceRecords.japanese: おみごと　ですな！
あなたと　その　ポケモンなら\nがいこくでも　つよいと　いわれるでしょう！
sourceRecords.english: Your POKéMON and you...\cYour prowess together will be\nconsidered strong, even overseas.

sourceRecords.japanese: よの　なかには　ふしぎな　ちからが\nいっぱい　あるの‥‥
sourceRecords.english: There are powers beyond our\nunderstanding in the world...

sourceRecords.japanese: あたし　まけたのね‥‥
おくりびやま‥‥\nあそこに　ふしぎな　ちからが　あるの‥‥
sourceRecords.english: MT. PYRE...\nThere is a mysterious power\rat work there...

sourceRecords.japanese: マナ『ふたり　そろえば　こわいもの　なし！\nあたしたちの　つよさ　みせつけちゃうから！
sourceRecords.english: KATE: Together, we're fearless!\nWe'll demonstrate how tough we are!

sourceRecords.japanese: マナ『コウハイの　まえで　かっこわるいわ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: KATE: I blew it in front of my junior\nstudent partner...

sourceRecords.japanese: マナ『あたしって　たよられちゃうと\nつい　かっこいい　ところ\rみせたく　なっちゃうのよね‥‥
sourceRecords.english: KATE: When someone's relying on me,\nI get this urge to look cool in front\rof them...

sourceRecords.japanese: マナ『ポケモン　１ぴき　しか　いないのね\nじゃあ　しょうぶは　できないわ！\cだって　よわいもの　いじめに　なるもの
sourceRecords.english: KATE: If you've only got one POKéMON,\nwe can't battle with you.\cThat would be bullying.

sourceRecords.japanese: ユイ『ふたり　そろえば　こわいもの　なし！\nあたしたちの　つよさ　みせつけちゃうから！
sourceRecords.english: JOY: Together, we're fearless!\nWe'll demonstrate how tough we are!

sourceRecords.japanese: ユイ『センパイ　ごめんなさーい
ユイ『えへっ！\nまた　センパイと　いっしょに　とっくんね！
sourceRecords.english: JOY: Ehehe, I'll have to train with KATE,\nmy senior student partner, again.

sourceRecords.japanese: ユイ『あたしたちに　しょうぶを　いどむなら\nポケモン　２ひきは　ひつよう　だからね！
sourceRecords.english: JOY: You need at least two POKéMON\nif you're going to challenge us!

sourceRecords.japanese: あたくしの　だいじな　ポケモン\nちょっと　みなさいよ！
sourceRecords.english: Stop! Have a good look at my precious\nPOKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぷんぷん！\nなによ　ほんき　だしちゃって！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, how dare you!\nDon't take it so seriously!

sourceRecords.japanese: サファリで　あたらしい　ポケモン\nつかまえようかな？
sourceRecords.english: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at\nthe SAFARI.

sourceRecords.japanese: だいじな　ポケモン　そだったのよ！\nちょっと　みていきなさいよ！
sourceRecords.english: My precious POKéMON grew!\nHave a good look!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぷんぷん！\nまた　てかげん　してくれないのね！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, how dare you!\nYou still won't take it easy!

sourceRecords.japanese: サファリで　あたらしい　ポケモン\nつかまえようかな？
sourceRecords.english: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at\nthe SAFARI.

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたの　じつりょくが\nどれほどの　ものか‥‥\rわたしが　たしかめて　あげる！
sourceRecords.english: Want to determine how strong you are?\nI'll be the test!

sourceRecords.japanese: すばらしいわ‥‥！
わたしに　かつなんて‥‥\nあなたの　じつりょくも　そうとうな　もの！
sourceRecords.english: To best even me...\nYour strength is marvelous!

sourceRecords.japanese: たくさん　ジムの　バッジを\nもっている　みたいだね！\cほんとうに　それだけの　ちからが　あるか\nたしかめさせて　もらうよ！
sourceRecords.english: You seem to have a big collection\nof GYM BADGES.\cLet me see if you're actually worthy of\nthose BADGES!

sourceRecords.japanese: たしかに　ちからは　ある！
ジムバッジに　はじない\nたたかい　だったよ！
sourceRecords.english: You did your BADGES proud in that\nmatch!

sourceRecords.japanese: たのしい　ことが　あるとき　って\nいい　においで　いっぱいに　なってるのね
sourceRecords.english: They say that good times are filled\nwith good aromas.

sourceRecords.japanese: あぁ\nかなしみの　におい　だわ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Oh...\nI smell the bitter scent of misery...

sourceRecords.japanese: きのみ　めいじんの　はなばたけ\nすっごく　いいかんじの　においで　いっぱい！
sourceRecords.english: The BERRY MASTER's garden is filled\nwith uplifting fragrances.

sourceRecords.japanese: サイキックとは　きもちの　つよさ‥‥\cそう　ぼくは　だれにも　まけないと\nおもっているから　つよいよ！
sourceRecords.english: Being a psychic is about willpower.\cI've willed myself not to lose to\nanyone. That makes me strong!

sourceRecords.japanese: しょんぼり‥‥
サイキックとは　きもちの　つよさ\nきみには　まけないと　おもっていたのに‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Being a psychic is about willpower.\nI thought I wouldn't lose to you...

sourceRecords.japanese: ぼくは　もう　だれにも　まけないと\nおもっているから　つよいよ！！
sourceRecords.english: I've convinced myself that I won't\nlose anymore. That makes me strong!

sourceRecords.japanese: しょんぼり‥‥
おくりびやまで　しゅぎょうでも　しようかな\nこのままじゃ　ずっと　きみに　かてないよ
sourceRecords.english: I should train at MT. PYRE...\nI'll never beat you this way...

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンも　ちょうのうりょくも\nつかえるだけじゃ　いみ　ないわ\rきたえてこそ　ほんものに　なるのよ
sourceRecords.english: Don't be too happy if your POKéMON\ndevelop psychic powers.\cYou need to refine those powers to\nmake them really useful.

sourceRecords.japanese: すごい！
だれでも　ちょうのうりょくを　もっているの\nただ　つかいかたを　わすれている　だけよ
sourceRecords.english: We all have psychic powers.\nWe've just forgotten how to use them.

sourceRecords.japanese: どう？　あなたの　なかの\nちょうのうりょく　めばえたり　した？
sourceRecords.english: Have you awoken the psychic powers\nwithin you?

sourceRecords.japanese: すごいわ！
あなたの　つよさ\nそれも　ちょうのうりょく　かもね
sourceRecords.english: Your power with POKéMON...\nThat could be a psychic power, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミウ『トレーナーさんの　ポケモン\nまけても　なかないで　くださいね！
sourceRecords.english: MIU: Hello, TRAINER. I hope your\nPOKéMON won't cry when they lose.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミウ『まけちゃったね‥‥
ミウ『トレーナーさんの　ポケモン\nなかが　いいから　つよいんですね！
sourceRecords.english: MIU: TRAINER, your POKéMON are\nstrong because you are friends.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミウ『ポケモンさん　２ひきは　いないと\nたたかっても　つまらないもん！
sourceRecords.english: MIU: It's no fun to battle if you\ndon't have two POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: ユキ『よーし！\nトレーナーさんの　ポケモン　やっつけます！
sourceRecords.english: YUKI: Okay!\nWe're beating the TRAINER's POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: ユキ『まけちゃったね‥‥
ユキ『どーして　そんなに　つよいの？\nあたちたち　たたかって　まけたの　はじめて！
sourceRecords.english: YUKI: Why are you so strong?\nWe've never lost before.

sourceRecords.japanese: ユキ『ポケモンさん　２ひきは　いないと\nたたかっても　つまらないもん！
sourceRecords.english: YUKI: It's no fun to battle if you\ndon't have two POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: おくりびやまは‥‥\nポケモンの　たましいが　ねむるところ‥‥\rあなたの　ポケモンも　ねむる‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: MT. PYRE...\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep...\rWill your POKéMON sleep?

sourceRecords.japanese: げんき　いっぱいね‥‥
おくりびやまは‥‥\nポケモンの　たましいが　ねむるところ‥‥\cきっと　たましいを　なぐさめる\nちからに　あふれてるのよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: MT. PYRE...\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep...\cIt must overflow with a power that\nsoothes spirits...

sourceRecords.japanese: おっと　みちに　まよったのか？\cわたしの　ポケモンに　かてたら\nみずさき　あんないにんに　なってあげようか？
sourceRecords.english: Hey, are you lost at sea?\cIf you can beat my POKéMON, I can\nserve as your pilot.

sourceRecords.japanese: たたかいかたを　まよってしまった‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I lost my bearings in battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: うみで　まよってしまう　ひとは　おおい！\cそんな　ひとは　ポケナビで\nマップを　たしかめながら　すすむと　いい！
sourceRecords.english: Many people lose their bearings at sea.\cIf you're that sort, you should refer\nto the POKéNAV's MAP.

sourceRecords.japanese: むっ！　じぶんで　およがずに\nポケモンに　のっている‥‥\cなんて　うらやましいんだ！
sourceRecords.english: Hm! You're riding a POKéMON instead\nof swimming yourself...\cI am envious!

sourceRecords.japanese: ああ！\nダメだ‥‥！
からだが　ひえてきた‥‥\nながいこと　みずの　なかに　いるからだ\cきみのように　ポケモンに　のりたいよ
sourceRecords.english: I'm getting chilled...\nI've been in the water too long...\cI wish I could ride a POKéMON like you...

sourceRecords.japanese: こうして　うみに　うかんでいると\nポケモンたちが　あそびに　くるのよ！
sourceRecords.english: If you just float in the sea like\nthis, POKéMON come around to play.

sourceRecords.japanese: あーあ\nまけちゃった‥‥
うみを　およいでいると\nおそってくる　ポケモンと\rただ　みているだけの　ポケモンが　いるの\cポケモンにも　こせいが　あるのね！
sourceRecords.english: While swimming, I noticed that some\nPOKéMON attack, and some just watch.\cI guess POKéMON have personalities\nof their own.

sourceRecords.japanese: こうして　うみに　うかんでいると\nトレーナーが　いどんで　くるのよね！
sourceRecords.english: If you just float in the sea like this,\nTRAINERS challenge you!

sourceRecords.japanese: おかしいなあ\nまた　まけちゃった‥‥
なんとなく　だけど\nカラクリやしきに　いってみようかな‥‥
sourceRecords.english: This has nothing to do with anything,\nbut maybe I'll visit the TRICK HOUSE.

sourceRecords.japanese: およぐのにも　あきた　ところだし‥‥\nわたしと　しょうぶ　しようよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm growing bored of swimming...\nHow about a battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: こんなに　つよいなんて\nおもいも　しなかったわ！
sourceRecords.english: I had no idea that you were\nthis strong!

sourceRecords.japanese: ずっと　がんばって　きたことが\nあなたの　つよさなのね‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: All the effort you put in must have\nmade you this strong.

sourceRecords.japanese: うふふふふ\nオレは　モグリの　スイマー\rもぐりは　とくいちゅうの　とくいだぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Fufufufu... I dive deep underwater\nto go deep under cover.\rPlumbing the depths is where I excel!

sourceRecords.japanese: ゴボゴボゴボ‥‥\nしずんでいく‥‥
うみの　そこに　もぐれる　ポイントが\nこの　あたりには　あるらしいぜ！\rモグリの　ちが　さわぐなあ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I have it on good authority that\nthere's a DIVE spot around here.\cIt gives me the urge to go deep\nagain...

sourceRecords.japanese: ナミ『はーあ\cせっかくの　うみ　なのに\nいっしょに　いるのが　おとうと　なんて‥‥\cあなた　きばらしに　ポケモン　しようか！？
sourceRecords.english: RITA: Sigh...\cHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\cLet's battle so I won't have to dwell\non that!

sourceRecords.japanese: ナミ『コウの　せいで　まけたのよ！\nあとで　おしおき　だかんね！！
sourceRecords.english: RITA: SAM! It's your fault we lost!\nYou're in for it later!

sourceRecords.japanese: ナミ『はーあ\cとなりに　いるのが　おとうと　じゃなくて\nすてきな　かれし　だったら　いいのに‥‥
sourceRecords.english: RITA: Sigh...\cIf only it wasn't my little brother\nnext to me, but a nice boyfriend...

sourceRecords.japanese: ナミ『あたしたちと　たたかう　つもり？\nポケモン　２ひき　いないと　ダメよ
sourceRecords.english: RITA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have more POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: コウ『オレの　ねえちゃん\nポケモン　つよいぞ！\rまけて　ないたり　するなよ！
sourceRecords.english: SAM: My big sister is tough at POKéMON!\cDon't cry when you lose!

sourceRecords.japanese: コウ『うわぁ‥‥\nあとで　ねえちゃんに　おこられる‥‥
sourceRecords.english: SAM: Uh-oh...\nMy big sister will chew me out...

sourceRecords.japanese: コウ『オレの　ねえちゃん\nおこると　むちゃくちゃ　こわいんだ‥‥\cだから　こいびと　いないんだぜ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: SAM: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\cThat's why she doesn't have a\nboyfriend.

sourceRecords.japanese: コウ『オレらと　たたかう　つもり？\nポケモン　２ひき　つれてきなよ！
sourceRecords.english: SAM: Did you want to battle us?\nBring some more POKéMON, then.

sourceRecords.japanese: ナミ『はーあ\cせっかくの　うみ　なのに\nいっしょに　いるのが　おとうと　なんて‥‥\cあら　あなた　ひさしぶりね\nきばらしに　ポケモン　しようか！？
sourceRecords.english: RITA: Sigh...\cHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\cOh, hi, it's been a while. Let's battle\nso I won't have to dwell on things!

sourceRecords.japanese: ナミ『コウったら！\nあんたの　せいで　また　まけたでしょ！\rあとで　とっくん　だかんね！！
sourceRecords.english: RITA: SAM!\nIt's your fault we lost again!\cWe're having a training session later!

sourceRecords.japanese: ナミ『はーあ\cあたしに　すてきな　かれしが　いたらなぁ\nすてきな　コンビネーションで\rどんな　あいてにでも　かっちゃうのに
sourceRecords.english: RITA: Sigh...\cIf I had a nice boyfriend, we'd beat\nanyone with lovely combinations...

sourceRecords.japanese: ナミ『あたしたちと　たたかう　つもり？\nポケモン　２ひき　いないと　ダメよ
sourceRecords.english: RITA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have more POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: コウ『まけたら　オレが　おこられるから\nむちゃくちゃ　ほんきで　がんばるぞ！
sourceRecords.english: SAM: If we lose, I'll catch heck.\nI'm going to go totally all out!

sourceRecords.japanese: コウ『うわぁ‥‥\nまた　ねえちゃんに　おこられる‥‥
sourceRecords.english: SAM: Uh-oh...\nMy big sister will chew me out again.

sourceRecords.japanese: コウ『オレの　ねえちゃん\nおこると　むちゃくちゃ　こわいんだ‥‥\cあとで　オレと　ポケモン\nもうとっくん　だよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: SAM: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\cShe's going to make me train really\nhard with POKéMON later...

sourceRecords.japanese: コウ『オレらと　たたかう　つもり？\nポケモン　２ひき　つれてきなよ！
sourceRecords.english: SAM: Did you want to battle us?\nBring some more POKéMON, then.

sourceRecords.japanese: キミが　やってくる　おとが\nきこえて　いたから　まってたよ！
sourceRecords.english: I heard you approaching, so I hung\naround for you!

sourceRecords.japanese: まいりました‥‥！
くうきちゅう　よりも\nすいちゅうの　ほうが　おとの　つたわる\rスピードが　はやいんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: Sound travels faster in water than\nit does through air.

sourceRecords.japanese: おらーっ！！\nおれの　かわいい　ポケモンだー！！
sourceRecords.english: Hey, there!\nCheck out my sweet POKéMON!

sourceRecords.japanese: まいったぜ‥‥！
タッツーの　みりょくに　まいって\nおれも　およぐように　なったんだー！
sourceRecords.english: I was blown away by HORSEA's charm,\nso I started swimming, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: およぎ　つかれちゃった！\nわたしと　ひとしょうぶ　どう？
sourceRecords.english: I'm tired of swimming.\nAre you up for a battle with me?

sourceRecords.japanese: あんた　つよすぎ！
ふう　ふう‥‥\nトクサネシティは　どっち　だったっけ？
sourceRecords.english: Whew...\nWhich way is it to MOSSDEEP CITY?

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしの　そだてた　みずポケモンと\nたたかって　みない？
sourceRecords.english: How would you like to take on the\nWATER-type POKéMON I raised?

sourceRecords.japanese: まけた‥‥
あなたの　つよさは　ホンモノね！\nおどろいたわ！
sourceRecords.english: Your power... You're the real deal.\nI'm amazed!

sourceRecords.japanese: オレさまは　たくましい　ふなのり！\nせかいの　うみを　わたりあるく　おとこ！
sourceRecords.english: Ahoy! I'm a buff, tough SAILOR!\nI've braved the world's seas!

sourceRecords.japanese: ぐおおおーっ！\nかてねえ‥‥！
あさせのほらあな　は　じかんによって\nしおが　みちたり　ひいたり　するんだ！\cちなみに　みちしお　から　ひきしお　まで\nおよそ　６じかんだぞ！　しっていたか？
sourceRecords.english: The tide ebbs and flows inside the\nSHOAL CAVE.\cBy the way, it's about six hours from\nhigh tide to low tide. Did you know?

sourceRecords.japanese: おっと　ここで　あったが　１００ねんめ！\nとにかく　ポケモンしょうぶ　だっ！
sourceRecords.english: It's high time I get my payback\nfrom you! Come on, we're battling!

sourceRecords.japanese: かてねえ\nちっとも　かてねえよ！
sourceRecords.english: I couldn't win!\nI flat out couldn't win!

sourceRecords.japanese: あさせのほらあな‥‥\cしおの　みちひきに　よって\nいけたり　いけなかったり　する\rばしょが　あるんだよな\cちなみに　みちしお　から　ひきしお　まで\nおよそ　６じかんだぞ！　おぼえておけよ！
sourceRecords.english: The SHOAL CAVE...\cThere are places you can and can't\nget to depending on the rise and fall\rof the tide.\cBy the way, it's about six hours from\nhigh tide to low tide. Don't forget!

sourceRecords.japanese: マホ『あさせのほらあなに\nへんな　じいさんが　いるんだって！\rあなたも　あいにいく　とちゅう？
sourceRecords.english: KIM: A funny old man lives in the\nSHOAL CAVE. Someone told me.\rAre you going to see him, too?

sourceRecords.japanese: マホ『かてると　おもったのに
sourceRecords.english: KIM: I thought we would win.

sourceRecords.japanese: マホ『あさせのほらあなに\nへんな　じいさんが　いるんでしょ？\cさっ　ナホちゃん　あいに　いくよ！
sourceRecords.english: KIM: A funny old man lives in the\nSHOAL CAVE, doesn't he?\cLet's go see him, IRIS!

sourceRecords.japanese: マホ『ダメだって！\nポケモン　２ひき　いないと　ダメだって！
sourceRecords.english: KIM: No, no, no! You need two POKéMON,\nor it's just no good!

sourceRecords.japanese: ナホ『センパイ\nこんな　ところに　なにが　あるんですかぁ？
sourceRecords.english: IRIS: KIM, can you tell me what we're\nlooking for out here?

sourceRecords.japanese: ナホ『とちゅう　おしいところ　あったのに
sourceRecords.english: IRIS: Oh, we came sort of close.

sourceRecords.japanese: ナホ『センパイ‥‥　ほんとに\nあさせのほらあなに　はいりますぅ？\rぬれちゃいますよぉ？
sourceRecords.english: IRIS: KIM, are we really going into\nthe SHOAL CAVE?\rWe'll get all wet.

sourceRecords.japanese: ナホ『２たい１で　しょうぶ　なんて\nそんな　まね　あたしたちに　できないわ
sourceRecords.english: IRIS: Oh, we could never, ever do\nanything like a 2-on-1 battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: すいえいは　ぜんしん　うんどう！\nたいりょくが　つくぞー！
sourceRecords.english: Swimming is a full-body workout!\nYou will get fit!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけましたーっ！
まいにち　およいでる　おかげで\nみよ！　この　きんにくっ！！
sourceRecords.english: Thanks to my daily swimming routine...\nLook! Feast your eyes on this physique!

sourceRecords.japanese: この　しろく　そびえる　いわやまが\nルネシティ　なんだぜー！
sourceRecords.english: This towering white mountain of rock\nis SOOTOPOLIS CITY.

sourceRecords.japanese: やられたか！？
ルネシティの　いりぐちが　みつからん！\nどこに　あるんだ？
sourceRecords.english: I can't find the entrance to\nSOOTOPOLIS. Where could it be?

sourceRecords.japanese: おほほほっ\nわたしは　にんぎょ！
アワと　なって　きえていく‥‥\nぶくぶくぶく‥‥
sourceRecords.english: My fantasy burst as if it were a bubble!\nBlub, blub, blub...

sourceRecords.japanese: こっぴどく　やられちゃったわ‥‥\nアワくって　にげだしたい　きぶん‥‥
sourceRecords.english: You thrashed me... I want to\ndisappear in a wave of despair...

sourceRecords.japanese: ねえ　ねえ\nおねえさんと　しょうぶ　しない？
sourceRecords.english: Hello, kiddo!\nWant a battle with me?

sourceRecords.japanese: いやーんっ！
こうして　ポケモンと\nうみで　あそぶのが　だいすきなの！
sourceRecords.english: I love frolicking with POKéMON in\nthe sea like this!

sourceRecords.japanese: オレと　しょうぶ　したいって\nかおに　かいてあるぜ！
sourceRecords.english: I can see it in your face. You want\nto challenge me.

sourceRecords.japanese: あわわわわ‥‥
いい　しょうぶを　した　あとは\nすがすがしい　きもちに　なるなー
sourceRecords.english: A well-played match leaves me feeling\nrefreshed and serene.

sourceRecords.japanese: あいつには　まけたくない　って\nライバル　きみには　いるの？
sourceRecords.english: Do you have a rival whom you just\nhate to lose against?

sourceRecords.japanese: あぁ　すっごく　くやしい！
ライバルが　いると\nつよくなりたい　って　きもちが\rどんどん　あふれて　くるよね
sourceRecords.english: If you have a rival, don't you get the\nfeeling that you have to keep getting\rbetter?

sourceRecords.japanese: つりを　することで　てにいれた\nおだやかな　こころ‥‥\rそれを　みせて　あげましょう‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Through fishing, I have attained a\nstate of becalmed serenity...\rPlease, allow me to demonstrate...

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥　まけても\nこころは　おだやかです
sourceRecords.english: Though I have lost, my heart remains\ncalm...

sourceRecords.japanese: つれなくても　かまいません\nずっと　いとを　たらしているのです‥‥
sourceRecords.english: It matters not that I catch nothing.\nThe line remains in the water...

sourceRecords.japanese: おっと！？　なみのり　している\nポケモンを　つりあげて　しまったか？
sourceRecords.english: Whoops! Don't tell me I snagged\na SURFING POKéMON?

sourceRecords.japanese: かなわん！
きみの　ポケモン　つよそうだから\nつりあげたら　かなりの　てごたえ　だろうな！
sourceRecords.english: Your POKéMON look pretty strong.\nThey'd be a handful if I hooked them!

sourceRecords.japanese: よーし！\nポケモンずきと　つりずきの　たいけつだ！
sourceRecords.english: Well, hey! This is a match between a\nPOKéMON fan and a fishing buff!

sourceRecords.japanese: わあ！　いとが　からまった！\nまさに　あとの　まつり
sourceRecords.english: No! My line's all tangled!\nThe party's over!

sourceRecords.japanese: つりでは　いとが　からまることを\nマツリ　と　いうんだよ
sourceRecords.english: My fishing line's doing a dance!\nThe tangle tango! Hahaha, snarl!

sourceRecords.japanese: ムロの　ポケモンジムで　まなんだこと\nいま　ここで　ためす！！
sourceRecords.english: What I learned at DEWFORD's POKéMON\nGYM, I will put into practice here.

sourceRecords.japanese: あらなみに　もまれた！
ムロの　ジムリーダー　トウキは\nむかし　カントーで　シバという　おとこと\rいっしょに　とっくん　したらしいな
sourceRecords.english: BRAWLY, DEWFORD's GYM LEADER, used\nto train with a guy named BRUNO in\rKANTO, I've heard.

sourceRecords.japanese: とりポケモンは　すごく　めが　いい！\nおおぞら　たかくから　えものを　みつけるぜ！
sourceRecords.english: BIRD POKéMON have excellent vision.\nThey spot prey from great heights.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふぅ‥‥　まいったぜ
この　ちかくには　いっぱい\nもぐれそうな　ところが　あるな！\cそらから　みてると\nうみの　いろが　ちがうから　よくわかる！
sourceRecords.english: There're lots of diving spots in the\nsea around here.\cYou can spot them easily from the sky\nbecause of their darker color.

sourceRecords.japanese: サイユウシティは　まだ　とおい‥‥
sourceRecords.english: EVER GRANDE CITY is still a long ways\naway...

sourceRecords.japanese: ボクの　はつしょうりも　とおい‥‥
sourceRecords.english: My first victory seems to be far\naway, too...

sourceRecords.japanese: まけつづけている　じんせい　ですが\nけっして　あきらめませんよ‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: My whole life has been about losing,\nbut I will never give up!

sourceRecords.japanese: まだまだ　げんき　ですからね\nサイユウシティ　めざして　およぎますよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm still feeling good. I'll keep on\nswimming to EVER GRANDE CITY.

sourceRecords.japanese: また　はつしょうり　ならず‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I've yet to taste my first victory...

sourceRecords.japanese: あきらめなきゃ　いつかは　かてる\nサイユウシティにも　たどりつく‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: I'll eventually reach EVER GRANDE CITY\nwhere I can eventually win...

sourceRecords.japanese: トライアスロンは\nすいえい　じてんしゃ　マラソン\c３つの　しゅもくを　つづけて　こなす\nかこくな　レースなの！
sourceRecords.english: You have to swim, cycle, and then run\na marathon in a triathlon.\cIt's a grueling race that consists\nof three events.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶも　かこく　よね‥‥
sourceRecords.english: A POKéMON battle is grueling, too...

sourceRecords.japanese: つぎは　じてんしゃ　だけど‥‥\nくじけそうだわ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I have to ride a BIKE next, but...\nI'm about to throw in the towel...

sourceRecords.japanese: トライアスロンも　ながいけど\nポケモン　チャンピオンを　めざすのも\rながい　みちのり　なのね！
sourceRecords.english: A triathlon is long. But I guess the\nroad to become the POKéMON CHAMPION\ris also a long and grueling one.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほんとっ\nポケモンしょうぶ　って　きびしい‥‥
sourceRecords.english: A POKéMON battle really is harsh\nand unforgiving...

sourceRecords.japanese: そろそろ　チャンピオンロードに\nちょうせん　してみるのも　あり　かな？
sourceRecords.english: You should give serious thought to\nchallenges on VICTORY ROAD.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンリーグに　ちょうせん　するため\nいままで　がんばって　きた‥‥\cここで　まけるわけには　いかないわ！
sourceRecords.english: We've been working so hard to mount\na POKéMON LEAGUE challenge...\cWe can't afford to lose now!

sourceRecords.japanese: ああっ！\nなんてこと
ここまで　きたんですもの\nいちど　まけたからって　あきらめない
sourceRecords.english: After all I've done to get here, I won't\ngive up after one setback.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしの　ように　つよい\nポケモントレーナーは　ほかに　いない！
sourceRecords.english: There is no stronger TRAINER than I!

sourceRecords.japanese: なんて　ことだ‥‥！
きみの　ように　つよい\nポケモントレーナーは　ほかに　いないだろう！
sourceRecords.english: There probably is no stronger TRAINER\nthan you!

sourceRecords.japanese: サイユウに　いってみたいから\nたきのぼりを　おぼえた\rポケモンを　つりあげたんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: I want to visit EVER GRANDE, so I\ncaught myself a POKéMON that knows\rthe move WATERFALL to crest the falls.

sourceRecords.japanese: その　いきおい\nまさに　たきのぼり！
しまった！\cたきのぼりを　おぼえた　ポケモン　つっても\nルネの　ジムバッジ　もってない！
sourceRecords.english: Awww, phooey!\cMy POKéMON know WATERFALL, but\nI don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!

sourceRecords.japanese: オレは　しょしんしゃ　トライアスリート\nはじめての　レースで　きんちょう！
sourceRecords.english: This is my first triathlon.\nI'm all tense and nervous!

sourceRecords.japanese: うおー！\nまけてしまったーっ！
きんちょう　していたら\nじつりょくが　だせないよな！
sourceRecords.english: If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to\ngive it my all.

sourceRecords.japanese: トライアスロンの　とちゅう　だけど‥‥\nポケモンしょうぶを　しようよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but,\nsure, why don't we battle?

sourceRecords.japanese: かてると　おもったのにーっ！
だいしぜんを　あいてに\nじぶんの　ちからを　ためす　ことも\rトライアスロンの　だいごみ！
sourceRecords.english: Do you know what's the greatest thing\nabout triathlons?\cTesting the limits of your own\nstrength and endurance against\rMother Nature!

sourceRecords.japanese: ホラホラ！\nとっとと　しょうぶ　しようぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Say hey, hey!\nLet's get on with it!

sourceRecords.japanese: まけた　まけたよ\nとっとと　おわろうぜ！
まけたら　なにも　ないさ\nとっとと　かえると　するか！
sourceRecords.english: There's nothing for a loser.\nTime for me to beat it home.

sourceRecords.japanese: のーんびり　のーんびり　やりましょうか？
sourceRecords.english: What's the hurry?\nLet's take it slow and easy.

sourceRecords.japanese: あらら\nもっと　のんびり　したかったなあ
sourceRecords.english: Oh, my.\nI wanted to relax a little more...

sourceRecords.japanese: あせって　ミスを　するのって　イヤでしょ？\nのんびり　やることに　してるのよ
sourceRecords.english: Don't you hate making mistakes when\nyou're in a rush?\cThat's why I try to take things\nslowly.

sourceRecords.japanese: うみの　ドまんなかで\nトレーナーに　であうとは　めずらしいな\rイッパツ　しょうぶ　するか！？
sourceRecords.english: What a surprise! I didn't expect to\nsee a TRAINER out in the sea.\cI think we should battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: なんて　つよい　こどもだ‥‥
きびしい　たたかいを　くぐりぬけてきた\nいい　めを　しているぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Your eyes have that look of someone\nwho's experienced harsh challenges\rand won. It suits you well!

sourceRecords.japanese: あおい　うみ\nブルーな　こころ\rいやされる‥‥
sourceRecords.english: In the deep blue sea,\nmy shattered blue heart finds\rcomfort among waves.

sourceRecords.japanese: うみ　ひろく\nポケモン　せかい\rまた　ひろし‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Like the vast blue sea,\nthe world of POKéMON spans\rdepths beyond belief.

sourceRecords.japanese: こどもたち\nポケモン　チャンプ\rめざしてる‥‥
sourceRecords.english: The world's children dream\nof one day becoming the\rPOKéMON CHAMPION.

sourceRecords.japanese: うみには　ポケモンが　たくさん　いるからね\nおよいで　わたるのも　くろう　するよ！
sourceRecords.english: The sea is teeming with POKéMON.\nIt's not easy swimming, I tell you.

sourceRecords.japanese: トレーナーの　そだてた　ポケモンは\nホントに　つよいなぁ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are\nseriously tough...

sourceRecords.japanese: ひいひい‥‥　つかれた‥‥\nいきは　よいよい　かえりは　こわい‥‥\rかえりの　たいりょく　のこってるかなあ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Gasp... Gasp... I'm wiped out...\cThe going's easy. It's the leaving\nthat's the hard part.\cWill I have any energy left to make\nthe return trip?

sourceRecords.japanese: うみ　うみ　うみ‥‥\nみわたす　かぎり　うみ‥‥\rうみは　もう　あきたぞーっ！
sourceRecords.english: The sea... The sea... The sea...\nThe sea as far as these eyes can see!\rI'm sick and tired of the sea!

sourceRecords.japanese: ひょえええええっ！
うみに　あきても\nおよぎ　つづけるしか　ないのか\cそんな　オレは\nねっからの　スイマー‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.\cI'm a born swimmer!\nThat's what I am.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちょっと　あんた\nわたしと　しょうぶ　しましょ！
sourceRecords.english: Hi, sweetie, wait!\nWe should battle, you and I!

sourceRecords.japanese: みかけに　よらず\nつよいわねーっ！
sourceRecords.english: You're tough in spite of the way\nyou look!

sourceRecords.japanese: あっちで　うみは　あきた　とか　いってる\nおとこが　いるでしょ？\cアレ　くちだけ　なのよ\nホントは　うみが　すきで　しょうがないの！
sourceRecords.english: Did you see a guy over there who whines\nthat he's bored of the sea?\cThat's all talk.\nHe's hopelessly in love with the sea!

sourceRecords.japanese: なんで　オトコって\nビキニが　すき　なのかしらね！\cみんな　わたしの　こと\nジロジロ　みるのよ！
sourceRecords.english: Why do men love bathing suits so much?\cThey all ogle me!

sourceRecords.japanese: じつりょくが　ちがい　すぎるわ‥‥！
みんな　ビキニを　みてるんじゃなくて\nわたしの　びぼうが　げんいん　かしら‥‥？
sourceRecords.english: Maybe it's not my bathing suit that\nmakes men look. It must be my beauty!

sourceRecords.japanese: アミ『きょうだい　ちからを　あわせて\nがんばっちゃおうかな！？
sourceRecords.english: RELI: We'll work together as siblings\nto take you on!

sourceRecords.japanese: アミ『きょうだいで　ちからを　あわせても\nかてなかったわ
sourceRecords.english: RELI: We couldn't win even though we\nworked together...

sourceRecords.japanese: アミ『キナギの　にんげんは\nうまれた　ときから\rうみと　ポケモンと　いっしょ　なんだ
sourceRecords.english: RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\ntogether with the sea and POKéMON from\rthe time they are born.

sourceRecords.japanese: アミ『ポケモン　２ひき　いないの？\nポケモンしょうぶ　たのしめないわね
sourceRecords.english: RELI: You don't have two POKéMON?\nWe can't enjoy a battle, then.

sourceRecords.japanese: カツ『きょうだい　ちからを　あわせて\nがんばりまーす！！
sourceRecords.english: IAN: I'm doing my best together with\nmy sis!

sourceRecords.japanese: カツ『あねきと　がんばったのに\nかてなかったよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: IAN: I did my best with my sis, but\nwe still couldn't win...

sourceRecords.japanese: カツ『キナギって　うみの　うえに\nうかんでる　まち　だろ？\cだから　うみが　つづくかぎり\nそこは　キナギ　なんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is\na floating town?\cSo, wherever there is the sea, that's\na part of PACIFIDLOG!

sourceRecords.japanese: カツ『ポケモン　２ひき　いたら\nポケモンしょうぶ　してやるよ！
sourceRecords.english: IAN: If you have two POKéMON, we'll\ntake you on!

sourceRecords.japanese: ちいさい　ころは　よく　カゼを　ひいたけど\nすいえいを　はじめて　こんなに　じょうぶ！
sourceRecords.english: I used to catch colds all the time as\na kid, but I became totally fit after\rI started swimming.

sourceRecords.japanese: もっと　つよくなりたい‥‥！
ポケモン　トレーナーも\nのやまを　あるき　まわるから\rとっても　けんこうてき　だよねー！
sourceRecords.english: TRAINERS travel the fields and\nmountains, so they must be fit, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: ながれの　つよい　ところでは\nおよがないように　しているのよ
sourceRecords.english: I try not to swim where the currents\nare too strong.

sourceRecords.japanese: いやああああんっ！
ながされると　じぶんが　どこに　いるのか\nわからなく　なっちゃうの‥‥
sourceRecords.english: If I get swept away, I'll lose all my\nsense of place...

sourceRecords.japanese: かつか　まけるか\nやれば　わかることだろ！
sourceRecords.english: Win or lose, you'll never know until\nyou try!

sourceRecords.japanese: わーん\nまけて　しまった
かてると　わかる　しょうぶは　しない！\nかつか　まけるか\rその　ギリギリの　かんじが　いいんだ！
sourceRecords.english: I never battle when I know I'll win.\nI like to battle at the razor's edge of\rvictory and defeat!

sourceRecords.japanese: ２４じかん　ポケモンのこと　かんがえてる\nそんな　おれに　かてると　おもうか！？
sourceRecords.english: I contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day.\nHow could you possibly beat me?

sourceRecords.japanese: まけた\nおまえさんには　まけたわ
くう‥‥\nおまえも　ポケモンばか　だな！\c２４じかん　ポケモンのこと　ばかり\nかんがえて　いるんだろ！
sourceRecords.english: Urggh...\nYou're a POKéMON fanatic, aren't you?\cYou must contemplate POKéMON 24 hours\na day, don't you?

sourceRecords.japanese: キミも　しおに　ながされて　きたの？\nこれも　なにかの　えんだね\rしょうぶ　しようよ！
sourceRecords.english: Did the currents carry you here, too?\nThis must have been fated. Let's battle!

sourceRecords.japanese: つよい！\nつよすぎっ！
キミみたいな　つよい　トレーナーが\nながされて　くるなんて‥‥\rオレも　ツキが　ないなぁ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER\nlike you would drift here...\rI must be cursed...

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしは　かなしい　おんな‥‥\nながれ　ながれて　ここまで　きたの‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I've led a life of woe and misery...\nI've been cast away, and this is where\rI've drifted...

sourceRecords.japanese: まけたぁ‥‥
ながされる　だけの　じんせい　なんて‥‥\nもう　イヤっ！
sourceRecords.english: A life adrift...\nI don't want it anymore!

sourceRecords.japanese: いらっしゃーい！\nおまち　してましたわ！
いやーん！
つよい　こどもの　トレーナーなんて‥‥\nおねえさん　こまっちゃうぅ！
sourceRecords.english: A strong child TRAINER...\nThat's so annoying!

sourceRecords.japanese: かちたいから　って\nひとと　おなじように　そだては　しないぜ！
sourceRecords.english: I want to win like everyone else, but I\nwon't raise POKéMON like everyone else.

sourceRecords.japanese: くそー！\nおれの　やりかたは　まだまだ　あまい！
sourceRecords.english: Darn it!\nMy way is still too slack!

sourceRecords.japanese: ひとと　おなじこと　するより\nじぶんの　したいこと　したほうが\rたのしいに　きまってるだろ！
sourceRecords.english: It's way more fun to do things the way\nI want than to be like everybody else.\rI mean, that's obvious!

sourceRecords.japanese: とりポケモンと　いっしょに\nこんな　ところまで　きました
sourceRecords.english: I came all the way out here with my\nBIRD POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみ‥‥\nなんて　かっこいいんだ！
そろそろ　ヒワマキに　かえりたいけど\nなんとなく　ここ　すきに　なっちゃったぞ！？
sourceRecords.english: I'd like to go back to FORTREE, but I've\ngrown to like this place, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: およぎの　とくいな　ポケモンだって\nながされる　しおの　ながれだ！
sourceRecords.english: Even those POKéMON that can swim are\ncarried along by the rapid currents.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひえーっ！
ポケモンたちは　この　ながれを\nたのしんでる　みたいだよ！
sourceRecords.english: I think POKéMON enjoy the fast-running\ncurrents around these parts.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたしの　ラブカスたちと\nたのしく　しょうぶ　しましょうよ！
sourceRecords.english: My LUVDISC are looking for a fun\nmatch. Will you join us?

sourceRecords.japanese: あらららららっ！
どこかの　マニアが\nラブカスの　ウロコを　あつめてるのよねー
sourceRecords.english: There's a collector who's after the\nSCALES of LUVDISC.

sourceRecords.japanese: よーしっ！　きゅうけい　おわり！\nポケモンしょうぶ　しようぜ！
sourceRecords.english: Okeydokey! That's enough rest, gang!\nIt's time for a match!

sourceRecords.japanese: また　バテた‥‥
オレの　とりポケモンたち‥‥\nながいあいだ　とぶと　すぐに　バテるんだ
sourceRecords.english: My BIRD POKéMON get tired quickly after\na long flight...

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモントレーナーなら\nだまって　ポケモンしょうぶ！
sourceRecords.english: You're a POKéMON TRAINER.\nNo need for words. We battle now.

sourceRecords.japanese: じぶんから　しょうぶを　いどんでおいて\nまけるとは‥‥　はずかしすぎる‥‥
sourceRecords.english: It was I who challenged you, and yet\nI lost. I am deeply shamed...

sourceRecords.japanese: このあたりの　はげしい　しおの　ながれ！\nそれもまた　おれたちを　きたえてくれる！
sourceRecords.english: The savage tide in this area serves to\nmake us stronger than ever.

sourceRecords.japanese: すなおに　まけを　みとめよう
りゅうせいのたきで\nしゅぎょう　しなおすと　しよう！\cよければ　きみも　いってみたまえ\nきっと　いまより　つよくなる！
sourceRecords.english: We will return for more training at\nMETEOR FALLS.\cIf you'd like, you should go, too.\nIt will definitely toughen you up!

sourceRecords.japanese: スプレーのこうかが　きれた
サファリゾーンを\nこのまま　しゅうりょう　しますか？
sourceRecords.english: Would you like to exit the SAFARI ZONE\nright now?

sourceRecords.japanese: ピンポーン！　じかん　でーす！\nサファリゲームを　しゅうりょう　します
sourceRecords.english: Ding-dong! Time's up!\nYour SAFARI Game is over.

sourceRecords.japanese: サファリボールを　つかいきったので\nサファリゲームを　しゅうりょう　します
sourceRecords.english: You've run out of SAFARI BALLS.\nYour SAFARI Game is over.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポロックおきばに　ポロックを　おきますか？
sourceRecords.english: Would you like to place a [POKEBLOCK]\non the [POKEBLOCK] FEEDER?

sourceRecords.japanese: まだ　[STR_VAR_1]が　のこっています
sourceRecords.english: The [STR_VAR_1] you left\nbefore is still here.

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]を\nおきました！

サファリゾーンへ　ようこそ！\cここでは　ホウエンでは　なかなか
みることの　できない　ポケモンを\cしぜんの　すがたの　まま
めに　することが　できます\cまた　ポケモントレーナーの
ようぼうに　おこたえ　して\cポケモンを
つかまえる　ことも　できます！\cサファリゾーンを　たのしんで　いってね！
sourceRecords.english:
Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\cHere, you may witness many kinds of
POKéMON rarely seen in HOENN.\cAnd, you'll see them in their wild,
untamed state in natural habitats.\cWhat's more, we've thrown open the
gates to POKéMON TRAINERS.\cYou're encouraged to catch POKéMON
for keeps!\cCome in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!

sourceRecords.japanese: サファリゾーンへ　ようこそ！\nサファリゾーンは　はじめて　ですか？
sourceRecords.english: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\nIs it your first time here?

sourceRecords.japanese: サファリゾーンを　たのしんで　いってね！
sourceRecords.english: Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!

sourceRecords.japanese: サファリゾーンでは\n３０この　サファリボールを　つかって\rポケモンを　つかまえる　ことが　できます\cサファリボールを　つかいきるか\n５００ぽ　あるくと\cゲームは　しゅうりょう　です\cサファリゾーンを　たのしんで　いってね！
sourceRecords.english: When you enter the SAFARI ZONE, you\nstart with 30 SAFARI BALLS for\rcatching POKéMON.\cThe SAFARI Game is over when you run\nout of SAFARI BALLS, or when you've\rwalked 500 steps.\cCome in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!

sourceRecords.japanese: サファリゾーンへ　ようこそ！\c５００えんで　ポケモン　つかまえほうだい！\nサファリゲームに　さんか　しますか？
sourceRecords.english: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\cAll you can catch for just $500!\nWould you like to play a SAFARI Game?

sourceRecords.japanese: そうですか\nこんど　ぜひ　さんか　してください！
おかねが　たりませんよ！
それでは　５００えん　いただきます
では　サファリボールを　どうぞ！
[PLAYER]は　サファリボールを\n３０こ　うけとった！
じかんに　なりましたら\nこちらから　おしらせ　しますので\cぞんぶんに　おたのしみ　ください！\nでは　いってらっしゃい！
sourceRecords.english: We'll let you know when your game\nis over.\cSo, until then, enjoy yourself, please!\nOff you go on your wild excursion!

sourceRecords.japanese: おきゃくさん！\nボックスが　いっぱい　ですよ！
sourceRecords.english: Excuse me!\nYour PC BOX is full.

sourceRecords.japanese:
あ！　おきゃくさん
ポロックケースを　おもちで　ないですね？\cサファリゾーンは　ポロックを　つかうと
より　おたのしみ　いただけますので\cぜひ　ポロックケースを
おもちに　なって　おこし　ください！
sourceRecords.english: Excuse me!\nYou seem to be without a [POKEBLOCK] CASE.\cYour SAFARI Game will be much more\nfruitful if you use [POKEBLOCK]S.\cPlease come back with a [POKEBLOCK] CASE.

sourceRecords.japanese: まだ　じかんが　のこっていますが\nサファリゾーンを　やめますか？
sourceRecords.english: You still have time left. Would you like\nto exit the SAFARI ZONE now?

sourceRecords.japanese: では　ひきつづき　おたのしみ　ください！
sourceRecords.english: Please enjoy the rest of your wild\nadventure!

sourceRecords.japanese: わかりました\cそれでは　のこりの　サファリボールを\nおあずかり　します\cおつかれさまでした\nまた　ごりよう　ください
sourceRecords.english: Okay.\cI'll take back your remaining SAFARI\nBALLS.\cThank you for playing.\nWe hope to see you again.

sourceRecords.japanese: それでは　いってらっしゃい！\rなにか　ありましたら\nわたしに　こえを　かけて　くださいね
sourceRecords.english: Good luck!\cIf you need anything, don't hesitate\nto tell me, please!

sourceRecords.japanese: しってた？\cあの　しかくい　はこに　ポロックを　おくと\nポケモンが　あつまって　くるんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: Did you know?\cIf you put a [POKEBLOCK] in that square box,\nPOKéMON gather around.

sourceRecords.japanese: この　さきに　いきたい　けど\nじてんしゃ　もって　くるの　わすれた‥‥\cおくに　めずらしい　ポケモンが\nいそうな　きが　するのに！
sourceRecords.english: I want to keep going deeper, but I\nforgot to bring a BIKE.\cSomething tells me that rare POKéMON\nlive in the outlying areas.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンに　ポロックを　なげても\nしらんぷり　される　ときが　あるのよ\cポケモンにも　すききらいが　あるのかしら？
sourceRecords.english: Sometimes, when I toss a [POKEBLOCK] at \nPOKéMON, it gets ignored.\cDo POKéMON have likes and dislikes\nabout what they eat?

sourceRecords.japanese: ぜぇ‥‥　ぜぇ‥‥\nやっと　ここまで　きたけど‥‥\cつかれちゃって　ポケモン　つかまえる\nげんきも　のこって　ないよ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Gasp... Gasp...\nI...made it out here...but...\cI'm exhausted... I don't have the\nenergy to catch POKéMON...

sourceRecords.japanese: ホウエンに　いない　みずポケモンを\nさがしに　きたんだけど‥‥\cみずうみは　どこにあるのか\nきみ　しってるかい？
sourceRecords.english: I'm on a mission to find WATER POKéMON\nyou don't see in HOENN.\cDo you have any idea where the lake is?

sourceRecords.japanese: ここで　めずらしい　ポケモンを\nたくさん　つかまえて\rともだちと　こうかん　するんだ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm going to catch a lot of rare POKéMON\nhere and trade them with my friends!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポロックおきばに　おいた　ポロックが\nいつのまにか　なくなっていた‥‥\cしらない　うちに\nポケモンが　たべちゃったのかな？
sourceRecords.english: I put a [POKEBLOCK] on the [POKEBLOCK] FEEDER.\nBut it seems to have disappeared.\cI guess POKéMON must have eaten it\nwithout me noticing.

sourceRecords.japanese: サファリゾーンの　おとくな　じょうほう！\cであった　ポケモンに\nポロックを　なげると　にげにくく　なります！
sourceRecords.english: SAFARI ZONE TRAINER TIP!\cThrow [POKEBLOCK]S at wild POKéMON to make\nthem less likely to flee.

sourceRecords.japanese: あるき　つかれたら　ちょっと　ひといき！\n「みんなの　きゅうけいじょ」
おれ　ポロック　もってないけど\nポケモン　たくさん　つかまえたよ\cちかづいて　ボールを　なげる　だけで\nけっこう　つかまえられる　もんだよ！
sourceRecords.english: I don't have any [POKEBLOCK]S, but I caught\na good number of POKéMON.\cYou can improve your chances of making\na catch by getting closer to them\rbefore throwing a SAFARI BALL.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポロックを　つかうと　いつもより\nちょっぴり　にげにくく　なるみたい\cだから　にげにくい　ポケモンに　つかっても\nあんまり　いみが　ないかもね
sourceRecords.english: If you use [POKEBLOCK]S, wild POKéMON won't\nbe so quick to run away.\cIt's not much use to give [POKEBLOCK]S to\nPOKéMON that don't flee easily.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポロックおきばに　ポロック　おいて\nポケモンを　つかまえると\cおなじ　ような　せいかくの　ポケモンが\nあつまる　きが　するなあ
sourceRecords.english: If you put a [POKEBLOCK] on the FEEDER,\nPOKéMON are attracted to it.\cI think POKéMON with the same sort of\nnature are drawn by a certain [POKEBLOCK].

sourceRecords.japanese: ここは　レート[STR_VAR_1]の　ルーレットだい　です\nルーレットで　あそびますか？
sourceRecords.english: The minimum wager at this table is [STR_VAR_1]. \nDo you want to play?

sourceRecords.japanese: コインが　たりません
ほんじつ　このだいでは\nレート　アップ　じっしちゅう！
ベットする　わくを　じゅうじボタンで　えらんで\nＡボタンで　けってい　します
sourceRecords.english: Place your wager with the + Control Pad,\nthen press the A Button.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたりー！
おおあたり！！
はずれー
おめでとう　ございます！\nコイン　[STR_VAR_1]まい　はいります！
コインが　なくなりました
つづけて　あそびますか？
だいの　うえの　たまを\nクリア　します
sourceRecords.english: The ROULETTE board will be cleared.

sourceRecords.japanese: コインケースを　もっていません！
sourceRecords.english: You don't have a COIN CASE.

sourceRecords.japanese: コインが　いっぱいです！\nけいひんと　こうかん　して　ください
sourceRecords.english: Your COIN CASE is full!\nCoins can be exchanged for prizes.

sourceRecords.japanese: わしは　おおきな　[STR_VAR_1]に\nとても　きょうみが　ある！\cん？　きみ　[STR_VAR_1]　もってるの？\nちょ　ちょ　ちょっと・・・\rおじさんに　みせて　おくれ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm very interested in big [STR_VAR_1].\nThe bigger the better.\cHuh? Do you have a [STR_VAR_1]?\nP-p-please, show me!

sourceRecords.japanese: おお！　こいつは　でかい！\nとても　すばらしい　[STR_VAR_1]だ！\cみせて　くれて　ありがとう\nおれいに　これを　もって　いきなさい
sourceRecords.english: Oh, my gosh, this is a big one!\nThis is a grand [STR_VAR_1]!\cThanks for showing me.\nThis is my thanks!

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]は\n[STR_VAR_2]を　もらった！
ありゃ？\nきみ　もちもの　いっぱいだね
ううむ　わしは　これより　おおきい\n[STR_VAR_1]を　みたこと　あるな・・・
sourceRecords.english: Hmm... I've seen a bigger [STR_VAR_1]\nthan this one.

sourceRecords.japanese: おお　こいつは　なかなか・・・って\nこれ　[STR_VAR_1]じゃ　ないよ！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, now this is quite something...\nBut it's not a [STR_VAR_1]!

sourceRecords.japanese: おおきい　[STR_VAR_1]　もってないの？\rそれは　ざんねん・・・\nこんど　おおきい　[STR_VAR_1]　みせてね
sourceRecords.english: You don't have a big [STR_VAR_1]?\nThat's too bad...\cIf you get a big [STR_VAR_1],\nplease come show me.

sourceRecords.japanese: しじょう　さいだいの　[STR_VAR_1]！\n[STR_VAR_2]の　[STR_VAR_3]ｃｍのやつ！
オダマキ『おお　[PLAYER][KUN]！\cポケモンずかんの　ようすを\nみせて　くれるのかい？
sourceRecords.english: PROF. BIRCH: Ah, [PLAYER][KUN]!\cHave you come to show me how your\nPOKéDEX is coming along?

sourceRecords.japanese: うん？　みせるほど\nポケモンを　つかまえて　いないのか
sourceRecords.english: Hm? Oh, you haven't caught enough\nPOKéMON to make it worthwhile.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふむふむ‥‥\cみつけた　ポケモン　[STR_VAR_1]\nつかまえた　ポケモン　[STR_VAR_2]　か‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Hmhm...\cSo, you've seen [STR_VAR_1] POKéMON,\nand you've caught [STR_VAR_2] POKéMON...

sourceRecords.japanese: もっと　くさむらに　はいって\nポケモンを　さがしてみると　いいな！
sourceRecords.english: You should go into grassy areas more\nand look for POKéMON more carefully.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちょうしが　でてきた　みたいだね\nでも　これからが　たいへん　なんだぞ！
sourceRecords.english: I guess you're getting the hang of it.\nBut, it gets harder from here.

sourceRecords.japanese: きまった　ばしょでしか　みつからない\nポケモンは　しつこく　さがすしか　ないぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Some POKéMON only appear in certain\nareas. You'll need to be persistent.

sourceRecords.japanese: ボリュームは　まだまだ　だけど\nすこしは　ポケモンずかん　らしく　なったぞ
sourceRecords.english: Well, it could use more quantity, but\nthis is looking more like a POKéDEX now.

sourceRecords.japanese: なかなか　いい　かんじ　だな！\nこの　ちょうしで　がんばって　くれよ
sourceRecords.english: This is coming along pretty good.\nKeep up the effort.

sourceRecords.japanese: つりざおは　つかって　いるかな？\nうみにも　ポケモンは　たくさん　いるからな
sourceRecords.english: Are you using any RODS?\nThere are many POKéMON in the sea.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンを　つかまえる　だけでなく\nしんか　させるのは　どうだい？
sourceRecords.english: Instead of just catching POKéMON,\nhow about making them evolve, too?

sourceRecords.japanese: すばらしい　ポケモンずかんに　なりそうだ\nそんな　よかんが　して　たまらないね！
sourceRecords.english: This is going to be a fantastic POKéDEX.\nThat's the feeling I'm getting.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここまで　あつめるとは‥‥\nきみの　さいのうは　たいした　ものだよ！
sourceRecords.english: You've collected this many...\nYour talent is remarkable!

sourceRecords.japanese: サファリゾーンには　いったかい？\nあそこでしか　つかまえられない\rポケモンも　いるって　はなし　だぞ！
sourceRecords.english: Have you visited the SAFARI ZONE?\cI hear there are some POKéMON that\ncan only be caught there.

sourceRecords.japanese: とうとう　１００しゅるい　こえたのか！\nポケモンずかん　として　みごとな　もんだね！
sourceRecords.english: You've finally reached the 100-kind\nmark. This is an impressive POKéDEX!

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥そういえば　いわくだきを　つかうことで\nみつかる　ポケモンも　いたっけ
sourceRecords.english: There might be POKéMON that can be\nfound using ROCK SMASH.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンこうかん　すれば\nもっと　あつまるかも　しれないな
sourceRecords.english: You should get some more POKéMON by\ntrading with others.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんでも　なついていると\nしんか　する　ポケモンも　いるそうだよ！
sourceRecords.english: I've heard of POKéMON that evolve when\nthey come to fully love their TRAINERS.

sourceRecords.japanese: ホウエンちほう　には　こんなにも\nおおくの　ポケモンが　いたのか‥‥
sourceRecords.english: I had no idea that there were so many\nPOKéMON species in the HOENN region.

sourceRecords.japanese: ときどき　たいりょうはっせい　する\nポケモンが　いるらしい\rその　チャンスを　のがさないようにな！
sourceRecords.english: On occasion, some POKéMON appear in\nlarge numbers like wild outbreaks.\rDon't miss opportunities like those.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみの　ずかんを　みれば\nホウエンちほうの　ポケモンの\rすべてが　わかるようだ！
sourceRecords.english: One can get a very good idea about the\nPOKéMON of the HOENN region by looking\rthrough your POKéDEX.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみは　ポケモンはかせ　としても\nゆうしゅう　なんだな
sourceRecords.english: I'd say you already qualify as a POKéMON\nPROFESSOR, and a good one, too!

sourceRecords.japanese: ここまで　ずかんが　できたら\nもはや　プロフェッショナル　だぞ！
sourceRecords.english: With a POKéDEX this complete, you're\na real professional at this!

sourceRecords.japanese: いよいよ　かんせいに　ちかづいた！\nそんな　よかんが　してきたよ！
sourceRecords.english: You're very close to completing this\nPOKéDEX. I can feel it in my bones!

sourceRecords.japanese: おめでとう！！\nポケモンずかんの　かんせい　だよ！！
ふむふむ　ぜんこくてき　には‥‥\cみつけた　ポケモン　[STR_VAR_1]\nつかまえた　ポケモン　[STR_VAR_2]　だね
sourceRecords.english: Hmhm...\nOn a nationwide basis...\cYou've seen [STR_VAR_1] POKéMON,\nand you've caught [STR_VAR_2] POKéMON...

sourceRecords.japanese:
こちらは　ポケモンくじ
ちゅうせん　コーナーです\cとうデパートに　おこし　いただいた　かたに
もれなく　ポケモンくじをひいて　いただいて　います！\cひいた　くじの　ナンバーと
おきゃくさまの　ポケモンの　ＩＤがあっていましたら　すてきな　しょうひんをプレゼント　いたします！\cポケモンくじを　ひかれますか？
sourceRecords.english:
This is the POKéMON LOTTERY CORNER.\cAll shoppers visiting our DEPARTMENT
STORE get to draw a POKéMON LOTOTICKET.\cIf the LOTO TICKET's number matches
the ID number of any of your POKéMON,you will receive a fabulous gift.\cWould you like to draw a POKéMON
LOTO TICKET?

sourceRecords.japanese: また　あした　いこう\nおこし　ください
それでは　また　おこし　ください
では　くじを　ひいて　ください\n‥‥‥
では　くじを　ひいて　ください\n‥[PAUSE 57]‥[PAUSE 57]‥[PAUSE 57]
くじの　ナンバーは　[STR_VAR_1]です！\cナンバーが　あなたの　ポケモンの　ＩＤと\nいっちしているか　おしらべ　いたしますので\rしょうしょう　おまちください
sourceRecords.english: The LOTO TICKET number is [STR_VAR_1].\cI need to run a check on this number\nto see if it matches any of your\rPOKéMON's ID numbers. Please wait.

sourceRecords.japanese: おめでとう　ございます！\cあなたが　つれている\n[STR_VAR_1]ちゃんの　ＩＤが　みごとに\rくじの　ナンバーと　いっち　しました！
sourceRecords.english: Congratulations!\cThe ID number of your team's\n[STR_VAR_1] matches your LOTO TICKET's\rnumber!

sourceRecords.japanese: おめでとう　ございます！\cパソコンに　あずけている\n[STR_VAR_1]ちゃんの　ＩＤが　みごとに\rくじの　ナンバーと　いっち　しました！
sourceRecords.english: Congratulations!\cThe ID number of your PC-boxed\n[STR_VAR_1] matches your LOTO TICKET's\rnumber!

sourceRecords.japanese: ざんねんでした\nすべて　はずれの　ようです
sourceRecords.english: I'm sorry.\nNone of the numbers matched.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２ケタ　あって　いましたので\n３とう　です！\r[STR_VAR_1]を　さしあげます！！
sourceRecords.english: Two digits matched, so you win the\nthird prize!\rYou've won the [STR_VAR_1]!

sourceRecords.japanese: ３ケタ　あって　いましたので\n２とう　です！\r[STR_VAR_1]を　さしあげます！！
sourceRecords.english: Three digits matched, so you win the\nsecond prize!\rYou've won the [STR_VAR_1]!

sourceRecords.japanese: ４ケタ　あって　いましたので\n１とう　です！\r[STR_VAR_1]を　さしあげます！！
sourceRecords.english: Four digits matched, so you win the\nfirst prize!\rYou've won the [STR_VAR_1]!

sourceRecords.japanese: なんと　５ケタ　すべて\nあって　いました！！\cとくとうです！！\n[STR_VAR_1]を　さしあげます！！
sourceRecords.english: Oh, my goodness, all five digits matched!\cYou've won the jackpot prize!\nYou've won the [STR_VAR_1]!

sourceRecords.japanese: ‥‥‥あら？\nどうぐが　いっぱいの　ようですね\cどうぐを　せいりしてから　もういちど\nおこし　ください
sourceRecords.english: Oh?\nYou seem to have no room for this.\cPlease make room in your BAG and\nlet me know.

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER]さん　ですね\nおまちして　おりました！\cでは　しょうひんを\nおわたし　いたします
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER]?\nYes, I've been expecting you.\cThis is the prize we've been holding\nfor you.

sourceRecords.japanese: それでは　また　おこし　ください
パパ『[PLAYER]！　よく　きたな！\n[PLAYER]あての　てがみが　とどけられたぞ
sourceRecords.english: DAD: [PLAYER]! Good to see you!\nThere's a letter here for you, [PLAYER].

sourceRecords.japanese: パパ『わたしも　みたことのない\nふねの　チケット　だな‥‥\rミナモに　いってみると　いいだろう
sourceRecords.english: DAD: I guess this is a PASS for a ship.\nBut I've never seen this ship before.\cYou should find out what this is about\nin LILYCOVE.

sourceRecords.japanese: カイナいき　れんらくせん‥‥\cあら？\nその　チケットは‥‥！
sourceRecords.english: The ferry to SLATEPORT is...\cOh?\nThat PASS...

sourceRecords.japanese:
ヘンテコな　チケットを
もってきたのは　おまえさんか？\cおまえが　いこうと　しているのは
みなみの　はての　ちっぽけな　しま‥‥\cそこでは　なにが　おこるのか
だれも　わからねえ‥‥ううむ　ふなのりの　ちが　さわぐぜ！\cさあ　のりな！
sourceRecords.english:
Aye, mate, are you the one who brought
that mighty odd PASS?\cI'll tell you, you're trying to reach a
tiny spit of an island far in the south.\cThere's no telling what we'll encounter
once we reach there, aye.That shivers my timbers!\cAll aboard!

sourceRecords.japanese: なにもねえ　ちんけな　しま　だな‥‥\nミナモへ　かえるか？
sourceRecords.english: Aye, mate, there's nothing here to\nsee or do on this forgettable island.\cWhat say we sail back to LILYCOVE?

sourceRecords.japanese: よし！　かえると　するか！
sourceRecords.english: Aye, right, then!\nSail home we will!

sourceRecords.japanese: そうかい\nまあ　すきにするが　いいさ
sourceRecords.english: Aye, right, as you like, then.

sourceRecords.japanese: すべての　ゆめは　もうひとつの　げんじつ\nそれを　わすれるべからず‥‥
sourceRecords.english: “All dreams are but another reality.\nNever forget...”

sourceRecords.japanese: きおく　かすみし　ものは\nこころに　きざみつける　ことを　のぞむ‥‥
sourceRecords.english: “Those whose memories fade seek to\ncarve them in their hearts...”

パパ『やあ　[PLAYER]！\cめずらしい　きのみを　てに　いれたから\nプレゼント　するよ！
sourceRecords.english: DAD: Hi, [PLAYER]!\cI just received a very rare BERRY.\nI'd like you to have it.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふかふかの　つちに　はえている　きのみは\nじゆうに　とっても　よいのじゃが‥\c１つだけ　きのみを　おなじ　ばしょに　うめる\nそれが　れいぎと　いうものじゃ\cほれ　これを　わけてやろう
sourceRecords.english: If you see BERRIES growing in loamy\nsoil, feel free to take them.\cBut make sure you plant a BERRY in the\nsame spot. That's common courtesy.\cHere, I'll share this with you.

sourceRecords.japanese: あんた　みたところ　トレーナーじゃろ？\cトレーナーは　よく　きのみを　ポケモンに\nもたせとるわい\cふやすも　つかうも　あんた　しだいじゃ
sourceRecords.english:
The way you look, you must be a
TRAINER, no?\cTRAINERS often make POKéMON hold
BERRIES.\cIt's up to you whether to grow BERRIES
or use them.

sourceRecords.japanese: いつも　みずを　あげてたら\nたくさん　はなが　さいたんだ\cそしたら　きのみも　たくさん　できた！\cはい！\nこれ　あげる
sourceRecords.english:
I watered my plants lots and lots!
A whole bunch of flowers bloomed!\cAnd then a whole bunch of BERRIES
appeared!\cHere you go!
You can have this!

sourceRecords.japanese: がんばって　あかいポロック　つくるんだ！\n[STR_VAR_1]も　がんばってね！
sourceRecords.english: I'm going to try really hard and make\nsome RED [POKEBLOCK]S!\cI hope you try hard, too!

sourceRecords.japanese: きょうは　なにいろの　きのみを\nさがそっかなー
sourceRecords.english: I wonder what color BERRIES I'll look\nfor today?

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンコンテストの　ゆうしょうを　めざして\nきのみを　あつめているんだ\cよかったら　きみにも　わけて　あげるよ！
sourceRecords.english: I'm gathering BERRIES so I can win a\nPOKéMON CONTEST.\cIf you'd like, I'll share one with you.

sourceRecords.japanese: きみも　がんばれ！
きょうは　どの　きのみを　うめるか‥\nそして　なにいろの　ポロックを　つくるか‥\cなやむのも　また　たのしいよ
sourceRecords.english: What BERRIES should I plant today?\nWhat color [POKEBLOCK]S should I make?\cFretting over stuff like that is fun\nin its own way.

sourceRecords.japanese: ケースを　ふると　でてくる　ポロック‥\cそして　それを　キャッチして\nたべてくれる　ポケモン‥\cこれって　あい　だよね？
sourceRecords.english: Give the case a shake, and out pops\na [POKEBLOCK]...\cAnd that [POKEBLOCK] is caught and eaten\nby a POKéMON...\cIt's an expression of love, isn't it?

sourceRecords.japanese: うん　うん！\nやっぱ　わかるひとには　わかるよね\cこれ　あげる
sourceRecords.english: Yes, yes.\nYou understand what I mean.\cYou should take this.

sourceRecords.japanese: そっか‥‥\nでも　ちがうと　かんじることも　たいせつだね\cこれ　あげる
sourceRecords.english: Oh... But it is important to make your\nown impressions, I guess...\cYou can have this.

sourceRecords.japanese: その　きのみは　めずらしいもの　らしいから\nたいせつに　そだててね！
sourceRecords.english: I think that BERRY is rare.\nI hope you raise it with loving care.

sourceRecords.japanese: また　きのみめいじんに　もらって　こようっと
sourceRecords.english: I'll get more BERRIES from the\nBERRY MASTER.

sourceRecords.japanese: やっぱり\cわたしに　スーツが　にあうように\nうみには　しおかぜが　にあうな\rそして　きみには　きのみが　にあいそうだ‥‥\cなんでだろうね？
sourceRecords.english: When it gets right down to it...\cThe same way suits suit me perfectly,\na crisp breeze suits the sea.\cAnd you, a BERRY suits you to a “T”...\cWhy should that be so?

sourceRecords.japanese: やっぱり　それは‥‥‥‥\cきみが　トレーナーだからだ！
sourceRecords.english: When it gets right down to it...\cIt's because you're a TRAINER!

sourceRecords.japanese: やっぱり\cわたしに　シンプルさが　にあうように\nポケモンには　ポロックが　にあうな
sourceRecords.english: When it gets right down to it...\cThe way dignified simplicity suits me,\n[POKEBLOCK]S perfectly suit POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: わしは　きのみめいじんと　よばれておる\cわしは　せかいじゅうを　うつくしい　はなで\nうめつくそうと　きのみを　そだてて\rそして　くばり　まくって　おるのじゃ\cきみにも　きのみを　わけて　あげよう！
sourceRecords.english: You may call me the BERRY MASTER.\cI dream of filling the world with\nbeautiful flowers, so I raise BERRIES\rand hand them out to everyone.\cYou're deserving of one!

sourceRecords.japanese: ほれ　えんりょ　せずに　もう　ひとつ！
カナズミの　ちかくにある　サン・トウカという\nフラワーショップも　よろしくの\cせかいに　はなを　さかせましょう！
sourceRecords.english: Be sure to visit the PRETTY PETAL\nflower shop near RUSTBORO.\cLet flowers fill the world!

sourceRecords.japanese: きょうは　もう　おしまいじゃ\nまた　おいで\cせかいに　はなを　さかせましょう！
sourceRecords.english: I'm done for today.\nCome again another day.\cLet flowers fill the world!

sourceRecords.japanese: じいさんの　きのみの　そだてかたは\nそりゃあ　せかいいちじゃ\cわしも　はなが　たかいわい\cところで　あんた\nいい　ことばを　きいたことが　ないかい？
sourceRecords.english: The way my husband grows BERRIES,\noh, he's the best in the world.\cHe makes me proud, that he does.\cIncidentally, child, have you heard\na good saying lately?

sourceRecords.japanese: おお！　とても　よい　ことばじゃ！\nかんどう　したわい\cほれ　これを　もっていきなされ
sourceRecords.english: Ah! What a remarkable saying!\nInspirational, it is!\cI want you to have this.

sourceRecords.japanese: おお！　なかなか　よい　ことばじゃ\nあんたも　たいしたもんじゃ\cほれ　これを　もっていきなされ
sourceRecords.english: Oh! A good saying it is.\nYou're quite remarkable.\cI want you to have this.

sourceRecords.japanese: まごたち　４にんも　じいさんを　しのぐ\nおおものに　なるじゃろうて\cじんせい　たのしいことが　つきんのう！
sourceRecords.english: Our four grandchildren should become\nmore accomplished than my husband.\cJoy never goes out of my life!

sourceRecords.japanese: ほう‥‥
こんにちは！\cはなを　せかいに　ひろめる\nフラワーショップ　サン・トウカです！
sourceRecords.english: Hello!\cThis is the PRETTY PETAL flower shop.\nSpreading flowers throughout the world!

sourceRecords.japanese: [PLAYER][KUN]　きのみの　こと　しりたい？
sourceRecords.english: [PLAYER][KUN], would you like to learn about\nBERRIES?

sourceRecords.japanese: あなたの　なまえは‥‥\c[PLAYER][KUN]ね！\nとっても　いい　なまえだね！\r[PLAYER][KUN]　きのみのこと　しりたい？
sourceRecords.english: Your name is?\c[PLAYER][KUN].\nThat's a nice name.\c[PLAYER][KUN], would you like to learn about\nBERRIES?

sourceRecords.japanese:
きのみはね　くろい　ふかふかの　つちの
ところで　たまに　とれるのでね‥‥\cとったら　その１つを　また　うめるの！\cそうすると　その　きのみ　から
めがでて　みきが　できて　はながさいてまた　きのみ　が　できるの\cそうやって　はなを　ふやして
せかいじゅうを　はなに　するのがわたしの　ゆめ　なんだ！\cだから　[PLAYER][KUN]も　きのみを　うめて
せかいに　はなを　ふやしてね！
sourceRecords.english:
BERRIES grow on trees that thrive
only in dark, loamy soil.\cIf you take some BERRIES, be sure to
plant one in the loamy soil again.\cA planted BERRY will soon sprout,
grow into a plant, flower beautifully,then grow BERRIES again.\cI want to see the whole wide world
filled with beautiful flowers.That's my dream.\cPlease help me, [PLAYER][KUN]. Plant BERRIES
and bring more flowers into the world.

sourceRecords.japanese: おはなって　とっても　しあわせな　きぶんに\nしてくれるよね
sourceRecords.english: Flowers bring so much happiness to\npeople, don't they?

sourceRecords.japanese: こんにちは！\cおはなは　せわを　すれば　するほど\nたくさん　きれいに　さいて　くれるの\cあなたも　せわを　したく　なった　でしょ？\nこれ　あげるわ
sourceRecords.english: Hello!\cThe more attention you give to flowers,\nthe more beautifully they bloom.\cYou'll like tending flowers. I'm sure\nof it. You can have this.

sourceRecords.japanese:
きのみが　そだつ　たびに
じょうろで　みずを　あげてね！\cあとね\cきのみは　ずっと　ずっと　ほうっておくと
じめんに　おちてしまうのでもね　そこから　また　めがでて　くるの！\cすごいよね！
いきものの　ちからを　かんじるよね
sourceRecords.english:
While BERRY plants are growing,
water them with the WAILMER PAIL.\cOh, another thing.\cIf you don't pick BERRIES for a while,
they'll drop off onto the ground.But they'll sprout again.\cIsn't that awesome?
It's like they have the will to live.

sourceRecords.japanese: おねーちゃんたちを　みならって\nがんばって　おはなを　そだててるの\cはい！　これあげる！
sourceRecords.english: I'm trying to be like my big sisters.\nI'm growing flowers, too!\cHere you go! It's for you!

sourceRecords.japanese: きのみは　うめて　おおきく　したり\nポケモンに　もたせたり　できるの\cでも　さいきん　きのみを　いくつか　まぜると\nポケモンの　おかしになる　きかいが\rある　らしいんだ\cあたしも　おかし　ほしー
sourceRecords.english: You can plant a BERRY and grow it big,\nor you can make a POKéMON hold it.\cBut now they have a machine that mixes\nup different BERRIES and makes candies\rfor POKéMON.\cI want some candy, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]　なまえ　なんていうの？\c‥‥‥　‥‥‥　‥‥‥\nへー　いいねー\cわたしは　キリ　っていう　なまえなの\cパパと　ママが　すくすくと　そだって\nこころの　あたたかい　おんなのこに　なって\rほしいっていう　ねがいを　こめたんだって！\c[STR_VAR_1]にも　これ　あげる
sourceRecords.english: Hi, what's your name?\c... ... ...  ... ... ...  ... ... ...\nOkay. That's nice!\cMy name is KIRI.\cMy mommy and daddy named me that so\nI would grow healthy and warmhearted.\rThat's what they wished.\cYou can have one of these.

sourceRecords.japanese: あと　[STR_VAR_1]には　キリの　だいすきな\nこの　きのみも　あげちゃう！
sourceRecords.english: KIRI will give you this BERRY, too!\nI really like it lots!

sourceRecords.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]の　なまえには\nどんな　ねがいが　こめられてるの？
sourceRecords.english: I wonder what kind of wish is included\nin your name.

sourceRecords.japanese: はる　なつ　あき　ふゆ\nはるに　うまれると　はるが　すきで\rなつに　うまれると　なつが　すきなのかな？
sourceRecords.english: Spring, summer, autumn, and winter.\cIf you're born in springtime, do you like\nthe spring, and if you're born in the\rsummer, do you like the summer?

sourceRecords.japanese: じゃあ　キリは　あきに　うまれたから\nあきが　だいすき！\c[STR_VAR_1]は　いつが　すき？
sourceRecords.english: Then KIRI was born in the autumn,\nso I love the autumn!\cWhich season do you like?

sourceRecords.japanese: そっか‥\nかんけいないのか‥\cしりたいことって　たくさんあるなー
sourceRecords.english: Oh...\nIt doesn't matter...\cThere's so much that I want to know...

sourceRecords.japanese: このさきに　すすむのかね？\cもしで　よかったら\nあさせのしおと　あさせのかいがらを\rあつめてきて　くれないか\cざいりょうが　あつまったら\nわたしが　いいもの　つくるんだがね
sourceRecords.english:
Are you planning on going deep in
there?\cHow about bringing me back some
SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS?\cI can make you something good if
you bring me the ingredients.

sourceRecords.japanese: あさせのしおと　あさせのかいがら\nそれぞれ　４つ　あれば\rかいがらのすずが　つくれるんだが‥‥\cかいがらのすずの　ざいりょう　なら\nまいにち　とれるよ
sourceRecords.english: If you bring me four each of the\nSHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS,\rI can make you a SHELL BELL...\cYou can get those ingredients\nevery day.

sourceRecords.japanese: お！　あさせのしおと　あさせのかいがら！\nりょうも　じゅうぶんだ！\cこれで　かいがらのすず\nつくっても　いいかね？
sourceRecords.english: Oh, hey! SHOAL SALT and SHOAL\nSHELLS! And enough of them, too!\cWould you like me to make you a\nSHELL BELL with them?

sourceRecords.japanese: かいがらのすず\nさっそく　つくらせて　もらうよ\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\n‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cよし　できたっ！
sourceRecords.english: All righty, then! I'll make you a\nSHELL BELL right away.\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThere! Done!

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンに　もたせてあげると　よろこぶよ\cなんたって　かいがらのすずの　ねいろは\nてんか　いっぴん　だからね\cかいがらのすずの　ざいりょう　なら\nまいにち　とれるから\rそろえば　また　つくらせて　もらうよ
sourceRecords.english:
Have a POKéMON hold on to that.
It'll love it, that's for certain.\cWhy, the SHELL BELL's chime...
It's simply sublime!\cYou can get its ingredients every
day, so I can make you more.

sourceRecords.japanese: そうかね‥‥\nかいがらのすず　つくりたかった‥‥
sourceRecords.english: Oh... Is that so...\nI wanted to make a SHELL BELL...

sourceRecords.japanese: あさせのしおを　とった　あと‥‥\nいまは　なにも　ない‥‥
sourceRecords.english: There was some SHOAL SALT here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.

sourceRecords.japanese: あさせのかいがらを　みつけた　あと‥‥\nいまは　なにも　ない‥‥
sourceRecords.english: There was a SHOAL SHELL here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.

sourceRecords.japanese: つくっても　バッグが　いっぱいで\nもてない　ようだね‥‥\cせいりして　また　くると　いいよ
sourceRecords.english: You don't have space in your BAG\nif I were to make it for you.\cYou should make room and come back\nfor a SHELL BELL.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンえほんが　そろってる！
sourceRecords.english: There's a set of POKéMON picture books.

sourceRecords.japanese: いろんな　ほんが　いっぱいだ！
sourceRecords.english: It's filled with all sorts of books.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンざっしが　ならんでる！\c‥‥「ポケモンのとも」\n‥‥「ポケモン　てちょう」\r‥‥「かわいい　ポケモン」
たかそうな　つぼが　ある！\nのぞきこむと‥‥\cなかは　からっぽ　だ！
sourceRecords.english: This vase looks expensive...\nPeered inside...\cBut, it was empty.

sourceRecords.japanese: なかは　からっぽ　だ！
たくさんの　ポケモン　グッズが\nところせましと　ならべられてる！
sourceRecords.english: The shelves brim with all sorts of\nPOKéMON merchandise.

sourceRecords.japanese: なにかの　せっけいず‥‥？\nみても　チンプンカンプン！
sourceRecords.english: A blueprint of some sort?\nIt's too complicated!

sourceRecords.japanese: テストよう　メッセージです！\nポケモンの　せかいへ　ようこそ！
sourceRecords.english: テストよう　メッセージです！\nポケモンの　せかいへ　ようこそ！

sourceRecords.japanese: テストよう　メッセージです！\nかんばん　です
sourceRecords.english: テストよう　メッセージです！\nかんばん　です

sourceRecords.japanese: テストよう　メッセージです！\nざひょう　チェックの　イベントです
sourceRecords.english: テストよう　メッセージです！\nざひょう　チェックの　イベントです

sourceRecords.japanese: ここまでの　かつやくを\nポケモンレポートに　かきこみますか？
sourceRecords.english: Would you like to save the game?

sourceRecords.japanese: まえに　かかれた　レポートに\nうえから　かいても　いいですか？
sourceRecords.english: There is already a saved file.\nIs it okay to overwrite it?

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンレポートに　かきこんでいます\nでんげんを　きらないで　ください
[PLAYER]　は\nレポートに　しっかり　かきのこした！
セーブに　しっぱい　しました‥
べつの　ぼうけんの\nレポートが　かかれています！\cうえから　かいても　いいですか？
sourceRecords.english: There is a different game file that is\nalready saved.\cIs it okay to overwrite it?

sourceRecords.japanese: いやー　おまたせ　おまたせ！\cポケットモンスターの　せかいへ\nようこそ！\cわたしの　なまえは　オダマキ！\cでも　みんな　からは\n「ポケモンはかせ」と　よばれて　いるよ！\c
sourceRecords.english: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!\cWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\cMy name is BIRCH.\cBut everyone calls me the POKéMON\nPROFESSOR.\c

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケットモンスター\n‥‥すなわち　ポケモン\c
sourceRecords.english: This is what we call a “POKéMON.”

sourceRecords.japanese:
この　せかいには
ポケモンと　よばれる　いきもの　たちがいたるところに　すんでいる！\cわれわれ　にんげんは
ポケモンと　なかよく　あそんだりたすけあって　しごとを　したり\cときには　ちからを　あわせて
たたかったり　しながら\cいっしょに　くらして　いるんだ！\c‥‥しかし　われわれは　ポケモンの
すべてを　しっている　わけでは　ない\cポケモンの　ひみつは
まだまだ　いっぱい　ある！\cその　ひみつを　ときあかす　ため
わたしは　けんきゅうを　つづけているという　わけなんだ！\c
sourceRecords.english:
This world is widely inhabited by
creatures known as POKéMON.\cWe humans live alongside POKéMON,
at times as friendly playmates, andat times as cooperative workmates.\cAnd sometimes, we band together
and battle others like us.\cBut despite our closeness, we don't
know everything about POKéMON.\cIn fact, there are many, many
secrets surrounding POKéMON.\cTo unravel POKéMON mysteries,
I've been undertaking research.That's what I do.\c

sourceRecords.japanese: ところで　きみは‥‥？
おとこのこ？\nそれとも　おんなのこ？
sourceRecords.english: Are you a boy?\nOr are you a girl?

sourceRecords.japanese: なまえも　おしえて　くれるかい！
[PLAYER][KUN]　だね？
‥‥そうか！\cきみが　こんど　わたしの　すむ　まち\nミシロタウンに　ひっこして　くる\r[PLAYER][KUN]　だったのか！\c
sourceRecords.english: Ah, okay!\cYou're [PLAYER][KUN] who's moving to my\nhometown of LITTLEROOT.\rI get it now!

sourceRecords.japanese:
よーし　じゅんびは　いいかい？\cこれから　きみ　だけの　ものがたりが
はじまろうと　している！\cゆめと　ぼうけんと　であいに　みちた
ポケットモンスターの　せかいへゆうきを　もって　とびこんで　みてくれ！\cでは　また　あとで　あおう！
けんきゅうじょで　まって　いるぞ！\c
sourceRecords.english:
All right, are you ready?\cYour very own adventure is about
to unfold.\cTake courage, and leap into the
world of POKéMON where dreams,adventure, and friendships await!\cWell, I'll be expecting you later.
Come see me in my POKéMON LAB.\c
