sourceRecords.english: This is a newly discovered POKéMON.\nIt is currently under investigation.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: No detailed information is available\nat this time.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひなたで　ひるねを　する　すがたを　みかける。\nたいようの　ひかりを　いっぱい　あびることで\nせなかの　タネが　おおきく　そだつのだ。
sourceRecords.english: BULBASAUR can be seen napping in\nbright sunlight.\nThere is a seed on its back.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed\ngrows progressively larger.

sourceRecords.japanese: つぼみを　ささえるため　あしこしが　つよくなる。\nひなたで　じっとする　じかんが　ながくなれば\nいよいよ　たいりんの　はなが　さくころだ。
sourceRecords.english: There is a bud on this POKéMON's back.\nTo support its weight, IVYSAUR's legs\nand trunk grow thick and strong.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If it starts spending more time lying\nin the sunlight, it's a sign that the\nbud will bloom into a large flower soon.

sourceRecords.japanese: じゅうぶんな　えいようと　たいようの　ひかりが\nはなの　いろを　あざやかに　すると　いわれる。\nはなの　かおりは　ひとの　こころを　いやす。
sourceRecords.english: There is a large flower on VENUSAUR's\nback. The flower is said to take on vivid\ncolors if it gets plenty of nutrition

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: and sunlight. The flower's aroma\nsoothes the emotions of people.

sourceRecords.japanese: しっぽの　ほのおは　きぶんを　ひょうげん。\nたのしい　ときには　ゆらゆら　ほのおが　ゆれて\nおこった　ときには　めらめら　さかんに　もえる。
sourceRecords.english: The flame that burns at the tip of its\ntail is an indication of its emotions.\nThe flame wavers when CHARMANDER is

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: enjoying itself. If the POKéMON becomes\nenraged, the flame burns fiercely.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどい　ツメで　ようしゃなく　たたきのめす。\nきょうてきと　むかいあうと　きぶんが　たかぶり\nしっぽの　ほのおが　あおじろく　もえあがる。
sourceRecords.english: CHARMELEON mercilessly destroys its\nfoes using its sharp claws.\nIf it encounters a strong foe, it turns

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: aggressive. In this excited state, the\nflame at the tip of its tail flares with a\nbluish white color.

sourceRecords.japanese: つよい　あいてを　もとめて　そらを　とびまわる。\nなんでも　とかして　しまう　こうねつの　ほのおを\nじぶんより　よわいものに　むけることは　しない。
sourceRecords.english: CHARIZARD flies around the sky in\nsearch of powerful opponents.\nIt breathes fire of such great heat

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: that it melts anything. However, it\nnever turns its fiery breath on any\nopponent weaker than itself.

sourceRecords.japanese: こうらの　やくめは　みを　まもる　だけではない。\nまるい　かたちと　ひょうめんの　みぞが　みずの\nていこうを　へらすので　はやく　およげるのだ。
sourceRecords.english: SQUIRTLE's shell is not merely used\nfor protection.\nThe shell's rounded shape and the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: grooves on its surface help minimize\nresistance in water, enabling this\nPOKéMON to swim at high speeds.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふさふさの　けで　おおわれた　おおきな　しっぽは\nながいき　するほど　ふかい　いろあいに　かわる。\nこうらの　キズは　つわものの　あかし。
sourceRecords.english: Its tail is large and covered with a rich,\nthick fur. The tail becomes increasingly\ndeeper in color as WARTORTLE ages.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The scratches on its shell are evidence\nof this POKéMON's toughness as a\nbattler.

sourceRecords.japanese: こうらの　ふんしゃこうの　ねらいは　せいかく。\nみずの　だんがんを　５０メートル　はなれた\nあきかんに　めいちゅうさせる　ことが　できるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: BLASTOISE has water spouts that\nprotrude from its shell. The water\nspouts are very accurate.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: They can shoot bullets of water with\nenough accuracy to strike empty cans\nfrom a distance of over 160 feet.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだ　よりも　おおきな　はっぱを　みるみる\nたべつくして　しまうほどの　しょくよくを　もつ。\nしょっかくから　きょうれつな　においを　だすぞ。
sourceRecords.english: CATERPIE has a voracious appetite.\nIt can devour leaves bigger than its\nbody right before your eyes.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: From its antenna, this POKéMON releases\na terrifically strong odor.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　カラは　てっぱんの　ように　かたい。\nあまり　うごかないのは　カラのなかで　やわらかい\nなかみが　しんかの　じゅんびを　しているからだ。
sourceRecords.english: The shell covering this POKéMON's body\nis as hard as an iron slab.\nMETAPOD does not move very much.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It stays still because it is preparing\nits soft innards for evolution inside\nthe hard shell.

sourceRecords.japanese: おいしい　はなの　ミツを　さがす　のうりょくに\nすぐれ　すみかから　１０キロはなれた　ばしょに\nさく　はなから　ミツを　あつめて　はこんでいる。
sourceRecords.english: BUTTERFREE has a superior ability to\nsearch for delicious honey from\nflowers.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It can even search out, extract, and\ncarry honey from flowers that are\nblooming over six miles from its nest.

sourceRecords.japanese: とても　するどい　きゅうかくを　もっている。\nこうぶつの　はっぱか　きらいな　はっぱか\nおおきな　あかい　はなで　かぎわける。
sourceRecords.english: WEEDLE has an extremely acute sense\nof smell.\nIt is capable of distinguishing its

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: favorite kinds of leaves from those it\ndislikes just by sniffing with its big\nred proboscis (nose).

sourceRecords.japanese: ほとんど　うごかず　きに　つかまっているが\nなかでは　しんかの　じゅんびで　おおいそがし。\nその　しょうこに　からだが　あつくなっているぞ。
sourceRecords.english: KAKUNA remains virtually immobile as it\nclings to a tree. However, on the\ninside, it is extremely busy as it

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: prepares for its coming evolution.\nThis is evident from how hot the shell\nbecomes to the touch.

sourceRecords.japanese: なわばりいしきが　とても　つよいので　スピアーの\nすみかには　ちかづかない　ほうが　みの　ためだ。\nおこると　しゅうだんで　おそって　くるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: BEEDRILL is extremely territorial.\nNo one should ever approach its nest -\nthis is for their own safety.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If angered, they will attack in a furious\nswarm.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほうこう　かんかくに　とても　すぐれているので\nどんなに　はなれた　ばしょからでも　まよわずに\nじぶんの　す　まで　かえる　ことが　できる。
sourceRecords.english: PIDGEY has an extremely sharp sense\nof direction.\nIt is capable of unerringly returning

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: home to its nest, however far it may be\nremoved from its familiar surroundings.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひろい　なわばりを　とんで　みまわりを　する。\nなわばりを　あらす　あいては　ようしゃ　しない。\nするどい　ツメで　てっていてきに　こらしめるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: PIDGEOTTO claims a large area as its\nown territory. This POKéMON flies\naround, patrolling its living space.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If its territory is violated, it shows\nno mercy in thoroughly punishing the\nfoe with its sharp claws.

sourceRecords.japanese: うつくしい　こうたくの　はねを　もつ　ポケモン。\nあたまの　はねの　うつくしさに　こころ　うばわれ\nピジョットを　そだてる　トレーナーも　おおい。
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON has a dazzling plumage of\nbeautifully glossy feathers.\nMany TRAINERS are captivated by the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: striking beauty of the feathers on its\nhead, compelling them to choose PIDGEOT\nas their POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: けいかいしんが　とても　つよく　ねている　ときも\nみみを　うごかし　まわりの　おとを　きいている。\nどこにでも　すみつき　す　を　つくる。
sourceRecords.english: RATTATA is cautious in the extreme.\nEven while it is asleep, it constantly\nlistens by moving its ears around.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It is not picky about where it lives -\nit will make its nest anywhere.

sourceRecords.japanese: じょうぶな　キバは　どんどん　のびるので\nいわや　たいぼくを　かじって　けずっている。\nいえの　カベを　かじられる　ことも　あるよ。
sourceRecords.english: RATICATE's sturdy fangs grow steadily.\nTo keep them ground down, it gnaws\non rocks and logs.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It may even chew on the walls of\nhouses.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおきな　なきごえは　１キロ　さきまで　とどく。\nあちこちで　カンだかい　こえが　きこえる　ときは\nなかまたちに　きけんを　しらせている　あいずだ。
sourceRecords.english: SPEAROW has a very loud cry that can\nbe heard over half a mile away.\nIf its high, keening cry is heard

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: echoing all around, it is a sign that\nthey are warning each other of danger.

sourceRecords.japanese: ながい　くびと　くちばしは　つちや　みずの\nなかに　いる　エサを　つかまえるのに　べんり。\nほそながい　くちばしで　きように　つまむぞ。
sourceRecords.english: FEAROW is recognized by its long neck\nand elongated beak.\nThey are conveniently shaped for

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: catching prey in soil or water.\nIt deftly moves its long and skinny\nbeak to pluck prey.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぐるぐる　からだを　まいて　やすんでいるのは\nどの　ほうこうから　てきが　おそってきても\nとっさに　あたまを　むけて　いかくできるからだ。
sourceRecords.english: EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while\nit rests.\nAssuming this position allows it to

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: quickly respond to a threat from any\ndirection with a glare from its upraised\nhead.

sourceRecords.japanese: しめつける　ちからは　とても　きょうりょく。\nドラムかんも　ぺしゃんこに　してしまうぞ。\nまきつかれたら　にげだす　ことは　ふかのうだ。
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is terrifically strong in\norder to constrict things with its body.\nIt can even flatten steel oil drums.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Once ARBOK wraps its body around its\nfoe, escaping its crunching embrace is\nimpossible.

sourceRecords.japanese: はじめて　みる　ものには　でんげきを　あてる。\nくろこげの　きのみが　おちていたら　それは\nでんげきの　つよさを　まちがえた　しょうこだよ。
sourceRecords.english: Whenever PIKACHU comes across\nsomething new, it blasts it with a jolt\nof electricity.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If you come across a blackened berry,\nit's evidence that this POKéMON\nmistook the intensity of its charge.

sourceRecords.japanese: でんきぶくろに　でんきが　たまりすぎた　ときは\nしっぽを　じめんに　つけて　ほうでんする。\nす　の　ちかくには　じめんに　やけこげが　ある。
sourceRecords.english: If the electrical sacks become\nexcessively charged, RAICHU plants its\ntail in the ground and discharges.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Scorched patches of ground will be\nfound near this POKéMON's nest.

sourceRecords.japanese: すいぶんを　むだなく　きゅうしゅうする　からだの\nつくりなので　かんそうした　すなちでも　へいき。\nからだを　まるめて　てきの　こうげきを　ふせぐ。
sourceRecords.english: SANDSHREW's body is configured to\nabsorb water without waste, enabling it\nto survive in an arid desert.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON curls up to protect itself\nfrom its enemies.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　トゲは　ひふが　かたくなったもの。\n１ねんに　１かい　ふるい　トゲが　ぬけおちて\nあたらしい　トゲが　したから　はえてくる。
sourceRecords.english: SANDSLASH's body is covered by tough\nspikes, which are hardened sections of\nits hide. Once a year, the old spikes fall

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: out, to be replaced with new spikes that\ngrow out from beneath the old ones.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちいさい　からだを　まもるため　きょうりょくな\nどくばりが　はったつしたと　かんがえられている。\nおこると　ツノの　さきから　もうどくを　だす。
sourceRecords.english: NIDORAN has barbs that secrete a\npowerful poison. They are thought to\nhave developed as protection for this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: small-bodied POKéMON.\nWhen enraged, it releases a horrible\ntoxin from its horn.

sourceRecords.japanese: なかまや　かぞくと　いっしょの　ときは　おたがい\nきずつかないように　トゲが　ひっこんでいる。\nなかまから　はなれると　ふあんに　なるらしい。
sourceRecords.english: When NIDORINA are with their friends or\nfamily, they keep their barbs tucked\naway to prevent hurting each other.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON appears to become\nnervous if separated from the others.

sourceRecords.japanese: かたい　ウロコで　おおわれた　からだを　ぶつけて\nあいてを　はじきとばす　こうげきが　とくいだ。\nこどもを　まもる　ときが　いちばん　つよい。
sourceRecords.english: NIDOQUEEN's body is encased in\nextremely hard scales. It is adept at\nsending foes flying with harsh tackles.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is at its strongest when\nit is defending its young.

sourceRecords.japanese: みみを　うごかす　きんにくが　はったつしていて\nどんな　むきにも　じざいに　みみを　うごかせる。\nかすかな　ものおとも　ききもらさない　ポケモン。
sourceRecords.english: The male NIDORAN has developed\nmuscles for moving its ears. Thanks to\nthem, the ears can be freely moved in

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: any direction. Even the slightest sound\ndoes not escape this POKéMON's notice.

sourceRecords.japanese: ダイヤモンドよりも　かたい　ツノを　もつ。\nてきの　けはいを　かんじると　せなかの　トゲが\nいっせいに　さかだち　ぜんりょくで　たちむかう。
sourceRecords.english: NIDORINO has a horn that is harder than\na diamond. If it senses a hostile\npresence, all the barbs on its back

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: bristle up at once, and it challenges\nthe foe with all its might.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふとい　しっぽの　ひとふりは　がんじょうな\nてっとうも　へしおる　すさまじい　はかいりょく。\nいちど　あばれだすと　てが　つけられない。
sourceRecords.english: NIDOKING's thick tail packs enormously\ndestructive power. With one swing, it\ncan topple a metal transmission tower.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Once this POKéMON goes on a rampage,\nthere is no stopping it.

sourceRecords.japanese: まんげつの　よるは　げんき　いっぱいに　あそぶ。\nあけがた　つかれた　ピッピたちは　しずかな\nやまおくで　なかまたちと　よりそって　ねむる。
sourceRecords.english: On every night of a full moon, groups of\nthis POKéMON come out to play.\nWhen dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: return to their quiet mountain retreats\nand go to sleep nestled up against each\nother.

sourceRecords.japanese: つばさを　つかって　とぶように　スキップ。\nすいめんを　あるく　ことだって　できるのだ。\nしずかな　つきよに　みずうみを　あるく。
sourceRecords.english: CLEFABLE moves by skipping lightly as if\nit were flying using its wings. Its\nbouncy step lets it even walk on water.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It is known to take strolls on lakes on\nquiet, moonlit nights.

sourceRecords.japanese: うまれた　ときは　しろい　１ぽんの　しっぽ。\nあいじょうを　たっぷり　うけると　しっぽは\n６ぽんに　わかれて　みごとな　まきげになる。
sourceRecords.english: At the time of its birth, VULPIX has one\nwhite tail. The tail separates into six\nif this POKéMON receives plenty of love

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: from its TRAINER.\nThe six tails become magnificently\ncurled.

sourceRecords.japanese: まっかな　ひとみは　あやしい　ひかりを　はなち\nあいての　こころを　じざいに　あやつる。\n１０００ねんかん　いきると　いわれている。
sourceRecords.english: NINETALES casts a sinister light from\nits bright red eyes to gain total\ncontrol over its foe's mind.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is said to live for a\nthousand years.

sourceRecords.japanese: こえの　はちょうを　じざいに　かえる　せいたいを\nもっているので　あいてが　いちばん　ねむくなる\nはちょうで　うたを　うたう　ことが　できる。
sourceRecords.english: JIGGLYPUFF's vocal chords can freely\nadjust the wavelength of its voice.\nThis POKéMON uses this ability to sing

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: at precisely the right wavelength to\nmake its foes most drowsy.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおきな　まるい　ひとみの　ひょうめんには\nなみだの　うすい　まくが　いつも　はっている。\nほこりが　ついても　すぐに　あらい　ながされる。
sourceRecords.english: WIGGLYTUFF has large, saucerlike eyes.\nThe surfaces of its eyes are always\ncovered with a thin layer of tears.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If any dust gets in this POKéMON's\neyes, it is quickly washed away.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひるま　くらやみで　じっと　しているのは\nたいようの　ひかりを　ながい　じかん　あびると\nぜんしんが　かるく　やけどしてしまうからだ。
sourceRecords.english: ZUBAT remains quietly unmoving in a\ndark spot during the bright daylight\nhours. It does so because prolonged

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: exposure to the sun causes its body to\nbecome slightly burned.

sourceRecords.japanese: いきものの　けつえきが　だいこうぶつ。\nとくに　まよなか　かつどうする　ことが　おおく\nいきちを　もとめて　よぞらを　とびまわる。
sourceRecords.english: GOLBAT loves to drink the blood of\nliving things. It is particularly active\nin the pitch black of night.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON flits around in the night\nskies, seeking fresh blood.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひるま　じめんの　なかに　からだを　うめて\nつちの　えいようを　ぜんしんで　すいあげている。\nこえた　つちほど　はっぱに　ツヤが　でるという。
sourceRecords.english: During the daytime, ODDISH buries\nitself in soil to absorb nutrients from \nthe ground using its entire body.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The more fertile the soil, the glossier\nits leaves become.

sourceRecords.japanese: きけんを　かんじると　めしべの　はなつ　くさい\nにおいは　さらに　つよまるが　こころ　おだやかな\nときは　くさい　においを　ださないのだ。
sourceRecords.english: GLOOM releases a foul fragrance from\nthe pistil of its flower. When faced\nwith danger, the stench worsens.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If this POKéMON is feeling calm and\nsecure, it does not release its usual\nstinky aroma.

sourceRecords.japanese: どくかふんは　ひどい　アレルギーを　おこす。\nジャングルで　うつくしい　はなを　みつけても\nうかつに　ちかよらない　ほうが　いいよ。
sourceRecords.english: VILEPLUME's toxic pollen triggers\natrocious allergy attacks. That's why\nit is advisable never to approach any

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: attractive flowers in a jungle, however\npretty they may be.

sourceRecords.japanese: パラスから　ようぶんを　すいとって　おおきくなる\nキノコは　とうちゅうかそう　と　よばれている。\nちょうじゅの　くすりになる　きちょうな　キノコ。
sourceRecords.english: PARAS has parasitic mushrooms growing\non its back called tochukaso. They grow\nlarge by drawing nutrients from this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: BUG/GRASS POKéMON host. They are\nhighly valued as a medicine for\nextending life.

sourceRecords.japanese: パラセクトは　しゅうだんで　たいぼくの　ねもとに\nくっついて　えいようを　すいとってしまう。\nかれると　いっせいに　べつの　きに　いどうする。
sourceRecords.english: PARASECT is known to infest large trees\nen masse and drain nutrients from the\nlower trunk and roots.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: When an infested tree dies, they move\nonto another tree all at once.

sourceRecords.japanese: みを　まもるために　ほそく　かたい　たいもうが\nぜんしんを　おおうように　なったと　いわれる。\nちいさな　えものも　みのがさない　めを　もつ。
sourceRecords.english: VENONAT is said to have evolved with\na coat of thin, stiff hair that covers\nits entire body for protection.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It possesses large eyes that never fail\nto spot even miniscule prey.

sourceRecords.japanese: やこうせいで　よるに　かつどうを　はじめる。\nがいとうの　あかりに　さそわれ　あつまった\nちいさな　むしを　このんで　たべる。
sourceRecords.english: VENOMOTH is nocturnal - it is a POKéMON\nthat only becomes active at night.\nIts favorite prey are small insects

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: that gather around streetlights,\nattracted by the light in the darkness.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほとんどの　のうかは　ディグダを　そだてている。\nディグダが　あなを　ほった　とちは　ほどよく\nたがやされ　おいしい　やさいが　つくれるからだ。
sourceRecords.english: DIGLETT are raised in most farms.\nThe reason is simple - wherever this\nPOKéMON burrows, the soil is left

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: perfectly tilled for planting crops.\nThis soil is made ideal for growing\ndelicious vegetables.

sourceRecords.japanese: もともと　ひとつの　からだから　３つごに\nなったので　みんな　かんがえることは　おなじ。\nちからを　あわせ　どこまでも　ほりすすむ。
sourceRecords.english: DUGTRIO are actually triplets that\nemerged from one body. As a result,\neach triplet thinks exactly like the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: other two triplets.\nThey work cooperatively to burrow\nendlessly.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどい　ツメを　ひっこめて　ぬきあし　さしあし\nあしおとを　たてずに　あるくことが　できる。\nキラキラ　ひかる　コインが　なぜか　だいすきだ。
sourceRecords.english: MEOWTH withdraws its sharp claws into\nits paws to slinkily sneak about without\nmaking any incriminating footsteps.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: For some reason, this POKéMON loves\nshiny coins that glitter with light.

sourceRecords.japanese: たくましい　６ぽんの　ヒゲは　くうきの　うごきで\nまわりの　ようすを　キャッチする　やくわり。\nヒゲを　つかまれると　おとなしくなって　しまう。
sourceRecords.english: PERSIAN has six bold whiskers that give\nit a look of toughness. The whiskers  \nsense air movements to determine what

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: is in the POKéMON's surrounding\nvicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed\nby the whiskers.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふしぎな　ちからを　はっきしている　コダックから\nねむっている　ときにだけ　でるはずの　のうはが\nかんそくされて　がっかいの　わだいに　なった。
sourceRecords.english: PSYDUCK uses a mysterious power.\nWhen it does so, this POKéMON \ngenerates brain waves that are

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: supposedly only seen in sleepers.\nThis discovery spurred controversy\namong scholars.

sourceRecords.japanese: てあしの　みずかきと　りゅうせんけいの　からだが\nすいちゅうで　おそるべき　スピードを　うみだす。\nきんメダリスト　よりも　だんぜん　はやいぞ。
sourceRecords.english: The webbed flippers on its forelegs and\nhind legs and the streamlined body of\nGOLDUCK give it frightening speed.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is definitely much faster\nthan even the most athletic swimmer.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだが　ふるえ　はないきが　あらくなれば\nおこりだす　まえぶれ　なのだが　あっというまに\nはげしく　おこるので　にげだす　ひまは　ない。
sourceRecords.english: When MANKEY starts shaking and its\nnasal breathing turns rough, it's a sure\nsign that it is becoming angry.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: However, because it goes into a\ntowering rage almost instantly, it is\nimpossible for anyone to flee its wrath.

sourceRecords.japanese: はげしく　おこる　ことで　けっこうが　よくなり\nきんにくの　ちからを　つよくするのだ。\nただし　あたまの　かいてんは　おそくなるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: When PRIMEAPE becomes furious, its\nblood circulation is boosted. In turn,\nits muscles are made even stronger.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: However, it also becomes much less\nintelligent at the same time.

sourceRecords.japanese: きゅうかくに　すぐれ　いちど　かいだ　においは\nなにが　あっても　ぜったいに　わすれない。\nあいての　きもちを　においで　さっちする。
sourceRecords.english: GROWLITHE has a superb sense of smell.\nOnce it smells anything, this POKéMON\nwon't forget the scent, no matter what.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It uses its advanced olfactory sense\nto determine the emotions of other\nliving things.

sourceRecords.japanese: １００００キロの　きょりを　いっちゅうやで\nはしると　いわれている　かいそくの　ポケモン。\nたいないで　もえさかる　ほのおが　パワーとなる。
sourceRecords.english: ARCANINE is known for its high speed.\nIt is said to be capable of running over\n6,200 miles in a single day and night.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The fire that blazes wildly within this\nPOKéMON's body is its source of power.

sourceRecords.japanese: うずまき　もようの　ないぞうが　すけてしまうほど\nうすい　ひふだが　するどい　キバを　はねかえす\nだんりょくを　もっているのだ。
sourceRecords.english: POLIWAG has a very thin skin. It is\npossible to see the POKéMON's spiral\ninnards right through the skin.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Despite its thinness, however, the skin\nis also very flexible. Even sharp fangs\nbounce right off it.

sourceRecords.japanese: いつも　からだの　ひょうめんが　えきたいで\nぬるぬる　ぬれているため　てきに　つかまっても\nぬるりと　すりぬけ　にげる　ことが　できるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: The surface of POLIWHIRL's body is\nalways wet and slick with an oily fluid.\nBecause of this greasy covering, it can

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: easily slip and slide out of the clutches\nof any enemy in battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: はったつした　きょうじんな　きんにくは　どんなに\nうんどうしても　つかれる　ことは　ない。\nたいへいようも　かるく　おうだん　できるほどだ。
sourceRecords.english: POLIWRATH's highly developed, brawny\nmuscles never grow fatigued, however\nmuch it exercises.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It is so tirelessly strong, this POKéMON\ncan swim back and forth across the\nPacific Ocean without effort.

sourceRecords.japanese: １にち　１８じかん　ねむっている　ポケモン。\nねむったままでも　てきの　けはいを　さっちすると\nテレポートして　にげる　ことが　できるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: ABRA sleeps for eighteen hours a day.\nHowever, it can sense the presence of\nfoes even while it is sleeping.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: In such a situation, this POKéMON\nimmediately teleports to safety.

sourceRecords.japanese: ずつうを　おこす　とくしゅな　アルファはを\nだすので　つよい　せいしんりょくの　もちぬしじゃ\nないと　ユンゲラーの　トレーナーには　なれない。
sourceRecords.english: KADABRA emits a peculiar alpha wave\nif it develops a headache. Only those\npeople with a particularly strong

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: psyche can hope to become a TRAINER\nof this POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: のうが　どんどん　おおきくなったので　くびでは\nささえきれないほど　あたまが　おもくなった。\nちょうのうりょくで　あたまを　ささえているのだ。
sourceRecords.english: ALAKAZAM's brain continually grows,\nmaking its head far too heavy to\nsupport with its neck.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON holds its head up using\nits psychokinetic power instead.

sourceRecords.japanese: どんなに　うんどうを　しても　いたくならない\nとくべつな　きんにくを　もつ　ポケモン。\nおとな　１００にんを　なげとばす　パワー。
sourceRecords.english: MACHOP's muscles are special - they\nnever get sore no matter how much they\nare used in exercise.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON has sufficient power to\nhurl a hundred adult humans.

sourceRecords.japanese: きたえあげた　きんにくは　はがねの　かたさ。\nすもうとりの　からだも　ゆび　１ぽんで　らくらく\nもちあげてしまう　かいりきの　ポケモンだ。
sourceRecords.english: MACHOKE's thoroughly toned muscles\npossess the hardness of steel.\nThis POKéMON has so much strength,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: it can easily hold aloft a sumo wrestler\non just one finger.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんでも　なげとばす　パワーを　もつが　こまかい\nさぎょうを　すると　うでが　からまってしまう。\nかんがえる　よりも　さきに　からだが　うごく。
sourceRecords.english: MACHAMP has the power to hurl anything\naside. However, trying to do any work\nrequiring care and dexterity causes

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: its arms to get tangled.\nThis POKéMON tends to leap into action\nbefore it thinks.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほそく　しなやかな　からだは　どんな　つよい\nこうげきでも　しなって　よける　ことが　できる。\nくちから　てつも　とかしてしまう　えきを　だす。
sourceRecords.english: BELLSPROUT's thin and flexible body\nlets it bend and sway to avoid any\nattack, however strong it may be.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: From its mouth, this POKéMON spits a\ncorrosive fluid that melts even iron.

sourceRecords.japanese: よるに　なると　おしりの　フックを　きの　えだに\nひっかけて　ぶらさがり　ねむりに　つく。\nねぞうが　わるいと　あさ　おっこちているよ。
sourceRecords.english: WEEPINBELL has a large hook on its rear\nend. At night, the POKéMON hooks on to\na tree branch and goes to sleep.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If it moves around in its sleep, it may\nwake up to find itself on the ground.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたまに　ついている　ながい　つるを　ちいさな\nいきものに　みえる　うごきで　えものを　さそい\nちかづいてきた　ところを　ぱくりと　ひとのみ。
sourceRecords.english: VICTREEBEL has a long vine that\nextends from its head. This vine is\nwaved and flicked about as if it were

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: an animal to attract prey. When an\nunsuspecting prey draws near, this\nPOKéMON swallows it whole.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　ほとんどが　みずで　できているので\nうみから　でると　からからに　ひからびてしまう。\nひからびた　ときは　うみに　もどしてあげよう。
sourceRecords.english: TENTACOOL's body is largely composed\nof water. If it is removed from the\nsea, it dries up like parchment.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If this POKéMON happens to become\ndehydrated, put it back into the sea.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたまの　あかい　たまが　ひかるとき　はげしい\nちょうおんぱが　あたりに　はっしゃ　される。\nそのとき　かいめんが　はげしく　なみうつという。
sourceRecords.english: TENTACRUEL has large red orbs on its\nhead. The orbs glow before lashing the\nvicinity with a harsh ultrasonic blast.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's outburst creates rough\nwaves around it.

sourceRecords.japanese: ながいきの　イシツブテほど　からだの　かどは\nけずれ　まるくなっていくが　きもちは　いつまでも\nごつごつ　とがって　あらあらしいのだ。
sourceRecords.english: The longer a GEODUDE lives, the more\nits edges are chipped and worn away,\nmaking it more rounded in appearance.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: However, this POKéMON's heart will\nremain hard, craggy, and rough always.

sourceRecords.japanese: いわを　たべて　せいちょうする　ポケモンだ。\nコケの　ついた　いわの　ほうが　すき　らしい。\n１にちに　１トンの　いわを　たべてしまうぞ。
sourceRecords.english: GRAVELER grows by feeding on rocks.\nApparently, it prefers to eat rocks\nthat are covered in moss.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON eats its way through\na ton of rocks on a daily basis.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおきな　じしんが　おこると　やまに　すんでいる\nゴローニャが　なんびきも　ふもとまで　ごろごろ\nころがり　おちてくる　ことが　あるよ。
sourceRecords.english: GOLEM live up on mountains.\nIf there is a large earthquake, these\nPOKéMON will come rolling down off

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: the mountains en masse to the\nfoothills below.

sourceRecords.japanese: うまれて　すぐは　たちあがるのも　やっとだが\nころびながら　おやの　あとを　おいかけている\nうちに　じょうぶな　あしこしに　そだつのだ。
sourceRecords.english: PONYTA is very weak at birth.\nIt can barely stand up.\nThis POKéMON becomes stronger by

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: stumbling and falling to keep up with\nits parent.

sourceRecords.japanese: いつもは　のんびり　のはらを　かけまわっているが\nひとたび　ほんきを　だすと　たてがみの　ほのおが\nもえあがり　じそく２４０キロで　はしりだす。
sourceRecords.english: RAPIDASH usually can be seen casually\ncantering in the fields and plains.\nHowever, when this POKéMON turns

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze\nas it gallops its way up to 150 mph.

sourceRecords.japanese: しっぽを　かわに　いれて　エサを　つっているが\nそのうち　なにを　しているのか　わすれてしまい\nかわべりに　ねそべったまま　１にちを　おえる。
sourceRecords.english: SLOWPOKE uses its tail to catch prey by\ndipping it in water at the side of a\nriver.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: However, this POKéMON often forgets\nwhat it's doing and often spends entire\ndays just loafing at water's edge.

sourceRecords.japanese: シェルダーが　かみついて　いるので　しっぽで\nエサを　つれなくなった　ヤドランは　しぶしぶ\nすいちゅうを　およいで　エサを　つかまえている。
sourceRecords.english: SLOWBRO's tail has a SHELLDER firmly\nattached with a bite. As a result, the\ntail can't be used for fishing anymore.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This causes SLOWBRO to grudgingly swim\nand catch prey instead.

sourceRecords.japanese: でんせんに　くっついて　でんきを　たべている。\nていでんに　なったら　ブレーカーを　しらべよう。\nコイルが　びっしり　くっついて　いるかも。
sourceRecords.english: MAGNEMITE attaches itself to power\nlines to feed on electricity.\nIf your house has a power outage,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: check your circuit breakers. You may\nfind a large number of this POKéMON\nclinging to the breaker box.

sourceRecords.japanese: つよい　じりょくで　きかいを　こわしてしまうので\nおおきな　まちでは　サイレンを　ならして\nレアコイルの　たいりょう　はっせいを　しらせる。
sourceRecords.english: MAGNETON emits a powerful magnetic\nforce that is fatal to mechanical\ndevices. As a result, large cities sound

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: sirens to warn citizens of large-scale\noutbreaks of this POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: もっている　しょくぶつの　クキにも　よいものと\nそうでない　ものが　あるらしく　カモネギどうしが\nクキを　めぐって　たたかう　ことが　ある。
sourceRecords.english: FARFETCH'D is always seen with a stick\nfrom a plant of some sort. Apparently,\nthere are good sticks and bad sticks.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON has been known to fight\nwith others over sticks.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２つの　あたまが　どうじに　ねむることは　ない。\nねている　とき　てきから　おそわれない　ように\nかわりばんこで　みはりを　しているからだ。
sourceRecords.english: DODUO's two heads never sleep at the\nsame time.\nIts two heads take turns sleeping,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: so one head can always keep watch for\nenemies while the other one sleeps.

sourceRecords.japanese: ３つの　あたまが　べつべつの　ほうこうを\nむいている　ときは　けいかいしている　しょうこ。\nうかつに　ちかよると　くちばしで　つつかれるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: Watch out if DODRIO's three heads are\nlooking in three separate directions.\nIt's a sure sign that it is on its guard.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Don't go near this POKéMON if it's being\nwary - it may decide to peck you.

sourceRecords.japanese: こおりに　おおわれた　うみで　エサを　とる。\nいきつぎを　するときは　あたまの　でっぱりで\nこおりを　わって　うみから　かおを　だす。
sourceRecords.english: SEEL hunts for prey in the frigid sea\nunderneath sheets of ice.\nWhen it needs to breathe, it punches

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: a hole through the ice with the\nsharply protruding section of its head.

sourceRecords.japanese: つめたい　こおりの　うえで　ねるのが　だいすき。\nむかし　ひょうざんで　ねむる　すがたを　みた\nふなのりが　にんぎょと　まちがえた。
sourceRecords.english: DEWGONG loves to snooze on bitterly\ncold ice.\nThe sight of this POKéMON sleeping on

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: a glacier was mistakenly thought to be\na mermaid by a mariner long ago.

sourceRecords.japanese: ドロドロ　ブヨブヨした　からだは　どんなに\nほそい　すきまにも　はいりこむことが　できる。\nげすいかんに　もぐって　きたない　みずを　のむ。
sourceRecords.english: GRIMER's sludgy and rubbery body can\nbe forced through any opening, however\nsmall it may be.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON enters sewer pipes to\ndrink filthy wastewater.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだから　しみだしている　たいえきは　はなが\nまがるほど　きょうれつな　においを　はなつ。\n１てきで　プールのみずが　にごり　においだす。
sourceRecords.english: From MUK's body seeps a foul fluid that\ngives off a nose-bendingly horrible\nstench.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Just one drop of this POKéMON's body\nfluid can turn a pool stagnant and\nrancid.

sourceRecords.japanese: よるに　なると　おおきな　ベロで　かいていの\nすなに　あなを　ほり　そのなかで　ねむる。\nカラを　とじて　ねむるが　ベロは　だしたまま。
sourceRecords.english: At night, this POKéMON uses its broad\ntongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor\nsand and then sleep in it.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: While it is sleeping, SHELLDER closes its\nshell, but leaves its tongue hanging\nout.

sourceRecords.japanese: のみこんだ　かいすいを　うしろへ　いきおい　よく\nふんしゃする　ことで　うみの　なかを　およぐ。\nトゲを　はっしゃする　しくみも　おなじ。
sourceRecords.english: CLOYSTER is capable of swimming in the\nsea. It does so by swallowing water,\nthen jetting it out toward the rear.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON shoots spikes from its\nshell using the same system.

sourceRecords.japanese: きょうふうを　うけると　ガスじょうの　からだは\nみるみる　ふきとばされ　ちいさくなって　しまう。\nかぜを　さけた　ゴースが　のきしたに　あつまる。
sourceRecords.english: GASTLY is largely composed of gaseous\nmatter. When exposed to a strong wind,\nthe gaseous body quickly dwindles away.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Groups of this POKéMON cluster under\nthe eaves of houses to escape the\nravages of wind.

sourceRecords.japanese: やみに　うかぶ　ゴーストが　てまねきしても\nぜったいに　ちかよっては　いけないよ。\nペロリと　なめられ　いのちを　すわれてしまうぞ。
sourceRecords.english: HAUNTER is a dangerous POKéMON.\nIf one beckons you while floating in\ndarkness, you must never approach it.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON will try to lick you with its\ntongue and steal your life away.

sourceRecords.japanese: まよなか　がいとうの　あかりで　できた　かげが\nじぶんを　おいこして　いくのは　ゲンガーが\nかげに　なりすまして　はしって　いくからだ。
sourceRecords.english: Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow\nthrown by a streetlight will suddenly\nand startlingly overtake you.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It is actually a GENGAR running past\nyou, pretending to be your shadow.

sourceRecords.japanese: のうみそに　じしゃくが　あるので　つちの　なかを\nほり　すすんでいても　ほうこうを　まちがえない。\nとしを　とるほど　からだは　まるみを　おびる。
sourceRecords.english: ONIX has a magnet in its brain. It acts\nas a compass so that this POKéMON does\nnot lose direction while it is tunneling.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: As it grows older, its body becomes\nincreasingly rounder and smoother.

sourceRecords.japanese: ねむっているとき　キミの　はなが　ムズムズしたら\nまくらもとに　たった　スリープが　はなの\nあなから　ゆめを　たべようとしている　あいず。
sourceRecords.english: If your nose becomes itchy while you\nare sleeping, it's a sure sign that one\nof these POKéMON is standing above

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: your pillow and trying to eat your dream\nthrough your nostrils.

sourceRecords.japanese: てに　もっている　ふりこの　うごきと　かがやきが\nあいてを　ふかい　さいみんじょうたいに　おとす。\nえものを　さがしながら　ふりこを　みがいている。
sourceRecords.english: HYPNO holds a pendulum in its hand.\nThe arcing movement and glitter of the\npendulum lull the foe into a deep state

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: of hypnosis.\nWhile this POKéMON searches for prey,\nit polishes the pendulum.

sourceRecords.japanese: すなはまに　あなを　ほり　そこで　くらしている。\nエサの　すくない　すなはまでは　ばしょとりをする\nクラブたちの　あらそいを　みる　ことが　できる。
sourceRecords.english: KRABBY live on beaches, burrowed inside\nholes dug into the sand.\nOn sandy beaches with little in the way

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: of food, these POKéMON can be seen\nsquabbling with each other over\nterritory.

sourceRecords.japanese: キングラーは　きょだいな　ハサミを　ふって\nなかまどうしで　あいずを　おくりあっているが\nハサミが　おもすぎて　すぐに　つかれてしまう。
sourceRecords.english: KINGLER has an enormous, oversized\nclaw. It waves this huge claw in the\nair to communicate with others.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: However, because the claw is so heavy,\nthe POKéMON quickly tires.

sourceRecords.japanese: モンスターボールを　つくっている　かいしゃで\nはじめて　はっけんされた　ことと　すがたかたちが\nにている　ことの　かんけいは　まだ　ナゾである。
sourceRecords.english: VOLTORB was first sighted at a company\nthat manufactures POKé BALLS.\nThe link between that sighting and

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: the fact that this POKéMON looks very\nsimilar to a POKé BALL remains a\nmystery.

sourceRecords.japanese: くうきちゅうの　でんきエネルギーを　たべる。\nカミナリの　おちる　ひは　でんきを　たべすぎた\nマルマインが　あちらこちらで　だいばくはつする。
sourceRecords.english: ELECTRODE eats electricity in the\natmosphere. On days when lightning\nstrikes, you can see this POKéMON

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: exploding all over the place from\neating too much electricity.

sourceRecords.japanese: なかまおもいの　６この　たまごは　おたがいに\nひきつけあい　くるくる　かいてんしている。\nカラの　ヒビが　ふえると　しんかは　まぢかだ。
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON consists of six eggs that\nform a closely knit cluster. The six eggs\nattract each other and spin around.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: When cracks increasingly appear on the\neggs, EXEGGCUTE is close to evolution.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんごく　うまれの　ナッシーの　あたまは　つよい\nひざしを　いっぱい　あびて　どんどん　そだち\nじめんに　おちると　タマタマに　なると　いう。
sourceRecords.english: EXEGGUTOR originally came from the\ntropics. Its heads steadily grow larger\nfrom exposure to strong sunlight.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It is said that when the heads fall off,\nthey group together to form EXEGGCUTE.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２どと　あえない　ははおやの　おもかげを\nまんげつに　みつけて　なきごえを　あげる。\nかぶっている　ホネの　しみは　なみだの　あと。
sourceRecords.english: CUBONE pines for the mother it will\nnever see again. Seeing a likeness of\nits mother in the full moon, it cries.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The stains on the skull the POKéMON\nwears are made by the tears it sheds.

sourceRecords.japanese: ははおやに　あえない　かなしみを　のりこえた\nカラカラが　たくましく　しんかした　すがた。\nきたえられた　こころは　かんたんに　くじけない。
sourceRecords.english: MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE\nthat has overcome its sadness at the\nloss of its mother and grown tough.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's tempered and hardened\nspirit is not easily broken.

sourceRecords.japanese: じざいに　のびちぢみする　あしで　きょうれつな\nキックを　はなち　あいてを　けりたおす。\nたたかいの　あと　つかれた　あしを　もみほぐす。
sourceRecords.english: HITMONLEE's legs freely contract and\nstretch. Using these springlike legs, it\nbowls over foes with devastating kicks.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: After battle, it rubs down its legs and\nloosens the muscles to overcome\nfatigue.

sourceRecords.japanese: せかいチャンピオンを　めざしていた　ボクサーの\nたましいが　やどったと　いわれる　エビワラーは\nふくつの　せいしんで　ぜったいに　へこたれない。
sourceRecords.english: HITMONCHAN is said to possess the\nspirit of a boxer who had been working\ntowards a world championship.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON has an indomitable spirit\nand will never give up in the face of\nadversity.

sourceRecords.japanese: はじめて　めに　する　ものは　かならず　ペロリ。\nしたざわりと　あじで　きおくしているのだ。\nでも　すっぱい　ものは　ちょっと　にがて。
sourceRecords.english: Whenever LICKITUNG comes across\nsomething new, it will unfailingly give it\na lick. It does so because it memorizes

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: things by texture and by taste.\nIt is somewhat put off by sour things.

sourceRecords.japanese: しげきを　あたえると　ガスの　どくそが　つよまり\nからだの　あちこちから　いきおいよく　ふきだす。\nまんまるに　ふくらんだ　あと　だいばくはつする。
sourceRecords.english: If KOFFING becomes agitated, it raises\nthe toxicity of its internal gases and\njets them out from all over its body.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON may also overinflate its\nround body, then explode.

sourceRecords.japanese: くさった　なまゴミから　でる　ガスが　だいすき。\nそうじを　しない　いえに　すみつき　かぞくが\nねしずまった　まよなか　ゴミばこを　あさる。
sourceRecords.english: WEEZING loves the gases given off by\nrotted kitchen garbage. This POKéMON\nwill find a dirty, unkempt house and

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: make it its home. At night, when the\npeople in the house are asleep, it will\ngo through the trash.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひたすら　まっすぐ　つきすすみ　こわしまくる。\nこうてつの　かたまりに　ぶつかっても　へいきだが\n１にち　たつと　ちょっと　いたみを　かんじる。
sourceRecords.english: RHYHORN runs in a straight line,\nsmashing everything in its path.\nIt is not bothered even if it rushes

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: headlong into a block of steel.\nThis POKéMON may feel some pain from\nthe collision the next day, however.

sourceRecords.japanese: ツノは　ダイヤモンドの　げんせきを　くだき\nしっぽの　いちげきは　ビルを　なぎたおす。\nかたい　ひふは　たいほうでも　キズつかない。
sourceRecords.english: RHYDON's horn can crush even uncut\ndiamonds. One sweeping blow of its tail\ncan topple a building.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's hide is extremely tough.\nEven direct cannon hits don't leave\na scratch.

sourceRecords.japanese: えいよう　まんてんの　タマゴを　まいにち　うむ。\nしょくよくを　なくした　ひとでも　ペロリと\nたべてしまうほど　おいしい　タマゴだ。
sourceRecords.english: CHANSEY lays nutritionally excellent\neggs on an everyday basis.\nThe eggs are so delicious, they are

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: easily and eagerly devoured by even\nthose people who have lost their\nappetite.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきに　つかまれると　ツルは　ぷちっと　きれる。\nぜんぜん　いたくないので　その　スキに　にげる。\nよくじつには　あたらしい　ツルが　はえそろうぞ。
sourceRecords.english: TANGELA's vines snap off easily if they\nare grabbed. This happens without pain,\nallowing it to make a quick getaway.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The lost vines are replaced by newly\ngrown vines the very next day.

sourceRecords.japanese: ガルーラの　こどもが　１ぴきで　あそんでいても\nぜったいに　つかまえたりしては　いけないよ。\nちかくに　いる　おやが　はげしく　おこりだすぞ。
sourceRecords.english: If you come across a young KANGASKHAN\nplaying by itself, you must never\ndisturb it or attempt to catch it.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The baby POKéMON's parent is sure to\nbe in the area, and it will become\nviolently enraged at you.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちいさな　ムシや　いわばの　コケを　たべる。\nかいりゅうが　はやく　なると　しっぽを　いわばや\nサンゴに　まきつけ　ながされない　ように　する。
sourceRecords.english: HORSEA eats small insects and moss off\nof rocks. If the ocean current turns\nfast, this POKéMON anchors itself by

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: wrapping its tail around rocks or coral\nto prevent being washed away.

sourceRecords.japanese: サンゴの　えだの　すきまに　もぐって　ねむる。\nシードラに　きづかず　サンゴを　とろうとして\nどくの　トゲに　さされてしまう　ことが　ある。
sourceRecords.english: SEADRA sleeps after wriggling itself\nbetween the branches of coral.\nThose trying to harvest coral are

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: occasionally stung by this POKéMON's\npoison barbs if they fail to notice it.

sourceRecords.japanese: すいちゅうで　ゆうがに　たなびく　ひれが　とても\nうつくしい　ポケモンだが　ゆだんを　していると\nきょうれつな　ツノの　ひとつきを　くらうぞ。
sourceRecords.english: GOLDEEN is a very beautiful POKéMON\nwith fins that billow elegantly in water.\nHowever, don't let your guard down

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: around this POKéMON - it could ram you\npowerfully with its horn.

sourceRecords.japanese: あきに　なると　メスに　プロポーズする　ために\nかわぞこで　おどる　オスを　みることが　できる。\nからだの　いろが　もっとも　うつくしい　きせつ。
sourceRecords.english: In the autumn, SEAKING males can be\nseen performing courtship dances in\nriverbeds to woo females.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: During this season, this POKéMON's body\ncoloration is at its most beautiful.

sourceRecords.japanese: なつの　おわりごろ　よるに　すなはまへ　いくと\nコアと　よばれる　きかんを　あかく　ひからせた\nヒトデマンが　ほしの　ように　みえるよ。
sourceRecords.english: STARYU's center section has an organ\ncalled the core that shines bright red.\nIf you go to a beach toward the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: end of summer, the glowing cores of\nthese POKéMON look like the stars\nin the sky.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　ちゅうしんに　ある　コアと　よばれる\nぶぶんが　なないろに　かがやく　ことから\nうみのほうせき　という　べつめいを　つけられた。
sourceRecords.english: STARMIE's center section - the core -\nglows brightly in seven colors.\nBecause of its luminous nature, this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON has been given the nickname\n“the gem of the sea.”

sourceRecords.japanese: めに　みえない　ものを　みぶりで　そこに　あると\nしんじこませる　パントマイムの　たつじん。\nしんじさせた　ものは　ほんとうに　あらわれる。
sourceRecords.english: MR. MIME is a master of pantomime.\nIts gestures and motions convince\nwatchers that something unseeable

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: actually exists. Once it is believed,\nit will exist as if it were a real thing.

sourceRecords.japanese: めにも　とまらぬ　スピードが　りょううでの\nカマの　きれあじを　さらに　するどく　するのだ。\nひとふり　すれば　たいぼくも　まっぷたつだ。
sourceRecords.english: SCYTHER is blindingly fast. Its blazing\nspeed enhances the effectiveness of\nthe twin scythes on its forearms.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's scythes are so\neffective, they can slice through thick\nlogs in one wicked stroke.

sourceRecords.japanese: おどるような　こしつきで　リズミカルに　あるく。\nその　うごきは　みている　ひとも　おもわず\nこしを　ふってしまうほど　かろやかなのだ。
sourceRecords.english: JYNX walks rhythmically, swaying and\nshaking its hips as if it were dancing.\nIts motions are so bouncingly alluring,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: people seeing it are compelled to shake\ntheir hips without giving any thought\nto what they are doing.

sourceRecords.japanese: あらしが　くると　きの　うえ　など　カミナリの\nおちそうな　たかい　ばしょへ　きそって　のぼる。\nひらいしん　がわりに　する　まちも　ある。
sourceRecords.english: When a storm arrives, gangs of this\nPOKéMON compete with each other to\nscale heights that are likely to be

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: stricken by lightning bolts.\nSome towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of\nlightning rods.

sourceRecords.japanese: たたかいに　なると　からだから　しゃくねつの\nほのおを　ふきあげ　あいてを　いかくする。\nその　ねっぷうで　まわりの　くさきも　もやすぞ。
sourceRecords.english: In battle, MAGMAR blows out intensely\nhot flames from all over its body to\nintimidate its opponent.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's fiery bursts create\nheat waves that ignite grass and trees\nin its surroundings.

sourceRecords.japanese: じぶんの　たいじゅうの　２ばいも　ある　あいてを\nツノで　はさみ　かるがる　もちあげる　かいりき。\nさむい　ばしょでは　からだの　うごきが　にぶる。
sourceRecords.english: PINSIR is astoundingly strong. It can\ngrip a foe weighing twice its weight\nin its horns and easily lift it.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's movements turn sluggish\nin cold places.

sourceRecords.japanese: いつも　あばれて　いないと　きが　すまない。\nたたかう　あいてが　いない　ときは　たいぼくに\nぶちあたり　なぎたおす　ことで　きを　しずめる。
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is not satisfied unless\nit is rampaging at all times.\nIf there is no opponent for TAUROS to

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: battle, it will charge at thick trees and\nknock them down to calm itself.

sourceRecords.japanese: はねる　ことしか　しない　なさけない　ポケモン。\nなぜ　はねるのか　しらべた　けんきゅうしゃが\nいるほど　とにかく　はねて　はねて　はねまくる。
sourceRecords.english: MAGIKARP is a pathetic excuse for a\nPOKéMON that is only capable of\nflopping and splashing.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This behavior prompted scientists to\nundertake research into it.

sourceRecords.japanese: コイキングから　ギャラドスに　しんかする　とき\nのうさいぼうの　こうぞうが　くみかわる　ために\nせいかくが　きょうぼうに　なると　いわれている。
sourceRecords.english: When MAGIKARP evolves into GYARADOS,\nits brain cells undergo a structural\ntransformation. It is said that this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: transformation is to blame for this\nPOKéMON's wildly violent nature.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひとが　ぜつめつの　ききに　おいこんでしまった。\nゆうぐれどきになると　すくなくなった　なかまを\nさがして　かなしそうな　こえで　うたうと　いう。
sourceRecords.english: People have driven LAPRAS almost to the\npoint of extinction. In the evenings,\nthis POKéMON is said to sing plaintively

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: as it seeks what few others of its kind\nstill remain.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　さいぼうを　くみかえて　へんしんする。\nおもいだしながら　いぜん　みた　ものに　かわると\nちょっと　ちがう　かたちに　なってしまうのだ。
sourceRecords.english: DITTO rearranges its cell structure to\ntransform itself into other shapes.\nHowever, if it tries to transform itself

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: into something by relying on its memory,\nthis POKéMON manages to get details\nwrong.

sourceRecords.japanese: くらしている　かんきょうで　とつぜんへんい　する\nふあんていな　いでんしを　もつ　ポケモン。\nいしの　ほうしゃせんが　しんかを　ひきおこす。
sourceRecords.english: EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup\nthat suddenly mutates due to the\nenvironment in which it lives.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Radiation from various STONES causes\nthis POKéMON to evolve.

sourceRecords.japanese: とつぜんへんいに　より　すいちゅうで　せいかつ\nできる　ように　ヒレと　エラが　はえてきた。\nみずを　じざいに　あやつる　ちからを　もつ。
sourceRecords.english: VAPOREON underwent a spontaneous\nmutation and grew fins and gills that\nallow it to live underwater.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON has the ability to freely\ncontrol water.

sourceRecords.japanese: さいぼうの　だす　よわい　でんきを　たいもうの\nせいでんきで　ぞうふくさせ　カミナリを　おとす。\nさかだった　たいもうは　でんきを　おびた　はり。
sourceRecords.english: JOLTEON's cells generate a low level of\nelectricity. This power is amplified by\nthe static electricity of its fur,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: enabling the POKéMON to drop\nthunderbolts. The bristling fur is made\nof electrically charged needles.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふさふさの　たいもうは　あがりすぎた　たいおんを\nくうきに　ほうねつして　さげる　きのうを　もつ。\nたいおんは　さいこう　９００ど　まで　あがるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: FLAREON's fluffy fur has a functional\npurpose - it releases heat into the air\nso that its body does not get

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: excessively hot.\nThis POKéMON's body temperature can\nrise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぜんしんを　プログラム　データに　もどして\nでんし　くうかんに　はいる　ことが　できる。\nコピーガードされて　いるので　コピー　できない。
sourceRecords.english: PORYGON is capable of reverting itself\nentirely back to program data and\nentering cyberspace.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is copy-protected so it\ncannot be duplicated by copying.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおむかしに　ぜつめつしたが　にんげんの　てで\nかせきから　ふっかつさせた　ポケモンの　ひとつ。\nてきに　おそわれると　かたい　カラに　かくれる。
sourceRecords.english: OMANYTE is one of the ancient and long-\nsince-extinct POKéMON that have been\nregenerated from fossils by people.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If attacked by an enemy, it withdraws\nitself inside its hard shell.

sourceRecords.japanese: しょくしゅを　あやつり　えものを　つかまえる。\nカラが　おおきく　なりすぎた　ことで　うごきが\nにぶくなり　ぜつめつしたと　かんがえられている。
sourceRecords.english: OMASTAR uses its tentacles to capture\nits prey. It is believed to have become\nextinct because its shell grew too large

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: and heavy, causing its movements to\nbecome too slow and ponderous.

sourceRecords.japanese: かせきから　ふっかつした　ポケモンだが　まれに\nいきつづけている　カブトを　はっけん　できる。\nその　すがたは　３おくねん　かわっていない。
sourceRecords.english: KABUTO is a POKéMON that has been\nregenerated from a fossil. However, in\nextremely rare cases, living examples

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: have been discovered.\nThe POKéMON has not changed at all for\n300 million years.

sourceRecords.japanese: すいちゅうを　およぎ　えものを　とらえていた。\nみずの　せいかつから　ちじょうで　くらせるように\nエラや　あし　などが　へんかを　はじめていた。
sourceRecords.english: KABUTOPS swam underwater to hunt for\nits prey in ancient times.\nThe POKéMON was apparently evolving

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: from being a water-dweller to living on\nland as evident from the beginnings of\nchange in its gills and legs.

sourceRecords.japanese: コハクから　とりだした　いでんしを　さいせいして\nふっかつした　きょうりゅう　じだいの　ポケモン。\nそらの　おうじゃだったと　そうぞうされている。
sourceRecords.english: AERODACTYL is a POKéMON from the age\nof dinosaurs. It was regenerated from\ngenetic material extracted from amber.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It is imagined to have been the king of\nthe skies in ancient times.

sourceRecords.japanese: たべて　ねての　くりかえしで　１にちが　おわる。\nおおきな　おなかの　うえを　あそびばに　している\nこどもたちも　いるほど　おとなしい　ポケモンだ。
sourceRecords.english: SNORLAX's typical day consists of\nnothing more than eating and sleeping.\nIt is such a docile POKéMON that there

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: are children who use its expansive belly\nas a place to play.

sourceRecords.japanese: こおりを　あやつる　でんせつの　とりポケモン。\nはばたく　ことで　くうきを　つめたく　ひやすので\nフリーザーが　とぶと　ゆきが　ふると　いわれる。
sourceRecords.english: ARTICUNO is a legendary bird POKéMON\nthat can control ice.\nThe flapping of its wings chills the air.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: As a result, it is said that when this\nPOKéMON flies, snow will fall.

sourceRecords.japanese: でんきを　あやつる　でんせつの　とりポケモン。\nふだんは　カミナリぐもの　なかで　くらしている。\nカミナリに　うたれると　ちからが　わいてくる。
sourceRecords.english: ZAPDOS is a legendary bird POKéMON that\nhas the ability to control electricity.\nIt usually lives in thunderclouds.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The POKéMON gains power if it is\nstricken by lightning bolts.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほのおを　あやつる　でんせつの　とりポケモン。\nからだが　きずつくと　かこうの　マグマに　はいり\nぜんしんを　もやして　きずを　いやすと　いう。
sourceRecords.english: MOLTRES is a legendary bird POKéMON\nthat has the ability to control fire.\nIf this POKéMON is injured, it is said to

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: dip its body in the molten magma of a\nvolcano to burn and heal itself.

sourceRecords.japanese: ミニリュウが　だっぴを　くりかえして　いるのは\nからだの　なかで　せいめいの　エネルギーが\nどんどん　ふくらみ　おさえきれなく　なるからだ。
sourceRecords.english: DRATINI continually molts and sloughs\noff its old skin.\nIt does so because the life energy

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: within its body steadily builds to reach\nuncontrollable levels.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおきな　エネルギーを　からだに　ためている。\nくびと　しっぽの　すいしょうから　エネルギーを\nときはなち　あたりの　てんきを　かえると　いう。
sourceRecords.english: DRAGONAIR stores an enormous amount\nof energy inside its body.\nIt is said to alter weather conditions

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: in its vicinity by discharging energy\nfrom the crystals on its neck and tail.

sourceRecords.japanese: １６じかんで　ちきゅうを　１しゅうできる。\nあらしで　なんぱしかけた　ふねを　みつけると\nりくちまで　ゆうどうする　やさしい　ポケモン。
sourceRecords.english: DRAGONITE is capable of circling the\nglobe in just sixteen hours.\nIt is a kindhearted POKéMON that leads

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: lost and foundering ships in a storm to\nthe safety of land.

sourceRecords.japanese: いでんしそうさに　よって　つくられた　ポケモン。\nにんげんの　かがくりょくで　からだは　つくれても\nやさしい　こころを　つくることは　できなかった。
sourceRecords.english: MEWTWO is a POKéMON that was created\nby genetic manipulation.\nHowever, even though the scientific

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: power of humans created this POKéMON's\nbody, they failed to endow MEWTWO with\na compassionate heart.

sourceRecords.japanese: すべての　ポケモンの　いでんしを　もつと　いう。\nじゆうじざいに　すがたを　けすことが　できるので\nひとに　ちかづいても　まったく　きづかれない。
sourceRecords.english: MEW is said to possess the genetic\ncomposition of all POKéMON.\nIt is capable of making itself invisible

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: at will, so it entirely avoids notice even\nif it approaches people.

sourceRecords.japanese: はっぱを　ふりまわして　あいてを　いかくするが\nはっぱから　あまい　かおりが　ただようので\nおたがいに　なごやかな　ふんいきに　なるよ。
sourceRecords.english: In battle, CHIKORITA waves its leaf\naround to keep the foe at bay.\nHowever, a sweet fragrance also wafts

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: from the leaf, becalming the battling\nPOKéMON and creating a cozy, friendly\natmosphere all around.

sourceRecords.japanese: くびの　まわりの　くるりと　まいた　はっぱの\nなかには　ちいさな　きのめが　１こ　なっている。\nその　かおりは　ひとを　げんきに　させるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: BAYLEEF's neck is ringed by curled-up\nleaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a\nsmall shoot of a tree.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The fragrance of this shoot makes\npeople peppy.

sourceRecords.japanese: はなの　かおりは　きもちを　おだやかにする。\nたたかいの　ときは　かおりを　はっさんさせて\nあいての　たたかう　きもちを　にぶらせるのだ。
sourceRecords.english: The fragrance of MEGANIUM's flower\nsoothes and calms emotions.\nIn battle, this POKéMON gives off more

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: of its becalming scent to blunt the\nfoe's fighting spirit.

sourceRecords.japanese: せなかから　ほのおを　ふきあげて　みを　まもる。\nおこった　ときの　ほのおは　いきおいが　いいが\nつかれている　ときは　ふかんぜんねんしょうする。
sourceRecords.english: CYNDAQUIL protects itself by flaring up\nthe flames on its back.\nThe flames are vigorous if the POKéMON

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: is angry. However, if it is tired, the\nflames splutter fitfully with incomplete\ncombustion.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほのおの　いきおいと　ねっぷうで　いかくする。\nすばやい　みのこなしで　あいての　こうげきを\nかわしながら　どうじに　ほのおで　もやす。
sourceRecords.english: QUILAVA keeps its foes at bay with the\nintensity of its flames and gusts of\nsuperheated air.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON applies its outstanding\nnimbleness to dodge attacks even while\nscorching the foe with flames.

sourceRecords.japanese: しゃくねつの　ほのおで　まわりに　かげろうを\nつくりだして　すがたを　かくす　ことが　できる。\nもえあがる　ばくふうは　すべてを　やきつくすぞ。
sourceRecords.english: TYPHLOSION obscures itself behind a\nshimmering heat haze that it creates\nusing its intensely hot flames.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON creates blazing explosive\nblasts that burn everything to cinders.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちいさな　からだでも　アゴの　ちからは　つよい。\nワニノコじしんは　あまがみ　している　つもりでも\nおおけがを　してしまう　ほどの　ちからが　ある。
sourceRecords.english: Despite the smallness of its body,\nTOTODILE's jaws are very powerful.\nWhile the POKéMON may think it is just

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: playfully nipping, its bite has enough\npower to cause serious injury.

sourceRecords.japanese: いちど　かみついたら　ぜったいに　はなさない。\nキバの　さきが　つりばり　みたいに　そりかえって\nいるので　いちど　ささると　ぬけなく　なるのだ。
sourceRecords.english: Once CROCONAW has clamped its jaws on\nits foe, it will absolutely not let go.\nBecause the tips of its fangs are

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: forked back like barbed fishhooks, they\nbecome impossible to remove when \nthey have sunk in.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおきな　くちを　あけて　あいてを　いかくする。\nきょうじんな　うしろあしで　じめんを　けって\nものすごい　スピードで　とっしん　してくるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: FERALIGATR intimidates its foes by\nopening its huge mouth.\nIn battle, it will kick the ground hard

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: with its thick and powerful hind legs to\ncharge at the foe at an incredible\nspeed.

sourceRecords.japanese: ねむる　ときには　こうたいで　みはりをする。\nきけんを　さっちすると　なかまを　おこすのだ。\nむれから　はぐれると　こわくて　ねむれなくなる。
sourceRecords.english: When SENTRET sleeps, it does so while\nanother stands guard. The sentry wakes\nthe others at the first sign of danger.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: When this POKéMON becomes separated\nfrom its pack, it becomes incapable of\nsleep due to fear.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきに　おそわれても　ほそい　すきまに\nするりと　もぐりこんで　にげる　ことが　できる。\nてあしは　みじかいが　とても　すばしっこい。
sourceRecords.english: FURRET has a very slim build.\nWhen under attack, it can slickly squirm\nthrough narrow spaces and get away.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: In spite of its short limbs, this\nPOKéMON is very nimble and fleet.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　なかには　ちきゅうの　じてんを\nかんじとる　きかんを　もっているので　まいにち\nおなじ　じかんに　なると　なきごえを　あげる。
sourceRecords.english: HOOTHOOT has an internal organ that\nsenses and tracks the earth's rotation.\nUsing this special organ, this POKéMON

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: begins hooting at precisely the same\ntime every day.

sourceRecords.japanese: わずかな　ひかりでも　みえる　すぐれた　めと\nはおとを　たてない　やわらかい　はねの　おかげで\nくらやみでは　えものを　ぜったいに　にがさない。
sourceRecords.english: NOCTOWL never fails at catching prey in\ndarkness. This POKéMON owes its\nsuccess to its superior vision that

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: allows it to see in minimal light, and to\nits soft,  supple wings that make no\nsound in flight.

sourceRecords.japanese: あしの　つけねから　だす　えきたいの　においで\nなかまと　コミュニケーションを　とっている。\nにおいの　ちがいで　きもちを　つたえるという。
sourceRecords.english: LEDYBA secretes an aromatic fluid from\nwhere its legs join its body. This fluid\nis used for communicating with others.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON conveys its feelings to\nothers by altering the fluid's scent.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほしが　たくさん　みえる　くうきの　きれいな\nとちには　レディアンが　たくさん　すむと　いう。\nほしあかりを　エネルギーに　しているからだ。
sourceRecords.english: It is said that in lands with clean air,\nwhere the stars fill the sky, there live\nLEDIAN in countless numbers.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: There is a good reason for this - the\nPOKéMON uses the light of the stars\nas its energy.

sourceRecords.japanese: いとで　つくった　ワナは　だい２の　しんけい。\nいとを　つたわる　わずかな　しんどう　だけで\nえものの　しゅるいが　わかると　いわれている。
sourceRecords.english: The web spun by SPINARAK can be\nconsidered its second nervous system.\nIt is said that this POKéMON can

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: determine what kind of prey is touching\nits web just by the tiny vibrations it\nfeels through the web's strands.

sourceRecords.japanese: あしの　せんたんには　ちいさな　カギヅメが　あり\nてんじょうや　すいちょくの　かべも　あるける。\nほそく　じょうぶな　いとで　てきを　しめあげる。
sourceRecords.english: ARIADOS's feet are tipped with tiny\nhooked claws that enable it to scuttle\non ceilings and vertical walls.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON constricts the foe with\nthin and strong silk webbing.

sourceRecords.japanese: うでか　あしの　どちらかだけで　はばたいている\nときは　ながい　きょりを　とんでいる　しょうこ。\nつかれると　はばたく　ハネを　かえるのだ。
sourceRecords.english: If this POKéMON is flying by fluttering\nonly a pair of wings on either the\nforelegs or hind legs, it's proof that

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: CROBAT has been flying a long distance.\nIt switches the wings it uses if it is\ntired.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２ほんの　しょくしゅから　プラスと　マイナスの\nでんきを　ながして　えものを　きぜつ　させる。\nでんきの　あかりは　なかまとの　サインだ。
sourceRecords.english: CHINCHOU lets loose positive and\nnegative electrical charges from its\ntwo antennas to make its prey faint.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON flashes its electric\nlights to exchange signals with others.

sourceRecords.japanese: しんかいのほし　と　よばれる　ポケモンだ。\nしょくしゅの　なかの　バクテリアと　たいえきを\nかがくはんのうさせる　ことで　ひかりを　つくる。
sourceRecords.english: LANTURN is nicknamed “the deep-sea\nstar” for its illuminated antenna.\nThis POKéMON produces light by

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: causing a chemical reaction between\nbacteria and its bodily fluids inside\nthe antenna.

sourceRecords.japanese: かみなりぐもが　でている　ときや　くうきの\nかんそうした　ひは　でんきが　たまりやすい。\nパチパチ　せいでんきの　おとが　なっているよ。
sourceRecords.english: PICHU charges itself with electricity\nmore easily on days with thunderclouds\nor when the air is very dry.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: You can hear the crackling of static\nelectricity coming off this POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: ながれぼしの　おおい　よるは　わ　に　なって\nおどる　ピィの　すがたを　みることが　できる。\nひのでまで　おどり　よつゆで　のどを　うるおす。
sourceRecords.english: On nights with many shooting stars,\nCLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring.\nThey dance through the night and stop

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: only at the break of day, when these\nPOKéMON quench their thirst with the\nmorning dew.

sourceRecords.japanese: せいたいが　まだ　じゅうぶんに　はったつして\nいないので　うたい　つづけると　ノドが　いたむ。\nきれいな　おがわの　みずで　うがいをするよ。
sourceRecords.english: IGGLYBUFF's vocal chords are not\nsufficiently developed. It would hurt\nits throat if it were to sing too much.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON gargles with freshwater\nfrom a clean stream.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひとや　ポケモンが　はっしている　やさしさや\nたのしい　きもちを　エネルギーに　している。\nカラの　なかに　ためた　しあわせを　わけている。
sourceRecords.english: As its energy, TOGEPI uses the positive\nemotions of compassion and pleasure\nexuded by people and POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON stores up feelings of\nhappiness inside its shell, then shares\nthem with others.

sourceRecords.japanese: こううんを　もたらす　ポケモンと　いわれている。\nじゅんすいな　こころの　もちぬしを　みつけると\nすがたを　あらわし　しあわせを　わけあたえる。
sourceRecords.english: TOGETIC is said to be a POKéMON that\nbrings good fortune. When the POKéMON\nspots someone who is pure of heart,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: it is said to appear and share its\nhappiness with that person.

sourceRecords.japanese: はねが　まだ　そだって　いないので　とべない。\nめを　あわせると　じっと　みつめるが　あいてが\nすこしでも　うごくと　とびはねて　にげていく。
sourceRecords.english: NATU cannot fly because its wings are\nnot yet fully grown. If your eyes meet\nwith this POKéMON's eyes, it will stare

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: back intently at you. But if you move\neven slightly, it will hop away to safety.

sourceRecords.japanese: いちにちじゅう　ネイティオが　じっとしているのは\nみらいよちで　わかった　おそろしい　できごとに\nおびえているからだと　しんじられている。
sourceRecords.english: XATU stands rooted and still in one\nspot all day long. People believe that\nthis POKéMON does so out of fear of

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: the terrible things it has foreseen in\nthe future.

sourceRecords.japanese: たいもうが　こすれて　せいでんきが　たまる。\nでんりょくが　たくさん　たまるほど　しっぽの\nさきに　ついた　でんきゅうが　あかるく　ひかる。
sourceRecords.english: MAREEP's fluffy coat of wool rubs\ntogether and builds a static charge.\nThe more static electricity is charged,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: the more brightly the lightbulb at the\ntip of its tail grows.

sourceRecords.japanese: たいもうの　せいしつが　へんかするので　すくない\nりょうでも　たくさんの　でんきを　つくりだせる。\nでんきを　さえぎる　つるつるの　はだを　もつ。
sourceRecords.english: FLAAFFY's wool quality changes so that\nit can generate a high amount of static\nelectricity with a small amount of wool.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The bare and slick parts of its hide are\nshielded against electricity.

sourceRecords.japanese: デンリュウの　あかりは　うちゅうからも　みえる。\nむかしの　ひとは　デンリュウの　あかりを　つかい\nとおくの　なかまと　あいずを　おくりあっていた。
sourceRecords.english: AMPHAROS gives off so much light that\nit can be seen even from space.\nPeople in the old days used the light of

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: this POKéMON to send signals back and\nforth with others far away.

sourceRecords.japanese: たいようの　ひかりを　いっぱい　あびると\nからだの　はっぱが　くるくる　まわり　はじめる。\nキレイハナの　ダンスは　なんごくの　めいぶつだ。
sourceRecords.english: When BELLOSSOM gets exposed to plenty\nof sunlight, the leaves ringing its body\nbegin to spin around.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's dancing is renowned in\nthe southern lands.

sourceRecords.japanese: あぶらの　つまった　しっぽは　うきわの　かわり。\nすいめんに　しっぽだけが　ういている　ときは\nもぐって　みずくさを　たべている　めじるしだ。
sourceRecords.english: MARILL's oil-filled tail acts much like\na life preserver. If you see just its\ntail bobbing on the water's surface,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: it's a sure indication that this POKéMON\nis diving beneath the water to feed on\naquatic plants.

sourceRecords.japanese: ながい　みみは　マリルリの　だいじな　センサー。\nみみを　すませば　ながれの　はげしい　かわでも\nそこに　いる　えものの　しゅるいが　わかるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: AZUMARILL's long ears are indispensable\nsensors. By focusing its hearing, this\nPOKéMON can identify what kinds of

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: prey are around, even in rough and\nfast-running rivers.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきに　おそわれない　ように　きの　ふりをする。\nりょうては　１ねんじゅう　みどりいろなので\nふゆは　にせものだと　すぐに　ばれてしまう。
sourceRecords.english: SUDOWOODO camouflages itself as a tree\nto avoid being attacked by enemies.\nHowever, because the forelegs remain

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: green throughout the year, the POKéMON\nis easily identified as a fake during\nthe winter.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたまの　まきげは　おうじゃの　あかしだ。\nながく　きれいに　まいている　ニョロトノほど\nなかまの　そんけいを　あつめると　いわれている。
sourceRecords.english: The curled hair on POLITOED's head is\nproof of its status as a king. It is said\nthat the longer and more curled the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: hair, the more respect this POKéMON\nearns from its peers.

sourceRecords.japanese: かぜに　のって　ふわふわ　ただよう　ポケモン。\nきょうふうの　けはいを　かんじると　なかまどうし\nはっぱを　からめ　とばされない　じゅんびをする。
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON drifts and floats with the\nwind. If it senses the approach of\nstrong winds, HOPPIP links its leaves

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: with other HOPPIP to prepare against\nbeing blown away.

sourceRecords.japanese: きおんが　１８どを　こえると　はなが　ひらく。\nおんどに　より　はなの　ひらきかたが　かわるので\nおんどけいの　かわりに　することも　ある。
sourceRecords.english: SKIPLOOM's flower blossoms when the\ntemperature rises above 64 degrees F.\nHow much the flower opens depends on

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: the temperature. For that reason, this\nPOKéMON is sometimes used as a\nthermometer.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたたかい　みなみかぜに　のって　うみを　こえ\nがいこくまで　とんでいってしまう　ポケモン。\nつめたい　くうきに　ふれると　じめんに　おりる。
sourceRecords.english: JUMPLUFF rides warm southern winds to\ncross the sea and fly to foreign lands.\nThe POKéMON descends to the ground

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: when it encounters cold air while it is\nfloating.

sourceRecords.japanese: きように　うごく　しっぽの　さきを　てのひらの\nかわりに　つかっていたら　はんたいに　りょうてが\nぶきように　なってしまった　ポケモンだ。
sourceRecords.english: AIPOM's tail ends in a hand-like\nappendage that can be cleverly\nmanipulated.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: However, because the POKéMON uses its\ntail so much, its real hands have become\nrather clumsy.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだに　ためた　えいようは　しんかの　ときまで\nとっておくため　ほとんど　うごこうとしない。\nなにも　たべずに　あさつゆ　だけを　のんでいる。
sourceRecords.english: SUNKERN tries to move as little as it\npossibly can. It does so because it\ntries to conserve all the nutrients it

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: has stored in its body for its\nevolution. It will not eat a thing, \nsubsisting only on morning dew.

sourceRecords.japanese: たいようエネルギーから　えいようを　つくりだす。\nきおんの　たかい　にっちゅう　かっぱつに　うごき\nたいようが　しずむと　ぱったり　うごかなくなる。
sourceRecords.english: SUNFLORA converts solar energy into\nnutrition. It moves around actively in\nthe daytime when it is warm.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It stops moving as soon as the sun goes\ndown for the night.

sourceRecords.japanese: めだまを　うごかさずに　３６０ど　みわたせる。\nきゅうブレーキや　ほうこうてんかんが　とくい。\nねらった　えものを　すばやく　おいつめていく。
sourceRecords.english: YANMA is capable of seeing 360 degrees\nwithout having to move its eyes.\nIt is a great flier that is adept at

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: making sudden stops and turning midair.\nThis POKéMON uses its flying ability to\nquickly chase down targeted prey.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふだんは　みずの　なかで　くらしているが　エサを\nさがすときなど　たまに　ちじょうに　でてくる。\nりくでは　どくの　ねんえきで　からだを　おおう。
sourceRecords.english: WOOPER usually lives in water.\nHowever, it occasionally comes out onto\nland in search of food.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: On land, it coats its body with a gooey,\ntoxic film.

sourceRecords.japanese: みずの　なかで　くちを　あけて　エサが　ぐうぜん\nとびこんで　くるのを　ただただ　まっている。\nうごかないので　あまり　おなかが　すかないのだ。
sourceRecords.english: QUAGSIRE hunts for food by leaving\nits mouth wide open in water and waiting\nfor its prey to blunder in unaware.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Because the POKéMON does not move,\nit does not get very hungry.

sourceRecords.japanese: みとめた　トレーナーには　きわめて　ちゅうじつ。\nトレーナーを　きけんから　まもる　ために\nよちのうりょくが　はったつしたと　いわれている。
sourceRecords.english: ESPEON is extremely loyal to any\nTRAINER it considers to be worthy.\nIt is said that this POKéMON developed

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: its precognitive powers to protect its\nTRAINER from harm.

sourceRecords.japanese: つきの　はどうを　うけて　しんかした　ポケモン。\nくらやみに　じっと　ひそみ　あいてを　うかがう。\nおそいかかる　とき　からだの　わっかが　ひかる。
sourceRecords.english: UMBREON evolved as a result of exposure\nto the moon's waves.\nIt hides silently in darkness and waits

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: for its foes to make a move.\nThe rings on its body glow when it leaps\nto attack.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふこうを　はこぶと　いわれ　おそれられていた。\nキラキラ　ひかる　ものに　きょうみを　しめし\nじょせいの　ゆびわを　とっていこうとする。
sourceRecords.english: MURKROW was feared and loathed as the\nalleged bearer of ill fortune.\nThis POKéMON shows strong interest in

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: anything that sparkles or glitters.\nIt will even try to steal rings from\nwomen.

sourceRecords.japanese: せかいの　ふしぎを　かいめい　するため　まいにち\nけんきゅう　しているが　あたまの　シェルダーが\nはずれると　ぜんぶ　わすれてしまう　らしい。
sourceRecords.english: SLOWKING undertakes research every\nday in an effort to solve the mysteries\nof the world.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: However, this POKéMON apparently\nforgets everything it has learned if\nthe SHELLDER on its head comes off.

sourceRecords.japanese: すすりなく　ような　なきごえで　こわがらせる。\nあいての　こわがる　こころを　あかい　たまで\nきゅうしゅうして　えいように　している　らしい。
sourceRecords.english: MISDREAVUS frightens people with a\ncreepy, sobbing cry. The POKéMON\napparently uses its red spheres to

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: absorb the fearful feelings of foes and\nturn them into nutrition.

sourceRecords.japanese: こだいの　もじに　にた　すがたの　ポケモン。\nさきに　うまれたのは　もじか　アンノーンなのか。\nけんきゅうちゅうだが　いまだに　なぞである。
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is shaped like ancient\nwriting. It is a mystery as to which\ncame first, the ancient writings or the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: various UNOWN. Research into this\ntopic is ongoing but nothing is known.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２ひき　いじょう　あつまると　がまん　くらべを\nはじめるが　くうふくを　がまんして　しまうので\nソーナンス　トレーナーは　ちゅういが　ひつよう。
sourceRecords.english: If two or more WOBBUFFET meet, they will\nturn competitive and try to outdo each\nother's endurance.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: However, they may try to see which one\ncan endure the longest without food.\nTRAINERS need to beware of this habit.

sourceRecords.japanese: シッポの　あたまにも　ちいさな　のうが　ある。\nにおいや　おとに　はんのうして　こうげきするので\nうしろから　ちかよると　いきなり　かみつかれる。
sourceRecords.english: GIRAFARIG's rear head also has a brain,\nbut it is small. The rear head attacks in\nresponse to smells and sounds.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Approaching this POKéMON from behind\ncan cause the rear head to suddenly\nlash out and bite.

sourceRecords.japanese: きの　えだに　ぶらさがり　えものを　まっている。\nきを　ゆらされて　しょくじの　じゃまを　されると\nじめんに　おちてから　いきなり　ばくはつするぞ。
sourceRecords.english: PINECO hangs from a tree branch and\npatiently waits for prey to come along.\nIf the POKéMON is disturbed while

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: eating by someone shaking its tree, it\ndrops down to the ground and explodes\nwith no warning.

sourceRecords.japanese: こうてつの　カラの　なかに　ほんたいが　いる。\nえものを　つかまえる　ときに　カラが　ひらくが\nあまりの　はやさに　なかみは　みえないのだ。
sourceRecords.english: FORRETRESS conceals itself inside its\nhardened steel shell. The shell is opened\nwhen the POKéMON is catching prey,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: but it does so at such a quick pace\nthat the shell's inside cannot be seen.

sourceRecords.japanese: ドリルの　シッポを　つかって　うしろむきに\nじめんを　ほりすすみ　ふくざつな　かたちの\nすあなを　ちちゅう　ふかくに　つくる　ポケモン。
sourceRecords.english: DUNSPARCE has a drill for its tail.\nIt uses this tail to burrow into the\nground backwards.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is known to make its nest\nin complex shapes deep under the\nground.

sourceRecords.japanese: おとを　たてず　すべる　ように　かっくうする。\nりょううでの　おおきな　ツメと　あしの　ツメで\nえものの　かおに　しがみつき　どくばりを　さす。
sourceRecords.english: GLIGAR glides through the air without\na sound as if it were sliding.\nThis POKéMON hangs on to the face of

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: its foe using its clawed hind legs and\nthe large pincers on its forelegs, then\ninjects the prey with its poison barb.

sourceRecords.japanese: イワークよりも　ふかい　ちちゅうに　すんでいる。\nちきゅうの　ちゅうしんに　むかって　ほりすすみ\nふかさ　１キロに　たっする　ことも　ある。
sourceRecords.english: STEELIX lives even further underground\nthan ONIX. This POKéMON is known to dig\ntowards the earth's core.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: There are records of this POKéMON\nreaching a depth of over six-tenths\nof a mile underground.

sourceRecords.japanese: キバを　むきだして　こわい　かおを　すれば\nちいさな　ポケモンなら　おびえて　にげだす。\nにげられた　ブルーは　ちょっと　さみしそう。
sourceRecords.english: By baring its fangs and making a scary\nface, SNUBBULL sends smaller POKéMON\nscurrying away in terror.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: However, this POKéMON seems a little\nsad at making its foes flee.

sourceRecords.japanese: したアゴが　とても　はったつした　ポケモン。\nキバが　おもたいので　くびを　かしげている。\nおどろかさなければ　むやみに　かみつかない。
sourceRecords.english: GRANBULL has a particularly well-\ndeveloped lower jaw. The enormous fangs\nare heavy, causing the POKéMON to tip

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: its head back for balance.\nUnless it is startled, it will not try to\nbite indiscriminately.

sourceRecords.japanese: のみこんだ　みずの　ちからを　りようして\nぜんしんの　どくばりを　いっせいに　うちだす。\nおよぐのは　ちょっと　にがてな　ポケモンだ。
sourceRecords.english: QWILFISH sucks in water, inflating\nitself. This POKéMON uses the pressure\nof the water it swallowed to shoot

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: toxic quills all at once from all over\nits body. It finds swimming somewhat\nchallenging.

sourceRecords.japanese: はがねの　かたさを　もつ　からだは　ちょっとや\nそっとの　こうげきでは　びくとも　しないぞ。\nハネを　はばたかせ　たいおんを　ちょうせつする。
sourceRecords.english: SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of\nsteel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary\nsorts of attacks.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON flaps its wings to\nregulate its body temperature.

sourceRecords.japanese: いわの　したで　こうらの　なかに　たくわえた\nきのみを　たべながら　みを　ひそめている。\nたいえきと　まざり　きのみは　ジュースに　なる。
sourceRecords.english: SHUCKLE quietly hides itself under\nrocks, keeping its body concealed\ninside its hard shell while eating

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: berries it has stored away.\nThe berries mix with its body fluids to\nbecome a juice.

sourceRecords.japanese: いっちょくせんに　てきの　ふところに　もぐりこみ\nたくましい　ツノで　すくいあげ　なげとばす。\nたいぼくも　ねこそぎ　たおす　ほどの　パワーだ。
sourceRecords.english: HERACROSS charges in a straight line at\nits foe, slips beneath the foe's grasp,\nand then scoops up and hurls the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: opponent with its mighty horn.\nThis POKéMON even has enough power\nto topple a massive tree.

sourceRecords.japanese: てあしの　カギヅメを　つきたてて　きを　のぼる。\nおやの　いない　すきを　ねらって　きの　うえに\nある　す　から　タマゴを　ぬすんで　たべる。
sourceRecords.english: SNEASEL scales trees by punching its\nhooked claws into the bark.\nThis POKéMON seeks out unguarded

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: nests and steals eggs for food while\nthe parents are away.

sourceRecords.japanese: ハチミツの　しみこんだ　てのひらを　なめている。\nヒメグマの　ハチミツは　くだものと　スピアーの\nあつめた　かふんが　ブレンドされて　つくられる。
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON likes to lick its palms that\nare sweetened by being soaked in honey.\nTEDDIURSA concocts its own honey by

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: blending fruits and pollen collected by\nBEEDRILL.

sourceRecords.japanese: もりの　なかには　リングマが　エサあつめを　する\nたいぼくや　おがわが　あちこちに　あると　いう。\nまいにち　エサを　あつめて　もりを　あるく。
sourceRecords.english: In the forests inhabited by URSARING,\nit is said that there are many streams\nand towering trees where they

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: gather food. This POKéMON walks\nthrough its forest gathering food\nevery day.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　なかでは　しゃくねつの　ようがんが\nうずまいているが　ひえると　かたまって　しまい\nくずれて　からだが　ちいさく　なっていく。
sourceRecords.english: Molten magma courses throughout\nSLUGMA's circulatory system.\nIf this POKéMON is chilled, the magma

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: cools and hardens. Its body turns\nbrittle and chunks fall off, reducing\nits size.

sourceRecords.japanese: カラは　ひふが　ひえて　かたまった　もの。\nさわった　だけで　ボロボロと　くずれて　しまう。\nマグマに　はいると　もとの　おおきさに　もどる。
sourceRecords.english: MAGCARGO's shell is actually its skin\nthat hardened as a result of cooling.\nIts shell is very brittle and fragile -

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: just touching it causes it to crumble\napart. This POKéMON returns to its\noriginal size by dipping itself in magma.

sourceRecords.japanese: じめんに　はなを　こすりつけて　エサを　さがす。\nかれくさの　したに　はえた　キノコが　こうぶつ。\nたまに　おんせんを　ほりあてる　ことが　あるよ。
