sourceRecords.english: SWINUB roots for food by rubbing its\nsnout against the ground. Its favorite\nfood is a mushroom that grows under

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: the cover of dead grass.\nThis POKéMON occasionally roots out\nhot springs.

sourceRecords.japanese: こごえる　さむさにも　たえられる　ように\nあつくて　ながい　けがわに　おおわれている。\nこおりに　うまった　エサを　キバで　ほりだす。
sourceRecords.english: PILOSWINE is covered by a thick coat\nof long hair that enables it to endure\nthe freezing cold.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON uses its tusks to dig up\nfood that has been buried under ice.

sourceRecords.japanese: サンゴの　えだは　たいようの　ひかりを　あびると\nなないろに　キラキラ　かがやき　とても　きれい。\nおれても　ひとばんで　もとどおりに　はえてくる。
sourceRecords.english: CORSOLA's branches glitter very\nbeautifully in seven colors when they\ncatch sunlight.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If any branch breaks off, this POKéMON\ngrows it back in just one night.

sourceRecords.japanese: のんだ　みずを　ふっきんを　つかい　いきおいよく\nふきだして　そらを　とぶ　えものを　しとめる。\nしんかが　ちかづくと　かわを　くだっていく。
sourceRecords.english: REMORAID sucks in water, then expels it\nat high velocity using its abdominal\nmuscles to shoot down flying prey.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: When evolution draws near, this POKéMON\ntravels downstream from rivers.

sourceRecords.japanese: きゅうばんの　うでで　あいてに　からみつく。\nうごけなくなった　ところを　しとめるのだ。\nかなわない　ときは　スミを　はいて　にげる。
sourceRecords.english: OCTILLERY grabs onto its foe using\nits tentacles. This POKéMON tries to\nimmobilize it before delivering the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: finishing blow.\nIf the foe turns out to be too strong,\nOCTILLERY spews ink to escape.

sourceRecords.japanese: しっぽで　エサを　つつみ　もちはこぶ　ポケモン。\nデリバードに　エサを　わけてもらった　おかげで\nエベレストを　のぼりきれた　ぼうけんかが　いた。
sourceRecords.english: DELIBIRD carries its food bundled up\nin its tail. There once was a famous\nexplorer who managed to reach the peak

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: of Mt. Everest thanks to one of these\nPOKéMON sharing its food.

sourceRecords.japanese: はれた　ひには　うみの　うえを　ゆうがに　はねる\nマンタインの　むれを　みることが　できるよ。\nテッポウオが　くっついていても　きにしない。
sourceRecords.english: On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can\nbe seen elegantly leaping over the\nsea's waves.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is not bothered by the\nREMORAID that hitches rides.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぜんしんが　かたい　ヨロイに　おおわれている。\nじそく　３００キロの　スピードで　そらを　とび\nかたなの　きれあじを　もつ　ハネで　きりさく。
sourceRecords.english: SKARMORY is entirely encased in hard,\nprotective armor. This POKéMON flies at\nclose to 190 mph.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It slashes foes with its wings that\npossess swordlike cutting edges.

sourceRecords.japanese: さまざまな　なきごえを　つかいわけ　なかまと\nれんらくを　とりあい　えものを　おいこんでいく。\nチームワークの　みごとさは　ポケモンずいいち。
sourceRecords.english: HOUNDOUR hunt as a coordinated pack.\nThey communicate with each other using\na variety of cries to corner their prey.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
あたまの　ツノが　おおきく　そりかえって　いる\nヘルガーが　グループの　リーダーてき　そんざい。\nなかま　どうしで　あらそい　リーダーが　きまる。
sourceRecords.english: In a HOUNDOOM pack, the one with its\nhorns raked sharply towards the back\nserves a leadership role.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: These POKéMON choose their leader by\nfighting amongst themselves.

sourceRecords.japanese: せいぶつの　すまない　しんかいに　せいそくする。\nキングドラの　あくびが　さかまく　かいりゅうを\nひきおこすと　ながい　あいだ　しんじられてきた。
sourceRecords.english: KINGDRA lives at extreme ocean depths\nthat are otherwise uninhabited.\nIt has long been believed that the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: yawning of this POKéMON creates\nspiraling ocean currents.

sourceRecords.japanese: かわの　ほとりに　たてあなを　ほって　くらす。\nすみかの　ちかくに　はなの　しるしを　つけて\nじぶんの　ばしょだと　なかまに　おしえているよ。
sourceRecords.english: For its nest, PHANPY digs a vertical pit \nin the ground at the edge of a river.\nIt marks the area around its nest with

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: its trunk to let the others know that\nthe area has been claimed.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだを　まるめて　こうそくかいてん　しながら\nあいてに　とっしんする　こうげきが　とくい。\nころがり　はじめると　なかなか　とまれなくなる。
sourceRecords.english: DONPHAN's favorite attack is curling\nits body into a ball, then charging at\nits foe while rolling at high speed.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Once it starts rolling, this POKéMON\ncan't stop very easily.

sourceRecords.japanese: にんげんが　かがくの　ちからで　つくりだした。\nじんこう　ちのうを　もたせたので　あたらしい\nしぐさや　かんじょうを　ひとりで　おぼえていく。
sourceRecords.english: PORYGON2 was created by humans using\nthe power of science. The man-made\nPOKéMON has been endowed with

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: artificial intelligence that enables it\nto learn new gestures and emotions\non its own.

sourceRecords.japanese: みごとな　かたちの　ツノは　びじゅつひん　として\nたかく　うれた　ために　ぜつめつ　すんぜんまで\nらんかくされた　ことのある　ポケモン。
sourceRecords.english: STANTLER's magnificent antlers were\ntraded at high prices as works of art.\nAs a result, this POKéMON was hunted

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: close to extinction by those who were\nafter the priceless antlers.

sourceRecords.japanese: しっぽの　さきから　にじみでる　たいえきで\nなわばりの　まわりに　じぶんの　マークを　かく。\n５０００　しゅるいの　マークが　みつかっている。
sourceRecords.english: SMEARGLE marks the boundaries of its\nterritory using a body fluid that leaks\nout from the tip of its tail.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Over 5,000 different marks left by this\nPOKéMON have been found.

sourceRecords.japanese: まいにち　トレーニング　しないと　ストレスが\nたまってしまうので　トレーナーは　そだてる　とき\nスケジュールかんりに　くふうが　ひつようだ。
sourceRecords.english: TYROGUE becomes stressed out if it\ndoes not get to train every day.\nWhen raising this POKéMON, the TRAINER

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: must establish and uphold various\ntraining methods.

sourceRecords.japanese: こうそく　かいてんしながら　はなつ　キックは\nこうげきと　ぼうぎょを　かねた　みごとな　わざ。\nあるく　よりも　かいてんした　ほうが　はやい。
sourceRecords.english: HITMONTOP spins on its head at high\nspeed, all the while delivering kicks.\nThis technique is a remarkable mix of

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: both offense and defense at the same\ntime. The POKéMON travels faster\nspinning than it does walking.

sourceRecords.japanese: げんき　いっぱい　うごきまわるが　よく　ころぶ。\nむっくり　おきあがると　みずうみの　すいめんに\nかおを　うつして　よごれていないか　しらべる。
sourceRecords.english: SMOOCHUM actively runs about, but\nalso falls quite often.\nWhenever the chance arrives, it will

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: look for its reflection to make sure its\nface hasn't become dirty.

sourceRecords.japanese: きんぞくに　さわって　からだに　ためた　でんきが\nほうでん　してしまうと　りょううでを　ぐるぐる\nまわして　ふたたび　でんきを　ためる。
sourceRecords.english: ELEKID stores electricity in its body.\nIf it touches metal and accidentally\ndischarges all its built-up electricity,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: this POKéMON begins swinging its arms\nin circles to recharge itself.

sourceRecords.japanese: きいろい　ほのおを　くちから　ふいている　ときは\nけんこうな　しょうこだが　つかれていると　くろい\nけむりが　まざる　ように　なるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: MAGBY's state of health is determined\nby observing the fire it breathes.\nIf the POKéMON is spouting yellow

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: flames from its mouth, it is in good\nhealth. When it is fatigued, black smoke\nwill be mixed in with the flames.

sourceRecords.japanese: まいにち　２０リットルの　ミルクを　だす。\nあまい　ミルクは　おとなも　こどもも　だいすき。\nにがてな　ひとは　ヨーグルトにして　たべている。
sourceRecords.english: MILTANK gives over five gallons of milk\non a daily basis. Its sweet milk is\nenjoyed by children and grown-ups alike.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: People who can't drink milk turn it into\nyogurt and eat it instead.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふわふわの　たいもうで　かなしんでいる　こころを\nキャッチすると　どんなに　とおくでも　かけつけて\nえがおに　なる　しあわせタマゴを　わけてあげる。
sourceRecords.english: BLISSEY senses sadness with its fluffy\ncoat of fur. If it does so, this POKéMON\nwill rush over to the sad person,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: however far they may be, to share an\negg of happiness that brings a smile\nto any face.

sourceRecords.japanese: かみなりの　スピードを　やどした　ポケモン。\nその　とおぼえは　かみなりが　おちた　ときの\nように　くうきを　ふるわせ　だいちを　ゆるがす。
sourceRecords.english: RAIKOU embodies the speed of lightning.\nThe roars of this POKéMON send shock\nwaves shuddering through the air and

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: shake the ground as if lightning bolts\nhad come crashing down.

sourceRecords.japanese: マグマの　じょうねつを　やどした　ポケモン。\nかざんの　ふんかから　うまれたと　かんがえられ\nすべてを　やきつくす　ほのおを　ふきあげる。
sourceRecords.english: ENTEI embodies the passion of magma.\nThis POKéMON is thought to have been\nborn in the eruption of a volcano.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It sends up massive bursts of fire that\nutterly consume all that they touch.

sourceRecords.japanese: わきみずの　やさしさを　やどした　ポケモン。\nすべる　ような　みのこなしで　だいちを　はしり\nにごった　みずを　きよめる　ちからを　もつ。
sourceRecords.english: SUICUNE embodies the compassion of\na pure spring of water. It runs across\nthe land with gracefulness.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON has the power to purify\ndirty water.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちちゅう　ふかくで　うまれる　ヨーギラスは\nつちを　たべつくして　ちじょうへ　でないと\nおやの　かおを　みる　ことが　できないのだ。
sourceRecords.english: LARVITAR is born deep under the ground.\nTo come up to the surface, this POKéMON\nmust eat its way through the soil above.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Until it does so, LARVITAR cannot see\nits parent's face.

sourceRecords.japanese: たいないで　つくりだした　ガスを　あっしゅくして\nいきおいよく　ふんしゃする　ことで　とんでいく。\nこうてつに　ぶつかっても　へいきな　ボディだ。
sourceRecords.english: PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body\nthat it compresses and forcefully\nejects to propel itself like a jet.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The body is very durable - it avoids\ndamage even if it hits solid steel.

sourceRecords.japanese: じぶんの　すみかを　つくる　ために　やま　ひとつ\nくずしてしまう　ほどの　つよい　パワーを　もつ。\nたたかう　あいてを　もとめて　やまを　さまよう。
sourceRecords.english: TYRANITAR is so overwhelmingly\npowerful, it can bring down a whole\nmountain to make its nest.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON wanders about in\nmountains seeking new opponents to\nfight.

sourceRecords.japanese: つばさを　かるく　はばたかせた　だけで　みんかを\nふきとばす　はかいりょくを　もっている　ために\nかいていで　ひとしれず　くらす　ように　なった。
sourceRecords.english: LUGIA's wings pack devastating power -\na light fluttering of its wings can blow\napart regular houses.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: As a result, this POKéMON chooses to\nlive out of sight deep under the sea.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひかりの　あたる　かくどに　よって　なないろに\nかがやく　ハネは　しあわせを　もたらすと　いう。\nにじの　ふもとに　すむと　いわれている。
sourceRecords.english: HO-OH's feathers glow in seven colors\ndepending on the angle at which they\nare struck by light.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: These feathers are said to bring\nhappiness to the bearers. This POKéMON\nis said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

sourceRecords.japanese: ときを　こえ　みらいから　やってきた　ポケモン。\nセレビィが　すがたを　あらわす　かぎり　あかるい\nみらいが　まっていると　かんがえられている。
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON came from the future by\ncrossing over time.\nIt is thought that so long as CELEBI

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: appears, a bright and shining future\nawaits us.

sourceRecords.japanese: あしの　うらの　ちいさな　トゲを　ひっかけて\nすいちょくの　カベを　のぼることが　できる。\nふとい　しっぽを　たたきつけて　こうげきする。
sourceRecords.english: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom\nof its feet that enable it to scale\nvertical walls.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON attacks by slamming foes\nwith its thick tail.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだから　はえた　はっぱは　もりの　なかで\nてきから　すがたを　かくす　ときに　べんり。\nみつりんに　くらす　きのぼりの　めいしゅ。
sourceRecords.english: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE's\nbody are convenient for camouflaging\nit from enemies in the forest.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is a master at climbing\ntrees in jungles.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだに　はえた　はっぱは　するどい　きれあじ。\nすばやい　みのこなしで　きの　えだを　とびまわり\nてきの　ずじょうや　はいごから　おそいかかるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE's body\nare very sharp edged. This POKéMON is\nvery agile - it leaps all over the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: branches of trees and jumps on its foe\nfrom above or behind.

sourceRecords.japanese: トレーナーに　くっついて　ちょこちょこ　あるく。\nくちから　とばす　ほのおは　せっし　１０００ど。\nあいてを　くろコゲにする　しゃくねつの　たまだ。
sourceRecords.english: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER,\nfollowing behind with unsteady\nsteps.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON breathes fire of over\n1,800 degrees F, including fireballs\nthat leave the foe scorched black.

sourceRecords.japanese: のやまを　はしりまわって　あしこしを　きたえる。\nスピードと　パワーを　かねそなえた　あしは\n１びょうかんに　１０ぱつの　キックを　くりだす。
sourceRecords.english: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and\nthighs by running through fields and\nmountains.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's legs possess both speed\nand power, enabling it to dole out ten\nkicks in one second.

sourceRecords.japanese: たたかいに　なると　てくびから　しゃくねつの\nほのおを　ふきあげ　ゆうかんに　いどみかかる。\nあいてが　てごわいほど　はげしく　もえあがる。
sourceRecords.english: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense\nflames from its wrists and attacks foes\ncourageously.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The stronger the foe, the more\nintensely this POKéMON's wrists burn.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたまの　ひれは　とても　びんかんな　レーダー。\nみずや　くうきの　うごきから　めを　つかわずに\nまわりの　ようすを　キャッチすることが　できる。
sourceRecords.english: The fin on MUDKIP's head acts as highly\nsensitive radar. Using this fin to sense\nmovements of water and air, this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON can determine what is taking\nplace around it without using its eyes.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちじょうでも　せいかつできる　ように　からだの\nひょうめんを　うすい　ねんまくが　つつんでいる。\nしおの　ひいた　かいがんで　どろあそびを　する。
sourceRecords.english: The surface of MARSHTOMP's body is\nenveloped by a thin, sticky film that\nenables it to live on land.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON plays in mud on beaches\nwhen the ocean tide is low.

sourceRecords.japanese: おもさ　１トンいじょう　ある　いわの　かたまりを\nかるがる　ひっぱる　パワーを　もつ　ポケモンだ。\nにごった　すいちゅうも　みとおす　しりょく。
sourceRecords.english: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough\npower to easily drag a boulder weighing\nmore than a ton.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON also has powerful vision\nthat lets it see even in murky water.

sourceRecords.japanese: うごく　ものを　みつけると　すぐに　かみつく。\nえものが　ヘトヘトに　なるまで　おいかけまわすが\nはんげきされると　しりごみする　ことも　あるよ。
sourceRecords.english: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite\nat anything that moves.\nThis POKéMON chases after prey until

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: the victim becomes exhausted.\nHowever, it may turn tail if the prey\nstrikes back.

sourceRecords.japanese: どうもうな　うなりごえを　あげながら　しせいを\nひくく　している　ときは　こうげきの　まえぶれ。\nするどく　とがった　キバで　がぶりと　かみつく。
sourceRecords.english: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals when\nit is preparing to attack. It starts to\ngrowl deeply and then flattens its body.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON will bite savagely with its\nsharply pointed fangs.

sourceRecords.japanese: いつも　あっち　こっちへ　ジグザグ　あるくのは\nこうきしんが　とても　つよくて　めに　うつる\nいろんな　ものに　きょうみを　もつからだ。
sourceRecords.english: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders\neverywhere at all times. This POKéMON\ndoes so because it is very curious.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It becomes interested in anything\nthat it happens to see.

sourceRecords.japanese: まっすぐに　つっぱしり　しょうがいぶつが　ある\nときは　ちょっかくに　おれまがって　よける。\nゆるやかに　カーブした　みちが　とても　にがて。
sourceRecords.english: LINOONE always runs full speed and only\nin straight lines. If facing an obstacle,\nit makes a right-angle turn to evade it.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is very challenged by\ngently curving roads.

sourceRecords.japanese: おしりの　トゲで　きの　かわを　はがして\nしみだした　じゅえきを　しょくりょうに　する。\nきゅうばんの　あしは　ガラスでも　すべらない。
sourceRecords.english: Using the spikes on its rear end,  \nWURMPLE peels the bark off trees and\nfeeds on the sap that oozes out.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's feet are tipped with\nsuction pads that allow it to cling to\nglass without slipping.

sourceRecords.japanese: おちない　ように　いとを　えだに　まきつけて\nからだを　ささえながら　しんかを　まっている。\nちいさな　あなから　そとの　ようすを　うかがう。
sourceRecords.english: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch\nusing silk to keep from falling. There, \nthis POKéMON hangs quietly while it

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: awaits evolution.\nIt peers out of the silk cocoon through\na small hole.

sourceRecords.japanese: あまい　かふんが　だいこうぶつの　ポケモン。\nはなを　つけた　はちうえを　まどべに　おけば\nかふんを　あつめに　かならず　とんでくるよ。
sourceRecords.english: BEAUTIFLY's favorite food is the sweet\npollen of flowers. If you want to see\nthis POKéMON, just leave a potted

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY\nis sure to come looking for pollen.

sourceRecords.japanese: マユルドの　からだは　くちから　だした　ほそい\nいとが　からだを　つつみ　かたくなった　もの。\nマユの　なかで　しんかの　じゅんびを　している。
sourceRecords.english: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon\nby wrapping its body entirely with a\nfine silk from its mouth. Once the silk

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: goes around its body, it hardens.\nThis POKéMON prepares for its evolution\ninside the cocoon.

sourceRecords.japanese: あかりに　ひきよせられる　しゅうせいを　もつ。\nまちあかりに　さそわれた　ドクケイルの　むれが\nがいろじゅの　はっぱを　たべちらかしてしまう。
sourceRecords.english: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light.\nSwarms of this POKéMON are attracted\nby the bright lights of cities, where

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: they wreak havoc by stripping the\nleaves off roadside trees for food.

sourceRecords.japanese: いけや　みずうみの　すいめんに　ういて　くらす。\nはっぱが　かれると　よわってしまうが　きれいな\nみずを　もとめて　たまに　りくちを　いどうする。
sourceRecords.english: LOTAD live in ponds and lakes, where\nthey float on the surface.\nIt grows weak if its broad leaf dies.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: On rare occasions, this POKéMON travels\non land in search of clean water.

sourceRecords.japanese: ゆうぐれになると　かつどうする　やこうせい。\nつりびとを　みかけると　すいちゅうから　いとを\nひっぱり　ジャマをしては　よろこんでいる。
sourceRecords.english: LOMBRE is nocturnal - it will get active\nafter dusk. It is also a mischief-maker.\nWhen this POKéMON spots anglers,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: it tugs on their fishing lines from\nbeneath the surface and enjoys their\nconsternation.

sourceRecords.japanese: ようきな　おんがくを　みみにすると　おどりだす。\nハイキングを　している　こどもの　がっしょうに\nさそわれて　すがたを　あらわすと　いわれている。
sourceRecords.english: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as\nit hears cheerful, festive music.\nThis POKéMON is said to appear when it

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: hears the singing of children on hiking\noutings.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたまの　てっぺんを　きの　えだに　くっつけて\nぶらさがり　ながら　すいぶんを　すいとっている。\nみずを　のむほど　からだが　ツヤツヤ　ひかる。
sourceRecords.english: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree\nbranch using the top of its head.\nIt sucks moisture from the tree while

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: hanging off the branch.\nThe more water it drinks, the glossier\nthis POKéMON's body becomes.

sourceRecords.japanese: うっそうと　しげった　もりに　すむ　ポケモン。\nたまに　もりを　でては　ひとを　おどろかせる。\nながい　はなを　つかまれるのは　だいきらい。
sourceRecords.english: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown\nforests. They occasionally venture out\nof the forest to startle people.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON dislikes having its long\nnose pinched.

sourceRecords.japanese: じゅれい　１０００ねんを　こえた　たいぼくの\nてっぺんに　すむと　いわれる　なぞの　ポケモン。\nはっぱの　うちわで　きょうふうを　まきおこす。
sourceRecords.english: SHIFTRY is a mysterious POKéMON that\nis said to live atop towering trees \ndating back over a thousand years.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It creates terrific windstorms with\nthe fans it holds.

sourceRecords.japanese: どんな　つよい　あいてでも　ゆうかんに　いどむ。\nまけても　へこたれない　こんじょうの　もちぬし。\nおなかが　すくと　おおごえで　ないて　しまう。
sourceRecords.english: TAILLOW courageously stands its\nground against foes, however strong\nthey may be.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This gutsy POKéMON will remain defiant\neven after a loss. On the other hand,\nit cries loudly if it becomes hungry.

sourceRecords.japanese: はるか　じょうくうを　えんを　えがく　ように\nとびまわり　えものを　みつけると　きゅうこうか。\nあしの　ツメで　がっしり　つかんで　にがさない。
sourceRecords.english: SWELLOW flies high above our heads,\nmaking graceful arcs in the sky.\nThis POKéMON dives at a steep angle as

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: soon as it spots its prey. The hapless\nprey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW's\nclawed feet, preventing escape.

sourceRecords.japanese: エサや　だいじな　ものを　くちばしに　はさみ\nいろんな　ばしょに　かくす　しゅうせいを　もつ。\nかぜに　のって　すべる　ように　そらを　とぶ。
sourceRecords.english: WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey\nand valuables in its beak and hiding\nthem in all sorts of locations.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON rides the winds and flies\nas if it were skating across the sky.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちいさな　ポケモンや　タマゴを　クチバシに\nいれて　はこぶ　そらの　はこびやだ。\nうみべの　けわしい　がけに　すを　つくる。
sourceRecords.english: PELIPPER is a flying transporter that\ncarries small POKéMON and eggs inside\nits massive bill.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON builds its nest on steep\ncliffs facing the sea.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたまの　ツノで　ひとの　きもちを　かんじとる。\nひとまえには　めったに　すがたを　あらわさないが\nまえむきな　きもちを　キャッチすると　ちかよる。
sourceRecords.english: RALTS senses the emotions of\npeople using the horns on its head.\nThis POKéMON rarely appears before

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: people. But when it does, it draws\ncloser if it senses that the person has\na positive disposition.

sourceRecords.japanese: トレーナーの　あかるい　かんじょうに　ふれている\nキルリアは　うつくしく　せいちょうすると　いう。\nはったつした　のうで　サイコパワーを　あやつる。
sourceRecords.english: It is said that a KIRLIA that is\nexposed to the positive emotions of\nits TRAINER grows beautiful.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON controls psychokinetic\npowers with its highly developed brain.

sourceRecords.japanese: みらいを　よちする　のうりょくで　トレーナーの\nきけんを　さっちしたとき　さいだい　パワーの\nサイコエネルギーを　つかうと　いわれている。
sourceRecords.english: GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the\nfuture. If it senses impending danger\nto its TRAINER, this POKéMON is said to

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: unleash its psychokinetic energy at\nfull power.

sourceRecords.japanese: つまさきから　あぶらが　にじみでて　いるので\nみずの　うえを　すべる　ように　あるけるのだ。\nいけや　みずうみの　びせいぶつを　たべている。
sourceRecords.english: From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT\nsecretes an oil that enables it to walk\non water as if it were skating.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON feeds on microscopic\norganisms in ponds and lakes.

sourceRecords.japanese: しょっかくの　めだま　もようで　てきを　いかく。\n４まいの　はねを　つかい　ヘリコプターの　ように\nくうちゅうで　ぜんごさゆう　じゆうに　すすめる。
sourceRecords.english: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with\nthe eyelike patterns on its antennas.\nThis POKéMON flaps its four wings to

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: freely fly in any direction - even\nsideways and backwards - as if it were\na helicopter.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふかい　もりの　しめった　じめんに　せいそく。\nおちばの　したで　じっとしていることが　おおい。\nおちばが　つもって　できた　ふようどを　たべる。
sourceRecords.english: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark\ndepths of forests. They are often\nfound keeping still under fallen leaves.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON feeds on compost that\nis made up of fallen, rotted leaves.

sourceRecords.japanese: かろやかな　フットワークで　てきに　ちかづき\nのびちぢみする　うでで　パンチを　くりだす。\nボクサー　かおまけの　テクニックの　もちぬし。
sourceRecords.english: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light\nand sprightly footwork, then throws\npunches with its stretchy arms.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's fighting technique puts\nboxers to shame.

sourceRecords.japanese: １にち　２０じかん　いじょう　ねそべっている。\nほとんど　からだを　うごかさないので　はっぱを\n３まい　たべれば　１にちの　しょくじが　おわる。
sourceRecords.english: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty\nhours every day. Because it moves so\nlittle, it does not need much food.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's sole daily meal consists\nof just three leaves.

sourceRecords.japanese: いつも　あばれたくて　ウズウズ　している。\n１ぷんでも　すわっている　ことが　たえられない。\nうごいて　いないと　ストレスが　たまってしまう。
sourceRecords.english: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated\nto go on a wild rampage. It simply can't\ntolerate sitting still for even a minute.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's stress level rises if it\ncan't be moving constantly.

sourceRecords.japanese: １にちじゅう　ねそべったまま　くらす　ポケモン。\nての　とどく　ばしょに　はえている　くさを　たべ\nくさが　なくなると　しぶしぶ　ばしょを　かえる。
sourceRecords.english: SLAKING spends all day lying down and\nlolling about.\nIt eats grass growing within its reach.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If it eats all the grass it can reach,\nthis POKéMON reluctantly moves to\nanother spot.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんねんも　まっくらな　つちの　なかで　くらす。\nきの　ねっこから　えいようを　きゅうしゅうして\nじっと　うごかず　しんかの　ときを　まっている。
sourceRecords.english: NINCADA lives underground for many\nyears in complete darkness.\nThis POKéMON absorbs nutrients from

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: the roots of trees. It stays motionless\nas it waits for evolution.

sourceRecords.japanese: こうそくで　うごきまわり　すがたが　みえない。\nなきごえしか　きこえて　こないので　ながいあいだ\nとうめいな　ポケモンと　かんがえられていた。
sourceRecords.english: NINJASK moves around at such a high\nspeed that it cannot be seen, even\nwhile its crying can be clearly heard.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: For that reason, this POKéMON was long\nbelieved to be invisible.

sourceRecords.japanese: かたい　からだは　ぴくりとも　うごかない。\nせなかから　からだの　くうどうを　のぞくと\nたましいを　すいとられると　しんじられている。
sourceRecords.english: SHEDINJA's hard body doesn't move -\nnot even a twitch. In fact, its body\nappears to be merely a hollow shell.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It is believed that this POKéMON will\nsteal the spirit of anyone peering into\nits hollow body from its back.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふだんは　ちゅういしないと　ききとれない　くらい\nちいさな　こえだが　きけんを　さっち　すると\nずつうを　おこす　ほどの　おおごえで　なきだす。
sourceRecords.english: Normally, WHISMUR's voice is very quiet -\nit is barely audible even if one is\npaying close attention.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: However, if this POKéMON senses danger,\nit starts crying at an earsplitting\nvolume.

sourceRecords.japanese: もくぞうの　いえを　コナゴナに　ふきとばすほどの\nおおごえを　だして　あいてを　いためつける。\nまるい　みみが　スピーカーの　はたらきを　する。
sourceRecords.english: LOUDRED's bellowing can completely\ndecimate a wood-frame house. It uses\nits voice to punish its foes.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's round ears serve as\nloudspeakers.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおごえの　しんどうで　じしんを　おこす。\nからだの　あなから　くうきを　はげしく　すいこみ\nはじめたら　おおごえを　だす　まえぶれだ。
sourceRecords.english: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the\ntremors it creates by bellowing. If this\nPOKéMON violently inhales from the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: ports on its body, it's a sign that it is\npreparing to let loose a huge bellow.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんかい　たおされても　あきらめず　たちあがる。\nたちあがるたび　しんかするための　エネルギーが\nからだの　なかに　どんどん　たくわえられていく。
sourceRecords.english: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep\ngetting up and attacking its foe\nhowever many times it is knocked down.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Every time it gets back up, this\nPOKéMON stores more energy in its body\nfor evolving.

sourceRecords.japanese: いろんな　ばしょで　はりての　けいこに　はげむ。\nきょうれつな　はりて　こうげきを　くらうと\nでんしんばしらも　いちげきで　まっぷたつだ。
sourceRecords.english: HARIYAMA practices its straight-arm\nslaps in any number of locations.\nOne hit of this POKéMON's powerful,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: openhanded, straight-arm punches\ncould snap a telephone pole in two.

sourceRecords.japanese: なげなわの　ようりょうで　しっぽを　ふりまわし\nなげた　ときの　ちからで　とんでいく。\nさいこう　１０メートル　とんだ　きろくが　ある。
sourceRecords.english: AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a\nlasso, then hurls it far. The momentum\nof the throw sends its body flying, too.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Using this unique action, one of these\nPOKéMON managed to hurl itself a record\n33 feet.

sourceRecords.japanese: じしゃくの　はなは　いつも　きたを　むいている。\nノズパスどうしは　じしゃくが　はんぱつしあうため\nちかくで　かおを　あわせる　ことが　できない。
sourceRecords.english: NOSEPASS's magnetic nose is always\npointed to the north. If two of these\nPOKéMON meet, they cannot turn

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: their faces to each other when they\nare close because their magnetic noses\nrepel one another.

sourceRecords.japanese: うごく　ものを　みつけると　むちゅうに　なって\nおいかけまわす　しゅうせいを　もつ　ポケモン。\nじぶんの　シッポを　おいかけて　めを　まわす。
sourceRecords.english: SKITTY has the habit of becoming\nfascinated by moving objects and\nchasing them around.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is known to chase after\nits own tail and become dizzy.

sourceRecords.japanese: マイペースで　じゆうきままな　くらしを　このむ。\nきのむくまま　エサを　たべたり　ねむったり\nしているので　１にちの　リズムが　バラバラだ。
sourceRecords.english: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered\nexistence in which it can do as it\npleases at its own pace.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Because this POKéMON eats and sleeps\nwhenever it decides, its daily routines\nare completely random.

sourceRecords.japanese: どうくつの　おくで　ひっそりと　せいかつする。\nくらやみで　ひとみが　あやしく　かがやく　とき\nひとの　たましいを　うばうと　おそれられている。
sourceRecords.english: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside\ncaverns. They are feared, however,\nbecause these POKéMON are thought to

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: steal the spirits of people when their\neyes burn with a sinister glow in the\ndarkness.

sourceRecords.japanese: はがねの　ツノが　へんけいした　おおきな　あご。\nおとなしそうな　かおに　ゆだんを　していると\nとつぜん　ふりむき　バクリと　かみつかれるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: MAWILE's huge jaws are actually steel\nhorns that have been transformed.\nIts docile-looking face serves to lull

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: its foe into letting down its guard.\nWhen the foe least expects it, MAWILE\nchomps it with its gaping jaws.

sourceRecords.japanese: はがねの　からだを　つくるため　てっこうせきを\nやまから　ほりだして　たべているが　たまに\nはしや　レールを　たべてしまう　こまりものだ。
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON has a body of steel.\nTo make its body, ARON feeds on\niron ore that it digs from mountains.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Occasionally, it causes major trouble by\neating bridges and rails.

sourceRecords.japanese: えいよう　まんてんの　わきみずを　おなかいっぱい\nのむ　ことで　はがねの　からだが　きたえられる。\nおいしい　わきみずの　ちかくに　すを　つくる。
sourceRecords.english: LAIRON tempers its steel body by\ndrinking highly nutritious mineral\nspringwater until it is bloated.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON makes its nest close to\nsprings of delicious water.

sourceRecords.japanese: やま　ひとつを　じぶんの　なわばりに　していて\nあらした　あいては　ようしゃなく　たたきのめす。\nいつも　やまの　なかを　みまわり　している。
sourceRecords.english: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its\nown territory. It mercilessly beats up\nanything that violates its environment.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON vigilantly patrols its\nterritory at all times.

sourceRecords.japanese: やまおくで　ヨガの　しゅぎょうを　している。\nめいそうを　していても　しゅうちゅうりょくが\nとぎれてしまうため　しゅぎょうは　おわらない。
sourceRecords.english: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental\ntraining deep in the mountains.\nHowever, whenever it meditates, this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON always loses its concentration\nand focus. As a result, its training\nnever ends.

sourceRecords.japanese: めいそうする　ことで　からだの　エネルギーが\nたかまり　だい６かんが　するどくなる　という。\nのやまと　いったいになって　けはいを　けす。
sourceRecords.english: It is said that through meditation,\nMEDICHAM heightens energy inside\nits body and sharpens its sixth sense.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON hides its presence by\nmerging itself with fields and\nmountains.

sourceRecords.japanese: ながい　たいもうに　でんきを　ためている。\nでんりゅうで　あしの　きんにくを　しげきして\nばくはつてきな　しゅんぱつりょくを　うみだす。
sourceRecords.english: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its\nlong body hair. This POKéMON stimulates\nits leg muscles with electric charges.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: These jolts of power give its legs\nexplosive acceleration performance.

sourceRecords.japanese: たてがみから　いつも　ほうでんしているため\nひばなで　やまかじを　おこしてしまう　ことも。\nたたかいに　なると　かみなりぐもを　つくりだす。
sourceRecords.english: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging\nelectricity from its mane. The sparks\nsometimes ignite forest fires.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: When it enters a battle, this POKéMON\ncreates thunderclouds.

sourceRecords.japanese: いつも　なかまを　おうえんしている　ポケモン。\nなかまが　がんばると　からだを　ショートさせて\nパチパチと　ひばなの　おとを　たてて　よろこぶ。
sourceRecords.english: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader\nfor its partners. Whenever a teammate\nputs out a good effort in battle, this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON shorts out its body to create\nthe crackling noises of sparks to show\nits joy.

sourceRecords.japanese: じぶんよりも　なかまの　おうえんが　だいじ。\nからだから　はっする　でんきを　ショートさせて\nはでに　ひばなを　だしながら　おうえんするぞ。
sourceRecords.english: MINUN is more concerned about cheering\non its partners than its own safety.\nIt shorts out the electricity in its

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: body to create brilliant showers of\nsparks to cheer on its teammates.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひが　くれると　しっぽから　ひかりを　だして\nあかるさや　てんめつで　なかまと　かいわする。\nイルミーゼの　あまい　かおりに　ひきよせられる。
sourceRecords.english: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits\nlight from its tail. It communicates with\nothers by adjusting the intensity and

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: flashing of its light.\nThis POKéMON is attracted by the sweet\naroma of ILLUMISE.

sourceRecords.japanese: あまい　かおりで　バルビートを　ひきよせる。\nたくさん　あつまった　バルビートを　ゆうどうして\nよぞらに　きかがくてきな　ずけいを　えがくぞ。
sourceRecords.english: ILLUMISE attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT\nusing a sweet fragrance. Once the\nVOLBEAT have gathered, this POKéMON

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: leads the lit-up swarm in drawing\ngeometric designs on the canvas of\nthe night sky.

sourceRecords.japanese: りょうての　はなを　ねらう　あいてには\nするどい　トゲを　とばして　こうげきする。\nはなの　かおりは　きもちを　なごませる。
sourceRecords.english: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as\nprojectiles at any opponent that tries\nto steal the flowers on its arms.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The aroma of this POKéMON brings\nserenity to living things.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　ほとんどが　いぶくろで　できているので\nじぶんと　おなじ　おおきさの　ものも　のみこむ。\nとくしゅな　いえきで　なんでも　しょうかするぞ。
sourceRecords.english: Virtually all of GULPIN's body is its\nstomach. As a result, it can swallow\nsomething its own size.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's stomach contains a\nspecial fluid that digests anything.

sourceRecords.japanese: えものを　みつけると　けあなから　もうどくの\nたいえきを　ふきだして　あびせかけるぞ。\nよわった　ところを　おおきな　くちで　ペロリ。
sourceRecords.english: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out\na hideously toxic fluid from its pores\nand sprays the target.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Once the prey has weakened, this\nPOKéMON gulps it down whole with its\ncavernous mouth.

sourceRecords.japanese: はったつした　アゴと　するどく　とがった　キバは\nふなぞこを　かみちぎる　ほどの　はかいりょく。\nキバニアに　おそわれ　しずんだ　ふねは　おおい。
sourceRecords.english: CARVANHA's strongly developed jaws\nand its sharply pointed fangs pack the\ndestructive power to rip out boat hulls.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Many boats have been attacked and\nsunk by this POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: うみのギャングと　よばれ　おそれられている。\nおれても　すぐに　はえかわる　キバを　もち\nおおがたタンカーも　１ぴきで　バラバラに　する。
sourceRecords.english: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,”\nSHARPEDO is widely feared.\nIts cruel fangs grow back immediately

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: if they snap off.\nJust one of these POKéMON can\nthoroughly tear apart a supertanker.

sourceRecords.japanese: めの　うえに　ついている　はなの　あなから\nからだに　ためた　かいすいを　ふきだし\nひとを　おどろかすのが　だいすきな　ポケモンだ。
sourceRecords.english: WAILMER's nostrils are located above\nits eyes. This playful POKéMON loves\nto startle people by forcefully snorting

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: out seawater it stores inside its body\nout of its nostrils.

sourceRecords.japanese: みつかった　なかでは　さいだいの　ポケモン。\nおおうなばらを　ゆったりと　およぎ　おおきな\nくちで　いっきに　たいりょうの　エサを　たべる。
sourceRecords.english: WAILORD is the largest of all identified\nPOKéMON up to now.\nThis giant POKéMON swims languorously

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: in the vast open sea, eating massive\namounts of food at once with its\nenormous mouth.

sourceRecords.japanese: たたかれても　きが　つかない　にぶさ　だが\nくうふくは　１びょうでも　がまん　できない。\nからだの　なかでは　マグマが　にえたぎっている。
sourceRecords.english: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it\ndoesn't notice being hit. However, it\ncan't stand hunger for even a second.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's body is a seething\ncauldron of boiling magma.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　なかに　かざんを　もつ　ポケモンだ。\nからだに　たまった　せっし　１まんどの　マグマを\nときどき　せなかの　コブから　ふきあげている。
sourceRecords.english: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body.\nMagma of 18,000 degrees F courses\nthrough its body.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Occasionally, the humps on this\nPOKéMON's back erupt, spewing the\nsuperheated magma.

sourceRecords.japanese: やまを　ほって　せきたんを　みつけては　せっせと\nこうらの　くうどうに　いれて　もやす　ポケモン。\nおそわれると　くろい　けむりを　だして　にげる。
sourceRecords.english: TORKOAL digs through mountains in\nsearch of coal. If it finds some, it fills\nhollow spaces on its shell with the coal

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: and burns it.\nIf it is attacked, this POKéMON spouts\nthick black smoke to beat a retreat.

sourceRecords.japanese: シッポで　びょんびょん　とびはねる　ポケモン。\nとびはねる　しんどうで　しんぞうを　うごかして\nいるので　とびはねる　ことは　やめられないのだ。
sourceRecords.english: SPOINK bounces around on its tail.\nThe shock of its bouncing makes its\nheart pump. As a result, this POKéMON

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it\nstops, its heart will stop.

sourceRecords.japanese: サイコパワーの　はどうを　くろしんじゅで　つよめ\nじゆうじざいに　あいてを　あやつる　ポケモン。\nちからを　つかうとき　はないきが　あらくなるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its\nbody to amplify its psychic power waves\nfor gaining total control over its foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: When this POKéMON uses its special\npower, its snorting breath grows\nlabored.

sourceRecords.japanese: よのなかに　いる　パッチールは　みんな　ちがう\nところに　ブチもようが　あると　いわれている。\nおぼつかない　あゆみが　おどりのように　みえる。
sourceRecords.english: All the SPINDA that exist in the\nworld are said to have utterly unique\nspot patterns.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The shaky, tottering steps of this\nPOKéMON give it the appearance of\ndancing.

sourceRecords.japanese: すりばちじょうの　すあなの　そこで　じっと\nえものが　おちて　くるのを　まちつづけている。\nおおきな　アゴは　いわをも　くだく　いりょく。
sourceRecords.english: TRAPINCH's nest is a sloped, bowl-like\npit dug in sand. This POKéMON patiently\nwaits for prey to tumble down the pit.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Its giant jaws have enough strength\nto crush even boulders.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２まいの　ハネを　はげしく　しんどうさせて\nちょうおんぱを　だし　えものを　きぜつさせる。\nにんげんも　ずつうを　おこす　ほどの　いりょく。
sourceRecords.english: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates\nultrasonic waves by vigorously making\nits two wings vibrate.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's ultrasonic waves are so\npowerful, they can bring on headaches\nin people.

sourceRecords.japanese: さばくの　せいれいと　よばれる　ポケモン。\nハネの　はばたきで　すなを　まいあげるため\nとんでいる　ときは　いつも　すなあらしの　なか。
sourceRecords.english: FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental \nspirit of the desert.” Because its\nflapping wings whip up a cloud of sand,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: this POKéMON is always enveloped in a\nsandstorm while flying.

sourceRecords.japanese: さばく　など　かんそうした　ちいきに　せいそく。\nつよい　はなの　かおりで　えものを　さそいこみ\nするどい　からだの　トゲを　とばして　しとめる。
sourceRecords.english: CACNEA lives in arid locations such\nas deserts. It releases a strong aroma\nfrom its flower to attract prey.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: When prey comes near, this POKéMON\nshoots sharp thorns from its body to\nbring the victim down.

sourceRecords.japanese: さばくの　ひざしで　すいぶんを　うしなわない\nように　ひるまは　じっと　たちつくしている。\nきおんの　さがる　よるに　かつどうを　はじめる。
sourceRecords.english: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains\nunmoving so that it does not lose any\nmoisture to the harsh desert sun.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON becomes active at night\nwhen the temperature drops.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたぐもの　ような　ふさふさの　つばさを　もつ。\nひとを　こわがらず　わたの　ぼうし　みたいに\nあたまに　ちょこんと　のっかる　ポケモンだ。
sourceRecords.english: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that\nare like cottony clouds. This POKéMON\nis not frightened of people.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It lands on the heads of people and\nsits there like a cotton-fluff hat.

sourceRecords.japanese: わたぐもに　まぎれて　おおぞらを　まう。\nすきとおった　こえで　メロディを　さえずれば\nみみにした　ものは　うっとり　ゆめごこち。
sourceRecords.english: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the\nsky among billowing, cotton-like clouds.\nBy singing melodies in its crystal-clear

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: voice, this POKéMON makes its listeners\nexperience dreamy wonderment.

sourceRecords.japanese: しゅくてき　ハブネークとの　たたかいの　きおくが\nからだじゅうの　さいぼうに　きざみこまれている。\nびんしょうな　みのこなしで　こうげきを　かわす。
sourceRecords.english: Memories of battling its arch-rival\nSEVIPER are etched into every cell of\nZANGOOSE's body.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON adroitly dodges attacks\nwith incredible agility.

sourceRecords.japanese: せんぞだいだい　ザングースと　たたかってきた。\nからだの　キズは　はげしい　たたかいの　しるし。\nするどい　きれあじの　しっぽで　こうげきするぞ。
sourceRecords.english: SEVIPER shares a generations-long\nfeud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its\nbody are evidence of vicious battles.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON attacks using its sword-\nedged tail.

sourceRecords.japanese: いんせきの　おちた　ばしょから　みつかったため\nうちゅうから　やってきた　ポケモンという　せつも\nあるが　まだ　しょうめいされていない。
sourceRecords.english: LUNATONE was discovered at a location\nwhere a meteorite fell. As a result, some\npeople theorize that this POKéMON

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: came from space. However, no one has\nbeen able to prove this theory so far.

sourceRecords.japanese: うちゅうから　おちてきたと　いわれる　しんしゅ。\nくうちゅうに　うかび　おともなく　いどうする。\nたたかいに　なると　つよい　ひかりを　はなつ。
sourceRecords.english: SOLROCK is a new species of POKéMON\nthat is said to have fallen from space.\nIt floats in air and moves silently.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: In battle, this POKéMON releases\nintensely bright light.

sourceRecords.japanese: びんかんな　ヒゲは　すぐれた　レーダーだ。\nドロの　なかから　２ほんの　ヒゲだけを　だして\nえものが　ちかよってくるのを　まちかまえている。
sourceRecords.english: BARBOACH's sensitive whiskers serve\nas a superb radar system.\nThis POKéMON hides in mud, leaving only

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: its two whiskers exposed while it waits\nfor prey to come along.

sourceRecords.japanese: なわばり　いしきが　とても　つよい　ポケモン。\nおおきな　ぬま　ぜんぶを　なわばりに　している。\nてきが　ちかづくと　あばれて　じしんを　おこす。
sourceRecords.english: WHISCASH is extremely territorial.\nJust one of these POKéMON will claim a\nlarge pond as its exclusive territory.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If a foe approaches it, it thrashes\nabout and triggers a massive\nearthquake.

sourceRecords.japanese: もともと　がいこくに　すんでいた　ポケモンを\nペットとして　つれてきた　ものが　やせいかした。\nせいめいりょくが　つよいので　どんどん　ふえた。
sourceRecords.english: CORPHISH were originally foreign\nPOKéMON that were imported as pets.\nThey eventually turned up in the wild.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is very hardy and has\ngreatly increased its population.

sourceRecords.japanese: すぐに　たたかいを　いどむ　きしょうの　あらさ。\nシザリガーの　すむ　いけには　ほかの　いきものが\nすみつかず　さみしい　ばしょに　なってしまう。
sourceRecords.english: CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent\nnature that compels it to challenge\nother living things to battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Other life-forms refuse to live in\nponds inhabited by this POKéMON,\nmaking them desolate places.

sourceRecords.japanese: いっぽんあしで　かいてん　しながら　いどうする。\nヤジロンと　にんげんが　いっしょに　くらす\nこだいの　へきがが　いせきから　はっけんされた。
sourceRecords.english: BALTOY moves while spinning around on\nits one foot. Primitive wall paintings\ndepicting this POKéMON living among

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: people were discovered in some ancient\nruins.

sourceRecords.japanese: こだいじんの　どろにんぎょうが　かいこうせんを\nあびて　せいめいを　やどしたと　いわれている。\nくうちゅうに　ういて　いどうしている。
sourceRecords.english: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made\nby primitive humans and brought to life\nby exposure to a mysterious ray.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
やく　１おくねんまえに　ぜつめつした　ポケモン。\nかいていの　いわに　くっつき　はなびらの　ような\nしょくしゅで　よってきた　えものを　つかまえる。
sourceRecords.english: LILEEP became extinct approximately\na hundred million years ago.\nThis ancient POKéMON attaches itself

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: to a rock on the seafloor and catches\napproaching prey using tentacles \nshaped like flower petals.

sourceRecords.japanese: うみの　そこで　エサを　さがして　あるきまわる。\nきの　えだの　ような　くびを　じざいに　のばして\n８まいの　しょくしゅで　えものを　つかまえる。
sourceRecords.english: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor\nin search of food. This POKéMON freely\nextends its tree trunk-like neck and

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: captures unwary prey using its eight\ntentacles.

sourceRecords.japanese: たいこの　かせきから　よみがえった　ポケモン。\nあたたかい　うみに　せいそくし　はったつした\n２ほんの　ツメで　えものを　がっちり　つかむ。
sourceRecords.english: ANORITH was regenerated from a\nprehistoric fossil. This primitive\nPOKéMON once lived in warm seas.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It grips its prey firmly between its\ntwo large claws.

sourceRecords.japanese: こうらは　あらゆる　こうげきを　はねかえす。\nのび　ちぢみする　きょだいな　２ほんの　ツメは\nてっぱんを　くしざしにする　ほどの　いりょくだ。
sourceRecords.english: ARMALDO's tough armor makes all attacks\nbounce off. This POKéMON's two\nenormous claws can be freely extended

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: or contracted. They have the power to\npunch right through a steel slab.

sourceRecords.japanese: うまれつき　ヒレが　ボロボロで　みっともないため\nだれにも　あいてに　されない　ポケモンだ。\nうみと　かわの　どちらでも　せいかつできる。
sourceRecords.english: FEEBAS's fins are ragged and\ntattered from the start of its life.\nBecause of its shoddy appearance, this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON is largely ignored.\nIt is capable of living in both the sea\nand in rivers.

sourceRecords.japanese: もっとも　うつくしい　ポケモンと　いわれている。\nいかりや　にくしみの　こころを　いやして\nあらそいを　しずめる　ちからを　もっている。
sourceRecords.english: MILOTIC is said to be the most\nbeautiful of all the POKéMON.\nIt has the power to becalm such

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: emotions as anger and hostility to quell\nbitter feuding.

sourceRecords.japanese: てんきに　よって　すがたが　かわる　ポケモン。\nちいさい　からだを　まもる　ために　だいしぜんの\nおおきな　パワーを　つかえる　ように　なった。
sourceRecords.english: CASTFORM's appearance changes with\nthe weather.\nThis POKéMON gained the ability to use

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: the vast power of nature to protect\nits tiny body.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　いろを　じざいに　かえる　ことで\nまわりの　けしきに　とけこむ　ことが　できる。\nおなかの　ギザギザもよう　だけは　かえられない。
sourceRecords.english: KECLEON is capable of changing its body\ncolors at will to blend in with its\nsurroundings.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: There is one exception - this POKéMON\ncan't change the zigzag pattern on its\nbelly.

sourceRecords.japanese: ねたみ　うらみの　かんじょうに　ひきよせられる。\nだれかを　うらむ　こころが　つよく　なると\nカゲボウズが　のきしたに　ずらりと　ならぶぞ。
sourceRecords.english: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings\nof jealousy and vindictiveness.\nIf someone develops strong feelings of

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: vengeance, this POKéMON will appear\nin a swarm and line up beneath the eaves\nof that person's home.

sourceRecords.japanese: じぶんの　からだを　はりで　キズつける　とき\nつよい　のろいの　エネルギーが　はっせいする。\nもとは　すてられた　かわいそうな　ぬいぐるみ。
sourceRecords.english: BANETTE generates energy for laying\nstrong curses by sticking pins into its\nown body.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON was originally a pitiful\nplush doll that was thrown away.

sourceRecords.japanese: どんなに　あつい　カベも　とおりぬける。\nねらわれたら　さいご　あさひが　のぼるまで\nずっと　おいかけられる　ことに　なるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no\nmatter how thick it may be.\nOnce this POKéMON chooses a target,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: it will doggedly pursue the intended\nvictim until the break of dawn.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　なかみは　くうどうで　なにも　ない。\nブラックホールの　ように　なんでも　すいこみ\nすいこまれると　もどって　これないと　いわれる。
sourceRecords.english: DUSCLOPS's body is completely hollow -\nthere is nothing at all inside.\nIt is said that its body is like a black

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: hole. This POKéMON will absorb anything\ninto its body, but nothing will ever come\nback out.

sourceRecords.japanese: くびの　フサは　あまくて　こどもに　だいにんき。\nくだものが　だいこうぶつで　たべつづけて　いたら\nくびに　くだものが　できるように　なったらしい。
sourceRecords.english: The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS's\nneck are very popular with children.\nThis POKéMON loves fruit, and eats it

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: continuously. Apparently, its love for\nfruit resulted in its own outgrowth\nof fruit.

sourceRecords.japanese: こえを　からだの　くうどうに　はんきょうさせる。\nおこった　ときの　なきごえは　てきを　ふきとばす\nいりょくを　もった　ちょうおんぱに　なるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo\ninside its hollow body. When this\nPOKéMON becomes enraged, its cries

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: result in ultrasonic waves that have\nthe power to knock foes flying.

sourceRecords.japanese: アブソルが　ひとまえに　あらわれると　かならず\nじしんや　つなみなどの　さいがいが　おこったので\nわざわいポケモン　という　べつめいで　よばれた。
sourceRecords.english: Every time ABSOL appears before people,\nit is followed by a disaster such as an\nearthquake or a tidal wave.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: As a result, it came to be known as the\ndisaster POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: いつも　ニコニコ　えがおの　ソーナノ。\nおこっているときは　しっぽに　ちゅうもく。\nじめんを　パタパタ　たたいているぞ。
sourceRecords.english: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big,\nhappy smile on its face. Look at its tail\nto determine if it is angry.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: When angered, this POKéMON will be\nslapping the ground with its tail.

sourceRecords.japanese: ゆきの　おおい　とちで　くらす　ポケモン。\nはるや　なつの　ゆきの　ふらない　きせつには\nしょうにゅうどうの　おくで　しずかに　くらす。
sourceRecords.english: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy\nsnowfall. In seasons without snow, such\nas spring and summer, this POKéMON

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: steals away to live quietly among\nstalactites and stalagmites deep in\ncaverns.

sourceRecords.japanese: いわの　からだを　こおりの　よろいで　かためた。\nくうきちゅうの　すいぶんを　こおらせて　じゆうな\nかたちに　かえる　のうりょくを　もつ　ポケモン。
sourceRecords.english: GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it\nhardens with an armor of ice.\nThis POKéMON has the ability to freeze

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: moisture in the atmosphere into any\nshape it desires.

sourceRecords.japanese: あるくより　ころがる　ほうが　だんぜん　はやい。\nしょくじの　じかんは　みんなが　いっせいに　てを\nたたいて　よろこぶので　けっこう　うるさいのだ。
sourceRecords.english: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than \nwalking to get around. When groups of\nthis POKéMON eat, they all clap at once

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: to show their pleasure. Because of this,\ntheir mealtimes are noisy.

sourceRecords.japanese: はじめて　めにした　ものは　かならず　はなで\nクルクル　まわしてみる　しゅうせいを　もつ。\nタマザラシを　まわして　あそぶ　ことが　ある。
sourceRecords.english: SEALEO has the habit of always juggling\non the tip of its nose anything it sees\nfor the first time.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON occasionally entertains\nitself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL\non its nose.

sourceRecords.japanese: はったつした　２ほんの　キバは　１０トンも　ある\nひょうざんを　いちげきで　ふんさいする。\nしぼうが　ぶあつく　ひょうてんかでも　へいき。
sourceRecords.english: WALREIN's two massively developed\ntusks can totally shatter blocks of\nice weighing ten tons with one blow.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's thick coat of blubber\ninsulates it from subzero temperatures.

sourceRecords.japanese: がんじょうな　カラは　みを　まもる　だけではなく\nえものを　はさんで　つかまえる　ことも　できる。\nそだった　パールルの　かいがらは　キズだらけ。
sourceRecords.english: CLAMPERL's sturdy shell is not only good\nfor protection - it is also used for\nclamping and catching prey.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: A fully grown CLAMPERL's shell will be\nscored with nicks and scratches all\nover.

sourceRecords.japanese: とても　ふかい　うみの　そこに　すんでいるため\nながい　あいだ　ひとに　みつからなかった。\nくらい　しんかいでも　よく　みえる　めを　もつ。
sourceRecords.english: HUNTAIL's presence went unnoticed by\npeople for a long time because it lives\nat extreme depths in the sea.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's eyes can see clearly\neven in the murky dark depths of the\nocean.

sourceRecords.japanese: みなみの　しんかいに　せいそくする　ポケモン。\nしんかいの　すいあつに　きたえられた　からだは\nちょっとの　こうげきでは　キズも　つかない。
sourceRecords.english: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas\nat extreme depths. Its body is built to\nwithstand the enormous pressure of

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: water at incredible depths. Because of\nthis, this POKéMON's body is unharmed\nby ordinary attacks.

sourceRecords.japanese: １おくねんの　ながい　あいだ　まったく　すがたが\nかわらずに　しんかいで　くらしていた　ポケモン。\nはの　ない　くちで　びせいぶつだけを　たべる。
sourceRecords.english: RELICANTH is a POKéMON species that\nexisted for a hundred million years\nwithout ever changing its form.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This ancient POKéMON feeds on\nmicroscopic organisms with its\ntoothless mouth.

sourceRecords.japanese: ねったいの　あさい　うみで　くらしている。\nカップルを　みつけると　うしろに　くっついて\nおよぐ　ことから　この　なまえが　つけられた。
sourceRecords.english: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the\ntropics. This heart-shaped POKéMON\nearned its name by swimming after

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: loving couples it spotted in the\nocean's waves.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおぞらを　とぶことを　ゆめみて　くりかえし\nだんがいから　とびおりている　うちに　あたまが\nきたえられ　こうてつの　ように　かたく　なった。
sourceRecords.english: BAGON has a dream of one day soaring\nin the sky. In doomed efforts to fly,\nthis POKéMON hurls itself off cliffs.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: As a result of its dives, its head has \ngrown tough and as hard as tempered\nsteel.

sourceRecords.japanese: かたい　カラの　ないぶは　さいぼうが　へんかして\nあたらしい　からだを　つくっている　さいちゅう。\nカラが　とても　おもいので　うごきは　にぶいぞ。
sourceRecords.english: Inside SHELGON's armor-like shell, cells\nare in the midst of transformation\nto create an entirely new body.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's shell is extremely heavy,\nmaking its movements sluggish.

sourceRecords.japanese: つばさが　ほしいと　つよく　おもい　つづけてきた\nけっか　からだの　さいぼうが　とつぜんへんいを\nおこし　みごとな　つばさが　はえてきたと　いう。
sourceRecords.english: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a\nstrong, long-held dream of growing\nwings. It is said that this powerful

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: desire triggered a sudden mutation in\nthis POKéMON's cells, causing it to\nsprout its magnificent wings.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　なかでは　けつえきの　かわりに\nきょうりょくな　じりょくが　めぐっている。\nじりょくの　はどうで　なかまと　かいわする。
sourceRecords.english: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic\nforce courses throughout BELDUM's\nbody. This POKéMON communicates with

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: others by sending controlled pulses of\nmagnetism.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２ひきの　ダンバルが　がったいした　すがた。\n２つの　のうを　じりょくの　しんけいが　むすぶ\nことで　つよい　サイコエネルギーを　うみだす。
sourceRecords.english: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG\nis formed. The brains of the BELDUM are\njoined by a magnetic nervous system.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: By linking its brains magnetically,\nthis POKéMON generates strong\npsychokinetic power.

sourceRecords.japanese: ４つの　のうみそは　スーパーコンピュータよりも\nはやく　むずかしい　けいさんの　こたえを　だす。\n４ほんあしを　おりたたみ　くうちゅうに　うかぶ。
sourceRecords.english: METAGROSS has four brains in total.\nCombined, the four brains can breeze\nthrough difficult calculations faster

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: than a supercomputer.\nThis POKéMON can float in the air by\ntucking in its four legs.

sourceRecords.japanese: むかし　ひとに　ふういんされた　ポケモン。\nたたかいで　からだが　くずれると　じぶんで\nあたらしい　いわを　さがして　なおすと　いう。
sourceRecords.english: REGIROCK was sealed away by people\nlong ago. If this POKéMON's body is\ndamaged in battle, it is said to seek

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: out suitable rocks on its own to repair\nitself.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひょうがじだいに　つくられた　こおりの　からだは\nほのおでも　とかす　ことが　できない。\nマイナス　２００どの　れいきを　あやつる。
sourceRecords.english: REGICE's body was made during an ice\nage. The deep-frozen body can't be\nmelted, even by fire.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON controls frigid air of\nminus 328 degrees F.

sourceRecords.japanese: どんな　きんぞくよりも　かたい　からだを　もつ。\nからだの　なかは　くうどうに　なっているらしく\nたべている　ものも　わからない　ポケモンだ。
sourceRecords.english: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder\nthan any kind of metal.\nIts body is apparently hollow.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: No one has any idea what this POKéMON\neats.

sourceRecords.japanese: にんげんの　こころを　びんかんに　かんじとる。\nてきいを　キャッチすると　ぜんしんの　はねを\nさかだてて　はげしく　なきごえで　いかくする。
sourceRecords.english: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the\nemotions of people. If it senses any\nhostility, this POKéMON ruffles the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: feathers all over its body and cries\nshrilly to intimidate the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: みた　ものや　かんがえた　イメージを　あいてに\nえいぞうとして　みせる　のうりょくを　もつ。\nにんげんの　ことばを　りかいすることが　できる。
sourceRecords.english: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe\nsee an image of what it has seen or\nimagines in its head.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is intelligent and\nunderstands human speech.

sourceRecords.japanese: そら　いちめんを　おおう　あまぐもを　つくりだし\nおおあめを　ふらせる　ちからを　もつ　ポケモン。\nかんばつに　くるしむ　ひとびとを　すくった。
sourceRecords.english: KYOGRE has the power to create massive\nrain clouds that cover the entire sky\nand bring about torrential downpours.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON saved people who were\nsuffering from droughts.

sourceRecords.japanese: だいちを　もりあげて　たいりくを　ひろげた\nポケモンと　しんわで　かたり　つがれている。\nカイオーガと　しとうの　すえ　ねむりに　ついた。
sourceRecords.english: GROUDON has long been described in \nmythology as the POKéMON that raised\nlands and expanded continents.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON took to sleep after a\ncataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんおくねんも　オゾンそうの　なかを　とびつづけ\nけっして　ちじょうには　おりてこない　ポケモン。\nくうきちゅうの　チリと　みずを　たべるらしい。
sourceRecords.english: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions\nof years in the earth's ozone layer, \nnever descending to the ground.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON appears to feed on water\nand particles in the atmosphere.

sourceRecords.japanese: めざめた　とき　あたまの　たんざくに　かかれた\nねがいを　かなえると　いう　でんせつを　もつ。\nきけんを　かんじると　ねむったまま　たたかう。
sourceRecords.english: A legend states that JIRACHI will make\ntrue any wish that is written on notes\nattached to its head when it awakens.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If this POKéMON senses danger, it will\nfight without awakening.

sourceRecords.japanese: レーザーを　あびた　うちゅうウィルスの　ＤＮＡが\nとつぜんへんいを　おこして　うまれた　ポケモン。\nむねの　すいしょうたいが　のうみそ　らしい。
sourceRecords.english: The DNA of a space virus underwent a\nsudden mutation upon exposure to a\nlaser beam and resulted in DEOXYS.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The crystalline organ on this POKéMON's\nchest appears to be its brain.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたらしく　はっけんされたポケモン\nげんざい　ちょうさちゅう
sourceRecords.english: This is a newly discovered POKéMON.\nIt is currently under investigation.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: No detailed information is available\nat this time.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひなたで　ひるねを　する　すがたを　みかける。\nたいようの　ひかりを　いっぱい　あびることで\nせなかの　タネが　おおきく　そだつのだ。
sourceRecords.english: BULBASAUR can be seen napping in\nbright sunlight.\nThere is a seed on its back.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed\ngrows progressively larger.

sourceRecords.japanese: つぼみを　ささえるため　あしこしが　つよくなる。\nひなたで　じっとする　じかんが　ながくなれば\nいよいよ　たいりんの　はなが　さくころだ。
sourceRecords.english: There is a bud on this POKéMON's back.\nTo support its weight, IVYSAUR's legs\nand trunk grow thick and strong.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If it starts spending more time lying\nin the sunlight, it's a sign that the\nbud will bloom into a large flower soon.

sourceRecords.japanese: じゅうぶんな　えいようと　たいようの　ひかりが\nはなの　いろを　あざやかに　すると　いわれる。\nはなの　かおりは　ひとの　こころを　いやす。
sourceRecords.english: There is a large flower on VENUSAUR's\nback. The flower is said to take on vivid\ncolors if it gets plenty of nutrition

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: and sunlight. The flower's aroma\nsoothes the emotions of people.

sourceRecords.japanese: しっぽの　ほのおは　きぶんを　ひょうげん。\nたのしい　ときには　ゆらゆら　ほのおが　ゆれて\nおこった　ときには　めらめら　さかんに　もえる。
sourceRecords.english: The flame that burns at the tip of its\ntail is an indication of its emotions.\nThe flame wavers when CHARMANDER is

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: enjoying itself. If the POKéMON becomes\nenraged, the flame burns fiercely.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどい　ツメで　ようしゃなく　たたきのめす。\nきょうてきと　むかいあうと　きぶんが　たかぶり\nしっぽの　ほのおが　あおじろく　もえあがる。
sourceRecords.english: CHARMELEON mercilessly destroys its\nfoes using its sharp claws.\nIf it encounters a strong foe, it turns

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: aggressive. In this excited state, the\nflame at the tip of its tail flares with a\nbluish white color.

sourceRecords.japanese: つよい　あいてを　もとめて　そらを　とびまわる。\nなんでも　とかして　しまう　こうねつの　ほのおを\nじぶんより　よわいものに　むけることは　しない。
sourceRecords.english: CHARIZARD flies around the sky in\nsearch of powerful opponents.\nIt breathes fire of such great heat

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: that it melts anything. However, it\nnever turns its fiery breath on any\nopponent weaker than itself.

sourceRecords.japanese: こうらの　やくめは　みを　まもる　だけではない。\nまるい　かたちと　ひょうめんの　みぞが　みずの\nていこうを　へらすので　はやく　およげるのだ。
sourceRecords.english: SQUIRTLE's shell is not merely used\nfor protection.\nThe shell's rounded shape and the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: grooves on its surface help minimize\nresistance in water, enabling this\nPOKéMON to swim at high speeds.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふさふさの　けで　おおわれた　おおきな　しっぽは\nながいき　するほど　ふかい　いろあいに　かわる。\nこうらの　キズは　つわものの　あかし。
sourceRecords.english: Its tail is large and covered with a rich,\nthick fur. The tail becomes increasingly\ndeeper in color as WARTORTLE ages.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The scratches on its shell are evidence\nof this POKéMON's toughness as a\nbattler.

sourceRecords.japanese: こうらの　ふんしゃこうの　ねらいは　せいかく。\nみずの　だんがんを　５０メートル　はなれた\nあきかんに　めいちゅうさせる　ことが　できるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: BLASTOISE has water spouts that\nprotrude from its shell. The water\nspouts are very accurate.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: They can shoot bullets of water with\nenough accuracy to strike empty cans\nfrom a distance of over 160 feet.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだ　よりも　おおきな　はっぱを　みるみる\nたべつくして　しまうほどの　しょくよくを　もつ。\nしょっかくから　きょうれつな　においを　だすぞ。
sourceRecords.english: CATERPIE has a voracious appetite.\nIt can devour leaves bigger than its\nbody right before your eyes.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: From its antenna, this POKéMON releases\na terrifically strong odor.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　カラは　てっぱんの　ように　かたい。\nあまり　うごかないのは　カラのなかで　やわらかい\nなかみが　しんかの　じゅんびを　しているからだ。
sourceRecords.english: The shell covering this POKéMON's body\nis as hard as an iron slab.\nMETAPOD does not move very much.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It stays still because it is preparing\nits soft innards for evolution inside\nthe hard shell.

sourceRecords.japanese: おいしい　はなの　ミツを　さがす　のうりょくに\nすぐれ　すみかから　１０キロはなれた　ばしょに\nさく　はなから　ミツを　あつめて　はこんでいる。
sourceRecords.english: BUTTERFREE has a superior ability to\nsearch for delicious honey from\nflowers.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It can even search out, extract, and\ncarry honey from flowers that are\nblooming over six miles from its nest.

sourceRecords.japanese: とても　するどい　きゅうかくを　もっている。\nこうぶつの　はっぱか　きらいな　はっぱか\nおおきな　あかい　はなで　かぎわける。
sourceRecords.english: WEEDLE has an extremely acute sense\nof smell.\nIt is capable of distinguishing its

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: favorite kinds of leaves from those it\ndislikes just by sniffing with its big\nred proboscis (nose).

sourceRecords.japanese: ほとんど　うごかず　きに　つかまっているが\nなかでは　しんかの　じゅんびで　おおいそがし。\nその　しょうこに　からだが　あつくなっているぞ。
sourceRecords.english: KAKUNA remains virtually immobile as it\nclings to a tree. However, on the\ninside, it is extremely busy as it

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: prepares for its coming evolution.\nThis is evident from how hot the shell\nbecomes to the touch.

sourceRecords.japanese: なわばりいしきが　とても　つよいので　スピアーの\nすみかには　ちかづかない　ほうが　みの　ためだ。\nおこると　しゅうだんで　おそって　くるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: BEEDRILL is extremely territorial.\nNo one should ever approach its nest -\nthis is for their own safety.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If angered, they will attack in a furious\nswarm.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほうこう　かんかくに　とても　すぐれているので\nどんなに　はなれた　ばしょからでも　まよわずに\nじぶんの　す　まで　かえる　ことが　できる。
sourceRecords.english: PIDGEY has an extremely sharp sense\nof direction.\nIt is capable of unerringly returning

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: home to its nest, however far it may be\nremoved from its familiar surroundings.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひろい　なわばりを　とんで　みまわりを　する。\nなわばりを　あらす　あいては　ようしゃ　しない。\nするどい　ツメで　てっていてきに　こらしめるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: PIDGEOTTO claims a large area as its\nown territory. This POKéMON flies\naround, patrolling its living space.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If its territory is violated, it shows\nno mercy in thoroughly punishing the\nfoe with its sharp claws.

sourceRecords.japanese: うつくしい　こうたくの　はねを　もつ　ポケモン。\nあたまの　はねの　うつくしさに　こころ　うばわれ\nピジョットを　そだてる　トレーナーも　おおい。
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON has a dazzling plumage of\nbeautifully glossy feathers.\nMany TRAINERS are captivated by the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: striking beauty of the feathers on its\nhead, compelling them to choose PIDGEOT\nas their POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: けいかいしんが　とても　つよく　ねている　ときも\nみみを　うごかし　まわりの　おとを　きいている。\nどこにでも　すみつき　す　を　つくる。
sourceRecords.english: RATTATA is cautious in the extreme.\nEven while it is asleep, it constantly\nlistens by moving its ears around.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It is not picky about where it lives -\nit will make its nest anywhere.

sourceRecords.japanese: じょうぶな　キバは　どんどん　のびるので\nいわや　たいぼくを　かじって　けずっている。\nいえの　カベを　かじられる　ことも　あるよ。
sourceRecords.english: RATICATE's sturdy fangs grow steadily.\nTo keep them ground down, it gnaws\non rocks and logs.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It may even chew on the walls of\nhouses.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおきな　なきごえは　１キロ　さきまで　とどく。\nあちこちで　カンだかい　こえが　きこえる　ときは\nなかまたちに　きけんを　しらせている　あいずだ。
sourceRecords.english: SPEAROW has a very loud cry that can\nbe heard over half a mile away.\nIf its high, keening cry is heard

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: echoing all around, it is a sign that\nthey are warning each other of danger.

sourceRecords.japanese: ながい　くびと　くちばしは　つちや　みずの\nなかに　いる　エサを　つかまえるのに　べんり。\nほそながい　くちばしで　きように　つまむぞ。
sourceRecords.english: FEAROW is recognized by its long neck\nand elongated beak.\nThey are conveniently shaped for

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: catching prey in soil or water.\nIt deftly moves its long and skinny\nbeak to pluck prey.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぐるぐる　からだを　まいて　やすんでいるのは\nどの　ほうこうから　てきが　おそってきても\nとっさに　あたまを　むけて　いかくできるからだ。
sourceRecords.english: EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while\nit rests.\nAssuming this position allows it to

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: quickly respond to a threat from any\ndirection with a glare from its upraised\nhead.

sourceRecords.japanese: しめつける　ちからは　とても　きょうりょく。\nドラムかんも　ぺしゃんこに　してしまうぞ。\nまきつかれたら　にげだす　ことは　ふかのうだ。
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is terrifically strong in\norder to constrict things with its body.\nIt can even flatten steel oil drums.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Once ARBOK wraps its body around its\nfoe, escaping its crunching embrace is\nimpossible.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほっぺの　でんきぶくろの　でんきは　まよなか\nねている　あいだに　ためられている　らしいよ。\nねぼけて　ほうでんしてしまう　ことが　ある。
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON has electricity-storing\npouches on its cheeks. These appear to\nbecome electrically charged during the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: night while PIKACHU sleeps.\nIt occasionally discharges electricity\nwhen it is dozy after waking up.

sourceRecords.japanese: よわい　でんきを　ぜんしんから　だしているので\nくらやみでは　うっすら　ひかって　みえるよ。\nシッポを　じめんに　さして　でんきを　にがす。
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON exudes a weak electrical\ncharge from all over its body that makes\nit take on a slight glow in darkness.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: RAICHU searches for electricity by\nplanting its tail in the ground.

sourceRecords.japanese: からからに　かわいた　ひふは　とても　かたく\nまるくなると　どんな　こうげきでも　はねかえす。\nよなかは　さばくの　すなに　もぐって　ねむる。
sourceRecords.english: SANDSHREW has a very dry hide that is\nextremely tough. The POKéMON can roll\ninto a ball that repels any attack.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: At night, it burrows into the desert\nsand to sleep.

sourceRecords.japanese: せなかを　まるめると　トゲトゲの　ボールみたい。\nトゲに　さされて　ひるんだ　あいてに　とびかかり\nするどい　ツメで　ばりばり　ひっかきまくるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: SANDSLASH can roll up its body as if it\nwere a ball covered with large spikes.\nIn battle, this POKéMON will try to make

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: the foe flinch by jabbing it with its\nspines. It then leaps at the stunned\nfoe to tear wildly with its sharp claws.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちいさい　からだを　まもるため　きょうりょくな\nどくばりが　はったつしたと　かんがえられている。\nおこると　ツノの　さきから　もうどくを　だす。
sourceRecords.english: NIDORAN has barbs that secrete a\npowerful poison. They are thought to\nhave developed as protection for this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: small-bodied POKéMON.\nWhen enraged, it releases a horrible\ntoxin from its horn.

sourceRecords.japanese: なかまや　かぞくと　いっしょの　ときは　おたがい\nきずつかないように　トゲが　ひっこんでいる。\nなかまから　はなれると　ふあんに　なるらしい。
sourceRecords.english: When NIDORINA are with their friends or\nfamily, they keep their barbs tucked\naway to prevent hurting each other.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON appears to become\nnervous if separated from the others.

sourceRecords.japanese: かたい　ウロコで　おおわれた　からだを　ぶつけて\nあいてを　はじきとばす　こうげきが　とくいだ。\nこどもを　まもる　ときが　いちばん　つよい。
sourceRecords.english: NIDOQUEEN's body is encased in\nextremely hard scales. It is adept at\nsending foes flying with harsh tackles.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is at its strongest when\nit is defending its young.

sourceRecords.japanese: みみを　うごかす　きんにくが　はったつしていて\nどんな　むきにも　じざいに　みみを　うごかせる。\nかすかな　ものおとも　ききもらさない　ポケモン。
sourceRecords.english: The male NIDORAN has developed\nmuscles for moving its ears. Thanks to\nthem, the ears can be freely moved in

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: any direction. Even the slightest sound\ndoes not escape this POKéMON's notice.

sourceRecords.japanese: ダイヤモンドよりも　かたい　ツノを　もつ。\nてきの　けはいを　かんじると　せなかの　トゲが\nいっせいに　さかだち　ぜんりょくで　たちむかう。
sourceRecords.english: NIDORINO has a horn that is harder than\na diamond. If it senses a hostile\npresence, all the barbs on its back

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: bristle up at once, and it challenges\nthe foe with all its might.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふとい　しっぽの　ひとふりは　がんじょうな\nてっとうも　へしおる　すさまじい　はかいりょく。\nいちど　あばれだすと　てが　つけられない。
sourceRecords.english: NIDOKING's thick tail packs enormously\ndestructive power. With one swing, it\ncan topple a metal transmission tower.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Once this POKéMON goes on a rampage,\nthere is no stopping it.

sourceRecords.japanese: まんげつの　よるは　げんき　いっぱいに　あそぶ。\nあけがた　つかれた　ピッピたちは　しずかな\nやまおくで　なかまたちと　よりそって　ねむる。
sourceRecords.english: On every night of a full moon, groups of\nthis POKéMON come out to play.\nWhen dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: return to their quiet mountain retreats\nand go to sleep nestled up against each\nother.

sourceRecords.japanese: つばさを　つかって　とぶように　スキップ。\nすいめんを　あるく　ことだって　できるのだ。\nしずかな　つきよに　みずうみを　あるく。
sourceRecords.english: CLEFABLE moves by skipping lightly as if\nit were flying using its wings. Its\nbouncy step lets it even walk on water.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It is known to take strolls on lakes on\nquiet, moonlit nights.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　なかで　ほのおが　いつも　もえている。\nひるま　きおんが　あがると　たいおんも　たかく\nなってしまうので　くちから　ほのおを　にがす。
sourceRecords.english: Inside VULPIX's body burns a flame that\nnever goes out. During the daytime,\nwhen the temperatures rise, this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON releases flames from its mouth\nto prevent its body from growing too\nhot.

sourceRecords.japanese: ９にんの　せいなる　ちからを　もった　せんにんが\nがったいして　うまれたという　でんせつが　ある。\nちのうが　たかく　ひとの　ことばを　りかいする。
sourceRecords.english: Legend has it that NINETALES came into\nbeing when nine wizards possessing\nsacred powers merged into one.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON is highly intelligent - it\ncan understand human speech.

sourceRecords.japanese: うたう　ときは　いちども　いきつぎをしない。\nなかなか　ねむらない　てきを　あいてに　した\nときは　いきを　できない　プリンも　いのちがけ。
sourceRecords.english: When this POKéMON sings, it never\npauses to breathe. If it is in a battle\nagainst an opponent that does not

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: easily fall asleep, JIGGLYPUFF cannot\nbreathe, endangering its life.

sourceRecords.japanese: だんりょくせいに　すぐれた　からだは　おおきく\nいきを　すいこむと　どこまでも　ふくれていく。\nふくらんだ　プクリンは　ふんわり　はねるよ。
sourceRecords.english: WIGGLYTUFF's body is very flexible.\nBy inhaling deeply, this POKéMON can\ninflate itself seemingly without end.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Once inflated, WIGGLYTUFF bounces\nalong lightly like a balloon.

sourceRecords.japanese: たいようの　ひかりを　あびると　たいちょうが\nわるくなるので　ひるまは　どうくつや　ふるびた\nいえの　のきしたに　ぶらさがって　ねている。
sourceRecords.english: ZUBAT avoids sunlight because exposure\ncauses it to become unhealthy.\nDuring the daytime, it stays in caves or

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: under the eaves of old houses, sleeping\nwhile hanging upside down.

sourceRecords.japanese: ４ほんの　キバで　かみつき　けつえきを　のむ。\nつきの　でてない　まっくらな　よるは　かっぱつに\nとびまわり　ひとや　ポケモンを　おそうぞ。
sourceRecords.english: GOLBAT bites down on prey with its four\nfangs and drinks the victim's blood.\nIt becomes active on inky dark

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: moonless nights, flying around to\nattack people and POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: えいよう　たっぷりの　つちを　さがして　うまる。\nひるま　つちに　うまっている　ときには　あしが\nきの　ねっこのような　かたちを　しているらしい。
sourceRecords.english: ODDISH searches for fertile, nutrient-\nrich soil, then plants itself.\nDuring the daytime, while it is planted,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: this POKéMON's feet are thought to\nchange shape and become similar to\nthe roots of trees.

sourceRecords.japanese: どうやら　クサイハナは　くちから　たらしている\nもうれつに　くさい　ニオイが　だいすき　らしい。\nニオイを　かいで　さらに　みつを　あふれさせる。
sourceRecords.english: From its mouth GLOOM drips honey that\nsmells absolutely horrible.\nApparently, it loves the horrid stench.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It sniffs the noxious fumes and then \ndrools even more of its honey.

sourceRecords.japanese: せかいいち　おおきな　はなびらで　えものを\nおびきよせ　どくの　かふんを　あびせかける。\nうごけなくなった　えものを　つかまえて　たべる。
sourceRecords.english: VILEPLUME has the world's largest\npetals. They are used to attract prey\nthat are then doused with toxic spores.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Once the prey are immobilized, this\nPOKéMON catches and devours them.

sourceRecords.japanese: パラスから　ようぶんを　すいとって　おおきくなる\nキノコは　とうちゅうかそう　と　よばれている。\nちょうじゅの　くすりになる　きちょうな　キノコ。
sourceRecords.english: PARAS has parasitic mushrooms growing\non its back called tochukaso. They grow\nlarge by drawing nutrients from this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: BUG/GRASS POKéMON host. They are\nhighly valued as a medicine for\nextending life.

sourceRecords.japanese: パラセクトは　しゅうだんで　たいぼくの　ねもとに\nくっついて　えいようを　すいとってしまう。\nかれると　いっせいに　べつの　きに　いどうする。
sourceRecords.english: PARASECT is known to infest large trees\nen masse and drain nutrients from the\nlower trunk and roots.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: When an infested tree dies, they move\nonto another tree all at once.

sourceRecords.japanese: みを　まもるために　ほそく　かたい　たいもうが\nぜんしんを　おおうように　なったと　いわれる。\nちいさな　えものも　みのがさない　めを　もつ。
sourceRecords.english: VENONAT is said to have evolved with\na coat of thin, stiff hair that covers\nits entire body for protection.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It possesses large eyes that never fail\nto spot even miniscule prey.

sourceRecords.japanese: やこうせいで　よるに　かつどうを　はじめる。\nがいとうの　あかりに　さそわれ　あつまった\nちいさな　むしを　このんで　たべる。
sourceRecords.english: VENOMOTH is nocturnal - it is a POKéMON\nthat only becomes active at night.\nIts favorite prey are small insects

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: that gather around streetlights,\nattracted by the light in the darkness.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほとんどの　のうかは　ディグダを　そだてている。\nディグダが　あなを　ほった　とちは　ほどよく\nたがやされ　おいしい　やさいが　つくれるからだ。
sourceRecords.english: DIGLETT are raised in most farms.\nThe reason is simple - wherever this\nPOKéMON burrows, the soil is left

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: perfectly tilled for planting crops.\nThis soil is made ideal for growing\ndelicious vegetables.

sourceRecords.japanese: もともと　ひとつの　からだから　３つごに\nなったので　みんな　かんがえることは　おなじ。\nちからを　あわせ　どこまでも　ほりすすむ。
sourceRecords.english: DUGTRIO are actually triplets that\nemerged from one body. As a result,\neach triplet thinks exactly like the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: other two triplets.\nThey work cooperatively to burrow\nendlessly.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどい　ツメを　ひっこめて　ぬきあし　さしあし\nあしおとを　たてずに　あるくことが　できる。\nキラキラ　ひかる　コインが　なぜか　だいすきだ。
sourceRecords.english: MEOWTH withdraws its sharp claws into\nits paws to slinkily sneak about without\nmaking any incriminating footsteps.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: For some reason, this POKéMON loves\nshiny coins that glitter with light.

sourceRecords.japanese: たくましい　６ぽんの　ヒゲは　くうきの　うごきで\nまわりの　ようすを　キャッチする　やくわり。\nヒゲを　つかまれると　おとなしくなって　しまう。
sourceRecords.english: PERSIAN has six bold whiskers that give\nit a look of toughness. The whiskers  \nsense air movements to determine what

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: is in the POKéMON's surrounding\nvicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed\nby the whiskers.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふしぎな　ちからを　つかった　きおくが　ないのは\nちからを　はっきした　ときは　じゅくすいしている\nときと　おなじ　じょうたいだから　らしい。
sourceRecords.english: If it uses its mysterious power,\nPSYDUCK can't remember having done so.\nIt apparently can't form a memory of

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: such an event because it goes into\nan altered state that is much like\ndeep sleep.

sourceRecords.japanese: およぐ　スピードは　ポケモンじゅうで　いちばん。\nあらしで　おおあれの　うみでも　へっちゃら。\nなんぱせんから　ひとを　たすける　ことも　ある。
sourceRecords.english: GOLDUCK is the fastest swimmer among\nall POKéMON. It swims effortlessly, even\nin a rough, stormy sea.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
