sourceRecords.english: SHIFTRY's large fans generate awesome\ngusts of wind at a speed close to 100\nfeet per second. The whipped-up wind

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: blows anything away.\nThis POKéMON chooses to live quietly\ndeep in forests.

sourceRecords.japanese: すだちを　おえたばかり　なので　よるに　なると\nさみしく　なって　ないてしまう　ことも　ある。\nもりに　すむ　ケムッソを　つかまえて　たべる。
sourceRecords.english: TAILLOW is young - it has only just\nleft its nest. As a result, it sometimes\nbecomes lonesome and cries at night.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON feeds on WURMPLE that\nlive in forests.

sourceRecords.japanese: ツヤの　ある　はねの　ていれは　おこたらない。\nオオスバメが　２ひき　あつまると　かならず\nおたがいの　はねを　きれいに　ていれするぞ。
sourceRecords.english: SWELLOW is very conscientious about\nthe upkeep of its glossy wings.\nOnce two SWELLOW are gathered, they

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: diligently take care of cleaning each\nother's wings.

sourceRecords.japanese: うみから　ふく　じょうしょう　きりゅうに　のり\nほそながい　つばさを　のばして　かっくうする。\nながい　くちばしは　エサを　とるときに　べんり。
sourceRecords.english: WINGULL rides updrafts rising from the\nsea by extending its long and narrow\nwings to glide.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's long beak is useful for\ncatching prey.

sourceRecords.japanese: かいめん　すれすれを　とび　エサを　さがす。\nおおきな　クチバシを　うみの　なかへ　いれて\nエサを　すくいとり　ひとのみで　たべるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: PELIPPER searches for food while in\nflight by skimming the wave tops.\nThis POKéMON dips its large bill in the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: sea to scoop up food, then swallows\neverything in one big gulp.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひとの　かんじょうを　さっちする　ちからを　もち\nトレーナーが　あかるい　きぶんの　ときには\nいっしょに　なって　よろこぶ　ポケモンだ。
sourceRecords.english: RALTS has the ability to sense the\nemotions of people.\nIf its TRAINER is in a cheerful mood,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: this POKéMON grows cheerful and joyous\nin the same way.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたまの　ツノで　ぞうふくされた　サイコパワーが\nつかわれるとき　まわりの　くうかんが　ねじまがり\nげんじつには　ない　けしきが　みえると　いう。
sourceRecords.english: KIRLIA uses the horns on its head\nto amplify its psychokinetic power.\nWhen the POKéMON uses its power,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: the air around it becomes distorted,\ncreating mirages of nonexistent\nscenery.

sourceRecords.japanese: サイコパワーで　くうかんを　ねじまげ　ちいさな\nブラックホールを　つくりだす　ちからを　もつ。\nいのちがけで　トレーナーを　まもる　ポケモン。
sourceRecords.english: GARDEVOIR has the psychokinetic\npower to distort the dimensions and\ncreate a small black hole.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON will try to protect its\nTRAINER even at the risk of its own\nlife.

sourceRecords.japanese: きけんを　かんじると　あたまの　さきっぽから\nみずあめのような　あまい　えきたいを　だす。\nこれが　こうぶつの　ポケモンも　いるよ。
sourceRecords.english: If SURSKIT senses danger, it secretes\na thick, sugary syrup from the tip of\nits head.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: There are some POKéMON that love\neating this syrup.

sourceRecords.japanese: おこった　ひょうじょうの　めだま　もようが\nかなしそうに　たれさがっている　ときは\nゆうだちの　ふりだす　ぜんちょうと　いわれる。
sourceRecords.english: MASQUERAIN's antennas have eyelike\npatterns that usually give it an angry\nlook. If the “eyes” are droopy and

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: appear sad, it is said to be a sign\nthat a heavy rainfall is on its way.

sourceRecords.japanese: きけんを　かんじると　からだを　ふるわせて\nあたまの　てっぺんから　ほうしを　ばらまくぞ。\nくさきも　しおれてしまうほどの　もうどくだ。
sourceRecords.english: If SHROOMISH senses danger, it shakes\nits body and scatters spores from the\ntop of its head.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's spores are so toxic,\nthey make trees and weeds wilt.

sourceRecords.japanese: シッポの　タネは　どくの　ほうしが　かたまって\nできた　ものなので　たべたら　たいへんだ。\nひとくちで　おなかが　グルグル　なりだすぞ。
sourceRecords.english: The seeds ringing BRELOOM's tail are\nmade of hardened toxic spores. It is\nhorrible to eat the seeds.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Just taking a bite of this POKéMON's\nseed will cause your stomach to rumble.

sourceRecords.japanese: しんぞうの　こどうは　１ぷんかんに　１かい。\nとにかく　じっと　ねそべっている　ポケモンで\nうごく　すがたを　みることは　ほとんど　ない。
sourceRecords.english: SLAKOTH's heart beats just once a\nminute. Whatever happens, it is\ncontent to loaf around motionless.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It is rare to see this POKéMON in\nmotion.

sourceRecords.japanese: じっとしている　ことが　できない　ポケモンだ。\nねむろうとしても　からだの　ちが　たぎってしまい\nもりじゅうを　かけまわらないと　おさまらない。
sourceRecords.english: VIGOROTH is simply incapable of\nremaining still. Even when it tries to\nsleep, the blood in its veins grows

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: agitated, compelling this POKéMON to\nrun wild throughout the jungle before\nit can settle down.

sourceRecords.japanese: そうげんに　きざまれた　はんけい　１メートルの\nわっかは　ケッキングが　ねそべったまま　まわりの\nくさを　たべつくして　できた　ものだ。
sourceRecords.english: Wherever SLAKING live, rings of over\na yard in diameter appear in grassy\nfields. They are made by the POKéMON

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: as it eats all the grass within reach\nwhile lying prone on the ground.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどい　ツメで　じゅもくの　ねっこを　けずり\nすいぶんや　えいようを　きゅうしゅうする。\nたいようの　ひかりは　まぶしいので　にがて。
sourceRecords.english: NINCADA lives underground. It uses its\nsharp claws to carve the roots of trees\nand absorb moisture and nutrients.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON can't withstand bright\nsunlight so avoids it.

sourceRecords.japanese: じょうずに　そだてないと　いうことを　きかず\nおおごえで　なきつづけるので　トレーナーの\nうでが　ためされる　ポケモンと　いわれている。
sourceRecords.english: If NINJASK is not trained properly,\nit will refuse to obey the TRAINER and\ncry loudly continuously.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Because of this quality, this POKéMON\nis said to be one that puts the\nTRAINER's abilities to the test.

sourceRecords.japanese: ツチニンが　しんかしたとき　なぜか　かってに\nモンスターボールに　はいっている　ポケモンだ。\nからだは　まったく　うごかず　いきも　しない。
sourceRecords.english: SHEDINJA is a peculiar POKéMON.\nIt seems to appear unsought in a POKé\nBALL after a NINCADA evolves.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This bizarre POKéMON is entirely\nimmobile - it doesn't even breathe.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひとたび　おおごえで　なきだすと　じぶんの\nこえに　びっくりして　さらに　はげしく　なく。\nなきやむと　つかれて　ねむってしまう。
sourceRecords.english: WHISMUR is very timid. If it starts to\ncry loudly, it becomes startled by its\nown crying and cries even harder.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: When it finally stops crying, the\nPOKéMON goes to sleep, all tired out.

sourceRecords.japanese: あしを　ふみならしながら　おおごえを　だす。\nおおごえを　だしたあとは　しばらくの　あいだ\nなにも　きこえなくなってしまうのが　じゃくてん。
sourceRecords.english: LOUDRED shouts while stamping its feet.\nAfter it finishes shouting, this\nPOKéMON becomes incapable of hearing

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: anything for a while. This is considered\nto be a weak point.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　あなから　ふえの　ような　おとを\nだして　なかまに　きもちを　つたえている。\nおおごえは　たたかう　ときしか　ださないのだ。
sourceRecords.english: EXPLOUD communicates its feelings to\nthe others by emitting whistle-like\nsounds from the tubes on its body.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON only raises its voice when\nit is in battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぜったいに　あきらめない　こんじょうを　もつ。\nたくさん　たべ　よく　ねて　うんどうする　ことで\nからだの　なかに　エネルギーが　じゅうまんする。
sourceRecords.english: MAKUHITA has a tireless spirit -\nit will never give up hope. It eats a lot\nof food, gets plenty of sleep, and it

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: trains very rigorously. By living that\nway, this POKéMON packs its body with\nenergy.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふとった　からだは　きんにくの　かたまり。\nぐぐっと　ぜんしんに　ちからを　こめると\nきんにくは　いわと　おなじ　かたさになるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: HARIYAMA's thick body may appear fat,\nbut it is actually a hunk of solid muscle.\nIf this POKéMON bears down and

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: tightens all its muscles, its body\nbecomes as hard as a rock.

sourceRecords.japanese: しっぽには　せいちょうする　ために　ひつような\nえいようが　たっぷり　つまっているぞ。\nだんりょくの　ある　しっぽに　のって　あそぶ。
sourceRecords.english: AZURILL's tail is large and bouncy.\nIt is packed full of the nutrients this\nPOKéMON needs to grow.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: AZURILL can be seen bouncing and\nplaying on its big, rubbery tail.

sourceRecords.japanese: じしゃくの　はなを　きたに　むけたまま　まったく\nうごかないと　いわれていたが　１ねんに　１センチ\nいどう　している　ことが　かんそくされた。
sourceRecords.english: NOSEPASS had been said to be completely\nunmoving, with its magnetic nose\npointed due north.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: However, close observation has revealed\nthat the POKéMON actually moves by a\nlittle over 3/8 of an inch every year.

sourceRecords.japanese: じぶんの　シッポを　おいかけまわす　ポケモン。\nやせいは　もりの　じゅもくの　あなで　くらす。\nあいくるしい　かおで　ペットとして　だいにんき。
sourceRecords.english: SKITTY is known to chase around\nplayfully after its own tail. In the wild,\nthis POKéMON lives in holes in the trees

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: of forests. It is very popular as a pet\nbecause of its adorable looks.

sourceRecords.japanese: きまった　すみかを　もたずに　くらす　ポケモン。\nほかの　ポケモンが　ねどこに　ちかよって　きても\nけっして　あらそわず　ねる　ばしょを　かえる。
sourceRecords.english: DELCATTY sleeps anywhere it wants\nwithout keeping a permanent nest.\nIf other POKéMON approach it as it

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: sleeps, this POKéMON will never fight -\nit will just move away somewhere else.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどい　ツメで　つちを　ほり　いしを　たべる。\nいしに　ふくまれた　せいぶんは　けっしょうとなり\nからだの　ひょうめんに　うかびあがってくる。
sourceRecords.english: SABLEYE digs the ground with sharpened\nclaws to find rocks that it eats.\nSubstances in the eaten rocks

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: crystallize and rise up to the POKéMON's\nbody surface.

sourceRecords.japanese: あいてを　ゆだんさせ　おおきな　あごで　がぶり。\nかわいい　かおに　だまされると　きけんだよ。\nはがねの　あごは　ツノが　へんけいした　ものだ。
sourceRecords.english: Don't be taken in by this POKéMON's\ncute face - it's very dangerous. MAWILE\nfools the foe into letting down its

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: guard, then chomps down with its\nmassive jaws. The steel jaws are really\nhorns that have been transformed.

sourceRecords.japanese: こうてつの　からだで　おもいっきり　ぶつかれば\nおおきな　ダンプカーも　いちげきで　バラバラだ。\nこわれた　ダンプカーを　むしゃむしゃ　たべるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: ARON has a body of steel.\nWith one all-out charge, this POKéMON\ncan demolish even a heavy dump truck.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The destroyed dump truck then becomes\na handy meal for the POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: いしや　みずに　ふくまれる　てつぶんを　たべる。\nてっこうせきの　うもれた　やまに　すを　つくるが\nてつを　とりにくる　にんげんと　あらそいになる。
sourceRecords.english: LAIRON feeds on iron contained in\nrocks and water. It makes its nest on\nmountains where iron ore is buried.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: As a result, the POKéMON often clashes\nwith humans mining the iron ore.

sourceRecords.japanese: どしゃくずれや　やまかじで　やまが　あれると\nせっせと　つちを　はこび　きの　なえを　うえて\nじぶんの　なわばりを　きれいに　そうじする。
sourceRecords.english: AGGRON is surprisingly protective\nof its environment. If its mountain\nis ravaged by a landslide or a fire, this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON will haul topsoil to the area,\nplant trees, and beautifully restore its\nown territory.

sourceRecords.japanese: めいそうで　せいしんエネルギーを　たかめている。\n１にちに　きのみを　１こだけしか　たべない。\nあまり　たべない　ことも　しゅぎょうの　ひとつ。
sourceRecords.english: MEDITITE heightens its inner energy\nthrough meditation. It survives on\njust one berry a day.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Minimal eating is another aspect of\nthis POKéMON's training.

sourceRecords.japanese: ヨガの　ちからで　だい６かんが　はったつして\nサイコパワーを　あやつれる　ように　なった。\n１かげつかん　なにも　たべずに　めいそうする。
sourceRecords.english: Through the power of meditation,\nMEDICHAM developed its sixth sense.\nIt gained the ability to use

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: psychokinetic powers. This POKéMON is\nknown to meditate for a whole month\nwithout eating.

sourceRecords.japanese: めにも　とまらぬ　スピードで　はしる　ポケモン。\nくうきの　まさつで　でんきを　はっせいさせて\nぜんしんの　たいもうに　たくわえている。
sourceRecords.english: ELECTRIKE runs faster than the human\neye can follow. The friction from\nrunning is converted into electricity,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: which is then stored in this POKéMON's\nfur.

sourceRecords.japanese: たてがみから　つよい　でんきを　はっしている。\nくうきちゅうの　でんきを　たてがみに　あつめ\nあたまの　うえに　かみなりぐもを　つくりだす。
sourceRecords.english: MANECTRIC discharges strong\nelectricity from its mane. The mane is\nused for collecting electricity in the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: atmosphere. This POKéMON creates\nthunderclouds above its head.

sourceRecords.japanese: なかまを　おうえんする　ときは　ぜんしんから\nでんきの　ひばなを　だして　パチパチ　ひかる。\nなかまが　まけると　おおごえで　ないてしまう。
sourceRecords.english: When PLUSLE is cheering on its partner,\nit flashes with electric sparks from all\nover its body.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If its partner loses, this POKéMON cries\nloudly.

sourceRecords.japanese: なかまの　おうえんが　だいすきな　ポケモン。\nなかまが　まけそうに　なると　からだから　でる\nひばなの　かずが　どんどん　ふえていくよ。
sourceRecords.english: MINUN loves to cheer on its partner in\nbattle. It gives off sparks from its\nbody while it is doing so.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If its partner is in trouble, this\nPOKéMON gives off increasing amounts\nof sparks.

sourceRecords.japanese: しっぽの　あかりを　つかって　しゅうだんで\nよぞらに　きかがくてきな　ずけいを　えがく。\nイルミーゼの　だす　あまい　かおりが　だいすき。
sourceRecords.english: VOLBEAT's tail glows like a lightbulb.\nWith other VOLBEAT, it uses its tail to\ndraw geometric shapes in the night sky.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON loves the sweet aroma\ngiven off by ILLUMISE.

sourceRecords.japanese: バルビートを　ゆうどうして　サインを　えがく。\nふくざつな　サインを　えがく　イルミーゼほど\nなかまから　そんけいされると　いわれているよ。
sourceRecords.english: ILLUMISE leads a flight of illuminated\nVOLBEAT to draw signs in the night sky.\nThis POKéMON is said to earn greater

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: respect from its peers by composing\nmore complex designs in the sky.

sourceRecords.japanese: ごく　まれに　めずらしい　いろの　はなを\nさかせている　ロゼリアが　いると　いわれる。\nあたまの　トゲは　もうどくを　もっているぞ。
sourceRecords.english: On extremely rare occasions, a ROSELIA\nis said to appear with its flowers in\nunusual colors.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The thorns on this POKéMON's head\ncontain a vicious poison.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだの　だいぶぶんが　いぶくろで　できていて\nしんぞうや　のうみそは　とても　ちいさい。\nなんでも　とかす　とくしゅな　いえきを　もつ。
sourceRecords.english: Most of GULPIN's body is made up of its\nstomach - its heart and brain are very\nsmall in comparison.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's stomach contains\nspecial enzymes that dissolve anything.

sourceRecords.japanese: はが　１ぽんも　ないので　なんでも　まるのみ。\nいっぱいに　あけた　くちは　とても　おおきく\nじどうしゃの　タイヤだって　すっぽり　はいるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: SWALOT has no teeth, so what it\neats, it swallows whole, no matter what.\nIts cavernous mouth yawns widely.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: An automobile tire could easily fit\ninside this POKéMON's mouth.

sourceRecords.japanese: テリトリーを　あらす　ものには　しゅうだんで\nおそいかかり　とがった　キバで　やつざきにする。\n１ぴきに　なると　とたんに　よわごしに　なるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: If anything invades CARVANHA's\nterritory, it will swarm and tear at the\nintruder with its pointed fangs.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: On its own, however, this POKéMON turns\nsuddenly timid.

sourceRecords.japanese: かいすいを　おしりの　あなから　ふきだして\nじそく１２０キロで　およぐことが　できる。\nながい　きょりを　およげないのが　じゃくてんだ。
sourceRecords.english: SHARPEDO can swim at speeds of up to\n75 mph by jetting seawater out of its\nbackside.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's drawback is its inability\nto swim long distances.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだに　かいすいを　ためると　ボールの　ように\nじめんで　とびはねることが　できるように　なる。\nたくさん　ためると　たかく　ジャンプできる。
sourceRecords.english: WAILMER can store water inside its body\nto transform itself into a ball for\nbouncing around on the ground.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: By filling itself up with more water, this\nPOKéMON can elevate the height of its\nbounces.

sourceRecords.japanese: えものを　おいたてる　ために　すいちゅうから\nジャンプして　おおきな　みずしぶきを　あげる。\nむれで　ジャンプする　すがたは　だいはくりょく。
sourceRecords.english: When chasing prey, WAILORD herds them\nby leaping out of the water and making\na humongous splash.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It is breathtaking to see this POKéMON\nleaping out of the sea with others in\nits pod.

sourceRecords.japanese: １２００どの　マグマを　からだに　ためている。\nみずに　ぬれると　マグマが　ひえて　かたまり\nおもたくなるので　うごきが　にぶって　しまう。
sourceRecords.english: NUMEL stores magma of almost 2,200\ndegrees F within its body. If it gets\nwet, the magma cools and hardens.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: In that event, the POKéMON's body\ngrows heavy and its movements become\nsluggish.

sourceRecords.japanese: せなかの　コブは　ほねが　かたちを　かえたもの。\nにえたぎった　マグマを　ときどき　ふきあげる。\nおこった　ときに　よく　ふんかする　らしい。
sourceRecords.english: The humps on CAMERUPT's back are\nformed by a transformation of its\nbones. They sometimes blast out molten

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: magma. This POKéMON apparently erupts\noften when it is enraged.

sourceRecords.japanese: せきたんを　もやして　エネルギーを　つくりだす。\nひの　いきおいが　よわまると　げんきが　なくなり\nたたかう　ときは　せきたんを　たくさん　もやす。
sourceRecords.english: TORKOAL generates energy by burning\ncoal. It grows weaker as the fire\ndies down.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: When it is preparing for battle, this\nPOKéMON burns more coal.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたまに　のせた　しんじゅが　バネブーの\nサイコパワーを　たかめる　はたらきをする。\nおおきな　しんじゅを　いつも　さがしている。
sourceRecords.english: SPOINK keeps a pearl on top of its head.\nThe pearl functions to amplify this\nPOKéMON's psychokinetic powers.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It is therefore on a constant search\nfor a bigger pearl.

sourceRecords.japanese: くろしんじゅを　りようして　ふしぎな　ちからを\nつかうとき　きみょうな　ステップで　おどりだす。\nくろしんじゅは　びじゅつひんの　かちを　もつ。
sourceRecords.english: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its\nbody to wield its fantastic powers.\nWhen it is doing so, it dances bizarrely.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's black pearls are valuable\nas works of art.

sourceRecords.japanese: おなじ　ブチもようは　ないと　いわれている。\nいつも　めを　まわしている　ような　フラフラした\nうごきには　てきを　まどわせる　こうかが　ある。
sourceRecords.english: No two SPINDA are said to have\nidentical spot patterns on their hides.\nThis POKéMON moves in a curious manner

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: as if it is stumbling in dizziness.\nIts lurching movements can cause the\nopponent to become confused.

sourceRecords.japanese: だっしゅつ　ふかのうな　あなを　さばくに　つくり\nえものが　くるのを　ひたすら　まちかまえている。\nみずが　なくても　１しゅうかんは　へっちゃら。
sourceRecords.english: TRAPINCH is a patient hunter. It digs\nan inescapable pit in a desert and waits\nfor its prey to come tumbling down.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON can go a whole week\nwithout access to any water.

sourceRecords.japanese: ビブラーバの　ハネは　まだ　せいちょうとちゅう。\nながい　きょりを　とぶ　よりも　しんどうさせて\nちょうおんぱを　だす　ほうが　とくいなのだ。
sourceRecords.english: VIBRAVA's wings have not yet\ncompleted the process of growing.\nRather than flying long distances,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: they are more useful for generating\nultrasonic waves by vibrating.

sourceRecords.japanese: はばたきで　おこす　すなあらしの　なかから\nうたごえの　ような　はおと　だけが　きこえるため\nフライゴンは　さばくの　せいれいと　いわれた。
sourceRecords.english: FLYGON whips up a sandstorm by\nflapping its wings. The wings create a\nseries of notes that sound like singing.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Because the “singing” is the only thing\nthat can be heard in a sandstorm, this\nPOKéMON is said to be the desert spirit.

sourceRecords.japanese: あめの　すくない　きびしい　かんきょう　ほど\nきれいで　かおりの　つよい　はなを　さかせる。\nトゲの　ついた　うでを　ふりまわして　たたかう。
sourceRecords.english: The more arid and harsh the\nenvironment, the more pretty and\nfragrant a flower CACNEA grows.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON battles by wildly swinging\nits thorny arms.

sourceRecords.japanese: まよなか　さばくを　あるく　たびびとの　うしろを\nぞろぞろと　しゅうだんで　くっついて　あるく。\nつかれて　うごけなく　なるのを　まっているのだ。
sourceRecords.english: If a traveler is going through a desert\nin the thick of night, CACTURNE\nwill follow in a ragtag group.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The POKéMON are biding their time,\nwaiting for the traveler to tire and\nbecome incapable of moving.

sourceRecords.japanese: よごれたものを　みると　わたの　ような　つばさで\nせっせと　ふきとる　きれいずきな　ポケモンだ。\nつばさが　よごれると　かわで　みずあびを　する。
sourceRecords.english: SWABLU loves to make things clean.\nIf it spots something dirty, it will wipe\nand polish it with its cottony wings.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: If its wings become dirty, this POKéMON\nfinds a stream and showers itself.

sourceRecords.japanese: うつくしい　ソプラノで　うたう　ポケモン。\nわたぐもの　ような　つばさで　じょうしょう\nきりゅうを　うけて　おおぞらへ　まいあがる。
sourceRecords.english: ALTARIA sings in a gorgeous soprano.\nIts wings are like cotton clouds.\nThis POKéMON catches updrafts with its

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: buoyant wings and soars way up into\nthe wild blue yonder.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふだんは　４ほんあしで　こうどうして　いるが\nおこると　うしろあしで　たち　ツメが　とびだす。\nハブネークとは　せんぞから　つづく　ライバルだ。
sourceRecords.english: ZANGOOSE usually stays on all fours,\nbut when angered, it gets up on its\nhind legs and extends its claws.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON shares a bitter rivalry\nwith SEVIPER that dates back over\ngenerations.

sourceRecords.japanese: かたなの　ような　しっぽは　てきを　きりさくのと\nどうじに　しみだした　もうどくを　あびせるぞ。\nしゅくてき　ザングースと　たたかい　つづける。
sourceRecords.english: SEVIPER's swordlike tail serves two\npurposes - it slashes foes and douses\nthem with secreted poison.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON will not give up its long-\nrunning blood feud with ZANGOOSE.

sourceRecords.japanese: まんげつの　じき　かっぱつになる　しゅうせい。\nくうちゅうに　ういて　いどうし　あかい　ひとみは\nみたものの　からだを　すくませる　はくりょく。
sourceRecords.english: LUNATONE becomes active around the\ntime of the full moon. Instead of\nwalking, it moves by floating in midair.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The POKéMON's intimidating red eyes\ncause all those who see it to become\ntransfixed with fear.

sourceRecords.japanese: たいよう　こうせんが　パワーの　みなもと。\nあいての　こころを　よみとると　いわれている。\nからだを　かいてんさせて　こうねつを　はなつ。
sourceRecords.english: Sunlight is the source of SOLROCK's\npower. It is said to possess the ability\nto read the emotions of others.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON gives off intense heat\nwhile rotating its body.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだが　ヌルヌルの　まくで　おおわれているので\nてきに　つかまれても　ヌルリと　にげだせるのだ。\nヌルヌルが　かわくと　からだが　よわってしまう。
sourceRecords.english: BARBOACH's body is covered with a\nslimy film. If a foe grabs it, this\nPOKéMON just slips out of the enemy's

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: grip.\nThis POKéMON grows weak if the slimy\ncoating dries up.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおあばれ　すると　ぬまの　しゅうい　５キロの\nはんいで　じしんの　ような　ゆれが　おこる。\nほんとうの　じしんを　よちする　ちからも　もつ。
sourceRecords.english: If WHISCASH goes on a wild rampage,\nit sets off a quake-like tremor with a\nradius of over three miles.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON has the ability to predict\nreal earthquakes.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどい　ハサミで　えものを　つかまえる。\nすき　きらいが　ないので　なんでも　たべるぞ。\nきたない　みずでも　へっちゃらな　ポケモン。
sourceRecords.english: CORPHISH catches prey with its sharp\nclaws. It has no likes or dislikes when it\ncomes to food - it will eat anything.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON has no trouble living in\nfilthy water.

sourceRecords.japanese: だっぴした　ちょくごは　こうらが　やわらかい。\nこうらが　かたくなるまで　てきの　こうげきを\nさけるため　かわぞこの　あなに　かくれている。
sourceRecords.english: CRAWDAUNT molts (sheds) its shell\nregularly. Immediately after molting,\nits shell is soft and tender.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Until the shell hardens, this POKéMON\nhides in its streambed burrow to avoid\nattack from its foes.

sourceRecords.japanese: なかまを　みつけると　すぐに　あつまって　きて\nいっせいに　なきごえを　あげるので　うるさい。\nいっぽんあしで　きように　たったまま　ねむる。
sourceRecords.english: As soon as it spots others of its kind,\nBALTOY congregates with them and\nthen begins crying noisily in unison.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON sleeps while cleverly\nbalancing itself on its one foot.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２まんねんまえに　さかえた　こだい　ぶんめいの\nどろにんぎょうから　うまれた　ナゾの　ポケモン。\nりょうてから　ビームを　はっしゃするぞ。
sourceRecords.english: CLAYDOL is an enigma that appeared\nfrom a clay statue made by an ancient\ncivilization dating back 20,000 years.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON shoots beams from both\nits hands.

sourceRecords.japanese: かせきから　さいせいした　こだいの　ポケモン。\nいわに　くっつき　あるく　ことが　できない。\n２つの　めで　じっと　えものを　さがしている。
sourceRecords.english: LILEEP is an ancient POKéMON that was\nregenerated from a fossil. It remains\npermanently anchored to a rock.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: From its immobile perch, this POKéMON\nintently scans for prey with its two\neyes.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだが　おもりがわりに　なっているので\nうみが　あれても　ながされる　ことは　ない。\nしょくしゅから　つよい　しょうかえきを　だす。
sourceRecords.english: CRADILY's body serves as an anchor,\npreventing it from being washed away in\nrough seas.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON secretes a strong\ndigestive fluid from its tentacles.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンの　せんぞの　いっしゅと　いわれている。\nからだの　よこに　ついた　８まいの　はねを\nくねらせて　たいこの　うみを　およいでいた。
sourceRecords.english: ANORITH is said to be a type of \nPOKéMON predecessor, with eight wings\nat the sides of its body.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON swam in the primordial sea\nby undulating these eight wings.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおむかし　ぜつめつした　ポケモンの　いっしゅ。\nちじょうで　くらすとき　べんりな　ように\n２ほんの　あしで　あるくように　なったと　いう。
sourceRecords.english: ARMALDO is a POKéMON species that\nbecame extinct in prehistoric times.\nThis POKéMON is said to have walked on

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: its hind legs, which would have been\nmore convenient for life on land.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだは　ボロボロだが　どこでも　いきていける\nしぶとい　せいめいりょくを　もつ　ポケモン。\nしかし　ノロマなので　すぐに　つかまってしまう。
sourceRecords.english: While FEEBAS's body is in tatters,\nit has a hardy and tenacious life force\nthat enables it to live anywhere.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: However, this POKéMON is also slow and\ndimwitted, making it an easy catch.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおきな　みずうみの　そこに　すんでいる。\nからだが　あざやかな　ピンクいろに　かがやくとき\nすさんだ　こころを　いやす　はどうを　はなつ。
sourceRecords.english: MILOTIC live at the bottom of large\nlakes. When this POKéMON's body glows a\nvivid pink, it releases a pulsing wave of

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: energy that brings soothing calm to\nrestless spirits.

sourceRecords.japanese: しぜんの　ちからを　うけて　たいよう　あまみず\nゆきぐもに　すがたを　かえる　ポケモン。\nきしょうが　かわると　きしょうも　かわるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: CASTFORM borrows the power of nature\nto transform itself into the guises of\nthe sun, rain clouds, and snow clouds.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON's feelings change with the\nweather.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだを　けしきと　おなじ　いろに　かえて\nえものに　きづかれない　ように　しのびよる。\nながく　のびる　ベロで　すばやく　つかまえる。
sourceRecords.english: KECLEON alters its body coloration to\nblend in with its surroundings, allowing\nit to sneak up on its prey unnoticed.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Then it lashes out with its long,\nstretchy tongue to instantly ensnare\nthe unsuspecting target.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひとの　こころに　ある　うらみや　ねたみ　などの\nかんじょうを　たべて　せいちょうする　ポケモン。\nうらむ　こころを　さがして　まちを　さまよう。
sourceRecords.english: SHUPPET grows by feeding on dark\nemotions, such as vengefulness and \nenvy, in the hearts of people.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It roams through cities in search of\ngrudges that taint people.

sourceRecords.japanese: すてられた　ぬいぐるみの　わたに　のろいの\nエネルギーが　しみこんで　ポケモンに　なった。\nくちを　あけると　エネルギーが　にげてしまう。
sourceRecords.english: A cursed energy permeated the stuffing\nof a discarded and forgotten plush doll,\ngiving it new life as BANETTE.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The POKéMON's energy would escape if it\nwere to ever open its mouth.

sourceRecords.japanese: まよなか　やみに　まぎれて　さまよっている。\nママに　しかられるような　わるいこは　ヨマワルに\nさらわれるという　いいつたえが　のこっている。
sourceRecords.english: DUSKULL wanders lost among the deep\ndarkness of midnight. There is an oft-\ntold admonishment given to misbehaving

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: children that this POKéMON will spirit\naway bad children who earn scoldings\nfrom their mothers.

sourceRecords.japanese: どんな　おおきさの　ものも　すいこんで　しまう。\nあやしげな　ての　うごきと　ひとつめの　ちからで\nあいてを　さいみん　じょうたいにして　あやつる。
sourceRecords.english: DUSCLOPS absorbs anything, however\nlarge the object may be. This POKéMON\nhypnotizes its foe by waving its hands

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: in a macabre manner and by bringing its\nsingle eye to bear. The hypnotized foe\nis made to do DUSCLOPS's bidding.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんごくの　こどもたちは　トロピウスの　くびに\nなった　くだものの　フサを　おやつに　たべるよ。\nせなかの　はっぱを　はばたかせて　そらを　とぶ。
sourceRecords.english: Children of the southern tropics eat\nas snacks the fruit that grows in\nbunches around the neck of TROPIUS.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON flies by flapping the\nleaves on its back as if they were\nwings.

sourceRecords.japanese: かぜが　つよくなると　きの　えだや　のきしたに\nあたまの　きゅうばんで　ぶらさがり　なきだす。\nながい　シッポで　きのみを　つまんで　たべる。
sourceRecords.english: In high winds, CHIMECHO cries as it\nhangs from a tree branch or the eaves\nof a building using a suction cup on its

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: head.\nThis POKéMON plucks berries with its\nlong tail and eats them.

sourceRecords.japanese: しぜんさいがいを　キャッチする　ちからを　もつ。\nけわしい　さんがくちたいに　せいそくし\nめったに　やまの　ふもとには　おりてこない。
sourceRecords.english: ABSOL has the ability to foretell the\ncoming of natural disasters.\nIt lives in a harsh, rugged mountain

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: environment. This POKéMON very rarely\nventures down from the mountains.

sourceRecords.japanese: つきのよる　なかまたちと　おしくらまんじゅう。\nぎゅうぎゅう　おされて　がまんづよくなる。\nきょうれつな　カウンターを　くりだす　くんれん。
sourceRecords.english: WYNAUT gather on moonlit nights to play\nby squeezing up against each other.\nBy being squeezed, this POKéMON gains

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: endurance and is trained to dole out\npowerful counterattacks.

sourceRecords.japanese: ゆきや　こおりだけを　たべて　くらしている。\nユキワラシの　おとずれた　いえは　だいだい\nさかえるという　いいつたえが　のこっている。
sourceRecords.english: SNORUNT survives by eating only snow\nand ice.\nOld folklore claims that a house visited

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: by this POKéMON is sure to prosper for\nmany generations to come.

sourceRecords.japanese: こおりを　じざいに　あつかう　ちからを　もつ。\nえものを　いっしゅんで　こおらせて　うごけなく\nなった　ところを　おいしく　いただくのだ。
sourceRecords.english: GLALIE has the ability to freely\ncontrol ice. For example, it can\ninstantly freeze its foe solid.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: After immobilizing its foe in ice, this\nPOKéMON enjoys eating it in leisurely\nfashion.

sourceRecords.japanese: いつも　ころがって　いどうする　ポケモンだ。\nりゅうひょうの　きせつに　こおりの　うえを\nころがり　うみを　わたる　すがたを　みかける。
sourceRecords.english: SPHEAL always travels by rolling\naround on its ball-like body. When the\nseason for ice floes arrives, this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON can be seen rolling about on\nice and crossing the sea.

sourceRecords.japanese: しょっちゅう　はなで　なにかを　まわしている。\nまわしながら　においや　かんしょくを　たしかめて\nすきな　ものと　きらいな　ものを　わけるのだ。
sourceRecords.english: SEALEO often balances and rolls\nthings on the tip of its nose. While the\nPOKéMON is rolling something, it checks

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: the object's aroma and texture to\ndetermine whether it likes the object\nor not.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおきな　キバで　ひょうざんを　くだきながら\nひょうてんかの　うみを　およぎまわる。\nぶあつい　しぼうが　こうげきを　はねかえす。
sourceRecords.english: WALREIN swims all over in frigid\nseawater while crushing icebergs with\nits grand, imposing tusks.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Its thick layer of blubber makes enemy\nattacks bounce off harmlessly.

sourceRecords.japanese: かたい　かいがらに　まもられて　せいちょうする。\nほんたいが　カラに　おさまり　きらなくなると\nしんかの　しゅんかんが　ちかづいた　しょうこ。
sourceRecords.english: CLAMPERL grows while being protected\nby its rock-hard shell. When its body\nbecomes too large to fit inside the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: shell, it is sure evidence that this\nPOKéMON is getting close to evolution.

sourceRecords.japanese: さかなの　かたちをした　シッポで　おびきよせ\nおおきな　くちで　エサを　まるのみ　する。\nヘビのように　からだを　くねらせて　およぐ。
sourceRecords.english: HUNTAIL's tail is shaped like a fish.\nIt uses the tail to attract prey, then\nswallows the prey whole with its large,

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: gaping mouth.\nThis POKéMON swims by wiggling its\nslender body like a snake.

sourceRecords.japanese: およぐ　すがたは　ゆうがで　とても　きれいだが\nえものを　みつけると　ほそい　くちを　からだに\nさしこんで　たいえきを　ずるずる　すするぞ。
sourceRecords.english: Although GOREBYSS is the very picture\nof elegance and beauty while swimming,\nit is also cruel. When it spots prey, this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON inserts its thin mouth into the\nprey's body and drains the prey of its\nbody fluids.

sourceRecords.japanese: しんかい　ちょうさで　はっけんされた　ちんしゅ。\nごつごつした　いわの　ような　うろこで　おおわれ\nかいていの　すいあつに　たえる　からだを　もつ。
sourceRecords.english: RELICANTH is a rare species that was\ndiscovered in deep-sea explorations.\nThis POKéMON's body withstands the

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: enormous water pressure of the ocean\ndepths. Its body is covered in tough\nscales that are like craggy rocks.

sourceRecords.japanese: ハートがたの　からだは　あいじょうの　シンボル。\nラブカスに　であった　カップルは　えいえんの\nあいが　やくそくされると　いわれているよ。
sourceRecords.english: LUVDISC's heart-shaped body is a\nsymbol of love and romance.\nIt is said that any couple meeting this

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: POKéMON is promised a loving\nrelationship that never ends.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおぞらを　とぶことを　ゆめみている　ポケモン。\nとべない　くやしさを　はらす　ように　おおいわに\nいしあたまを　うちつけては　コナゴナに　くだく。
sourceRecords.english: BAGON harbors a never-ending dream of\none day soaring high among the clouds.\nAs if trying to dispel its frustration

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: over its inability to fly, this POKéMON\nslams its hard head against huge rocks\nand shatters them into pebbles.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだを　おおっているのは　ホネのような　もの。\nとても　かたく　てきの　こうげきを　はねかえす。\nほらあなで　みを　ひそめ　しんかを　まっている。
sourceRecords.english: Covering SHELGON's body are outgrowths\nmuch like bones. The shell is very hard\nand bounces off enemy attacks.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: When awaiting evolution, this POKéMON\nhides away in a cavern.

sourceRecords.japanese: ゆめにまで　みた　つばさが　やっと　はえてきた。\nうれしい　きもちを　あらわすため　おおぞらを\nとびまわり　ほのおを　はいて　よろこんでいる。
sourceRecords.english: By evolving into SALAMENCE, this\nPOKéMON finally realizes its long-held\ndream of growing wings.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: To express its joy, it flies and wheels\nall over the sky while spouting flames\nfrom its mouth.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだから　でている　じりょくと　ちきゅうの\nじりょくを　はんぱつさせて　ちゅうに　うかぶ。\nおしりの　ツメを　がけに　くいこませて　ねむる。
sourceRecords.english: BELDUM keeps itself floating by\ngenerating a magnetic force that\nrepels earth's natural magnetism.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: When it sleeps, this POKéMON anchors\nitself to a cliff using the hooks on\nits rear.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２ひきの　ダンバルが　がったいしたとき　２つの\nのうが　じりょくの　しんけいで　むすばれる。\nうでを　うしろへ　まわし　こうそくで　いどう。
sourceRecords.english: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG\nis formed. The brains of the BELDUM are\njoined by a magnetic nervous system.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON turns its arms to the rear\nfor traveling at high speed.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２ひきの　メタングが　がったいした　すがた。\nきょたいで　えものを　おさえつけながら\nおなかに　ある　おおきな　くちで　たべるのだ。
sourceRecords.english: METAGROSS is the result of two METANG\nachieving fusion. When hunting, this\nPOKéMON pins the prey to the ground

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: under its massive body. It then eats\nthe helpless victim using the large \nmouth on its stomach.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだを　つくっている　がんせきは　すべて\nちがう　とちから　ほりだされた　ものであると\nさいきんの　けんきゅうで　はんめいした。
sourceRecords.english: REGIROCK's body is composed entirely of\nrocks. Recently, a study made the\nstartling discovery that the rocks

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
マイナス２００どの　れいきが　からだを　つつむ。\nちかづいた　だけでも　こおりついて　しまうぞ。\nマグマでも　とけない　こおりの　からだを　もつ。
sourceRecords.english: REGICE cloaks itself with frigid air of\nnegative 328 degrees F.\nThings will freeze solid just by going

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: near this POKéMON.\nIts icy body is so cold, it will not melt\neven if it is immersed in magma.

sourceRecords.japanese: むかし　ひとによって　ふういんされた　ポケモン。\nからだを　つくる　きんぞくは　ちきゅうじょうに\nそんざいしない　ぶっしつと　かんがえられている。
sourceRecords.english: REGISTEEL was imprisoned by people\nin ancient times.\nThe metal composing its body is thought

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: to be a curious substance that is not\nof this earth.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちのうが　たかく　ひとの　ことばを　りかいする。\nガラスの　ような　うもうで　からだを　つつみこみ\nひかりを　くっせつさせて　すがたを　かえる。
sourceRecords.english: LATIAS is highly intelligent and capable\nof understanding human speech.\nIt is covered with a glass-like down.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: The POKéMON enfolds its body with its\ndown and refracts light to alter its\nappearance.

sourceRecords.japanese: やさしい　こころの　もちぬしにしか　なつかない。\nうでを　おりたたむと　くうきていこうが　へって\nジェットき　よりも　はやく　そらを　とべるぞ。
sourceRecords.english: LATIOS will only open its heart to a\nTRAINER with a compassionate spirit.\nThis POKéMON can fly faster than a jet

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: plane by folding its forelegs to minimize\nair resistance.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおあめと　おおなみで　だいちを　おおい　うみを\nひろげた　ポケモンと　しんわで　かたられている。\nグラードンと　しとうの　すえ　ねむりに　ついた。
sourceRecords.english: KYOGRE is named in mythology as the\nPOKéMON that expanded the sea by\ncovering the land with torrential rains

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: and towering tidal waves.\nIt took to sleep after a cataclysmic\nbattle with GROUDON.

sourceRecords.japanese: あまぐもを　ふきはらい　ひかりと　ねつで　みずを\nじょうはつさせる　ちからを　もつ　ポケモン。\nこうずいに　くるしむ　ひとびとを　すくった。
sourceRecords.english: GROUDON has the power to scatter rain\nclouds and make water evaporate with\nlight and heat.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It came as a savior to people who had\nbeen suffering from terrible floods.

sourceRecords.japanese: なんおくねんも　いきつづけていると　いわれる。\nくもの　うえに　ひろがる　オゾンそうの　なかを\nとんでいるため　だれも　はっけん　できなかった。
sourceRecords.english: RAYQUAZA is said to have lived for\nhundreds of millions of years in the\nearth's ozone layer, above the clouds.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: Its existence had been completely\nunknown because it lived so high in\nthe sky.

sourceRecords.japanese: きよらかな　こえで　うたを　きかせて　あげると\n１０００ねんの　ねむりから　めを　さます。\nひとの　ねがいを　なんでも　かなえると　いう。
sourceRecords.english: JIRACHI will awaken from its sleep of\na thousand years if you sing to it in a\nvoice of purity.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: It is said to make true any wish that\npeople desire.

sourceRecords.japanese: うちゅうウィルスから　たんじょうした　ポケモン。\nちのうが　たかく　ちょうのうりょくを　あやつる。\nむねの　すいしょうたいから　レーザーを　だす。
sourceRecords.english: DEOXYS emerged from a virus that came\nfrom space. It is highly intelligent and\nwields psychokinetic powers.

sourceRecords.japanese: [NULL]
sourceRecords.english: This POKéMON shoots lasers from the\ncrystalline organ on its chest.

てや　しっぽなどを　つかい\nてきを　はたいて　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Pounds the foe with\nforelegs or tail.

sourceRecords.japanese: チョップで　てきを　こうげき\nきゅうしょに　あたりやすい
sourceRecords.english: A chopping attack with a\nhigh critical-hit ratio.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきを　おうふくビンタで\n２ー５かい　れんぞくで　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Repeatedly slaps the foe\n2 to 5 times.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきを　れんぞくで　なぐりつけ\n２ー５かい　れんぞくで　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Repeatedly punches the foe\n2 to 5 times.

sourceRecords.japanese: ものすごい　ちからをこめた　パンチで\nてきを　なぐって　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: A strong punch thrown with\nincredible power.

sourceRecords.japanese: こばんをなげて　てきを　こうげき\nせんとうごに　おかねが　てにはいる
sourceRecords.english: Throws coins at the foe.\nMoney is recovered after.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほのおをこめた　パンチで　こうげき\nてきを　やけどさせることがある
sourceRecords.english: A fiery punch that may burn\nthe foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: れいきをこめた　パンチで　こうげき\nてきを　こおらせることがある
sourceRecords.english: An icy punch that may\nfreeze the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: でんげきをこめた　パンチで　こうげき\nてきを　まひさせることがある
sourceRecords.english: An electrified punch that\nmay paralyze the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどいツメを　つかい\nてきを　ひっかいて　こうげき
おおきなハサミを　つかい\nてきを　はさんで　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Grips the foe with large and\npowerful pincers.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおきなハサミを　つかって\nてきを　はさみ　せんとうふのうにする
sourceRecords.english: A powerful pincer attack\nthat may cause fainting.

sourceRecords.japanese: １ターンめで　かぜのやいばを　つくり\nつぎのターンで　てきを　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: A 2-turn move that strikes\nthe foe on the 2nd turn.

sourceRecords.japanese: たたかいの　おどりを　おどって\nこうげきを　グーンとあげる
sourceRecords.english: A fighting dance that\nsharply raises ATTACK.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどいカマや　ツメなどを　つかって\nてきを　きりつけて　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Cuts the foe with sharp\nscythes, claws, etc.

sourceRecords.japanese: つばさで　つよいかぜを　おこし\nそれを　てきにぶつけて　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Strikes the foe with a gust\nof wind whipped up by wings.

sourceRecords.japanese: つばさを　おおきく　ひろげて\nそのまま　てきに　たいあたりする
sourceRecords.english: Strikes the foe with wings\nspread wide.

sourceRecords.japanese: つよいかぜで　てきを　ふきとばす\nふきとばすと　せんとうは　おわる
sourceRecords.english: Blows away the foe with\nwind and ends the battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: １ターンめで　そらに　とびたって\nつぎのターンで　てきを　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Flies up on the first turn,\nthen strikes the next turn.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２ー５ターンのあいだ　ながいからだや\nつるを　つかって　てきを　しめつける
sourceRecords.english: Binds and squeezes the foe\nfor 2 to 5 turns.

sourceRecords.japanese: ながいシッポや　ツルなどを\nてきに　たたきつけて　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Slams the foe with a long\ntail, vine, etc.

sourceRecords.japanese: ムチのように　ほそながい　つるを\nてきに　たたきつけて　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Strikes the foe with\nslender, whiplike vines.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおきなあしで　ふみつけて　こうげき\nてきを　ひるませることがある
sourceRecords.english: Stomps the enemy with a big\nfoot. May cause flinching.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２ほんの　あしをつかって　てきを\n２かい　れんぞくで　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: A double-kicking attack\nthat strikes the foe twice.

sourceRecords.japanese: ものすごい　ちからをこめた　キックで\nてきを　けっとばして　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: An extremely powerful kick\nwith intense force.

sourceRecords.japanese: ジャンプした　いきおいで　キックを\nくりだす　はずすと　ダメージをうける
sourceRecords.english: A strong jumping kick. May\nmiss and hurt the kicker.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだを　すばやく　１かいてんさせ\nそのいきおいで　キックを　くりだす
sourceRecords.english: A fast kick delivered from\na rapid spin.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきの　かおなどに　すなをかけて\nめいちゅうりつを　さげさせる
sourceRecords.english: Reduces the foe's accuracy\nby hurling sand in its face.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたまから　つっこんで　こうげき\nてきを　ひるませることがある
sourceRecords.english: A ramming attack that may\ncause flinching.

sourceRecords.japanese: とがった　つのを　つかい\nてきを　つついて　こうげき
とがった　つのなどを　つかい\n２ー５かい　れんぞくで　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Jabs the foe 2 to 5 times\nwith sharp horns, etc.

sourceRecords.japanese: つのを　ドリルのように　かいてんさせ\nてきを　つつき　せんとうふのうにする
sourceRecords.english: A one-hit KO attack that\nuses a horn like a drill.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだぜんたいを　つかって\nてきに　たいあたりして　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Charges the foe with a full-\nbody tackle.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだごと　たおれこんで　こうげき\nてきを　まひさせることがある
sourceRecords.english: A full-body slam that may\ncause paralysis.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２ー５ターンのあいだ　ながいからだや\nツルをつかって　てきを　しめつける
sourceRecords.english: Wraps and squeezes the foe\n2 to 5 times with vines, etc.

sourceRecords.japanese: いきおいをつけて　てきに　たいあたり\nじぶんもすこし　ダメージをうける
sourceRecords.english: A reckless charge attack\nthat also hurts the user.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２ー３ターンのあいだ　あばれつづける\nあばれたあとは　こんらんしてしまう
sourceRecords.english: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns\nthat confuses the user.

sourceRecords.japanese: いのちをかけて　てきに　たいあたり\nじぶんもすこし　ダメージをうける
sourceRecords.english: A life-risking tackle that\nalso hurts the user.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきに　しっぽをふって　ゆだんさせて\nぼうぎょを　さげさせる
sourceRecords.english: Wags the tail to lower the\nfoe's DEFENSE.

sourceRecords.japanese: どくのある　ハリや　つので　こうげき\nてきに　どくをあたえることがある
sourceRecords.english: A toxic attack with barbs,\netc., that may poison.

sourceRecords.japanese: りょうての　ハリを　つかって\nてきを　２かい　れんぞくで　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Stingers on the forelegs\njab the foe twice.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどいハリを　てきに　はっしゃして\n２ー５かい　れんぞくで　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Sharp pins are fired to\nstrike 2 to 5 times.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきを　にらんで　おびえさせて\nぼうぎょを　さげさせる
sourceRecords.english: Frightens the foe with a\nleer to lower DEFENSE.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどい　はで　かみついて　こうげき\nてきを　ひるませることがある
sourceRecords.english: Bites with vicious fangs.\nMay cause flinching.

sourceRecords.japanese: かわいくないて　てきを　ゆだんさせて\nこうげきを　さげさせる
sourceRecords.english: Growls cutely to reduce the\nfoe's ATTACK.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほえて　てきを　にげださせる\nてきが　にげると　せんとうは　おわる
sourceRecords.english: Makes the foe flee to end\nthe battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここちよい　うたごえで\nてきを　ふかいねむりへと　さそう
sourceRecords.english: A soothing song lulls the\nfoe into a deep slumber.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだから　かいおんぱを　はっして\nてきを　こんらんさせることがある
sourceRecords.english: Emits bizarre sound waves\nthat may confuse the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: しょうげきはで　てきを　こうげき\n２０の　きまったダメージを　あたえる
sourceRecords.english: Launches shock waves that\nalways inflict 20 HP damage.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちょうのうりょくで　てきの　うごきを\nとめて　わざを　１つ　つかえなくする
sourceRecords.english: Psychically disables one of\nthe foe's moves.

sourceRecords.japanese: つよいさんで　てきの　ひふを　とかす\nぼうぎょを　さげることがある
sourceRecords.english: Sprays a hide-melting acid.\nMay lower DEFENSE.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちいさな　ほのおで　こうげき\nてきを　やけどさせることがある
sourceRecords.english: A weak fire attack that may\ninflict a burn.

sourceRecords.japanese: すごい　ほのおで　こうげき\nてきを　やけどさせることがある
sourceRecords.english: A powerful fire attack that\nmay inflict a burn.

sourceRecords.japanese: しろいきりで　からだを　おおい\nのうりょくを　さげられないようにする

sourceRecords.japanese: そのターンの　こうげきを　うけない\nれんぞくで　だすと　しっぱいしやすい
sourceRecords.english: Evades attack, but may fail\nif used in succession.

sourceRecords.japanese: ものすごいはやさで　パンチをくりだし\nせんせいこうげきする
sourceRecords.english: A punch is thrown at wicked\nspeed to strike first.

sourceRecords.japanese: こわいかおで　てきを　おびえさせて\nすばやさを　ガクッとさげさせる
sourceRecords.english: Frightens with a scary face\nto sharply reduce SPEED.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきを　ゆだんさせて　ちかづき\nよけられない　こうげきを　くりだす
sourceRecords.english: Draws the foe close, then\nstrikes without fail.

sourceRecords.japanese: かわいい　かおで　キスを　せまる\nキスされると　こんらんしてしまう
sourceRecords.english: Demands a kiss with a cute\nlook. May cause confusion.

sourceRecords.japanese: じぶんの　たいりょくを　けずって\nこうげきを　さいだいまで　あげる
ヘドロを　なげつけて　こうげき\nてきに　どくをあたえることがある
sourceRecords.english: Sludge is hurled to inflict\ndamage. May also poison.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきの　かおなどに　ドロをかけて\nめいちゅうりつを　さげさせる
sourceRecords.english: Hurls mud in the foe's face\nto reduce its accuracy.

sourceRecords.japanese: すみの　かたまりを　はっしゃして\nめいちゅうりつを　さげさせる
sourceRecords.english: Fires a lump of ink to\ndamage and cut accuracy.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきの　あしばに　わなを　しかけ\nこうたいした　てきを　こうげきする
sourceRecords.english: Sets spikes that hurt a \nfoe switching out.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたりにくいが　ダメージは　おおきい\nあたれば　かならず　まひさせる
sourceRecords.english: Powerful and sure to cause\nparalysis, but inaccurate.

sourceRecords.japanese: わざが　あたりにくくなった　てきに\nこうげきを　あてられるようになる
sourceRecords.english: Negates the foe's efforts\nto heighten evasiveness.

sourceRecords.japanese: このわざの　あとに　たおされると\nてきも　せんとうふのうになる
sourceRecords.english: If the user faints, the foe\nis also made to faint.

sourceRecords.japanese: きいた　ポケモンは　３ターンごに\nせんとうふのうに　なってしまう
sourceRecords.english: Any POKéMON hearing this\nsong faints in 3 turns.

sourceRecords.japanese: すごい　れいきで　てきを　こうげき\nすばやさを　さげさせる
sourceRecords.english: A chilling attack that\nlowers the foe's SPEED.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきの　こうげきを　かならずよける\nれんぞくで　だすと　しっぱいしやすい
sourceRecords.english: Evades attack, but may fail\nif used in succession.

sourceRecords.japanese: てにもった　ホネで　２ー５かい\nれんぞくで　てきを　こうげきする
sourceRecords.english: Strikes the foe with a bone\nin hand 2 to 5 times.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきに　しょうじゅんを　あわせて\nつぎの　こうげきを　かならずあてる
sourceRecords.english: Locks on to the foe to\nensure the next move hits.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２ー３ターンのあいだ　あばれつづける\nあばれたあとは　こんらんしてしまう
sourceRecords.english: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns\nthat confuses the user.

sourceRecords.japanese: すなあらしを　はっせいさせて\nまいターン　ダメージを　あたえる
sourceRecords.english: Causes a sandstorm that\nrages for several turns.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきに　あたえた　ダメージの\nはんぶん　たいりょくを　かいふくする
sourceRecords.english: An attack that steals half\nthe damage inflicted.

sourceRecords.japanese: そのターンで　こうげきを　うけても\nかならず　たいりょくが　１のこる
sourceRecords.english: Endures any attack for\n1 turn, leaving at least 1HP.

sourceRecords.japanese: かわいくあまえて　てきを　ゆだんさせ\nこうげきを　ガクッとさげさせる
sourceRecords.english: Charms the foe and sharply\nreduces its ATTACK.

sourceRecords.japanese: ５ターンのあいだ　てきを　こうげき\nあてるたびに　ダメージが　あがる
sourceRecords.english: An attack lasting 5 turns\nwith rising intensity.

sourceRecords.japanese: かならず　たいりょくが　１のこるよう\nてかげんして　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: An attack that leaves the\nfoe with at least 1 HP.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきを　おこらせて　こんらんさせるが\nこうげきも　グーンと　あげてしまう
sourceRecords.english: Confuses the foe, but also\nsharply raises ATTACK.

sourceRecords.japanese: キズついた　からだを　たいりょくの\nはんぶんだけ　かいふくする
sourceRecords.english: Recovers up to half the\nuser's maximum HP.

sourceRecords.japanese: でんきを　まとって　とっしんする\nてきを　まひさせることがある
sourceRecords.english: An electrified tackle that\nmay paralyze the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: わざを　あてるたびに\nいりょくが　ぞうだいしていく
sourceRecords.english: An attack that intensifies\non each successive hit.

sourceRecords.japanese: かたいつばさを　おおきく　ひろげて\nそのまま　てきに　たいあたりする
sourceRecords.english: Strikes the foe with hard\nwings spread wide.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきを　じーっと　みていると　なぜか\nてきは　にげられなく　なってしまう
sourceRecords.english: Fixes the foe with a mean\nlook that prevents escape.

sourceRecords.japanese: オスなら　メスに　メスなら　オスに\nわざが　だしにくくなる
sourceRecords.english: Makes the opposite gender\nless likely to attack.

sourceRecords.japanese: ねているときだけ　つかえる　わざ\nランダムで　じぶんのわざを　くりだす
sourceRecords.english: Uses an own move randomly\nwhile asleep.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここちよい　すずのねを　きかせて\nすべての　じょうたいを　かいふくする
sourceRecords.english: Chimes soothingly to heal\nall status abnormalities.

sourceRecords.japanese: よくしてくれる　トレーナーの　ために\nぜんりょくで　てきを　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: An attack that increases\nin power with friendship.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきに　ばくだんを　プレゼントする\nたまに　かいふくしてしまうことがある
sourceRecords.english: A gift in the form of a\nbomb. May restore HP.

sourceRecords.japanese: むごい　しうちの　うさばらしに\nてきを　ぜんりょくで　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: An attack that is stronger\nif the TRAINER is disliked.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふしぎな　ちからで　まもられて\nとくしゅ　じょうたいに　ならなくなる
sourceRecords.english: A mystical force prevents\nall status problems.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきと　じぶんの　たいりょくを\nたして　それを　なかよく　わける
sourceRecords.english: Adds the user and foe's HP,\nthen shares them equally.

sourceRecords.japanese: しんぴてきな　ほのおで　こうげき\nてきを　やけどさせることがある
sourceRecords.english: A mystical fire attack that\nmay inflict a burn.

sourceRecords.japanese: じめんを　ゆらして　てきを　こうげき\nダメージは　ランダムで　かわる
あたりにくいが　ダメージは　おおきい\nあたれば　かならず　こんらんさせる
sourceRecords.english: Powerful and sure to cause\nconfusion, but inaccurate.

sourceRecords.japanese: かたいつのを　ものすごい　いきおいで\nつきだして　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: A brutal ramming attack\nusing out-thrust horns.

sourceRecords.japanese: くちから　ものすごい　いきをはいて\nてきを　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Strikes the foe with an\nincredible blast of breath.

sourceRecords.japanese: ついかこうかを　のこしたまま\nほかの　ポケモンと　いれかわる
sourceRecords.english: Switches out the user while\nkeeping effects in play.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきが　さいごに　つかった　わざを\n２ー６かい　れんぞくで　ださせる
sourceRecords.english: Makes the foe repeat its\nlast move over 2 to 6 turns.

sourceRecords.japanese: あいてが　こうかんするときに\nつかうと　だいダメージを　あたえる
sourceRecords.english: Inflicts bad damage if used\non a foe switching out.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだを　はやく　かいてんさせて\nてきを　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Spins the body at high\nspeed to strike the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: あまいかおりで　きを　そらせて\nてきの　かいひりつを　さげさせる
かたい　シッポで　てきを　こうげき\nてきの　ぼうぎょを　さげることがある
sourceRecords.english: Attacks with a rock-hard\ntail. May lower DEFENSE.

sourceRecords.japanese: かたいツメで　てきを　こうげき\nこうげきが　あがることがある
sourceRecords.english: A claw attack that may\nraise the user's ATTACK.

sourceRecords.japanese: あとぜめに　なるが　かならず\nこうげきが　あたる
sourceRecords.english: Makes the user's move last,\nbut it never misses.

sourceRecords.japanese: たいりょくを　かいふくする\nてんきで　かいふくりょうが　かわる
sourceRecords.english: Restores HP. The amount\nvaries with the weather.

sourceRecords.japanese: たいりょくを　かいふくする\nてんきで　かいふくりょうが　かわる
sourceRecords.english: Restores HP. The amount\nvaries with the weather.

sourceRecords.japanese: たいりょくを　かいふくする\nてんきで　かいふくりょうが　かわる
sourceRecords.english: Restores HP. The amount\nvaries with the weather.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンによって　てきに　あたえる\nダメージの　りょうが　へんかする
りょうてチョップで　てきを　こうげき\nきゅうしょに　あたりやすい
ものすごい　かぜを　おこして\nてきを　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Whips up a vicious twister\nto tear at the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: ５ターンのあいだ　みずタイプの\nわざの　いりょくが　あがる
sourceRecords.english: Boosts the power of WATER-\ntype moves for 5 turns.

sourceRecords.japanese: ５ターンのあいだ　ほのおタイプの\nわざの　いりょくが　あがる
sourceRecords.english: Boosts the power of FIRE-\ntype moves for 5 turns.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどい　はで　てきを　かみくだく\nとくぼうを　さげることがある
sourceRecords.english: Crunches with sharp fangs.\nMay lower SP. DEF.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきから　うけた　とくこうの\nダメージを　ばいにして　かえす
sourceRecords.english: Counters the foe's special\nattack at double the power.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきに　かかっている　ほじょこうかを\nじぶんにも　かける
sourceRecords.english: Copies the foe's effect(s)\nand gives to the user.

sourceRecords.japanese: ものすごい　はやさで　うごいて\nちからづよい　こうげきをする
げんしの　ちからを　よびさます\nのうりょくが　あがることがある
sourceRecords.english: An attack that may raise\nall stats.

sourceRecords.japanese: くろいかたまりを　なげて　こうげき\nとくぼうを　さげることがある
sourceRecords.english: Hurls a black blob that may\nlower the foe's SP. DEF.

sourceRecords.japanese: せいしんりょくを　たかめて\n２ターンごに　てきを　こうげきする
sourceRecords.english: Heightens inner power to\nstrike 2 turns later.

sourceRecords.japanese: いわを　くだく　いきおいで　こうげき\nてきの　ぼうぎょを　さげることがある
sourceRecords.english: A rock-crushing attack\nthat may lower DEFENSE.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２ー５ターンのあいだ　てきを\nうずの　ちゅうしんに　とじこめる
sourceRecords.english: Traps and hurts the foe in\na whirlpool for 2 to 5 turns.

sourceRecords.japanese: なかまの　ポケモンが\nこうげきに　さんか　してくれる
sourceRecords.english: Summons party POKéMON to\njoin in the attack.

sourceRecords.japanese: せんせいこうげきで　ひるませる\nさいしょの　ターンにしか　つかえない
２ー５ターンのあいだ　さわいで\nだれも　ねむれない
sourceRecords.english: Causes an uproar for 2 to 5\nturns and prevents sleep.

sourceRecords.japanese: さいだい　３かいまで\nちからを　たくわえる
sourceRecords.english: Charges up power for up to\n3 turns.

sourceRecords.japanese: たくわえた　ちからを　はきだす\nかいすうで　ダメージが　へんかする
sourceRecords.english: Releases stockpiled power\n(the more the better).

sourceRecords.japanese: たくわえた　ちからを　のみこむ\nたいりょくを　かいふくする
あついいきを　あいてに　ふきかける\nてきを　やけどさせることがある
sourceRecords.english: Exhales a hot breath on the\nfoe. May inflict a burn.

sourceRecords.japanese: あられを　ふらせて\nまいターン　ダメージを　あたえる
sourceRecords.english: Summons a hailstorm that\nstrikes every turn.

sourceRecords.japanese: あいてに　いちゃもんを　つけて　\nおなじわざを　れんぞくで　ださせない
sourceRecords.english: Torments the foe and stops\nsuccessive use of a move.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきを　おだてて　こんらんさせるが\nとくこうも　あげてしまう
sourceRecords.english: Confuses the foe, but\nraises its SP. ATK.

sourceRecords.japanese: おにのような　ひで\nあいてを　やけど　させる
sourceRecords.english: Inflicts a burn on the foe\nwith intense fire.

sourceRecords.japanese: じぶんは　ひんしに　なるが　\nあいての　のうりょくが　さがる
sourceRecords.english: The user faints and lowers\nthe foe's abilities.

sourceRecords.japanese: どく　まひ　やけど　のとき\nこうげきの　いりょくが　あがる
sourceRecords.english: Boosts ATTACK when burned,\nparalyzed, or poisoned.

sourceRecords.japanese: いりょくの　たかい　こうこうわざ\nこうげきを　もらうと　ひるむ
sourceRecords.english: A powerful loyalty attack.\nThe user flinches if hit.

sourceRecords.japanese: まひしている　あいてに　だいダメージ\nそのかわり　まひが　なおる
sourceRecords.english: Powerful against paralyzed\nfoes, but also heals them.

sourceRecords.japanese: あいてを　じぶんに　ちゅうもくさせ\nこうげきを　ぜんぶ　じぶんが　うける
sourceRecords.english: Draws attention to make\nfoes attack only the user.

sourceRecords.japanese: しぜんのちからを　かりて　こうげき\nばしょによって　でる　わざが　かわる
sourceRecords.english: The type of attack varies\ndepending on the location.

sourceRecords.japanese: でんきを　たくわえることによって\nつぎにだす　でんきの　つよさをあげる
sourceRecords.english: Charges power to boost the\nelectric move used next.

sourceRecords.japanese: あいてを　ちょうはつして　おこらせる\nあいては　こうげき　しかできなくなる
sourceRecords.english: Taunts the foe into only\nusing attack moves.

sourceRecords.japanese: てだすけされた　あいては\nわざの　いりょくが　あがる
sourceRecords.english: Boosts the power of the\nrecipient's moves.

sourceRecords.japanese: トリックを　つかって\nどうぐを　こうかん　してしまう
sourceRecords.english: Tricks the foe into trading\nheld items.

sourceRecords.japanese: あいてに　なりきって　あいての\nとくせいを　コピーする
sourceRecords.english: Mimics the target and\ncopies its special ability.

sourceRecords.japanese: ねがいごとをして　かいふくする\nかなうまでに　ちょっと　かかる
sourceRecords.english: A wish that restores HP.\nIt takes time to work.

sourceRecords.japanese: みかた　ポケモンの　わざで　こうげき\nどの　わざが　でるかは　わからない
sourceRecords.english: Attacks randomly with one\nof the partner's moves.

sourceRecords.japanese: ねをはって　ちょっとずつ　かいふく\nねをはって　いるので　いれかわれない
sourceRecords.english: Lays roots that restore HP.\nThe user can't switch out.

sourceRecords.japanese: すごい　ちからを　はっきするが　\nつかれて　のうりょくが　さがる
とくしゅな　わざの　こうかを\nはねかえして　あいてに　かけてしまう
sourceRecords.english: Reflects special effects\nback to the attacker.

sourceRecords.japanese: いちど　つかってしまった　どうぐを\nもういちど　つかうことが　できる
sourceRecords.english: Recycles a used item for\none more use.

sourceRecords.japanese: あいてから　ダメージを　うけていると\nいりょくが　あがる
sourceRecords.english: An attack that gains power\nif injured by the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: リフレクター　などを　こわして\nあいてに　ダメージを　あたえる
sourceRecords.english: Destroys barriers such as\nREFLECT and causes damage.

sourceRecords.japanese: あくびで　さそって　つぎの　ターンに\nあいてを　ねむり　じょうたいに　する
sourceRecords.english: Lulls the foe into yawning,\nthen sleeping next turn.

sourceRecords.japanese: あいての　どうぐを　はたきおとして\nおわるまで　つかえなくする
sourceRecords.english: Knocks down the foe's held\nitem to prevent its use.

sourceRecords.japanese: じぶんの　たいりょくが　あいてより\nすくないほど　ダメージを　あたえる
sourceRecords.english: Gains power if the user's HP\nis lower than the foe's HP.

sourceRecords.japanese: じぶんの　たいりょくが　おおいほど\nおおきな　ダメージを　あたえる
sourceRecords.english: The higher the user's HP,\nthe more damage caused.

sourceRecords.japanese: おたがいの　とくせいを　\nいれかえることが　できる
sourceRecords.english: The user swaps special\nabilities with the target.

sourceRecords.japanese: じぶんが　おぼえて　いる　わざを\nあいては　つかうことが　できなくなる
sourceRecords.english: Prevents foes from using\nmoves known by the user.

sourceRecords.japanese: どく　まひ　やけど　じょうたいを\nなおしてしまう
てきの　わざで　ひんしに　なったとき\nその　わざの　ポイントを　０にする
sourceRecords.english: If the user faints, deletes\nthe PP of the final move.

sourceRecords.japanese: あいてが　つかおうとした　わざを\nうばって　じぶんに　つかってしまう
sourceRecords.english: Steals the effects of the\nmove the foe uses next.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひみつの　ちからを　よびさます\nばしょによって　ついかこうかがちがう
sourceRecords.english: An attack with effects\nthat vary by location.

sourceRecords.japanese: １ターンめで　みずに　もぐり\nつぎのターンで　てきを　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Dives underwater the first\nturn and strikes next turn.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２ー５かい　れんぞくで　つっぱり\nてきを　こうげき
sourceRecords.english: Straight-arm punches that\nstrike the foe 2 to 5 times.

sourceRecords.japanese: ばしょに　あわせて　\nポケモンの　タイプが　へんかする
sourceRecords.english: Alters the POKéMON's type\ndepending on the location.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひかりを　てんめつさせて\nとくこうを　グーンとあげる
sourceRecords.english: Flashes a light that sharply\nraises SP. ATK.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひかりを　ほうしゅつして　こうげき\nとくぼうを　さげることがある
sourceRecords.english: Attacks with a burst of\nlight. May lower SP. DEF.

sourceRecords.japanese: きりじょうの　うもうで　こうげき\nとくこうを　さげることがある
sourceRecords.english: Attacks with a flurry of\ndown. May lower SP. ATK.

sourceRecords.japanese: うもうを　ふりまき　からみつかせて　\nこうげきを　ガクッとさげさせる
sourceRecords.english: Envelops the foe with down\nto sharply reduce ATTACK.

sourceRecords.japanese: すべての　ポケモンを\nこんらん　じょうたいに　する
きゅうしょに　あたり　やすく\nたまに　やけど　じょうたいに　する
sourceRecords.english: A kick with a high critical-\nhit ratio. May cause a burn.

sourceRecords.japanese: どろどろに　なって\nでんきタイプの　ダメージを　へらす
sourceRecords.english: Covers the user in mud to\nraise electrical resistance.

sourceRecords.japanese: ５ターンのあいだ　てきを　こうげき\nあてるたびに　ダメージが　あがる
sourceRecords.english: A 5-turn attack that gains\npower on successive hits.

sourceRecords.japanese: トゲだらけの　うでで　なぐり　つける\nてきを　ひるませることがある
sourceRecords.english: Attacks with thorny arms.\nMay cause flinching.

sourceRecords.japanese: なまけて　からだを　たいりょくの\nはんぶんだけ　かいふくする
sourceRecords.english: Slacks off and restores\nhalf the maximum HP.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおごえの　しんどうで\nてきに　ダメージを　あたえる
sourceRecords.english: A loud attack that uses\nsound waves to injure.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどいキバで　こうげき　\nたまに　もうどく　じょうたいに　する
sourceRecords.english: A sharp-fanged attack.\nMay badly poison the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどいツメで　てきを　きりさく\nぼうぎょを　さげることがある
sourceRecords.english: Tears at the foe with sharp\nclaws. May lower DEFENSE.

sourceRecords.japanese: ダメージは　おおきいが　つかうと\nつぎのターン　うごけなくなってしまう
sourceRecords.english: Powerful, but leaves the\nuser immobile the next turn.

sourceRecords.japanese: ダメージは　おおきいが　つかうと\nつぎのターン　うごけなくなってしまう
sourceRecords.english: Powerful, but leaves the\nuser immobile the next turn.

sourceRecords.japanese: すいせいのごとく　パンチを　くりだす\nこうげきが　あがることがある
sourceRecords.english: Fires a meteor-like punch.\nMay raise ATTACK.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきを　おどろかして　こうげき\nてきを　ひるませることがある
sourceRecords.english: An attack that may shock\nthe foe into flinching.

sourceRecords.japanese: てんきに　よって\nタイプと　いりょくが　へんかする
sourceRecords.english: The move's type and power\nchange with the weather.

sourceRecords.japanese: ここちよい　かおりを　かがせて\nすべての　じょうたいを　かいふくする
sourceRecords.english: Heals all status problems\nwith a soothing scent.

sourceRecords.japanese: ないたふりで　あいてを　こまらせて\nとくぼうを　ガクッとさげさせる
sourceRecords.english: Feigns crying to sharply\nlower the foe's SP. DEF.

sourceRecords.japanese: するどい　かぜを　おこして　こうげき\nきゅうしょに　あたりやすい
sourceRecords.english: Hacks with razorlike wind.\nHigh critical-hit ratio.

sourceRecords.english: A fossil of an\nancient, seafloor-\ndwelling POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: おおむかし　かいていで\nくらしていた　ポケモンの\nカセキと　いわれている
sourceRecords.english: A fossil of an\nancient, seafloor-\ndwelling POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: みえない　ポケモンに\nはんのうして　おとをだす\nデボンの　とくせいひん
sourceRecords.english: A device by DEVON\nthat signals any\nunseeable POKéMON.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきに　だいダメージを\nあたえるが　こうげきを\nうけると　ひるんでしまう
sourceRecords.english: Powerful, but makes\nthe user flinch if\nhit by the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: ながく　するどい　ツメで\nてきを　ひっかけて\nこうげきする
sourceRecords.english: Hooks and slashes\nthe foe with long,\nsharp claws.

sourceRecords.japanese: ちょうおんぱ　こうげきで\nてきを　こんらんさせる\nことがある
せいしんを　しゅうちゅう\nさせて　とくこうと\nとくぼうを　あげる
sourceRecords.english: Raises SP. ATK and\nSP. DEF by focusing\nthe mind.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほえて　てきを　にがす\nてきが　にげると\nせんとうは　おわる
sourceRecords.english: A savage roar that\nmakes the foe flee \nto end the battle.

sourceRecords.japanese: じょじょに　ダメージが\nふえる　もうどくを\nてきに　あたえる
sourceRecords.english: Poisons the foe\nwith a toxin that\ngradually worsens.

sourceRecords.japanese: あられを　ふらして\nこおりタイプ　いがいに\nダメージを　あたえる
sourceRecords.english: Summons a hailstorm\nthat hurts all\ntypes except ICE.

sourceRecords.japanese: からだを　きたえて\nこうげきと　ぼうぎょの\nちからを　あげる
sourceRecords.english: Bulks up the body\nto boost both\nATTACK & DEFENSE.

sourceRecords.japanese: タネを　２ー５かい\nれんぞくで　はっしゃして\nてきを　こうげきする
sourceRecords.english: Shoots 2 to 5 seeds\nin a row to strike\nthe foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンによって　てきに\nあたえる　ダメージの\nりょうが　へんかする
５ターンの　あいだ\nほのおタイプの\nわざのいりょくが　あがる
sourceRecords.english: Raises the power of\nFIRE-type moves\nfor 5 turns.

sourceRecords.japanese: あいてを　おこらせて\nこうげきわざ　しか\nだせない　ように　する
sourceRecords.english: Enrages the foe so\nit can only use\nattack moves.

sourceRecords.japanese: れいきを　はっしゃして\nてきを　こうげきする\nこおらせる　ことがある
sourceRecords.english: Fires an icy cold\nbeam that may\nfreeze the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: ゆきを　つよいかぜに\nのせて　こうげきする\nこおらせる　ことがある
sourceRecords.english: A vicious snow-and-\nwind attack that\nmay freeze the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: ダメージは　おおきいが\nつかうと　つぎのターン\nうごけなく　なってしまう
ひかりのかべを　つくり\nとくこうの　ダメージを\nよわめる
sourceRecords.english: Creates a wall of\nlight that lowers\nSP. ATK damage.

sourceRecords.japanese: そのターンの　こうげきを\nうけないが　れんぞくして\nだすと　しっぱいしやすい
sourceRecords.english: Negates all damage,\nbut may fail if used\nin succession.

sourceRecords.japanese: ５ターンの　あいだ\nみずタイプの\nわざのいりょくが　あがる
sourceRecords.english: Raises the power of\nWATER-type moves\nfor 5 turns.

sourceRecords.japanese: あたえた　ダメージの\nはんぶんの　たいりょくを\nかいふく　できる
sourceRecords.english: Recovers half the\nHP of the damage \nthis move inflicts.

sourceRecords.japanese: ふしぎな　ちからに\nまもられて　とくしゅ\nじょうたいに　ならない
ポケモンが　なついて\nいないほど　あたえる\nダメージが　あがる
sourceRecords.english: The less the user\nlikes you, the more\npowerful this move.

sourceRecords.japanese: １ターンめで　ひかりを\nきゅうしゅうして　つぎの\nターンに　こうげきする
sourceRecords.english: Absorbs sunlight in\nthe 1st turn, then\nattacks next turn.

sourceRecords.japanese: かたいシッポで　こうげき\nてきの　ぼうぎょを\nさげる　ことがある
sourceRecords.english: Slams the foe with\na hard tail. It may\nlower DEFENSE.

sourceRecords.japanese: でんげきを　あびせる\nあたった　てきを\nまひさせる　ことがある
sourceRecords.english: A powerful electric\nattack that may\ncause paralysis.

sourceRecords.japanese: かみなりを　おとす\nあたった　てきを\nまひさせる　ことがある
sourceRecords.english: Strikes the foe\nwith a thunderbolt.\nIt may paralyze.

sourceRecords.japanese: じめんを　つよく　ゆらす\nとんでいる　てきいがいに\nだいダメージを　あたえる
sourceRecords.english: Causes a quake\nthat has no effect\non flying foes.

sourceRecords.japanese: ポケモンが　なついて\nいるほど　あたえる\nダメージが　あがる
sourceRecords.english: The more the user\nlikes you, the more\npowerful this move.

sourceRecords.japanese: １ターンめで　じめんに\nもぐり　つぎのターンに\nてきを　こうげきする
sourceRecords.english: Digs underground\nthe 1st turn, then\nstrikes next turn.

sourceRecords.japanese: つよい　ねんりきを　だす\nてきの　とくぼうを\nさげる　ことがある
sourceRecords.english: A powerful psychic\nattack that may\nlower SP. DEF.

sourceRecords.japanese: くろいかたまりを　なげる\nてきの　とくぼうを\nさげる　ことがある
sourceRecords.english: Hurls a dark lump\nat the foe. It may\nlower SP. DEF.

sourceRecords.japanese: ひかりのかべ　などを\nこわして　てきに　　\nダメージを　あたえられる
sourceRecords.english: Destroys barriers\nlike LIGHT SCREEN\nand causes damage.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぶんしんを　つくって\nてきを　まどわせて\nかいひりつを　あげる
ひかりのかべを　つくり\nぶつり　こうげきの\nダメージを　よわめる
sourceRecords.english: Creates a wall of\nlight that weakens\nphysical attacks.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぜったいに　よけられない\nすばやさで　てきに\nでんげきを　あびせる
sourceRecords.english: Zaps the foe with a\njolt of electricity\nthat never misses.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほのおを　まきちらす\nあたった　てきを\nやけどさせる　ことがある
sourceRecords.english: Looses a stream of\nfire that may burn\nthe foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: ヘドロを　なげつける\nあたった　てきに　どくを\nあたえることが　ある
sourceRecords.english: Hurls sludge at the\nfoe. It may poison\nthe foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: すなあらしを　おこして\nまいターン　てきに\nダメージを　あたえる
sourceRecords.english: Causes a sandstorm\nthat hits the foe\nover several turns.

sourceRecords.japanese: だいの　もじで　すべてを\nやきつくす　こうげき\nやけどさせる　ことがある
sourceRecords.english: A powerful fire\nattack that may\nburn the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: いわで　てきの　うごきを\nふうじて　こうげき\nすばやさを　さげられる
sourceRecords.english: Stops the foe from\nmoving with rocks.\nMay lower SPEED.

sourceRecords.japanese: すばやい　うごきで　\nぜったいに　よけられない\nこうげきを　する
sourceRecords.english: An extremely fast\nattack that can't\nbe avoided.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきが　おなじわざを\nれんぞくで　だせない\nようにする
sourceRecords.english: Prevents the foe\nfrom using the same\nmove in a row.

sourceRecords.japanese: どく　まひ　やけどのとき\nこうげきの　ちからを\nあげる　ことが　できる
たたかう　ばしょに　より\nてきに　あたえる\nついか　こうかが　かわる
sourceRecords.english: Adds an effect to\nattack depending\non the location.

sourceRecords.japanese: ２ターンねむり　からだの\nいじょうと　たいりょくを\nぜんかいふく　する
sourceRecords.english: The user sleeps for\n2 turns to restore\nhealth and status.

sourceRecords.japanese: オスなら　メスに\nメスなら　オスに\nわざが　だしにくくなる
sourceRecords.english: Makes it tough to\nattack a foe of the\nopposite gender.

sourceRecords.japanese: こうげきちゅうに　すきを\nみて　てきが　もっている\nどうぐを　ぬすむ
sourceRecords.english: While attacking,\nit may steal the\nfoe's held item.

sourceRecords.japanese: かたいつばさを　おおきく\nひろげて　そのまま\nてきに　たいあたりする
sourceRecords.english: Spreads hard-edged\nwings and slams\ninto the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: わざを　だした　ターンに\nじぶんと　てきの\nとくせいを　いれかえる
sourceRecords.english: Switches abilities\nwith the foe on the\nturn this is used.

sourceRecords.japanese: てきが　つかおうとした\nわざを　うばって\nじぶんに　つかう
sourceRecords.english: Steals the effects\nof the move the foe\nis trying to use.

sourceRecords.japanese: フルパワーで　こうげき\nできるが　とくこうが\nガクッと　さがってしまう
sourceRecords.english: Enables full-power\nattack, but sharply\nlowers SP. ATK.

sourceRecords.japanese: カマや　ツメなどの\nするどいもので　てきを\nきりつけて　こうげきする
sourceRecords.english: Attacks the foe\nwith sharp blades\nor claws.

sourceRecords.japanese: １ターンめで　そらへとび\nつぎの　ターンに　てきを\nこうげきする
sourceRecords.english: Flies up on the\nfirst turn, then\nattacks next turn.

sourceRecords.japanese: みずに　なみを　おこし\nそれを　ものすごい\nちからで　たたきつける
sourceRecords.english: Creates a huge\nwave, then crashes\nit down on the foe.

sourceRecords.japanese: ぜんしんに　ものすごい\nちからを　ためこみ\nてきを　こうげきする
つよい　ひかりで　めを\nくらませて　てきの\nめいちゅうりつを　さげる
sourceRecords.english: Looses a powerful\nblast of light that\nreduces accuracy.

sourceRecords.japanese: いわをもくだく　ちからで\nてきの　ぼうぎょを\nさげる　ことがある
sourceRecords.english: A rock-crushingly\ntough attack that\nmay lower DEFENSE.

sourceRecords.japanese: たきを　さかのぼるような\nいきおいで　てきに\nとっしんする
sourceRecords.english: Attacks the foe\nwith enough power\nto climb waterfalls.

sourceRecords.japanese: １ターンめで　みずに　\nもぐり　つぎのターンで\nてきを　こうげきする
sourceRecords.english: Dives underwater\nthe 1st turn, then\nattacks next turn.

たくさん　アピール　できる
この　アピールの　あと\nびっくり　しやすく　なってしまう
sourceRecords.english: After this move, the user is\nmore easily startled.

sourceRecords.japanese: すごいアピールに　なるが　このあと\nさいごまで　なにも　できなくなる
sourceRecords.english: Makes a great appeal, but\nallows no more to the end.

sourceRecords.japanese: つづけて　だしても　しんさいんに\nあきられずに　アピール　できる
sourceRecords.english: Can be repeatedly used\nwithout boring the JUDGE.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほかの　ポケモンに　おどかされても\n１ど　くらいは　がまんできる
sourceRecords.english: Can avoid being startled\nby others once.

sourceRecords.japanese: ほかの　ポケモンに　おどかされても\nがまんできる
ほかの　ポケモンに　おどかされても\nすこし　くらいなら　がまんできる
sourceRecords.english: Can avoid being startled\nby others a little.

sourceRecords.japanese: この　わざを　だした　あとは\nあまり　びっくり　しなくなる
sourceRecords.english: After this move, the user is\nless likely to be startled.

sourceRecords.japanese: じぶんの　まえに　アピールした\nポケモンを　ちょっと　おどろかす
